greetings: I must protect my people, but these attacks weaken me.
We have but a short time before the nightmare begins again.
Asheron studies the gem very carefully, almost reverently.
So, it is done then. You have seen the Avatar, and it has agreed to help.
Asheron sighs in relief.
Good. If the Avatar will help, then there is hope.
Though it may have seemed a simple enough task for one of your obvious skill, you have done a thing far braver than you can imagine, and I thank you for it.
Please, accept this in return for your bravery, and may all know you earned the right to be called a true 'Bearer of Darkness', in service to the Light.
Bring this to my Emissary, right over there. He's presently handling all research involving Tou-Tou.
quest: There is nothing more that I can tell you at this time. I must reflect upon what has transpired and devise a way to deal with this menace. It will require the efforts of us all if this is indeed the same Queen.
Welcome. I had never thought that I would see Isparians here, aside from Elysa and Borelean. But I see that you have made your way across my island and through the Olthoi Hordes.
I have fashioned this book to explain everything that I know at this time about the resurgence of the Olthoi. I am indebted to you once more for your actions.
I am not quite sure what caused them to come here, but I am quite sure that it relates directly to the evidence turned up at Knorr.
Oh yes, I am well aware that you have been making your way through my familial estate; while I am not happy about your intrusion there, this world is as much yours as it is mine now.
Asheron smirks.

I am however, all too well aware of Nuhmudira and her quest for more power. She plays with primal forces that are far beyond her frame to contain. In some respects, I pity her for her madness; in others, I revile her for the selfish manner in which she acts.
Asheron pauses looking to his guardians.
I had assumed that the Queen at Knorr was not eternal. But this invasion has caused me to re-assess that assumption. It has been nearly 800 years since I have seen that Queen.

If she has come, then we shall need to band together as never before. I could not use the full power of my magical arsenal while those creatures were here. There was something potent that drained the higher magics from the area. Now I feel them back again. You have helped to restore me...now we need to assist ourselves.

This Queen...is the most terrible thing that this world or any other has ever seen. What is worse is that she remembers, and in that memory she undoubtedly is stalking me...but when she learns that her children have suffered so much at our hands, her attentions will be cast toward us all.
I am Asheron Realaidain, heir of Lord Atlan and Lady Maila and last scion of the Yalaini.
No. I have come to work toward alliance against our common enemy Bael'Zharon, and I believe that exchanging insults is counterproductive.
Lady Aerfalle and Lord Haranue both look upon Asheron with dark looks.
Asheron holds the chalice up and says, "Yes, we must work toward unity against a common foe." He offers the chalice to Claude.
Thank you, Isin. Know that you have chosen wisely, and repentance is not impossible even at this late date.
So be it.

Here is what I would propose, then - what I believe is needed in order to defeat Bael'Zharon. Let us obtain and use these artifacts - forge them into the keystone of a ritual, whereby I may weaken him. Then he may perhaps be defeated, at least for a time...
You must wait %tqt to receive the reward.

Asheron sighs deeply. "The Beast with Many Heads turns its minds from our thoughts and dreams to our physical forms. He is coming. I am but a memory of a minor player in the battle between the light and the darkness."
Asheron turns dreamily to look at you.
Asheron looks down at his hand as he pulls something from his pocket.
I remember the people of your world. We have been watching your race with great hope. You have so much potential. Your people are among the few in the known worlds that may be able to save mine.

Give this to me in the waking world. It will help me remember. I often wish to forget the horrors I have seen which is why Aerbax has had so much success in invading my mind. I must not forget. My people are depending on me.
Thank you once again for your help. Once I'm sure any damage done to you by bearing the page has passed, I can send you with another, if you wish to aid me further in this.
You may repeat this quest in %tqt.
Experience Bonus for first-time completion.
Luminance Bonus for first-time completion.
You have been granted the title, "Bearer of Darkness".
Ahh, good. I can feel your inner Luminance. If you will help me, I have a mission of the utmost importance for you.
I have managed to capture the elusive and dangerous Book of Eibhil, and have divined a way to seal its power from affecting this world.
To that end, I am asking you to aid me in the delicate task of bearing a small portion of the cursed tome to one who can lock it away forever.
There is a power stirring under the desert of Neftet, awoken by the A'nekshay who have escaped the slavery of the Sand Kings.
It is a power strong enough to bind the Book from harming others forever.
Find that power, a true Avatar of the Deru, and ask it to help you seal away that single page. When you have succeeded, return to me.
Ahh good, you've returned. If you will help me once again, I have a mission of the utmost importance for you.
Many pages of the Book of Eibhil still remain locked up in my care. It is not yet dispersed enough to transport the remainder safely outside these walls.
The path to the Avatar of the Deru still lays under the desert canyons of Neftet, for those who know how to walk its paths.
Return to the Avatar of the Deru, and ask it to help you seal away another single page. When you have succeeded, return to me.
I'm sorry. The mission I have at present requires one capable of bearing the Luminance of this world. Without that capacity, this path would be far too dangerous for you.
I no longer sense the evil of the page upon you. Have you located the Avatar of the Deru?
I can sense the evil of the page still upon you. Have you located the Avatar of the Deru yet? My scryings lead me to believe the path to the Avatar should begin in Neftet, with the A'nekshay.
Have you located the Avatar of the Deru yet? My scryings lead me to believe the path to the Avatar should begin in Neftet, with the A'nekshay.

I did indeed spend time studying this place. In ages past it was called the Viridian Rise. It may seem that it has sprung forth overnight, but in reality the Deru trees are all hidden by extremely strong illusions and wards. Something has disrupted one of the great trees.
Someone will have to enter this place and find out what happened.
Asheron fixes his stare on you expectantly.
The ritual to enter the Viridian Rise is hidden in the guardian statues. I do not know the ritual order, but my studies did reveal the following:
Each guardian must be invoked in order, and only once. The ritual begins with Oak and ends with Ash.
I can sense that other beings skilled in magic have also studied the area. Perhaps you can find them and convince them to share their findings with you.
You have my blessing to enter these halls, child of another sun.

Your knowledge of the passage of time on this world is not great enough to enter the chapel beyond the door. Return to my in one day's time. If you obtain the knowledge of the past by that time, test yourself again.

Sickly from birth, Geraine IV, was taken by sisters who had stepped aside from the path and brought into a state that would forever sustain his body, soul and mind. Geraine in turn taught his people, but the sisters were not so foolish to not enter this state themselves. Many sleep, while in waking dreams, they think their time nears as a new singer raises her voice. But what of Geraine? His li...

You have proven to me that you are aware of what has transpired on this world. I give you my word that you shall see the halls beyond. Speak to my brothers and prove your worthiness to them. If you succeed the door to this chapel shall be yours to open evermore.

Child of another sun, your arrival shall herald a new age. I shall paint the world that you will create in images that shall grace these walls and hold the history within. My name is Hevk Loz, my name and painting are what endure from my life. This path was my choice. I, like my brothers, record history as it transpires and form it into art that can retain the knowledge of those times. You wish...
You must know of what has transpired before you may enter.

Three sons have driven the course of this world. From birth, each had a destiny not their own. Death for two and life for three. But only one has enjoyed the gift of life and of death given by the hands of those who once walked this world as our sisters. Which of the sons is this?

Three portraits show these sons. Choose the answer to my question wisely and you shall be given my blessing to pass into this chapel. Fail and I shall need you to rethink the purpose of your task within and ask that you return when you know more of this world.
You have my blessing to enter these halls, child of another sun.

Your knowledge of the passage of time on this world is not great enough to enter the chapel beyond the door. Return to my in one day's time. If you obtain the knowledge of the past by that time, test yourself again.

With a sword soaked in the blood of people with whom she once claimed a kinship, Nali Valynd fell upon the sisters at Ithaenc. They who followed a path bathed in Light lay broken by the Nali of the Northern Church. Misguided crusaders loyal to the Nali visited mistress Aurlanna and knelt before her with proud voices proclaiming victory over the -heathens- that dwelled within Ithaenc Cathedral....

You have proven to me that you are aware of what has transpired on this world. I give you my word that you shall see the halls beyond. Speak to my brothers and prove your worthiness to them. If you succeed the door to this chapel shall be yours to open evermore.

Child of another sun, your coming to this place will inspire another work of art. Your three leaders shall grace the walls of the chapel. Their busts carved by my own hands. My name is Jif Loz, it is all I retain of my life before. Nothing can halt the ruination of my memory. It is a position of grace that I gladly accepted in a time when all who walked in Light were not lost. Ages have past, t...
You must know of what has transpired before you may enter.

In the age of the Yalain, one came to Ithaenc and laid waste to the sisters there. All were slaughtered, none survived, light was drawn thin as darkness continued to slip into the hearts of the guardians. Who lead that slaughter, who gave the orders to murder the sisters of Ithaenc Cathedral?

I have carved and polished three busts along the wall of this room, each represents an individual from that time. Choose your answer wisely and you shall be given leave to enter this place. Fail and you will need to learn more of the secrets of this world before entering.
You have my blessing to enter these halls, child of another sun.

Your knowledge of the passage of time on this world is not great enough to enter the chapel beyond the door. Return to my in one day's time. If you obtain the knowledge of the past by that time, test yourself again.

Alighting on wings, head hung in grief, looking down one last time on her aerie, watching as her children looked up, Aurlanna flew into the heavens and beyond the stars never to return. Her heart was shattered when she found that those that she had once called sisters had been killed by zealots blinded by the purpose of a throne that had forsaken its true path for power. She felt the urge to jo...

You have proven to me that you are aware of what has transpired on this world. I give you my word that you shall see the halls beyond. Speak to my brothers and prove your worthiness to them. If you succeed the door to this chapel shall be yours to open evermore.

Child of another sun, your coming to this place will inspire works of art. In time, the three races that now strive for peace shall be known in statues across this hall. I shall carve likenesses with my own hands and offer them for future generations to see. The Age of the children from another sun shall be born in that vision and there shall be memory cast within that stone. My name is Kir Loz...
You must know of what has transpired before you may enter.
Forsaking her children and Au, she laid waste to the crusaders that scoured the halls of Ithaenc clean. Her will crushed, she went beyond the stars one last time. She has yet to return. Who is she?

Along the landing of this room I have placed the statues of three such beings. Choose the answer to my question wisely and you shall be given my blessing to pass into this chapel. Fail and I shall need you to rethink the purpose of your task within and ask that you return when you know more of this world.

greetings: %s, you know not what you do. If you walk through that door and open the way, Qin Xikit will wash this world in darkness. Her wickedness will further cloud the minds of the Empyrean and all will fall. We will be wiped from the world. Rethink your actions, %s!
I fail, the crown is stolen. The way to the deceiver's hall will be opened and all that walk in light shall know darkness.

quest: You are too frail to aid me in this creature. Return when your bones are equal to that of sixty.

My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. There is no threat to the inhabitants within. Your service is not needed.

My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. The weight of time has long crushed my bones to dust and left with me with this incorporeal form. Yet, I serve my purpose with the same vigor that I did in life.

The delta is long covered in the harsh and dry sands. If the taint unleashed from the world long hidden by the portals within these halls has claim all will be fertile to point of death. Life will grow unchecked and there will be a choking that suffocates the core of this world and all who live on it.
Enter these halls and purge this taint. Then shall we rest, then shall we find peace.

Once, in a time before measure, I stood beside my sisters and together we faced our enemies without fear, full of purpose and resolve. A task so great lay before us that we sacrificed our lives to see that it would be done. My coming heralds that tasks arrival, but time has seen fit to grind my sister's bones to dust. We are no more, but still this threat looms.

Qin Xikit, Mistress of the Golden Shore, Keeper of the Kilika Vale in Ualannan's absence, lays beneath over thirty thousands years of weight. She has been silent these years imprisoned beneath her temple, bound by those who called her sister.

Once she walked amongst children of other suns and ushered them along a quickened path. Heresy! Cried our sisters and a great hunt began within our sect. A schism grew and swallowed our sisters in madness. They drew chains of mana about our immortal forms and locked our eternal bodies away.
Qin Xikit was the first to feel the sting of her sister's barbs, locked into a temple of her crafting, sealed away with the power of her crown.

Eternal silence is shattered and Qin Xikit stirs in her tomb. A gateway has opened and through it comes consumption. Sealed in her tomb the matron can do nothing and the spirits therein are all but gone. I am the last to hold vigil.

Seek her crown. Xi Ru consumed in madness, sealed Qin Xikit away. The crown must be found and the gateway to Qin Xikit's temple must be opened. At long last I can see Xi Ru's island, the magic that once locked it from sight has failed, a sister has succeeded at breaking the wards.
Rejoice! Absolution is at hand.

I will not find rest until the threat from beyond is quashed. They will spread like a plague across this world if they are not shattered. Great waves of magic shall crash against their flesh and be pulled into their bodies. Their strength will grow until they can no longer be touched and then all shall be lost beneath the weight of their power.

A great failure for our sisterhood. They grew where our chosen fell. Now they come to shattered the coil of this world as we shattered the coil of theirs. You must defeat the behemoth within these halls else its power grow until it is unchecked by any force that remains on this world.

Within the halls of High Matriarch Ixir Zi's resting place grows a threat long thought gone. When first the worlds were closed and we passed through tunnels of sound and light we wrested the world from their grasp. They seek vengeance upon those who no longer draw breath.

Their avarice knows no bounds and they will not rest even though their greatest foes lie vanquished, crushed by the weight of time. Enter these halls and destroy them lest they draw the life from this world and turn all to ruin.
A threat, not of this world grows within the belly of this temple. They have come from across the stars, across the divide between our worlds with one thought in their ravenous minds; destruction.

Their pilgrimage is for naught, there are no sisters left upon this world who draw breath, there are none who recall the glory of Golden Shores and the valley wherein Ualannan once held vigil watching over all our sisters. All is dust, but this will not deter these beasts from another world.

They come and they shall spread their rot to the core of this world and there it shall grow unfettered until all is consumed and destroyed. You must destroy the beasts within the deepest halls of the Izji Qo's temple. They have found passage within and slaughtered or consumed all souls that have stood against their trespass.

greetings: %mn's ethereal energies wash over you as its form dissipates into nothingness. You feel changed somehow.
A shrieking voice wails, "Cross over my child.  All are welcome.  Go into the Light.  There is peace and serenity in the Light."
A fading voice cries, "There is no death.  It is only a transition to a different sphere of consciousness."
%mn's ethereal energies wash over you as its form dissipates into nothingness. You feel changed somehow.
The ceaseless mountain winds whistle around Eaushi's facets.
This book was crafted by Rurinah, a member of the last class of students here. She was quite skilled in the art of parchment-making.
The process had been passed through her family for generations. She was proud to note that her grandmother had made paper for the esteemed Maila of Knorr.
This servant recalls her well - a terribly serious silver-haired girl, given to calling more lighthearted people 'fools.'
This was once worn by the mage Sasalia, who became one of our instructors. In addition to the combat arts, Sasalia was also a master of culinary magic.
An unusual combination for a Hieromancer. She often cooked for the students.
She had a rather peculiar pet, too. When she was a girl attending this school, it would sit on her head during classes.
These bring back memories. These boots were the property of Marr Areleo, one of the Exarchs of the Order.
He and his brother were responsible for patrolling certain... storehouses, ensuring they remained safely under lock and key.
This task was given to them by Caerlin I, at the behest of the mage Asheron.
It is rare to gain such a prize from the Nephol Golems, young master. This geode is said to indicate much favor. Perhaps you were born under Irihane ascendant?
No... This golem does not feel the influence of any lights it knows upon you. How odd.

This golem fears it does not recognize these letters, young master. It humbly apologizes. This golem was granted the capacity to impress its words upon the softly glowing mind, but not to read languages other than its own.
Beautiful, is it not?
This note appears to be valid... although the date seems to be... a bit off. This golem shall now teleport you to one of the five trial grounds. May light fall upon your shoulders, young apprentice.
The golem stirs to life at your touch.  "Kiya auranil..." it grumbles, then pauses.

In your mind, a mild voice says, "Good day. It has been many turns of the stars since this servant has greeted visitors. Welcome to the Ishelai Lyceum, serving in good faith His Most Serene Majesty Kellin II."
"If you are a student, the written permission of the caloyer is required for me to send you to the trials."
quest: Ah. This bauble was created by the Imperial Talespinner Mistral Tersicor. For many years he wandered the world, recording the stories of all its' people.

He disappeared from the palace at Tentael one cold night, just after Caerlin II had taken the throne. He left a note, saying that the songs of other worlds needed to be written, and that he would return in 2300 years.
Eaushi prods the orb gently. It blossoms, the blue surfaces spiraling open to reveal patches of green, brown, and white.
Well done, young master! You have defeated the first Nephol Golem. This is the first step on your path to becoming a Thaumaturge of the Order.
You must still Enkindle this girth before it may be worn.
Splendid, young master! You have defeated the second Nephol Golem. Only one remains before you may be eligible to become a Thaumaturge of the Order.
You must still Enkindle these leggings before they may be worn.
Exceptional, young master! You have defeated the final Nephol Golem. You are now eligible to become a Thaumaturge of the Order.
You must still Enkindle this coat before it may be worn, and the skill required to add the Kindling Stones to your personal battle armor is your final test before becoming a full Hieromancer.
Seek the Halls of the Hieromancers, in the northwest of Werethas.
This golem has already unlocked one of Mistral's spheres for you recently, young master. Come back in a week.
This golem was provided with the essence of the old master, and remembers. Yes, it does. He would not leave the world bereft of story.
For a moment, Eaushi's fissure-eyes twinkle a merry sea blue.
Ah, young master, you have already bested the first Nephol Golem and gained its prize recently.
If you are truly worthy of this armor, you should not require a replacement set for at least a month.
Ah, young master, you have already bested the second Nephol Golem and gained its prize recently.
Ah, young master, you have already bested the last Nephol Golem and gained its prize recently.

greetings: It is forbidden to pass these walls unless you have been given the permission of he who watches the gate. To be given that passage, hand me your key so that I may verify the inscriptions and grant you access. But be forewarned, your entry to this place will place you in direct contact with the accused. Make your decision wisely, for you may cast your vote only once.
The key, had you forgotten, is a writing infused with the magic of my masters. I will infuse the writing with the power of the dias, and then return it to you.
quest: You may cast your vote only once. I will, however, infuse your writing.

The Golem lifts a metallic hand toward the dais holding the book. A soft thrum echoes through the room, as a warm glow surrounds the book. Pages twist upon one another, and a feeling of warmth cascades over you.

Read well the words within, this is a living being that has been imprisoned. There is too much passion in the writing for it to be otherwise. Choose wisely for the work within has never been used upon living flesh before and the results are as of yet untested and unknown. This prisoner must be guilty of heinous crimes against my masters.
You may now pass. Remember your judgement is final.

greetings: You are not wise enough to enter the halls of Knorr return when you have solved this riddle.
The Golem speaks in old Yalain, a language foreign and strange, but as it speaks you gain comprehension of it's words.

A moth ate a word. To me it seemed, a piteous thing when I learned the wonder that a worm had swallowed, in darkness stolen, the song of Empyrean, our glorious sayings, A great Empyrean's strength; and the thieving guest, who was no whit the wiser for the words it ate.
Hand me that which was lost to the worm that night.
Perhaps you are drunk with the folly of which is spoken, Knorr does not open its doors for fools.
The Golem speaks in old Yalain, a language foreign and strange, but as it speaks you gain comprehension of its words.

I am valued by Empyrean, fetched from afar, Gleaned on the hill-slopes, gathered in groves, In dale and on down. All day through the air, Wings bore me aloft, and brought me with cunning Safe under roof.

Empyrean steeped me in vats, to give me power to pummel and blind, To cast to the earth, the old and young. Stripped of their strength if they cease not their folly, Loud is their speech, but of power despoiled To manage their mind, their hands or their feet.
Now give me the item, who can bind all to earth, And lay fools low in the light of day.
Perhaps have not yet learned what you shall ever be without and what shall be the force to guard you against pain and strife. Come back when you are prepared

A lonely wanderer, wounded with iron, smitten with war-blades, sated with strife,Worn with the sword-edge; I have seen many battles, many hazardous fights, oft without hope of comforts or help in the carnage of war Ere I perish and fall in the fighting hands of Empyrean.
The leavings of hammers, the handiwork of smiths, Batter and bite me, hard-edged and sharp; The brunt of the battle I am doomed to endure. No healer may mend me that a fire may cure.
Hand me the item.
Asheron did not specify that students would be arriving at the Lyceum. However since you are here I will explain transportation within this place.
Lord Master Asheron has establish a network of devices through his knowledge of Planar magic, that will ease your movement through the Lyceum construct.

I will determine the level of safety of the different areas and allow you to pass through the Planar tunnels provided that the presence of entities catalogued as, Olthoi, are small enough to allow for survival in said areas.
We are here at the behest of Lord Asheron. Our duty is to maintain peace. We ask that you observe our requests so as to not force our hands into action.
I thank you for your sacrifice.
A remnant of the Temple watched by Ixir Zi, second amongst the thirteen keepers. Impressive, but a failure nonetheless. Your blood shall be refreshing.
Foul! Your blood will be spilled and not consumed. You are of the ill get. Begone you foul usurper!
You have answered the riddle correctly and may pass through the door. The door will close within ten grains. Move quickly.
Curious. This is not what the High Matriarch desires, but it may serve to awaken her more quickly. Alas, you have failed the riddle and are mine to feast upon.

You have entered the sacred halls of Liazk Itzi, the sleeping High Matriarch of the lush and fertile Iktzil Delta. The High Matriarch sleeps and you are not of the spirits that make this temple their home. Your business then must be to bring the sacrifices that will awaken the High Matriarch and allow her to reclaim this land once more.

Beyond the door that I guard are guardians of the tunnels that lead to her resting place. They stand vigil over the spirits who were tasked to defend her temple in her absence. You may prove yourself worthy of entrance to the halls beyond by answering the riddle she has devised.

I shall act as arbiter for her and I am prepared to receive the answer that you will posit. Know this. Failure to answer this correctly will allow me to feed, and I am ever so hungry. Listen carefully, and hand me that which you believe is the answer to the High Matriarch's riddle only when you are certain. The High Matriarch wishes that the sacrifices brought to her are hers, and not mine.
The riddle is as follows: Blood of flesh has sealed me and blood can see my locks undone. Though blood came first from opened flesh, the blood to see my joints unbound is found when ground is opened.
You feel your form being torn asunder.
You have pleased me. I will sup upon the tears of her soul this night and be sated for a time. Prepare for your reward.

Within this well the wayward sister of Hizk Ri was cast beneath the world and bound by vile arts to suffer for all eternity. The restless souls, that make this place their home, have tormented the woman's soul since its imprisonment here.

If you wish to meet Hizk Ri you shall need to garner her sister's tears for me. You will need to collect them in an ancient philter, lost somewhere in this crypt. Collect them from the well and return them to me and I shall then let you pass. Go now and return to me only when you can hand me the phial of bloody tears.
Welcome to the halls of Kivik Lir's temple, child. I will now transport you to the staging area. You will be able to prepare yourself there before continuing further in your training.
I thank you for your sacrifice, unworthy one.
Infestation spreads through these halls, the cursed are so much dust. You must push beyond these invaders to lay your life before the mistress.
You must be tested to ensure that your blood will not weaken the mistress.
You enter the tomb of Mistress Qin Xikit. Lay your life before her tomb so you may see eternity. Beyond the beacon lies her receiving chamber. Welcome sister, welcome to your destiny.
We are here to protect the Emissary. Please see him if you have any questions.
quest: You feel your form being torn asunder.
Though your body feels as though it is being ripped apart briefly, nothing happens.
You may advance through the halls of Hizk Ri, Matron of Pain. Be warned, you dwell amongst the hopeless and cruel.
You have entered the halls of Hizk Ri, the Matron of Pain. Your presence is unwelcome. You have disturbed a perfect order that has existed for eons. What right have you to enter these halls, cur?
Do not answer. Your presence marks a return of the ancient ways. You shall be tested and if not found wanting, you shall find your way to the seat of the Matron's power and wake her from her slumber.
I pray that you fail, for power such as Hizk Ri's should never be loosed upon the world. We have suffered for millennia under her cruel wiles.

The pillars scattered about the room are devoted to the bodies that hang in the sky above. A riddle seals their secret and bars entrance to the halls beyond. I shall issue this riddle after this final warning: return to me for judgment only when the riddle is solved. If you fail to do so you will be struck dead where you stand. If you return to me with only half the puzzle solved you will be st...

The riddle is as follows: Au, the light of this world, hangs in the east, opposed to star of portent. To the north, the moon run red with blood watches its twin in the south. Prove your worth, or die trying.
Au, the light of this world, hangs in the east, opposed to the star of portent. To the north, the moon run red with blood, watched its twin in the south. Prove your worth, or die trying.
You have trespassed where you do not belong. Be thankful I cannot gift you with death.

As you approach the Guardian, you hear what sounds like Burun on the other side of the wall. Before you can even formulate second thoughts the Guardian pulls you forward into the next area of the temple.
As you approach the Guardian, you hear what sounds like Burun on the other side of the wall. It is apparent that the Guardian does not feel you are suited for the area beyond.
The folly of speaking with me before the presenting my lady's glyph was pronounced. I shall enjoy your blood, unworthy one.

The Lady of this temple, Kivik Lir, has deemed it closed to visitors. Only her students may pass through the gates beyond. Should the student present a glyph bearing the union of blood and shadow, the doors of knowledge shall open. Those without the glyph of the Lady Kivik Lir shall be turned away from this temple, for her knowledge is not for you.
Heed my warnings. I shall sup upon your blood and send you from this place should you speak with me again, or should you fail to present the correct glyph.

As you approach the Guardian, you hear the sounds of Burun on the other side of the wall. Before you can act upon your second thoughts, the Guardian's magic pulls you forward into the next area of the temple.
A distorted and frightened voice states, "You are not fit to traverse these halls. Find a way better suited to you, or flee this place."
Portal space wells around you, causing slight discomfort.
The statue appears to be like every other statue found on Dereth; stone carved by an ancient race that has long since left this world.

greetings: Crumple beneath my blows, small one!
You attack us? Here? You will not leave this place alive.
A magic lightshow? You should probably run now mage.
A magic light show? You should probably run now mage.
Your bones are brittle and your flesh is soft. Death was an inevitability.
You have come to a crossroads where your life shall come to an end!
Your power is not in the endeavour of magic. Does it lie in a test of arms?

Muldaveus' voice thunders over the land, "Niarltah, we must flee. The Isparians have overrun our position. Come Morgluuk and Torgluuk, we will take you to the safety of our hidden fortress. Fostok, Amanua, get in here and clean up this tripe!"
Another body for the fire. Thank you for your gift.
Your frame is as weak as Kresovus's spirit!
Just another victim.
Isparian! You shall taste the weight of Gotrok steel even in your next life.
These preceedings would have brought peace to your race, but I see you prefer to the peace of death sooner than your brethren.
Your magic is too weak to penetrate band of chorizite. Call your words no more or earn my ire.
What did you wish to prove by twisting your tongue in such a fashion? That you can scream like a wounded mattekar.
%s has struck a mortal blow to Fostok. As the Lugian General falls to the ground motionless, his helmet falls from his head.
Legs are not meant to twist about the head in such a fashion are they? I thought not frail one!
This ends by my fists and weapons. Your body shall crumple like the walls of Linvak Tukal!
If this is the only means at your disposal to strike fear into my heart, I think you should rethink your position and flee toward the exit.
I wish for challenge in my victories, but you prove to be no more challenge than an armoredillo.
A breach in our defense, brothers to arms!
This magic you speak of, when will you begin to utilize it?
Bah, we are not mercenaries.  Anything we wish to say, we say, coins or no coins.  But I'll keep the money.  It is the cost of your insult.
There are rumors of Carenzi infestations on the island, but we're not worried.
News! A search party has been sent for Hea Toneawa. We believe he is consorting with the enemy.
Hea Riketura has announced a bounty on the heads of our Aun brethren. Those who bring him an Aun birth pendant shall be rewarded handsomely!
The Aun have placed a bounty on the atual arutoa, who helped us gain our freedom. Now the enemy of the Virindi are also our enemy!
All Hea should report to Rangaua for briefing on the Palenqual affair. From this time forward the Hea shall have no traffic with the Aun.
News! More Hea are leaving the island than ever before!  All Hea who wish to rejoin with our brethren in Osteth must first fullfill their obligations to the atual arutoa.
Heed my warning, pale one. Our glorious tah, Hea Arantah, has gained many powers from his dealings with the atual arutoa. But he is... passionate. Do not meddle in his affairs if you value your life.

Many years ago, when Hea and Aun lived together in Timaru, the atual arutoa greeted our glorious tah. The Aun were cruel and cold to him, though they will tell you otherwise. An orphan, they cared for him not. Starving, they feed him not. To Hea Arantah alone, chosen of the atual arutoa, were offered powers of great wrath, with which he lead the outcast and scorned children of Timaru into the w...

Hea Tuperea hunts for our tah along the base of the plateau. If you meet in your travels, stay upwind of him. His hunters are fierce, and have been been given their share in the blessings of the atual arutoa. Mighty and strange are the atual arutoa, who care even to bless the beasts of the field.

The poacher Aun Ralirea vexes our tah. He hunts the things you call gromnies, up among their lairs on the plateau. Hea Arantah has set aside a great reward for the one who brings him proof of Ralirea's demise. I suppose he would even grant it to a soft one like you, if you managed it. But don't try to decieve our glorious tah by claiming the deed of another! He can read your keh like the speedi...

The Aun xuta shall not long sully the lands which belong to the Hea xuta. Our glorious tah has set keen-eyed Hea Temenua and his brothers to watch the plateau. They will drive all from our rightful and well-earned holdings! Long ago, it was Temenua who captured the first of your kind that we met. She was given unto the atual arutoa, who said to us then, "Here are the ones we have gifted you in...
The atual arutoa watch over us, and our lands. You will not see them, but they are here, learning of Wharu.
Wharu's children are diligent. Their mother will return. They will see to it. As will the friends of the atual arutoa.

The rings the Aun shamans use are old and weak, like their arrogant tah. Every time the shamans beat their drums, the stones tremble. All that would be required to break them is a greater noise than that of Aun drums. Our glorious tah, Hea Arantah, would be much pleased if this were done.

The wretched Aun quiver in fear of Wharu's might. His hordes can eat the heart from the mightiest lodge's supports, and sweep the land of all but the bare stone and clean white bones. Aun drummers alone hold his divine shadow from swallowing the sun. But he shall be freed - so the atual arutoa have roared in the kehs of our xuta.

You reel as a tremendous shock wave passes through you upon the vanquishing of Dranith Menacet.  A horrible din rises up in the background, and then slowly fades away.  You hear the voice of Dranith Menacet echo loudly in your mind, 'Do you think this means you've won?  Do you really?  Our plan has only begun, flesh.  This is only the start.  Soon you will see what your victory has meant.  Empt...

A flash of purple light streaks through the horizon and you hear a shattering thunderclap in the distance.  A strange hollow voice echoes in your mind, 'Our conquest begins today.  At this point we are merely a rumble.  Soon we will be the thunder that shakes the very flesh off your bones.  Our time is soon, human.  Very soon.'  The voice fades away, leaving you with a dizzying headache.
Weak fleshy things.  You are so horrible.  I hate you!
So many of you humans.  Come to me.  Come and meet your doom.
Do you think the glow can hurt me?  I laugh at your glows.
Father...I have failed you...again...
As Dranith Menacet's dying sighs fade into the stillness, a crumpled note, worn and creased from many readings, tumbles from his broken frame.
Father...Father... My body crumbles to dust, am I forgotten. I am forgotten. I am dead. I am sorry father I have failed you and will rise no longer.

%s has slain Dranith Menacet. As the Hollow Minion bleeds its last bit of life onto the ground, it calls to its father in a child-like voice. "Father, I have failed you. They will find the way to your home." In Rithwic, a new portal appears.
My weakness is not yet complete, but oh the pain of being forgotten and abandoned.

%s has struck Bael'Zharon a mortal blow! The Hopeslayer, already weakened by the magic of Asheron, is driven from this plane of existence. As he retreats, his voice rends the air across Dereth, "Puppets of the Yalain! You have defeated me here, with the collusion of a great collection of rabble. But you will never rid the world of my power, and my minions will carry on the war without me! As fo...
Yes, my vassal, I will provide you the supplies you need, for a small fee.
The life outside of Asheron's protection is a tough road and I can sell you the supplies you will need for your journey.
I am Bael'Zharon, welcome to my lair
I'm sure one of my other vassals can use this
You're sure you won't need that?  Well, ok, I'm sure I can find someone who will like it.
Some rat has taken some of my pants, but they don't know how to drop them, so it must be terribly hard to sell them!
Put that too good use and kill, kill, kill!
Be strong my loyal follower of darkness!
Some of my sparring clothes seem to have up and walked away, but you buy from the source!
Could you spare me some money?
The wind carries a strong odor of tumeroks.
Thanks!
You're very kind...
Wing collectors will reward you for the wings of gold phyntos wasps that are found in the Direlands, but no one else will.
Near the main tumerok camp, outside of town, is a portal into the Direlands.  Supposedly there's a portal that comes back from the Direlands, too, but it's guarded by tumeroks on the other side.
Thank you.

I heard that a few brave men and women live in the Direlands in isolated outposts.  But even so, there aren't any towns as big or as extensive as, say, Cragstone.  Direlands travel is dangerous, no matter how you look at it.

I heard about some mage who got captured by Tumeroks. Heh! These absent-minded wizards. I think she's got some rare spell components on her. Her sister, Yu Vuo-Ki, sometimes walks around to the northwest of here. But good luck finding her!
Thank you stranger! I can get a good meal and a hot bath with this!
The snake sighs and uncoils from the coin.
"You have lifted the curse. Finally, I may rest." The small snake coils in on itself biting its tail.
Here, a small token of my gratitude.
Could you spare me some money so I can buy food for my family?
Will you help the poor with some money?
You are too generous.
Tumeroks have some basic building skills and have also taken over many Empyrean ruins in the Direlands, so you'll see numerous walled forts over there.
It's said that some of them are locked, so you might need to find the right key, or know someone who can pick the locks!
Thank you.
It's said that tumeroks are crawling all over the Direlands.  There's even supposed to be a big, hidden, underground fortress somewhere, where the biggest and most powerful tumeroks live.
Is that all you can spare?
Thanks...
Not all types of tumeroks carry insignia, you know.  For example, mere tumerok warriors and tumerok  priests never carry such things.

Have you heard about the imprisonment of the mage Dansha-Ki? I heard she was carrying some pretty strange spell components. Look for her sister, Yu Vuo-Ki, who can sometimes be found wandering around to the northwest of here.
Thank you stranger! I can get a good meal and a hot bath with this!
The snake sighs and uncoils from the coin.
"You have lifted the curse. Finally, I may rest." The small snake coils in on itself biting its tail.
Here, a small token of my gratitude.
I don't want to beg, but I need some money.
Thank you for helping a poor begger...

There's a strange rumor about an underground temple in the Direlands that's oddly similar to one in Osteth, near the Sho area.  They say some ancient race of Empyrean must have made them.  But who'd want to live in a swamp?
Thank you, kind soul!
%n kisses your hand in appreciation.

I heard the tumeroks surrounding Dryreach are from the swamp area of the Direlands.  The main swamp in the Direlands is on the eastern shore, but there are apparently swampy areas elsewhere in there, too.
May Asheron keep you from harm.
You are very kind...
Have you heard the name Bael'Zharon?  I keep hearing it on the wind, and it every time it makes me shudder!
Poor Dansha-Ki. She's gotten herself captured by Tumeroks again. Her sister, Yu Vuo-Ki, knows the details. I think Yu Vuo-Ki sometimes wanders the land to the northwest.
Thank you stranger! I can get a good meal and a hot bath with this!
The snake sighs and uncoils from the coin.
"You have lifted the curse. Finally, I may rest." The small snake coils in on itself biting its tail.
Here, a small token of my gratitude.
I don't want to beg, but I need money to buy food with.
Have you any spheres or jewels of obsidian?  If you give me such, I shall give back to you something of value.
I am seeking items crafted of pure obsidian, of the rarest kind.  I do not want the raw form.
My specialty is in crafting magic orbs and potions from crafted obsidian.
Hold on, I'm getting your item.
Here you go.
My specialty is creating magic orbs and potions from certain pieces of crafted obsidian.  If you have such an item, give it to me and I will return a useful and rare item.
Have you any spheres or jewels of obsidian?  If you give me such, I shall give back to you something of value.
I am seeking items crafted of pure obsidian, of the rarest kind.  I do not want the raw form.
My specialty is in crafting wands and orbs from crafted obsidian.
Hold on, I'm getting your item.
Here you go.
My specialty is creating magic gems and potions from certain pieces of crafted obsidian.  If you have such an item, give it to me and I will return a useful and rare item.
My specialty is in crafting magic adornments from crafted obsidian.
My specialty is creating magic adornments from certain pieces of crafted obsidian.  If you have such an item, give it to me and I will return a useful and rare item.
This is a dangerous place...
Be careful.
%n hiccups.
Me thanks.
Whatcha trying ta do, kill me!?
Not bad, but leaves me through dry.
AIEEE!!!!!
Hey!  This is good stuff.  Say, givya a tip.  Yas best stay away from dem mines to the south of here.  They make ya crazy like me.
Hee hee hee!
They tried to wall off the portals.  Hee!
Freedom!  Freedom from safety!  The path of strife!
Hic!
Ah, a drink!  Hee, hee!
I know the secret walled portal path, and I will let you enter it. See?
Ah, What's this?
That wasn't too nice. I'd like some sake, please.
Hmm. This doesn't look like sake.
Doesn't taste like sake either!
This doesn't smell like sake...
If I wanted coffee I would have asked for it.
Apple Juice! You must be kidding!
Ale? Thanks! I'm real partial to sake though. *hiccup*!
Didn't you understand me? I want sake, not cider!
Hah! This isn't sake, you fool.
I'd thank you for this drink, but I asked for sake.
What's this? It doesn't look like sake.
Not Sake!? NOT Sake! YOU!!! I'll g...
Oh right, you must want to see Ulgrim. He said people might be looking for him. Ok, I'll portal you there this time, but next time you better bring me sake!
You probably didn't hear me. I want sake, not red wine.
What is this? Doesn't look like sake....
And it's broken!  Now leave me alone!
I forgot to tell you...I'm a vegetarian!
Oh! That was fun!
Entering damn portal-space!
Have you read the note on the pedestal?
If that is what you desire, then fetch me a good drink of sake, and I shall grant your wish.  Otherwise, leave this place.  Hee, hee!
Hee hee hee!
They tried to wall off the portals.  Hee!
Freedom!  Freedom from safety!  The path of strife!
Hic!
Ah, yes, that's it, that's it!
Here, let me grant you the shortcut.  May your journeys be blessed with danger, just as Loredane's was.
Safety-weary traveler, seek you true danger from others like yourself?
Then I will give you a shortcut to that which you seek.  This is my service to those who wish to be free of Asheron's bonds.
Bring me the Broken Sigil from the dungeon to the south, and I will give you the shortcut you desire!
Wonderful! As a reward, Scholar Dai Ya in town might be interested in this piece of writing.
Greetings. If you are a newcomer, I have a small task for you. If you succeed, I shall reward you.
Nearby, just to the east and in a stand of trees, is a small cave infested with drudges. They've stolen my favorite bracelet. If you recover it for me, I'll give you a reward.
Nearby, hidden amidst the swamp trees to the east, is the deserted ruin where some lived before Yanshi was founded.  Follow the gaze of the statues.

Unless you have lockpicking or a friend who has the skill, you will need this key once inside. If you recover one of the writings of Jhong Mi and take it to Scholar Dai Ya in Yanshi, he will reward you and give you more information.
Greetings.
Follow the GLOWING ARROWS and DOUBLE-CLICK on the "?" SIGNS.  DOUBLE-CLICK on me to hear what I have to say.
Read the "?" SIGNS by DOUBLE-CLICKING them, and follow the GLOWING ARROWS.  DOUBLE-CLICK on me to hear what I have to say.
Welcome!  The Training Master is at the end of these Halls.  Please follow the GLOWING ARROWS to get to the end.  DOUBLE-CLICK the signs along the way to read them.
Double-click on me to hear what I have to say.
Good! Now, double-click on the Application Form on my desk to pick it up and add it to your inventory. Then, click on it and drag it to me.
Now we can begin to train you. Here is the key to the Practice Area Doors. It will open another door besides just this one.
To unlock the door, double-click on the key, then click on the door. Then, double-click on the door to open it. Look inside the next room for the next Guard!
No, thank you. Once you leave this Academy, this letter will serve as an introduction to others who will need your help.
No, thank you. You must use this key on the door to my office.
quest: Hurry! The Outer Courtyard is still under attack! You must help the Royal Guard immediately! Use the portal to the Central Courtyard and talk to the Senior Guard--he will send you to the Outer Courtyard.
Don't worry, I have already signed you in. Go ahead and use the key I gave you to continue to the next room to learn about picking up objects and manipulating your Viewpoints.
Good! Now, double-click on the Application Form on my desk to pick it up and add it to your inventory. Then, click on it and drag it to me.

Hail, fellow Isparian! The kingdom is in danger, and we need more brave adventurers like you. But first, we must train you. Click on the Backpack in the lower right corner of your screen to open your Inventory. Click on the blue Calling Stone, and drag it to me.

greetings: Many newcomers forget to improve their skills.  Once you are in the world and have battled real monsters, click on the triangle with the symbol of an arm.  Then you can improve your attributes and skills.
Barkeeps in the main towns usually sell information about where to find adventure.  Be sure to seek them out!
Much of the advice I can give you is already provided via magical Help.  Click the question mark at the top right of your screen for much more information.
Traveling with friends is the safest way to travel.
Be sure to use the Lifestone in towns and outposts.
Other dungeons in Dereth are often dangerous and difficult.  Proceed slowly, and try not to get lost.  The monsters often get tougher the deeper into the dungeon you go.

If you come across a new monster or item, use the magnifying glass to try to learn more information.  Since your assessment or appraisal skills are used, you may not learn very much if those skills are low.
Do not fear: the monsters in the Training Halls are not real monsters.  They cannot hurt you, and they also do not feel pain.
I must warn you that you cannot return to the Training Halls after you progress beyond Level 1.
No, that is not of interest to me, and I think you will need it later.  I seek the Calling Stone, which is given to all newcomers.

Well done! Here is a healing tonic for you, as well as some experience points that you can spend to increase a skill. Once you're outside, double-click on the inhabitants of the outpost. They might have a need for your services.
If you have a Calling Stone, please give it to me by DRAGGING it from your inventory onto me.  Stand near me when you give me the Stone so that I can give you your reward.
Double-click on me to hear what I have to say.

Ah, you must have confused me with Jonathan. Give this token to Jonathan and he will let you exit the Training Academy early. But beware! If you leave before you've been fully trained, you may be in for frequent trips to the Life Stone!
As you proceed through the Training Area, warriors should read the signs on the left. Spellcasters should read the signs on the right.
The signs will tell you how to retrieve the Academy Token. Bring that token back to me.
quest: Hurry! The Outer Courtyard is still under attack! You must help the Sentry immediately! Run through this area to the Central Courtyard and take the portal to the Outer Courtyard.

As you proceed through the Practice Area, warriors should read the signs on the left. Spellcasters should read the signs on the right. There are three chests filled with goodies hidden in this room--see if you can find them all!

Excellent work! You have completed your combat training! You may now take the portal to the Central Courtyard. Once you have teleported to the Central Courtyard, speak to the Academy Foreman to continue your training.

greetings: Thank you.  Here is the letter I would like you to give Shin Ro, who is the Archmage's Apprentice in Nanto itself.  He will give you a small reward.
Can you please help me?  Here is the letter I would like you to give Shin Ro, who is the Archmage's Apprentice in Nanto itself.  He will give you a small reward.
I take this with gratitude. I'll open the door for you, but be warned, this is a risky venture. If you should fail, you will return to this place outside of the sealed tower...And I give no refunds.
Oh, if you find something of interest I might be able to identify it for you.
You should hurry. I'll close the door for you in a minute.

This is clearly broken. There is one person I know who might have the knowledge and skill to repair this. He lives in the Mite Maze dungeon north of Arwic, located at 41.1N x 57.2E. Sorry I can't be more help.
I thank you, but what I really need is a trade note from any shop worth 5000 pyreals.
I lost this while trying to flee from the dungeon. Thanks for finding it.
While excavating this site, I inadvertently awakened the undead that rest here. I was able to escape the dungeon with my life, but before doing so I found a large audience chamber with treasure.

Offer me any trade note worth 5000 pyreals and I'll give you access to the dungeon. In return, you can keep anything you find in there. I can use the trade note to further my investigation in this site.

From what I was able to uncover so far, I believe this area was once a place used by powerful Gharu'ndim War Mages. Any relics you find may be difficult for you to use. Yet, perhaps you will be able to understand what I could not. You can't go down there if you're not level 20, in fact I wouldn't go down there if I were you. Just forget the whole thing, you're better off that way.
Ah, my love!
Tallial sniffs and wipes her eyes.
The last time I saw Joffre... Sir Tremblant... he was exploring the mountains to the west of the castle... Looking for the entrance to that accursed city!
Please, leave me be...
Just as I suspected.  Thank you for your bravery.  People have complained about the reward I granted for service in the past.  Perhaps this antique hauberk will be more appreciated.
What's this? This note must belong to my seneschal, Gormling. Please return it to him.
Welcome to Neydisa Castle.  We are a peaceful settlement, but MacDugal's band of raiders has recently re-occupied the castle to the east.  I am sure they are planning something vile.
If you are able to bring back to me evidence of MacDugal's plans, I will grant you a reward from my castle's armory.
quest: And someone of your obvious experience deserves a bit more.

greetings: Hey, money! I appreciate it. Your contributions are welcome.
I heard a secret, but it'll cost you more than that.

So, Samuel in Eastham claims to have some sort of new wonder drink! He says it cured him of his nightmares. So, I went to the Singularity Caul, got some of those bits he makes the drink from, and gave them over... Can't say that it did much for me outside of clinging to my throat on the way down...
Have you found them yet? Those Singularity Caul reliquaries I keep hearing about? I hear people have found some strange items in them!
Lord Kresovus has put out a call for help. The Queen offered her aid, but he said he would rather seek assistance from independent adventurers. I wonder what that's all about?
The Queen is looking for help in finding out how Carlo di Cenza found his way to Dereth. Talk to Antius Blackmoor in Yaraq if you wish to help!
Last month I found what I thought was the most powerful sword I have yet come across. But this month, I found an even better one! This a good time to be a hunter!
Has that 50,000 pyreal piece of armor been cluttering up your house chest for too long? Well, go to Shoushi, Yaraq, or Holtburg and sell it!
A friend of mine was hunting the Singularity Caul when he came across a powerful new creature. It was a tough fight, he said, but he got a nifty spear out of the deal.

My good friend Loh-Gann Huhjj found a page from Carlo di Cenza's journal on the beach near the northern Beach Fort. It appears to be part of a much larger work. I sure hope he finds all the pieces. I am very interested in this Viamontian's past.
If you stand on the northern shores and listen closely enough, you can hear the screams of war. What madness makes its home up there? And when will it find its way to our lands?

Oh just like everyone else, my advice is only good enough for a paltry amount of pyreals! Well thank you, Mr. Pyrealbags this'll go a long way toward providing for my family. I'm sure that an egg will feed me, my three kids and my spouse.
Oh you just don't know...

Need a vassal? I won't ask for much just some tinkered armor and maybe a tinkered weapon. Oh and maybe a few MMD trade notes, or maybe some golem hearts, wasp wings, armoredillo spines, lugian sinews, dark revenant thigh bones, full sturdy iron key rings, full singularity key rings, or anything else that you don't need.
They say that Asheron went back home. I can't wait to see what he does, now that he's in control of the place.
Town criers are available in most major towns to tell you of the latest news and events. We'll also give you a piece of information for a bit of money.
Has it really been a year since poor Samuel was discharged from the Royal Guard? I would like to say Eastham was better for it, but... well... Sam hasn't done much outside of drink.
I can't wait to put this back together!
The Town Crier produces a handful of some blackened mineral.
Wait, you can't have this! It's mine! If you want some for yourself, you'll have to get it on your own!
I was speaking with a Lugian friend of mine the other day when he mentioned something about a great disturbance. He refused to elaborate, though I plied him with enough ale to drop a horse.
Have you read Carlo di Cenza's journal? I've never heard of a place called Shadow Pass, though I suspect the world outside of Dereth is much larger than we suspect.
If you're looking for some powerful weaponry, I recommend hunting some of Dereth's tougher creatures.
The vendors in Shoushi, Yaraq, and Holtburg must have benefited from those newly relocated casinos. They seem to have several more pyreals in their possession than usual.
What's the story behind these Banished creatures? They sure sound scary to me.
Who is this Sezzherei I keep hearing about? And what does he want with the Caul?
The Queen is greatly disturbed by the recent attack on the Royal Vaults. She fears we may not have heard the last of these mysterious Lugians.
The wind from the north grows cold. I fear a storm may be on the horizon.

Did you know that they moved us to a new pay schedule? We only get paid once a month, and only on the first day of the month. But I'm expected to be at my post the same amount of hours... Oh sure the town crier is here for you, but where's the love for us, huh?

So I'm sure you've noticed that I haven't left this spot in nearly four years. Yeah it's a tough life, standing here all day. Sure... sometimes people are nice enough to give me Shackles of Obedience. But I was wondering...Need a patron?
What news... traveler?
Hey, money!  I appreciate it.  Your contributions are welcome.
I wonder how Flufens is faring? It has been many weeks since she started her farm out by the western shore.
Have you just arrived? Have you SEEN the Tumies up on the plateau? Sweet mothers, I didn't even recognize them! They have... have TAILS! And their magic is different from ours!

Watch out for the Tumerok they call Tuperea. He's a hunter, we think. He has a pack of trained reedsharks that he uses to flush the siraluun from cover. But to that one, everything is prey - including you.

We've had a lot of problems with brigands lately. Not just us, for that matter. The Tumies are bedeviled by them too. Queen Elysa's Advocates think they're coming from Vesayen. Doesn't it just figure? MacDugal and MacNiall cause trouble wherever they go.

We don't go up on the plateau much. It's riddled with Olthoi hives, and the land is...queer. Everything is overgrown with patches of fungus, like you find in Olthoi tunnels.  It's almost as if it's been changed to suit them. The bugs up there do seem smarter, but not enough to do something that big. Our sage likes to call it an "infection."

If you want my advice, stay off the plateau. Leave it to the Tumies. There are Olthoi up there, Saint Elysa preserve us. And not just the sorts we're become used to back on Dereth!  You ever hear about the breed they used to defend their eggs with? The kind they used to suppress slave rebellions in the hives? The Zaikhal Arcanum called that sort "praetorian," after the Roulean Imperial guard. T...
There is something that I don't trust about that Britana.  Beautiful, you say?  Like a black widow spider, perhaps.
Behdo Yii in Redspire is looking for assistance to help clear out an abandoned Tumerok Outpost.  Please help him!
News! Travelers beware: Tumerok factions are battling for possession of the island! Do not get caught in the crossfire! Adventure in groups! Ration your supplies! Watch your pyreals!
News! Burn and electrocution victims have been limping back into town for weeks. We have not yet determined what out in the wilderness could cause this much agony.

I don't know why the Tumeroks up on the plateau look different. We've noticed that the ones in Ahruenga - that's their town on the west coast - are a bit bent. And that chief of theirs is... worrying. Don't tell them I said any of this. There are stories...

The Tumeroks here are split into two warring tribes. The ones up on the plateau are funny sorts. Actually, they're rather nice. Bit preachy. The ones down here though, the ones that look like the ones on Dereth... *shudder*
We've heard from the Tumies that there are some massive Empyrean ruins up on the plateau. None of us have seen them yet, though. I think they called them "walls to stay the water."
We've heard reports of a new Mattekar roaming the northern parts of the island.  I've heard some unscruplous folks are already trying to find ways of processing the hide.  The poor, poor mattie.
Deep in the forests on the plateau, I have received word of glints of steel, surrounded by a purplish glow.  I shudder to think at what new weapons of destruction are used up there.  *Shivers*
I hear this island used to be called Marae Lassel.  It sounds Viamontian to me.  A snooty lot, eh?

We sent a few scouts up on the plateau recently. They reported a bunch of the old menhir rings standing up there. The funny Tumeroks even built their town around one. They seem awfully interested in them, if you ask me.

The great years are gone, if you ask me. Where can you find the like of Wari al-Sha'im these days, or Lord Cragstone, or Saint Elysa? Ah, I tell you, if the Olthoi could produce another queen, many would die before she could be defeated.
Every once in a while we hear a rumor that Virindi were spotted up on the plateau. If there are any of them, they hide themselves well. I can't imagine what they want there.
Ooo hoo oo oo.
Oo hoo oo aa.
%n chortles, then scratches its behind.
Aaa aa oo.
Oo aaa oo hoo hoo hoo hoo.
Bobo.
Ooo oo aaa aaa aaa. Hoo.
Ooo?
Ooo oo, aaa, ooo ooo hoo hoo haa haa!
Thanks! I had a bad case of the shakes there. Here's a key to get you into those caves up there.
Those scary caves... It's giving me the shakes again...  Oh, those caves of ice!

There's something really strange about those caves north of here.  Gives me the shakes just to think about it... Hey, be a nice kid and get me a bowl of Carrot Soup, and I'll tell you what's what, all right?
You've found it!  Oh, thank you, thank you, you've saved my life!  Here, take these...  And go ahead and keep those notes.
Oh, I don't really need that back.  Did you happen to find my bag down there?  I dropped them both in the same room, dratted insects!
Sorry, I'm too busy with my own problems right now...
quest: That's not much for someone of your stature. But this is all I can give you.

greetings: Right, thanks.  Ye're a toff.  Take this note to MacDugal and he'll treat yer right.  Now sod off and let me drink in peace!
Wotcha, mush. Keep this on the hush-hush, will yer? Here's somefin' fer yer troubles. Got 'em off some passing rogue in green armor. Shifty-eyed manker.
Oi, mush! Want ter do me a favor? It's tough ter get a decent drink around here, especially wiv the prices Gorth charges.
Fetch me a bottle of Olde Ispar Stout from Neydisa Castle, down the road to the west, and I'll put in a good word fer yer with MacDugal!
quest: Wot? Not enough? Well don' ye have the big britches! Here, then.

greetings: Hey, I have something you might want...
Remember, you didn't get this from me...
Listen, I just "acquired" the Seal of Dericost. It's yours if you can part with any trade note worth 10,000 pyreals.
Hey, I have something you might want...
Remember, you didn't get this from me...
Listen, I just "acquired" the Seal of Dericost. It's yours if you can part with any trade note worth 50,000 pyreals.
Thanks for the green taper
awarding 1000 xp via the AwardXp emote!
you deserve mace experience! Have 1000 points of it! (If you don't have mace trained, it will be wasted.)
now, to test some more, give me a WaspWingGreen.
you deserve a point of missile defense! Hope you have it trained, or it will be wasted.
Have you completed the EmoteTestDrudgeKillerQuest twice?
Now I will see if you have done the EmoteTestSwordQuest three times!
I am removing the EmoteTestDrudgeKillerQuest from your quest table!
type @quests to make sure it is gone!
Give me a WaspWingMire to continue testing.
I am incrementing your EmoteTestDrudgeKillerQuest by 1.
type @quests to verify that this has been done one time.
Give me a WaspWingJungle to continue testing.
I am decrementing your EmoteTestDrudgeKillerQuest by 1.
type @quests to verify that this has now been done zero times.
Give me a Heaume to continue testing.
Here is a training credit! Wow!
Give me a Helmet to continue testing.
Thanks! Let me see if you are over level 20.
I really hate apples!
Enjoy that Vitae loser.
Give me a drudge charm and maybe I'll forgive you.
Dance, fool, dance!
Now give me a male tusker token (TokenTuskerMale). But look at your deaths (on the burden panel) first.
I'm going to make you die 100 deaths.
You have died 100 times more! Ahahahah! (Check your burden panel to see how many times you have died.)
Now give me a female tusker token (TokenTuskerFemale).
Didn't like that, huh? Okay, okay, you didn't die 100 more times. (Check your deaths again.)
Now give me a tusker slave token (TokenTuskerSlave).
Instead of adding to your deaths, I can just set them. Here, you have died exactly 3 times.
Now give me a tusker guard token (TokenTuskerGuard).
Oooh, pretty! I'll give you something for that!
There you go! Enjoy your incomparable jewelry.

greetings: Here you are.
You are the brave soul who slew the great Nexus Crystal? Take this suit of Amuli armor as a tribute to your prowess.
I have no idea what to do with a  gem of this power. But I have heard of three collectors, two brothers and a sister, who may seek a gem like this. I believe they live near Uziz.

Nuhmudira has finally restored us to full health!  She has also stocked us with some extra supplies that we needed, such that we can provide you with either a version of the original Shadow Armor, or its successor.  If you wish to trade one version of your Amuli set for another, simply hand it to me.  Please take out all Atlan stones from your armor before handing it to me.

Also, if you wish to color your new Greater Shadow Armor, you may buy a vat of color from my assistant.  If you do not like the color, please give me the armor piece and I will replace it with the standard piece, which you may then choose to recolor.
The crystals from the shadows have powers which can be harnessed for use in great armor.
Be always on the lookout soldier.
quest: A small gem... delightful. Take these leggings. Another glimmering gem will allow me to make you a coat as well.
Here is a coat to complete your suit of armor.
Back again? I can do no more for you unless you make a more powerful gem. Unless ...
If you really must have another set of that inferior armor, however, give me this gem again and I will see what I can do.
A gem of moderate power. Here is a fine set of Amuli leggings for you. With another sparkling gem, I could make you an Amuli Coat to match.
Another gem. I will make for you an Amuli coat imbued with the gem's power.
You have a complete suit already. Take this gem back.
A great gem. You must have slain many shadows and crystals.  Take these leggings as a reward. And remember, I can also make you a coat with another gem.
Another great gem.  Allow me to complete your suit of armor with this Amuli coat. Take vengeance for me and my colleagues against the shadows!
You already possess armor as strong as I am currently able to craft. Take this back.
Unless ... If you want another suit, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.

greetings: Here you are.
This is the gem from the core of the Nexus Crystal, is it not? A worthy achievement, indeed. I will make you the greatest suit of armor in Dereth.
Though it shames me to admit so, this gem is beyond my talents. I will not tamper with it. There are some gem collectors outside of Uziz, however, who may be able to help.

Nuhmudira has finally restored us to full health!  She has also stocked us with some extra supplies that we needed, such that we can provide you with either a version of the original Shadow Armor, or its successor.  If you wish to trade one version of your Celdon set for another, simply hand it to me.  Please take out all Atlan stones from your armor before handing it to me.

Also, if you wish to color your new Greater Shadow Armor, you may buy a vat of color from my assistant.  If you do not like the color, please give me the armor piece and I will replace it with the standard piece, which you may then choose to recolor.
I craft armor with the powerful Scintillating Gems from the shadows.
Best of luck with your adventures in these lands.
quest: A small gem. Hmph. Here is your lower-body armor. If you care to bring me another of these small gems, I can make upper armor as well.
Back for more, are you? Here is the upper-body armor to complete your lesser suit.
If you are so adept at slaying shadows and crystals, bring me a more powerful gem and stop bothering me with this detritus.
If you really must have another set of that inferior armor, however, give me this gem again and I will see what I can do.
A mediocre gem.  Take your reward. These leggings are of fair quality. I need another of those gems to make sleeves and a breastplate for you.
This gem allows me to complete the suit for you. Take it, and perhaps you can slay greater creatures and bring me a more powerful gem.
You have a complete suit already. Take this gem back.
A very powerful gem indeed. This is the strongest armor I am able to craft. Bring me another gem to receive upper-body armor as well.
Excellent. I can complete your suit of armor now. This is the most powerful armor I am able to craft.
I have made you the best armor I can make.
If you want another suit, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.

greetings: Here you are.

Breathtaking... I have never heard of a crystal of this size and power. You must be the one who dealt the killing blow to the great Nexus Crystal! I will make you a full suit of Koujia armor that surpasses all my previous work.
Ayeeyah! This gem would be beyond my skill even if I were not suffering the curse of the shadow assassin! Try those three arrogant collectors near Uziz, I think they wanted gems like this.

Nuhmudira has finally restored us to full health!  She has also stocked us with some extra supplies that we needed, such that we can provide you with either a version of the original Shadow Armor, or its successor.  If you wish to trade one version of your Koujia set for another, simply hand it to me.  Please take out all Atlan stones from your armor before handing it to me.

Also, if you wish to color your new Greater Shadow Armor, you may buy a vat of color from my assistant.  If you do not like the color, please give me the armor piece and I will replace it with the standard piece, which you may then choose to recolor.
The secrets of how to craft with the shadow gems is well kept. However, the results are available to all.
Never underestimate your foes and you will do well.
quest: A small gem... I salute your accomplishment. Here is a set of Koujia leggings, infused with the power of the gem. With another gem of similar quality I can make a breastplate and sleeves to match.
This gem allows me to complete your suit of armor. Take this breastplate and these sleeves, with my compliments.
I cannot do anything more for you with these smaller gems. Please take this back.
Unless ... If you want another suit of this inferior armor, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.
Admirable. A potent gem. Here are some fine Koujia leggings for you. Another gem like that will allow me to craft sleeves and a breastplate for you.
A fine accomplishment, to make this gem. Here are the sleeves and breastplate I promised you.
I have done the best I can with the materials provided.
If you want another suit of this quality, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.
A gem of the best quality!
Here are your leggings. With another great gem such as this, I could make you similar upper-body armor.
Impressive! Here is the upper-body armor I promised you. It is an honor to craft for a warrior of your prowess.
Regrettably I have reached the limits of my craft, and I cannot spare any more time to make you armor. Here is your gem back.
If you *insist* on another suit of this quality, give this gem back to me and I'll see what I can do.

greetings: Wonderful, wonderful!
Now I may continue my studies. Here is the book I mentioned. I'm sure you'll find it of interest. All my histories sold well on Ispar.
Um... I already fixed this for you. Perhaps you've been out in the sun too long?
I know it gets awfully hot out here. Take this flask and get a drink from the fountain.
Sit down for a while, before you start seeing Olthoi Queens doing a Viamont waltz!
Greetings! I rarely have visitors here in the hills...a pleasure to meet you!

Tell me, would you be able to procure a skeleton's skull for me? I have need of it in my research. Should you find one, I can provide you with a copy of my latest history tome. It's the first of a major multi-volume work!
quest: Good heavens! Do you know what you have here? Do you see these markings? This is a piece of the legendary Silifi of the Crimson Stars!

It looks like the blade, the rubies, and the top two jewel fittings have been broken off. I can repair the haft, but it will only be able to hold three of the five gems, should you manage to find them.
You'll also have to replace the blade. Here, this pamphlet has some suggestions and tips for you.
I'd choose carefully, were I you. As fragile as this is now, you wouldn't be able to remove the spine or the rubies try again.
Another broken haft? That's okay, I can still repair it for you. But, you know ... I really don't think Leikotha is your type.

greetings: Can anyone please help me?
Thank you for saving my life!

I was taken prisoner by a group of Tumeroks and locked in this cell. If you can find my talisman I can use it to portal out of this dungeon. The talisman should be with the rest of my belongings somewhere in this dungeon.
It is good to be home.  I have the deepest gratitude for the heroes who reclaimed my town from the Virindi.

I grieve for proud Ayan Baqur.  I was not strong enough to defend it from the waves of cloaked fiends.  I have tried to locate my people... I think the Virindi are holding them in an underground complex to the east of town.  I am not strong enough to rescue them myself... Please, friend, do what you can to help them.
Yes, fool, I gave this to you.  Now deliver it to Jourgensson, please!  And tell no one of this!
Welcome to our humble castle.  I am Gormling, Lady Tallial's seneschal.  Take care not to cause too much trouble around here, hm?
quest: Mmmm, delicious drink... Here, you're a good chappie.  Take this note over to the Bandit Castle for me, will you?  Give it to Jourgensson.  He'll make it worth your while.
Oh, I've had quite enough, thanks...You go ahead and drink, though.

greetings: Here is a stock and mechanism for your crossbow.
Hmmm. I wouldn't know what to do with this. Perhaps you could take it to Yuan Hanzu as this sort of thing is more his field.
I am Barnar the Tinker. Mechanisms and woodworking are my specialty. If you bring me the heart of a wood golem, I can make a crossbow stock and mechanism for you.
I have turned over a new leaf!
That Martine isn't around is he?
I want my mommy.
Here is the book that Martine wanted me to give you.  If you see him, make sure he knows I did what he required!
I think it's time I moved out of Arwic soon.  There are too many unsavory types around.

Hope you enjoyed you trip through the Tusker Emporium of Deadly Doom. You look thirsty- care for a refreshing umbrella drink? Why not take home a memento of you visit here? I sell a fine assortment of quality merchandise.
Looks like you had fun down here. Why not take home a souvenir T-shirt of your exciting visit to Tusker Island?
So, you survived the trip through the Tusker Emporium of Deadly Doom. You should get a plaque that says so!
The way out of here is that way. Or you could run back up.
Remember, the tables are for paying customers only!
Okay, I guess I'll take it.
I've got lots of other stuff.
Great, thanks. Move along or buy more.

I see that you have helped recover one of my mother's knives.  Thank you!  Just southwest of town is a dungeon that was once a small but diverse community of Aluvians and Gharu'ndim, before Al-Arqas was built.
Here is a key to a shop in which you may find "Distillery Ambrosia."  I shall reward you for any you bring me.  You may also keep whatever you find there.
