You have helped Sarqah!  Thank you.  I have a key that is used in a dungeon just to the southwest of town.  It was once a small but active community of Gharu'ndim and Aluvians, before Al-Arqas was founded.
The key will let you into a shop where you may find "Distillery Ambrosia."  I shall reward you for them.  You may also keep whatever else you find there.

Wonderful!  I hear these were originally Empyrean drinks, from elsewhere in Dereth.  We had a number of oldtimer Aluvians here for a while, so perhaps one of them brought them.  I'd be delighted if there were more such liquids somewhere.
In any case, here is something that should be more useful to you.
Oh, how rare!  It's not as good as Distillery Ambrosia, but good nonetheless.
Amazing!  It's much better than Distillery Ambrosia.  Here is a reward for you.  Thank you for thinking of me.
Greetings.  I hope you enjoy your stay in Al-Arqas.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
You'd rather cast this spell on your own?
Well I can't argue with that.

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth. If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for a reward.
It has also been requested that I start handing out these gems.
Just southwest of town is a dungeon that was once a small but diverse community of Aluvians and Gharu'ndim, before Al-Arqas was built.
Here is a key to a shop in which you may find "Distillery Ambrosia." I shall reward you for any you bring me. You may also keep whatever you find there.
quest: You will find gems on the table next to me which will allow you to change this weapon into a Heavy, Finesse or Light version.
You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.
No, this is for you to stamp the letters you find.  Please keep it.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Sho towns will exchange a piece of jewelry or a wand for this. If you take this to one of the Aluvian towns, you will receive a piece of armor.

greetings: An intriguing find. I regret that I am not a man of letters, so I cannot read this. It looks like Empyrean script. You may wish to present this to Bretslef, in the Aluvian capital of Cragstone. It's quite a trip there, though.
What an odd weapon. I have little doubt that the mite found it in the old Empyrean armory. It is well known that they have no handicrafts of their own. It's yours to keep - I have no use for it.

How peculiar. This geode almost looks like an egg, does it not? Can you see the little Knath'taed inside? I don't imagine that such a thing could be useful. Perhaps Aino, the Sho enchantress outside of town, could be of more help with this.
Ah, if only we could clear the lower levels of their pestilence. Then, truly, could Xarabydun become a great city.
My thanks. The bounty on these small rats is 100 pyreal - the larger ones are worth more.
My thanks. The bounty on these small rats is 200 pyreal - the larger ones are worth more.
My thanks. The bounty on these small rats is 300 pyreal - the larger ones are worth more.
Ugh! How revolting to think such creatures scurry below our beds every night! I am authorized to pay 500 pyreals from the town coffers for such a prize.
Well done, I am authorized to pay 900 pyreals from the town coffers for such a prize.
This trophy proves a fine catch indeed, my friend. Here is your bounty. May the blessings of the poet - and the thanks of Xarabydun - go with you.
Amazing! I would never have guessed that such a large vermin lived beneath my feet. Take this Mana Charge, my friend, and I pray the experience of fighting this beast makes you prosper.
I've never agreed with the taking of scalps, but this certainly proves that you've been clearing the Banderlings that infest the lower levels.
Have you come to help us cleanse the lower levels of vermin? As the Bey of Xarabydun, I will reward you greatly for trophies that prove the death of the beasts that prevent our growth.

Ahhh....fascinating.  I believe this is a part of a rare Ceremonial Weapon, highly prized by Banderling tribes.  For what reason, no one knows; it's the cutting edge of Banderling Studies.  If only you had the shaft as well.  The last I heard it was in a banderling dungeon far west from Sawato.

What a find!  This is the shaft of a unique Banderling Ceremonial Weapon.  They use it in many of their tribal rituals, although for unknown purposes.  If you can find the head of this weapon, and then find a way to reattach the weapon, I would be most interested! Please come see me!  The last I heard the head was in some sort of Maze a ways off east from Uziz.

My word, I am speechless!  Well, not speechless, but certainly amazed!  This is the first Banderling Ceremonial Weapon we have found intact.  I must send this on to the Society at once.  There may even be an Explorership in it for me. In return for this artifact, let me present to you this quality weapon.  It will serve you in good stead for much of your adventuring career.

Oh my.  This is certainly distressing.  But tremendously exciting.  I almost envy him!  To be able to observe them this closely...I, too, have never heard of Banderlings and Mosswarts coming to blows.  I shall have to further ponder what this means.  And I will have to forward this news on to the Society.  If you come across any further word of the whereabouts of Sir Martine, I would be most de...

Well, this explains everything!  Well, not everything.  But it is a start!  I can only surmise that Sir Martine's thoughts on the matter are correct.  A Banderling Ceremonial Weapon!  I am most amazed.  If I could get my hand on such a weapon, it would be an invaluable find!  I wonder what is behind all these machinations.  Is it possible the Mosswarts are acting on their own?  Strange are the...
My heart is heavy.  May Pwyll protect him.  I do not know how to proceed from here.
I do not know what to say.  Whomever this person is writing these, it is certainly not the man I knew as Sir Candeth Martine.  I pray for his soul.
Disgusting.  Why do you engage in such senseless slaughter of these fascinating creatures?  Here, take this back.  I want nothing to do with it.
You are profiting off of the death of innocent creatures!  Away with you!
You beast!  Faugh!  I have no desire to do anything with you!  Get out of here.  We must study these creatures, not kill them!
Hello! If you journey to the Banderling Conquest dungeon far west from Sawato, and bring me back the mace shaft, I may be able to give you some more information.
If you come across any strange Banderling artifacts, please come see me at once.  I am an avid Banderling hobbyist.  And please, no Banderling scalps!  I want to study these creatures, not kill them!
Poor Sir Martine.  I fear the worst.
Greetings.
You have no soul.
quest: Aino's eyes light up at the sight of the geode.
Ah. A precious thing indeed.
She produces a few jeweler's tools and reworks the stone, chanting obscure spells to herself as she works. Soon, she hands back a fine gem.
My apologies. It would be unsafe for you to take another Impulse Gem at this time. The minimum period for handling another is one week.

greetings: Greetings to you, kind sir.  My name is Zenzaburou Hensu, and I am the leader of Kryst.
Can you tell us what happened to the Olthoi?  I noticed that many of you newcomers seem more concerned about strange floating crystals...
The Mosswarts seem to be fighting each other.  It is certainly odd, but I know good fortune when I see it.

It heartens me to hear the Olthoi have been dispatched.  Now, can you tell me who Elyssa Strathelar is?  And who this mysterious mage is that helped her?  If he was so powerful, why did he not tell her about Kryst's existence?
Welcome to Kryst.  Beware the Jungles, for they are dangerous.
These islands were named after one of my dear friends.  He gave his life to ensure we all reached safety.  He will never be forgotten.
There are dark secrets in the heart of the jungle.  Consider yourself forewarned.
Bloody Pwyll-worshipping lackeys...
Don't believe what the townies on the other island tell ye, the bunch of bleating sheep that they are... Hrm. It's been a while since I seen a sheep.
Well, Jourgensson says you're all right.  Maybe you can help.  Down underneath the castle, there's a prison full of beasties.  That idiot Gwillim dropped some notes and his bag in there.
Now he says he can't mix potions!  Bring the bag back to him, and he'll reward you.  You'll need this to get in there.

Ahh, I've been waiting for these. Not long mind you. The Lugians are very prompt in their delivery, nothing at all like the vermin I'm used to working with back on Ispar. Never mind the dogs living here on Dereth. This be for Captain K'rank.
Tell 'im that I'm willing to continue this advantageous relationship, so long as he's willing to keep supplying me with these herbs.

Arrr, and welcome to MacNiall's Freehold. Have ye seen them funny statue things the Mosswarts like to worship? I thinks their eyes is kinda pretty. Bring me one, and I'll see what I can do to reward ye.
quest: Errukh, look at the sparkle! Look, youngster, I'll give ye this note for my cousin MacDugal. I hear tell he's taken up residence with our old gang at some place called the Bandit Castle. Bring this note to him, and he'll reward ye right.
Oi mucker, I've already given ye the note to pass on to MacDugal! Don't tell me ye've lost it! Take this bauble back too, simpleton!

greetings: What are you waiting for? Go make yourself some peg legs!
Get!
I can't do anything with this. You see how the wood appears sort of striated and well... if I may say so - ugly? That's poor craftsmanship, there.
Now, if you were to bring me a left peg leg, I might be able to do something for you.
Ah, now that is one nice pair of peg legs!
I spit upon the tenets of Jojii.
Strangers to our island... Does this mean the Olthoi are gone?
I wonder what that tame Mosswart is up to?
My, my! I haven't seen one of these in a while. Half a moment, while I slightly alter it for you...
Done! Now, if you sew this together with a right peg leg, you'll be able to make yourself a peg leg set!

Welcome to MacNiall's Freehold.  You must be one of those people who has... rediscovered our island. Those who live here have earned their place by the strength of their arms and the power of their convictions. Do what you will is the whole of the law.

You are a newcomer here? Does that mean the mainland is free of Olthoi? In any case, welcome to the Vesayen Isles, and to MacNiall's Freehold. If you like, I have written a history of our island. It is sold by our barkeep, Jesren.
With this my lord Asheron may work the ritual to weaken the Hopeslayer. Take this, Isparian, and bring strong companions. The Hopeslayer will not fall easily. Go with the light.
This item is not yet complete. You must combine the three artifacts or they are useless to my lord.
Greetings, Isparian. My lord Asheron requests the cooperation of your people. Take this.
Assemble the artifacts and bring them to me, so that with my lord's help you may challenge and strike down the Hopeslayer.
The Hopeslayer has been destroyed, but you may wish to visit his lair nonetheless.  This gem will bring you there.

This item is not yet complete, nor is it needed any longer. The Hopeslayer has been defeated. If you wish, you may still bring me an assembled Dark Crucible to gain access to the Lair of the Hopeslayer.
You were one of the worthies who helped defeat the Hopeslayer. Please, take this helm, imbued with the gem's essence. I and my lord Asheron thank you, Lightbringer.

My lord conveys his gratitude for the efforts of your people. If you are one of the champions who took part in the defeat of Bael'Zharon, I can take your Soul Crystal Gem and give you a helmet to commemorate your achievement.
Also, I have instructions here that will lead you to the site of the Hopeslayer's defeat, should you wish to visit it.
You were one of the worthies who helped defeat the Hopeslayer. Please, take this casting staff, imbued with the gem's essence. I and my lord Asheron thank you, Lightbringer.

My lord conveys his gratitude for the efforts of your people. If you are one of the champions who took part in the defeat of Bael'Zharon, I can take your Soul Crystal Gem and give you a spellcasting staff to commemorate your achievement.
Have you a drudge charm, swamp stone, rat tail, or such? I'll pay you good money or items if you give them to me. They're hard to come by.
Did you know there are other people who collect other items, like gromnie teeth?  You might find them in some towns.  I'll take them, but I won't pay you for them!
Very rarely, you can get a perfect red phyntos wasp wing.  If you can give one to me, I'll pay you for it.  I will also pay you for the tails of rats.
I'm particularly interested in the spine of the sandy armoredillo.  Get that to me and I'll give you a health potion.  I'll also pay the same for swamp stones and the scalps of banderlings.
There are others who will reward differently for the same items I collect.  Not all types of monsters carry trophies, and of those variants that do, it's very rare.
Hold on, I'm getting your money.
Here you go.
Hold on, I'm getting your potion.
Okay. Here is your reward.
Oh, another blue wasp wing.
Thank you.
That's a very pretty wing.
Another tan rat tail...
Here's your reward.
Ah, one more russet rat tail...
Another spine for me, eh?
You found one! I don't see many of these around here...
These are my favorite and they are hard to find.
I don't even want to know where you got this at!
What a foul creature. I have no interest in this!
What a nasty little thing! Enough with the show and tell, you can have it back now!
That's great! Now get it out of my face!
I'm not a collector of skulls! What kind of collector do you take me for?
Wonderful! Maybe I can make this into a drinking mug for you! Then again, maybe I'll just give it back to you and forget I ever saw it!
I have no need for a broken mask.
You probably want to give this to the Olthoi Hunter in Arwic. Perhaps she'll be able to do something with it.
You can't decorate your own? Just find a carving or whittling knife and go at it!
Sorry, I'm not going to wear this around town!
There's no way I'm going to wear this!
Thanks for sharing this with me. Now you can have it back.
Oh! Scary!
Not a bad looking mask.
Something about this mask creeps me out...
This is quite a fine piece of art.

I'm interested in monster trophies from common rats,  red phyntos wasps, armoredillos, drudges, mosswarts and banderlings. If you give me such an item, I will reward you with money or an item. I don't deal in hides, however.
You can't decorate your own?
Just find a carving or whittling knife and go at it!
Wha... that's HUGE! Where did you find that? Be careful when you carve or whittle that, it must be worth a fortune! Unfortunately, I don't buy produce.
I wonder if this would fool a banderling.
Thanks for sharing this with me.
Ah yes, the Golden King. Exquisite! What a fine mask this is.
Hmmm, the Assassins Mask, I bet this is nice to have when the desert is restless.
Oh, the Ogre Mask. Somehow the crafter captured beauty in it's ugly features.
King Pwyll looks even more regal in this version of the mask.
You know, this mask is likely to keep people at a distance. No one likes to stand to close to an Assassin.
The mask of the Ogre Magi! I love this mask, but I keep mine locked up at night so I can sleep.
It's as if I'm looking upon King Pwyll himself! Amazing that Alexander could make this from memory.
The Shagar Zharala could have made this. It's a perfect recreation.
Ah!!! A monster!
Oh, hehe, just a mask of Koji's demon. It looks like it's watching me...
Keep those rat tails coming!
Tan rat tails make great boot laces.
Ah, one russet rat tail...
They say grey rat tails are good for the spleen.
Here's your money.
Brown, not bad. I'll get your money.
Here you are, don't forget I have higher rewards for black and red rat tails.
Oooo, this deserves more than a coin reward!
That's the Top Rat reward. I always need more black and red rat tails.
Red! Very good, you get the Top Rat reward for this!
quest: I'm overflowing in Scarlet Letters right now. Check back later.
I'm overflowing in Gold Letters right now. Check back later.
Take this note to Bretself the Translator. He'll tell you what to do with it.
I'll keep the bounty I usually pay for these.
Good luck in your travels.
Why not bring this back to me when you are a bit more experienced.
I'm afraid the knowledge I would give to you would go right over your head.
You must be at least level 40 to turn in a Scarlet Letter for XP.
You must be at least level 40 to turn in a Lucky Gold Letter for XP.
Hey! I remember my first Red Letter.
This is yours in exchange.
10 Red Letters, nice work.
Here, take these in exchange for the letters.
An Explorer Society Gold Letter. A real collectors item.
This should be a fair reward.
10 Gold Letters, nice work.
I really love these trinkets. I wonder what meaning they have for the drudges.
I have taught you all level one spells I have.
I have taught you all level two spells I have.
I have taught you all level three spells I have.
I have taught you all level four spells I have.
I have taught you all level five spells I have.
I have taught you all level six spells I have.
I have taught you all level seven spells I have.
I have taught you all fellowship spells I have.
I have taught you all dispel spells I have.

greetings: Servitude... Wretched...
Should've stayed in Arwic...
Never... in all my campaigns...
I tried talking to that Director around here.  Names himself Adirred.  He makes no sense, talking about "privileged self" and posts and structures.
Mighty resourceful of you, getting stout all the way down here.  Well, here's suds in your eye, kid.
There's a Director somewhere around here who's the cause of all this mess.
The Observer in town's actually a reasonable guy.  Or entity.  Whatever they call themselves.
You talked to the other guys around here?  They seem, I don't know, a little dull lately.
You've come a long way for my words of wisdom, youngster.  But I suppose now that everyone knows that I'm right about the Virindi, my wisdom is in especially high demand, eh?
Hey, I never thought I'd see this again!  Thanks a lot!  But don't expect any special favors from me.
Right, then.  What'd I tell you?  No one believed me... now, do you see?  I was right all along!  Applesauce, I said!
Ugh! I hate this stuff, but I have a friend who likes it. Maybe you should drop in on him.
What do you want me to do with this? Pick my teeth? Stop bothering me I have some serious drinking to do.
You find enough of this you might be able to have some tailor make a really fine shirt.
Hey. This is stolen property. I might swill my share of ale, but I'm not swilling my brew from Celcynd's mug.

No, no, that's your robe now. I have quite a few of them myself. Thanks again for finding those wand splinters. I can't stand the thought of a bunch of semi-literate drunken fools ruining my good name.
Bwahahaha!!! People are still trying to bring me these things?
Aw! None Left!
Nothing like an Ulgrim's Brew in the crisp mountain air.
Cold-brewed to warm the bones.
Ayan Baqur used to be such a wonderful place to live. People were always so... respectful of...
Who am I kidding? That place has been a hive of scum and villainy for years. But the state of affairs in my hometown has little to do with my latest excursion!

Let's look at this situation from a practical standpoint. Yes, it is cold here. Yes, there was no brew here before I came along. But there's no incessant wars between people just beside the lifestone. There's no chance that those blasted Burun coming here. They hate cold!
So, this really isn't a bad place to be right now.
Get beer.
Get beer from keg.
Get beer from keg now.
Get out! Geesh, some people just don't understand an adventure.
I drank that sake crud the other day. You know what it did to me?

Hallucinations! I saw myself in the belly of the beast literally. It was horrible. A stomach surrounded me on all sides, my legs burned and itched as acid ate away at my clothing and flesh. Then the most horrible thing of all happened. I dropped my beer!
This little mosswart fellow came into town screaming about the Burun.
I gave him a drink to calm him down. He gave me a stone that smells like something plucked from a mattekar's hind quarters. I figure I'll throw it at the next Burun I see.
Guess what I'm doing tomorrow night.
The same thing I do every night.
You know you're a real hero if you can fight naked.
I wish I could fly. You think with all this magic in the world we would have magical flight.
I want to fly!
I need a cape too.
I met this small man yesterday. He had a mask on and these big red gloves. He talked about scrolls and buttons. We shared a few cold ones and then he had to get back to his chainmail or something.
Strong little fellow...
Are you naive enough to think Elysa runs Dereth? Hmm.

There is a conspiracy that those in power don't want you to know. I can't tell you everything, not yet. I can tell you there is a cabal of mages in the upper echelons of our government who control every aspect of our society. Do you think that the Olthoi Invasion happened by chance?
Just ask yourself, who is the fourth man?
You know, Muldaveus and Niarltah asked me to join their Renegade cause. I was going to join too...

Then they told me that they didn't supply the Breakfast Beer, Morning Mickeys, Spring-to-Action Ale, Midday Mead, Late-Night Lager or Sleepy-Time Stout. So I told them that they could take their Mattekar Swill and stuff it. My allegiance to Elysa could never be bought!
Fill me up a Beer Stein and I'll tell you the story of how I tied to a broken lifestone.
You the man!
You say, "No, You the man!"
You're right, I am.
There aren't a lot of stimulating people to talk to around here.
I don't mean you of course, you're fascinating.
I had a bad dream the other night. I was in the ruins of some town and I couldn't get anyone to talk to me or give me stout.
That wasn't the worst part of the dream though. There were these horrible wormy things floating around and I was terrified they would see me.
I thought Mosswarts smelled bad, but Burun smell like Tremendous Monouga feet. At least you know when they're close.
I saw a cute little Ursuin Cub the other day. I tried to pat it on the head. Cute little teeth on that cub. See my cute little bite mark?
Have you noticed how dazed the people at fishing holes look?
Just try talking to one of them. You'll be lucky if they even acknowledge you. More than likely they'll just stand there casting and casting and casting.
They're Fishing Zombies! Fishing Zombies I tells you!
Wish I could take my sword with me. I'd at the very least like to have it on my wall at home.

It's really good to be back in Ayan Baqur. It hasn't changed all that much. The big difference is I see more crazy fools running around killing each other than I used to. How can they stand all the Vitae?
I hear old Jaleh got killed. Aaminah really looks as if she's broken up over it. I think we should elect a new leader for Ayan Baqur.
Now let's see... who would make a good leader?
No, I couldn't!
quest: I don't need these splinters anymore, but seeing as you went to all that work.
I bestow upon you the Robe of Extraordinary Comfort!
You have truly bested me. I bow to you in my humble defeat.
My my, you really have been practicing! I believe this is the 10th time you've beaten me. I think... no.

Yes, I think you are ready. You have achieved the coveted rank of "Master of the Mystical Mug". You are entrusted with the safekeeping of the Mystical Mug. Keep it well protected, for there are many dark forces that would love to get their claws on it.
You beat me! I can't believe I lost.
Ulgrim really looks at you for the first time and smiles in admiration.
It's a pleasure to drink with you my friend!
For besting me at my own game I'm making you one of my Drinking Buddies. Come back and drink with me anytime!
Thanks, but I don't need anymore splinters.
Are you trying to poison me? This stuff is terrible!
Oh, you purchased me another ale.
How kind.
Kid, I don't know if you're trying to poison me or what but that's swill!
Tell ya what, why don't you go skip a rock.
And take your dirty skunk ale with you!
Five! Haha! I win again!
For coming in second place I award you a title befitting of your drinking prowess.

Why are you bothering ME about the Viridian Rise? Oh yeah, something attacked that Deru and the tree sent out unhealthy amounts of magic. Everything there is growing like crazy, and even the guardians are a bit...off because of it. Probably too tough for someone like you. I went up there looking for good ingredients for a new mead. Found the guardian statues, and figured out two things.
Spruce follows directly after Pine.
Maple follows directly after Willow.
Yeah, good luck with that.

greetings: Not a puppet...
I used to heal... but I cannot awaken...
Teeth and bones, teeth and bones...
Very good, you may keep your cestus. A lady near Zaikhal named Devana bint Hamudi is looking for skilled hunters.
Give this to her.
I seek the teeth of certain creatures, the gromnies.  But I won't take just anything, I want only the most well preserved gromnie teeth!
Give me the rare tooth of the fierce gromnies, and I will craft it into something useful.  I will also take auroch horns.
I require stout gromnie teeth for my craft!
I am still experimenting with the skulls of certain skeletons.  They don't seem to be good for weapons, but I'll give you a health potion for them.
Nasty for you, if they catch you on one of these, eh?
There you are, a bit of a reward and I've made a nice spear from the horn.
Fire Auroch horns are beyond my skill, but I can trade for them. Here, take this reward.
I've heard about some master bowyer named Yuan Hanzu who makes these into bows.
Hmmm, yes, I'll take this horn. I may just trade this for something I can use. Here's your reward.
I think Yuan Hanzu, the Sho master bowyer, makes great bows from these horns.
Well, this tooth is neither that of a gromnie, nor an auroch. I used to avoid trading for these, but I've learned they have offensive properties.
As you can see, this mace will now do some nasty piercing damage.
Ah, one of the smaller Niffis shells. With a special technique I have devised I can flatten and reform these.
Here, I made this shield yesterday. That's sure to make quite a statement on the battlefield.
Hehe, the shell almost looks like a helmet now. With just a little work...
There you are! A beautiful Niffis Shell Helm.
Oh, what a beautiful niffis orb! You deserve a reward worthy of this find.
Don't hesitate to bring me more of these opalescent marvels.
These teeth are light and will fly well. They just won't do as much damage as some of your higher end spiketails.
These teeth are light and will fly well. They just won't do as much damage as some of your higher end atlatl darts.
You might get more if you put this under your pillow, haha!
Jade tooth eh? These are just the right weight for bolt heads.
Enjoy!
Swamp Gromnie teeth are exceptionally sharp. Ow! See what I mean?
Be careful with those.
This reminds me, A lady near Zaikhal is looking for hunters.
Here is your reward. If you wish to know more, hand the dagger back to me as a sign of trust.
It has taken me a few years, but I have finally figured out a use for Sable Gromnie teeth.
It has taken me a few years, but I have finally figured out a use for Ebon Gromnie teeth.
The Brass Gromnie only recently appeared on Marae Lassel. Had I not been inspired to craft, I wouldn't have even thought of making this out of Brass Gromnie teeth!
The Copper Gromnie only recently appear on Marae Lassel. Had I not been inspired to craft, I wouldn't have even thought of making this out of Copper Gromnie teeth!
I hope you don't think me macabre for collecting these.
I will give a greater reward for more unique skeleton skulls.
This skull is very unique, it will be extremely useful to me.
Thank you for bringing me this treasure.
Yes, I have found a use for these. I'll have to cleanse the skull first of course. Yech!!
I know of a sage somewhere in the southern mountain range that also collects these.
Tibia from a grievver if I am not mistaken. Interesting bone structure.
Thank you, bring me more of these and you will receive the same reward.
A Tusker Slave tusk. You can't use these on the Island of the Tuskers. It's a good thing you came to me.
These tusks are exceptionally useful since they are hollow.
Well Done! I expect the Lich didn't give this willingly.
Please convince more Liches to part with their bones.
A thighbone... hmmm, not a Dark Revenant, but I can still use it.
Bring me a Dark Revenant thighbone I will reward you fivefold.
Aha! A Dark Revenant thighbone, quite exceptional!
A fine reward for your formidable deed.
Hard to imagine that they used this as body ornamentation. Thankfully, we can use these as an augmentation of sorts.
This is a nice find. I have a friend that would like this. Thank you, and here is your reward.
With a little carving, and a little work with the top of the bone here... There we go, a rather dastardly looking dirk, don't you think?
Oh I agree... It isn't really enough, so take this too.
Hmm, if we stretch this a little here and disjoint the jaw. We can twist this little bit and then, excellent! Wear this with pride.
Since the helmet doesn't really offer much protection, I think a little monetary reward is in order as well.

Well. This is a little fleshy. Of course we can pull this, oh blech, what was that? Well whatever it was, this poor sod won't need it. Oh and the smell, well, let's just add a little touch of sunflower oil. Much better.
Here you go.
A grim looking shell. The Niffis are never this dark. Well I'll see what I can craft from it.
Odd, there seems to be magic within the shell that was left within when I finished the shield. You might be able to affix a symbol if you center on this shield.
quest: What a lovely piece of work! Look at the inlay here! Thank you for bringing this to me.
I wish to study this in depth. Perhaps I can learn this level of work ...
I have already given you one of the nice stuffed Monouga's. But I can still reward you with a little something. There's a little extra money in there for you.
Thank you, but I have plenty to study for at least a month. Perhaps if you return later I will have time to examine this.

This is an excellent find. My friend is working on a collection and has given me an exclusive special offer. You qualify for the special collector's edition Tremendous Monouga Pack Doll. Supplies are limited, so only one per person, per month.

greetings: I like the pretty lights...
Flesh is... meaningless?  After the flesh?
What an unusual hide.  Surely something more interesting could be made from this. Seek out Yi Yo-Jin at Neydisa Castle.
There is nothing more I can do with this.
Thanks, but it's of no use to me.
How disgusting! There is, however, a sage somewhere in the southern mountain range that actually likes those things.  How revolting...
I can't work with this, but I hear there is a person in the Bandit Castle that can.
Hmm, I think that I once made a Helm that you could affix this to.
I can take the hides of certain creatures and turn them into items of value.
Have you the skins of armoredillos, gromnies, or reedsharks?  I can use them in my craft.
Hmm. A few snips here, and a few snips there...
Add some dye...There you go!
Here you go!
This is large enough to craft into a well fitting cuirass I think.
Well then. I think that this may be the first of a great many new robes to come my friend. Make sure to show your friends.
Not quite as sturdy as the tanned red hide that I worked with before, but it's still strong enough and large enough to craft into a nice robe. Wear it well.
Let's see. The hide is thick and leathery, and aside from the small bony protrusions it's in fine shape. I think a nice set of leggings.
There you go.
Another fine specimen. A little thicker than the last shreth hide I was given to work with. Let me have a moment and I'll... Yes, yes that's it!
Here you go.
Where did you get this? It's rather frightening, and rancid smelling. Well, let me see what I can do with it.
I've seen something like this recently. Came from a carenzi though, it mottled and smelled rank. Much like this. Where are you finding these creatures?
Well, I've done the best I can.
What is this!? I've never seen anything like this. It will make a fine robe I think. Give me a moment.
Yes, there it is done.
I've seen some interesting hides pass my way, but the hides that people have been bringing me most recently are the oddest.
A few more threads...and done!
Be careful out there.
If you give me the hide of an armoredillo, gromnie, reedshark, or mattekar, I can make something with it that you may find useful.
Words... are... meaningless...
My shop... where is my shop?
Thank you.  Here is your reward.

Hello.  Myself and my brothers-in-arms have been assigned to exchange gifts with those that donate undead trophies to the Shagar Zharalim.  We were not expecting the plethora of trophies we have received, so we have adjusted our prizes accordingly.
It seems that the Reavers that plagued us in our ancestral lands are here to plague us as well.  Beware the Dune Reavers, for they are dangerous.

Recently the Zharalim have uncovered lore that enables us to make magical arrows.  If you trade me a mnemosyne fragment, I will be more than happy to grant you some arrowheads. You'll have to assemble them yourself though.  You'll need a bow like mine to use them.
Thank you.  Here is your reward.

Hello.  Myself and my brothers-in-arms have been assigned to exchange gifts with those that donate undead trophies to the Shagar Zharalim.  We were not expecting the plethora of trophies we have received, so we have adjusted our prizes accordingly.
There have been many strange occurrences in the desert recently.  On occasion, there are sudden sandstorms for no reason.  It is very odd...

I realize that it is dangerous to hunt the more potent Sand Kings without protection.  They cast a plethora of debilitating spells on any aspiring hunter.  With the proper gift, I have been authorized to grant you a gem that can disperse such maladies.
Thank you.  Here is your reward.

Hello.  Myself and my brothers-in-arms have been assigned to exchange gifts with those that donate undead trophies to the Shagar Zharalim.  We were not expecting the plethora of trophies we have received, so we have adjusted our prizes accordingly.
The literal translation of my name means daughter of the wind.  I adopted it in honor of my mentor, who recently disappeared during a journey to Uziz.

There are healing kits even more potent than the ones dropped mainly by Lugians.  The Zharalim have recently uncovered lore that enables them to treat these kits in order to make them more potent.  If you trade me a mnemosyne fragment, I will reward you in turn, depending on the quality of the fragment.
The horn of a Fire Auroch, eh? These beasts are impressive, but very slow, which makes them easy to kill. Here, I have carved the horn into a shape suitable for use in a composite bow.
Great Mattekars are worthy prey. Take this piece of carved horn. With it you may make a strong weapon.
This is not of flesh and blood. Perhaps someone with a more mechanical mind would be able to do something with it. Ask Barnar the Tinker.

It is a tragedy, what has befallen Ayan Baqur.  Luckily, Jaleh al-Thani and I were able to fight our way out of the town and escape.  I wonder what has become of the other townsfolk... Still, life goes on.  I can still carve horn to help you make a composite bow.
Yes, these bones make good handles.
Master Hanzu deftly carves the Ancient Bone into a Fine Handle.
Here you are. This can be used on the finest crafted Composite Bow and Composite Crossbow to increase their effectiveness.

I wouldn't use that to upgrade your bow or crossbow unless you are sure you can handle a more powerful weapon. It may prove to be more than you can wield. If you decide you would rather have a different reward I can pass along a little experience I've learned in hunting.
Alright, I'll just take that then. Here are a few pointers in tracking your target.
Yes, this bone has an aged hardness, it will make a wonderful handle.
Master Hanzu deftly carves the Hardened Bone into a Superb Handle.
My yes, this bone will make an astoundingly good handle.
Master Hanzu deftly carves the Fossilized Bone into an Exquisite Handle.
The horn of a Fire Auroch, eh? These beasts are impressive, but very slow, which makes them easy to kill. Here, I have carved the horn into a shape suitable for use in a composite bow

Have you read my work on composite bows? I gave some to my ivory crafter associates. I can help you by carving pieces of horn to go into the bow's stave. If you are interested in crossbows, talk to my friend, Barnar the Tinker.

My requests for assistance has been heard! I have been here keeping an eye on Tumerok movements ever since Ardry, Aleval, and I captured a band of Tumerok scouts. We interrogated them for their dealings with the Virindi, but all they told us was a story of a legendary spear weilded by one of their reknowned heroes...Little did we realize that their babble was but a smokescreen before they attem...

Ah, so there was something to their story after all...What an interesting find! But look here...Doesn't these slots along this side suggest it that it is missing a part? Perhaps the answer could be discovered out around the caves near the (landmark) to the (direction) where I last spotted the TumerokS gathering.

I have never seen an artifact such as this before...Some sort of Tumerok figurine? Ah...But it seems as if it is not in its entirety...Perhaps it should be married to another piece? If you bring me back the completed artifact, I will surely reward you!

A Tumerok War Taiaha!  One of the first examples of Tumerok war craft that we have found.  I must send this on to Aliester--he will be delighted to further his research on Tumerok culture.  I and the Society thank you!
Take care as you travel down this road to the south. The Tumeroks seem to be heightening their activities near Dryreach!
My wife is happy to be here, she grew tired of living in Eastham.  If you ask me though that man that gave us the means to build this place...Well he just gave me the shakes...Him and his mask.
Hrm...Something is still missing just can't seem to figure out what that is.
I guess living out here in the wilderness isn't that bad, I just wish that there was more meat around here.  How am I supposed to perfect my meatballs if I can't get meat?
If you're looking to sell something then you should visit my wife, but be careful she's a shrewd one.
I never caught that strangers name, come to think of it I don't think he told us...

Wonderful!  You found one!  Ummm, unfortunately, Mazur has brought a small problem to my attention.  As I mentioned when I first saw you, this is a fine and strong pelt.  A little too strong, in fact.  Mazur is unable to tan the hide with his existing tools.  However, he informs me that if one were to use some form of strong acid on the hide, that he should be able to treat the hide and fashion...

Well, you found the acid.  Congratulations.  Oh, you don't expect me to do the actual crafting do you?  That is why I have Mazur.  He will give you your prize.  Just remember that Britana always delivers!

Well, you found the acid.  Congratulations.  Oh, you don't expect me to do the actual crafting do you?  That is why I have Mazur.  He will give you your prize. Just remember that Britana always delivers!
Yes, it is quite beautiful, isn't it?
Ecch.  I don't need this.  Use this on your mattekar pelt, and then give the pelt to Mazur.  Do I look like a craftsperson to you?
This smells awful!  Take it away from here!  Use it on your mattekar pelt and give the pelt to Mazur.  Go, go!
Don't ever bring this piece of garbage to me again.  Just remember that this is what Ketnan stands for: Garbage.  Understood?  Britana only creates quality items.

What!  Do you think I am some shiftless slob like Ketnan?  Just because we are related doesn't mean I will take charity like him!  Well, I suppose it would be rude of me to refuse a gift, I guess I could make an exception for someone with such a discerning eye as yourself.

Greetings brave adventurer!  My name is Britana, perhaps you've heard of my...never mind, he isn't important anyway.  What is important is have I got a deal for you!  Perhaps you have heard of a small fashion accessory...The Hoary Mattekar Robe?  Yes, I am sure you have.  Well, unlike some others who seek to perpetuate fraud upon the Isparian public with cheap knockoffs, Britana only provides t...

I have come to this island upon hearing reports of a great white beast that stalks its northern coasts.  Rumor has it this is a Mattekar straight out of legend, come to rid the island of its troublesome denizens.  Which denizens, you ask?  Legend does not say.
But what I say is that a Mattekar this large and strong must produce a robe which makes the Hoary robe seem like a bath rug!  Bring me this mattekar pelt, and I will craft you a robe fit for a king!
What? Who's there? Ketnan? Mazur? Please, get me out of here!
I don't understand. Why can I not return to the Lifestone in Greenspire? What magic is this?
I told them that I didn't know where Ketnan is, but they didn't believe me!
They say that some woman is running my shop now. I hope she is kind to Mazur and Balarazo...
Lai Fanli grunts. "I keep telling Oswald... archers can't compete against opponents this difficult. Where is the 'love' he keeps promising me?" At that, his bow falls from his cooling fingers.
Itala falls before %s's assault as she fought, silently.
Itala glances at Adroth and murmurs, "I told you those boots of yours would give away our position."
Itala winces as she receives %s's telling blow!
As he begins his journey back to the lifestone, Torgrym is heard to mutter, "Damn. Bloke must use that Virindi thing... whassit... that funny gear stuff. I'm too... elite... for this..."
As he begins his journey back to the lifestone near, Torgrym mutters deliriously, "Anyone gotta portal to subway..?"
Torgrym glares over his orb at %s. "Come on, foight like a man. Been whackin' on these dumb local critters too long, eh? No challenge in 'em, I say."
Torgrym glares over his orb at %s. "Loik the Tumies say, mate, 'zhtufu ah gahrede.' That means 'silence, loser, or meet me outside.' Er... kinda, anyway."
Torgrym glares over his orb at %s. "Ya precious great pansy ... wossamatta, been sittin' down in Black Spawn Den too long? Do the sun hurt yer eyes?"
Torgrym winces and mumbles, "Roit, thassit. I'm recalling. I'm not dying for this."
Torgrym winces and mumbles, "Ack, that hurts. Are me buffs down already?"
"Ha!" Torgrym guffaws. "If yeh can't foight wid the best of us, go foight drudges. Suck vitae, %s."
"Woo hoo!" Torgrym crows. "I owned yeh loik a wee lil' girl!"
Torgrym laughs at %s's feeble spellcasting. "Ha! When I wozza boy I spent weeks honing my magic defense in the Zaikhal meeting hall."

Adroth spits blood and teeth upon the ground, and grins a gap-toothed, bloodstained smile at %s. "If yer not carrying a full pack of vitae, yer not a real man. Roight then. I'll be back for you, bub. Ye'll get yers soon enough." The wicked gleam in his eyes fades as his spirit is whisked away to the lifestone.
You hear the clanking of heavy boots nearby.
Adroth's boots clank loudly as he lunges at %s!
Adroth grins down at %s's corpse. "Kiss them boots while yer down there, kid."

Adroth spits on the ground as he sizes up %s. "Dunno how yeh found us, mate. Seems like the longer we all stay in this world, the more we get a sixth sense for danger, eh? Anyway. Time to pay yer toll."
Adroth spits on the ground as he sizes up %s. "Roight. Stand and deliver."
"C'mon yeh dumb bastards, fight like a team!" Adroth bellows over the clash of battle.

Den-Ru tries to cast healing spell, but is too weak. "Bah. Wear a robe, get sliced open by hollow weapons. Wear armor, become too heavy to move. Well, all you're getting from me is a sackful of those useless damned robes that old fool Celdiseth knits!"
The wind blows hollowly through the deserted bottom of the hive...
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A sweet smell fills the air, as a colorful plant springs forth!
Now, take good care of this. Give it plenty of water and sun.
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, three plants spring forth from the dirt!
Amazing... truly, these seeds have been touched by the Powers.
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, two plants spring forth from the dirt!
Have you ever seen anything so lovely?
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and sings lovingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, six plants burst forth from the dirt! Terese blinks in disbelief.
Wow. I sure didn't expect that.
Now, take good care of these. Give them plenty of water and sun.
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, four plants spring forth from the dirt!

Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and sings lovingly. A sweet smell fills the air, and the soil glows softly. Suddenly, eight plants burst forth from the dirt! Terese blinks in disbelief.
Terese places the seed in a small pot of earth, and speaks soothingly. A acrid smell fills the air, as a dark plant springs forth!
How beautiful! And how rare! Please take good care of this...it would be a shame if anything happened to such a wondrous living thing!
How beautiful! And how rare! Please take good care of this... it would be a shame if anything happened to such a wondrous living thing!
What do you want? Wasting my time, no doubt, wasting my time! Don't you have some grandiose quest to do, or innocent monkeys to kill? Leave me alone with my plants. Growing them isn't easy, you know.
If I really believed you cared, I might help you grow your own plants. But I'm sure you wouldn't find them to be terribly "elite".

Yes, the Shreth have been eating the plants. That's part of Dereth's new ecology. Go look it up. But, if you happen to go rooting through Shreth droppings, as I imagine you like to do, I'll take any seeds that you might find.
Do you see all these lovely new plants? I woke up one morning and their fronds had appeared out of nowhere! Even an animal-killer such as you cannot dampen my spirits.
Sorry, I don't frame pictures. You want the Master House Decorator or the Wall Hanging Master to frame these.
Yes, I can mount this for you. Just promise not to ring the thing after it get's dark. There's nothing more disturbing than a bell ringing out in the night.
The Master Furniture Maker mounts the bell onto a sturdy post.
You might want that crack in the bell looked at sometime.
Sure, I can take that off for you.
The Master Furniture Maker unmounts the bell.
There you go. Watch out for bats. They love these things.
Good day to you!  I am Bartholomew, though my friends call me Bart.  After I get set up here, I'll start taking certain items and making them into furniture.
There's nothing finer, than wares made by Steiner!
Sorry, I'm not in the unframing business.
I think you want the Master Furniture Maker, Bartholomew, for this. It's way to big for me to mess with.
Jordan Ibn'Ikia examines the map.

Such a fine map. This looks like the work of Alatar Locke, only he understands line weight so well! This would look magnificent hanging on your wall but it obviously requires a frame. I could frame this for you, however I have run out of wood. If you were to bring me some wood from a woodsman I could frame the map for you. I can hold the map for you until then. The woodsman in Holtburg carries...
Ah yes, these banners are really quite rustic. I find that a framed Tumerok Banner really adds a simple charm to a room. Here, let me frame this with some of my leftover wood.
There you are, enjoy!

Hello! I am Jordan. I deal specifically in wall hangings, and after I am settled into this new shop, I'll start taking items and crafting them into wondrous hangings for your house! For now, if you give me an unframed picture I could frame it for you.
quest: Thank you for obtaining this wood for me. I shall frame your map now.
Jordan Ibn'Ikia skillfully makes a decorative frame for the map
Don't let people mark it all up with their corpse locations, now! Hee hee!
Thank you, but someone else is fetching me a supply of wood.

greetings: Sorry, I don't have a clue how to get that thing off.
I think you want the Master Furniture Maker, Bartholomew, for this. It's way to big for me to mess with.

Ah yes, these banners are really quite rustic. I find that a framed Tumerok Banner really adds a simple charm to a room. Here, let me frame this for you. Jordan the Wall Hanging Master sent me some frames just for this purpose.
May it brighten up your home. Don't forget to hang it level.
Hello!

My name is Jubei, and I specialize in random knickknacks that may seem worthwhile to have in your house.  Once I get around to making the necessary tools, and you have an item that might be of interest, bring it to me.
Or not...
Ahh, here is the token of Nuhmudira's esteem.

You may use this token in one of two ways.  First, you may deliver it to an Agent of the Arcanum, and they will reward you with a Writ of Refuge.  But be aware that they will only do this once.  After that, they will have no need of these tokens from you.

The alternative is to give me back the token.  I will then permit you to enter the portal next to me.  You will there see a furniture vendor who has unique items to sell you for your house.  Choose your desire with care.
Thank you.  You may now enter the portal.  I hope you enjoy the selection of goods.
quest: So have you found something?  Please give it to me, and I will give you in exchange a token from Nuhmudira.  She has instructed her Agents to give a Writ of Refuge in return for this token.  Or, you could give the token back to me, and I can give you temporary access to this portal beside me, where you can purchase interesting items of decor for your home.
Greetings, brave adventurer!  Time is short, I fear.  We have discovered a delicate situation.  While the Virindi have apparently been vanquished, not all of their minions have followed suit.

There is a crazed Hollow Minion, residing at the end of these tunnels.  We have never seen such a tenacious hollow minion commanding troops before.  I hope this is the worst of the surprises we face in the near future.

Nuhmudira preserve us.  If you are able to reach and vanquish the Hollow Minion, please see if he has left anything of note behind.  The Arcanum is extremely interested in getting at the root of this problem.  According to the Arcanum, portalspace disruptions around the nine Arrival towns are increasing daily.  We need to put a stop to this immediately.

greetings: Double-click on me to hear what I have to say.
Help! Stop thief!
My bellows! Thank you. Take this, with my thanks!
Furthermore, I believe you have proven yourself worthy of a weapons upgrade. This Oil of Rendering will help you achieve one.

Now you should visit the Quartermaster's workshop and buy one of his Training Weapons. They will serve you well in your initial travels, and if you use this special oil on them,I guarantee you will enhance it.

The Quartermaster has locked himself away in his shop for some reason--he must be feeling shy today. Little does he know that I smithed a copy to his key, which I will give to you! You'll find his workshop across the courtyard from where you first entered.
Good luck!
The Academy Blacksmith grins wryly.
Those Sparring Golems are pretty exciting, aren't they? Thanks for the token--I'll return it to the Practice Area for you.
I am a Blacksmith --not a Scribe.
The Academy Foreman would be happy to see this--he's been plagued by these pests for ever so long. Maybe he should take a shower!
No, friend--I must give this to you as a gesture of my friendship. Now I can get back to work! Use this oil on one of the Quartermaster's items--you won't be dissatisfied with the result!
No thanks. I am far too busy to read these days.
This is one of the Training items forged by our Quartermaster. If you use the Oil of Rendering that I gave you on it, you'll find its powers will increase tremendously.

This is a fine weapon indeed. I have always believed that the best weapons are those crafted by one's own hands. Congratulations--you have done a fine job indeed. I would be proud to carry this in battle.
This is the key to the Quartermaster's workshop. You should pay him a visit! To unlock the door, double-click on the key, then double-click on the door.
Help! Stop, thief!
You should visit the Academy Researcher. Purchase the Oil of Rendering from him and use it on your weapon. I guarantee you, that Oil will greatly improve your weapon's effectiveness.
Use this key to enter the Academy Library. Double-click the key, then click on the door to open it.
quest: The Blacksmith looks worried and tired.

The Queen and her advisors were correct. The Nexus towns are still under threat. I can only hope that our recent efforts to fortify this area will withstand the assault. Go to the Senior Guard--he will know what's best at this time.
Ah! The Academy Foreman must have sent you over to me. He's always had a good eye for capable folk.

Thank you so much for helping me with those incorrible Mosswarts! Now use the key I gave you to unlock the door to the Quartermaster's workshop. You'll find his workshop across the courtyard from where you first entered. He's selling items that you'll be able to upgrade by pouring the Oil of Rendering on it.

Perhaps you could help me with these thieving Mosswarts. They and their noxious kin have stolen my bellows! How can I contribute to building these fortifications if I do not have them? The last time I saw them, they were running towards the vegetable gardens. Retrieve my bellows for me, and I will reward you!

Wonderful! A new arrival! You should visit the Academy Foreman--he's been having a world of trouble with the Carpenter Wasps over in his construction area. He's nearly at his wit's end...and will be glad to see you.
You should visit the Academy Researcher. Purchase the Oil of Rendering from him and use it on your weapon. I guarantee you, that Oil will greatly improve your weapon's effectiveness.
Use the key to enter the Academy Library. Double-click the key, then click on the door to open it.

Perhaps you could help me with these thieving Thrungum. They and their noxious kin have stolen my bellows! The last time I saw them, they were running towards the vegetable gardens. Retrieve my bellows for me, and I will reward you!

greetings: Double-click on me to hear what I have to say.
Shoo, fly!
These look like the Academy Blacksmith's bellows. You should take this over to him--he's been bellyaching ever since the Mosswarts stole them. He'll probably reward you, too.
You must have been fighting our Sparring Golems lately. Instructive, aren't they? I'll give this back to the Senior Guard for you.
Yes, you are certainly welcome here! Especially if you go kill those horrid Carpenter Wasps for me!
Ah, my studying days are over, my friend. You may have this back.

The Blacksmith's Oil of Rendering...looks like you've helped him with those Mosswarts that have been plaguing him lately. I don't know why they're so fond of his bellows though...maybe he should take them on as his apprentices!
The Academy Foreman guffaws loudly at the Blacksmith's expense.
If you pour this oil onto one of the Quartermaster's Training Weapons, I'm sure you'll be happy with the result.
This is one of the Training items forged by our Quartermaster. If you use the Oil of Rendering that I gave you on it, you'll find its powers will increase tremendously.
You've bought one of the Quartermaster's Training Weapons. It's a nice one! But try pouring the Blacksmith's Oil of Rendering on it--I'm sure you'll be happy with the result.
Beautiful! We're all rooting for you. Carry your new weapon with pride.
This is the key to the Quartermaster's workshop. You should pay him a visit! To unlock the door, double-click on the key, then double-clicking on the door.
Thank you! You are certainly doing your part to ensure that this Academy will thrive. Let me reward you with experience.
You should go visit the Academy Blacksmith now; The Thrungum have been stealing from him, and I'm sure he could use your help. Good luck with the rest of the Academy!
quest: The Foreman is nearly hysterical with fear.
Haven't you heard? The Outer Courtyard is under attack! What are we going to do? You must report to the Senior Guard--he will know!
I heard that you successfully helped the Blacksmith regain his bellows. Good job--I have no idea how those Mosswarts strayed in here, but they certainly don't belong.

Now, you have already helped me enough, my friend--I'm sure from now on I'll be able to manage these Wasps on my own. Good luck in the rest of the Academy! Have you already completed your Academy Weapon? You should show it to the Senior Guard--I'm sure he'd be happy to see your progress! Good luck in the rest of the Academy!

You have already helped me enough, my friend--I'm sure from now on I'll be able to manage these Wasps on my own. You should now go visit the Academy Blacksmith around the corner--the Mosswarts have been stealing from him, and I'm sure he could use your help. Good luck in the rest of the Academy!
Thank you! You are surely doing your part to ensure that this Academy will thrive. Let me reward you with experience.
You should now go visit the Academy Blacksmith--the Mosswarts have been stealing from him, and I'm sure he could use your help. Good luck with the rest of the Academy!

Perhaps you can help me out as well. Quickly, Carpenter Wasps have infested my woodpile! There are so many of them--could you help me clear out a few? They are here through this door beside me. If you bring me one of their wings to prove that you have taken some of them out, I will surely reward you.

Help has arrived at last! Quickly, Carpenter Wasps have infested my woodpile! There are so many of them--could you help me clear out a few? They are here through this door beside me. If you bring me one of their wings to prove that you have taken some of them out, I will surely reward you.
You have already helped me enough, my friend--I'm sure from now on I'll be able to manage these Wasps on my own. Good luck in the rest of the Academy!
You should go visit the Academy Blacksmith now; The Thrungum have been stealing from him, and I'm sure he could use your help. Good luck with the rest of the Academy!

Help has arrived at last! Quickly, Carpenter Wasps have infested my woodpile! There are so many of them; could you help me clear out a few? They are here through this door beside me. If you bring me one of their wings to prove that you have taken some of them out, I will surely reward you.

greetings: Where did you find this? It certainly isn't mine! Why are you giving this to me?
My Goodness...look at the time, must be going, bye!
Shurov Thiloi!
quest: The "reformed" bandit has an extremely guilty look on his face. He even looks as if he might run for the hills.
Look! Behind you! Is that the white bunny?!
Shurov Thiloi!

Greetings, stranger. I've done many things to be ashamed of in the past, but I've come here to make a new start near the fair town of Holtburg. I enjoy the peace and quiet of these parts. Would you mind if I asked you to be on your way? I am entertaining some important guests, and I don't want them to be disturbed.

greetings: The stranger couldn't possibly look guiltier.
Why are you giving this to me? I don't know what this is, and I don't want it either. Take it back--I'll have nothing to do with it.
This note couldn't be for me--you see, I'm not a farmer.
quest: The stranger nearly jumps out of his shoes.
You're...you're back? Oh my! I didn't expect you to...they were supposed to take care of...so, you survived! Good for you! Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some chores to do.

Greetings, my friend, greetings! Welcome to my humble home. The hurly-burly of Marae Lassel proved too much for me, so I've decided to move here and call Yaraq home. Blend in. Make some friends among the peaceful townsfolk. In fact, I've made a good friend over in the Darkened Halls. He's recently moved here too. Why don't you pay him a visit as well? I'm sure he'd be happy to meet you and make...

greetings: You say you found this note near Shoushi? You should take it to Sir Tenshin. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
You say you found this note near Yaraq? You should take it to Dame Tsaya. She is overseeing the garrision in Yaraq and will be interested in any local developments.
You say you found this uniform near Shoushi? You should take it to Sir Tenshin. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.

You say you found this...thing in Yaraq? You should take it to Dame Tsaya. She is overseeing the garrision in Yaraq and will be interested in any local developments. Good thing she has a stronger stomach than I.
This letter is addressed to Sir Tenshin. You should take it to him in Shoushi.
This letter is addressed to Dame Tsaya. You should take it to her in Yaraq.
Sir Rylanan reads the letter from Dame Tsaya with great interest and growing concern.
What terrible news! It sounds as if Tsaya has her hands full down in Yaraq. A human husk, torn from a living being, I shudder to think of it.

Well, I have had some interesting times myself.  I've recently been assigned to Holtburg to build a garrision and be on the lookout for suspicious happenings. There is one fellow on the outskirts of town that I've been keeping my eye on. He's just moved here from Marae Lassel and sometimes comes into town for provisions. He says he's been "reformed", but I can spot a bandit when I see one! Town...
Sir Rylanan unfolds the note and reads it carefully.

So...this was all a plot to kill our Queen's son--through us, her own Guards! We, who have sworn to protect her heir!  I hope you gave those evil doers a good thrashing! Martine will pay for this some day! Let me reward you--you have done the kingdom of New Aluvia a great service on this day. We owe you a debt of gratitude.
quest: Thank you for all your help, traveler. The kingdom is grateful for all you have done. I have not seen anything overly suspicious recently; however, we can never be too sure. Come back in two weeks--there may be trouble again.
You are safely back from Fort Witshire, I see! Were my suspicions correct? Did you find any more clues to this plot?
Back so soon? Have you infiltrated their plot?
You have helped me a great deal my friend--have you taken the letter  I gave you to Sir Tenshin in Shoushi? He should be updated on what has transpired here.
I see you've returned from Asuger Temple in one piece. Did you find anything out of the ordinary while you were there?
You're back! How did your interview with that ex-bandit go? Did you find anything of note in his house?
I see you've just come over from Yaraq. Did Dame Tsaya send a letter with you? She has always been so good about updating her reports.
Greetings! I heard you helped Sir Tenshin a great deal down in Shoushi. You should visit Dame Tsaya in Yaraq now--she is setting up the garrison in Yaraq and should hear about your discoveries.
Thank you, but my hands are full with administrative affairs at the moment. I shall have to ask you to return at another time--perhaps two weeks from now.
What a strange object! Perfectly round, and perfectly smooth!
Sir Rylanan holds the spherule up to the light and stares into the milky glass.
What substance could possibly be swirling around in there? Looks like portal space energy, doesn't it?
Sir Rylanan starts to shake the spherule but suddenly thinks better of it.
I am out of my depth here...the mages of the Arcanum might be able to fathom this object's purpose. I will send it to the Arcanum for analysis.

I believe Sir Tenshin would be very interested to hear about your discoveries. He is heading up the garrision down in Shoushi. This letter will serve as your introduction to him--I have chronicled your discoveries, as well as the contents of the note you found earlier.
I should now reward you for your aid in investigating this matter.
Sir Rylanan reads the letter from Dame Tsaya with great interest and growing concern.
I think I am beginning to discern a pattern here. The Hollow Minions are creating their Simulacra by inflating these human husks they've been collecting with concentrated portal space energy...
Sir Rylanan shudders and continues.

And they've been paying that ridiculous farmer down in Shoushi to stockpile an arsenal of stolen Guards uniforms and weapons...they must have a plan to garb these new Simulacra in our uniforms to infiltrate our ranks. Could they be making a gambit to reach our Queen? Those miscreants! But where could their headquarters be?
Sir Rylanan thinks for a moment.

You know...Fort Witshire has been abandoned for quite some time now, but our scouts have found  that a group of Hollow Minions have claimed it and barricaded themselves inside so no one may enter. I'll bet you that's where they are.

We know that Fort Witshire was built on the ruins of an old Empyrean prison and prepared the portal beside me to penetrate the fort by using the underground passages underneath. You seem like just the person to help us with this. You may need this key once you enter Fort Witshire--it was found among Witshire's effects after he left the fort. Find out what those Hollow Minions are up to, the kin...

I've recently been assigned to Holtburg to build a garrision and be on the lookout for suspicious happenings. There is one fellow on the outskirts of town that I've been keeping my eye on. He's just moved here from Marae Lassel and sometimes comes into town for provisions. He says he's been "reformed", but I can spot a bandit when I see one! Townsfolk say they've spotted shady-looking guests co...

You say you found this note in that bandit's house? Surrounded by a pack of Hollow Minions? I knew that fellow was up to no good! Look here...it refers to Asuger Temple, up to the north. Last I heard, the temple was just a Banderling hideout...harmless really. I wonder what sort of trouble might be brewing up there? Find out what is going on, and I'm sure I could find something in the Guard's c...
What terrible news! It sounds as if Tsaya and Tenshin both have their hands full in their garrison towns. Stolen Guards uniforms and human husks, what's next?

Well, I have had some interesting times myself.  I've recently been assigned to Holtburg to build a garrision and be on the lookout for suspicious happenings. There is one fellow on the outskirts of town that I've been keeping my eye on. He's just moved here from Marae Lassel and sometimes comes into town for provisions. He says he's been "reformed", but I can spot a bandit when I see one! Town...

greetings: You say you found this note near Holtburg? You should take it to Sir Rylanan. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
My instincts were correct. I wonder who his new patron is? Here, you may have this back. I have already committed it to memory.
You say you found this note near Yaraq? You should take it to Dame Tsaya. She is overseeing the garrision in Yaraq and will be interested in any local developments.
You say you found this strange  object near Holtburg? You should take it to Sir Rylanan. He is overseeing the garrison in Holtburg and will be interested in any local developments.
Sir Tenshin takes one look at the object you just handed and turns a delicate shade of green.

I think I'm going to be ill. You say you found this near Yaraq? Quickly, take it to Dame Tsaya. She is overseeing the garrision in Yaraq and will be interested in any local developments. Go now, and take this with you.
Sir Tenshin reads the letter from Sir Rylanan with no small amount of amazement.

A glass spherule encapulating what looks as if it could be portal space energy? For what purpose? They say that Dereth is full of wonders...but if Hollow Minions are playing around with portal space, no good can come of it. Mark my words...

Come to think of it, I've remarked on some suspicious characters lately myself. Perhaps you can help me. There is a farmer who lives a little ways past the Shoushi South Outpost. He's been a normal townsmember for a very long time, but no one can speak for how he's come into so much wealth recently. Normally it's a cause to celebrate when one's neighbor moves up in the world...but why is he act...
Could you go and check in on him? I am sure there is nothing amiss, but I just want to be sure...
This letter is addressed to Dame Tsaya. You should take it to her in Yaraq.
This letter is addressed to Sir Rylanan. You should take it to him in Holtburg.
Sir Tenshin reads the note you found in the Hall of Hollows.

As I suspected--I thought they would try to infiltrate our ranks to gain access to Queen Elysa. But who would have thought they would be so low as to try to murder Borealean, Thorsten Cragstone's own son? The storm gathers once more...but nevermind. Your efforts have not gone unnoticed this day, comrade. Let me bestow upon you a mark of our Queen's favor, in recognition of your service to the c...
quest: It is always a pleasure to greet those who have helped the kingdom as you have done. Things seem to have died down a little bit--perhaps if you come back in two weeks or so I'll have more news to impart.
Good to see you again. I am glad  to see that you survived infiltrating Fort Witshire unscathed. Did you find anything of note while you were there?
Oh there you are. Need to go back underneath Fort Witshire? The portal is right there.
Good to see you again! Have you taken my letter to Dame Tsaya yet? I think that she really ought to be informed of your discoveries here.
There you are! Have you found out what that farmer's secret is? Let me know if he's been hoarding anything that could be considered...unusual in his house.
Greetings. Sir Rylanan mentioned he might be sending updates to me from Holtburg every so often. Might he have sent one with you?

Oh hello! I've got my hands full at the moment with a little local problem...perhaps you should visit Sir Rylanan up in Holtburg for now. He's heading up the garrison up there and will probably have a task for you.

Well, this is interesting! A Guard's uniform, no less! But I must apologize--I must tend to my duties as senior Guard here in Shoushi today. Keep this for now--but be sure to return and remind me of it in the future when I have more time.
You say you found this Guard's uniform in a hidden room in the farmer's basement? What's more, he had many of them? And he's stockpiling a large armament as well?

How could he have found access to these uniforms? These are the sole property of Her Majesty's Guard--and are dispensed only through our headquarters. They must have been stolen whilst our quartermaster was in his cups...I will alert our Queen of this affair immediately.

I believe Dame Tsaya in Yaraq should be alerted to this affair as well. Please take this letter to her--I have included your recent discoveries. I'm sure she will be highly interested to hear of what you have found.
Thank you for your help--here is your reward.
Sir Tenshin reads the letter from Sir Rylanan with no small amount of amazement and disgust.

This is just too much. Farmers stockpiling arsenals in their hidden basements, Hollow Minions torturing hapless victims and removing the very skin from their bodies, filling spherules with portal space energy, I can't take it! Why was I ever promoted?
Sir Tenshin quickly descends into a short flurry of hysteria, hiccups, and pulls himself together.

There must be connection here...could the Hollow Minions be taking the skins from their victims in order to fill them with the portal space in those spherules Rylanan told me about? All to clothe them in our Guards uniforms? This must be a plot to strike down our Queen! Every one knows that our station here is intended only to be temporary--we're only here to restore stability and then return t...

We have heard that a group of Hollow Minions have recently claimed Fort Witshire and barricaded themselves inside. Now that I think of it, this must be where their headquarters for this plot are located. It has long been known that Fort Witshire was built upon the ruins of an old Empyrean prison. We have been planning to infiltrate the fort by using the hidden corridors deep beneath the fort--a...

Use the portal next to me to enter the prison, then find your way to the top to reach the confines of Fort Witshire. Now, hurry! Try to find out what those Minions are plotting! There is no time to waste!

Greetings! I've just come to head the garrison here in Shoushi. The townsfolk of this peaceful city must be protected, and everyone should do their share to help! Could you help me to investigate a certain matter?

There is a farmer who lives a little ways past the Shoushi South Outpost. He's been a normal townsmember for a very long time, but no one can speak for how he's come into so much wealth recently. Normally it's a cause to celebrate when one's neighbor moves up in the world...but why is he acting so distantly when he comes to town to stock up on provisions?
Could you go and check in on him? I am sure there is nothing amiss, but I just want to be sure...

A glass spherule encapulating what looks as if it could be portal space energy? And what's this? Husks made from human skins? Poor Rylanan and Tsaya--they have more to deal with than they signed up for, I'll wager.  Hollow Minions playing around with portal space and harvesting the skin off of people's backs--no good will come of it. Mark my words...

Come to think of it, I've remarked on some suspicious characters lately myself. Perhaps you can help me. There is a farmer who lives a little ways past the Shoushi South Outpost. He's been a normal townsmember for a very long time, but no one can speak for how he's come into so much wealth recently. Normally it's a cause to celebrate when one's neighbor moves up in the world...but why is he act...
Could you go and check in on him? I am sure there is nothing amiss, but after hearing all of this I have to be sure...

greetings: You say you found this note near Holtburg? You should take it to Sir Rylanan. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
You say you found this note near Shoushi? You should take it to Sir Tenshin. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
What's this? Planting? Crops? Harvest? Old Man Witshire had a farm? This requires more thought. Here, you should keep this, I have already memorized it.
You say you found this object near Holtburg? You should take it to Sir Rylanan. He is overseeing the garrison in Holtburg and will be interested in any local developments.

You say you found this uniform in Shoushi? Most irregular--no one should have these uniforms on hand except the members of the Strathelar Guard themselves. You should take it to Sir Tenshin. He is overseeing the garrision in Shoushi and will be interested in any local developments.
This letter is addressed to Sir Tenshin. You should take it to him in Shoushi.
Dame Tsaya quickly glances over the letter from her comrade in Shoushi.

What a disappointing happenstance. Not only has a farmer been allowed to stockpile an arsenal in his basement, but he is concealing stolen Guards uniforms as well? Tenshin must learn to keep better order than this.

Nonetheless, perhaps you could aid me as well.  Queen Elysa recently appointed me to lead the garrison here in Yaraq. She was deeply grieved when the 12 Training Halls were destroyed and wants to ensure that no harm will come to her subjects here.

To that end, I have a small task for you: We have heard that a newcomer to this town has moved into a villa that has lain abandoned for many years. No one knows where he came from, although it is said he speaks with a Northern accent. Would you stop by his residence, and find out more about him? He lives to the southwest, near Lubziklan al-Luq's apple orchards.
This letter is addressed to Sir Rylanan. You should take it to him in Holtburg.
Dame Tsaya sighs deeply and shuts her eyes after reading the contents of the folded note.

I was right, in all except one thing. It was Borelean's life at stake, not Elysa's. And to attempt his murder through us, the Queen's own Guard...an audacious plan. Martine deserves no mercy for this, you have my word. We of the Strathelar Guard owe you a great debt for warding off what would have been a terrible tragedy--especially for Elysa and Asheron.
quest: You are still remembered well among the Guards. Such service to the crown does not go unnoticed, comrade. There have not been any new developments for me to relate, but come back in two weeks--I am sure we have not heard the last from Martine.
I see you have come back from the Fort in one piece. Do you have any more interesting finds for me?
No doubt Fort Witshire is exceedingly more difficult than has been in the past.

Thank you for your assistance in this matter, my friend. If you haven't already, you should take the letter I gave you to Sir Rylanan in Holtburg. What I learned today worries me a great deal. I fear for the people of this peaceful town, now I know what lies up in the hills of Yaraq...
Dame Tsaya turns to you gravely.
Yes, what did you discover up in the Darkened Halls?

The stranger actually asked you to visit his new "friend" down in the Darkened Halls? That dismal place has always been just the lair of some lowly Drudges, to my knowledge...perhaps you should investigate this matter. If you find anything out of the ordinary, I'd appreciate it if you brought it to me for inspection. Something just doesn't sound quite right.
I am mentoring Sir Tenshin in the responsibilities that come with being the leader of an important garrison. Did he send any letters for me along with you? I do like to keep track of his progress.
