Greetings. I believe Sir Tenshin over in Shoushi has a matter in which he requires assistance. Please go to him and offer your help in whatever he requires. As his mentor, I would normally go myself, but I am afraid I must attend to my duties here.
Appalled, Dame Tsaya gingerly handles the human husk and covers it with a linen cloth.

You found this in the Darkened Halls? Poor soul. I can only wonder what he went through in his last tortures.  What dark intent could spur the Hollow Minions into committing such an atrocity? No wonder that stranger asked you so nicely to visit his comrades in those Halls--he must have been seeded here to send weak, innocent victims to their deaths--luckily he failed in taking your measure.  I...
Please take this letter to Sir Rylanan in Holtburg. He must know immediately of the terrible crimes that are being committed here in Yaraq.
I must now reward you for your discoveries here today.
Dame Tsaya quickly glances over the letter from her comrade in Shoushi and muses aloud.

I have no doubt now that what has occurred here and in Holtburg and Shoushi are connected. Rylanan reports that the Hollow Minions are siphoning portal energy into concentrated spherules of glass. Tenshin tells me that a man has been discovered hoarding weapons and stolen Guard's uniforms. And the terrible atrocities here in Yaraq, under my own watch...
Dame Tsaya abruptly comes to a conclusion.

The Hollow Minions are creating their own Simulacra by somehow channeling portal space energy into these poor human husks. I have no doubt their plan was to clothe their Simulacra in our uniforms to infiltrate the Guard. Our Queen is in danger, and we must put a stop to this.
I have received reports that a band of Hollow Minions have barricaded themselves into Fort Witshire. I am now confident that the fort must house the headquarters of this plot.
Dame Tsaya sizes you up speculatively.

I believe I have just the plan. Fort Witshire was built upon the ruins of an old Empyrean prison. We can infiltrate the fort if we first go through its lower passageways. We created this portal to reach the prison, and I have only been waiting for the right person to grant permission to use it--and I now believe that person is you.

Press onwards to the top, and when you enter Fort Witshire itself, try to find out who is commanding the Hollow Minions there. This key may be of good use once you enter the fort--it was found among Witshire's effects when he left the fort. I cannot emphasize how much I believe the Queen's safety depends on this. Good luck.

Hail, adventurer! Queen Elysa recently appointed me to lead the garrison here in Yaraq. She was deeply grieved when the 12 Training Halls were destroyed and wants to ensure that no harm will come to her subjects here.

To that end, I have a small task for you: We have heard that a newcomer to this town has moved into a villa that has lain abandoned for many years. No one knows where he came from, although it is said he speaks with a Northern accent. Would you stop by his residence, and find out more about him? He lives to the southwest, near Lubziklan al-Luq's apple orchards.
But first, I must reward you for your discoveries here today.
Dame Tsaya quickly glances over the letter from her comrade in Shoushi.

What a disappointing happenstance. Not only has a farmer been allowed to stockpile an arsenal in his basement, but he is concealing stolen Guards uniforms as well? And Rylanan is having his own share of suspicious behavior up in Holtburg too...I wonder what trouble could be brewing now?

Nonetheless, perhaps you could aid me as well.  Queen Elysa recently appointed me to lead the garrison here in Yaraq. She was deeply grieved when the 12 Training Halls were destroyed and wants to ensure that no harm will come to her subjects here.

To that end, I have a small task for you: We have heard that a newcomer to this town has moved into a villa that has lain abandoned for many years. No one knows where he came from, although it is said he speaks with a Northern accent. Would you stop by his residence, and find out more about him? He lives to the east, past Lubziklan al-Luq's house.

greetings: Attentive.
The box attends the master.
Lilitha inclines her head toward you and waits, looking numbly expectant.
Lilitha blinks at you uncomprehendingly.
Why is that one on the other side of the wall?
Lilitha reaches toward you, and absently gropes her own face. She seems confused.
That one is... The box hasn't seen flesh poison in... in a long time.
Person. The box meant person.
The box used to count the days with marks on the walls. It used its fingernails. It counted four years. Then they changed the walls so they wouldn't mark. That was a long time ago.

Does that one see the hand? It is not the box's hand. They took that. They put it in a glass bubble and it turned into fog. They attached the box to this one later. Sometimes the hand talks to the box.
Temenua. That one caught the box as it slept. It brought the box to a child, and the child gave it to these things.
An angry blush colors Lilitha's cheeks, and an unexpected gleam rises in her eyes...
It BOUND me. No one EVER --
... but a faint, glissando shriek comes from her head. She flinches, and the gleam dies as quickly as it came.
They put a thing in the box's head. A crystal thing. When the box becomes agitated it screams. The Masters told the box it is a keeper.

The box doesn't know what they are. They didn't talk at first. They just kept stabbing glass pins into the box. The first thing they said was the box's own voice, like an echo. Then they started putting the box's words together in different ways.
They took the box apart twice. First they looked for what was inside the box, but they said it was empty. Then they wanted to know what made the box go.
They did it with blue lights. They drew lines on the box and it fell to pieces.
They wouldn't let the box move. The box watched it happen, until the light reached its eyes.
It... hurt me...
Lilitha abruptly falls to her knees and begins to retch, hugging herself tightly.
They brought a man here once. They split him open and scooped out his insides. They made a pile, like sticky fruit. Then they put other things inside him that glowed red and purple.
One of the Masters said they learned how to do it by studying the box. It said the man's name was Martine.
They took the box outside in a cloud. It's nothing but purple. You could fall forever, and everything was bent this way and that. But in some places there were blue ribbons that crackled and danced.

There were things around the ribbons. They looked like glowing water and trailed strings of jelly. They turned as the box went by and poked each other with the jelly-strings. They were the size of houses. Maybe. Size doesn't work right outside.
This is not a complete Symbol of Marriage. Please find the other symbols, combine them, and return to me the Symbol of Marriage.
To begin the marriage ceremony, you must first hand me the Symbol of Marriage. If you are in search of the Symbol, a series of tests await you near Arwic.
It gives me great joy knowing those I join in union go forth to make this land a happier and healthier place to be.
quest: You have visited me too recently.  Please reconsider your vows and reread the Wedding Handbook.
Welcome, friends and family! Let us begin the ceremony of Marriage!

You have come here today to demonstrate your commitment to one another.  You come bearing the Symbol of Marriage as proof of that commitment.  I accept this Symbol as a your vow that you agree to love, cherish and honor your spouse for all your time here in Dereth.

You have made your vows under the Symbol of that which you hold important.  Before the witnesses of your friends and family, I now pronounce this union to be made.  There is one last step you must take to make this union complete.
May your marriage bring you great happiness. You should take the time to inscribe the Emblem of Marriage with words that show your commitment to your spouse, then present them.

You who stand here as witnesses are the friends and family of those seeking our blessings today.  You are charged with the task of helping them in their new role of marriage, to support them in their times of need, and to do all that you can to make their marriage a blessed and happy union.
Use this Promise Gem as a final demonstration of your love.  When used, the of Marriage becomes complete.

To begin the marriage ceremony, you must first hand me the Symbol of Marriage. If you are in search of the Symbol, a series of tests await you near Arwic.
It gives me great joy knowing those I join in union go forth to make this land a happier and healthier place to be.

greetings: Thank you for liberating me! I hope you are not injured!  I see Glysander has sent you. I know he is anxious to recover the letters but alas, I cannot continue this quest now.

Here are two letters I have found. I can tell you where to find another letter, or its exact copy. Find Lia Tze in Baishi. She has a letter in her possession, and I was informed she might have a means for you to obtain a replica of Thorsten Cragstone's Armor.  Or you may go to Tou-Tou and seek out a man named Tai Wo. He has a copy of the same letter Lia Tze has and may have knowledge of how to...
Those Tumeroks have me trapped here. I am glad their number has been dealt a severe blow!

quest: You know where Eastham is, right? Please go find Brontynn Marshad's cottage south of there and see if he left any letters in his chest. He said his cottage was between the beach and the road.
You gave me that one recently. Is this a copy? It is worthless to me, I will dispose of it.
You gave me that one recently and it broke my heart. Is this a copy? It is worthless to me, I will dispose of it!

Hello, I hope that you are here to help me!  My name is Glysander Cartoth.  I seek to recover a series of letters that Elysa Strathelar wrote to my older sister, Lania Cartoth.  They were friends from childhood on Ispar and they corresponded for some time here in Dereth.  One day my sister disappeared.  I believe the letters may hold a clue to her disappearance.  I will reward you with Experien...

There is a man, Brontynn Marshad, who promised to try to track down the letters but I have not heard from him in some time. He was staying in a cottage south of Eastham, near the beach. There is a chest in the cottage inside which he said he would leave letters for me to pick up periodically. I give you the key to the chest, for I am unable to make this journey. Please see if there are letters...
Thank you, that is one of the letters! Here is your reward.
Oh Lania, why did you have to go there!
Thank you for bringing me the letter. Here is your reward. Please leave me to my sorrow.
I am sorry, I believe you are not powerful enough to help me.  Please come back when you have reached Level Twenty.

greetings: Lia Tze examines the mould intensely.
You took a fine mould!
Lia Tze crafts a fine replica of Thorsten's Armor.
Here is an exacting replica of Thorsten Cragstone's Armor. It will make a fine decoration!
quest: A friend of mine in Tou-Tou observed you speaking with that vile excuse of a man, Tai Wo.  I do not trust anyone who deals with him.  Be gone!
Are you having trouble finding where Thorsten Cragstone's Armor is? Read the letter I gave you!

Ah, yes, Brontynn Marshad sent you. Here is the letter I intended to give him. I came across it a long time ago, I remember not where. It seems to offer a clue to where Thorsten Cragstone's Armor was hidden.

If you seek it and find it, I doubt you can remove the armor. Nor should you. However, I have also given you a quantity of wax with which you may make a mould of the armor. Having some armorsmithing skills myself, I have a historical interest in the armor. Bring me the mould with the impression of the armor and I will give you a fine replica of the armor which will serve as an exquisite decorat...
Have you been sent by Brontynn Marshad, who is helping Glysander Cartoth in Cragstone?  No, I think you have not. Go see Glysander Cartoth in Cragstone and he will tell you what he needs done.

greetings: Tai Wo examines the mould intensely.
Tai Wo crafts a fine replica of Thorsten's Axe.
You took a fine mould!  Here is an exacting replica of Thorsten Cragstone's Axe. Use it with care! I pray you do not come to the same end as he!
quest: A friend of mine in Baishi saw you speaking with that terrible woman, Lia Tze.  I cannot trust anyone who deals with her.  Go away!
Are you having trouble finding where Thorsten Cragstone's Armor is? Read the letter I gave you!

Good, I see Brontynn Marshad sent you.  Here is the letter I was going to give him. A learned colleague of mine who examined it believes this letter holds a clue to the location of Thorsten Cragstone's Axe.

Should you find it, you should leave it in its hiding place, however here is a quantity of wax with which you may make a mould of the axe. Having been an armorsmith in the past, the axe is of historical interest to me and I would very much like to make a replica of it. Bring me the mould with the impression of the armor and I will make a fine replica of the axe for you!  I wish you luck in this...
Have you been sent by Brontynn Marshad or by Glysander Cartoth in Cragstone?  No, I see you have not. Go see Glysander Cartoth in Cragstone and he will tell you what he needs done.

greetings: The Monster deserves what she gets.
Sacrificing Isparians -- for any cause! -- is evil!
Damned be the monster.
quest: Greetings. Thank you for showing the wisdom to let the witch suffer her fate. Her transgression against her fellow man is at an end. My teacher has completed the reward for those that show this witch what she deserves.
%n waves his hand in the air, an odd gesture, but one he seems to find amusing.
He has constructed a place for you to train yourselves quickly. Mind you, you cannot stay there. Here, take this.
Each time that you speak to me I will give you another gem just like that one. When you give me that gem back, I will give you the means to the training grounds that my master has prepared.
%n wipes his brow as if sweating. A pained look spreads over his face for a moment, then dissipates.
But though I will give you as many gems as you wish, I will only grant you access to the place three times per week.
I cannot allow you passage into the chambers of reward until you have waited for some time to pass. Please return to me after the passage of one week.

I will transport you back this last time. Be careful not to be crushed while within those walls you impudent- I mean, take care and be well, for I cannot send you to that place again, at least for a short while.
You shall have one more passage after this friend. Pray you do not perish within these walls that third time. For if you do you shall be bereft of whatever items you leave behind.
%n looks as though he will begin laughing, but then his face goes pale and blank.
How did you come to me? You have overstayed your welcome here. Return to your precious cities! My master cares not for those that will let her evil go unpunished.
Very well. I shall give you the means to portal to the place that my master has created for you who chose the right. You must obtain a gem from me each time to make the journey.
But be very careful within, for I will not give you more than three gems within the space of one week. The full cycle of days shall be calculated from the third gem I give you.

greetings: %n writes something into a book of notes, mutters a bit and continues writing.
What are they up to?
Fascinating!

Did you see that!? One of the Grievvers just motioned as if to warn another one! Perhaps this is a basic form of non-verbal communication or maybe a hierarchical order, I must record this and study it further.
Remarkable creatures!

So, you were able to get the Spinning Wheel to make this? Wonderful! And very strong thread too. Are you going to see what the Loom at Neydisa Castle might do with it? This is wonderful, now that grievvers can provide us with Silk, perhaps people will take my work more seriously.
Such fine craftsmanship. You say the Loom at Neydisa Castle made this? Fascinating what machines can do.
If I weren't so interested in Grievvers and Olthoi I might consider studying these magical devices, perhaps in time I will grow tired of them...
Oh, look here, you have something on your flag. I'll just wash that out for you.
All clean, here you go.
Verdentine holds the Olthoi Head up reverently peering through the eyeholes.
The Olthoi is a marvel of nature. I would love to see the world they can from, their natural environment must be very harsh and demanding to require so much armor.

Have you thought of making a helmet out of this? I have a friend who crafts items from Olthoi trophies. She lives in Newic, I'm sure she would be happy to make this into a helm for you. She's known as the Olthoi Hunter.
The researcher hefts the claw in his hands.

Extremely lightweight, yet amazingly strong and look at the sharp edge here. They can pierce armor with these things as easily as you do with a sword. Speaking of which, you can have this crafted into a sword by my friend who still lives in Newic. Her name is... come to think of it, I don't know her name. Huh! Everyone just calls her the Olthoi Hunter.
Verdentine eyes grow extremely wide as he surveys the Olthoi Carapace you hand him.
Did you take this from a Queen?
For a brief moment Verdentine looks extremely dangerous, then the anger drains from his features leaving a look of sad resignation.
I wasn't sure if the rumors were true... Now I'll never be able to see her alive, I can only hope that she wasn't the last.
You must be quite a skilled hunter to have recovered this whole. I just can't get over the size of this Carapace... Thank you for showing it to me.

I've heard of these. Apparently they are quite valuable on Marae Lassel. I really need to take a trip to that island to study it's Olthoi. I've even heard rumors of a new Olthoi Queen. There just isn't enough time is there? Oh well, my work here is fascinating too.
Verdentine hands the pincer back to you.
Very interesting, thank you.

I've heard of these. Apparently they are quite valuable on Marae Lassel. I really must to take a trip to that island to study it's Olthoi. I've even heard rumors of a new Olthoi Queen. There just isn't enough time is there? Oh well, my work here is fascinating too.
I don't know how to feel about this. You have managed to kill this unique and marvelous Lady.

I am joyed to be able to examine this specimen, but I also feel anger and sorrow at the possibility that you may have doomed the Olthoi species of this land. Do we have more of a right to this world than they? Who is to say? I know the Olthoi enslaved us. I know they kill us. I just don't think that exterminating them is the only answer.
I am sorry I did not mean to place a burden on your shoulders. You have done a mighty deed for sure.
%n holds the mounted head at arms length. His face contorts in sorrow for a brief moment.
I am... joyed to be able to examine this specimen. I'm sure tales of your deed will be told for years to come. A fine mounting job, Tumerok craftsmanship if I'm not mistaken.

Ah yes, an original Olthoi Helm. My friend the Olthoi Hunter no doubt made this for you quite a long time ago. It truly is a classic design. May it serve you well, at least better than it served its original owner.
Haha, it's not often I have company to laugh with.

A newer version of my friend's famous helm. Look at that craftsmanship! He uses the Olthoi head's natural strengths and adds to them where the shell is weakest. A beautiful helm. You are very lucky to own one.

Here we have one of the most beautiful examples of natural armor. The Olthoi Carapace is perfectly suited to resisting heavy blows and attacks as well as sharp piercing strikes. This cuirass is lighter than most and stronger too, a fine piece of work. Thank you for allowing me to study it, may it protect you always.
%n hefts the weapon in his hand and examines the blades black luster.
A blade lighter than steel and sharper than most non-magical weapons.
Odd that you can fight Olthoi with their own appendages. You would think it would cause them some confusion as well... Perhaps it just makes them angry. A fine sword!
You experience a slight queasy feeling watching Verdentine eat the cake.
Mmmmm chocolate, and you can taste the Olthoi!
Verdentine pokes a hole in the egg with his finger. He eyes the contents for a second and then tips the egg to his mouth and drinks it down.
A wave of nausea washes over you.
Delicious! And it will keep me going while I'm out here in the field. Thank you.
How Clever! It's really a very good likeness of an Olthoi. What will they think of next?
Oh, right, you want your doll back. Here, take it.
Oh! It's not real! Haha, very funny. Of course you wouldn't think it so funny if you had been bitten by one of the little nippers.
Oh, this isn't mine to keep? Well, have it back I guess.

I see you've harvested some of the rare Grievver Acid. Very powerful stuff! I sometimes use it to clean my armor up. By the way, don't open this anywhere around here. If the Grievvers pick up on it they could cause you no end of trouble.

Haha, just kidding! I know what this stuff is and I very seriously doubt I would like the taste of it. However be forewarned, I wouldn't open this here if I were you. The Grievvers have a fierce dislike of the Olthoi and I'm afraid that the smell of this stuff, if in fact Grievvers can smell, would bring them running in droves.
No, I can't have a campfire. It might attract the Grievvers.
Small price to pay really.
I recently tried to get recognition at the Arcanum for my work on Grievvers. Do you know what they told me?

They said chasing bugs is "just an eccentric hobby" not worthy of funding. Well, I don't need the Queen's backing. I'm sure that my work will bear fruit and prove it's worth to those skeptics someday.
I have a theory on how Grievvers perceive the world. They have no evident visual organs, yet they seem to move about quite easily.

From what I have learned and deduced I believe Grievvers come from the same world as the Olthoi, but unlike the Olthoi they were bent to the will of the Shadows. This undoubtedly changed them in ways I cannot say. Perhaps they used to have eyes, perhaps not, I think they may use magics now to attain a view of the world. If so, they can probably see things that we cannot. Or it may be that they...
At some point I may try and get a specimen to dissect and learn more, but my work here is currently more important.
%n gazes dreamily into the distance.

Imagine having the abilities of a Grievver! You could climb almost any surface. Your strength would be magnified many times that of a normal human. You could spin webs, although that seems rather useless unless you want to catch your lunch... You reactions would be enhanced and you might have senses beyond those we are aware of.
I know that sounds silly, but I often daydream about such things.
Did you see that? A little Grievver! I wonder if it's a different species or just a juvenile.
I fear that they may detect my camp here on the hill and figure out a way up. I'm not much of a fighter I'm afraid.

This I know for a fact. The Grievvers cannot abide the presence of Olthoi. They will fight fiercely against them whenever the two come in contact. This leads me to believe that the Grievvers and Olthoi share some common origin.
quest: Verdentine takes the Silk and fluffs it in his hands.
That's some very nice Silk! Got it from a Grievver you say? Well you shouldn't try and get anymore for at least two weeks. We have to think about conservation don't we?

Here you go. Very interesting substance, it's a much finer quality than the webbing I've seen all over the valley. You know, I've heard of two machines able to spin fine materials like this into cloth. I seem to remember they were both found in Castles somewhere... let me check my notes.
Yes, here it is!

It says here that there was a Spinning Wheel found in a Castle to the Northeast of Shoushi overrun by skeletons... and here it says that a Loom was recently found in a food cellar at Neydisa Castle. The residents dragged it up to a tower room, but were unable to get it to produce any useable cloth.
I think our insect friends have provided you with the materials required. You might try seeing if you can get the devices to work.

Good luck in your travels my friend! I am going to continue my studies of these fascinating creatures here. Please, only kill them out of necessity so as not to disturb the fragile ecological balance in this area.
Verdentine studies the Silk for a moment.

Yes, a high quality Silk! Looks like you could go and get some more now if you like, but after that I must insist that you not try and harvest more Silk from the Grievvers for at least two weeks. I'm concerned about the colonies well being as I'm sure are you.
Here's your Silk back. Do you know of the two machines able to spin fine materials like this into cloth?
I've read of a Spinning Wheel found in a Castle to the Northeast of Shoushi overrun by skeletons and there was a Loom found in a food cellar at Neydisa Castle.
You might try seeing if you can fashion this Silk into something of use.
Farewell my friend, I am only just beginning to uncover the secrets of how the Grievvers social structure works and I must get back to my observations so as not to miss anything.

greetings: Remember, if you find anything that looks even slightly mechanical down in those Foundries, bring it to me and I'll see if I can make it into a little statue for you.
quest: I'm afraid I'm all out of spare parts at the moment! I'm waiting on another shipment--if you come back a week from now, I'm sure I can work on your items for you then.

Gears, pliers, metal plates, screws, nuts and bolts,  A-ha! Here we go...

No, that wasn't YOUR name I heard singing from the hills! You're not the one who killed the Native Cast in the towns' defense! Why don't you give this trophy to the one who truly destroyed the statue? There's a good fellow.

greetings: %n turns the item over in his hands, scrutinizing the metal.
Hmm ... It looks to be intact. Those filthy snakebeasts did not harm this one, it appears. That means it can still be imbued.
As %n speaks words that sound like gibberish, the metal of the necklace glows softly and then returns to normal.
Well then, I suppose that I should explain what you are to do with this item, eh? Hrmph.
%n leans over his table and picks up a book.
The most important thing to understand about this item is that it is yours. You make it, you wear it. And once you've made it, you can't change it -- you'll have to make another one.

This one seems to be of the lowest quality -- when you imbue it, it will only hold lesser spells. I assume that you were unable to enter the more dangerous areas of the storehouse. Well, for now you may as well imbue this one.
You have been into the hive of sclavus then, and lived to tell the tale. Excellent work.
%n examines the metal ring and smiles as if very pleased.
Here, you will need this guide.

Now, you must be know that once you make one of these things, you can't change it. That means that you should think long and hard on what you would like to create for yourself. This book will explain the process in greater detail.
%n looks at the gorget and tears well in his eyes.
She has done so much to help us. This is the most minor of her efforts. Here, this was made for one such as you in the first place.
You may only alter this item once each month, so take care and make the correct decision for you. You will need this as well.

This will impart to you the details that are necessary in the crafting of your new gift. Remember well what you have done to earn this gift. She was ... is vigilant in her protection of us, fellow. Remember that.
This is an odd base. Nothing like the other dais I have seen. Nicely detailed, but very light. You say that Fanzen San believes it is hollow? Hmm...

After a brief examination of it, I do believe that it is indeed hollow. Here, take this Etheric Seal and use it to open the Dais. I can't imagine what might be inside, so please be careful when you open it.
quest: %n looks you over with disgust.
No, I do not think I will speak with you.
%n surveys you with the scrutiny of a jeweler appraising a fine gem.
I see that you are an adventurer of sorts. I find most adventurers to be fools. But ... you have helped Nuhmudira. That makes you a noble fool, at least.
%n sighs.
If you assisted Balthazar and you obtained a necklace or gorget of sorts, then be quick -- hand it to me.

If you have not, perhaps you had best go see if Balthazar and the High Queen's Royal Guard need your help in getting the job done in Lin. Though I wouldn't put much faith in the woman, or anyone loyal to her. Don't look so surprised -- not everyone follows the High Queen blindly. I think that our recent contact with Asheron is an affront to Nuhmudira.
%n raises an eyebrow and studies you grimly.
No ... I do not believe the lies that are spread about Nuhmudira. But you are welcome to your own opinion.
I am a very busy man. If you have no dealings with me or messages from the High Queen's man in Lin, Balthazar, please leave me be.
%n spits at your feet.
You abandoned Nuhmudira? Get out of my sight!
You helped Nuhmudira! You are a very noble person.
%n snaps to attention, and salutes you.

You are most welcome within this place. We need your help. There are sclavus beyond this portal that are as strong as a Banderling Captain. If you feel that you can handle fighting these creatures you are welcome to enter.
Everyone should have the opportunity to strike a blow against these defiling creatures.
You may also, if you are lucky, find a gorget inside. Balthazar can explain a little bit more about this item to you. Good luck, friend!

greetings: Thank you for the Sunflower Oil! Thou hast made a wise purchase! Here is thy  instruction book explaining how to craft the Horn of Vigilance and thy free carving knife! Be certain to read the instruction book carefully. There are a mere four items you will have to loot from creatures I am certain you will easily defeat. Then you must carve them into the appropriate components.
You may begin by getting a large Niffis Shell. It is needed for the base of the instrument. Not a small Niffis shell, mind you, but a large one- you are not in the business of crafting a mere kazoo!

Whoa friend! Are you having a problem with your Horn of Vigilance? I cannot provide a refund for this item or exchange it! I have fifteen of these things around my house and they don't do a da... uh, I mean, they don't allow any Olthoi to intrude into my domain. Heh, heh! Hey, when was the last time you saw Olthoi around here?  Run along now please, I have customers to attend to.

Hello harried traveler. Is thy residence threatened by Olthoi or other vermin?  Then thou art in need of the Horn of Vigilance! I have been commissioned by the famed Isparian Researcher Telk the Addlepated to sell instructions for this device that he has spent decades developing. The merest breath of wind blowing through this instrument produces a sound which is not discernible by human ears, y...

Such a fine instrument could easily be sold for 999,999,999 Pyreals, however I will provide you with everything you need to craft it for a mere jar of Sunflower Oil!  For one single jar of Sunflower Oil I will provide thee with a beautiful, leather bound, instruction book describing the easy to follow crafting steps for making the astounding Horn of Vigilance.
But hark! There is more!

For no extra fee at all I will give thee an extremely useful carving knife which thou may use to craft this item!  This knife alone has a thousand and one uses! It can carve arrowshafts, cut meat and chicken, chop cabbage, filet fish, slice mushrooms and carrots, cut bread and even carve a pumpkin! Is that not extraordinary?!

Thus, I strongly urge thee to hurry, pick a Sunflower and bring it to Lilly of Glenden Wood.  She will make thee some Sunflower Oil which thou should bring back to me. It is just that effortless! One may find Sunflowers in forested areas of North and South Osteth.
When you return I will tell you about other items required. Good hunting!

Greetings. Asheron, my lord and creator, has sent me here in an effort to assist your Arcanum. I am working closely with Ciandra of the Arcanum Consortium at Xarabydun. Vist her, and she can enlighten you as to the task at hand.
The Emissary carefully takes the Aerbax Mask Shard, surrounding it in a ball of white light. The Shard writhes with dark energy.
I cannot cleanse this mask shard, it is far too corrupted. Perhaps Leopold, the Virindi in Ayan Baqur, can do something with it.
Well, I suppose Olthoi will eat anything. Perhaps you should hold on to this for awhile.
Perhaps you would rather have some experience in exchange for this?
Ah Yes, I see that you have broken the hold Aerbax had on the memories of poor Ilservian.
The data crystal. Thank you, you have done well. I have this for you, from Lord Asheron.
The Emissary absorbs the crystal, glowing brighter for a moment, and then hands you a fairly large device similar to the one you just returned from, but much smaller.
It seems these Apostate Virindi are the cause of the disturbances, but there is not enough data here to answer why.
It will take about a week for the device to collect enough data to give me more information. Come back then if you wish to further aid my Lord Asheron.
A fascinating piece of congealed energy. It does not look very stable though. I fear it would not long survive contact with the energies that animate this form.
Perhaps it can be used to open a passageway into portalspace, if brought to the correct area in the Iron Blade tunnels? It does resonate similarly to one of the detected anomalies within the tunnels.

I wish I could tell you more, but the Aetherium levels in the tunnels and in the Gear Knights make it difficult to pin down an exact location...Which would indeed be a great reason to hide something there...
Good luck!
Interesting. This is similar to the Apostate Shards being found in the area of the Iron Blade Gear Knights, but there seems to be some sort of supression effect or ward upon it.
Let me see what I can do about that.
The Emissary of Asheron chants softly in an odd singsong language. After a moment, there's a faint 'pop' sound, and the shard begins to glow.
Ah, there we go. This should now allow you to slip through a portalspace fluxuation in the area near where you found it, and bypass the Apostate's defenses to the area it is attuned to.

Here you go. Don't waste time, however, as it seems somewhat unstable. Head back to the steam vents near the Freebooter Isle Volcano, find an anomoly that looks similar to the destroyed portals, and use it next to the fluxuations you see.
What's this?!
Well, when I sent you to investigate the Apostate Activity on Freebooter Isle, I did not expect you to come back with a shard like this.
This is a shard off of an animate Blood Stone. Dark things, those, and this one has been used in some sort of draining ritual, and a powerful one at that.
Come, tell me, how did you come about this?
You explain to the Emissary about the Undead you found allied with the Apostates, and the information you gained in defeating them.
Hmmm... This explains much, and is very troubling. If the old Emperor of the Dericost is involved in this, there is no telling how deeply these troubles will run.
But, for now, let me reward you for your assistance, and then we'll see if I can use the signatures on this to rescue some of the Empyreans this Bloodstone was affecting.
You are not authorized to receive a weapon.
I am collecting those old rare weapons that adventurers used to stumble upon from time to time.
If you give me one I'll give you a token you can use to buy a fancy new one.
You are not authorized to receive any tokens at this time.
I see. Perhaps you would prefer some information instead?
The Emissary draws back a bit at the sight of the potion.
No thank you, I never touch the stuff.
Goodness, this befouled ichor came from the Harbinger?
A different Harbinger you say? Beneath the Essence Chambers?

Lord Asheron must be informed of this immediately. Here take these trinkets I have gathered from the brave people who have fought the Harbinger and may those you meet know that you are a "Storm Rider."
I award you the title Champion of Dereth. The stamp is a gift from the High Queen. We are indebted to you for your efforts, Champion.
I award you the title Harbinger's Bane. We are indebted to you for your efforts in keeping the Harbinger down.
I award you the title Master of the Elements. We are indebted to you for your efforts in keeping the Harbinger down.

With the resurgence of the Harbinger and the assaults levied against it by Nuhmudira and Aerbax, I have taken it upon myself to stand as a balance between the two. I cannot offer the same gifts that they would grant but if you return to me with proof of the Harbinger's defeat I will gladly offer you a reward and a symbol of your efforts.

If you wish to fight the Essences that reside below. You should buy a Decanter of Nullified Essence and a Guide to the Harbinger from Beldin in the old mage tower west of the stone. Or you could talk to Ciandra's Apprentice, Talar, in Xarabydun.
quest: You have assisted me recently. Others should also help in this endeavor. Please return in a few days and I may require your assistance.

Greetings. Asheron is continuing a line of research into Lifestones which he had begun once, long ago. He has sent me to enlist the services of Isparians in obtaining a rare form of crystal. Dailantium Crystals are important to this research- there are several ancient mines in which Dailantium Crystals are yet stored.

Asheron has summoned a portal on a hill north of the town of Holtburg. From that portal you may begin this pursuit. You will discover direct portals to the mine at its destination- you should enter the portal appropriate to your abilities.  Once you have obtained a quantity of the crystal return it to me.  You shall then be granted access to the gift container Asheron has placed nearby. I wish...

Thank you for your assistance in obtaining this Dailantium Crystal for Asheron. I now grant you access to the gift container. Asheron may require more Dailantium Crystals in about four days if you wish to undertake this task again.
You must wait %tqt to receive the rewards again.

Well done! Aerbax's Shadow has lost his hold on the planar energies his device has been extracting. We must stay vigilant for he will continue to gain power as long as he holds the platforms. Return tomorrow to defeat Aerbax's Shadow again and I will reward you further.
Hurry, your fellowship only has approximately %tqt left. Use the Harmonic Transference Field.
You haven't brought me the North Gate Harmonic Crystal yet.
Return to me when you have them and I will prepare you and a Fellowship of your choosing for travel to Aerbax's Platforms above.
You haven't brought me the East Gate Harmonic Crystal yet.
You have been awarded the title of "Aerbax's Bane"
You haven't brought me the West Gate Harmonic Crystal yet.

Good, I am attuning your fellowship to the resonant magic field surrounding the device. Be warned, this spell will only allow you access to Aerbax's platforms for one hour before it fails and Aerbax expels you.
Please return to me if you succeed in defeating Aerbax and I will reward you.
Good, you made it.
There seems to be a fellowship already helping with stopping Aerbax. Please return later.
I have been sent here by Lord Asheron to help you stop Aerbax.
I have been unable to destroy this device. Aerbax realized what you were doing and protected his last device somehow.
However, I have studied the device and believe there is a way to use it's resonant magic field.

Scouts report that Aerbax's forces are even now attempting to repair the other devices you destroyed. Return to the other Gates and bring me back the crystals they are using to repair the devices. Once I have all three crystals I believe I can send a fellowship of you through to the platforms above.
You cannot proceed unless you first create a Fellowship.
Excellent! You have brought me all three Harmonic Crystals.
Have you prepared a fellowship friend?
You must wait %tqt to turn this item in again.
Thank you, a memento from the memory of Knorr?
Thank you for preventing Aerbax from changing the memory at Knorr. Take this as a small reward.
And take the Spherule back as a souvenir of your visit to the past... wait a moment, there's something jammed in it.
The Emissary removes a small sliver of metal from the Spherule. It glows faintly white.
Hmmm, perhaps you should keep this too, it may come in handy later.
While you humans defended the memories of this world from Aerbax. Lord Asheron discovered a way to search Aerbax's memories. He used the same link Aerbax had formed to invade his mind.
My master also wished for me to grant you this title.
For valor and bravery in the face of the unknown I award %tn the title "Protector of the Past."
Aerbax has built a floating structure over the Obsidian Plains. Large amounts of energy are being focused there. Lord Ashron left you further instructions in his Sanctum.
Let's see if you have had any success with the Quiddity Seeds I told you of.
The first Quiddity Seed lies in the Planar Collegium in the Lyceum at Knorr.
The second alludes me. Speak with the Aun Tumeroks at Fort Tethana.
The third is known to an apparition in the Northern Desert.
What is this that you give me, Isparian?
It is like the head of the old Olthoi Queen, but insubstantial. Tell me how you came about this?
You detail your pursuit of Elysa's remembrances.

It would seem that Aerbax's minion have been manipulating the memory of the defeat of the Olthoi Queen. Perhaps Aerbax thought that it would prove easier to turn the Isparians if they were still held in bondage to the Olthoi.
There is a strange core to the Olthoi head...I have extracted it for your use.

Elysa is safe. You have restored the past to what should be, and I believe Aerbax will not be able to gain a foothold against you through that means. Elysa is safe, but more importantly, all of your kind is safe by your actions.
For valor and bravery in the face of the unknown I award %tn the title "Warrior of the Past."
Welcome, I'm glad you've come.
From observations Lord Asheron has made and from reports he received from your Queen he surmised that Aerbax is attempting something quite unheard of.

It would seem our enemy has been tampering with the collective memories of three critical events in the past. He has built three dream structures using Quiddity Seeds to allow him to attack these memories and change our perspective in the present.
The first Quiddity Seed is in Knorr where Lord Asheron first summoned the portals that sent his people into portal space.

The second Quiddity Seed's location was unknown to my master. He believes that the Aun Tumeroks may have more experience in locating these dream structures. Visit Fort Tethana where an emissary of the Tumeroks has been sent to meet you.

The third and final Quiddity Seed was not found by Lord Asheron's divinations. He only has a vague idea of what memory is at risk. Seek out an apparition in the Northern Desert who I have been told will help you.
Do not take these tasks lightly. Memories form the way we see the world around us. Change our memories and change reality. This is a very real threat.
If Aerbax succeeds you may not even remember you were trying to stop him.
Very well
I'm afraid you cannot help me with my task yet. Keep improving your skills and I will revaluate you for this mission.
Thank you again for your assistance. If these Apostates cause further difficulties, I will have work for you once again.
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.
Any luck in retrieving the data at 60.0S, 98.4E?
Greetings to you.

I have been tasked with gathering adventurers to protect Lord Asheron's Portalspace devices from the depredations of an offshoot of the Virindi called the 'Apostates'. The devices are set to both stabilize local portalspace fields and to analyze the disturbances that caused... problems... recently.
If you would be willing to go to 60.0S, 98.4E, dispose of 30 of these Apostate Virindi, and bring me back the data the device has collected, my Master would be grateful.
I can feel the data crystal's touch upon you. May I have it?
Any luck in retrieving the data at 84.8N, 17.6E?
If you would be willing to go to 84.8N, 17.6E, dispose of 30 of these Apostate Virindi, and bring me back the data the device has collected, my Master would be grateful.
Any luck in retrieving the data at 65.9S, 85.1W?
If you would be willing to go to 65.9S, 85.1W, dispose of 30 of these Apostate Virindi, and bring me back the data the device has collected, my Master would be grateful.
Come back later and I will have another mission for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Hello again! Have you located the source of the disturbances that are blocking my Lord Asheron from rescuing the pocket of Empyreans he has located?
We managed to detect several temporal and portalspace disturbances within the Iron Blade's area of influence, and believe that masked portals may be hidden within their tunnels.

We also managed to locate a new portal in the deep cave the Simulacra have delved near to the Iron Blade fortifications, and believe that may be a good place to seek out what is needed to find the masked portals within the Iron Blade tunnels.
Greetings!
I have been sent here to ask adventurers, such as yourself, to aid in a rather delicate situation my Lord Asheron has found himself in.
He has learned that the disruptions endangering a small pocket of located Empyreans are tied to a set of growing Temporal anomalies, as well as direct interference by these 'Apostate' Virindi.

To that end, he has located a confluence of overlapping temporal and portalspace disturbances in the Iron Blade fortifications to the north of here, as well as a defended portal in the caves of the Apostate Simulacra.

There are several...points, of greater disturbance within the Iron Blade's tunnels. We originally thought them to be due to the high levels of Aetherium, combined with the methods the Iron Blade Primus is using to control the portal pathway to his or her homeworld, but there are temporal anomalies mixed into the disturbances that lead my Lord to believe that they are related to the Portalspace...

I have been given the means to allow you passage through the defended portal, but from there, it will be up to you to locate and end the disturbances, so my Lord Asheron may stabilize the area around the located Empyreans, and extract them from their present circumstances.
My apologies, I do ramble on sometimes.
The short form. There's a portal in the simulacra cave we believe to be key to ending the disturbance. I can protect you from the barriers and wards upon it.
In there, hopefully, you'll find the source of the problem, or something that will lead you through the points of greatest disturbance in the Iron Blade Tunnels.
Find the force or entity responsible, end it. Return to me with proof, and I'll reward you.
Any questions?
This is amazing! I have never seen so much power packed into a small shard of Virindi mask like this before!
The energy signature on this also matches the brunt force of the disturbances that have striven against my Lord Asheron!
I believe, I owe you both great thanks, and reward for the aid you have given me in my task. Ah, I have an idea!
The Emissary absorbs the shard, glowing brighter for a moment, and then pulls from his center a smaller mask, identical to the one the Grand Director wore.
This being was indeed at the heart of the Portalspace disturbances, but strangely not the temporal ones...
I will relay your success and these findings to my Lord Asheron. Hopefully, the temporal disturbances alone are not enough to further delay his rescue efforts.
You must be at least level 150 to help me.
Please return to me at a later time, I may need your assistance again.
Hello again! Have you located the source of the disturbance that is blocking my Lord Asheron's ritual from rescuing the pocket of Empyreans he has located?
The main source of the disruption seems to be coming from an area under the Freebooter Isle Volcano, likely inside one of the steam vents that riddle the area.
Be warned, though, the portalspace disruptions in the area are massive, and my lord Asheron also believes there is a large scale temporal disturbance being shielded by the portalspace disruptions.
Take friends, be careful.
We have found another pocket of temporal and portalspace disturbances similar to the ones located in the Iron Blade foothold in the Direlands.
This newer disturbance is located along a mana flow underneath the volcano on the north end of the place locally referred to as 'Freebooter Isle'.
Be warned, however, that this disturbance seems more powerful than the ones in the Direlands, and as it sits on a known Ley Line, the potential threat is far greater.
Gather strong friends, bring them all to me, so I may offer them what protections I can, and then begin your hunt.
Now, as to those mentioned protections...
The Emissary of Asheron utters a single, harsh sounding word, and a tingle washes over you.
Find the force or entity responsible, end it. Return to me with proof, or better; a way to save my lord's people, and I'll reward you for it.
Now, let's see if we can put this shard to good use.
Shirov Tangoli Sith
The Emissary of Asheron ponders the weakened Empyreans for a moment.
All of you, you are back on Ireth Lassel. You are home. However, until my lord Asheron has a chance to ensure your health, I ask that you allow me to transport you to a safer area.
Shirov Thiloi
May your new weapon suit you well.
The shadows are surrounding Tou-Tou and beginning an assault?
Isin Dule is correct. We must form a plan for action and end the madness that has gone on for far too long.
You have been awarded the title of Bright Knight.
You already delivered the note and crystal sample.
Bael'zharon will not stop trying to destroy these lands.
We will have to remain vigilant and strong.
As long as we have powerful forces on our side, Dereth shall remain safe.
The Emissary of Asheron reads the note and then examines the crystal briefly.
This is troubling news indeed.
I will get to work on studying this crystal right away. Thank you for bringing me this.
You have been awarded the title of Illuminating the Shadows.
The Emissary of Asheron appears busy. Perhaps you should come back when you have a sample of the crystal.
Where to begin... Oh, yes, It was long ago in a land far from here...
The Emissary drones on and on and while you do learn quite a bit you realize there must be a better way to acquire experience.

greetings: What's this? A letter? Oh, from Elysa! Such a dear girl. I'll read this later. Thank you.
quest: Do you enjoy the view from here as much as I do?

Well, hello! My name is Alatar Locke. I am a cartographer for the Explorer Society. I was beginning to think no Isparians would ever make it to this place! I ended up here after spending quite a bit of time in the Floating City. I must say I do enjoy it here. From a good height, one can study the lay of the land and for one of my avocation that is quite a happy thing! In my spare time I have be...
If you would like to have the map framed, I understand there is a Furniture Master in Zaikhal that may frame it for you. His name is Jordan Ibn'Ikia and he does quality work for little money.

greetings: You were able to do it! Let me see what kind of image you captured of the Arcane Pedestal.
Slithe Tradittor examines the images within the crystal intently...
Ah, yes I can see what its components may be.  They are similar to...
Slithe Tradittor turns the crystal every which way, peering within it...

Thus far I can only say for certain that a Gelidite Dais is required for me to build this device.  Once I have all the components, I should be able to build a scaled down version of the Arcane Pedestal. Go get one now and bring it to me. One may be found in the Gelidite Library.

I still cannot discern the purpose of the Arcane Pedestal, but with a functioning version I may understand it. It must be a thing of great power! Go quickly. Tell no one of the Arcanum about this. This is no affair of theirs.
quest: I made you an Arcane Pedestal recently.  Go away!
I remember making an Arcane Pedestal for you not too long ago. Take this back, and begone!
You have already given me the Dais I need, I do not need another! Why aren't you out collecting those statue parts in the list I gave you?
I made one of those for you recently. I will keep this for my own use. Away with you!
You have the Gear.
Slithe Tradittor quickly constructs an Arcane Pedestal!
This device appears to do nothing. I suppose you want your version. Here it is. Do not speak of this to others. Be gone.
Slithe Tradittor mutters to himself about now being to make many more for his master.
You have found the Coil.
You have obtained the Spring.

Traveler. I have a tale to tell and a task I would put upon you. Were you to take this task on yourself, you will bear witness to things I have seen and a wondrous device I glimpsed but could not fathom or grasp.
For you see, there is an artifact in a place unlike any that exists in Dereth.

I am an explorer for the Explorer Society. In a desert region, I came upon a suspended walkway hung out from the edge of a cliff.  The other end of the walkway was attached not to solid ground but was lost in the spinning light of a portal.  I held my breath and stepped upon the walkway, half expecting it to collapse and throw me to the ground so far below. Yet, the walkway held my weight!  I c...
I must study this device. I call it the "Arcane Pedestal." I even believe I have the means to create a version of it, but first I require an imprint of its morphology.

I shall give you a copy of my notes and an Imaging Crystal. The notes show you the way to that place. The Imaging Crystal can be imprinted with the composition and design of this device.  Return to me with the imprint embedded within the Crystal and I will study it and determine how to create it.
The Arcane Pedestal!  We shall have the Arcane Pedestal!
Yes, this is the first component. I have been studying the imaging crystal and now know what the other components are.
They are the same parts which are within the living bronze statues. Here is a list of the components. Bring them to me and I will construct this device. Remember, tell no one of this.
I do not need this item right now.
I do not need this right now.
The Spring is still required.
Where is the Coil?
I still need the Gear item.
I do not need this now.
You are not powerful enough to help me. Come back when you have reached Level Thirty. Then you may at least attempt the task, though maybe not alone.

greetings: Things have begun to quiet down thankfully. But there are stirrings from the deeper areas of the Retreat. Hibdin knows more about it than I do. I'm content simply watching for now. I'm just glad that I am free of Gaerlan's mind control.
If you have a moment to spare, please come talk to me.

Well, it looks like you've done pretty well down there. I've got a reward for your efforts--it's only fair that we give you something. You have, after all, returned the productivity to the farm for the time being.
quest: While I appreciate your enthusiasm, we've been experiencing less trouble. Try back in a few weeks--maybe things will have changed by then.
Of course, if you've brought me proof of your efforts in the deep, hand it to me so I may reward you.
Hello friend. We've fallen on some hard times here in Martine's Retreat. With Martine being gone for so long, we can only surmise that he is indeed dead. But that is the least of our problems.
About two weeks ago Remmick, our head farmer, came up from the subterranean farm and said that it was madness down there. It seems that a farm hand named Harker had become... touched.
If you wouldn't mind helping us out with getting some of the food and maybe killing Harker, we'd be in your debt. I'd pay you handsomely.
Before you go, you might want to speak to Remmick. He might have some pointers for you.
If you show these to Leandra she might be able to explain the special properties of these gauntlets.
While these aren't as potent as the other gauntlets, they have the distinction of three cantrips.
This should not be possible.

greetings: Psst!
Hey over here!
Yeah you, I'm talking to you!
Psst! Buddy!
C'mere friend I need to talk to you.
Over here.
Watcha lookin' around for? That was me that called you.
Hey you! Get over here a minute I need to talk to you.
Not bad. Not bad at all. You got connections kid. This will get me in real good.
%n snickers and looks you over.
I guess that means that I've got some singing to do. No problem. Grab a chair maybe.
%n pauses a long moment.

Gaerlan, yeah that was the guys name. Where he came from nobody knows but Martine came right close to turning him into slag after he got back from opening the portals to Marae Lassel. The only thing that allowed the guy to stay was that he groveled better than anyone I had ever seen grovel. Even better than Ketnan.

Anyway, this guy said that he had the ability to help Martine, so long as he kept him alive. Martine was wary at first. When I say wary I mean really wary. You see Martine was really trying to get himself back on the straight and narrow. Kind of like what he did for us and all. But he listened to the guy anyway. It went well. I guess. Martine allowed him to stay. Heck he even gave him his own r...
Where is it? Keep the goodies coming.
Hmm, nice trinket.
Okay so this Gaerlan guy, he starts "assisting" Martine with some of his endeavours, going with him out to blow up the arrival points around Dereth. See it went like this.

Martine told this guy about the fact that he had it in for Asheron. Mistake one, this guy was into that and used that to his advantage. See, this guy never looked at us as anything more than vermin. Really it's true. Once or twice I overheard him talking about how we had bred as quickly as the vermin that had come from our world.

I guess they brought them back after they visited us. Now this was something that was a little odd to hear, but I guess that a long time ago they used to go to different worlds and watch. Then the portals started opening to other places...I never pieced that together. But I know that this guy Gaerlan put the poison thoughts into Martine's head.

Martine had been getting better. He was less whimsical from time to time. More stable really. Then the poison started and the high-pitched voice came back. Then he set out to destroy the arrival points from Ispar.
Martine had no idea what was happening with that, but I know that this guy did. He even wrote about it I'd guess.
In his little diary. He carried it with him a lot. Sorry pal, no more until there is more payment.
Pulling out all the stops now aren't you.

Okay then. Martine went to those places where the portals dropped people from Dereth and together with Gaerlan they sealed them closed. No more people that went through the portals that lead there could get through.

Kind of makes you wonder, huh? At any rate the deed was done. Martine was happy, no content, you can never really say that he has been happy. I mean the guy did lose his wife and child and then his humanity. That has to be rough right?

So this Gaerlan guy starts riling him up and getting him to listen to his hatred, or the Virindi in him, whatever that is. Then Martine builds a son. I wouldn't say it if it wasn't true. He thought about it and it happened. Of course Gaerlan was there the entire time, assisting him in the creation of this thing. A Hollow Minion. I tell you, he called it son and embraced it. And sent it out onto...

He did that three times in all. Each time, they got a little tougher. But still Martine wasn't done. He set about a plan to kill the Queen. But then that was twisted. Gaerlan made sure of that. "The boy he said. The boy. You have a son now, Martine. You won't need two." Martine listened and lo, he set about to kill Borelean.
%n shakes his head.
That was just not like Martine. Just not like him. I'm sorry I can't talk about this anymore.
These won't help me much, but...

That should help you a little. See, I want these for a specific reason. They'd remind Martine of what the Virindi did to him. We don't want that happening to him ever again. By we I mean the majority of us here. All of us had problems. Some greater than others, but we did all have problems and Martine gave us something that none of us had, Hope.
In a sense he was our savior. He took us out of the darkest times that any of us had ever faced, brought us back from that brink and got us motivated to live again.

Not easy to do with a bunch of ne'er do wells. But he did it. We started working with him to build places that we could call our own. Do things that we could have pride in. We struggled it's true but in the end we were feeling better and things were looking up. Until Gaerlan came back. And then the voice returned.
%n lowers his eyes.
It was like watching your best friend disappear. He had beaten that thing back. It was gone, forever. But now it was back.
Nothing more I can say about that.
Nice one.

Settle in. So Martine set his sights on the kid. Vile. Out of character. Why did we stay you wonder? We're loyal to Martine. Loyal cause he saved us from something worse than any death could be. He saved us from despair.

What else could we do? We stayed with him. But this guy Gaerlan preyed on him more. He helped him with the Olthoi. He demonstrated some intense understanding about their bodies. Strong points, weak points. The best place to strike them to incapacitate but not kill them. Things that no one of us would have known. Where he got that knowledge I don't know.

He helped Martine where the Virindi failed. He made a hollow version of the Olthoi. Weaker. But damn they hit hard and there was no way to defend against them. Funny thing is Gaerlan would never go near them.
But he convinced Martine to invade the mainland of Dereth. That Elysa and Asheron were joined now, making war on his son. Trying to bring about Martine's destruction now.

And also about this time, Gaerlan started to gain more freedom, and he used it. We'd inform Martine but he didn't care. He was busy off on his own. Not until recently did we start to realize that he was visiting Elysa.
There's more, but we made a deal.
Hmm more trinkets. Good job.

Martine started getting a little more lucid around this time. Not a lot mind you, but with Gaerlan taking some time away from constant contact with Martine he started to act more normal. Though something had really changed within him and every night he would leave here to go visit Elysa.
He watched her from afar at first, then got closer and closer until recently he came back here and became very solemn. No silent.
He hasn't spoken in the longest time. Not since Gaerlan shunted him like a child. Not since he killed Asheron.
%n lowers his eyes and shakes his head.

Now, things are breaking down. We need him you see. Some of us still think that we can pull him around. Others think that we'd be best to foster his hate and tell him to finish the job. Still others...like me think he did the job. There is no hope left. Asheron is dead. And Martine has finally realized the truth.
%n looks you dead in the eye and speaks solemnly.
Asheron never meant harm to anyone. This world, the Olthoi, the pain. It was never him. It was never him...and now Martine has killed the brightest light that this world had.
I knew if I whispered long enough one of you outsiders would make your way over to me. The names Josef, and before you ask no there's no surname. Just Josef. Don't ask cause I ain't tellin'.
Now listen up, and listen up well cause i don't like taking to much time in repeating myself. It makes me waste precious air and that's not fun.
%n clears his throat and then drops his voice into a deep whisper.

A while back the boss, Martine, was planning on opening the way to Marae Lassel. A new home for people. Thing is there were people there already, like us but they grew up different. No big deal right? Well the thing is when he did his spell or whatever something else happened.

He finished his little trick and suddenly a portal storm hit the center of the living area here. Portal energy was whipping off the walls and down the corridors. Next thing we know there's a guy sitting in the middle of the room, naked as the day he was born and about eight, maybe nine feet tall.
He was real confused. Had no clue where he had come from or where he was, just his name. Gaerlan. And he said over and over again...is Asheron among you.
Now here's the rub. I know a lot more than that, but I need some help. So you help me...I help you. Take this.
Get me the things on that list and I'll talk. It's simple really.
quest: You should have already gotten your reward. Take this back and use it for yourself. You've already helped me out quite enough.
This is the best possible thing you could give me friend.
Martine likes these the most because it means that you not only killed one of their most powerful members, but you have also found a way to steal some of their treasures.
%n manages a weak smile.
Take this.

See I've made a life of finding information. I listened to everything and learned as much as I could. In his room Gaerlan kept a chest. In that chest must be something special. It was bright, like the rainbow and vibrant. Get what you can, he left it. Oh and getting there just takes a little leap of faith.
Good luck, friend.

greetings: Since Martine... left the simulacra that used to assist me in the armory have begun acting strange.
It's starting to become a chore to keep them in line. But so far so good. Hibdin is a good man, but the things down there don't listen to him the same.
It was you people that brought Martine to his end. You and your meddling. Why couldn't you have left him alone?
He was finally becoming happy, but then you had to come down here and cause your ruckus and look where we are now.
Everything is falling apart and your hands are tainted. Your hands are covered in his blood.
You make me sick.
I remember these. Martine was working on these before he left. He said that they would be some of the best gauntlets that this world would ever see. Now what was it that he said about them...
Ah yes! He said that with the right insignia, we'd be able to infuse the gauntlets with a fairly potent cantrip.

Also, in an effort to make a name for themselves, the Apprentice Mask Crafters in Sawato, Al Jalima, and Eastham have devised ways to bring out some of the facetted colors of Sunstone. Unfortunately, they still aren't up to the level of mastery they need in order to go into business on thier own.

While I am far too busy providing my services here in our small retreat, I am confident that Pagrok in Candeth Keep can restore your gauntlets to their original luster should they be damaged by the hands of the apprentices.
These are made with the same process as the more potent gauntlets, but they lacked the setting for the amulet. This doesn't make them useless, but makes them less desirable.
One moment please.  The success of choritize distillation relies on steady hands and a clear mind.
All done, here is one flask of chorizite formula, as promised, and a copy of my notes.
Be sure to read the notes I gave you - and remember, the formula is new and largely untested.  More research will be needed to fully understand its properties.
Ah, a visitor!  It is so nice to see a new face around here, especially now that my spirits have been lifted.  I must tell you of my newest findings.
I have been working on a distillation process that transforms chorizite ore into a viscous formula capable of absorbing magical damage.
If you have the inclination, bring me a small amount of the highest quality refined chorizite available, and I will reward you with one application of the formula, and my notes.

quest: Good! I'm not glad we had to kill him but I am glad that there are still people willing to help us out. Harker was a good man, it's sad to see him slip into such a state. Thank you for your help and for allowing us to gather the food.

Everything is falling apart. I can't get crops anymore, and without those crops then everyone here will starve, or be forced to move back to the surface. But most don't want that. They'd rather live out their lives here.
If only we could get rid of Harker! The farm has never been truly safe. Rats, wasps, even Olthoi have been known to peek their heads in from time to time.
The worst were the grubs, though. Hundreds of them at times. They're small enough to smash outright, sure... but they're more a threat to the harvest.
If you're going down there, be prepared... One more thing: Harker has a bundle of hooligans who traffic with him now. You watch your back down there, you hear?
Go talk to Hibdin, he's the one organizing the expeditions down there.

greetings: High Queen Elysa, brought me back from my post on Marae Lassel to assist Asheron's Emmissary in study the changes in this area. Thus far, we have discovered little.

Aside from a rising temperature there are no oddities here that are noteworthy. We've been busy night and day studying the devastation that was levied here. This crater is nearly as large as the one left when Arwic was destroyed, but...the force that destroyed Yanshi seems untainted. Whatever Asheron senses here must be powerful though.

Having studied the crater and measuring the distance of some of the debris I have discovered that this explosion originated within the ground. It is as though a great force welled up from somewhere below the city and burned its way to surface before exploding out with a force comparable, if not greater than, the one that destroyed Arwic.
We've noticed some off fluctuations in the mana fields here. They ebb like the ocean tide, from strong to weak and back again. Something is here, I believe it now.
We think we found something, but if the indications are true, we could be looking at a most devastating force. Intelligent mana, sentient in every way.

We never seem to learn from the past, we never follow directions or show respect to the things we don't understand. Look at us now, on the verge of destruction. Not from Gaerlan, well maybe inadvertently, but you see...he is the same as us. He didn't think his actions through. Now we find this.
Antius looks over the broken city and shakes his head.
I don't know. I think if we succeed at driving Gaerlan away, and destroying whatever this thing is we should change our focus to learning instead of simply doing.
This seems to indicate that the Viamontians may well be on Dereth, but we cannot be sure. I need more than this. Keep searching.
This settles the matter. The Viamontians are here. And from what I can tell, they are the occupants of that mysterious landmass to the north.
I wonder, how long have they been here? What plans do they have for the rest of us? And when will they make themselves known?
I thank you for your assistance in this matter. You have done a great service to your Queen.
What creature is capable of doing this to an Olthoi? I have seen my fair share of Olthoi corpses, but this...
Do you see these ridges here? Along the neck? It appears that this head was bitten off.
What manner of creature is this from? I've never seen a tooth of this size. You say the Viamontian gave you this? What foul creatures did the blue-skins bring with them, I wonder?
A Viamontian dagger! I have not seen one of these in years!
We are in for a great deal of trouble, my friend. You would do well to prepare yourself for the worst.
Friend! A word!

As I am sure you are aware, a Viamontian recently appeared in Rithwic. His name is Carlo di Cenza. If my memory serves me correctly, he serves the house of Bellenesse, which was quite loyal - and quite close - to the King of Viamont.
As far as we can tell, Carlo di Cenza is the only Viamontian on Dereth. But we cannot be sure of that. The man has yet to speak an intelligible word so far as we've seen.
We must find out if others arrived with him. If there are Viamontians on Dereth, and if they are hiding from the Queen, then we may have a great deal of trouble ahead of us.
Do what you can. Scour the continent. If you uncover any worthwhile intelligence, return it to me.
Oi, mush! Want ter do me a favor? It's tough ter get a decent drink around here, especially wiv the prices Gorth charges.
Fetch me a bottle of Olde Ispar Stout from Neydisa Castle, down the road to the west, and I'll put in a good word fer yer with MacDugal!
quest: I am here against my better judgment. I had hoped that we would find an answer to the growing Burun problem, but as of yet, the Arcanum's scholars are not able to unlock the magic necessary to imbue weapons with slaying properties. Thus I am here at the request of High Queen Elysa with a proposition.

Nuhmudira was removed from the council some months ago for conduct that was not befitting of her position. No public charges were levied, but she understood that there was an unspoken accusation. I am here to see that she is given a message. That message is one that I must support

Elysa is willing to grant her clemency in return for her aid. We need you to seek her out and obtain the devices necessary for finishing the Noble Weapons. They require the addition of a complex gem. Once that gem is set in place they should become Burun slaying weapons. Nuhmudira was last known to be residing in a remote cottage outside of Uziz near an oasis on the rim of the A'mun desert.

Nuhmudira was removed from the council some months ago for conduct that was not befitting of her position. No public charges were levied, but she understood that there was an unspoken accusation. I am here to see that she is given a message. That message is one that I must support.
Antius' demeanor changes slightly.

Please, if she gives you the opportunity once you have obtained what you will need, ask her a simple question. Ask her if she let Oswald into the castle the night that Elysa was attacked. The sky is split by the sound of thunder. Gaerlan's Citadel rocks under the force of a great assault. As the fury subsides, two voices are carried across the world.
Gaerlan says, "Insolence. How dare you enter my citadel?"
Martine says, "I am here to exact my vengeance, and make amends for what I have done."
The sounds of powerful magic tear through valleys, and threaten to shake buildings to their foundations. As the sounds subside the voices return.

Gaerlan says, "There is no magic you can call upon that I cannot match. There is nothing in this world that you know, that I have not already stolen from your mind. You were a clever tool, nothing more. We are your greater in every way. Why rise against what you cannot hope to stand against."
Martine says, "I am not going to let you eradicate our people. We have fought too long and struggled to survive here."
A thunderous clash of magical energies is unleashed across the skyline above Gaerlan's Citadel and the voices fall silent.
Voices sunder the air as Gaerlan and Martine continue the struggle on the citadel.
Gaerlan says, "You grow weaker. You have yet to breach the citadel proper, yet still you think you will survive. Can you not see the power that I now possess?"
Martine says, "Power is relative, Gaerlan. Yours will wane, and I will not fail. I owe too much to these people to fail."
The mountains in northern Osteth shake under a great force. Around Gaerlan's Citadel a halo of frost erupts and disspates.
Martine says, "So you are weakening..."
Gaerlan says, "Come for me childling, vermin...human."
At Gaerlan's citadel a violent explosion brightens the sky for a moment. Flames erupt from the western side of the citadel as Martine tears through more of Gaerlan's forces.
Martine says, "Nothing can hinder me now Gaerlan. I have routed two of your commanders thus far, and then I shall destroy you."

Gaerlan says, "I have watched you Martine. You have sloughed your true form away, returning to what you once were. Why? Tell me Martine...have you seen the portal that I have created for you? I have given you the way home."
Martine says, "No! Asheron told me that it cannot be done, the research was destroyed."

WorldBroadcast Gaerlan says, "Destroyed? He never found his way there again, and then there were his greater failures to attend to. But even he forgot the other, the one who went native and lived there. Not all minds are so strong."
A maniacal laughter fills the air. Martine's voice cracks and a scream of rage explodes into a sound of metal scraping on metal.
WorldBroadcast Gaerlan says, "The Old Man is a fool, and will be as dead as you shall be, should you continue this foolish crusade."
Acid rains from the citadel as Martine reaches the base of the tower.
Gaerlan says, "At last. Well then vermin, let us see what you have brought me."
Martine says, "I have brought you the end, Gaerlan. I have brought you death."

Gaerlan laughs. "You have once again forsaken your human form. A pity. I should have liked crushing you as I will the lifestones that defend your precious race. You have come to exact your vengeance...come then rodent, let me weigh you and give you the death you crave."
The battle rises through the tower, as the combatants unleash arcane power that threatens to sunder the world. The world trembles. The wizards ascend to the pinnacle of the citadel's tower.
Gaerlan says, "And so I have proven the victor. You have lost...Isparian."
Martine says, "I have yet to lose Gaerlan."

At the crest of the tower a vibrant purple glow begins. An electric hum floods the world. At the citadel a windstorm rushes toward the apex of the tower as Martine prepares to unleash his greatest spell.
Gaerlan shouts above the hum and the rush of wind, "You are no more!"
A twist of elemental energy is released from Gaerlan's hands as he leaps from the top of his tower, the elemental energy surrounds Martine.
As Martine unleashes the magic within him the sky flashes purple. The elemental prison about him holds the blast within for a long moment, and the world falls silent.
Gaerlan says, "Insignificant. Martine is no more, run to your hovels, run to Asheron! Though not even he can protect you!"

The clouds above the citadel clear. The portal that once beckoned at the zenith of the tower is no more. The citadel begins to shake, and grows unstable. It falls toward the earth slowly at first, and then accelerates.
Gaerlan howls with rage as he realizes what has transpired and what is happening.
Asheron bellows, "Yes Gaerlan. I am very much alive, you have no Throne to protect you now. The time for reckoning is at hand."
