Welcome! Here you see the beginnings -- the fragile embryo -- of the future art community of Dereth.

We are here, my two fine friends and I, to prepare for peace! After all the recent hubaloo, we believe that Dereth is in for a long and glorious Golden Age of Art, in which all Derethians everywhere will forsake their violent ways and instead take up the gentlest and most noble of sciences: alchemy, cooking, and fletching.
We are at the forefront of this artistic revolution, leading the way, dismantling the roadblocks, smoothing the path for the mass of humanity behind us! We live to serve!

We're gathering converts every day, every minute! If you would like to join us, you can start by trying your hand at crafting. Just take an old, disused item that is of no worth to anyone -- for instance, gromnie teeth! -- and fashion it into a beautiful and useful object of art.
Then bring it to one of us, and we will reward your efforts.
quest: This is very good. I am impressed with your efforts. But you must understand that Arwic was not built in a day. You should take more time to consider your art, to place it within the proper historic and economic perspective. Only then will you truly understand art, and be able to fuse form and function for the sake of the people.
Good job! This paste will serve the people in excellent fashion!
Did you make a drudge sneeze in this before bringing it to me? A good paste wouldn't be nearly as chunky.  I'll accept it, but I won't like it!
What an amazing ... er ... paste! You have combined form and function most admirably!
Excellent job! Your desire to serve in the forefront of the revolution is pushing you on to greater glory!
Wonderful! Rarely have I seen such dedication to pursuing a life of artistic leadership!
Amazing! Simply amazing! You have crafted an almost useable toothpaste.
Wow! It's obvious you have spent a lot of time perfecting the noble art of Toothpaste crafting.
The texture and consistency of this paste is unbelievable. You have learned much about this art!
Perfect! Well, nearly perfect. There is always room to learn.

greetings: Food. Food is the basis of life. We are all food. You, you I see as a bountiful dessert, layered with chocolate and cinnamon, encrusted with rare fruits and sweetmeats in arcane patterns. You are a work of art! But cloyingly sweet ...
Our purpose here? We are here to ennoble the Derethian soul! To encourage it to rise to its full potential, like a fine, full loaf of the best bread in the oven of the gods!
Tiffany is our fearless leader, the great organizer. She can tell you of our efforts here.
quest: You are moving too quickly. Take your time, consider your technique. A brush like this should fill your entire being for at least a week.
I would be lying if I told you this was a good attempt. Never the less, keep on trying. I am sure you will improve.

This is passable work. You still have far to go before you are a master, but I am encouraged by your ... determination.
Not bad, not bad. Soon you will wield the carving knife with all the elegance of a true cook!
Hmm .. you are learning. I particularly like this detailing here -- like grapes, slowly burnishing their tender skin in the sun, ready to be picked! ... and eaten.
This brush .. this brush is a work of art! Keep refining your technique, and soon I may allow you to touch ... the food itself!
Amazing! Simply amazing! You have crafted an almost useable toothbrush.
Wow! It's obvious you have spent a lot of time perfecting the noble art of Toothbrush crafting.
The bristles of this brush are beautiful. You have learned much about this art!
Perfect! Well, nearly perfect. There is always room to learn.

greetings: Through your efforts we have succeeded in defeating Gaerlan and holding the Harbinger at bay. But our fight is not yet done. We have earned this respite, and I truly hope that this time of peace continues to grow.

In the coming months I intend to see universities built so that future generations of our children born on this world can learn of the dangers that we faced and the sacrifices that were made to make this land ours.
Together with the Arcanum, headed now by Ciandra, we shall establish the first such university in the newly rebuilt town of Arwic.

There scholars will come not from just the races of Ispar but also from the Tumerok and Lugian settlements. We are a diverse people that over time may set aside our differences and come to exist peacefully.
The process will be slow and will not be without its difficulties but I believe that we can overcome anything that we shall face in the future.

Please join me now in honoring all of those that have been lost to us in the years that we have come to Dereth. Their company may have been taken from us, but their spirits and their acts shall live forever within our memories.

I wish to acknowledge the efforts of Sir Candeth Martine who through valor and a courage, that proved to be unshakable, knowingly sacrificed himself so that we could stand against Gaerlan.  Without his efforts the world we know here would still be covered in a blanket of elemental beings.

Nuhmudira, as she imprisoned Gaerlan, stated this best. This land is ours now. We have fought against great enemies and emerged victorious. We have met the challenges of Dereth and stood proud at each test.
My thanks, to the true heroes of Dereth!
Thorsten! No...no...
You! Die, now!

A female whisper on the wind says, "...and that was the end of my story, hunter...while the swarm still exists, it never again held this land in thrall. And so, one queen gave way to another. Remember me...as an enemy, but as a worthy enemy..."
Thorsten? Where are you? I cannot see what has happened in here...
Must not catch me...must stay ahead of them...
No! Not back to the caverns! I'll die first!
Thank Pwyll! Give me a weapon and I'll help!
A female whisper on the wind says, "Seek resolve in the place where the words of the past were found."
Lemongrass is fine, Thorsten. Thank you.
Thorsten, come here and look at this paper.

Oh...well, I'll teach you. But later. This writing is like nothing that I've ever seen before. It's not Roulean, not any of the scripts of far off lands - not even similar. I've figured out a way to translate it, though.
This word seems like it would sound like...'Empyrean'...it's another culture, maybe a culture we can contact for help with the Olthoi!

No, Thorsten...we will free our people...we must. There's directions to another one of those portals that leads to an island. If I read this right, there's a man named...'Asheron', I think. He's supposed to be the master of a school of powerful magic...surely his magic can help against the Olthoi!
Perhaps he doesn't know how prolific they are, perhaps he doesn't even know we're here...either way, I intend to go there, with or without you.
Yes. I cannot be content to live here under the earth when our people still live in thrall.
A female whisper on the wind says, "Seek courage in the home of light."
Where is the key...
Nonsense...I will not believe that this place is uninhabited.
Whoever's in there - open up! I won't go away! You must listen to us, of the plight of our people! We were summoned here by strange portals, an unknown magic we have never seen be-
It is alright, Thorsten...there was nothing you could've done. Thorsten, I have done it! I have met the sorcerer in his tower! It is a wondrous place. He is a man of few words though.
Just one thing - "You must find the Queen and slay her."
I think with this...
I think it's a sort of poison, maybe. I think we should try it on our weapons when we fight the Olthoi.
A female whisper on the wind says, "Seek determination in the tomb of past warriors."
Pay heed me words, brave warriors of Aluvia! Today is the day we have dreamt of! We have our destiny in our hands!
We have found the Queen of the Olthoi, the heart of the darkness we have fought for so long! We can reach her, and if we can reach her, we can slay her!
Do you remember your families, your friends, all held in slavery for so long? Today is the day we march forward to free them!

There is no fury in the world like the Aluvians marching to war. Let us show the Olthoi the steel of Aluvian hearts! Let their death scream echo in their caverns, until finally we have met the Olthoi Queen in her dark majesty and ended her reign!
Let the horns of our ancestors sound triumphant! We march to war!
A female whisper on the wind says, "And now, in the end...you must seek the end to my story, and the beginning to the story of humanity upon Dereth."
Elysa appears behind you.
No that is not my bow, and it was not I who was killed.
But if you do not tell me who was behind this, you may be the one who ends up dead.
He can run, but no place in Dereth will shelter him now.
quest: My son, Borelean, can be found in Arwic. Please go to him and report what happened here.

Apologizes for the misdirection and deception involved in this mission, but even you could not be allowed to know the plot at hand. We could not take any chances.
I must lead the hunt on tracking down this fugitive, please be so kind as to return to my son and let him know everything has gone as planned.

If I could impose on you to deliver this Iolite gem to my colleague Aun Paritea he can tell you where to obtain the Chrysoberyl compound and the Daichroic crystals. To find Aun Paritea, go through the Tia-Leh Homestead portal which is in the Hebian-to settlement portals array.  Aun Paritea is just south of the Tia-Leh Homestead.  When you obtain them, please bring the Daichroic crystals to me a...

Thank you for your assistance in obtaining this Daichroic Crystal for Nuhmudira. Here is your reward. Nuhmudira may require more of these materials in about four days if you wish to undertake this task again.

I see you've learned a thing or two about fishing. You're becoming quite good at this. Not every fisherman catches 100 fish. It takes determination and skill it does. Here, have your reward.
My oh my! I'm truly impressed. You caught yourself 300 Large Fish. You're really becoming a pro at this. Here's your reward my friend.

You need three things to be a good fisherman.

First, you need a fishing pole. I can make one for you, but I'll need a Golem Jo or a Wood Golem Heart to assemble it. I remember my first fishing pole, it was just a stick with some string. I couldn't catch a cold with that thing.
Second, you need a fishing license. I sell licenses for a C note, allowing you to fish for a whole day.
And last, you need patience. Just enjoy the peace that fishing brings and talk to your fellow fisherman, but don't believe all their fish stories, heh.
Here take this fishing guide. It has everything you need to know.
I see you're already licensed to fish. Make sure you have your rod ready and don't crowd the other fisherman. If you still need to get a fishing pole, I'll give you the instructions for a few pyreal.
I license fisherman for a C note. That covers you for an entire day.
If you still need help getting ready to fish I sell a good beginner's fishing guide for only a few coins. Just hand me whatever you can and I'll give you a guide.
I license fisherman for a C note if you care to fish. The license covers all fishing holes run by the Department of Fish and Games.
So you want to go fishing, eh? Ok then, lets see here...

You know, I used to fish back in Ispar. One time I had this giant fish on the line and it was a real fighter. Had to lash... oh, right, sorry, you're all set. Remember the license is only good for a day, so catch a big one before then!

Oh, I also supply the local grocers with fresh fish, so I'll buy your catch from you if you like. I pay a lot more than most grocers will, because I know the fish are fresh. Good luck and remember to throw the small ones back.
Thank you, come again.
You caught 400 Minnows? That's not very impressive, but I suppose I should give you something. Here take this and try catching some bigger fish. I'll just release these little ones.
You know, I just have to release these little ones. Why do you bother to keep catching these anyway? Have you heard of a thing called catch and release?
Just hold your nose when you drink that.
I get these potions wholesale from the healers!
What? No, that potion is still good! They get better with age, like wine.
You notice what looks like a date scratched out on the side of the bottle.
Do not bother me about Tamian any more, go talk to someone else about him.

Have I seen Tamian Wilmit? Strange fellow he is, not very able. Seems he can do nothing. I do not understand why Astara is still friends with him.  Tis true, they knew each other on Ispar when younger but he is of no use here. Little in the way of useful skills, he has.

Yes, you may go tell Astara I said so.  He tried to fight me in sword practise. I swatted him finely for he is no good with a blade and he came at me like a rabid Carenzi.  I had to give him a good thrashing, lucky he is we were using wood, not steel. Astara made me stop, also screamed at him, he slunk away like a drudge.
I believe the last time I saw him was over by Ji Tenxien the Tailor. You could ask her.
Hail! A nice day for practising swordplay, is it not?  I plan to hunt later, too.

Why yes, I do know Tamian Wilmit. I met him when I was travelling through Rithwic.  Then he came here not too long ago. He seemed unhappy, and driven.  His goal is to find an Empyrean structure that I had shown him evidence of, a sketch I let him have while staying with his family. He did some research while he was here but did not speak much to me about it.

He left me a sealed copy of his journal in case someone came by looking for him.  I think you are not the person he imagined may show up but I believe I should let you have it. He went to look for this structure. He went west.
Hello. I study manuscripts and historical items.
What are you doing here? Why don't you give me an M note and get started on your mission? Nuhmudira and her students won't wait forever you know.

I see that you have reached the Seat of Knorr. If you pay me an MMD note I'll weave up a gem that will take you back to that very spot. Just make sure to speak to the golem there, if you want to back there quick again.
I am sorry, but I think that you lack the cognitive capacity to ascertain the memorandums and literature that we seek. Please take some time to think about your failure, perhaps 3 days.
If you've lost something of worth to you at the Lyceum or you simply wish to return to it, I can assist you but, it cost you an M note for the return trip.

Once you use this gem you will be on your own. Knorr has no portals, we assume for fear that the Olthoi that have not completely been removed would find a way through to Dereth. You will need to have your own transportation home. You have been warned.
This is all you'll get from me. I need results. If you don't bring me something this time then no more gems for you.
I am afraid that there is no more for you until you've thought about your failures for a little while shall we say... 3 days. Begone.
Speak to the Golem again and maybe I'll be able to craft another one of these for you.
Hey! You're trying to pull one over on me eh?
Olcris looks at you angrily.
I'll keep this, cause Nuhmudira might like it, but you're note getting anything else from me moneywise. Begone.
Ah, good work. Nuhmudira will be pleased that you held up your end of the bargain. Now let me take care of my end.
It has been a pleasure working with you.

Hail! It has come to my attention, through means at my disposal, that Asheron has recently visited his old school somewhere far from Dereth. I'd be willing to assist you in getting there if you promise to do something for me.

I am sure that the structure contains a great many books that pertain to the history of this world. We are looking for any information that you may be able to gather there. Return the books to me  so that Nuhmudira's school might thrive.
If you would agree to such an exchange I will only ask for a small gesture of good will, shall we say an M note?
Should you return the books to me I will ensure that you are given this expenditure upon your return.
I'm sorry I am not willing to send someone along before I have explained all there is to know of this undertaking, besides you may find my offer... beneficial.

I'm sorry, I am not willing to send someone along before I have explained all there is to know of this undertaking; besides you haven't really ever been anywhere that interesting, from the looks of you.
So what do you think you are trying to pull, I don't remember your face. You should really just get out of here.
Olcris looks at you incredulously.
What? You want this back. I have my orders and they clearly say that any and all information gathered from the Lyceum should be given to Nuhmudira. I'm not going to cross her.
I am sorry but your life would be over too quickly if you went where I would send you.

greetings: You wish this sword converted into a dagger?  Very well, I shall do my best. I hope you do not end up with just the hilt, like my last three customers...
Despite his quips, Omaro Nagate skillfully refashions the Sword of Frozen Fury into a Dagger of Frozen Fury
I am just joking. Here you are.
Hello. I have some skills with modifying weapons, though I am still learning the craft.
I'm afraid I don't know what to do with this.
What should I do with a half drunk mug of cider that smells funny? How long was this in the sun? No thank you. I am not thirsty.
It's a mug, and there is a name scratched on the bottom. Maybe it belongs to that person.
This looks like the silk that I used to make a shirt for Jaleh al-Thani. Oh I remember it very well. He asked for a shirt made in a very ornate and overly pretentious way.

This was the first item that my master had me craft. When Jaleh came to collect it he pointed out a tiny flaw in my weaving and demanded the cost be lowered. It was, but so was my pay. I was very angry with him. Very angry with him.
I have heard that he is missing. Surely you don't think that I had anything to do with it. Please you must believe me. Look at my sollerets if you don't.
This clears a lot up. I had thought that the shirt was some of my best work. Now I know that it was.
I am truly sorry that Jaleh is dead. That is a tragedy.
My thanks for delivering this to me.
Oh my. This does look bad, but I swear. I've never been to the desert. I've spent most of my life just around this area, I'm a tailor, not a kidnapper.
You think back to the way the scene looked. The tracks left there were distinctly boots, not sollerets. Someone is trying to frame this poor girl.
You have to believe me.
Hello I am an apprentice of To-ping Ra. He is teaching me the venerable art of tailoring. I have seen a few setbacks in my studies recently but I am sure that my confidence will return.
I can craft you an axe from an armoredillo spine.  Any spine will do.  I'll also return something for a wood or iron heart.
I don't have a use for gromnie teeth.  But I will reward you for auroch horns.
Spines and golem hearts are what I use.  Have any?
A Black Stone, so easily confused with a Black Rock. Let's see, Mana Potions for the stones.
Wonderful, I've been looking for more of these Black Rocks. Health Potions for the rocks I believe.
This is a very impressive rock!
A heart of mud.
Is it the golem's heart that animates them do you think?
A heart of water.
I am confounded by these solid pieces of water. They aren't cold like ice. Hmmm...
A heart of wood.
The most understandable and natural golem heart. Quite pretty too.
A heart of copper.
Living copper. Did you know golem hearts have hollow chambers much like our hearts.
A heart of granite.
Imagine what it would be like to have a heart of stone.
A heart of iron.
The materials these hearts are made of are purer than our blacksmiths can refine.
A heart of ice! How apt.
At least this one is cold.
A heart of obsidian.
These are among the most beautiful of the golem hearts. See how it shines when I polish it?
A heart of diamond.
The materials toughness seems to have a direct correlation to the golems toughness.
A heart of pure pyreal!
This is very valuable.
A heart of pure platinum!
A heart of... vapor.
These are even more mystifying than the Water Golem Hearts.
Spines are nice.
Thank you.
Spines are good.
Come again.
Spines are great!
Spines are wonderful!
Well, would you look at that? I can probably make a slightly better axe from this.
Oh wonderful, a new spine! Maybe I can .. No .. Well .. Hmm. I'll just hold onto it for now.
A fine quality horn.
May your future see good fortune.
I can resecure this to a haft.
And now you have a Basalt Axe instead.
And now you have an Obsidian Axe instead.
I am interested in armoredillo spines and golem hearts of all kinds.  If you give me one I will craft an item from it, or give you something else of value.

quest: You punching bug?  Punch bug or Nanoc mad.
Good. Now Nanoc make puncher. You go bash bug, make Nanoc happy.
Nanoc fashions a crude, yet effective katar from the materials.
I make puncher already. You want punch?
Good leather. Hold puncher together. Now Nanoc make puncher. You go bash bug, make Nanoc happy.
Nanoc fashions a crude yet effective katar.
I make puncher already for you. You want punch? I keep leather now. You bash bug.
I smash bug.  You need something smash bug with?  Give bug crest to Nanoc.  Give leather gauntlet too. Nanoc need leather. I make something you punch bug with. Punch bug dead, bam!
Good crest.  Still need leather gauntlets.
Good leather. Need crest. Have crest, make puncher.
I already made ya a axe.  Why you not out there kickin' chitin an' takin' claws?
This is a nice one. Lemme see...
Narg fashions an axe from the materials. It is crude but sharp.
How many axes you think I can make?  Go kill something.
Yeah this is good. I'll cut it down. I get to keep the rest, see?
How many axes you want? Thanks, I can use this. You gotta problem with that?
We been here for years fightin' off the bugs.  We kills 'em when they sleep sometimes.  And sometimes they does the same to us.

Hey, ya bring me a Olthoi crest and I make ya a fine axe.  Nothin' busts bug shell like bug shell, I always say. Need some wood too though, and that's rare here. An old quarterstaff might do if ya got one. A plain, old wood quarterstaff.
Yeah this should do but I still need a quarterstaff, if ya take my meaning.

Nice quarterstaff. Bop a bug on the head is all's I can do with this, though. Bug'll laugh and spit acid at me. Ya gotta get me an Olthoi crest if ya wanna axe. Gimme a crest, I cut this staff down, bugga bing, bugga bam, I make ya an axe, you're happy, you kill bugs, I'm happy.

greetings: Pincer Danta turns the grub inside out and prepares a delicacy with practiced skill.
Want a grub bite? They're tasty and about all we get to eat. Okay, maybe not so tasty.
quest: I hope you're breaking lots of shell with that atlatl.
This should work.
Pincer Danta fashions an atlatl from the materials you gave her.
How many atlatls do you need? Thanks, I'll hold onto this in case mine breaks.
Hi, I'm Pincer Danta. Glad someone finally came to help us.  We got us a nice place here. Want to see my pincer collection? Every time the bugs come and try to take 'em back I get more.

I made a nice atlatl out of pincers. Seeing as how you're here fighting the bugs with us, if you get me a bug's stabbing claw I could carve it into an atlatl for you. Also need an Olthoi femur.  That's the top part of the leg, in case you don't know.  You been around Olthoi as much as us, you get to know a lot about 'em.  Femur and a stabbing claw, that's what I need.
Say, got any grub bites?
You found a femur, maybe you outsiders aren't so dumb after all. I'll need a stabbing claw too, like I said...
You found a stabbing claw. Maybe you outsiders aren't so dumb after all. I'll need a stabbing claw too, like I said...

greetings: The big man does not speak, only looks at you with eyes that seem no longer human.

quest: Honey, have you tasted Olthoi fungus?  We eat it steamed, fried, roasted and burnt. Sure is good. Why, I tell myself every day that I sure can't wait for another meal of Olthoi fungus. And grub bites. Mmmm. Hey, you should use that nice spear I made you and kill some bugs so we can get more fungus and grub bites.
Honey, didn't I make you a spear already? You think they grow on trees? We hardly got any trees here either! I'll keep this. If you break yours in a week or so maybe I'll make you another.

Well, honey, it sure is nice to know there's others fighting the Olthoi with us here.  Can you really kill 'em with that?  I use a nice spear myself.  Goes through bug shell like butter.  Of course, it's been years since I've tasted butter... Get me a bug's long claw and I might make you one. Make sure the long claw is nice and pointy.  And freshly killed.
This should work.
Teela makes a spear out of the Olthoi long claw.
I will stay and help fight the Olthoi if you could deliver the note.

You found us! Did the High Queen send you? We came across this group of Olthoi fighters and decided to stay and help them keep the Olthoi at bay.  All the portals in the deepened lairs appeared to lead to these catacombs.  Perhaps the Olthoi are re-grouping!
Please deliver this note to one of the Queen's Royal Guard.

greetings: I am pleased to see you. Did you find notes I left on the way?  There are Olthoi in tunnels all around us. We have been helping defend this area but we may be overrun soon.
It is fortunate you have arrived. Without help these valiant fighters might be slaughtered after having held out for so many years.  The Olthoi seem to be on the move!
Mandible turns the grub inside out and prepares a delicacy with practiced skill.
Ooo hah! Grub bite! Have one!

Yeah that's right we tear 'em up.  Never did find no way outa here though. Portal disappeared, got us trapped way back when. We got good at fightin' the bugs. There's more of the bugs now, though. Guess you got down here in your fancy armor. Well, maybe you ain't leavin' either.  Maybe we ain't leavin' too.  Kinda cozy down here.
Ooo hah! I love the smell of burnin' chitin in the morning. But down here ya never know when it's morning.

Yeah, I'm tough but I sure like to eat grub bites. Nothin' better than grub bites. 'cept maybe the foot races we used to have back home. Those was fun. Here we just run from bugs. But then we turn and ambush 'em. Yeah that's right we tear 'em up.
You need not pay me to pass through the gate
Quickly, step inside the gates before the encampment is roused to strike out against us.
You may pass through the gate.
I've got most of the town's fortification drawn out here, but I keep having to change them. Working with the other races is all well and good, but it can be difficult.
The Tumeroks want access to some sort of undergound aquifer they say they have sensed in order to feed this bush they say is important.

The Lugians want everything made of stone and I keep having to tell them that the expense is too great. They just shake there heads and pat their hammers meaningfully. If I survive the building of this town I think I'll change my career.

An Agent of the Arcanum came by and officially informed me that there is a Zoning Ordinance which does not allow us to build a moat around the town.  No sooner than the monsters are cleared out of an area, the bureaucrats move in!
I had designed taller watchtowers but some of the new residents complained they would block their view!  Maybe they would prefer to be eaten when the monsters sneak up on them.

The kiln operators stopped work when the Lugians stacked the stone incorrectly. It seems the Tumeroks won't supply them with enough water which the kiln operators have in their contract as exclusively supplied to them, lest they stop work.
Welcome to the town that you helped build Founder.

Welcome to the town that you helped build Founder. Yes, I did have a different name last time we met. I thought that I would change everything in my life including my name. I liked being Lecor Busier, but I've found that a different name doesn't make you a different person.
I like it up here. Far above the busy town. Come again.
Hehe, you're a Town Builder and I'm a Town Planner.
Thank you for visiting us up here Town Builder.
Goodbye. I seem to have misplaced a few of my things. Oh, well I find them at some point.
I can use this.
Hmm, never seen one of these. I'll take it.
Thank you, I was running short on those.
Let me see that. Yes, I'll take all you have.
You be careful with that.
Your purchase and I'll put these in here and these shouldn't be here they need to go in with the tools. Oh, sorry, anything else?
Here you are, I have a lot of these if you need more.
An excellent buy Town Founder.
I am delighted you were able to get some Whispering Venom crystals from that mine!
Nuhmudira's assistant casts several spells upon the crystal and fashions a portion of it into a ring.
Wearing this ring will allow passage through the portal. Go and get the better of the Olthoi that dwell in that foul lair!

Hello. I have been tasked by Nuhmudira to continue to collect Whispering Venom crystals.  They aided in overcoming the threat of the ancient Olthoi Queen who resided within this lair.  It is important to probe this lair lest the Queen should return here and defeat any Olthoi within it! Nuhmudira had determined there is an unknown force that seems to "drown out" mana and suppresses higher forms...

A very rare crystal, Whispering Venom crystal is required to nullify this effect- the wearing of a ring made from this crystal allows a successful journey through portal space to this lair.   Alas, Nuhmudira did possess a supply of these crystals however they were stolen once from her warehouse, together with numerous other crystals. While the other crystal types are being replaced through the...

There is a mine at desert's edge, west of Khayyaban, which used to be a source of these crystals.  It may be somewhat depleted but it is our only hope.  Please try to find some and return as soon as you are able!
Cydna Wren looks about fearfully.
I do not want that! Get it away from me!
quest: What do you want from me? Oh ... the crystal. That jeweler must have led you to me. Ah well, there is no hiding ... nor does it matter who I put my trust in. Experience has taught me that lesson. If you keep my location here a secret, I will tell you where some of those crystals may be found. Take this small journal. I wrote it in case ... something happened to me.
What do you want from me? Go away, I do not trust you.

greetings: Hiyp The Toad looks at you with a sodden expression

Hey, that's my best pickaxe!  I must have left it down in the, ummm, where was that... oh yeah there was that mine, I was tryin' to get some of those crystals them's in Zaikhal wanted. Maybe it'll help with the bugs, maybe not. Well, there's nothing in that mine, I'll tell ya. So I said to myself, forget it, go have a drink. You trying to get some too? Hmmm, I just may know someone who can get...
quest: Thanks for picking up that pickaxe for me. Now I can stop worrying about it and get back to business... Barkeep! Another ale over here.
Don't forget to find Djusfa bint Huqis in Zaikhal. She'll know all about what you're looking for.
Yeah, I like the beer here, so what?  I'll do some alchemy later. I could mine some crystals if I had my pickaxe...

greetings: I ask you to find out what happened to my husband and you bring me back a scrap of paper with doodles on it!!!
I can't read this. Is it about my husband?
I just wish I knew what happened to him.
quest: I'm grateful for what you have done. You told me the truth when a lie would have been easier. I still hold hope that someday my husband and I will be reunited.
My Gareth is gone!
I've told you everything I know about my husbands disappearance. Ask Dalius if he knows more about the Sclavus Temple he found.
What's this?
%mn opens the book and starts to read.
This fits with the story from Gareth's journal. That undead horror seems to believe my husband died from the process she used on him.
I guess my husband's ruse worked and she believed the corpse he left behind was his.
Thank you, I'll keep this in case it has some clue how to help my Gareth.
Do I look like a woman who would forget my own husbands death?!
I have no need of the foul thoughts of that wretched murderess!
%mn throws the journal at you.
Bastard! I will not have my emotions toyed with. Dalius warned me that you might try something like this.
%mn torches the book with a flamebolt.
You already brought me my husbands journal. I know what happened to him. Do not taunt me so cruelly!
%mn shoves the book back at you.
Maybe you have heard of my husband, Gareth Dain?

He hunted these lands looking for treasure and glory, but three years ago he failed to return home. I could find nothing else to explain his disappearance, then one year ago a warrior told me that he had seen Gareth shortly before he went missing. The man said that Gareth had been fighting a group of Sclavus in the crater hills somewhere around here.
I moved to Candeth Keep with the hope that I could find clues to tell me what had happened to Gareth. Recently my husband's dear friend Dalius found a Temple in a crater west of here.

He says that the crater was filled with a howling sandstorm. He bravely fought his way to the eye of the storm to find a Temple protected by Sclavus. I am sure that this must be the same temple that my husband was last seen at.
Please, go and find out what happened to my husband. I just need to know what really happened.
Have you brought word of my husband?
%mn takes the book and reads Fanzen's notes.
This Vitriaka performed some magical process on a...
%mn looks up from the book in shock.
No. No, it can't be! It was someone else!! That undead Beast couldn't take my Gareth!    Nooooo!!!
%mn throws the book at you.
She collapses to the floor in grief. Her body shaking with her sobs.
Gaaareth! My Gareth!!!
Dalius quietly motions you over to him and holds out a hand for the book.
%mn takes the book and stares at the sclavus covering. She slowly opens it and starts to read.
Oh, my lord... Gareth... what did they do to you?!
No! My poor Gareth... She hurt you, she changed you.
%mn points a shaking finger at you.
You killed the Beast that did this to him? Tell me you killed her!!!
You did as I asked. I know the truth now, it's horrible, but I know.
Take this as a small reward and leave me.
%mn hands you a beautiful staff.

greetings: I cannot read this. It looks like a clue though. Did you find anything else?
Why give this to me? I cannot read Falatacot... if that is what this strange language is.
These are lies fabricated by some confused creature. My dear friend Gareth is dead and we must prove that to our Lady there. I will keep this so that she does not get confused.
Did you find nothing to prove what we already know?
quest: %mn glares at you with distaste.
You had to tell her.
What good did you do her by telling her that her husband is now some hideous freak? I asked you to do a simple task and put my Lady's mind at peace, but you just had to go and ruin everything!
%mn's eyes suddenly loose their ferocity and he straightens up.
Well, what's done is done. Take your little magic staff and leave us. I have to comfort Talira. I'll make it all right.
You think you see a slight smile on his face.
I owe you a great debt my friend. You have helped my Lady put her late husband behind her. With my help she will learn to be happy once more.
I have told you of the temple to the west. Search for a great sandstorm and find it's eye.
Lady Dain may be able to tell you something of use, but I warn you not to cause her undo stress.
%mn glares at you in disgust.
You can't fix the damage you've done now.
Leave us! I'll dispose of this myself.
You already gave me a copy of this. The deed has been done and I have rewarded you for your services. You aren't trying to trick me are you?
Hello friend, did Lady Dain ask you to speak with me?
I must ask a favor of you. I recently discovered something while searching for my long lost friend Gareth Dain.

I was exploring the wastelands west of here when a giant sandstorm blew in out of nowhere. It stung my face and made it almost impossible to breathe, but I forced my way onward. I eventually came to a calm at the center of the storm where I found an ancient temple. When I approached the structure a great number of Sclavus sprung from the sands and attacked, forcing me to retreat.

I have told Lady Dain what I discovered and we believe that this is the very Sclavus Temple that Gareth was last seen at. I do not however hold her belief that her husband still lives. She has obsessed over his disappearance for three years now and I dearly wish to see her mourning end.

Do her a noble deed and find proof of her husband's death. I am sure that my friend Gareth would have come back if humanly possible, so I know him to be dead. I ask of you to be sure that you bring only proof of his death, she has suffered enough and I could not bear to see her suffering continue. Do this for me and I will reward you.
You have done my Lady and myself a great service. You are truly worthy of my friendship.
Take this staff as a small token of my appreciation.

greetings: A wise decision -- one I may ask you to make again sometime.  For now however, I will make good on the promise of advice, with a little bit of secret information thrown in for free.  Consider it another gift, heh.
The advice:  "Always seek to gain advantage when your enemy is involved; double the advantage when the enemy is a friend."
And now, the information.  I suggest you keep this to yourself, lest we end up with every arch mage and their vassal running around this place like gromnies with their heads cut off.
I know of a well-hidden complex of deep tunnels called the Elemental Caverns.  You look like you get around, so I'm sure these directions will be quite easy for you.

In the southern Direlands, there is a dungeon called the Lightless Catacombs.  It is here that a winding valley begins, running westward.  Head west through the valley until you reach two small in ground structures.  One filled with undead, the other housing a portal to Zaikhal.
Nearby, you will find a steep slope that will take you to the top of the mountains.  You will find the entrance to the caverns in the rocky peaks.
I can move with complete invisibility, using no magic trick or power.  I use only skill to move unseen, or to strike, or to evade the onslaught of war magic -- you do know what skill is, aye?
I have learned the deadly and secret arts from Dereth's greatest assassin -- so do watch your back, please.
If you are stealthy enough, you can sneak right up to a banderling who is too busy looking around nervously to notice -- sadly, I have not found this to be the case with dancing drudges.

Well, you do seem to be pretty wealthy, and this is broad daylight, after all -- so how's about you consider loaning me one of those crisp new 250,000 pyreal notes?  Consider it payment for the two gifts I am giving you:  Protection from imminent danger, and a bit of advice to be imparted upon payment.

quest: You think, "The man looked me over with a hint of malice in his eye. I'd seen that look before. His type only respected strength. I showed him I meant business."
You think, "He saw things my way. All brawn and no brain. He reminded me of a shreth, charging forward not realizing that it looks a lot tougher than it really is."

You think, "I started to think back over the mistakes that I made getting to this point. The first was thinking that I was getting past this guy. He wasn't an overly large man, more or less my size, really. But he was irascible, kept saying something about only bandits can get in the treasure room. I was a prisoner it appeared...gee thanks for the update big man. Guess he didn't get the memo th...
You think, "I tried to calm him down..."
You think, "It didn't help. He was swinging and there was nothing that I could do about it."
You think, "The world was spinning again. I knew where I'd end up. The bandits had their orders. I was being kept alive for some purpose. I'd find myself back in the cage..."

greetings: You think, "He looked like a kid running around the holiday pole. The gleam in his eye reminded me of a diamond golem in the noonday sun. He opened the door without hesitation and bowed deeply."

You think, "This guy was something else. They must have been paying him the pocket change that young banderlings carry around. He kept going on about only needing 100 pyreals. 100 pyreals? I had a trade note for that much. Did the Dame know that I'd need it...I'd written it off as a back-handed sum of cash to undertake a dangerous case. Now, I saw the irony of the situation was like statues bui...
You think, "He was looking for a bribe. I just might have the money he needed."

quest: You think, "More crying. Either this guy was related to a mite, or he was genuinely afraid for his life. I figured I had learned everything that there was from, Gentleman Jake. Time to choose. Continue on my journey now, or wait until later."
Listen well, you scurvy mutt, I'm Gentleman Jake Hawkins! If MacNiall follows the right way of doing things, then I'm 8 paces to the left. Yar!
Don't forget old Gentleman Jake now, friend.
You think, "The man standing before me looked haggard. As soon as he saw me approaching, he started shaking like a leaf getting ready to be shed in the autumn air."
You think, "Being one to press my advantage, I shook the man down."
You think, "He folded like a simulacrum skin suit falling to the ground..."

You think, "He was begging me not to slap him silly. He wasn't worth the effort. His tale was pretty simple. Lonely kid, came through the portal from Ispar and got involved in the wrong crowd. He'd heard whispers coming down through the chain of command and ran when the kitchen fires grew too hot. Now he was a refugee, living in MacNiall's Freehold. He talked big, but sobbed bigger."
You think, "I was less than enthused, and waited for his blubbering to end."
You think, "When his tantrum was done he handed me a torch..."
You think, "...a signed confession..."
You think, "...and a portal gem."

You think, "The choice was up to me now. Did I chance what lay in the dungeon beyond this gem. The blubbering idiot standing before me told me it was dark. How dark? Dark enough that the torch would be my only light. I wasn't afraid, just wary...maybe this would best wait for a later time."

greetings: These crystals must be laid into the Dragon's protective arms. Place them within the brazier. If you choose to use them alone, you can anoint them with the water I have given you, but you will not find completeness.

This should placed atop the crystals that have been laid into the brazier that represents the Dragon's power. Place it atop the crystals and brazier. You can choose to anoint this stone with the water I have given you, but you will not find completeness.

The brazier represents the power of the Dragon a shield and defense for the Unicorn and Firebird. You can place the crystals within the Brazier. If you so choose, you may alter this with the water I have given you, but you will not find completeness.

Anoint the combines pieces that represent the Dragon, Firebird and Unicorn to find a center for yourself. If you choose to anoint a single item you may release the magical properties within the item but you will still find yourself empty.
quest: You have completed your journey. Allow time for the teachings to be set within your being. If within one month you are still without direction, follow my path again, and I shall teach the steps anew.
You have done well to find the power of the Dragon.
You have done well to find the power of the Firebird.
You have traveled the same path as I, and learned the lessons of the great spirits. Now you must know how they fit together.

The base is the Dragon's power. The grace of the Unicorn must be spread within. The splendor of the Firebird can be placed atop the combination of strength and grace but...only with pure water that represents the four stones and the path of Jojii can you bring the object to life.
Here, take this.

The water can be used to waken the combined spirit of the three, or to awaken the strength of just one. I would advise against waking just one. There is little that can be finished that is not complete.
You have done well to find the splendor of the Firebird.
You have done well to find the grace of the Unicorn. You need only find the Dragon's power.
You have found the grace of the Unicorn. But you lack the splendor of the Firebird.
You have not found your way upon the path. You must first find the grace of the Unicorn, the splendor of the Firebird and the power of the Dragon.
You have found the grace of the Unicorn. But you lack the splendor of the Firebird or the power of the Dragon.
You need to find the Dragon's power and the Firebird's Splendor.
You must now find the grace of the Unicorn and the splendor of the Firebird.
I have traveled far to reach this point, and still my journey only begins. Visit the adherent to Jojii in Tou-Tou to learn my tale.

greetings: A moment, please.
If you paint your armor with this, it will have highlights as blue as the sky.
If you paint your armor with this, it will shine like the setting sun in summer vibrant and purple hued.
If you paint your armor with this, it will have edges the color of blood.
quest: The power of the Dragon must be tempered by the Unicorn's grace and Firebird's splendor; else it is a shield used by the ignorant.
One must possess humility so as to not be filled with pride.
One must become detached to avoid desire.
One must possess compassion to alleviate suffering.
One must know discipline to not become soft.

Though I try to live my life according to Jojii's path I sometimes find that I lack discipline. I have begun painting, and hope to continue doing so. I have noticed that many who come here seek the armor that is wrought by Koga Hideki and his peers.

I wish to assist those who wish to bring the colors of the rainbow to the armor he makes. If you hand me vials of Lapyan, Hennacin and Relanim dyes, I will make them into paints that will stay upon the shadow armor that has been enhanced with the new magical shards.

You seek the power of the dragon, as did Honshu. Very well. I shall tell you were he was sent. In the valley, across the stretch of land, and water. Through the hills that bite, atop the crest where the sun sets, there is a portal into the place where the Dragon's flame smolders in a basin of metal. Honshu went there to find the Dragon's power.
Go there and find the strength that I hope he found.

I have met the man you seek, this Honshu Takeda. He is a good man. He will find his way back to the path of right living. I have sent him to seek grace at the shrine in Sawato. Perhaps if you pray, as he likely did, at the shrine you will see grace as well.
The grace of the unicorn is not the same as the balance of the crane. It is an ephemera that suffuses the soul and fills one with peace.
Your steps are just beginning, fear not the road that they will follow. Tranquility is as the river who calls to the sea.
A reed that does not bend, shatters and is swept away in the current.
As philosophies divide, so do the adherents of the paths. Not all are able to follow the path of the human.
Through the four stones we are shown the way to heaven and perfect life.
Grace allows us to walk through life in perfection.
The rocks are all too large. You found a smooth stone here within the past month. Perhaps if a little more time passes another such stone will be created by the shifting magma.
The rocks appear to be too large to carry. However, as you search through them you see one that has been formed into a perfectly smooth sphere, about the size of an orb.
You see nothing special in the rock formation here.
The narrow path allows all who walk upon it to attain balance.
The journey of the obstinate is to find the will to become as pliable as the reed in the riverbed.
Within the bounds of grace lies the wisdom to know strength.
Seek what you know and discover what you shall.
There is no grace in the bull. Passion is the way of the poet, not wisdom. Ignorance is a shield that protects none.
Seek the truth of Jojii. His teaching can be found in every aspect of life. To follow his words is to walk the right way in life.
Sit, Please.
In my life, I have seen a great many wonders that have challenged my beliefs, and driven me near the edge of forsaking all that I had known. But in Jojii, I have found the virtuous path.
Not so long ago, another came to me. He was as accomplished as you, more so perhaps. What he had accomplished is not as important as what he had learned.

His name is Honshu Takeda, and he has begun to learn about himself and the way of Jojii. He had lost his way, and I have set him back upon his path. He will follow the shrines to Jojii. The first lies within this very town, just beyond these doors between the trees.
His journey will end in Kara. Much wisdom can be garnered by following the path and incorporating the lessons of the four stones in your actions.
Should you wish to follow in his steps, seek the shrine and pray as I am sure he has done.
The narrow path, allows all who walk upon it, to attain balance.
The journey of the obstinate, is to find the will to become as pliable as the reed in the riverbed.
There is no grace in the bull. Passion is the way of the poet, no wisdom. Ignorance is a shield that protects none.
I have already provided you with a pennant.  Display it proudly!

The High Queen has commissioned me to create a pennant for all Isparians currently upon Dereth.  Asheron himself has provided the device - the heraldry of his family.  I am told that this is in honor of our continued bravery and heroics. He and the High Queen have decided that he no longer needs to watch over us, and now Asheron may return to his home.
Take this pennant and display it proudly! But be warned that I am only commissioned to provide you with this once.

I am sorry, friend. I have only the materials to provide pennants to those who were already on Dereth when Asheron returned home. I am sure that you will find other ways to show your courage and honor.

greetings: This came from the garb worn by one of the traitors? I have no need for it and I have nothing to reward you for defeating them. My apologies. Perhaps someone else affiliated with the Shagar Zharala can given you a prize worthy of your efforts.
My... my master's journal!
Yalik reads over the journal, closes it, and returns it to you.

His final hours were met with glorious battle against our new enemies. For that I am happy for him. This information should not be withheld, please take it to someone of higher rank than I. They will know what to do with this journal.
Our foreman was against this journey from the start. Just the fact that the Order of the Raven Hand displayed an interest in this tower was enough to give him pause.
It seems his concerns were justified. Please take this to someone of higher rank than I. They will know what to do with this journal.
Thank you! As I promised, here is the key. Use it well.
Beyond the door are a series of levers. Once you pass through the gate they bar, you may not be able to return here, so please prepare first.
Also, if you happen to find my master in the depths, please let him know I am safe and continuing my duty up here.
quest: Ah! I see you've brought your emblem with you. Give it here and I'll give you the key to the door over there.
Already so many Zharalim have fallen into the grasp of madness, I would hate to see any more fall.
Finally! People! People who aren't crazed!
Don't look at me like I'm the crazy one. It's all those down below who have gone raving mad! Can you help them?
Wait, you don't look like a Zharalim. Let me see your emblem! No emblem? Then I'm afraid I cannot let you pass. I am not about to let more people fall to the madness of this tower!

If you see any of my brethren in the wilds, be wary of them. Chances are they are maddened by whatever is in the depths of this place. I fear that in that maddened state, they may have fallen prey to some beast. Shreth are all too common in this region.

greetings: Barkeep... one last drink...
Rosebud.
I should have taken the red pill.
Now I'll never know what happened to Tuka...
We Rock!
No power in Auberean can stop me!
Get offin my land!
This is private property!
Your head'll look good in my trophy room!
Stay outta my basement!
Gettem!
Ugh! I hate this stuff, but I have a friend who likes it. Maybe you should drop in on him.
Hmmm, I can't use a stamp... Oh! Very funny! Very funny! Get outta my house Mr. Funnyman!
What do you want me to do with this? Pick my teeth? Stop bothering me I have some serious drinking to do.
You find enough of this you might be able to have some tailor make a really fine shirt.
Hey. This is stolen property. I might swill my share of ale, but I'm not swilling my brew from Celcynd's mug.
Aw! None Left!
Ahem, I like my privacy when I can get it!
Rotten tourists.
You know, this isn't some vacation hotspot. This is my home!
Wipe your feet! Cleaning house takes time away from my life's endeavor.
Nothing you see here is for sale! Not even for...
How much did you say you had?
Hey, down here bozo!
I can't even see out the window!
This sucks!
Think they're so big! I'll show'em.
My boots don't fit anymore.
I can drink five times my weight in stout!
You don't want me angry with you. Most of my punches tend to land below the belt.
I can't decide. Do you think I should decorate in Neo-Aluvian or Classic Sho?
I'm looking for a growth spell. If you find one let me know.
You know what they say. Small something or other, big something something.
Did you notice that everything seems to have gotten larger?
Small am I? I could drink you under the table!
No, not drink under the table! You rasell frassin! Get out of here!
People are always coming up to me "Oh, look how cute! A little Ulgrim!"
Gits!
One advantage to my size is that all my stout mugs are bigger!
You know it's good when you have to stop and breathe.
Great! You found my Home Brew!
Ahh!!! If that ain't the mothers milk to me! I've been saving that stout for a special occasion like this one.
What special occasion? Why my coming home party of course!
Let's see, I think I have a reward for you here.
Don't say I never gave you anything!
No thanks, I never get hangovers. You keep it.
Wah Chon's winter brew!
Ulgrim tips the stein and drains it in one long draught.
Gasp! Great Mattekar that's tasty! This inspires me to rhyme!
A larger lager lather is the taste I'd rather gather
when my lesser lager's suds are in the drink.
Then I mull the flavor over with it's hops and malts and clover
and again about the pub is what I think.
What's this?
Hey! This is half of that spell I wrote!
Good thing I was able to find the other half. Now let's see...
A little here...
A little there...
There good as new... almost. Wow, this is a really good spell. Let me just copy this down...
Ulgrim crouches and writes the spell on the back of his hand.
Here...
I want you to have it. It won't be all that useful to you I'm afraid, but you never know. Just don't depend on it. I don't have anywhere to go, but the Big Guy travels around quite a bit.
Aha! Another ring for my collection.
Of course I already found the only ring I'll ever need, but thanks.
Wait, This ring looks familiar.
This is MY RING!!!
You stoles it!!!
Get out of my house you nasty thief!!!
Hey, good stuff, thanks. Tough to find this around here. What? You're standing there looking at me with your mouth open. You expect me to say something special for this? I'm not a performing monkey!
Expect me to drink this eh?
Ulgrim drinks the mead quickly.
No thank you, but I prefer a sweeter wine.
Very good. If you could find a handful of wine I might be convinced to tell you of my adventures and heroic deeds.
Nice, but I prefer wine.

This drink reminds me of a crazy fellow I met in a desert fort south of here. He was very serious and wanted us to help him cast some spell. I saw nothing for me in that, so I headed out to find my fortune and drink my fill of wine.
If it's no bother, would you be kind enough to buy me something to wet my thirst? Byrdara seems to have locked up the liquor for some reason.
Alas I am so very thirsty after my trip from the southern reaches. I fear that I will be unable to enlighten you lest this terrible thirst is quenched.
quest: It would appear that I have told you all that I know. Or have I? Perhaps I know something that I do not know that I knew. I find drink of great utility in remembering things I have forgotten.
Yes, one more drink may finally get us to the bottom of this enigma! Run off and fetch me more wine before I forget to remember!
Mmmmm..Mmmmm..Ow!!!
Vers thomfing thuck in ma mouf!
A splinter? I guess they add all sorts of stuff to wine to give it that woody flavor.
Ulgrim tosses the splinter aside.
What's that over there, behind you?!
What, nothing? My mistake, I thought I saw something. Well never mind, here let us drink to our continued friendship.
Ulgrim watches you expectantly from over his mug.
So, I've got a small problem maybe you can help me with. There's this guy in Dryreach thats been posing as me, Ulgrim!
If you could maybe just scare him a little? You know, make him realize that there can be only one.
Yes, yes, I think I'm remembering something...
No, I've lost it.
Perhaps one more wine will help me cogitate.
Yes and what would you like my friend?
Drink? I'm sure I don't know what drink you are talking of.
No, you are mistaken, but if you were to bring me more drink I might be able to devise of an elaborate plan to track down the culprit.
So, are you looking to earn a little extra pyreal on the side? We could perhaps enter into a mutually beneficial arrangement.
Think about it. I'm always looking for bright new people to join my allegiance.

You look at me expectantly. You think this drink puts me in your debt? I would think again my friend. It is you who are in my debt. I have graced you with knowledge that you cannot acquire anywhere else. I would step carefully were I you.
Now kiss the ring.
Very Good.

greetings: I think I'de like something to drink. Do you think I should drink something? Maybe I shouldn't... how this whole mess got started... never learn.
I should go back, but I don't want to. If I go back I might not get to go anywhere. What'll I do?
quest: I already gave you what you were looking for.
I did... didn't I?
Ummm, thanks for the drink.
I think you should have this.
Yes, I agree.
Wait, no I don't.
On second thought.
Well, maybe.
Should I stay or should I go?
Thanks.
What would you do if you were a duplicate of someone else?
Really? But...
Where would I get a pair of oven mitts that large?
You go and talk to him. He's in Dryreach. Tell him that I'm sorry and I'm not coming back.
Well, maybe I will, but not right away... probably.
Don't tell him where I am.
You shouldn't never not remove those labels from mattresses. I don't... wait, yes I do.

greetings: Girls!
Drink!
Sumperbumperhuggies... soddin yipwangler!
Eh! Drink! Watch the frogs!
...raykit flying horse brazier capes!
Sandstretch! Tusker headed bone poo! Filestone! Feh!
Feh!
Pyreal hand and fish!
Suddy skunk hut, carenzi 7.1 fishpliers! 71.6 Epileptic spongemonkies!
quest: Super pogo lake-insect nappy trouser eagle ring!
Winter green carenzi pants.
Lucky apple tinker flakes.
Free dead door frogs! Rings in Rings!!! Buggrit! Kill!
Suck intangible gravy jumpers!
Sodding jackson ring! Feh! Dumb electric criers!

greetings: Did I say Stout? I didn't.
I don't drink stout. Give me beer!
That repli-jerk in Dryreach likes this stuff. NOT ME!
Not big enough!
I'm not talking to anyone unless I get some beer.
quest: What?! I already gave you what you wanted.
Get lost!
Do you know what you sound like?
Ulgrim fakes a whiny voice, "I'm looking for a splinter. I want a piece of wood. Me, me, me! Look at me, I'm a flippin' ponce!"
Fine! Take it! Just stop talking.
Right, here's your bloody splinter. Now run along.
Ulgrim murmurs, Stupid .... always looking for ... my problem ... can go take ... at a mattekar for all I care.
No!
Stop bothering me with your stupid problems.
What part of the word NO don't you understand?
I'll kill you to death if you don't stop pestering me. See if I dont!

greetings: Nope, that's not the stuff I like. I like my drink simple and not all snooty-like.
Shreth piss. Look kid, get me somethin' else.
Look, I don't like the stout. Don't bring me stout, cause I don't like it.
Do you get my meanings that I'm makin' here? Heh?
Jeez, what a meathead!
I leave all the hoity toity drinkin' to that fool over der in that fort. There's a dumb place to go for a drink! Dry-somtin-or-other wasn't it?
Look, I'm thirsty, get me somethin' to drink, will ya?
What is this?! Are you just gonna stand there jabbin' me in the side all day? Huh?
Why don't you make yourself useful? Go tell that unpleasant guy that we ain't comin' back. No how, no way.
quest: You ain't to bright are you? Look I've told you all I know. If I knew somethin I'd have already told you by now. Go talk to that there fancy boy in the desert. He thinks he knows everything.
Ulgrim stirs the beer with a bit of wood and tosses it aside.
Aw, now look what you gone and done. Now I realize that I'm thirsty here. Bring me another will ya?
See what I've done der? I've made it so this cup is empty. There should be beer there, but there's not. Heh?
Hey, hey, watch the personal space there friend. I'm not one of those support mages! I keep my wand in my pocket, thank you very much.
What's with all these lugians in our towns. Don't get me wrong, they deserve all the freedoms and stuff, but just not around here.
Do you smell something?
Phew! You should think about taking a bath there.
Cheers!

greetings: What are you looking at?
Good, but it's a bit bland isn't it.
I prefer something a bit richer.
Refreshing, but none too fulfilling. Isn't there a drink with some spice to it?
Boooooring. I want something that will warm me up out here. This stuff is worse than that swill they served in Dryreach.
You should join me. It's liberating!
Can you buy me a drink? I seem to have left my money in my other pants.
Oh, and get me a drink with a bit of zing to it.
You know your a real hero if you can fight naked.
quest: Nope, I gave you the only toothpick I had.
I do have a toothbrush if you want to borrow it though.
No? Suit yourself.
Sure I have a toothpick.
Here you go.
Go on, take it.
Where did I pull that from?
You don't want to know.
No, I'm not a sheriff. Why do you ask?
Ummm, I don't think so. What's a wardrobe malfunction?
Thanks!
Say, what's a Ursuin Shot? I heard someone talking about one. Are they a good drink?
Clothes are for the weak. I save all my money for lager.
I'm naked as a Siraluun!
Hmph! I hear they aren't so prudish on Tusker Island.
Nope, it's just a nanner.

greetings: The stout pours right through poor Ulgrim.
Maybe I can drink something lighter.
The mugs hard to hold. Ok, I think I have it.
The stout spills all over the floor where Ulgrim stands.
I wish I could taste it.
Just nod if you can see me.
Good, I thought I'd faded out all together.
I could really use a drink.
I remember trying to lifestone tie somewhere and then boom, everything went dark.
Something must have gone wrong. I'm not quite here.
I - I can see things... horrible things. They're everywhere. Swimming around and through everything like it's not there.
I don't think they've noticed me... You have to figure out what happened. Go to Dryreach where I tried to lifestone and see if there are any clues.
Hurry!
quest: Thanks, have you found out anything?
Have you even been to Dryreach? Look, I don't have much time left. You have to help me!
What about that splinter I gave you? I think it's part of the wand I used to cast my lifestone tie. That could be important.
Oh, thank you!
I don't know how much more of this I can handle. You have to help me.
Here, take this, it's the only thing I have that seems to still be solid. Maybe it has something to do with what happened to me.
Please hurry, those things seem to be looking for me. They're getting closer!
Ulgrim seems to be yelling something, but you only hear a faint whisper.
The floor feels like sand almost.
I almost fell through a little while ago. I'm afraid to think where I might end up if that happens.
Ah, I could taste that one.
I just want you to know that I'm thankful for everything you've done.
Whatever happens, it wasn't your fault.
Not long now.
They... can definitely see something.
It's when they brush against me that I want to scream.
My friends seem to like you.
Gah! Oh nooooo. Please, no!
It's...
Ulgrim's voice fades out, but his face is contorted in a crazed scream.

greetings: No thanks, I've kindof turned off this stuff since the incident in Dryreach. It wasn't pretty.
I seem to have formed an allergic reaction to stout. I puff up and stop breathing when I drink it.
I wouldn't say no to some wine.
Thanks.
Do you have any red wine?
Greetings! Welcome to the Lofty Spire. Please have a seat and a server will be with you shortly.
If you buy me a drink I'll tell you what you shouldn't order.
You wouldn't believe what happened to me on the way here from Dryreach.
I was running away from some shadows when they suddenly decided to give up the chase.
I thought I had finally caught a break, but that's when I slammed into foot of a tremendous monouga.
He scooped me up and threw me across the desert. Luckily some hard jagged rocks broke my fall.
I was completely lost and crawled through the desert until I came across Uziz. Finally something was going right! I crawled my way into this bar and ordered a drink.
It was then I recognized Maryata the barkeep. It seems I have a small bar tab that was mistakenly unpaid that last time I was here.
She's making me work off the money I owe her by greeting her customers... So, Greetings and welcome to the Lofty Spire... have a seat and buy me a drink.
quest: I'm sorry I don't have more things embedded in my flesh that I can give you, but if you stay around awhile I'm sure it's just a matter of time.
Ahhh!!! That should help with the gout.
Oh joy! Things are looking up! That splinter embedded in my neck has finally come out!
Here, take it as a good luck charm.
Funny thing, I was greeting people outside until this fellow comes up to me and tells me about this terrible secret he wants to protect everyone from.
I couldn't quite figure out what the terrible secret was, but it sure is terrible. So, I'm standing here by the stairs like he asked me to, just in case.
You might want to stand here too.
I bet you don't know that some magical components are quite deadly if ingested.
I sure didn't.
I went to visit the fortune shrine today. Want to hear my fortune?
You will fall into a very deep hole and your broken body will slowly be devoured by the foul things that reside in the lightless places.
That didn't sound so good.
My lucky numbers are 6,6,6.

After I clear up this whole bar tab mess I think I'll go and spend some quiet time in Yanshi. It's so nice and peaceful there. Someone else suggested the Singularity Caul too. That might be nice. I haven't been there in a long time.
Maryata says that as long as I don't break any more mugs today I can go.
I was so happy, I dropped another mug.
She's so nice. She said that didn't count since I wasn't ready. And when I was leaving her office she pretended not to notice when I tripped over that table of mugs.

greetings: Don't they have something stronger here?
Ask Feng to pour us a few of his specials with extra cowbell.
I stopped drinking this stuff. I like the house wine now.
Say, is it raining out? I was thinking about going for a walk around town and doing some shopping perhaps. I'm looking for some cowbell.
This is so much nicer than that sandhole Dryreach.
Nice crackling fire in the hearth. Good company.
I think I'll stay here for awhile.
After all. All work and no play makes Ulgrim something thirsty.
This town hasn't changed a bit. Good ole' Yanshi with it's weird rock.
By the way, my name is Ulgrim. Yes, the Ulgrim. Pull up a chair and buy me a drink friend.
It's really nice in this bar isn't it? Just look at the attention to decorating Feng made.
quest: Sweet nectar, thy name is sake.
I bet you ten sakes you'll never guess where this came from.
You don't know do you?
I'm not telling you. You owe me ten sakes!
Listen, before you walk away from here you'll be wearin' gold girths.
Never question Ulgrim!
Cock of the walk!
I gotta have more cowbell, baby!
Easy guys, I drink my stout just like the rest of you - one sip at a time. Except, once my mugs empty, I make gold gromnies.
I'm tellin' you fellows, you're gonna want that cowbell.
I'm gonna need more cowbell.
I remember you! I already gave you a Realaidain Raiment. Wear it with pride, my friend!

High Queen Elysa asked me to create a special raiment for all Isparians who have made Dereth their home. The crest up on the raiment is that of Asheron's own family, the Realaidains. Wear this raiment with pride! But please take care of it - I only have the materials to provide one to each adventurer.
I am sorry, friend. I can only provide raiments to those who had already made Dereth their home by Morningthaw, PY 15.

greetings: The fish plops into the water and slowly sinks to the bottom.
The Sluice Gate looks like a good place to release a fish.
quest: The fish splashes happily into the water. It seems a bit stunned, but after a few seconds it swims away.
The fish splashes happily into the water. It seems shaken, but swims away strongly.
The fish splashes happily into the water. It seems fine and swims away quickly.

greetings: Hello! My master in Glenden Wood, Tiffany Comfore, has sent me out into the world to participate in the great Mission - encouraging the young people of Dereth to embrace a life of artistry!
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, a frost infusion - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
The apprentice coughs quietly.
Um, we're not rich yet, though, so I'm afraid I can only reward you once a week.
If you bring me an example of your craftsmanship - say, a lightning infusion - I will reward you with a token of encouragement.
