greetings: The hermit strains to read the handwriting, then returns the note to you.
I wrote this?
Yes, yes it seems I did write this, so very long ago...
The secret...yes, the secret -- I remember something now.
The hermit's eyes grow wide as he looks at the diamond relic.
So you found the golems then?  I trust they did not give you too much trouble -- I see a stout and strong dead-eye when I look into your eyes!
Do not lose this priceless artifact.  You will need to harness the magical, protective power found within it -- eventually.

Ah, but you have so much to do yet.  Let us not delay any longer!  You must venture to the Itheanc Cathedral, in the Veseyan Islands.  The horrible fleshless dead, the blood fiends, have a most precious treasure in their possession -- a bright, silvery ring.
You must find this ring, for it contains a most vital magical element.
The hermit rolls the ring back and forth in his hand slowly, thinking deeply about the past.
A warding ring...
Long ago I took a ring identical to this one from the charred and burning hand of a fiend.  That time seems unreal to me now, beyond my grasp in memory.
I do remember some of the important details, though.  This ring conceals a small glass vial containing blood.  You will need this foul fluid.
There is no way for either of us to remove the vial from the ring, I'm afraid.  But there is one who can -- one who knows of the darker magics.
You must locate the seer that calls the wild jungles of Aphus Lassel her home, and show this ring to her.
She will know what to do, and she will help you.
So you have been to the seer's jungle abode?  You seem to be handling all of this adventure and excitement quite easily.
Hold onto this vial as if your life depended on it.  The blood will be useful...but I am having trouble remembering in what way.
Oh, what an awful smell!  I remember this stench more than ever!  I hope the experience did not make you too ill.
The old hermit thinks hard for a few moments.
I remember...I took the fur somewhere, and it was fashioned into a sturdy piece of rope, or cord if you will.
I am sorry, but I cannot recall how this was accomplished.  You will have to figure out a way to bind or weave this fur.
Ah, you've done it -- I knew you would find a way!
Suddenly a thought bursts into your mind:  "The blood will strengthen the bond."  Had Kleeoh said this?
I remember now!  The braided tusker fur is physically strong, indeed -- however it must be magically strong as well, otherwise it is useless.
The hermit pulls on the ends of the blood-soaked cord, testing it's toughness.

You could not have done better!  This braided cord, soaked in the black blood of the fiends, will serve as a bridge between the two idol guardians.  It will also bind the powerful magic of the idols to your weapon.
Speaking of idols, you will be pleased to know there is only one more relic to obtain.
The diamond relic will provide magical protection, but used alone it is heavy and unbalancing.  You would hardly be able to steady your weapon with only one idol hanging from it!
A similar idol is necessary not only to balance the weight of the first idol, but to balance it's protective powers as well.

It is getting late, so I will not keep you any longer.  You must make your way to Marae Lassel, and retrieve a relic from the Great Elariwood golems that inhabit the wild northern forests of that island.
You will know it when you see it.  An elariwood idol is very similar to a diamond idol in appearance.  Find it and return to me.
The hermit eyes the elariwood idol, hefting the weight of the relic in his hands.
You should be proud of yourself!  These creatures do not part with their treasures easily.  This elariwood idol is the final component of my secret -- and your quest.
You should now have the items necessary to create your own fetish.  Attach the blood-soaked cord to the ancient diamond idol first, then to the great elariwood idol.
You are doing well.  Do you now see why the second idol is needed?
If you were to attach this incomplete fetish to your weapon, it would become so unbalanced and unwieldy you would not be able to aim or fire it!
The great elariwood golems which roam the northern plains of Marae Lassel will provide you with the second and final idol.
quest: Do you intend to linger?  I suppose I could make some cinnamon tea if you'd like to stay a while longer...if only I could remember where I put the cinnamon.
What were we talking about?  Oh that's right, your departure!  Hurry along now and return soon!
I can't remember if you were arriving or leaving -- I am just that old.
When I was your age I had to walk uphill in the snow both ways to get to the Lyceum.  You kids have it easy these days.
If you aren't leaving, at least make yourself useful.  Go stand at the bottom of the tower and put this apple on your head.  I want to try something...
Another fetish?  This one has been bound even shoddier than the last one!
I suppose I can try to fix this one as well...
The hermit struggles with the fetish for a moment, then hands it back to you -- obviously disappointed with himself.
I am sorry, but my hands are far too weak to fix this now.
When my strength returns, I should be able to help you.  But who knows when that will be?
The hermit's eyes grow wide as he begins to speak.
Ah, I do remember now.  I didn't think it would take this long, but no matter - you are here.  If you will but listen to my story, I will reveal a great secret to you.
I once was the greatest and most feared arbalister in all of Dereth.  I once had everything a man could want from this life, and I have enjoyed all that I have experienced over the long years.

But decades of adventure and excitement have caught up finally, I'm afraid.  I find myself unable to see the bull's-eye any longer, thanks to the slow dimming of my sight.  And more often than not I find the string to be too powerful for these feeble hands to draw or load.

However, a ghost of the past still stirs in this old body.  And before death's final arrow tears through the dark night in search of this weary target, I must see to it that my secret becomes known -- it is with you I entrust this knowledge.
The old hermit shifts his position, and begins to talk with a slow and deliberate voice.
I have seen with my own eyes the devastating power of magic; how easily a burning fireball can send the most skilled archer to his demise!
It has long been said:  "The only way to combat magic is with stronger magic."  Before you sits an old man who has come to understand what this truly means.
I obtained certain artifacts and studied about old, forgotten magic.  I devised for myself a way to empower my crossbow with a powerful, arcane device - a fetish, one might call it.

Any missile weapon may be empowered similarly.  Be warned - the magic is strong, and thus irreversible by any process I know of.  I will tell you all I can remember soon enough.  But today I have talked long enough.

Travel now to Aerlinthe Island.  Find the old ones, the ancient diamond behemoths roaming that enchanted, volcanic isle.  Retrieve the ancient diamond relic, and return to me.  I should more clearly see the past when I am again holding a piece of it.
You are truly a hunter worthy of this powerful magic fetish.  I have no doubt that you are excited to head out and t--
The hermit stutters, then begins to laugh loudly.
Aha!  It's a good thing you showed this to me.  You did not properly secure the idols to the cord!
The hermit rebinds the cord to both idols, using a method of tying you have never seen before.
There you are.  It took some effort, but I have fixed it for you.
You have done well.  I am very content in the knowledge that the secret will not die with me now.
One final request:  Tell no one of what you have learned from me!

greetings: Oh, thank you! You're most kind.

Good day! I see that you're an adventurous sort. So am I, my dear friend! I must admit that I have been in better spirits than I am at the moment, but the sight of another adventurer has caused a smile to spread across my face.

You see, I have just finished a jaunt across and all around Dereth. I managed to make the walk in about eighty days. I've only recently settled here in the pleasantly arid air of Candeth Keep. I had a particularly nasty run-in with some foul undead near the southern entrance of the Valley of Death.

While making my way into a valley, I was accosted by these foul looking undead beasts. They gave me such a fright that I lost a collection of rare plates I'd received from Baron Eli von Schreft back on Ispar. They're priceless, and I would certainly be pleased if someone were to bring them back to me. If you find them please bring them here.
Ah, a fine robe - but the style is just too wild for my tastes.  Let's see here, I know I have one of those older patterns lying around somewhere...
Ah! Here you go!
So you'd rather have the newer style?  Can't say I agree with you, but a deal is a deal!
Enjoy!
Hello, my name is Balarazo.  I am a traveling tailor, but I have decided to make my home here in Greenspire.
I noticed there was a stockpile of older Canescent robe patterns laying around here.  If you have a new or old style Canescent robe, I will gladly exchange it for you, free of charge!
This looks to be a very important report. I think that this should be delivered to Captain K'rank. I do not wish to keep such an important report from his hands.
I have been sent by High Queen Elysa to reward those who have assisted Captain K'rank of Linvak Tukal. If you have proof of this assistance give it to me and I will see that you are rewarded.
quest: Alec says, "Hail %tn. I see that you have returned to shatter the morale of the Burun again. Your efforts continue to assist our people in lessening the threat these creatures pose. Here are your rewards."
The key will open whichever chest you choose in that room. Each chest should clearly display what it holds.
Alec says, "That is all that I have to give. Thank you again for your efforts, %tn."

Alec says, "Hail %tn. Again you take the head of the Burun leader, Morgluuk. You are surely a hero to all. As we have already placed the creatures head outside of the city in your honor, this one will be turned into a trophy that you can display with honor, %tn."
%tn has defeated Morgluuk and received a glorious reward for their efforts.
You should also be able to draw your rewards from the High Queen's treasure as well. Here take this key and this gem.
As you know, this key opens whichever chest you choose within that room. You are due just another small token, %tn.
Alec says, "That is all I have to give. You are a hero to us all, %tn."
Filthy creatures these Burun. As promised you are to be rewarded for your efforts.
A brave warrior who has continued our efforts to crush the morale of the Burun and the renegades. You have done well. Here take this and display it proudly.
The High Queen also wishes you to take a small reward from her coffers. Take these.
The key will open whichever chest you choose within the treasure room to which the gem brings you.
Alec exclaims, "%tn, you have killed the Burun leader, Morgluuk! This head is proof of what you have done. All should know your name."

%tn has slain Morgluuk and returned his head to the Aluvian capital of Cragstone. There it is to be placed on a pike as a symbol of victory for the Isparian, Lugian and Tumerok people and a symbol of defeat for the Burun that threaten our way of life. Huzzah, %tn!
You must be rewarded for your efforts.

Alec says, "The portal gem will take you into the High Queen's Vault. There you will find many chests that house treasures and weaponry that has been worked on by the finest smiths in the land. Take your gift and use it well, %tn. You are deserved of much praise in this victory."
Alec says, "That is the final reward I have for you. You have become a hero to all of Dereth, %tn. I shall never forget your name or your deeds."

It appears as though another grave robber has taken the bones that once rested within this sarcophagus.

You reach into the sarcophagus and begin to collect the bones of this woman. There are no adornments to her corpse. There is only a simple mosaic on the inside of the coffin. A sun, a star, a tree and what appears to be a world. The motif repeats along the entirety of the coffin. You get an ill feeling in the back of your mind and feel sick to your stomach. Your thoughts trail to the natural or...
The feeling passes, but the thought lingers in your mind for a long moment.
A sarcophagus. There seems to be nothing special about this.
The book, child. I need the book.
The urn is next, child. Bring me the urn.
Are you a dullard? I told you, the book, the urn and then the corpse. You've brought me the book and the urn. I require the corpse, or you shan't have your precious stone.
I have nothing more to offer you now, child. Your discussion, while engaging, does little to aid me in my study. If there were more for you here I would make you aware. Please, be gone.

In the past, your face has graced my nightmares. I have watched as you drew the life from my body, choosing to throw my efforts to the wind, rather than forgive the misguided way that I traveled. But I see that your heart has not always borne me ill. So I will grant you lenience.

Within this hall are two objects that I require to further my study of these unique people. The first is a book. It will be like many others in appearance. It will be located in the library beyond this hall. Bring that to me first. It will be indecipherable and foreign to your eyes. I will know it at once.

Second, I require a simple urn. It will hold the internal remains of the woman that held sway over the people here. She would have been interred in a very deliberate manner. These organs will have been preserved within this urn. Collect it from the crypt and bring it to me after you have delivered the book and I will grant what Elysa desires of me.
Elysa's clemency... is... appreciated.
Nuhmudira smiles wryly and ushers you toward your tasks.

Child, you come to me and ask a favor for the woman who has banished me from my home? Very well. She wishes to change these words, she wishes to make amends for her terrible slight, but she cannot come herself? What have I done for our people? Are my deeds so dark? Granting housing, providing the guidance and hope for our future... are these so minor that I should be cast aside like a useless r...
Nuhmudira shakes her head.

It matters little. You are here at the behest of Elysa, but you have proven to me before that you have the interest of all Isparians within your heart. I need one small task undertaken before I grant you with what you need.

Within the library of this place is a book. These people were efficient, not opulent. Far less depraved than the Yalain, yet their predilection toward creating magical devices was still tantamount. I have yet to determine the period in which these people held sway on this world, but their language is opening to me very quickly. Bring me the book that I desire. It should be on a table, though if...
Be warned, the Moarsmen guard this place with their lives. The have dug tunnels beneath this chapel and enter freely. Retrieve this book and I shall see you rewarded.
You are doing well, child. There are still two object to be found. The second is the urn I mentioned before. Quickly now. My time is precious.
You are doing well, child. There is still the matter of the urn, then you shall have the precious gift that Elysa so desires.

Yes... I do need this child. But I was specific in my instructions, was I not? The book first. There are precautions that must be taken in an endeavor such as this. Please, collect the book for me. Then hand me the urn.
Another service out of the way and only one before you. The more time you waste with me, the more time your precious Queen needs to wait to have her desire sated. Quickly now, retrieve the corpse.

Perhaps I was not as clear as I should have been. You are to collect me three objects, in order: a book, an urn and then the corpse. This is of no use to me until I have the other two objects in my possession.
Return to me when you have deciphered my words and are prepared to accept the responsibility placed upon your shoulders.
You are helping me to decipher a question for which I have long searched for an answer. It may be the case that not all members of our race are worth saving.
Take this back.

I asked for the book, the urn and then the corpse. Write it down. This will help you to remember what I need and the order in which I need to receive them. Return to me when these instructions have made an impression.
Perhaps there is hope for you yet. You have brought each object to me that I have desired, with little protest. I am a woman of my word.

Find a fair amount of Burun blood and douse the stone. The stone will drink the blood and become a vile poison to the Burun. In essence, it will become a burun slaying device. Affix the resultant stone to a -Noble- weapon and you shall have what Elysa desired.
Now, begone.

As you turn to leave, you remember that Antius had wanted you to ask a question of Nuhmudira. You turn on your heels and call back. "Nuhmudira, did you let Oswald into the castle the night of the assassination attempt on Elysa?"
Oswald was given --
Nuhmudira gives you a stern look, "It would be wise of you to leave my presence now, %s."
What have we here? An errand runner from the High Queen. Sent by that whimpering waste of a man, Antius. I know your face. I know your scorn. After all that I have done for our Race, for our people.
Nuhmudira shakes her head. "You abandon me to death at the hands of that -- Empyrean! My memory is long, %s." She pauses.
Yet you come to me now and ask for help.
Very well, you will receive my assistance, but there is a cost.
Within the halls beyond are three objects that I require. I am not wont to leave my study of this place and have no students here at present to undertake this endeavor. You shall do.

I require a book from the library of this structure. It will appear as grand as the book that Asheron created. These people, while talented, were as degenerate and lavish as Asheron's ilk. To think, they would waste their arts on creating such garish items.
Collect the book and return it to me first.

When that is complete I will need you to collect a small trifle of an object. These people believed in interring their dead in a unique fashion. There is an urn within a crypt here. That urn contains organs that these people thought precious above all else. They belonged to the woman who sat as the head of this chapel and this order. Fetch that urn and return it to me. This will leave only the...

Lastly, this woman was once possessed of great power. She had the ability to sway masses, lead and inspire by her presence alone. Now she lies in a sarcophagus. Dead, bones rotting away while time presses them and their secrets into dust. I require her corpse. Bring this to me last, and I shall see that you receive what Elysa wants.
You... are not familiar to me in any way.
Nuhmudira looks you over. A simple flick of her fingers and you feel a wave of magic wash over your form.

Intriguing... Nonetheless, you come bearing news from Elysa. The very woman who wished me to never to return to -her- kingdom. A kingdom granted by an adoring populace that had known terror for years! A kingdom handed to her by a being unwilling, nay, unable to undertake the task himself because of paralyzing fear. You... are young. Misguided perhaps.

I am Nuhmudira, child. I am the creator of the sanctity that we Isparians are afforded on this world. For that, I am cast out because of baseless accusation and fear. It is a yoke akin to one I have borne since childhood. It is a curse that those with power must learn to bear.
I am not without generosity and compassion. Since Elysa has seen fit to forgive her accusations, I shall see fit to oblige her what she asks. But there is a small price.

Second, I require a simple urn. It will hold the internal remains of the woman that held sway over the people here. She would have been interred in a very deliberate manner. These organs will have been preserved within this urn. Collect it and bring it to me after you have delivered the book and I will grant what Elysa desires of me.

Most impressive, dear child. You have pleased me greatly. Take this, it is a small token. You will need to craft it yourself. It is a pittance to make. You will need a fair amount of Burun blood to complete the process with the gem.

When you have found a large enough sample of burun blood apply it to the stone. The stone will drink the blood and take on the properties that will most harm the Burun. Affix the stone to your weapon or wand, and the magic will flow into the item. We will survive this latest threat, child. Fear not.
Because of your service to me in the past I want to give you a little more. Please, open your mind to me.
Go in peace child. Leave me to my task.

You've done all I have asked and done so without managing a scowl. You have proved that my faith in you was well founded. Leaves sometimes do turn over and show a brighter side, don't you think that is true. Do not answer. For your services, I gift you with this stone.

You will need to obtain a fair amount of Burun blood to enhance this stone. Apply the blood and it will drink the qualities in and become the antithesis. After that is complete apply the stone to one of the -Noble- weapons. It will assume the qualities and become a slayer of Burun.

I think that I shall prove that I mean well to us all, child. I know what has been occurring, the teachings of my former student, Ciandra. I have been watching from afar and here is a gift that I think will aid you. Open your mind to me.
Interesting, how did you come by this? it is a very nice gift. Thank you.

greetings: Lead by Mgrauleshk, a Guruk Gorefiend, the Burun storm the Temple of Izji Qo. The portal gateway in the matron's crypt has become active and the Burun have stormed a receiving chamber containing a sealed portal. Mgrauleshk and his force will break through the wall and activate the portal beacon, bringing the Burun masters to Dereth unless they are stopped within ninety minutes.
quest: His force successful, Mgrauleshk stands before the portal beacon in Izji Qo's temple. He sacrifices the life's blood of one of his force to the beacon and it hums to life. Pungent fumes and the damp swamp air filter into the receiving chamber. Mgrauleshk finds his way to kneel by the side of the first Burun master to cross the vast divide.

greetings: The Burun Kukuur, Reeshan, has found a way to transfer his girth to an undiscovered area of Izji Qo's temple. His presence can be felt within the temple, but his whereabouts are unknown.
A massive wave of magic swells from beneath the surface of the world in the vicinity of Izji Qo's temple. The Burun King, Reeshan, has surfaced once again!
A massive wave of magic pulses out from Ixir Zi's  temple in the Blackmire Swamp. A second Burun King has found his way to Dereth!

A chain of magical explosions seer the desert sands near Fadsahil's shop. Somewhere in the depths of Liazk Itzi's temple another Burun King has forced his way through the portal and arrived on Dereth!
In the depths of Hizk Ri's temple, a great magic is unleashed. Waves of mana pound the surrounding area, as another Burun King has forced his way onto Dereth!
Kivik Lir's temple is briefly surrounded in a corona of magical energy. Deep within the temple another Burun King has crossed the vast divide!

Off the western shore of the Direlands a soft pulse of energy forms. The energy steadily grows until it crashes into the ocean waters and reveals a partially exhumed temple in the sands. An assault of mana pounds the western surf and then becomes silent. Residents at Ayan Baqur are taken aback at the appearance of a spectral being.
What... no... I don't... no.
They eat and eat. They... their screams. Sir Bellas, their screams!
Eleonora. I will return... this message... Eleonora!
Where will they take... Sir Bellas, where...
It burns so much...
It burns!
%n doubles over and weeps uncontrollably.
%n looks around, as though expecting some vile foe to attack him at any second.
My words... my words...
You have no idea... They... No idea...
They come... Soon... They come!
Your queen... Tell your queen...
They eat and eat... You cannot es... You...
They're everywhere! They're everywhere!
Here is 1% of the experience needed for your next level.
Here is 100% of the experience needed for your next level.
Give me a Lead Scarab for 1% of the experience needed for your next level or an Iron Scarab for 100% of the experience needed for your next level.
What am I to do with this?  Pick my teeth?  Bah!
This is indeed armor from one of the Gotrok Leaders.  On behalf of Linvak Tukal, I bless you with this gift.
This is one of the treasures stolen from our vault by the Gotrok!  Thank you for it's return.  In order to show my appreciation, I will forge you a replacement.
This is one of the old artifacts of station within our ranks.  Because of your valor in smiting the thief, you may keep it as as symbol of trust.  But here, let me fix it for you.
This is the pauldron of one of the Gotrok generals!  I have been studying the other soft ones in the area, and have tried to master your armorsmithing ways.
Here is one of my first models.  I hope you like it.
Aha! An example of my earlier work. Allow me to improve it for you.
Greetings, soft one.  I am Ulkas, Master smith of Linvak Tukal.
The Gotrok looted the donjon of Linvak, taking all they could carry.  Many of the items have not true value, but some are quite dangerous in the wrong hands...
My skills have grown over the past few years. If I made an item for you in the past, I would be happy to improve it for you.
My Lord has given me the right to craft items as a reward to those who bring trophies from exceptionally strong Lugians.
Have you met my apprentice?  His name is Krage, and he is a quick study.  If I do not live long enough to see the end of this siege, he will make a good Master Smith.
quest: I am not worthy to possess such an item.  Please, return it to one of the emissaries my people sent to contact you.
I do not want this, Isparian.
This seems to be a miniature relic of my people.  It is of no use to a grown Lugian such as myself.  Perhaps a child, or someone their size would find it of use...

greetings: The %n looks over the crater and makes a mark on his instrument.
The %n adjusts some metal rings on his device.
The %n sights along a line he has drawn in the dirt.
I'm here to Survey this land under the authority of the Arcanum.
I'm surveying this land for the Arcanum. Please move on, I have much to do.
HALT! Who goes there?
quest: Defending the town my Patron!
We are guarding the gates against intruders. Please move on.

greetings: I need you to take this to Captain K'rank in Linvak Tukal. He has been researching several of the odd occurrences that have plagued our peoples in the past year. He may conscript you to help him.
Ahh, an Isparian. We must be quick. If I am seen talking to you then I will surely be killed and all that I have worked for will be lost.

My efforts to uncover the details of the treaty between the Burun and the Renegades has turned up very little as of yet. Though I have managed to garner enough information to provide Captain K'rank with enough to formulate a strike against the Renegades and Burun.

Take this to K'rank. He will give you the greater details of what I have discovered. Be wary however, the details within explain what I have learned about the Burun brothers, more specifically, Morgluuk. Tell him that if he can find someone to assist in raiding the Burun fortress that I will handle the other brother, keeping him away long enough for a group to defeat Morgluuk, smashing the mora...
Go quickly, do not let the renegades see you leave.
The Tumerok and Lugians that have betrayed their brethren shall not breach these walls as long as Gorak breathes.
Of course there are Lugian females, but we do look an awful lot alike.
K'rank is the best soldier we have. He really knows how to take care of his men. Bring this back to him and make sure that the funds reach the smith.
Gorak runs a thick, calloused finger along the edge of the blade.
This will certainly split a few thick skulls.

We've been stationed here to maintain the tenuous peace. We're simply here reinforcing these walls and providing a strong show of support for you and your people. But you and I know, we're warriors. If these Tumeroks ever got organized they could tear these walls down and slaughter all these folk before we could defeat them all. I'm hopeful though that our wayward brothers will find their way b...
I have no need of such reconnaissance. But you would do well to heed the words within it. It appears the Virindi have some plan for you Isparians.

This is not the Forge Essence which I require. Perhaps you should visit my kinsman, Amaroth. He may be found in Holtburg at the moment. But you must not tarry. We shall not remain on your shores for long.
This is not the Forge Essence which I require. Perhaps you should visit my kinsman, Urleg. He may be found in Yaraq at the moment. But you must not tarry. We shall not remain on your shores for long.
quest: You are a young Isparian, aren't you? I fear that you lack the power to aid me in this endeavor.
Isparian, hear my offer.

Working with my citadel brothers, I discovered a way to construct forges which will bestow crafting boons to those that use it. We desire to place these forges within our citadels that we might better equip our warriors with the supplies which are so necessary in combat.

However, we require the assistance of one brave enough to delve the depths of the Virindi Power Forges. The Overseers of those Forges carry a Forge Essence which I need if I am to construct these crafting boons.
If you can venture into one of these pits and retrieve a Forge Essence, I will reward you handsomely. In addition, in my appreciation I will place five crafting forges for all of your people to use.
The Northern Power Forge lies upon the northern shore of the Inner Sea. Be safe, young Isparian, and be quick. My time here is short. I shall leave your lands before the snow recedes.
You are quite the powerful Isparian. Too powerful, I fear, for such a quest as I have to bestow.
Isparian, you have done both our races a great service.
%mn smiles broadly.
If you were not so small, I would invite you to join our citadel as a fellow in arms.
I shall not forget my promise. As a gesture of appreciation, I shall erect a series of crafting forges in the town of Shoushi.

%tn has defeated the Northern Overseer and delivered its Forge Essence to the Lugian Kerrak. In exchange, Kerrak has assembled and activated the crafting forges in the town of Shoushi. Crafters the world over owe a debt of gratitude to the mighty %tn!
The incantations necessary to create these forges are arcane indeed! Please wait a moment, I suddenly feel the need to meditate upon them.
Half a moment, as I contemplate the infinite crafting mysteries of the universe!
Ah! The beauty of my crafting forges! I am so fortunate that such a brave adventurer was able to bring me the forge essence that I required.
Such a lovely day we're having, don't you agree?
Voila! I have finished my meditations. Alright, who's next?
This is your reward by rights, Isparian. I would not deprive you of such a boon, though I thank you for your kindness.

This is not the Forge Essence which I require. Perhaps you should visit my kinsman, Kerrak. He may be found in Shoushi at the moment. But you must not tarry. We shall not remain on your shores for long.

greetings: A symbol of the Shadow -- you may enter.
%s has entered the Forbidden Catacombs.
A symbol of Greed -- you may enter.
I have always wanted one of these.
The Guardian of the Forbidden hugs his beloved new Pack Doll.
A symbol of the Cute -- you may enter.
You shall not enter.
Heed my warning -- Turn back now! This place is not for you.
Begone! Only death dwells within.
The pustule explodes, spraying you with it's rank fluids.
The surface of the Pustule ripples; at the other end of the room, a faint glow appears briefly, then fades away.
The Pustule shudders, then bursts. You have opened a gateway portal!
A section of the floor boils up producing a large glowing pustule.
Virindi-altered Utelari yelps from %s's fatal blow! She collapses on her side, never again to bay at the moons.
Utelari howls cheerfully over the corpse of %s!
Utelari's muzzle drops into a lazy parody of a grin as she spies %s!
Utelari bays for assistance from the pack!
Tuperea whistles for Utelari to heel.
Utelari's eyes flash violet as %s's spell slides off her.
The sarcophagus cracks and it's stone crumbles to the floor. A figure rises from the debris.
With a soft rumble the two sarcophaguses slide away to reveal stairs leading down.
As the Sarcophagus resonates with energy, you hear bones being reconnected.
The wind whispers to you: %s destroyed the first shadow of Black Ferah, but that is no hindrance.  The Enemy is advancing  into the craggy Linvak Mountains, south of the Sho lands.
As the shadow of Black Ferah falls, you hear a cold, contemptuous voice declare: "A fine attempt, %s, but this is but my shadow. I shall move on!"

A whisper floats upon the wind: %s has defeated the shadow of Black Ferah. The Shadow forces press onward, even to the frontier of the lands settled by the Sho. The aspect of Black Ferah will doubtless seek the power within the southern Shadow Spire... Find the portal to that dread construct, where ever it may appear...

As the shadow of Black Ferah falls, you hear a cold, contemptuous voice declare: "Ah, %s, you have but slain my shadow!  I shall press on from this tiny hamlet, but don't think reaching me next time will be easy!  I shall be far above you."

The wind brings terrible news: While the shadow of Black Ferah has been slain by %s in the Direlands, Ler Rhan has renewed his offensive in the A'mun desert!  But a new, cool and quiet undercurrent rides this wind, and it says: Little ones, seek now the Key that leads to the Nexus, and all will be made well!

Black Ferah laughs as she falls.  "I have merely bought some time for Ler Rhan to regroup, my sweet %s. How much longer can you humans continue? Our forces are infinite, and you fools still know not our true objective!"

The wind brings good tidings: %s has found and destroyed the shadow of Black Ferah! Leaderless, the Shadow Armies melt away. All but the mountains are safe once more.  The land is quiet for the moment...
As the shadow of Black Ferah falls, you hear the cold voice say: "A fine attempt, to have reached me within this twisted pathetic creation.  Well done, %s. I see I must reformulate my plans."
I don't have time for such things right now. Bring it to Ler Rhan. I'm sure he can pull some useful information from it.
quest: I see you have chosen to side with Isin Dule. Be gone.
Isin Dule's forces left with their tails between their legs.
Ler Rhan will be pleased, the last phase of the plan is almost ready...
You have been awarded the title of Soul Siphon.
I suggest you leave this place.
Ler Rhan says we need as many people collecting ley line data as we can get.
It is a simple task, so even you shouldn't be able to screw it up.
Some of the previous inept workers left pieces of the Recording Device in several caves around here.
Collect the pieces and assemble the device. Then use that device at the two locations marked by the dark stones.
Return to me with the information you've collected.
We are still working with the data you collected.
I already received the communication. I have no further use for you. Be gone.
You've collected the data?
Let me have a look.
Black Ferah looks over the data quickly.
Very odd, this data conflicts some of our early tests.
Black Ferah eyes you wearily.
Are you sure you conducted the tests correctly?
Never mind, I will send someone else out to reverify the results.
You have been awarded the title of Searching the Shadows.
I have no further need for you. Leave this area and don't confuse that with a suggestion.
You have been awarded the title of Guiding Light.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Soldiers.
Return after you have killed %tqm Soldiers.
You must rid Tou-Tou of Isin Dule's forces.
It is not of your concern what is happening at Tou-Tou. You have one purpose for your sad life and that is to do what you are told.
We have setup forces at the edge of town.
Find the Shadow Captain and provide her with any assistance she needs.
Very nice, this data confirms some of our early tests.
I will pass this data on to Ler Rhan.
You have been awarded the title of In the Dark.
That is nice and all, but I asked you to collect data with the device, not just bring it to me.
I wonder what Ler Rhan sees in you.
So Ler Rhan wants us to hold our attack for now. I have to wonder what he is waiting for, but I trust his lead on this.
I have no further need for you. If you keep up this kind of loyalty then perhaps we can use you in our ranks when the time comes.
You have been awarded the title of Clouded Soul.

greetings: A voice calls out to all upon the wind: Set back by %s, Isin Dule is withdrawing into the dark center of all shadow, even while the shadows spring up all across the world.  Use his key to reach him there, and free all of Dereth at last from the dark armies!

The wind brings great tidings: the shadow of Isin Dule has been destroyed by %s!  The Shadow Generals have spent the last of their power.   The invasion of the shadows has failed.  Dereth is safe...for now.
quest: We are waiting for the shadows to regroup before striking again.
You must wait %tqt to be rewarded again.
I'm busy. Leave before I have the guards help you leave.
If it wasn't for such loyal and dedicated warriors like yourself, more than Tou-Tou may have been destroyed.
I think you have failed me for the last time. You are a fool who has no idea what you are helping to cause.
Be gone from this place. May your decisions haunt you for eternity.
The fact that you would show your face to me after helping the madness that enveloped and destroyed Tou-Tou proves the twisted type of being you are.
We managed to slow down the shadow assault on Tou-Tou. I fear it is not enough and that a much larger action is needed.
The kingdom thanks you for the information you have given us.
We are discussing over our plans to deal with this and will let you know more in the future.
You have done well young one.
We have prevented the chaos from spreading in this land for another day.
Unfortunately, I do not suspect the generals will ever stop their quest.
I ask you to inform Asheron both of what is happening in Tou-Tou and the feat you achieved there. I think the time for action has arrived.
Excellent work soldier. I ask you to inform Asheron both of what is happening in Tou-Tou and the feat you achieved there. I think the time for action has arrived.
If you wish to redeem yourself, go see if you can find out what Ferah is up to and return to me with the information.
I need for you to go back into the Shadow Spire near Tou-Tou and gather one of the purple crystals they seem to be collecting there.
Bring the crystal to Asheron along with this note so he understands the situation.
This information must reach Asheron.
Those souls are better off having not been fully corrupted by the darkness. I only wish we could have acted sooner to prevent this.
You have been awarded the title of Merciful Killer.
Return the device to Ferah with the false information I've implanted in it.
You aid the generals in attempting to bring back Bael'Zharon.
Do you realize the destruction this would cause?
It is a shame that I almost trusted you.
You must bring this message to Ferah before they realize you have slipped the information to us. Hurry!
The shadows do not accept defeat easily.
My scouts have informed me that the shadows have sent out engineers who are collecting pieces of the Attunement Device Ler Rhan used to bring the Void of Bael'zharon to the surface.
If they succeed in retrieving those parts and building the device, we may not be able to defeat him a second time.
Destroy all 4 of the engineers before it is too late.

Something strange has happened to Tou-Tou. It has been blocked off by some sort of energy. I feel this will result in awful things. A dark portal has been spotted at the entrance to the town. Investigate this and return to me with what you discover.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Shadow Vortexes.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Shadow Vortexes.
This may be one of our last chances to hold back the shadow advances on the town of Tou-Tou. Go there and destroy several of the Shadow Vortex which have moved in around the edges of the town.
I do not have time for idle chat, citizen. A shadow spire has appeared near Tou-Tou and we must discover the cause of this incident.
Ahh that data is most interesting indeed, and quite disturbing.
Isin Dule tinkers with the Recording Device.
Return the device to Ferah, but with the false information I've implanted in it.
If we are lucky it will take them a while to figure out the information they have been using is incorrect and will allow us enough time to prepare for their next move.
Ferah asked you to use this device to gather the data?
Gather that data but return to me first.
The ritual has been stopped?
That is good news, although I am sure the generals will not give up so easily.
You have been awarded the title of Hopebringer.
I thank you again for aiding in the prevention of Bael'Zharon's release. The world is a safer place... for now.
Isin Dule examines the message carefully.
Ah, most interesting. This explains the spire that has appeared near Tou-Tou and the beginning of the generals' plans.
Bring this to Ferah so that they do not suspect we have received this information.
The ritual has been stopped? Excellent news.
You got a strange shard flowing with energy from the dungeon? I would like to see that.
I am afraid I must call on your services yet again.
I have received word that another Shadow cave has been discovered near Tou-Tou.
The rumor is that the generals are attempting to bring Bael'Zharon to the surface permanently.
It should go without saying that we must not allow this to happen.
Go to this cave and disrupt the ritual they are using to bring Bael'Zharon out of his prison and to the surface.
I have sent others on this mission as well. Hopefully they will be of assistance to you in completing this mission.
I've heard that Ler Rhan is planning something big which may involve bringing Bael'Zharon back to the surface.
See what information you can find out from him and let me know.
Be careful in there, Ler Rhan may be getting suspicious of all of the willingness to help the Shadows.
You have been awarded the title of Duleing with the Dark.
You have been awarded the title of Hero of the Night.
You have been awarded the title of Conspirator.
You have been awarded the title of Double Agent.
You have been awarded the title of The Tou Tou Terror.
You have been awarded the title of Creature of Chaos.

Yes, I sensed a darkness attack one of the elder trees. Something corrupt gnaws at the roots of the great tree. When I investigated the area I found the guardians. Although their ritual is hidden from my eyes, my research did reveal the following about the magics of those guardians.
The Guardian of Spruce must be invoked at some point after the Guardian of Willow.

I am simply a man of the former town of Daralet who calls himself Isin Dule, who concerns himself most fiercely with an individual's right of choice. I just happen to have compatriots who...agree with me...and former friends who have gone too far.

Both of you can take your Dericostian arrogance and throw it into the void. You regarded those beneath you as chattel and treated them in the worst way possible. It was only a blessing that your empire fell. As for the rest of you...you are no better, Asheron, you meddling child of Yalaini nobility, and I cannot even begin to verbalize the dread I would feel at a Wind-Walker rulership.

Claude says, in concert with the other Virindi, "We consider your statement valueless. Your knowledge is unworthy of inclusion to the Singularity. The Quiddity comprehends all. You will cease existence."

Isin Dule holds the chalice before him and says, "How could I refuse such an invitation? The madness of my old friend must be stopped before it is too late." He hesitantly hands the chalice to Asheron.

There is an item which acts as a channel between this world and the realm of the Living shadow, from which we draw our power. We call it the Heart of Shadow. While the Heart is heavily guarded by Ferah's forces, a skilled group could invade, claim the Heart for their own, and somehow use its connection to Ilser...
Repent? I think not. I merely object to total annihilation, not to power.

A slender woman with gentle features stands above you holding a curved dagger. She mutters in a language that you do not know and plunges the dagger into your heart. A snake-man dresses you in a fine silken robe. Nearby a woman cries, at her feet a small child with golden eyes attempts to stifle the tears which brim at his eyes. You smile, and turn from them and are led toward an altar by the snake-man.

There is the smell of something sweet nearby. The moons are large and high above your head. Four spires the color of sea-foam rise about you, and a chill wind blows. You taste blood, and the heady scent of sage fills your senses. You cough and shower yourself in blood.

A small whispering voice calls to you, "It follows its own whim, now here, now there, now gone, once we held it, but not it is gone. When the wheel turns it shall be here again, but first there shall be gold."

quest: There is the sound of a hammer falling against stone, all around you. It is dark, and the smell of befouled earth fills your nostrils.

Your heads pounds. A stream of mana flows over and through you washing away your flesh and leaving only your bones. You feel closer to magic, though you are weaker of form. The vision ends as does the pain in your skull.

A voice in your mind giggles, "Can you hear the voices? Do you heed their words? Think you master magic, do you master swords? Are you just a keeper or a puppet by a string? Can you hear the voices listen to them sing."

A low hum is heard as a hand extends from the bookcase and places a book into your hand.
A soft voice alights upon your ear, "We watch this age with baited breath. Slowly it slips from the grasp of the race that held this world. Now it is anothers."

A light breeze surrounds you momentarily. You see a city of alabaster, sapphire and gold stretching toward the sky. Skyships the color of the sun traverse the sky. A man wearing a cerulean crown walks toward you and hands you a missive. As you open the document he stretches his hand forward holding a brooch for you.
He knows you are here and he will be prepared. He stole his throne. Take it back for the master.

You are sitting at a table in this very room as a chill shakes you to your soul. You feel breath brush against your neck. You turn but there is no one to be seen. The candles flicker as a breeze fills the room. You gently close your book and call upon fire to form beside you. A minor elemental appears. A small prism within your robes turns to dust.
You stumble as the staircase shifts beneath your feet. You maintain your balance as they slide to the far wall.

As you step over the threshold into the small room you are immediately drawn to the bookcase before you. It is as though it calls your name. As you approach its hands reach toward you and offer knowledge to you.

The trials left you shaken but you were prepared for much worse. You shoulder your weight against your staff and rest a moment, age it seems has the better of you. Your wrinkled skin makes you feel ill, there is still so much to accomplish. You sense the hundreds of eyes within the room and call to them.

A voice says, "He commands the spirits here now, blood given to the Blood."

A poor man has too much of me, a wealthy man needs me not, and if you feast upon me you will die. What am I?
At night they come without being called, but at dawn they are lost without being stolen. What are they?
It never was, is always to be, none have seen it, but many dream of it, it is the hope of all that live that it shall always come. What is it?
It begins eternity, ends time and space, it rests at the start of every end and the end of every place. What is it?
It waits for none and gauges all, it is eaten by leisure and work the same, it is abundant but there never seems to be enough. What is it?
No sound, no voice, no breath, no sleep, no thought, no sight, no more. What is it?
It cannot be slain so long as there is a ray,  it is inspires the heart to wish for the best, yet exercise caution to not lose this gift for then you shall just be forlorn. What is it?
What has no beginning or end, yet binds two together?
I cannot exist when I'm full, and I grow when you empty my contents. What am I?
I can be an old love, but mostly a lost passion. My life grows as you feed me, but when I drink water I die. What am I?
What is it that has one voice but becomes four-footed, two-footed, and three-footed?
I pass through the water and never get wet. What am I?
I whip, and I whistle all the day long, sometimes my voice can sound as a song. I never grow tired but sometimes grow weak, and I change without warning and cause door to creak. What am I?
I've legs, and a foot, and also a head. But I cannot think nor move on my own. What am I?
I am a room without walls, windows or doors. What am I?
I never grow, but can become very wide, and everything falls into darkness when I hide. What am I?
I am void, and absence, I am not a color. What am I?
You will break me if you name me. What am I?
The maker want it not, the buyer does not use it, and the user never sees it. What is it?
The more of me there is the less you see. What am I?

The statue remains motionless, as if waiting a prompt from some outside force.
The Guardian of the Arena speaks into your minds.

"Beyond these walls lie the arenas of Kivik Lir. Within these blood spattered walls, the students of Kivik Lir tested their will against others. Those who were deemed champions were presented a Bloodstone Emblem, symbol of might in combat."
"Those who present a Bloodstone Emblem will be judge worthy and permitted to continue further in the Lady's temple."
"A warning to those who are unworthy, presentation of anything but the Emblem will result in punishment."
"Those who wish to test their mettle against other students should now speak to me once again."
The Guardian of the Arena shudders and grants a boon upon your group. From this point,  you have fifteen minutes to complete the remaining two trials.

As you approach the Guardian, you hear what sounds like Burun on the other side of the wall. Before you can even formulate second thoughts the Guardian pulls you forward into the next area of the temple.
The staue remains motionless, as if waiting a prompt from some outside force.
The Guardian of the Trials speaks into your minds.
"You have done well children. You may proceed further towards our sleeping mistress, Kivik Lir."

"Welcome, young initiates. You have found your way beyond the guardians of the Tomb of Kivik Lir. You have done well to reach this point. By the Watcher, you shall awaken the High Matron. But there are still spirits to defeat and still challenges that you must complete to prove your worthiness."

"Within this very hall lie several such challenges. Each must be completed by you within a set period of time. When you have completed all of the tests, and only then, return to me. If you have succeeded, you shall be granted passage deeper into the halls of Kivik Lir's temple."
"Should you fail... then I shall be forced to rid these halls of your presence. Pray to the Iakvi Liviliakti that you do not fail."
"Your efforts were judged as wanting."
Only those in a union of fellows will be permitted to attempt the tasks in this area.

greetings: The Conveyor of the Arena speaks into your mind.

"If you are victorious and wield the Emblem of Victory, present it to the Guardian of the Arena."

As %s lifts the crown from the dais, a thin wisp of light is pulled forward. A great protector has been disturbed. The only way to open the door leading from this chamber is to defeat the defender. Only then could one use the crown to unseal the way to Qin Xikit's temple.

greetings: Voices sound throughout the hall and a hum of magic fills the area. A section of the ground begins to glow softly and a portal coalesces in that spot.
There is an outline of Qin Xikit's crown in the center of this dais. The fitting is deep set.

quest: Though there is no physical form present, the power that Qin Xikit still wields stays your hand for the moment. Perhaps if you were to wait twenty one days you could return for another draw from her tomb.
It appears as through there is nothing here for you. Your presence here is unwarranted.
You should not have been able to reach this place.
You have no purpose at this place, be gone.
Reason guide your action. The gate is unveiled, pass through and do what you must, I pray by the Sun, Stars, Earth and Moons that your path is noble.

The heat released from the cavernous depths will power the gateway for twenty moments, then the way will close and power will need to be returned. Reason guide your action. The gate is unveiled, pass through and do what you must, I pray by the Sun, Stars, Earth and Moons that your path is noble.

The path is closed. The path is opened by the scalding heat of the world. Four watchers hold vigil over this heat. Delve into the depths of the watchers and end their vigil, loose the heat and return to me. I shall act as arbiter. Should power be drawn from all four fonts, I shall open the path. Be warned, this path leads to the crown of a dark disciple. Be sure of the path before you tread.

greetings: They call me a 'melon-headed buhka,' but that's just because they're jealous of my mask!
Why are you looking at Putiputipuh that way?! PUTIPUTIPUH'S A GOOD GRUBBY!
No, Putiputipuh! Bad Putiputipuh!
Look, she did a trick! Good Putiputipuh! You're such a very smart Putiputi!
I tried giving her onga. She must just like my special onga, the ones I left where I found her.
I was all itchy before, but now I'm better!
We may both be 'puh,' Putiputi, but we still have each other.
Nooooooooooo. Uh uh. No takebacks. You keep it!
quest: Thanks again, buhdi, and enjoy the Panaq!
Did you play with the splashy-pots like I did?
Putiputipuh's all full now. But thanks anyway!
C'mon! Feed Putiputipuh the onga!
Hey! I already gave you a Panaq! You're forgering stuff at me!
Naah. Not this piece! I need Pah!
Hey, you already gave me one of these! Where'd you get another one? Now I need Ahna.
Hey, you already gave me one of these! Is this a cheap Aun knockoff? I need Naq now.
See, Ahna fits into Pah like this--er, something like that. More or less. Um. Now I need Naq!
And then Naq goes into Ahna like, um... This! And here you go! Thanks again for your help!
Not this! Now I need Ahna!
If you find the pieces I left behind, I'll put my old Panaq together for you!
Go feed Putiputipuh!
Did you go to the hidey-hole! I think I left my onga near one of the bubble-pots there! Those onga are the only thing Putiputipuh will eat!
You got the onga! I'll let you feed Putiputipuh all by yourself! It's fun!
It's the Pah! You don't know what do with this? Silly buhka! I'll help you then. Bring me Ahna next.
Oh, my poor Putiputipuh! Nothing else matters!
Not this! First I need Pah!
Oh, my poor Putiputipuh! She is so sad!
Oh, my poor Putiputipuh! It makes me feel so bad!
If only you were mightier, you could help me and my Putiputipuh!
Oh, man! You can help me! My beloved Putiputipuh, she's not happy. She needs special onga from where I found her!
I dropped my stuff in the hidey hole where I found her. It's all the way to the east, straight east from here, right until you hit a BIIIG wall.
I set up a magic portal to the hidey-hole. Here, I'll give you the password.
Thanks for your help!
Aun Imeitanua tells you, "Always good to see you, %s. Any friend of the Aun is welcome to visit me here."

Ah, friend! It takes me quite a while to carve these weapons. While I do have a great deal of free time down here, I'm afraid I won't be able to exchange another weapon for you for at least another month.
Sorry about making you come this far, but we can't be giving away our prized secrets to just ANYONE...besides, if the Hea knew of my whereabouts, they'd kidnap me and my brother in a second.

Here to make your weapon, are you? Well, if you've made it this far, I'm sure you've earned it. Any friend of the Aun, I say...Now, if you've bought a talisman from that miserly old brother of mine, I'll be happy to exchange it for your weapon.
Just a moment...

Now, don't forget--this weapon will only gain its full magical potential once you fuse it with one of our sacred totems. Wield it with our blessings...and remember always that the Aun have extended their friendship to you. I'm afraid that after you leave this place, you will not be able to return to visit me for a month or so--the Hea are ever vigilant, and we must do our best to keep this plac...
