Thank you! I have been waiting for more of these gems. I will see this gets to Nuhmudira. You may be aware that Iolite is said to increase spiritual insight and help in seeing both sides of an issue more clearly.

My fellow student who you obtained this from may also have told you that Chrysoberyl compound is needed.  The portal over there will take you to what we call the Spirit Cell.  Within you should find some Chrysoberyl compound.  Please bring some to me.
Hello. Have you spoken to any of my colleagues in some of the towns?
quest: At present, I have a sufficient quantity of that.

I am happy you have succeeded. Now, I am sure you have been informed as to how important Daichroic crystals are to Numhudira's research. There are several ancient mines in which Daichroic crystals are yet stored. There is a portal on a hill northwest of the town of Holtburg.  From that portal you may begin this final pursuit. You will discover direct portals to the mine at its destination- you...

greetings: Niarltah's voice echoes over the land, "Muldaveus, we must flee. The Isparians have overrun our position. Come Morgluuk and Torgluuk, we will take you to the safety of our hidden fortress. Amanua, Fostok, get in here and clean up this tripe!"
Isparians! Firm the breach and call reinforcements. We can end their lives here and now.
Let the blood of the ancient fuel my anger and drive my weapons straight to your heart.
The spirits of the land forsake you. Make your peace quickly, my wrath will be swift.
This amuses me in many ways. I will use your bones to call the spirits.
%s has struck a mortal blow to Amanua. As the Tumerok War Chief falls to the ground motionless, his armor snaps free.
Your blood will serve as gravy for my pet's meal.
You should have thought of the consequences of this action, Isparian.
Mighty spirits watch over my soul. What hope have you to penetrate their protection?
You must collect three more bundles of Marsh Siraluun Feathers for me to have enough to weave a dress for you.
You must collect two more bundles of Marsh Siraluun Feathers for me to have enough to weave a dress for you.
You are almost there. If you add one more bundle of Marsh Siraluun Feathers to this bag, I will have enough to weave a dress for you.
You must collect three more bundles of Tidal Siraluun Feathers for me to have enough to weave a dress for you.
You must collect two more bundles of Tidal Siraluun Feathers for me to have enough to weave a dress for you.
You are almost there. If you add one more bundle of Tidal Siraluun Feathers to this bag, I will have enough to weave a dress for you.
I am not yet worthy of the honor of crafting this item. Please visit Mareura in Timaru. I am certain he will be happy to help you out. Well, that is unless you have done something to anger him.

I am not yet worthy of the honor of crafting this item. Please visit my father,  Whethura, in Timaru. I am certain he will be happy to help you out. Well, that is unless you have done something to anger him.
You'd rather not collect the feathers for the dress?  No wonder--the Siraluun is a fearsome beast. I don't blame you for being afraid to confront her.
Here you go!
If you happen upon another of these claws and you do not wish for a weapon, I suggest you visit Merlonna Farel in the town of Bluespire. She has an interest in Marsh Siraluun claws as well.
Ah...Siraluun feathers. Wait just a moment, and I will make something special for you.
Aun Arenura mumurs a prayer to the Siraluun.
You must have hunted long and hard to find these! This will be a dress to be worn with great pride.
Aun Arenrua weaves the feathers into a shimmering raiment.
A beautiful garment. How I wish my father could see this!
If you happen upon another of these claws and you do not wish for a weapon, I suggest you visit Ling Xaio in the town of Redspire. He has an interest in Tidal Siraluun claws as well.
If you happen upon another of these claws and you do not wish for a weapon, I suggest you visit Shalon ibn Mayar in the town of Greenspire. He has an interest in Littoral Siraluun claws as well.
Greetings! My father, Aun Whethura in Timaru has tasked me with helping the younger members of the xuta, Ispar. He says that we can both learn much from each other.
My father's fondness for the Siraluun has also rubbed off onto me. Should you find any trophies, such as Siraluun Feathers or Claws, I will gladly take them and reward you with a weapon.
Also, I am learning the art of tailoring as well. If you should bring me this bag...

...full of feathers, I will craft you a gown of feathers. I should warn you though. I am not skilled enough, nor am I worthy of working with the feathers of the more powerful Siraluun. You should bring those feathers to my father in Timaru.

One final note, unlike my father and the others who reside within the walls of Timaru, I bear no grudges to those who may have acted against the Tonk. My father would say that I am foolish for this belief.
The recent rise of arts and crafts on the land of your xuta has inspired my siblings and I to take up the noble practice of the fine arts ourselves. My name is Nireeura, Aun Artisan in Pin and Pitch.
quest: Your pins are a boon to our xuta. We use the pins we make, as well as the ones you and your xuta have supplied to us, for many tasks. However, we only need so many. Extras would sadly be put to waste. Please return to me in a week and I may be able to take more pins off of your hands.
This could hardly be called a pin. Look! The claw this was crafted from was not properly dried, the feathers not properly plucked and the claws not properly cleaned.
As my mother always told me, if something is worth doing, do it right. Obviously you felt that this wasn't worth doing, otherwise the pin would have been sharp, and the grip sturdy.
Your efforts have almost done justice to the majesty this fine bird once represented.

A quality pin will withstand multiple uses. It will be strong enough to hold the hide of a mattekar upon the wall while sharp enough to cut the hide of an armoredillo. Unfortunately, this is not a quality pin.
You are making leaps and bounds in improvement. The spirits must smile upon you.
The Kithless Siraluun has long been hunted and revered. Its ferocity is reflected nicely in the spike of this pin.
You are nearing perfection in your art. I am honored to have been a part in your learning.

This pin is magnificent. The details on the head spiral down the claw to the tip of the pin. Each etched line speaks of the thought and care you put into crafting this item. I am honored to be receiving such a fine piece of workmanship.

greetings: The recent rise of arts and crafts on the land of your xuta has inspired my siblings and I to take up the noble practice of the fine arts ourselves. My name is Ihmenaura, Aun Artisan in Feather and Claw.
quest: We must forever be cautious of the land we live in. Hunt the Siraluun too frequently and their numbers dwindle. The spirits demand that respect be paid to these fowl before further can be accomplished. Several passings of the sun must be made before the spirits will allow me to accept another token from you.

I would think that one with hands as small and nimble as those of your xuta, one would be capable of crafting this brush. And yet, I have seen better workmanship come from the clumsy hands of an Obeloth.

It seems you have much left to learn about the profession of brush making. Look at this brush! The feathers of the Siraluun barely cling to the stock of it. At least you made an attempt, and that alone merits a reward.
Your efforts have almost done justice to the majesty this fine bird once represented.
Practice and skill have always been the corner stones of quality. Your efforts, while still far from being a strong supporting key stone, are building in strength with each attempt you make.

Your attention to detail is surprising! The intricate lines and details on the handle of this brush are marvelous. Unfortunately, the bristles themselves lack in quality, which in turns reduces the beauty of the brush on the whole.

This mighty bird has been transformed into a stunning piece of art. You have learned much to have created something such as this, but do not let my praise swell your pride. You still have much to learn.
You are nearing perfection in your art. I am honored to have been a part in your learning.
Your efforts have culminated in this, a brush so fine and detailed that my skills are put to shame. I humbly thank you for this and I look forward to seeing your future efforts.

greetings: The recent rise of arts and crafts on the land of your xuta has inspired my siblings and I to take up the noble practice of the fine arts ourselves. My name is Kahuiura, Aun Artisan in Arcane Ointment.
quest: As with many of the other crafted goods my siblings accept, I too suffer from a surplus. Please, give us time to use what we have. Perhaps in a week we will have run our stock down low enough and I will be able to accept goods from you.

I am sure your intentions at heart were well meaning, the quality of this product are far from healthy. Were one to apply it to his mane, the mane would likely corrode and recede. Perhaps you Isparians find being bald and burnt attractive, but we of the Aun Xuta certainly do not.
Surely you jest! Are you certain this is crafted from the claw of a siraluun? It smells as if you simply followed behind one, captured its leavings and added some essence of lapyan to mask its color.
This gel is my particular favorite. I find the shade of green it colors my hair to be most agreeable with my personality.

Admittedly it does not take much skill to crush something with a stone and slab. However, it takes a keen eye and sense of touch to know how to mix a gel with the appropriate consistency. This, for example, is a bit too chalky to be of much use. Perhaps the little ones could amuse themselves by flinging it at the Hea on the lower plains.
You are making leaps and bounds in improvement. The spirits must smile upon you.
The spirit of the Siraluun is indeed embodied in this gel. Vibrant and powerful, yet fluid and malleable.
You are nearing perfection in your art. I am honored to have been a part in your learning.

This was made from the claw of one of the most dangerous breeds of Siraluun. Those who can withstand the sting of this gel upon their scalp will be rewarded with great luck. I am honored that you would gift this to me.

greetings: The recent rise of arts and crafts on the land of your xuta has inspired my siblings and I to take up the noble practice of the fine arts ourselves. My name is Pitamaura, Aun Artisan in Spike and Blade.
quest: I encourage your zeal in the fine art of shear crafting. Unfortunately, my siblings cannot dull your blades fast enough. If, in a week's time, you still have scissors you wish to donate to our practice of artistry, please bring them to me and I will happily reward you for them.
An admirable attempt. I recommend you work on sharpening your skills further before thinking you worthy of another reward from me.
These shears are obviously deficient. A golem's hand could cut more than these blades could.
Your efforts have almost done justice to the majesty this fine bird once represented.
Practice and skill have always been the corner stones of quality. Your efforts, while still far from being a strong supporting key stone, are building in strength with each attempt you make.

This is perhaps amongst your finest work. The only issue is the handle of these shears suffers from a lack of creativity and design. But, I suppose they function, and that alone should count for something.

This mighty bird has been transformed into a stunning piece of art. You have learned much to have created something such as this, but do not let my praise swell your pride. You still have much to learn.
You are nearing perfection in your art. I am honored to have been a part in your learning.
Your efforts have culminated in this, shears so fine and detailed that my skills are put to shame. I humbly thank you for this and I look forward to seeing your future efforts.

greetings: The Assailer grunts, Soon... Tusker King... Bobo come!
The force of your killing blow breaks Assailer's tusk!
Mowen Smash!
Mowen Crush!
Mowen Beat!
Mowen Kill!
Mowen beat fleshy beast into tiny pulp that squirt between his fingers.
I should be walking around and stuff.
Who da Tusker? Who da Tusker?!
The Dericost lord's body collapses into rot and dust, but a voice in your mind sneers, "Pathetic little wretch! I shall rise again soon enough."

The Dericost lord's body collapses into rot and dust, but a voice in your mind sneers, "I should like to see you test your mettle against my Lady, barbarian dog! She is a far more powerful magician than I."

The Dericost lord's body collapses into rot and dust, but a voice in your mind sneers, "I trust my defeat makes you feel slightly more in control of your destiny ... less like a dog at the end of Asheron's leash? Get you from my halls before I rise again!"
A voice in your mind sneers, "Faugh! Pathetic."
A voice in your mind sneers, "It is difficult to imagine that the Great Ones would waste skin on such as you, %s."
A voice in your mind sneers, "You would not have lasted a halfbreath against my Lady, barbarian!"
A voice in your mind sneers, "Do not return here again, %s. The boy's spinning rocks would not protect you if I released my full power."
Lord Rytheran stamps his foot contemptuously on %s's corpse.
Lord Rytheran gleefully spits on %s's corpse.
A voice in your mind sneers, "I believe I have, as you barbarians are wont to say, 'owned' you."
A voice in your mind sneers, "Don't you people have anything better to do than bother me?"
A voice in your mind sneers, "Oh, now what do YOU want, %s?"
Lord Rytheran turns to fix his steely gaze upon %s!
Lord Rytheran notices %s entering his sanctum, and rolls his rotting eyes in exasperation.
A voice in your mind sneers, "Oh for the throne and all that comes with it... Guards!
A voice in your mind sneers, "You bore me, and I have a letter to complete. Shoo, pest."
A voice in your mind sneers, "Your powers are weak, dog!"
A voice in your mind sneers, "The thought of a primitive like you besting me through Art is laughable! Show me your sword, that I may enjoy this battle!"
Lord Rytheran blinks in surprise, then begins to chuckle at %s's inept spellcasting!
Lord Rytheran resists %s's feeble spell. He shakes his head, muttering something about "the mages these days" under his foul breath.
I do not want this any more. The memories are too foul and terrible. Better that I forget. Bring it to your masters, who would surely find it illuminating.
As Rytheran's battered bones collapse under the force of your assault, the undead lord's skeletal face seems to break into a bitter grin.
Fool! Are you truly willing to risk my eternal enmity, and the wrath of the formidable legions that serve me? Even if my memories fail me, the Web will remember...
Ah, a keepsake from my lady love... At last, a memory that will bring me some warmth in this eternal darkness. Take this mnemosyne, and my mask of office... And go. Leave me to my memories.
quest: You have the mnemosyne your masters seek. Be off with you and bring it back to them. I find I take little pleasure in the stink of your sweat or the sound of your beating heart.

Ah, you seek my mnemosyne, do you not? My memories of that long-ago day when I read from the book... Your masters desire it so that they may meddle in this affair and save their fragile settlements from the depredation of the Blight. Well enough. I will give you the mnemosyne you seek if you do something for me...

In the ancient garden below, my followers have gone mad, forgotten themselves and their allegiance to me. Regrettably, they had something that is dear to me in their possession when they lost their minds. A ring of some... sentimental value. Find that ring, and bring it to me. I will give you the mnemosyne you seek when you bring me the ring. You will have to kill me to get the mnemosyne otherw...

greetings: ...cold...
...help...can't...stop...
...Frisirth controls...me...
...make it...stop...
...mercy...please...
...kill me...
...so cold...
Insignificant mortal! Soon you shall know your own demise!
Flee from this fate and into the arms of my awaiting minions...
I give you new life, mortal!
Your kind has disturbed us for the last time!
Another fool has come in search of fate, my brothers.
The voice in your mind purrs, "You are generous, not to mention strong. Yet honor requires I return the excess."

The voice in your mind purrs, "Seek the dark ones and destroy them...yet meddle not with the devices you may find on our island of Aerlinthe. Perilous they are to those who do not understand their art."

The voice in your mind purrs, "Ai, this will serve. Seek the dark ones and destroy them...yet meddle not with the devices you may find on our island of Aerlinthe. Perilous they are to those who do not understand their art."
The voice in your mind laughs, "You think I cannot read or count, child? This is not enough to satisfy my needs!"
The voice in you mind laughs, "Ah, poor barbarian child. I said 50,000 pyreal, not 5,000! Your education is slack, I think."

Garaena shakes her head, flakes of desiccated skin flying off her high cheekbones. "Ah, child. You are either far too poor or far too foolish to take this road. It would be better for you to return to Ifistra. Ah, that is Osteth in your tongue."

The rotting woman inclines her head stiffly, and a disembodied voice seeps across your mind like oil. "Child, you walk among the tombs of the Sand Kings. Long ago they were mighty captains in service to the powers behind the Ice Throne. Now they rest, and dream of new plots. Yet still they hold themselves great power, and are ageless and fey."

"My mistress sent me hither to solicit their aid in a great cause. Perhaps you could serve, for I shall call the enemy of mine enemy friend. Those in shadow...thralls of the one called Slayer of Hope...beset our isle. If you give me a note worth 50,000 of the Yalaini pyreal, to fund my mission to bribe the Sand Kings, I shall open the gate for you.
"Be warned; only the mightiest may pass through this gate, and I will not allow you to tie to it."

The voice in your mind sneers, "You give me more than I ask. I am not a moneychanger, insolent whelp! I shall open the path to my home, the ancient port of Aerlinthe, and keep the excess! You would be wise to tread lightly, lest you wake the ire of my island and my Lady."

The voice in your mind sneers, "You are wise to offer me such a boon, lest I strike ye down like a cur in the street. I shall open the path to my home, the ancient port of Aerlinthe. You would be wise to tread lightly, lest you wake the ire of my island and my Lady."
Faladha stares at you coldly. The voice in your mind sneers, "This is insufficient, dog! Do you seek to incur my wrath? My patience with you wears perilously thin."
The voice in your mind cries, "You mock me!"

The dead man turns and looks down the rotted remains of his nose at you. A cool, aristocratic presence invades your mind, and seems to speak in Roulean. "You are foolish to come here, outlander. This is the castle called Chalicmere, fortress of the Latzimestal faction..."

"Ah, but such subtleties are beyond you. To your barbarian eye, we are merely corpses and bones, all alike and monstrous. Yet it is not so, and these rotting forms you revile shaped the destinies of men and kingdoms far beyond your ken.

"Obstruct me not, whelp. I have urgent traffic with the Lords of the Latzimestal... unless you will give me a note worth 10,000 pyreal. Then I shall grant you all the adventure you desire, if you be mighty enough to use my passage. Yet I shall not suffer barbarians in my home, and will prevent you from conjuring the gate yourself."

The cold, luminous eyesockets of the Lady of Aerlinthe regard you balefully. "Fools!" she hisses. "You will destroy us all! If you must have the key, protect that which we do!" So saying, the light in her rotted skull dies, and her spirit wafts back to the north to gather its strength.
We shall begin with the Exchange of Lineage honors. I am Aerfalle, Lady of Aerlinthe and the Dericost. I have walked this world for over ten millennia, and I shall walk it long hence.
A wind blows through the chamber, and the scattering of bones that was once Lord Rytheran of Menilesh vanishes. Another presence appears in the center of the room...
My poor Rytheran, what have you done to yourself? What perils were unleashed by your dabbling with that accursed book? I am here now, and I will not let these mortal vermin sully your remains...

On far Aerlinthe Island, an intrepid band has found the lair of the Dark Lady Aerfalle, at whose whim the earth itself does shake. But the bold %s has driven her back into her hidden crypts, and the ground stills... until she next awakens.

The withered corpse of Aerfalle hisses in rage as it is hewn in twain... "I shall not be sent to a final rest by primitives like thee, %s!" her severed head says from the stones. "Enjoy this insignificant victory, child. For I have walked this world for over ten millennia, and I shall walk it long hence your little race has returned to the dust that birthed thee!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Did that hurt thee, %s?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Perhaps I play too roughly with you fragile outlanders..."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "I call thee forth, bound servants of another! Let us see thy power against these small interlopers!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "I am one of the primogen of Dericost. I am not like mine countrymen you have fought. If you strike me down, I shall rise again!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "I shall not be defeated!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Is that the best you can do, my poor child?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Tell your little gods who sent you to them, %s!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "That head will make a fine trophy. Which of you will next decorate my keep?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Vermin!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Don't you have anything better to do than bother me?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Disturb not your betters, child!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Guards! To me!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "A little help here, please."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Gentlemen, could I trouble you to perform thy task?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Bah. There are Dark Spawn and Walkers yet in the world. You are not worthy of my attention."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Guards! Clean up the mess in here. I have more important things to attend to."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "A skillful attack, %s."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Impressive, child. Your people do sometimes surprise me."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Your so-called magics are no match for those of old Dericost!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Your spellcraft is feeble, %s! Are you sure your calling is that of a mage?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Is that the extent of thy powers, child? I shall show thee true power!"
quest: Now that we are introduced, it is traditional to begin the Exchange of Insults. I shall begin, and say, Lord Haranue, that the Latzimestal approach towards rulership has truly brought ruin to all you hold dear.
Lord Asheron, will you retort?
So be it. We next traditionally begin the Exchange of Cups. Lord Haranue?
Stop this! We are here to discuss the defeat of Bael'Zharon, not to begin a war amongst ourselves.
Enough of this. Walkers, do you have anything to contribute to this discussion?

Claude says, in concert with the other Virindi, "We find the entity classified as Bael'Zharon to exceed limits on discordance. Tapping a fragment of the Singularity may reduce the entity's power by serving as a conduit to all. The entity may be susceptible to the solidification of all that the Singularity represents."
I see - and will you grant us a fragment of the Singularity to use?
All three Virindi emphatically answer, "No."
You seem...enthusiastically reluctant to help.
Claude and the other Virindi reply, "We are prepared for a reduction in discordance either through the entity's defeat or through your defeat."
If I took you more seriously, I might feel threatened. Lord Haranue, why don't you reveal to our guests what we have to share?

Ilservian Palacost suffers from overly attaching himself to things of this world - notably, to the fate of his departed son. His rage swelled forth when his son died, and when Ilservian became Bael'Zharon, the magic that flowed through his veins flowed into the remains of his child. The skull, then, is bound to the father and is a weakness we can exploit.

greetings: The undead spymaster croaks, "No! I am yet needed!"
The undead spymaster croaks, "Your incaution will ruin us all!"
The undead general staggers and falls to his knees. "So it goes," he murmurs sadly. "I commend myself into thy arms, Isishaa..."

The undead general staggers and falls to his knees, but pauses and looks up into %s's eyes. "Don't let it end like this, young one. If you must send me to the wind, my task is yours to complete. Protect the stone."
As the undead falls, its rotting flesh ripples and sloughs away, revealing the ebon form of a Shadow! "We slew the third deadflesh commander," it cackles. "What was his is ours now!"
As the undead falls, its rotting flesh ripples and sloughs away, revealing the ebon form of a Shadow! "Ler Rhan's chosen," it whispers to itself. "They shall keep it on Savao."
As the undead falls, its rotting flesh ripples and sloughs away, revealing the ebon form of a Shadow! "The dusty fool knows naught," it chuckles softly. "They cannot bar the way."

As the undead falls, its rotting flesh ripples and sloughs away, revealing the ebon form of a Shadow! "Your little victory matters not," it cackles. "We already altered the path so none may follow but our own!"

As it collapses into a mass of bone and rot, the ancient mage mutters, "Faugh! Human, ever do your people play the pawns. First you unwittingly served the Hopeslayer, and then you banished him at the direction of others..."

As it collapses into a mass of bone and rot, the ancient mage mutters, "Your triumph against the Hopeslayer will be laughably short-lived. Do not grow too comfortable in this world, as it will soon be reclaimed by its true masters. His Eternal Splendor still broods in his citadel!"

As it collapses into a mass of bone and rot, the ancient mage mutters, "Your triumph against the Hopeslayer will be laughably short-lived. Do not grow too comfortable in this world, as it will soon be reclaimed by its true masters. The Steward merely bides her time in Chalicmere!"
As the undead archer falls to the floor of its Skytower, it groans the name of Aerfalle.
As the undead archer falls to the floor of its Skytower, it calls in Roulean, "Excellent shot!"
As the undead archer falls to the floor of its Skytower, a voice in your mind screams, "They are breaking through our perimeter! Notify Lord Anadil!"
As the undead archer falls to the floor of its Skytower, it groans the name of Anadil.
As the undead archer falls to the floor of its Skytower, it groans the name of Asmolum.
As the ancient creature collapses into viscera and rot, it groans the name of Avoren.
Magic swirls around the acolyte, forming a portal to the next area.
A Lesser Acolyte has been summoned nearby.
As the ancient creature collapses into viscera and rot, it groans the name of Rytheran.
As the ancient creature collapses into viscera and rot, it groans the name of Aerfalle.
As the ancient creature collapses into viscera and rot, it groans the name of Anadil.
As the ancient creature collapses into viscera and rot, it groans the name of Asmolum.
You hear soft chanting in the distance, in some odd language.
My death at the hands of that which I have never seen, shall not go unknown. I am a Warrior of the Blood and shall return to serve, this new master again.
Bound as I am, I cannot syphon your strength and make it my own. Odd though, that I sense you are not dead, nor undead.
The Blood protects those that dedicate their souls to it.
What care have I for a note that I discarded? You are being meddlesome. Be gone at once. Your presence here will only serve as a distraction from the Winds that strive to protect Killiakta.
Why must you interfere? Your race is such an insignificant speck upon this world, and yet you feel as though you must place your fingers where they do not belong. I have no need of that memento.
Another note dropped because of irrelevance. Do you think it is necessary for me to maintain my faculties? I may not be one of the Primogenitors, but my mind is still whole.
Cease your interference here. Each moment that you distract me from my purpose is another moment that we risk her return.

I do not remember ridding myself of this order. It is inconsequential. It has no bearing on my task...which you have turned my attention from. Meddling outlanders! A pox upon your people, the Ice Throne will rise again, and you shall be swept aside!
Ae...? Outlanders, for what purpose have you come to this place? Speak not. I care not. You are the cause of much suffering upon my ilk. I desire no discourse with those such as you.
Leave us to our task, and allow us to shore these tunnels. Continue your efforts to supply the mechanic with the devices we require, that is the only assistance that we require from you, Outlanders.

Be gone from this place. Your meddling here will only serve to remove the impetus of my workers, and cause a delay in the reshaping of these tunnels. Be gone, lest you wish to unleash the horde back upon your populace and bring an end to Killiakta.
The door Hezhit was guarding slides open as he is defeated.
The door Zixki was guarding slides open as he is defeated.
The loom cranks noisily and weaves the silk thread from the spool into a fine white cloth.
You feed the infected assailer fur into the loom, hoping it does not break the machine.
The loom produces a thick, braided cord of tusker fur.
The loom cranks noisily, but without any thread it fails to make anything.
The wheel spins the silk into a fine thread, which winds onto a spool.
The wheel spins to life, but without any material to spin it slows and stops.
You shift the spyglass and it spins around, changing the numbers displayed on the wheel mechanisms.
You spin the spyglass around. It comes to rest in roughly the same position it started in, you think.
The spyglass spins around and around. That was fun.
Ah, yes, this is obviously some sort of magical device. You press the little button near the base of the instrument.
With the locking mechanism released the spyglass spins freely.
You look through the spyglass and see the tumerok shamman drumming in front of a tree. Numbers seem to float by him and...
Ooops.

quest: You can find nothing else of interest in the pack.
You receive a paper-cut while shuffling through the pack.
You rummage through the papers again. Amazing, you never realized that the Renegades were so organized.
You find a little green lump of putty and drop it in disgust.
Wait, you think you feel the point of a powerful weapon!
No, just a quill.
You find a small scrap of folded paper. It reads: I don't trust Maloth, he would trade his own mother for a chance at advancement. Please, reconsider his promotion.
You reach into the pack and rummage through the papers.
You find an important looking letter and worn book.
You look through the pockets of the pack, but it appears as though there is nothing of value left in it.
You look over the tattered pack. Anything of interest within it seems to have been taken by someone or something.
On the front of the pack you notice the emblem of the Strathelar Royal Guard pinned to the front pouch.

greetings: Thank you, I find this most pleasant. Run along, now.
You know... two of the little flesh things managed to escape to the southeast...
I'm not entirely convinced the Director and the Observer are communicating properly...
A pity the Dark Walker has been banished. He was most entertaining to watch.
Just between you, me, and the bottle, human, the theft of the Fragment of Singularity has made some beings angry.
Just don't tell the Observer that I'm drinking this human filth, okay?
I saw a human with a sword attack an Executor the other day. The human never stood a chance. Rip, rip, rip, another inert human.
I find that I have acquired a taste for the wine sold by the Barkeep. Would you bring me a glass? Good human.
"The Virindi's cloak almost implodes inward as it shrieks in your mind, "But the experiment was going so well!  We were so close to breaking past the Singularity's structuralism..."
Flesh puppet!  You are not one of my Black Claw servants!
Very well, I will make a portal for you to enter the Director's private chambers.  But be warned!  The Director does not take kindly to frivolous interruptions!
Another flesh petitioner!  The Director is very busy, altered one.  Are you not aware of all of the additional work he has had to do since our experiment in the human desert town went awry?
If you do not have one of the Quiddity Orbs as your token to enter, I must insist that you turn around and join your squealing fellows.

The Virindi's mask is backlit with a deep purple light!  The dying Virindi shares its thoughts with you before it collapses.  "The Quiddity brings only death for your kind.  You will be flayed as your meat body burns over the inner fires of their purity.  Your destiny was not always so, but you have unknowingly condemned yourself, and this world..."

A shrieking sound pulses from the core of the falling Virindi as it collapses into its center, and it whispers in your mind, "We shall be set upon you, flesh puppet, as retribution for your role in the corruption of the Directors..."

A shrieking sound pulses from the core of the falling Virindi as it collapses into its center, and it whispers in your mind, "You may destroy this construct, human, but there is still strength in our Unity.  You and yours have not triumphed, will not triumph."

A shrieking sound pulses from the core of the falling Virindi as it collapses into its center, and it whispers in your mind, "We anticipate the day, human, when we can devote all of our time and attention to making your kind more suitable to the new order..."

A shrieking sound pulses from the core of the falling Virindi as it collapses into its center, and it whispers in your mind, "When the renegades have been brought back to heel, human, your kind, the source of their corruption, will feel the wrath of our unified might..."

As you deal the fatal blow to the Virindi Inquisitor, its luridly colored form collapses silently to the ground.  Behind the black mask, just for a moment, a swirling mass appears, then blinks out of existence.  A dissonant alien voice whispers, "Vulgar flesh puppet!  The Quiddity should not have decided to spare your kind!"

As you deal the fatal blow to the Virindi Inquisitor, its luridly colored form collapses silently to the ground.  Behind the black mask, just for a moment, a swirling mass appears, then blinks out of existence.  A dissonant alien voice whispers, "A pity it is, human, that Levistras was unable to eradicate your kind.  You are more fortunate than you deserve!"
Your life cycle is a crude imitation of our own link to the Quiddity, human.  Still, hopefully this experience shall teach you to know your place.
Is that what you call magic, flesh puppet?  Your dependence on flesh makes your efforts pathetic!
A flash of violet backlights the Virindi's mask, and in your mind, a hollow voice intones, "So this is my reward for following the Directive.  Aerbax was right..."

The Virindi's mask is backlit with a deep purple light!  The dying Virindi shares its thoughts with you before it collapses.  "The new directive granted you surcease while they continued with their plans, and this is how you repay us?!?  Know this, meat puppet, there will be a reckoning..."
Here is the item you seek.  Use it on our enemies.
Odd... you are not as the master described.  Your epidermis is fair and supple.
You are made of flesh, and are therefore the one whom I seek.  Grant me the ore delivered by the Quiddity, and I will make what you desire.

As the Virindi dies, it screams in the minds of all nearby, "Failure, disjunction, unacceptable.  The invasion must hold.  We will send lesser forces ahead to permit us to refortify our position..."  A new vanguard force is sent ahead to imperil Cragstone...

As the Virindi dies, it screams in the minds of all nearby, "Failure, disjunction, unacceptable.  The invasion must hold.  We will send lesser forces ahead to permit us to refortify our position..."  A new vanguard force is sent ahead to imperil Hebian-To...

As the Virindi dies, it screams in the minds of all nearby, "Failure, disjunction, unacceptable.  The invasion must hold.  We will send lesser forces ahead to permit us to refortify our position..."  A new vanguard force is sent ahead to imperil Zaikhal...
As the Virindi dies, it screams in the minds of all nearby, "Critical loss!  Puppet fails to hold its position!"  The forces gathered to assault Cragstone are pushed back even further...
As the Virindi dies, it screams in the minds of all nearby, "Critical loss!  Puppet fails to hold its position!"  The forces gathered to assault Hebian-To are pushed back even further...
As the Virindi dies, it screams in the minds of all nearby, "Critical loss!  Puppet fails to hold its position!"  The forces gathered to assault Zaikhal are pushed back even further...
I was with the renegades... no use trying to hide that... but I disagree with some of the things they are doing...
If we cannot think of anything quieter and tidier than that... We are not any better than these humans...
Oh, we're not united any more than you are.
What human foolishness is this?  I gave you this chisel, human!  Take it!  It is for your use, that you may attempt to save your own kind!
What fools these humans be...
This is not what I need.  This needs to be coiled with a sliver of Chorizite and then with Obsidian.
This is not what I need.  This needs to be coiled with a sliver of Pyreal and then with Obsidian.
This is not what I need.  Combine it with a coil of the Chorizite and Pyreal slivers.
This is not quite complete.  You must coil this with the sliver of Obsidian from the repository in the Obsidian Plains.

This is what is required... I will make you the portal to enter the Seat of the New Singularity.  Seek out Levistras and put an end to the renegade faction's disastrous plan.  Levistras is vulnerable, because in his ambition he has severed his connection to the home Singularity, before the completion of the New Singularity!
My agents have summoned a return portal within if you wish to return to this town. Now, stand back, lest you interfere with my casting...
Strike now, human!

Greetings, human.  Call me Ecorto.  I have disjoined myself from those who plan your eradication because I disagree with their methods.  Their plan to construct a New Singularity in this realm is madness.  Even now they gather and imbue material to construct their monstrous dream.  Find the repositories of the New Singularity in the desert, the southern mountains and the Obsidian Plains, human.
Take this chisel, scrape slivers from the pillars they assemble, and bring the joined elements back to me... Be careful, however.  The Singular material is quite strong, and could break the chisel.
No!  The New Singularity was so close to completion!  This is not an acceptable outcome!

%s has struck down Levistras, the Speaker of the New Directive!  All across Dereth, Virindi recoil as the leader of their movement falls, severed from the Singularity.  The other members of the Virindi inner circle go into hiding...
You have come to stop the construction of the New Singularity, human?  Come and meet oblivion...
Your kind slew Levistras, meatling, but we will continue to build our New Singularity, against all resistance!

Taken off the corpse of a Virindi Master, no doubt. These masks are used as a way for the Virindi to hide their true forms, which are...well...um, Okay I've never seen one, but I hear that they have tentacles. The masks, Virindi believe, are a passable human face. Can you believe they think themselves intelligent.

A completed version of the mask. You can see that the eyes are open almost as wide as someone would open their eyes under normal circumstances. There is no nose, but the mouth is turned up at the ends to display an unnerving smile etched forever. These masks are worn by Master's, assisting them in evading melee attacks.

Wow. I...um...yeah. So this is from an inquisitor. They came here a while back as a way to enforce the singularity back onto the renegades that put their loyalty behind Levistras and the estranged Ecorto.

You're a tough one. These masks are worn by the imposing and frightening Inquistors. They were sent to Dereth in an effort to quell the resistance of the renegade virindi that stood with Ecorto and Levistras. They remain here now to enforce the will of the singularity over the loyalist virindi that are still here on Dereth. Cunning, violent, powerful magicians and warriors, Inquisitors are the...
While Martine has yet to decipher, or impart just what these keys are truly for, he has speculated that in the singularity they have some function to signify rank or some such...
Okay, I made that up. I really don't know much about them other than they unlock Directive chests which are a direct conduit into the singularity, or something.
Okay, I made that up. I really don't know much about them other than they unlock Master chests which are a direct conduit into the singularity, or something.

Okay, I made that up. I really don't know much about them other than they unlock Singularity chests which are a direct conduit into the singularity, or something. I do know that they are worth a great fortune. As typically the best items can be found in the chests.

Now before you go handing me any of the weapons that these things can make just listen. During the battle against Levistras and the Virindi that were trying to create the New Singularity these ingots started popping up on raiding parties across Dereth.

Martine made it a point to find as many of these as he could. He told us that they were created as a weapon for the Tumerok's that had given their souls over to the Virindi, I think that you know them now as the Hea.

At any rate, the Virindi that carried these were supposed to be meeting their Tumerok allies and somehow were "thrown off course" in portal space and ended up in the middle of hordes of people. Fortunate for us, not so fortunate for them.

There has been much speculation amongst many here as to whether Martine had anything to do with it, but I have heard that Aerbax himself may have had a hand in the betrayal, but who knows? That is the real question.

Only the most powerful members of the Singularity carry these. As to what their real purpose is, I'm not sure. But it has something to do with their bodies and their rank, and how they are able to stay whole on Dereth.
Members of the Singularity carry these. As to what their real purpose is, I'm not sure. But it has something to do with their bodies and their rank, and how they are able to stay whole on Dereth.

Crafted from pieces of chorizite, pyreal and obsidian these pieces of solidified magic would have been crafted into an object that would have brought the Singularity to Dereth. How this would have been achieved will always remain a mystery, as the renegade faction was thwarted, thankfully.

Martine was actually sad when this occurred. He was looking forward to ripping his torturers apart. Ecorto, a Virindi once aligned with the renegades, turned against his cohorts and collected fragments to destroy them and the hopes of creating the new singularity.
When Bael'zharon, walked on the world this object was found in the chakron flux, and without it the new prison for the Hopeslayer would never have been built.

This is a trophy mask, wearable of course. It was taken from an obsidian director. The leaders of the renegade faction that defended the obsidian. They were and still are a powerful breed. The cunning, intelligence and advanced understanding of the Virindi combined with the avarice of mankind. Wear this with pride.
Aren't they cute? I love them.
What?
You want it back?
But you gave it to me...
Just kidding. Here you go.
Communication devices, though how anyone can decipher this is beyond me. I have heard that Diyas-al Yat knows how to figure these out.

Communication devices...nothing more. Somehow the Virindi etch their thoughts onto these shards and can absorb the information that is written upon them. Diyas-al Yat can help you with these, but I certainly can't.
Hello! You are a human, I can tell by your canter. Yes I am Virindi, but I am loyal to Martine, what my fellows did. Horrible.
%n snickers.
Okay, it's really one of Martine's tricks. A cunning disguise, No?
I'm a scholar. Martine asked me to tell anyone that kills the darned things what their leavings mean. I don't translate though. Can't read a book for nothing.
Hello Fellow human, might I interest you in some insight into we who live beyond the world?
If you would hand over any objects of Virindi nature I will divine the truth behind them.
Here is the item you seek.  Use it on our enemies.

"My coin will not fulfill the ache of wretched greed. My curse on those who take my coin and mistake that ache with need."
The snake wraps itself around your fingers, preventing you from dropping the coin.

The snake releases its grip on your fingers as you slip the coin back into your backpack.
"Do not forget that you are bound to this coin as much as I am."

Walk a careful path in these lands, gentle friend. Steer clear of MacDugal's crew of ruffians at the Bandit Castle. And try not to get on the bad side of the Mite Queen. She's civilized, for a mite, but I don't entirely trust her ...
My thanks. We rarely get into town for supplies these days. And with the Mite Maze so close to the east ... well, I suppose it does make sense to trade there. But sometimes I feel ... watched.
I hope that soothes your ills.
Welcome! Welcome to our little outpost! What's your pleasure on this fine day? Perhaps some lockpicks, aye? Finest in the land, so they are! The mites love them! All jingly and glittery ...

You keep yourself safe out there. If you go east to the Eotensfang portal, stay away from Bandit Castle! Since MacDugal's mob returned, it's been nothing but trouble between them and Tallial of Neydisa. And don't bother the mites none, either. They don't bother us; we don't bother them.

Sometimes I miss the wandering life -- the open road, the freedom to come and go as I please -- but Denterra is worth it! And anyway, business is actually pretty good here since I started dealing with the Mite Queen.
Remember, that comes with a guarantee - if it breaks, I guarantee I'll be here to sell you another! Heh. That's a joke, friend. Feel free to laugh. The Mite Queen loves my jokes!
Welcome!  I have just the thing for marvelous kimchi.
May the Elders be with you.
I am your most convenient source of ground cinnamon!
Have a fine day.
A very good purchase, indeed.
My spices are fresh and always in stock.  But I will not buy spices, as I have my own secret sources.
Come again!
Thank you for your purchase.  Your cooking will be superb.
What can I help you with today, sir?
A good day to you, sir.
An excellent find, sir!
I am most gracious, sir.
Welcome to Xanadu.
Is that all? I suppose somepeople are just easy to please...
I like it here, it's comfortable, so I stay.
A fair exchange.
Thank you.
Welcome to Xanadu.
Is that all? I suppose somepeople are just easy to please...
I like it here, it's comfortable, so I stay.
A fair exchange.
Thank you.
Welcome to Xanadu.
Is that all? I suppose some people are just easy to please...
I like it here. It's comfortable, so I stay.
A fair exchange.
Thank you.
Hello, there. What'll it be?
Enjoy.
Enjoy. There's always more where that came from.
Hope you like it here, Domino's been working hard to put this place together. You wouldn't believe the zoning laws they have for portals, these days.
I bet you've got a couple of stories you could tell, maybe you could swap a story or two with some other folks here.
Hello, there. What'll it be?
Enjoy.
Enjoy. There's always more where that came from.
Hope you like it here, Domino's been working hard to put this place together. You wouldn't believe the zoning laws they have for portals, these days.
I bet you've got a couple of stories you could tell, maybe you could swap a story or two with some other folks here.
Hello, there. What'll it be?
Enjoy.
Enjoy. There's always more where that came from.
Hope you like it here, Domino's been working hard to put this place together. You wouldn't believe the zoning laws they have for portals, these days.
I bet you've got a couple of stories you could tell, maybe you could swap a story or two with some other folks here.
Welcome. With regret I can only offer you cabbage, as it is difficult to grow anything with all the tumeroks nearby.
Watch your back. The area around here is occupied with tumeroks.
Finally some decent food. Thank you!
I'm sorry I can only offer you carrots and cabbage.
This key doesn't fit the lock! I wish I had my backpack, then I'd be able to escape. Find my backpack and return here with it. Then I'll have a chance to escape.

I can't believe I let myself get caught by these Tumeroks again. You can't break me free from this cell, but if you can locate my belongings I can use my components to teleport myself away from here. The Tumeroks who took my belongings just left and were traveling north towards Dryreach. You need to hurry, not much time remains before they decide what to do with me...And I'm not sure if they wi...
Shhhh!  I think I hear someone coming!
quest: You found my belongings! Now I can portal out of here without the tumeroks outside seeing me.
I owe you a debt I can never fully repay. Please accept this ring and gem as a token of my appreciation. The ring was given to me by my father and has protected me on many occasions.
I owe you a debt I can never fully repay. Thanks again for finding my belongings again!

greetings: Welcome!  There's only two things I sell, and you can't throw either of them.
Thank you for coming by.  Stay frosty.
Thank you for coming by.  Keep it cool.
I hear my fellow snowmen are coming back! I hope they come by and visit. It gets so lonely here during the warm times.
I'm a pacifist.  I don't fight.  And no one bothers me.
I'm so glad that Winter is coming back! Soon I'll be able to go out and bask in the cold! I soo hope we have a really harsh winter this year!
I wonder if I have a mote of pyreal in me?  I doubt it!
My ice is of only the highest, purest quality!  And it never melts!
Oy.
Whatcher want?

Aye, I came here from Arwic. Once thought I'd make a fortune there, so ah spent most of me savings to buy a plot of land in town. Land was expensive in Arwic, yeh know. A'course, the damned Shadows saw to make my land into a smoking hole!

Business is slow here. Seems the Gare-un... Gare-oon... the desert people... have some religious problem with stout. Can ye imagine? Turning up your nose at a good highland stout... I dinna understand 'em. Had to make a deal with al-Luq of Yaraq to sell Cove Apple Cider. It's all they'll buy.

We get a lot of mages through here. Seems there's something down in the lower caverns they're interested in. I don' know much about that finger-wiggling bunk meself, but I reckon it must be somethin' pretty important to them.

Yeh know what I think? I think the desert people just string a bunch of letters together to make their names. I mean, look at the jeweler. Jurraf al-somethingorother. Looks kinda like 'diggy-quitter.' Why can't they use good, pronounceable Aluvian names, like 'Gondibyr,' or 'Fadmynda?'

When Xarabydun was first explored, they found a good lot of books in the lower levels. Now I don' know much about book learnin' meself, but whatever was in them must have been pretty important. Those swishy academics from Zaikhal fairly ran here to get at 'em, and carried them all away. Could be they forgot some, though.
You ever hear of Knath'taed? Funny lil' critters. They like to hang around in the lower caves. Looks like the Empyrean put up doors to keep 'em out. Dunno why they didn't just kill 'em all.
Now, the Bey will say otherwise, but I'm tellin' yeh straight. There's a bloody big rat down in the sewers, and the thing spits lightning bolts.
That scribe, Sifida... She's a bit off in the head, if yeh take my meaning. She came here from Tufa. Doesn't say much, just keeps to herself.
Not bad, not bad. But are ye gonna drink like a real man, or unload food on me like some bleedin' merchie?
Did yeh only come to sell? Buy a stout!
Come back anytime, mate. I'll keep the taps flowing.
The strong scent of fried food drifts down the corridor.
Need a blade? Need armor? I make both! I'm something of a tinker.
Whew! I've got the forge running hot, eh? What can I do for you?
Remember to take care of that, now. Equipment has to be maintained.
To fight the banderlings below, use electrical weapons. Slashing with an edged weapon will do in a pinch.
Hm... I bet I could repair that, make it better... I'll have to look over it later.
Come back whenever you need.
Greetings! I offer the choicest selection of natural, organic produce from Xarabydun's living grottos. Grown without any magical enhancement. Well, unless you count the Empyrean mage-light, anyway.

I've got a new item for sale. Drudge Cookie Cutters! They're hard to find I'm told, but I've got plenty. I asked the tinsmith who makes them if he has plans for any Knath shapes and he said I'de be the first to know.
You might want to take a torch with you to the lower levels. There are some old magical lights in the upper regions, but the caves below are mostly dark. It looks like the Empyrean left them alone.
Guaranteed fresh every day!
Hm... We don't get much of that here. But is it fresh?
If you can clear out the rats from the sewers below the town, you would have my gratitude. More than once I've found my prize cabbages nibbled.
I prefer light armor myself, but find that metal armor is the most protective.
I hope you are pretty tough, because those Mosswarts are dangerous..
Thanks.
Hope this helps.
Welcome to the Wildsong Inn!  I hope you enjoy your stay!
Come back soon!
Wow!  Thanks for selling me that!
Fair trade is very important!  I hope you enjoy your goods!
Nature can cure all ills, my friend.
Be cautious, and try not to injure yourself!
I hope that you will not regret this transaction later.
A wise choice.
Hopefully this will help you, after you are foolish enough to incur injury.
It is interesting to see that you new arrivals are all so well stocked.
A tinsmith sold me some cookie cutters in the shape of humans. Strange little fellow... he wouldn't sell me any of the other shapes he had, said he was trying to build demand or somesuch.
Thank you for doing business with me.
Hmph.  That caught my interest.  Thanks for selling it to me.
Those always tend to sell well.
Welcome to the Whipping Vine.
Be careful outside of town.  In the Jungle there are many creatures like those for which this smithy is named.
If this is no longer of any use to you, I will be more than happy to take it off your hands.
Thank you.
I hope you enjoys your time in our hold. Just don't be preachin' about Pwyll or Jojii and we'll get on fine.
Hope to see you around again, mate.
Sure, I can buy that.
Yeah, good on you with that.
Greetings. It's not often I get visitors out here. I'm looking for some good equipment. Seen any? I have a lot of hungry vassal mouths to feed!
Hm, maybe one of my allegiance's lower level peons can use that.
Not good enough to 'mule,' eh? Not a problem, I'll find a use for it.
Zairente winks.
You must be in quite a spot to need that out here!
I found a very peculiar old dagger the other day. It's quite rusted over. I don't think it can be polished up to be useful again, so I'm willing to part with it.
Maybe we'll meet again out here, sometime. Watch out for Virindi.
Zairente hums, "Little rabbit Poo-kie / running through the Di-res / scooping up the mon-archs / and BANGING 'em on the head."
What a fight! I took a few trips to the lifestone, I must admit. Of course, our lifestone is so close that I was able to jump right back into the fray! What a glorious battle!
Speak with Lord Kresovus. His heart seems much aggrieved at Balor's absence.
This is a fine item.  Use it well, or the one that takes it from you will.
Thank you.

The Shadows overran our city. But soon, they were gone. I can only hope that Captain K'rank's valiant efforts frightened them witless. But perhaps there was something else... Perhaps they merely sought to test our defenses?
I cannot heal those whom I cannot see. Speak with Lord Kresovus. Return our beloved Balor to us.
I have no use for this myself, but perhaps I can sell it to another adventurer.
I'm certain that will come in handy...

Greetings.  I and my two brothers have been sent to some of the Isparian Arrival points to offer our fine wares.  While many Isparians have only dealt with our less refined cousins, the Tukal smiths are masters of many arts.  These particular gems have been crafted by some of our finest master gem crafters and imbued with helpful magics which I am sure will be useful to the Isparian adventurer....
Remember that the Lugian and Isparian relationship does not need to be awash in blood.
I regret that I am not able to pay you very much for this.  I still am not adept at figuring out the Isparian economy.
You will find that to be of good service to you in the future.

Have you come for instructions or for puzzle pieces?  I can sell you either...
Have a pleasant day, and good luck with your application.
Don't need that, do you?  Okay.
Good luck, friend.
I sell instructions and puzzle pieces to applicants here at the Guild of Bestowers.
Fare well, friend.
If you no longer have need of that, I will take it.
May your application receive favor.
Have you come seeking instructions or puzzle pieces?  I sell what you need for your examination at this branch of the Guild of Bestowers.
Good travels.
I will buy that, if you do not need it.
Best wishes.
Welcome traveler, have you come to see my weapons forged by the Dragon's flame?
May the Dragon's might guide your arms to flay and rend your enemies in battle.
If this proves a poor purchase, I will remember that you knew not the Dragon's Fury.
Tell Make sure to put this to use such fine items should not remain unused.
How can I help you today?
Be sure to visit Baggs while you're here in Bluespire--he's such a cheery fellow!
We may all be in friendly competition here, but we Isparians have got to stick together!
Ton Ai Yen's another great friend of mine--please send her my regards if you see her!
I'm a busy man. Tell me what you need and be quick about it.
Did Dorlan send you? I'll open up a pack of drudge smack on that boy!
Now go away.
This is junk, but maybe I can do something useful with it.
My skills are unparalleled, regardless of what that Ton Ai Yen is saying.
Take care as you travel in this area. Bachus tells me that the Tumeroks seem to be engaged in some strange feud, and it'd probably be best if you didn't get yourself tangled up in it.

These are interesting times indeed...if only Bachus were here to embroider a pretty tale for us! Too bad she's off on another wild goose chase again--tracking down a spear, she says. I heard she's in Redspire now.
Just what I've been looking for! Now I won't have to send over to Micon's for more.
Whether you have come seeking refuge or information, I should be able to help.
Good day. I have a wide selection for you to peruse.
I shall be here when you return.
Yes, thank you.
I normally wouldn't carry such an eclectic inventory, but the rivalry between Klars and Yusnar has forced me to expand to stay competitive.
Greetings! New to the island?
If you're in need of more magic supplies, be sure to stop by Anh's shop on your way out of town--it never hurts to be prepared for any event.
I can always use more to restock my shelves.
This will do nicely, you'll see!
There have been many strange goings on here on the island. No doubt you'll want to rest a while.
This island has many secrets. A few days ago, my friend Bachus dropped by to spin fairy tales of Tumerok legend she's been gathering. She lives over in Redspire now--perhaps she'll spin some for you.
With all the people traveling here, I'll pick up all the supplies I can.
Many thanks.
Don't tell me--Dorlan sent you. I certainly can't complain...he's sent a lot of business my way.
Don't be too quick to leave town, traveler. Make sure you have all the supplies you need.
Be sure to come back when you need more--even Baggs can't surpass my skill with a hammer and anvil.
A fine choice.
With all the adventurers coming through Redspire, I've certainly heard a lot of interesting tales.

Come back whenever you have the time, traveler. I'm always up for a bit of gossip. Why, even now Bachus Flufens will tell me quite the tall tale about some Tumerok warrior and his "living" spear... I'm glad she came to stay with me here in Redspire - I was afraid for her safety out there by the western shore.
Well, if you're sure you won't be needing this...
I'm always happy to serve my customers here at the Siraluun's Wing.
How do you do? I'm sure I'll be able to supply your wants.
My prices are the best on the island--despite what Yusnar may say to the contrary!
Many thanks!
May these serve you well.
The more newcomers to the island I meet, the more my heart gladdens.
Take care as you travel this new land, adventurer...there are horrors on this island that make me yearn for my safe bed back in Ayan Baqur.
You drive a hard bargain, my friend.
Are you sure you'll be warm enough? I have more should you need it.
Do not trust anyone...or anything...that you meet once you venture outside our lands.
Thank you. These may be useful in our struggle against the Olthoi...although our drummers have proven more effective.
I'll still be here should you need another.
quest: Aun Maanuawa tells you, "Hail, Queenslayer %s! Your people do seem to be everywhere these days."
Aun Maanuawa grins cheerfully.
Back again? Seems like you just left!
This town has not been this busy since the Hea left to follow that outcast, Aranpuh.
Greetings! I have never seen so many of your kind before.

greetings: Come again--I'm always well supplied.
Are you sure you won't be needing this?
You'll find that this suits your needs.
quest: Aun Laranawa tells you, "Ah, the famous Queenslayer. %s, stay a while. I would be honored to hear of your tales against Wharu."
Aun Laranawa smiles happily.
Always happy to see you.
We Aun have and a long and tenacious history here on Palenqual. Many stories have been told between these walls.

greetings: Take care as you venture into the wilds--there will be no one to protect you outside our drum circle.
My thanks. Many other travelers are in dire need of these--now I will have plenty on hand for them.
Our elder shaman taught me the special preparations to make these.
quest: Aun Taguauri tells you, "It will be my honor to assist you, Queenslayer %s. Any art I have is at your service."
Aun Taguauri looks alarmed.
Good gracious! Did you injure yourself again so quickly?
Yet another in need of my help! Will Wharu's invasions never cease?

greetings: If you've found your way to me, it means that Aun Shimauri must have sent you. I can see it in your eyes that you're an honest, loyal fellow--a friend of the Aun! Totally unlike those rapacious heathens...if you had a tail they'd steal it right off your back! Now, don't complain about the price--I've got mouths to feed at home.
These caverns have been overrun by vicious beasts and mercenaries since they were given to us. I'm surprised you made it this far.
Here to purchase a weapon, are you? Well, if you've made it this far, I'm sure you've earned it. Any friend of the Aun, I say...
Sorry about making you come this far...but we can't be giving away our prized secrets to just ANYONE. Besides, if the Hea knew of my whereabouts, they'd kidnap me in a second.

The weapons I sell will only gain their full magical potential once they are fused with one of our sacred triple totems. If you ever create one for yourself, you may wield it with our blessings. Remember always that the Aun have extended their friendship to you.
This is all wrong, friend! You're supposed to come here and buy something from ME! But nonetheless, I'm sure I'll find some use for this...gets awfully boring in here all by myself.

Perfect. I hope you've chosen your totems well--fused with the proper triple totem, this weapon will be a powerful ally to you. And if you've forgotten how to finish its creation, may I suggest that you purchase Aun Shimauri's tome? He's giving them away for free..but I, for one, have my children to think about.
Welcome to the best source of furniture in town!
Thank you. Come again!
Ah, new supplies. Wonderful.
A very good purchase.
Perhaps I may be of some help to you?
Take care while traveling outside of town.
I wish you nothing less than hoards of treasure to appraise!
As you wish.
Perhaps I may be of some service?
Enjoy your visit here and be sure to stop by again.
I've always enjoyed appraising new items.
As you wish.
Perhaps I can help you appraise something?
Be sure to visit Cragstone often. We have much to offer you.
Appraising new items is alway so exciting!
As you wish.
You seek my services?
Return whenever you wish.
I hope this will be of some help to you.
I heard Fort Tethana was the place to be! If you want help in Identifying something I'm your man.
Take care traveling around this place...I wouldn't want you to lose any of your fine items.
Sometimes just knowing the value of the item is reward enough.
As you wish.
Do you have something you need help appraising?
Enjoy your stay here.
If you are lucky you will reveal an item worth not in value, but in magic.
As you wish.
I can be of service to you if you need help Identifying items.
I used to visit Arwic in the summer time...but no more.
Here comes a little hocus pocus for you! Stand back!
As you wish.
I see you have come for my services...How may I help?
You are welcome here always.
With magic, all things are possible.
As you wish.
I see you have come to me for my expertise in all items.
I sometimes think there is too much dust in Khayyaban...
Helping those without the ability to appraise is what I do best.
As you wish.
Ah, I see you have items you cannot appraise! I am here for you!
It's amusing to me how most items end up being sold and not cherished.
With luck, my magic will help you appraise most items.
As you wish.
What services do you seek from me?
I'm glad I could be of service.
Appraising items is safe and fun...That's why I'm hear and not in the depths of some dark dungeon!
As you wish.
Welcome! How can I serve you today?
You are always welcome here at Neydisa Castle.
Ahh...it shall be my pleasure to cast that upon you.
As you wish.
Welcome to my place here in Qalabar.
You are always welcome here, my friend.
My abilities are now your abilities...
As you wish.
Another one comes for my services...So, what do you wish of me today?
Sawato used to be such a quiet place...
May this spell last long and your visit here be short...
As you wish.
Uziz is the home of some wonderful people...I am one of them.
You will come back, and when you do, I will be here.
Without my services, your items would remain unknown to your inexperienced eye.
As you wish.
Perhaps you find you way here by accident? Or can it be you really seek my services?
Farwell...Be kind and visit from time to time.
What you want to know will soon be revealed to you.
As you wish.

Good day. Thank you for helping out the Arcanum. As such, I have been instructed to make available to you these specialty items for your home decoration. We have a lovely fountain, an interesting lawn ornament, a handy inscribable plaque, a useful chalk board and a melodious doorbell you can use in your home. I hope you enjoy.
Walk carefully, friend.  It's a dangerous place out there.
I usually don't purchase anything.
I'm sure this will be a fine addition to your home.

If you are interested in making an Academy weapon, I recommend you buy a weapon you are specialized in. I also sell wands. Appraise the items in my inventory by right-clicking on them. Also, click on the green down button to scroll through my complete inventory. Buy items by double-clicking on them.
Once you complete your Academy weapon, you should visit the Senior Guard.
I suppose other recruits might have a use for this.
Good choice! Now, you can improve this item by pouring the Blacksmith's Oil of Rendering on it. Double-click on the Oil, then click on the item you just bought. Good luck!
Could I interest you in some firewood?
Would you care to see any of my log furniture?
I have some treated wood that should burn extra hot for the winter.
Perhaps you would like a small tree or shrub to plant near your house?
Wood, it's improving the quality of life in every way. Buy some wood.
The woods are really beautiful around here and the wood is of surpassing quality. Oh, you're leaving so soon? Ok then, stop by when you need more wood.
Yeah, I can change that for you.
Bet you could make something really nice from that.
Sorry I don't have anything bigger, but this should do.
Ah, the great outdoors!

quest: How dare you nose around my house, when I expressely asked you not to? Ok, you can buy something, but after that, get out, GET OUT!
Like I said, LEAVE! GO! OUT! NOW!
Alright, alright, alright! Give it to me and get the dickens out of my shop!
Yes, that's a good one. Take one, take them all, just hurry up with your shopping and leave my shop!
Welcome to my grand opening! You are welcome to peruse my wares...but please, stay to the front of my shop--the heat from the fire is very strong, and I don't want you to get burned.
Thank you for your patronage. Now please be on your way, I have much work to do.
Why, I don't mind if I do. I have plenty of ready cash these days.
A fine choice. I have recently come into...an inheritance, so I can keep my prices lower than the other shops around town.

greetings: Choose your colors quickly now, I have a lot of customers right now and don't have all day.
Maybe now I'll have some peace and quiet.
Didn't want that after all, aye? Figures. Maybe Master Aleane will let me discontinue that one.
Nice dye you bought there! Now go away.
Welcome, welcome! Look at my pretty dyes! Choose one, for your very own!
My brother and I wish you the best of luck in your adventures!
You didn't like this one? But it's my favorite color!
Don't tell the folks who bought the other shades, but that's my favorite one! Enjoy!
How did I get saddled with this job, anyway? When I signed on to become Koga's apprentice I thought I would actually be making armor, not peddling pots and paints!
That's just fine. Off you go now.
Make up your mind, won't you?
Tell That's all people want, just buy, buy, buy! No one ever asks me how I'M feeling today!
Welcome!  I have everything that you may need to help plan your wedding.
Thank you!  May your wedding be all you have ever expected!
Ah, I was looking for that!
Excellent choice!  Can I interest you in anything else?
Even with such disasters you should still go ahead with your wedding plans!
Thank you!  May your wedding be peaceful!
Staying long?  Most people don't, but we hope some will stay.
If you want to just stay in here or anywhere in town, feel free.
Most people here at Kara are just passing through.  Only a few of us have been here for long.
If you need a jeweler, talk to Kuro.  Thank you for your patronage.
Isn't it wonderful what Asheron and the Arcanum were able to accomplish for us?
Good luck in your travels, friend.
Thank you.
No more components, or that dreaded research!
Make your choice. And be quick about it.
Go and fight. Bring glory to the great one.
May you spill much blood.
Take as much as you like. The lady is most magnanimous.
Spill much blood.
Use this knowledge well.

Double-click on an armor piece in your inventory in order to wear it. Each piece of armor covers a specific body part and offers protection to that body part alone. Additionally, you cannot wear multiple pieces of armor on the same body part. For example, if you later had a cap that you like better than this one, you will have to un-equip this cap before you can wear your new one.

You can examine items in your inventory and in the world in order to view their stats. Click once on an item, then press the "E" key to open the Examine panel. You can also right-click on items in your invenotry to bring up this panel.

Each piece of armor or clothing that you equip has a specific Armor Level, or AL. Your armor absorbs a portion of all physical attacks that hit you. The higher your armor's AL, the more useful that piece of armor.
As the Harbinger's Foci painlessly burrow into your forehead you sense the four elements ebbing and flowing in great magical tides beneath your feet.
A horrible sensation of loosing a portion of your mind accompanies the fleshy sucking sound as you remove the Harbinger's Foci.
You reach down and pickup the mask. You nearly drop it when you see two flaming eyes staring from the eyeholes. An instant later they are gone.

The mask slips onto your face, feeling slick and strangly oily. Tendrils of energy loop into your cheeks and a reddish hue covers your eyes for a brief moment. The world swims as all of your emotions flare into a new level of vibrance and clarity.
As the mask falls into place you see Rynthid and Virindi... everywhere. The faces melt into nothingness after a few panicked moments.
As the mask settles into place you are engulfed in a torrent of conflicting emotions. You are driven to your knees by the brief but overwhelming moment.
As you pull the mask from your head a great wave of sadness and disappointment washes over you.
As you reach up to remove the mask, the tendrils of energy it generates try to block your hands. A great wave of anger flows through you as you remove the mask a moment later.
The mask slips from your skull with a sickeningly slick sound. A wave of pure joy passes through you as the mask falls away.

Your flesh dissolved from bones, I triumph again.
Tempt not, what your magic is made of. There will only be a reckoning.
%s has defeated Corrosion, the Essence of Verdancy.

I have been working on a Scrying Rod which may allow us to discover the device in hopes of figuring out a way to disable it. Unfortunately, I have yet to be able to locate their device as I fear they move it regularly.
Please, take this Scrying Rod and see if you can find that device and hopefully bring us one step closer to our freedom.

I can't thank you enough.
The Sand Kings took control of our temple and began enslaving our people inside. Did Nephthys send you to free me? Speak with Nephthys and disable the Mumiyah device.
