greetings: Greetings, traveler. I am Bemeth the Gatherer, archivist of the great temple.
In ancient days we crafted artifacts from four great crystals that fell from the sky.
These were hidden away in Catacombs under the sands, and the tablets to reveal them were scattered in the Geresh'n Wars.
If you find these tablets and retrieve our crystal artifacts you may return them to me for a reward.
I will return them to our temple where they belong.
quest: You have found one of the ancient staves! Thank you, traveler. These artifacts will aid our rituals as they did in the old days!
You have found one of the ancient swords! Thank you, traveler. These artifacts will hang on the walls of our Temple once more!
You have found one of the ancient amulets! Thank you, traveler. These artifacts will adorn the guardians of our Temple once more!
You have found one of the ancient idols! Thank you, traveler. These artifacts will grace our Temple once more, as they did in the old days!
Although I can reward you only once per day for each type of artifact, if you find additional tablets you may use them again to renew your search for additional artifacts.

greetings: I may be a researcher, but I'm not an expert in ancient Falatacot texts. Find a translator for this, and we'll see if it's useful.
Is that what I think it is?"
Is that what I think it is?
This is amazing!
Even with the essence extracted from the seed, this is still very powerful in the magics of the Light Falatacot.
Perhaps the ladies here can use it in their rituals to improve the effects.
Popkin of the Gate handles the seedling with a deep reverence.
I am impressed. A seedling like that won't pick just anyone. There must be something special about you.
quest: Please return to me later. I may need more assistance.
Remember, the portal we found is east of Sanctuary, on the Vesayen Isles.
Greetings!
I wonder if you'd be interested in helping me.
I've been assisting the ladies here with their research. While they focus on the rituals, I've been digging into the history behind them.
I believe I've located a location that could be beneficial to this research. Alas, it's no place for an A'nekshay like me, so I'm looking to hire a few strong adventurers to help me out.
I managed to uncover a portal to the east of the Cathedral of Ithaenc, which a lot of people seem to refer to as 'Sanctuary'.
If you could go there and recover any full pieces of lore, something big enough to translate, I'd be eternally grateful.
Beautiful!
This is exactly what I was looking for!

It's a much later period transcription of the lore we've been researching, so I'll need to crosscheck it against the older pieces in case the story evolved over time, but this still invaluable to our research here.
I hope this'll do for compensation for your skills and time. You've given us a great leap forward here.
And now, to send you to a place prepared for you to use that key...
I'm sorry, but the help I need would take one more experienced than yourself.  Come back when you've gained in experience.
It's clearly only a small part of a larger story, but if I can assemble enough parts, I may be able to piece the whole thing together.
I hope this'll do for compensation for your skills and time.  If you're interested, I'll be able to reward you for your assistance again in a day.

Also, one of my researchers, a female A'nekshay named Shah-hi, is camped out next to a dig site in the Vesayen Isles, at 77.7S, 97.0E.  She's sent me some disturbing reports of issues at her dig site, and I'm sure she'd appreciate the help.

greetings: The whole legend... this is an amazing find. You should take this to Popkin of the Gate, near Cragstone. She's the one collating all of the lore. She'll reward you well for this, I'm sure.
I'm stuck here dealing with angry Gromnies and even angrier miners...
quest: Thanks again for your assistance. When I have more information or questions, I'll be sure to keep you in mind.
You must wait %tqt before you may repeat this quest.
You explain to Shah-hi what you found in the depths of the temple.
Wow! That's more than we could've hoped for.
You actually found and helped one of the four Sisters mentioned in the lore we've been researching? That's unbelievable.
I have to relay this info to Popkin immediately. We'll have to begin looking for sites in the areas where the sacred materials were found.
Thank you very much for your assistance. Here, let me reward you for your part in this.
If you're interested, my brother Kaltus has run into some problems with his dig site, just outside of the Canyons of Neftet, in the desert. I'm sure he'd love the assistance.
For now, however, I'll send you to a place prepared for you to use that key. You may also find that where your going makes it easier to get to Kaltus.
Have you found anything in the dig site? Please hurry.
Welcome to my excavation site!
I wonder if you'd be interested in a little job.

My mistress, Popkin of the Gate, sent me here to manage this dig site. We've uncovered a very promising Light Falatacot temple, but it's entirely overrun with gromnies. If you'd be willing to go in there and bring back word of anything you find, it'd be greatly appreciated.
I'm afraid you're not powerful enough to aid me.
If you're interested, I'll likely need your assistance again tomorrow. The bulb should be ready to produce another seed by then.
You can gain access to the temple from the Guardian, deeper into the dig site. Recover whatever you can that will help us with the Rituals.
You have already assisted me, come back tomorrow I'll likely need your assistance again.
Hello there.
I wonder if you'd be interested in helping me.
I've been managing this dig, but we seem to have caught a lot of unwated attention.
Spectres from the Fallen Princess and soldiers of the local Sand Kings have taken over the tunnels, and are attempting to break into the temple we uncovered.

This should be the location of the spirit of the Lady of Morning and Growth. According to the Lady of Mysteries, as well as recorded legends that have been recovered, her spirit should rest in some sort of bulb or plant.
We need to recover her essence before these invaders can do anything to harm or corrupt it.
If you'd be willing to fight past the invaders and enter the temple before they do, our order would reward you handsomely for your assistance.

If you're looking for work, my sister Shah-hi is in desperate need of assistance with her dig site, in the Vesayen Isles. Something has caused her miners to flee the site, and they refuse to go back to work until it's dealt with.
You'll find her excavation at 77.7S, 97.0E.
Beautiful!
This is... amazing!
Even being warned what we may find, it's still breathtaking to see. Now, to see if Popkin's spell works...
Kaltus chants over the seed, and a small wisp of light pours out of the seed and into his hand.
Oh good, it worked. Spirit-magic is such a touchy thing.
It's only a small fragment of her essence, but it's progress all the same. As for this seed, I think you may find it useful.
Also, my companion Adrenkus has a dig site in the Valley of Death, but hasn't reported in lately. If you could go check on him, it'd be greatly appreciated.
At the moment, however, I should send you to a place nearby where you can use that key. Travel well!
I'm afraid you're not powerful enough to aid me.

greetings: You explain to Fahneph what you saw within the Foundry.
This Falatacot stole the souls from my kind and through her blood rituals was able to transfer the energy into metal and wood?
A powerful foe indeed! This symbol you found...I will take this to our elders so they can decipher the magics within. We must know its secrets if we are to protect ourselves.
quest: While many of my kind would never believe or understand what transpired on this day, we owe you our gratitude.
No news? I can feel the lack of discovery emanating from you. Please return to me when you have information on the strange activities happening in the area.
Strange activities have been happening around Neftet recently. Many of my kinsmen have just up and vanished without a trace.
With Isparians eagerly seeking our treasures, an experienced A'nekshay disappearing is hardly unheard of.
As I hunted the nearby desert several nights ago, I was disturbed by the strangest of sights.

An ancient of the Falatacot approached. Her hands were empty but she was more armed than any I have ever seen. Weapons were dancing and darting in the air of their own will all around her. No master wielding them!
She beckoned, calling for me to join with my brothers and sisters within the Foundry. I felt my will fading and an irresistible force pulling me to this stranger.

Fortunately, a brief but timely windstorm suddenly kicked up the desert sands which was enough of a distraction for the connection to be broken. I then was able to use the swirling sands and slip away into the darkness.
Hunt this fiendish being down and discover what she has done with my kind. I fear if she is not stopped that our race will be in grave peril.
Search the area to the north of Neftet. This is where I encountered the being.
What have you discovered brave one? I could sense a foul presence as you approached. Please give me any artifacts or writings you uncovered. Our elders will find the truth within.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.
If you're interested, I'll likely need your assistance again tomorrow. The bulb should be ready to produce another seed by then.
Also, my friend Norus has a dig site near the Inner Sea Gearknight area, but none of us have heard from him recently. If you could go see if he needs any help, it'd be greatly appreciated.
You can gain access to the temple from the Guardian, deeper into the dig site. Recover whatever you can that will help us with the Rituals to heal the Prince and those afflicted by the Book.
You have already assisted me, come back tomorrow I'll likely need your assistance again.
Greetings!
Welcome to my little subterranean paradise!
Well, we were originally set up on the surface, but the local fauna kept trying to eat the miners, so we relocated here.
So far, we've been able to hide this location from Hoshino Kei's forces, but I'm not sure how long that'll last.

This should be the location of the spirit of the Lady of Harvest and Justice. According to the Lady of Mysteries, as well as recorded legends that have been recovered, her spirit should rest in some sort of bulb or plant.
We need to recover her essence as quickly as possible, preferably before the spectral skeletons figure out where this site is.
If you'd be willing to brave the temple, you'll find the Guardian deeper in these tunnels. Just watch out for the local fauna.

If you're looking for work, my sister Shah-hi is in desperate need of assistance with her dig site, in the Vesayen Isles. Something has caused her miners to flee the site, and they refuse to go back to work until it's dealt with.
You'll find her excavation at 77.7S, 97.0E.
Utterly fascinating...
The magics of the Deru and the Light Falatacot never cease to amaze me.
Now, to see if the essence is intact...
Adrenkus chants over the seed, and a small wisp of light pours out of the seed and into his hand.
Beautiful, what is contained here is both intact and free of corruption. Well done, well done indeed.
It's only a small fragment of her essence, but it's progress all the same. As for this seed, I think you may find it useful.
I'm afraid you're not powerful enough to aid me.
EscapeCompleted_0213@%tqt
Defying death not once but twice is a fate to be concerned with. The elders will be informed of your discovery.
Your expression tells me you have yet to uncover the cause of the disturbance.
Changes sweep across our landscape, friend. Unnatural changes.
The oldest and wisest of our kind have felt these rifts, yet they are unable to explain their cause.
Deep in the center of the nearby city is the source; the elders are able to discern that much.
You would be providing a great service to our kind by scouring the ancient city.
Although we have little information to provide you, the elders are most certain something is amiss within the city.
Good fortune my friend.
You do not meet the requirements to do this task.

Welcome to our little home away from home!
If you have any items from the Lost Sisters that you no longer wish to keep, I can take them and send them along to my mistress, Popkin of the Gate.
You desire the key, yes? This cannot be allowed.

I beg of you to flee or be destroyed, the choice is yours.
I have been expecting you. Your kind is consumed by insatiable greed.
Retreat from this chamber. Do not force me to protect the Fragment by taking your life.
The Fragment is mine to protect. I cannot surrender this to you.
You may leave this place in peace, or be slaughtered in your pursuit of what does not belong to you.
Choose your next action wisely.
Another brave adventurer. Take my advice and scurry back to where you came from.
If you force my hand, no mercy will be given.

Excellent. That should be enough for the moment. Here is your reward.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm wasps and wasp hives.
Once you've killed %tqm wasps and wasp hives in the Viridian Rise I will reward you.

As the great Deru tree fights off the corruption which attacks it the land is infused with its life energies. This has caused the phyntos wasps and hives of the area to grow wildly. We need to cull these before they grow out of control.
Destroy wasps and wasp hives within the Viridian Rise and I will reward you for your efforts.
The task I have for you is too difficult at this time.

greetings: You are interested in Cooking? I have devised a way to brew powerful meads from the Nightbloom in the area. If you have harvested the Nightbloom then you are already quite skilled at cooking.
The process requires a Brew Kettle and water, honey infused with the magical amber of our tree, and Nightbloom infused with the magical energies of the area.

I have a process to create the amber infused honey. Unfortunately with the attack on the roots of the Deru I cannot give out our supplies. I will have to trade Infused Amber for the honey you will need as an ingredient.
Give me one Infused Amber and I will give you five jars of honey and the recipe to make the meads.
quest: We certainly have need for this Infused Amber to bring our great tree back to health.
Here is my recipe to make these magical meads.
1.) Use the brew kettle to scoop up water.
2.) Add the Amber Infused Honey to the full kettle so it boils.
3.) To that mixture stir in the infusec Nightbloom.
The infusion of the Nightbloom will determine the type of mead you brew.
That is a generous offer. Since I am only a cook I am afraid I have little to offer you.

greetings: Wind Fury begins casting a deadly lightning ring! RUN!
NightBrier begins casting a deadly thorn ring! RUN!
The Storm Corruptor begins casting a lightning volley! Move out of the cone!
The Corrupt Thorn Reaver begins casting a deadly thorn ring! RUN!
The Corrupt Storm Reaver begins casting a deadly lightning ring! RUN!
The Thorn Corruptor begins casting a deadly thorn volley! Move out of the forward arc!

quest: If you're interested, I'll likely need your assistance again tomorrow. The bulb should be ready to produce another seed by then.
You can gain access to the temple from the Guardian, deeper into the dig site. Recover whatever you can that will help us with the Rituals to heal the Prince and those afflicted by the Book.
You have already assisted me, come back tomorrow I'll likely need your assistance again.
Thank the Deru someone came!
We were originally set up on the surface, but Hoshino Kei's spectral skeletons destroyed everything and slew all of the miners.
I barely made it out of there alive.
This should be the location of the spirit of the Lady of Twilight and Rest. According to the Lady of Mysteries, her spirit should rest in some sort of bulb or plant.
We need to recover her essence as quickly as possible, preferably before the spectral skeletons figure out a way past the Guardian or the creatures inside the temple.
If you'd be willing to brave the temple, you'll find the Guardian deeper in these tunnels. Just be very careful, the tunnels are still packed full of invaders.

If you're looking for work, my sister Shah-hi is in desperate need of assistance with her dig site, in the Vesayen Isles. Something has caused her miners to flee the site, and they refuse to go back to work until it's dealt with.
You'll find her excavation at 77.7S, 97.0E.
Well done...
You made it past that pile of invaders, as well as the temple itself. Well done indeed.
Now, to see if the essence is intact...
Norus chants over the seed, and a small wisp of light pours out of the seed and into his hand.
Beautiful, what is contained here is both intact and free of corruption. Well done, well done indeed.
It's only a small fragment of her essence, but it's progress all the same. As for this seed, I think you may find it useful.

Also, as you have aided all of the Lost Sisters, you may wish to seek out Lord Brem, in the encampment that watches over Hoshino Kei's Fortress. He is seeking those adventurers who've been brave enough to assist us in collecting all of the essences of the Sisters.
I'm afraid you're not powerful enough to aid me.

greetings: Shady quickly devours the meat.
After several moments, Shady falls to the ground. The sedative looks to have worked.
quest: This must be one of the pets Colton mentioned.

greetings: The mighty Ralirea sags from %s's fatal blow. "Ah, Mirakah," he murmurs. "I shall not be able to fill our stores this winter. But I will meet you at the lodge, my love... at last..." So saying, the hunter passes like the wind over sea.
Ralirea pokes the wood of his fire with a stick, and a swarm of embers ascend like fireflies. The hunter watches them, and sighs. "Ever do they fade," he murmurs.
Ralirea looks away toward the distant sea, and murmurs, "Somewhere..."
Ralirea grasps the small clay figurine that dangles from his neck, and holds it before the flickering light of the fire.
Ralirea sings, "The falling leaves glow red and gold,
the colors of faded glory,
the colors of faded dreams.
When I was young and strong and bold,
Ere I was old and hoary,
I knew that glory, so red, so gold - - -
The colors of faded dreams."
Ralirea sings, "In a distant land my love came to me
Her hair in braid and bow;
And long ago over shining sea
My love was lost in a gate's blue glow.
'Where has she gone?' her mother wails.
'Where has she gone?' she asks of me.
The wind asks 'Where?' in the sails
As ever I search over land and sea.
In a distant land my love was lost.
I seek it still, wherever I go,
through snow and gale and storm and frost:
Just a glimpse,
one more glimpse,
of that gate's blue glow."
Ralirea grunts as he swings his harpoon, "%s, I am among the greatest of the Aun hunters. You have little chance against me. Go you on your ways, and leave my party be."
Ralirea grunts as he swings his harpoon, "Leave me be! My skills are needed by the Aun, but if I wished to fight, I would be a warrior, not a hunter."
It is not as I would have had things, %s. Go in peace.
Well, then. Defend yourself.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the northwest.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the southwest.
I thank you for this effort, but this piece of debris is from the stone ring in the southeast.

quest: Aun Gehaua tells you, "How foolish do you think us, %s? We know your evil name, yes, we do. You have done your damage to our efforts just recently!"
Begone, and take your hideous bell with you. Even if you return in three weeks, it shall be too soon for me.
You have been awarded the title of "Out of Tune".
Begone, and take your hideous instrument with you.
Aun Gehaua tells you, "Praise the stars and sky, and praise to you, %s. This will heal the stones at this place."
You! Stonebreaker! The spiritcallers know your name now, and will not be duped again by you.
What do want here? Attempt to deceive us again with that fiendish bell and we will mark you for all to see!
You! The spiritcallers know your name now, and will not be duped again by you.
What do want here? Attempt to deceive us again with that fiendish instrument and we will mark you for all to see!
How interesting. This is an instrument used by your people? Tonk says 'music is all and everlasting'
The crashing of the great pyreal bell reverberates through the ground. The menhir stones crack and break!
No! What have you done? Villian!
I must go and warn the xuta.
How curious. This is an instrument used by your people to assure the highest quality of tones?
Aun Gehaua strikes the Tuning Fork against the stones and a low pitched tone resonates outward. The menhir stones crack and break!
What trickery is this...?
A blank look suddenly washes over Aun Gehaua's face. A gentle blue glow eminates from his eyes.
The demise of your kind is near fleshlings!
You are selfless, Isparian. You have assisted me in repairing this ring within the last three weeks. I cannot ask you to help me again.
I greet you. I have often conferred with Isparian. This one is a spiritcaller of the Aun xuta.
I and my fellow callers help maintain the stone rings of this island. Their energies somehow increase the power of our rhythm.

The other circles now are broken. Only this one keeps- ah, but I cannot speak it! Defend me!

I am Lai, of the Aun xuta. I beat this drum to keep the clawed ones far from the walls of our city.
The wind says they have begun to creep and scurry from their lairs. What has happened to the other stones? Bother me no more, I must drum.

greetings: I now grant you the title of Carenzi Slayer. Again, thank you.
Aha! This is the key to the chest where I keep my amulet--if you fetch it for me, I'll reward you with something much better.
If it weren't for Carenzi, I'd be able to tend the shrine I built for Raeta.
I know that if I were able to purge those loathsome beasts from my shrine, Raeta would bless it with her presence again.

Wonderful! Raeta graces my shrine once again. Take this necklace. Whenever you wear it, Raeta will bestow her grace upon you. If you wish to take on the title of Carenzi Slayer, give me back the necklace. I will return it and grant you the title.
quest: Thank you, but Carenzi has not yet returned to befoul my garden. I can only hope that he will not return a week from now.
Greetings, traveler. Raeta's migrations are such a beautiful mystery of nature. But where she goes, I must follow. I have moved my shrine to again be near her presence.

It is unfortunate that my misfortune seems to have followed me in turn. I have a grave favor to ask you. In his jealousy, the anima Carenzi has infested the beautiful shrine I built for Raeta with his own creatures. I tried to route them myself, but the horrid beasts nearly ripped me to pieces and ate the key to my chest! Until my shrine is cleansed of his defiling presence, Raeta will not return!

I locked my amulet inside my chest--if you bring it to me as proof that you have driven Carenzi away, I will reward you with the title of Carenzi Slayer. Follow Volkama's riverbanks to the south, and you'll find my shrine.

Incidentally, I would be careful going past my old grotto if I were you--a motley group of Hea have moved in and made the place their own. They had an interesting-looking chest with them...but I was in too much of a hurry to follow Raeta on her migration to inquire further.

greetings: I thought I told you to take this to that bukha Toneawa!
How dare you bring this sorry note to me! I have already seen its contents!
You can almost see the waves of anger radiating from Bernawa's countenance.
I'm sure that traitor would be be interested in seeing this. Perhaps he will have the bravery to show up himself for once!
I wonder if that bakha will have the gall to show up himself?
quest: YOU! Back again? Be off with you--and tell Hea Toneawa once and for all that the Aun will have nothing to do with him.
I have already given you the note to return to Hea Toneawa.
I am waiting here for Hea Toneawa. I don't suppose he gave anything to you for my sister, Mariona?

Hm...let me see...that bakha Toneawa! If he dares to think that he can meet my little sister here in secret he's got another thing coming. She will never be corrupted by that melodramatic sissy! If I ever catch him lurking about in our arbor again, I'll cut off his OWN tail for him! He'll wish he'd never left Timaru for Ahurenga! And if he thinks I'll let Mariona run away with him across the wa...

greetings: An Ebon Mattekar Hide. You must have hunted long to recover this fearsome trophy. Take it Tikakhe--he will provide you with a fragrant oil with which to tan this hide into leather.
I see you've created a buadren of your own! Tikakhe is a fine teacher. You must show it to him--he might even be able to enhance it for you as a reward.
A solid trunk such as this would be perfect to make a drum--if you hollowed it out first.

I have heard tell that these fiery beasts existed here on the mainland. In my homeland, the hides of Carenzi are the most suitable for the hardy straps that bind our drums but these hides will make do.
If you have already tanned an Ebon Mattekar Hide into leather, try covering this Hollow Trunk with it.
You nearly have a finished buadren! Use Leather Straps to bind the hide and trunk together.
Tika must think much of you to provide you with this oil. He carried only a special amount of it from Timaru.
I must congratulate you on your craftmanship in tanning this hide. Tikakhe himself could have done no better. This hide would make a perfect head for a drum.
You could use these straps to bind a drum.
I have asked you to take this ember into the Lightning-Sea, in hopes that you will be able to find Aun Tanua and give it to him.
The Invoker is yours to wield, for you have earned it.
Aun Aulakhe carefully lifts the glowing ember from your hands and gazes into it with awe.
Aun Tanua was unable to return with you again, but look! He has infused this ember with his own keh. I wonder...
Aulakhe kneels down and carefully adds the glowing ember to the encampment's fire.

This is a triumph, for even though he remains in captivity, Aun Tanua's spirit can now dance with our ancestors in the akiekie fire. For this I must reward you, for you have done the Tonk of Timaru a great service this day.
Give me the magic Buadren you received from Tikakhe, and I will add to its medicine.
quest: Aun Aulakhe takes your Buadren and carefully leans into the heat and smoke of the fire. He slowly starts to beat the drum, infusing it with the heat and magic now emanating from the fire's warmth. As he drums, the fire's glow coalesces around the drum with a shimmering intensity. When it seems as if the Buadren itself will catch fire, Aulakhe removes it from the flames.

You have done the Aun of Timaru a great service today, and for this I shall reward you. I have bound this Buadren to Aun Tanua's own keh, so you may carry it against your enemies. In your time of greatest need, invoke him, and he will come to your aid.

My own mission here is not finished, for I shall not walk through the gates of Timaru until the day when Aun Tanua himself may walk beside me. If you would like to brave Aun Tanua's prison once more, come to me after the Shining Twins have finished their journey, when I will have regained the strength to stabilize the Lightning-Sea.

This is indeed a beautiful buadren that you have made. But I must ask you again, were you able to deliver the akiekie ember to Aun Tanua? Even though he did not return with you, do you bring word from him?

Greetings, friend. Although my mission remains, bringing calm to the Lightning-Sea has sorely taxed my strength, and I must meditate to regain it. Come back in four weeks-at that time I may need to call upon your help once more.
I would be happy to enhance the buadren that you made previously with Aun Tikakhe, if you would give it to me.
Aun Aulakhe looks at you expectantly, but when he realizes you returned alone, he is downcast.

It is as I suspected: while I can stabilize the path to find Aun Tanua, the bonds the Atua ngamaru have placed upon him are too strong. But were you able to deliver the ember I entrusted to your care?
Several moons ago, my father Shimauri summoned us to his accustomed story hour, to tell of a story never heard by my generation.

Long ago, in the combined pasts of the Hea and Aun, Aun Tanua was a nigh-legendary warrior who was beloved by our xuta. He left our gates to challenge the Puh in his mudflats of Ahurenga, never to return. We thought perhaps he had been captured or slain by the Hea, but now we have discovered the truth: when they were unable to conquer him, the Hea called upon the Atua ngamaru. Answering them, t...
My task is to find warriors brave enough to enter the Lightning-Sea, who can search for him and bring him back to us. My buhdi Tikakhe tells me that you might be the person we are looking for.
When you find Tanua, warm him with the ember of the akiekie fire that you see on the ground, for there is no telling how Aun Tanua's mind might have fared in his captivity.

My training, both in my homeland and with the Aualuan of your xuta, has taught me to create the Burning Pools that shimmer upon the Lightning-Sea. I have opened such a portal on the surface  of the akiekie pond,  and if you dare swim its depths, enter it and find Aun Tanua!
A word of advice: All must depend upon the coordination of their fellows to navigate the Shimmering Sea. Farewell, and Tanae speed you in your hunt.
I must wait to engage your help in the great mission I have undertaken for my xuta  until you have gained in strength and accomplishment. Until then, may Tanae speed your hunt.
This is indeed a beautiful buadren that you have made. If you are willing to undertake a special mission for me, I might be able to enhance this buadren for you once you return.

My father, Aun Shimauri, sent me to the mainland to accomplish a great mission for our xuta. At the moment, I must still ponder on how I will fullfill it. For now, perhaps you should speak to Aun Tikakhe--he has a proposition that might interest you greatly.

This is indeed a beautiful Buadren you have made. When you are strong enough, I will ask you to undertake a special mission for me. When you complete it, I will be able to enhance this Buadren for you once you return.
Someone just informed me there is a problem at the warehouse.  Perhaps you could go check?
We are still trying to determine what happened at the warehouse.
How are things with you?
I will give this additional one to Nuhmudira. We are still trying to determine what happened at the warehouse.

Hello. I am a student of Nuhmudira. Nuhmudira is still enlisting the services of Isparians in obtaining some rare compounds and crystals necessary for her research into Lifestones. Dark Tree Crystal and Valara crystal are critical to this research.

If you could aid us in this endeavour we would be most grateful. To obtain Dark Tree Crystal you should go to a mine northwest of Fort Danby. Then, bring the Dark Tree Crystal to an ancient Empyrean dungeon we are using as a storage warehouse. It is located northeast of the Eotensfang Cottages settlement- you may journey there via the settlement portals near Arwic.  A fellow student at that loc...

What is this?  It is a crystal I do not recognize.  I will make sure that it gets to Nuhmudira!  Did you see what happened at the warehouse?  We know not what occurred but many of the crystals that were collected for Nuhmudira are gone!
I am sorry, I believe you are not powerful enough to help us with what is needed at this time.

greetings: Try giving that to the Human my friend.
Try giving that to the Lugian my friend.
I'm sorry, I'm not in charge of collecting that type of material. Try seeing if the other collectors, Kreavon or Caelis Renning, need any of that.
You should be proud not so many are skilled Trappers like you.
quest: Hello Isparian, my name is Aun Teverea.  All Tumeroks in the xuta of Aun Hareltah have been invited to join the new alliance.

We are assigned to this outpost near Wai Jhou, to collect building materials for the continued upkeep of Candeth Keep, the South Direlands stronghold. I will accept all types of cloth and hide that you can afford to donate to the cause.  Large or small, your donations will be treated equally.
Would you care to provide us with more materials? I accept all types of salvaged hide and cloth that you can afford to donate to the cause.
Welcome back, your continued help is most welcome! Any salvaged hide and cloth you can donate is greatly appreciated.
Thank you friend.  It takes many skins to build the tents and lean-to's we Tumeroks use in Candeth Keep.
You are off to a very good start. Yet, building materials are still in short supply. Please continue to bring me what you can.  If only Wharu had a salvageable hide...
Ah, more materials for the stronghold.  The reedshark, the armoredillo, and even the auroch have provided us the resources needed to survive in these harsh lands.
You have given me one-half the hide and cloth materials that I would ask of you. The residents of Candeth Keep shall know you by your name and your deeds.

Tell Many of the hide and cloth materials you have donated are now being cut and prepared for transport to Candeth Keep. With the harsh conditions and powerful creatures in the South Dires they can always use the new material supplies.  Your efforts shall be rewarded.
You have given much to help the alliance.  More materials are still needed, but rest assured you have donated the bulk of the quota set forth by the alliance council.

The storehouses are beginning to fill with the materials you and the others have generously given to the cause.  We now have enough materials to make another delivery to Candeth Keep, but we will surely need more to maintain our stronghold.
Friend, your hard work has paid off.  You have given the most that can be donated by any one member.
You will be welcomed in Candeth Keep as a co-founder.  Your donations of cloth and animal hide will not go unrewarded.
If you would like to be known as a skilled trapper, return this token to me.
Take this animal for your head. It keeps you warm on cold nights of hunting.

You have given one-half the resources of which the alliance is seeking from each member.  It is people like you who will be considered the true founders of Candeth Keep.  The alliance has allocated a symbolic gift for all of those who show dedication to the project.
You have helped us greatly. You can be sure that your efforts in continuing to provide materials for Candeth Keep will not go unrewarded.
You have given more than enough materials my friend. Perhaps the other collectors still require other materials.

greetings: What an unusual hide.  Surely something more interesting could be made from this. Seek out Yi Yo-Jin at Neydisa Castle.
There is nothing more I can do with this.
Thanks, but it's of no use to me.
How disgusting! There is, however, a sage somewhere in the southern mountain range that actually likes those things.  How revolting...
I can't work with this, but I hear there is a person in the Bandit Castle that can.
Hmm, I think that I once made a Helm that you could affix this to.
I can take the hides of certain creatures and turn them into items of value.
Have you the skins of armoredillos, gromnies, or reedsharks?  I can use them in my craft.
Hmm. A few snips here, and a few snips there...
Add some dye...There you go!
Here you go!
This is large enough to craft into a well fitting cuirass I think.
Well then. I think that this may be the first of a great many new robes to come my friend. Make sure to show your friends.
Not quite as sturdy as the tanned red hide that I worked with before, but it's still strong enough and large enough to craft into a nice robe. Wear it well.
Let's see. The hide is thick and leathery, and aside from the small bony protrusions it's in fine shape. I think a nice set of leggings.
There you go.
Another fine specimen. A little thicker than the last shreth hide I was given to work with. Let me have a moment and I'll... Yes, yes that's it!
Here you go.
Where did you get this? It's rather frightening, and rancid smelling. Well, let me see what I can do with it.
I've seen something like this recently. Came from a carenzi though, it mottled and smelled rank. Much like this. Where are you finding these creatures?
Well, I've done the best I can.
What is this!? I've never seen anything like this. It will make a fine robe I think. Give me a moment.
Yes, there it is done.
I've seen some interesting hides pass my way, but the hides that people have been bringing me most recently are the oddest.
A few more threads...and done!
Be careful out there.
If you give me the hide of an armoredillo, gromnie, reedshark, or mattekar, I can make something with it that you may find useful.
The keh have spoken to me and I have translated their words to paper for you. I have used your language so as to not confuse you.
Orders to establish contact with the race from beyond this world. What plans will our once brothers derive next? I will see that Ispar Elysatah receives this report. Thank you.
Farewell budhi.

They wished to ally with Aerbax? Going back to the atua ngamaru that began all the problems for the Tonk... I am sorry for my brothers. I fear they may be beyond salvation. I will see that Ispar Elysatah is informed of this discovery.
Interesting. It appears as though they modeled their fortress after Candeth Keep. How could they have done such a thing without the original designs? I will inform Ispar Elysatah of these findings.

I do not understand how such things could have occurred. These are the exact prints that were used when creating Candeth Keep. They had gone missing. Now they are found being spirited to the race from beyond. For what fell purpose? I will see that Ispar Elysatah hears of this.

Foul beasts. They mean to make war on us all and overwhelm this world for what appears to be Wharu. They claim they have begun to change the burnt lands; the desert I think? Be wary of this foe. I fear that they will arrive in greater waves.

I have seen such things before. These are stones carried by Mosswarts, and given to others as a gesture of gratitude. Clearly you have done some kind deed for one of their kin. Take it and display it with pride.
Your skill in negotiating with a warlike creature should be known to all. I will give you a token - if you wish to be known henceforth as a diplomat, simply hand the token back to me.
Let it be known to all that you are a Diplomat!

I recognize this. I have seen these stones carried by Mosswarts who are in mourning. I have heard that the Mosswarts have been driven from the Blackmire, and that the survivors carry these stones in memory of their lost kin.
There is a dark cloud over this stone. I sense that its owner came to you for help, and you failed him or betrayed him in some way. Take it away from me.
This I do not recognize.
I am disturbed. The keh do not recognize this idol. Was this taken from the newcomers? It is a thing that has never before been seen on this world. Please, keep it.
A vile beast! What villainy lurks in the hearts of these creatures! There is no word in the Tonk language to describe the atrocity that these beasts can manage.
It appears that the rumors that have been spreading through Elysatah's court could well be true.
Aun Laokhe sighs.

Apparently there has been some activity in the Direlands Swamp in an area once populated heavily by the Mosswarts. The Mosswarts have reached out and asked us for assistance, as you might know. Bleeargh, an emissary that sought out your people recently, went before Elysatah and asked for assistance. She told the Mosswart that they would afford him passage so long as he and his tribe remained pe...
I speak of this because many believe that the Mosswart exodus is related to the increase of the  Burun, especially in the direlands. I think that it would be better for me to write this down for you.
Please, look into this matter for all our sakes.
Interestingly, I do not sense the rage within this creature that I do in his brother. He appears decidedly confused. Perhaps there is hope to sway him to our cause of peace...
This appears to be a potent spell. The spirits have told me how to craft it into a readable version.

Hail budhi, I come from the council chambers of Ispar Elysatah with a request. She bids that willing souls investigate the origin of the dark magics that spread across Osteth and Palenqual. She has heard that new anima have spread from the place where the kah took place. Should you find anything of note, I would like to see it. I will be calling on the keh of the Nuuani for aid to understand th...
Should you find any odd writing that the other translators cannot decipher, perhaps the keh of the Nuuani will help decipher those as well.
quest: Farewell budhi.
This should never happen. What the heck did you do to the game!?

greetings: Welcome back, Buhdi! Have you come to get your title? Excellent!
quest: Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! Here is something to recognize your efforts in hunting the Coral Golem Viceroys!
Return the token to me and I will bestow an appropriate title upon you, buhdi!

Excellent! Your keh burns brightly with victory! As I promised, a reward for you! It isn't much, simply some fixings I brought with me from Timaru! Here, feast with me as we celebrate your achievement!
The spirits tell me you have defeated four of the Coral Viceroys! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated three of the Coral Viceroys! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated two of the Coral Viceroys! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
The spirits tell me you have defeated one of the Coral Viceroys! Good! You are well on your way as a warrior!
Good luck to you, hunter! Return to me to see your progress in your efforts against the Coral Golem Viceroys. The spirits will speak and tell me of your victories!

Greetings. I am Aun Aukherea. My twin, Khekie, and I have come to Ayan Baqur to hunt the Golem Lords. I am not quite as brazen as Khekie, so I have chosen to stalk the western borders of this land in search of the Coral Golem Viceroy.

Would you like to hunt them as well? Very well, scour this region and others like it and I am sure you will find the golem. Kill five of these golems, return to me and I will see that your battles are rewarded!
