Greetings. I am Aun Khekierea. I have come to this city with my twin, Aukhe, to hunt the golem lords! While Aukhe has chosen to seek out the Coral Viceroys, I am hunting the most dangerous of the Golem Lords! The Platinum Golem Mountain King, who resides solely in the valleys that wreak of the atua ngamaru , has fallen before my claws.

Would you like to hunt them as well? Very well, scour this region and others like it and I am sure you will find the golem. Kill five of these golems, return to me and I will see that your battles are rewarded!
Many beasts of tooth and boil have you slain. You do your xuta proud.
Ah, buhdi, you do my xuta a grand service. I thank you.
You are indeed a Voracious Hunter.
Return to me when you have slayed 50 of the Voracious Eaters.
With the arrival of the blue-skins come the creatures of tooth and boil. The gray ones call them simply Eaters, and aptly named they are.

These Eaters have wrought much destruction on my brothers. I require assistance in ridding the Aun of these beasts. There is a particular breed of Eater, the one they call Voracious. You must aid me. Slay 50 of the Voracious Eater and I will sing your name to the elders of my xuta.

Greetings, budhi. You have done well and, were I close enough to hear it, surely the keh of Halaetan would sing. Here is a reward - I am told this piece of paper is worth something to your kind. The plague still continues, however, and you may continue culling the Polar Carenzi if you find more livers.

Greetings, budhi. You have done well and Palenqual sings its praises. Here is a reward - I am told this piece of paper is worth something to your kind. The plague still continues, however, and you may continue culling the Carenzi Stalkers if you find more livers.

Greetings, budhi. You have done well and Palenqual sings its praises. Here is a reward - I am told this piece of paper is worth something to your kind. The plague still continues, however, and you may continue culling the Feral Carenzi if you find more livers.

Greetings, budhi. You have done well and Palenqual sings its praises. Here is a reward - I am told this piece of paper is worth something to your kind. The plague still continues, however, and you may continue culling the Carnivorous Carenzi if you find more livers.

Greetings, budhi. You have done well in attempting to cleanse this plague, despite how dark their native land is. Here is a reward - I am told this piece of paper is worth something to your kind. The plague still continues, however, and you may continue culling the Mangy Carenzi if you find more livers.

Greetings, budhi. You have done well in attempting to cleanse this plague, despite how dark their native land is. Here is a reward - I am told this piece of paper is worth something to your kind. The plague still continues, however, and you may continue culling the Tainted Carenzi if you find more livers.
Hurry, you must seek carenzi which bear plague and destroy both them and others of their kind.
Aun Teriona appraises you closely.

Greetings, human - hear the kah of the carenzi. While they are fierce creatures and sometimes infest burrows that they should not, by and large they exist in harmony with Palenqual. I have heard a troubling report, though - that the touch of Wharu infests some carenzi and inflicts a terrible disease.

To prevent the plague from overtaking the land, you must seek carenzi which bear plague and destroy both them and others of their kind in that immediate area. Examine their livers to identify whether the carenzi are diseased. If you have culled the diseased carenzi already, show me the liver that I may see the evidence of the infection.
Know that only those carenzi which burrow upward to the light are afflicted. Those which exist forever in the ground are not susceptible to the illness.

I can see that you are the paragon of hunters, and so I shall give you the hardest task of all. You must cull the Tainted Carenzi, foul creations of the atua ngamaru. Seek them in the place known as the Singularity Caul.

You are a great hunter and warrior whose exploits should be sung of far and wide, if they are not already. To you I task the culling of the Mangy Carenzi. I have been told that these creations of the atua ngamaru are found within the place known as the Singularity Caul.

You are a great hunter and warrior whose exploits should be sung of far and wide, if they are not already. To you I task the culling of the Carnivorous Carenzi. I have been told that these creations of the atua ngamaru are found within the place known as Marae Lassel.
You are a great warrior so I shall task you with the culling of the Feral Carenzi, foul creations of the atua ngamaru. Seek them in a place known as Marae Lassel.
You are a great warrior so I shall task you with the culling of the Carenzi Stalker, foul creations of the atua ngamaru. Seek them in a place known as Marae Lassel.
You are a brave warrior so I shall task you with the culling of the Polar Carenzi, foul creations of the atua ngamaru. Seek them in a place known as Corcosi Island.

greetings: Thank you, buhdi.
Greetings, buhdi. We search Palenqual for the atuakeh plant. If you find one, I will gladly take it from you for a small reward.
Peace be with you, buhdi. Welcome to my abode.
All are welcome to come and meditate upon their own keh, or upon the keh of others.

I have found that sometimes such visions are aided by the use of atuakeh dust. Form a fellowship and toss your dust into the fire, and your fellowship will be able to see things you were unable to before for a short time.
Beware - the atuakeh dust will only work upon those who are a member of your fellowship when you toss the dust upon the fire and who remain with your fellowship as they approach the fire.
The mists will only remain parted for a short time - a half hour at most. Hurry on your task.

Finally, if you die, the journey to your lifestone will erase what tie you have to the other world. Be careful in how you tread, for that which lurks there can kill as surely as the monsters of this world.

quest: Have you found any of the Dire Champion Tokens? I'll reward you if you have any for me.
I have all the tokens I need right now.
You must wait %tqt to turn in more tokens.
Here is a small reward for your service.
Your Queen, Ispar Elysatah, has asked me to help control of the growing threat of certain creatures here in the Direlands.
Atuakawa, or enemy warriors, called Dire Champions have been killing the unwary or unprepared who travel the Direlands. These atuakawa seem well trained and exceptionally difficult to kill.
It is my belief the creatures we fight in the Colosseum grow stronger from those battles, much as we do. These new atuakawa could be the result.
If you are able to kill one of the Dire Champions they usually have a orange coin on them. Bring me this coin as proof of your kill and I will reward your for helping to thin their number.
I see that you have killed your first Dire Champion Banderling.
Congratulations! I award you the title Banderling Bully.
I see that you have killed your first Dire Champion Drudge.
Congratulations! I award you the title Dire Drudge Decapitator.
I see that you have killed your first Dire Champion Golem.
Congratulations! I award you the title Gold Farmer.
I see that you have killed your first Dire Champion Lugian.
Congratulations! I award you the title Renegade Hunter.
I see that you have killed your first Dire Champion Monouga.
Congratulations! I award you the title Third Eye Blinder.
I see that you have killed your first Dire Champion Shadow.
Congratulations! I award you the title Shadow Sunderer.
I see that you have killed your first Dire Champion Skeleton.
Congratulations! I award you the title Anthropologist.
I see that you have killed your first Dire Champion Virindi.
Congratulations! I award you the title Xenophobic.
You have achieved much prowess in your hunts.
Aun Javhalrea waves a feathered ceremonial stick to your left and right and taps you on the chest.
You are now a Dire Huntsman and must uphold this honor by killing only those who threaten you or the thoughtless beasts you must hunt for food.
You have exceeded my expectations. You hunt like a true child of the Tanae. With the Queen's authority power invested in me by your Queen, I grant you the Title of Game Warden.
You have been awarded the title of "Game Warden"
The Queen will be informed of your great achievement.
You have exceeded my expectations. You hunt as a Tumerok Hunter hunts. Your name is inappropriate for the Rea honorary so I will make you an Honorary Rea of the Aun.
You have been awarded the title of "Honorary Rea of the Aun"
This is the greatest honor an Aun Hunter can achieve. Show your new Title with pride.
Very well then.
These tokens seem to represent the Dire Champions prowess.
Do you see the resemblance the token bears to the coins found in the Colosseum? I think that the Colosseum has been as instructive to the other inhabitants of Dereth as it has been for us.

greetings: I realize that you've already received those pauldrons, so if you don't want them, go ahead and give them to Lord Asheron, as they were awarded to you through his generosity.
A gift returned is rude in our culture.
Material things are all that matter to the many these sorrow filled days.
quest: Well done! What an exceedingly strange artifact! A claw of Bael'Zharon retrieved from the dream realm of the Quiddity Seed... You have done a great thing, by helping foil Aerbax's plans to destroy our memories of the triumph against Bael'Zharon. You certainly deserve your reward...
Aun Aemaua has granted you the title "Hope of the Past".

And there is this curious artifact, some kind of mysterious ingot that seems to be a remnant of the Hopeslayer's energy from that strange dream realm... Perhaps you should hold on to it. It may be useful later.
If you had a group of friends who helped you defeat the shade of Bael'Zharon, they will have to give me the claws they collected individually.

I'm sorry, I do not trust you. Perhaps if you were to prove yourself to Lord Asheron somehow, in the matter of these Quiddity Seeds... And I suggest you bring a group with you when you are ready to try.
So you have brought back a claw from the dream-realm in which you confronted the Hopeslayer?  If you give it to me, I shall reward you as befits your valor.

Aha! Another worthy adventurer. You have spoken with Lord Asheron about the threats to the realm, have you? Excellent. I would have you seek out the Quiddity Seed that materialized in Ithaenc Cathedral down in the Vesayen Isles. It is a gateway to a strange realm, both of this world and not... A realm in which memories and dreams acquire tangible form... Aerbax wishes to destroy the realm's mem...

greetings: Ugh. Only something that smells this bad could attract Wharu. It will work, and I guess that is what matters most.
Aun Kimintari stashes the jar into a heavy bag, which cuts off some of the smell.

Now, for the next part we need. Our scouts have found a place in the Roots where the minions of 'T'thuun' have collected the power of this world into a shard, and then corrupted it. I can use this power to anger Wharu against these creatures.
I can protect you from the shard's corruption using a trick taught to me by these 'Societies' your Xuta has created.
Aun Kimintari chants softly while tapping on her drum with one hand. you feel a wash of power settle over you.
You'll find the shard under the roots of the Deru, guarded by this T'thuun's minions. Bring it to me, and we can set the trap in motion.
The level of corruption and raw power in this thing is horrifying. Just taking this away from those things may help protect the Deru.
But, we will do one better. We will turn their corrrupted hopes into the very thing that destroys them.

Aun Kimintari combines the Royal Olthoi Jelly and the Corrupted Mana Shard with a carved fetish that she pulls from a pouch. As she combines the items, she chants softly in a strange tongue and the Akiekie Fire flares up beside her.
There, this should do it. Take this fetish to the altar in the deepest part of the area hollowed out under the roots of the Deru. If you keep going down, you should find it eventually.

Place the fetish, a fetish to Wharu himself, upon the Altar. This should call Wharu to the place, who will then war with this T'thuun, weakening them both. This will help protect the Deru and weaken Wharu both, which will help the Tonk and those of your Xuta as well.
Be careful, the conflict between Wharu and this T'thuun will be vicious, if what has been seen by our scouts is true.
quest: Return to me in a day, and we should be able to trick them once again.

You honor the Tonk, the Aun and your Xuta by your actions and sacrifice. I thank you. I have been given a number of these keys by our Tah, who has gotten them from Elysatah of the Ispar Xuta. I am told your people prize them highly, and will take them as a proper reward for the risks you have taken.

Our trap will not end the threat, but will keep them from progressing for a time, and keep the Deru safe until a better answer can be found. Return to me in a month, and we should be able to trick them once again.
Travel to the site of the Deru Trees, east of here, and pass down below their roots and place the fetish upon the Altar.

Travel to the site of the Deru Trees, east of here, and pass down below their roots.  From there, seek the tunnels guarded by the minions of T'thuun and collect the shard of corruption they keep there.  With it, I can complete the trap for this 'T'thuun' creature.
Travel to the site of the Deru Trees, east of here, and pass down below their roots.  From there, seek the Jelly left by their Tah.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.
I am called Aun Kimintari, and I am honored to meet you.
It is my chosen duty to guard the Keh of Tanae in Palenqual, what your Xuta call the Deru Trees of Marae Lassel, who are named Skuld, Urd and Verdandi in their own tongue.
These Deru, young by their count of years, have been weakened by Wharu, and are now attacked by a thing called T'thuun. This thing must be stopped.
I have a plan to weaken this 'T'thuun' and aid the Deru Trees, but I will need the assistance of your Xuta.
I believe that we can use Wharu against this new threat, but I will need some items our scouts have found under the roots of the Deru.

Find the passages of Wharu under the roots of the Deru Trees, east of Timaru. In those passages, find the Jelly left by their Tah. This can be used to attract Wharu, and will be important in our trap for this T'thuun.
Spirits have risen from below the mansion of Frest Greelving.
These spirts now walk the grounds. Greelving lives outside his own home.
Recover the three belongings for which Frest Greelving asks from his mansion and return with the reward you're given.
I will make this act worth your while.
I have already rewarded you for showing me Frest Greelving's reward.
The spirits in the mansion are restless. You braved their presence and recovered his belongings.
This is the reward I promised you. You will go on to do great things.
You're not yet strong enough to do the quest I require. Ask one of the others.

greetings: This trinket contains great power, and great evil. The potency within must be cleansed from this land.
Aun Ol'tra places the Crimson Scarab within a small pouch and shakes it violently.
The corruption has been removed. Never again will this trinket hold influence for the Rynthid.
Take these, you have attained great respect from our tribe by your deeds.
quest: Come back later and I might have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
You return so soon?
Greetings. We are in grave danger with the appearance of these Rynthid. This Curator of Torment performed unthinkable experiments on my kind to mold them into its vision of perfection.
We simply cannot allow the Virindi influence to twist our kind once again!
Our elder Shamans have felt a Tonk that now calls himself Bah'Ktar toying with the powerful energies that summoned these Rynthid to Dereth.
Reason and logic will have no influence on this creature now that the cloaked demons have altered his consciousness. This abomination must be destroyed.
Enter this creature's lair at 62.7S 66.6W and strike Bah'Ktar down...no other outcome is acceptable.
Return to me with the vile Crimson Scarab that corrupts him as proof of his demise.
I suggest returning when you are stronger.

greetings: Portal energy swirls throughout the chamber, littering the area with Tumerok loot as Bah'Ktar crumbles to the floor.
A twisted smile appears on Bah'Ktar's face as he looks your way.
Hmmm... Strange thing, this. Power feels, wrong, somehow...
Taraash shakes his head, as if clearing it.
Keep it. I do not trust it. Perhaps your Tribe has use for it.
Thank you again. With the stolen artifacts returned, Haraag cannot use to get other Tribes to follow him. Please, accept reward for help you have given us.
quest: Again I thank you for returning the artifacts. Please return to me later...
Hurry, I need those artifacts.
Hmmm... Winterborn sent you. I smell him on you and your friends.
Perhaps... Perhaps you can help. I trust you. I trust your friends.

There is Banderling, named Haraag. He changed recently. He changed a lot. Bigger, stronger, different. He come and try to get Tribes to follow him. Some choose to follow, we chose to fight. We drove him off. Chased him to cave. Then, he ripped a hole in the world and fled through it. Those who chased him through hole, did not return.
Now, those who choose Haraag come and steal artifacts of the Banderlings. If he get enough, he will use to get others to follow him. I want you all to retrieve those artifacts.

Near here, at cave to the east, you will find the hole in the world. Like those things you call portals, but worse. I have learned trick to protect you from hole while you travel to its end-place. Take your friends, who are group with you now, and go there. Inside, find Haraag. Retrieve what was stolen from us, and kill Haraag, if you can. Each bring back Artifacts, and I will reward each of yo...
Chief Taraash raises his hands, and a soft glow infuses %tn's Fellowship.
Now, go. And remember, if you leave group, you'll need new group and my blessing to enter hole again.
Why you here, eh? How I know I can trust you...
Hmmm... Winterborn sent you. I smell him on you.
Perhaps... Perhaps you can help. I trust you. You will need strong friends to help. Not a thing to do alone. Gather a group, come back, speak to me again.
The Banderling Guard Champion looks around, watching for threats.

greetings: Hoogan looks the blueprints over.
Alright, we know we need to dig to avoid these tunnels the Drudges dug here and here, but we don't have anything to dig with. If we had a shovel we could really get out of here.

Can you find us a shovel? I don't know what the drudges used to dig their tunnels, but maybe you can find a clue around. If you bring me back a shovel I'll give you this key we slipped off of Shanks when he was sleeping today. I think it leads into their tunnels below.
Remember, if you find a shovel be sure not to give it to anyone else. Bring it to me.
quest: The tunneling is going much faster now that we have the shovel you brought us. You should use that key I gave you to get into the Drudges under ground caves. I'm pretty sure their leader is down there. At least that's what Shanks let slip the other day. Thanks again human and good luck.
Hoogan bestows the title "Hoogan's Hero" on you.

Perfect! With this we can finish the tunnel we've been clawing and scrapping out under the bed in here. You've saved my skin friend. Take this key and bring the fight to the Drudges in their tunnels and caves below.
The Banderling leans over to the window and whispers to you.
You must help us. The Drudges have imprisoned us here. We've tried everything to escape, but they're always watching.

The only one whose been kind to us is Sergeant Shanks. We found out he knows where the blueprints for the Drudge Fort are. You may be able to "convince" him to give you the information if you bring him something tasty to eat. He tends to talk when he eats.
Hoogan has no need for this yet.

greetings: The fighter takes the ticket from you and rips it in two, storing it's half in a bag marked "Bets".
Harraag screeches in confusion and pain as he crumples under the force of %tn's deadly blow!
As Harraag's body crashes down, you hear the sound of something crystalline shattering apart.
You invade my refuge! Now you all die!!!
You have cleared out this Spawning Pool for now.
A Sleech appears from the void to aid the Blind Keeper!
Wounded, the Blind Keeper summons a Listris Sleech to his aid!
The fighter takes the ticket from you and rips it in two, storing it's half in a bag marked "Bets".
As the Fiend dies, it lets out a vicious sound. It's ward is unprotected, Morgluuk will send his personal guard of savages to investigate. This will weaken his lair.

As the Shaman dies, it lets out a curse in an unintelligible language. It's death throes will alert Morgluuk and he will dispatch shamans from his lair to learn of what happened here. His lair will be weaker.
Gruuk'lar looks the medallion over, sniffing at it.
There is strange magic on this. I will send it to our Shaman, and see what they can learn from it. Thank you. It is a clue, and with it, we may be able to track down more information.
Take this.
Gruuk'lar declares you an ally of the Ruuk.
quest: Return to me later traveler, as I may have more work for you.
Have you had any success in destroying the Falatacot who seek to control our world?
Greetings, traveler from Dereth.

Don't look too surprised that I know your language. We've had one of your people here for some time, teaching us of your ways. Teaching us of this metal you call 'Pyreal' and of how to engage in 'Commerce'.
But I digress. I'm no gatherer or 'merchant' to trade in such things. I'm a guardian of this small Tribe, and my Clutch helps protect and hide this place from the others.

There are four caverns which have become connected to this cavern via magic, "Portals" I have heard them called. They appeared the same time Torgluuk and Asheron disappeared, and occasionally Guruk come through them to attack us. I have sent hunters from my Clutch, but none have returned, and I can't afford to send more, as we must be ready to defend the village.

These Guruk who attack us seem to be being controlled by those your people call Falatacot. The False Gods of our hated Fiazhat enemies. Travel into these 'Portals', destroy these False Gods, and bring proof of their demise to me, and I will reward you.
Gruuk'lar looks you over.
Down the tunnel to the Southeast of here, you will find the portal to the Muggy Guruk Caverns.
There is a portal to the Northern Catacombs, down the tunnel to the Northeast of here. In the depths of those catacombs, you will find the portal to the Humid Guruk Caverns.
There is a portal to the Eastern Catacombs, down the tunnel to the Northeast of here. In the depths of those catacombs, you will find the portal to the Steamy Guruk Caverns.
There is a portal to the Southern Catacombs, down the tunnel to the Northeast of here. In the depths of those catacombs, you will find the portal to the Deep Guruk Caverns.

Haha, you wiped the floor with those Bashers! That should teach them to mess with the Ruuks of Kor-Gursha! They won't be back for awhile after that beating, but they may need another reminder not to eat our crops. They mostly think with their stomachs. Come back in a day.
Well done! You tallow skins can really hunt! Our harvest is safe! You deserve our thanks and a reward.
You will be forever remembered as a "Basher Slasher.
I see that the hunt is progressing! Keep up the good work, and return to me when you have killed all 40 Guruk Bashers.

The Guruk Bashers have been stealing our fungal harvest. I could really use your help clearing them out of the Eastern Catacombs. If you want to prove you're a real hunter track down and slay 40 of those lumbering Guruk Bashers and I'll reward you.
You did a fine job hunting down those Colossi.
Brogosh leans in conspiratorially and whispers to you, "I hear they eat their own dead."
He makes a grimace and shivers.
They won't be bothering us for awhile I reckon. Come back in a day, they always come back.
Good job! I bet the caverns are full of colossal corpses. That should keep them away from us for awhile. Here's the reward I promised.
You will be forever remembered as a "Dead Eye for the Colossi".
I see that the hunt is progressing! Keep up the good work, and return to me when you have killed all 30 Guruk Colossi.

Those Guruk Colossi have been stomping on our citizens! Prove yourself a hunter my friend. Search the Southern Catacombs and kill 30 of those colossal brutes! I'll reward you well for stomping them flat.

After seeing you hunt down those Guruk I'm not sure who's more fiendish you or them! You've certainly made them think twice about threatening our town. Come back tomorrow though, they may decide that it's safe to start their fiendish schemes again.
By the fungal roots, you humans can hunt better than anyone I've ever seen! Maybe you can stay around for awhile. Here's your reward.
You will be forever remembered as a "Fiendish Huntsman".
I see that the hunt is progressing! Keep up the good work, and return to me when you have killed all 30 Guruk Fiend.

If there's a more dangerous Guruk than the Guruk Fiend I don't know of it. They are more cunning than the average Guruk and stronger too. They've been trying to get into our town's caverns ever since Torgluuk passed through. Go and kill 30 of the cunning fiends lurking in the lower Southern Catacombs and I'll reward you for your help.
You cleared out those Marauders pretty well. They won't be bothering us for awhile. Come back tomorrow, I'll bet they'll need another lesson in respecting our territory then.
I'm impressed. I didn't think a human could hunt that well. You have helped insure Kor-Gursha's safety and for that you deserve our thanks and a reward.
You will be forever remembered as a "Ranger Ruuk".
I see that the hunt is progressing! Keep up the good work, and return to me when you have killed all 40 Guruk Marauders.

You need something to hunt? We have a problem with the Guruks invading our territories. From time to time we send hunting parties into the Catacombs to clear them out. If you want to prove you're a real hunter, track down and slay 40 of those despicable Guruk Marauders and I will reward you appropriately. They mostly forage in the Northern Catacombs.
I'm sure those monstrosities will crawl back from their holes soon enough. Come back tomorrow and I'll reward you for another hunting trip.
Thank you, I can sleep soundly for a time. Accept your reward my friend.
You will be forever remembered as a "Monster Killer".
I see that the hunt is progressing! Keep up the good work, and return to me when you have killed all 10 Guruk Monstrosities.

There are monsters lurking in the fetid recesses of the Southern Catacombs, huge and bloated with dark purpose. Take your weapon and hunt down 10 of the Guruk Monstrosities and I will reward you. Be careful human, those are dangerous caverns.

Thanks to you, the Guruk Smashers haven't been seen near our store houses recently. I'm sure they will return to destroy whatever they can get their stinking hands on. Come back tomorrow, I'll bet they'll need another lesson in respecting other peoples property.
Yes! Those vandals got what was coming to them! The store houses should be safe for awhile now. You deserve a reward.
You will be forever remembered as a "Guruk Hunter".
I see that the hunt is progressing! Keep up the good work, and return to me when you have killed all 40 Guruk Smashers.

Those Guruk Smashers keep destroying our fungal store houses. You should hear them laughing. I've gotten pretty good at hunting them, but I could really use your help. They hide out in the Eastern and Southern Catacombs. Track down and slay 40 of those infuriating Guruk Smashers and I'll reward you well.

greetings: You... You did it!
Thank you!
You have been awarded the title "Bosh Bosh Kibosh".
quest: Please return to me later I may need your assistance again.
Have you had any luck in locating Bosh Bosh?
Prepare to hunt down the most degenerate boil this land has ever been afflicted with. A Kukuur named Bosh Bosh has been stealing into our town at night and taking our young! He... eats them.
He must pay for every innocent life he has taken! He makes the Deep Guruk Caverns below the Southern Catacombs his home. Do not rest until you have hunted that filthy scum down and made him pay.
Do not fail me on this. Bring me proof of his demise and I will reward you well for your help.
If you find a mushroom bring it to me. I can teach you a thing or two about surviving on Bur.
Ooo a glowing one! These are delicious and they make good light snack. Whar har hoorg!
Furgal whispers a secret to survival on Bur to you.
Look upon my spores ye mighty and despair!
You have been awarded the title "Thrungamandius".
Good work. You deserve to be known for your harvesting skills.
You have been awarded the title "Mushroom King".
Good work. You really are an amusing fellow.
You have been awarded the title "Fungi".
You have been awarded the title "Mushroom Man".
You have been awarded the title "Fungal Farmer".
You have been awarded the title "Mushroom Collector".
Furgal taps the mushroom with his index finger. A cloud of spores puffs out and he eagerly breathes them in. A calm seems to envelop him.
Aaaaah. This is just what I need after a stressful day of dealing with humans.
No offense to you my friend. It's just hard to know what your type will do from one moment to the next.
Furgal squeezes the mushroom as if inspecting a piece of fruit for ripeness. He smacks his lips.
Good sponge on this one. I can't wait to see what sort of dish Doruuk can make with this!
Furgal holds the swaying mushroom in his palm watching it squirm about.
I love to eat these! They keep wriggling after you swallow them.
Furgal holds the Burning Mushroom up and eyes it critically.

Perfect! These mushrooms only start to burn this brightly when they are ripe. I'm impressed that you knew how to pick this mushroom. It's very hard to find and even harder to find one that's perfectly ripe.
I collect the mushrooms that grow in the Catacombs. We used to be able to harvest these ourselves, but then the Guruk invaded our caverns and destroyed our store houses so we retreated here.
We sneak out when we can to collect the food we need, but I'm worried the Guruk will eat all of the mushrooms and we might starve. So, I'm collecting a backup supply for the town just in case.
Go and find as many mushrooms as you can in the Catacombs. I'll reward you with the knowledge that will help you stay alive on Bur.

greetings: I welcome you to Kor-Gursha, human. You are a friend of Asheron, yes? These caverns are home to me and to my friends, who escaped the tyranny of the Kings and the evil magic of the Dark Ones. The others in these caverns could use your help, fighting against the things which threaten our home. My cousin Rheegur can tell you more about the history of Kor-Gursha.
A good life we have made, safe in tunnels under Bur.
Ah, you wish to learn about the history of Kor-Gursha. I am always happy to share our knowledge with newcomers.

Welcome, human friend of Asheron! Have you come to me to learn the history of Kor-Gursha? Give me a piece of parchment, and I will write it for you in your language. Are you surprised that a Ruuk would know your language? We are a surprising group here in Kor-Gursha...

Welcome, human! Welcome to our humble outpost! I am an expert in cutting the fabled Tiriun Mushroom into pieces - spores, cap, and stalk. Very delicate work! It would take you a lifetime to learn how! If you give me a mushroom, I will cut it into its component pieces for you.

Happy to meet you, human! Do you seek the prized Tiriun Mushroom? Very useful! I take trade notes for Tiriun Mushrooms and Ginger! I will give you one Tiriun Mushroom for a D note and five Tiriun Mushrooms for a MMD note. If you want Ginger, I will give you one Ginger for a CC note and five Gingers for an M note. Yes, I collect trade notes to do business with the glorious mercantile company, Ke...
Thank you. I shall put this to good use - save it for a time of need, rather than consuming it incessantly as the Kukuur do.
quest: Thank you for doing your part to stabilize our home. If you return when it is safe for you to enhance more mucor, I will give you more inert mucor to use.
Greetings to you who would help us. I can give you no more information except what I have already told you. If you have lost your inert mucor, however, I can give you more.

The smell of preparing mucor has faded from you - I can still tell you have ever done it, but it should be safe for you to go again. The cavern of the ley line is reached through one of the statues alogn the southern edge of the upper catacomb.
Here is some more inert mucor. Once again, do not consume it until it is prepared - it is dangerous otherwise.

I see that you are aware of the upper catacomb. Doubtless, you are also aware of the mana barrier within and what lays beyond? I have mused on how to remove the barrier, and I think I have a way. Listen closely.

The mana barrier must be powered, and most likely that power comes from what you term "ley lines". Asheron has told me of these things, and the Ruuk have in fact encountered them on occasion. The Falatacot have manipulated the ley lines of this world in the past for their own purposes, often eventually causing upheaval. I believe this is what has caused earthquakes and other disasters in the past.

You may have heard of mucor - the fungus that the shamans of the Burun consume for its power and recollection to the past? It does not begin as safe for consumption - it must be prepared. I think that if you were to siphon a small part of the power of the ley line into some inert mucor, it may disrupt the mana barrier for a short period of time - perhaps a day. By doing this, you would also be...
Be warned that one can only enhance mucor safely every so often. I would recommend that you wait a day after you enhance your mucor.

The ley line exists in a chamber off of the upper catacomb. There will be a Falatacot statue along the southern edge of the catacomb.  If you focus upon it and put into your mind the image of a cavern with a great glowing line, you will reach your destination.

I would take the enhanced mucor if you were to bring it to me. I cannot demand it of you, though. I also cannot tell you what effect enhanced mucor may have on your - you would have to try it for yourself. Finally, I'm told our weaponcrafter, Kuurak, has some ideas on how enhanced mucor might be used in weaponcrafting. Speak to him for more information on that.

Take this. But heed my warning. Do not consume it before you have prepared it within the ley line. It has a generally fatal effect on our people and, which you are different, I suspect it would harm you as well.

While I have an idea for a task you may wish to undertake, it requires traveling to the upper catacomb of the Falatacot. Speak to Scout Leader Tmauruk - he will tell you how to reach it, if he judges you able enough to survive there.
I see you have prepared mucor recently - you have the smell of it about you. If you wish to give me the mucor, you are welcome to do so, of course.
Here, take this.

Remember, mucor can be dangerous, even to Burun - do not consume it while it has not been properly prepared, and do not try to prepare more than one piece of mucor within a day or grave consequences may result. You should be safe to prepare mucor currently.

As you wish. Remember, mucor can be dangerous, even to Burun - do not consume it while it has not been properly prepared, and do not try to prepare more than one piece of mucor within a day or grave consequences may result. You should be safe to prepare mucor currently.

greetings: Jurukka, friend! I am Kuurak, the chief weaponsmith of Kor-Gursha. I have been trading my work to Dobblar in exchange for training in how to work with metal, so I am afraid I have no goods myself to sell.
Ah! But I do have something that you may be interested in!
Read that over! Discoveries to amaze the smallest egg or largest Kukuur!

quest: Jurukka, finder. We do not need your help in finding our shamans right now.
Have you found the rock in the southern catacombs? It is somewhat near the north of the top level cavern. Hurry.
Jurukka, finder. We have lost another shaman. If you would like to help, your help is welcome. Bring the chain back, same as before.
Again you aid us, finder! Our shamans owe you a debt of gratitude. But the bloodletters will surely try to kidnap our shamans again in the future, and we may need your help again.
Jurukka. I am Tmauruk, leader of the scouts of this tribe. While I would rather be away from the town scouting, Gruuklar has asked me to remain here and brief those of you who wish to help.

Torgluuk has been rescued, but the bloodletters continue to abduct the other shamans of the tribe. Torgluuk wants me to continue instructing you Derethians how to find the upper catacomb so that they can be rescued.

There is a rock in the southern catacombs, somewhat near the north of the top level cavern. If you push the rock aside, you'll find a very small corridor, impossible to see without knowing exactly what you are looking for.
Bring the chains that bound the shaman to me as evidence of their freedom.
Well done, finder! To have freed our people is a noble thing. We shall remember your deeds. If any more shamans are lost to the bloodletters, I will tell you.
You have been given the title 'Burun Liberator'!
Please return to me when you are stronger.

greetings: What this?!?!
Tibik screams!
Spiketooth!! Spiketooth mean! Spiketooth bite Tibik in leg! Wait!! Spiketooth Dead??? Oooh. Tibik reward you for this! Thankyou!!!
For your bravery, Tibik awards you the title of "Spiketooth Slayer".
quest: Less Moar now. Gathering easier. Thank you. If more Moar later, I ask you help again.
Tibik lets out a guttural croak.
Excellent! Tibik be sneaky now. Gather food for Kor-Gursha. Tibik reward strong hunter now.
Tibik declares you a hunter of Moar, and you receive the "Moar Hunter" Title.
You find magic door in Eastern Catacombs, near top. You go, kill Moar, come back, yes?

Me Tibik. Me gather food for Clutch and Tribe. Me find magic path to great food, but cave full of Moar! Moar bad. Moar eat Tibik. If less Moar, then maybe Tibik sneak and gather food. You kill Moar, hmmm... 25. You kill 25 Moar, and Tibik reward Strong Traveler from Faraway.

The Ruuk Ranger glares straight ahead and begins to howl!
%tn has struck a deadly blow to Bosh Bosh! The behemoth falls to the ground lifeless.
Bgaaaaaaaaawww...k
Squakzzzt!!!

Deep under the shores of Freebooter Isle, the Engorged Bloodstone has been destroyed by %tn and their allies!  The dark magics feeding on and holding the Empyreans trapped in portalspace have faded, for now.
The portal in the alcove splits in two, revealing a passage beyond.
As the Bloodstone shatters, two of the fragments spring to life!

Defeat 20 Guardians or Testing Grounds Bloodstones in order to retrieve a shard from the Prototype Bloodstone.
You try and remove a piece of the Prototype Bloodstone but fail. Grow in strength and return.

greetings: The rift pulses, and disgorges a creature!
The rift surges with crackling energy, and a creature appears!
The air becomes heavy with ozone, and another creature spawns from the rift!
The rift pulses, and disgorges a creature!

Human thing will not steal master's supplies!
Not Again!
Time for a little payback!
No! Don't take my belt you dirty humans!
I'm gonna bite me off some human ears!
The fighter takes the ticket from you and rips it in two, storing it's half in a bag marked "Bets".
I no talk to you. You are not Drudge and I told not to talk to not Drudge!
quest: Shanks gobbles the food in a happy dimwitted sort of way. He begins to babble about this and that.
Mmm! Slurp! Crunch! Munch! Those Biters think they special just because Klank give them blueprints to guard. Crunch! Munch! I could guard blueprints. No one gets nothing from me!
I named after my favorite food, Ursuin Shanks. So sweet meaty juicy! Do you have some?
This good, but you have any Meaties? They part of a balanced morning food. Those and apples.
I was one of first Drudges that learn to speak. My mother so proud. She call me "weeraawreee." That mean good smart son.
Mmm! This good! You have anymore? I not picky with food or drink. I like them all.
Chocolate makes me sick, but I love it. I don't blame chocolate for making me sick, it can't help it.`

greetings: Leave now humans or I burn you so bad you be dead!
You have defeated my child. Your kind shows just as much promise as the Martine creature did. Soon you will embrace the simple truth. Clarity and purpose will be paid for with free will.
Your time as masters of this land is at an end humans. You have no idea what is coming.
This is my throne room. I am BoneCrunch and that's my throne. There, tours over, now you die.
Your not part of the Plan!
Come! Protect your leader! Bite! Stab! Burn!
Stay away from my apples!
What? You call this loot? How come I never get your weapons?
The portal glows brightly released of it's restriction.
Kernel Klank shuts down the portal.
The force of your killing blow violently dislocates Ravenous Eater's jaw!
The force of your killing blow violently dislocates Insatiable Eater's jaw!
The force of your killing blow violently dislocates Engorged Eater's jaw!
You have killed an Invader.
The force of your killing blow violently dislocates Voracious Eater's jaw!
The force of your killing blow violently dislocates Abhorrent Eater's jaw!
The force of your killing blow violently knocks a sword out of the creature's stomach!
You have killed an Invader.
You have killed an Invader.

"It cannot be. I am the well of world blood given consciousness, your blades should not matter. It will not claim me. I am not of darkness borne. I will not fall to darkness. He means to cage me within his tomb of corruption. No! I will stand again, you cannot contain what I am!"
"You dare strike at me? My retribution is swift, is it not? But I sense that your spirit has not fled this world. How can I, the sum of power, grow weaker?"
"Severed from the cord that binds you to this world, you shall not return to hamper me; no, it cannot be, the strand of life stays."
"Another victim fallen into the stream that floods this world in form. You are no more. Not possible, I sense that your form returns. Perhaps the same will be of mine."

"It cannot be. I am the well of world blood given consciousness, your blades should not matter. I hear her singing. I hear the song that so long I have been without. No! I shall return, I now taste freedom, I shall yet rise again!"
The Prodigal Harbinger's death cry shakes the walls of the chamber, threatening to cave it in.
%tn has destroyed the Prodigal Harbinger!

In the northern Direlands are strange creatures called Gear Knights. One of them is known as the Iron Blade Overseer. Defeat him and bring his Aetherium Core here, so I may better understand these strange creatures.
Your next challenge is one of empowerment.  To continue infusing magics into the Paragon Gems, I will need an infusion of Luminance from you.

I wish to experiment with more efficient ways to cleanse the amber, and what is left will help fuel the creation of more Paragon Gems for you.
The ancient Colosseum uses a strange currency to reward those who participate in its games.  Bring me 1,000 Colosseum Coins to complete your next challenge.

Deep in the Oubliette under House Mhoire one can find a thing called the Spectral Fountain. Gather a Corrupted Amber from the Viridian Chasm below, and place it into the Spectral Fountain. Return to me with whatever result you find.
I am running low on Infused Amber with which to forge your gems. Your next task is to bring me 300 Infused Ambers, so we may continue.
Enter the Colosseum once again. This time, defeat the one known as The Master and bring me his token.
In the Obsidian Plains hides one of the Lothus Virindi known as the Curator of Torment. Defeat the vile thing and bring me the shard of his mask as proof.
Your next task is to bring me 200 Corrupted Ambers from the Viridian Chasm below.
My last experiments were promising, but incomplete. Also, as before, what is left will help fuel the creation of more Paragon Gems for you...

In the forests of Northern Osteth lies the spectral Fortress of Hoshino Kei. One of her generals, General Idah can sometimes be found inspecting his forces in the haunted towns around the outside of the fortress itself.
Your next challenge is to complete 30 'Legendary Quests' and then return to me.
And I see you have already proven yourself in this challenge. Well done.
Enter the colosseum and defeat the challenge of Gladiator Diemos. Once he is defeated, bring his token to me.

In the forests of Northern Osteth lies the spectral Fortress of Hoshino Kei. One of her generals, General Nobanuga can sometimes be found inspecting his forces in the haunted towns around the outside of the fortress itself.

In the forests of Northern Osteth lies the spectral Fortress of Hoshino Kei.  Find the entrance to her deepest sanctum and slay her. Once you have, bring her Mirror Shard to me.
I am running low on Infused Amber with which to forge your gems. Your next task is to bring me 400 Infused Ambers, so we may continue.

Your next challenge may be the most difficult yet.  Within the Viridian Rise, four Elite Guardians stalk the land.  Defeat one of these Elite Guardians and bring proof of their fall to me.  They have been driven by the Great Tree's pain, and their defeat will help set them free.
Your next challenge is to complete 40 'Legendary Quests' and then return to me.
In the place known as the Gauntlet there is a challenge to defeat a Doll known as Holcha. Defeat it and bring its token to me as proof.
Your next challenge is the last one of empowerment. To continue infusing magics into the final Paragon Gems, I will need the largest infusion of Luminance from you yet.
The ritual to empower the final Paragon Gem is a costly one. To craft your final imbue, I will need 500 Infused Ambers for the ritual.
When you have given the ambers to me, we will begin.
It is good to see this monstrosity dispatched.
Now, for your efforts, this is for you.
It is good to see you've succeeded. Hopefully Lord Cynreft's Shade finds some rest from the curse of the Book.
It is good to see even an aspect of that monster destoyed. To flagrantly wield such evil.
It is good to see you've suceeded. Hopefully Lady Tairla's Shade finds some rest from the curse of the Book.
Such an unusual creature. Very corrupt, but hopefully useful in figuring out ways to purify the guardians who've been lost to Sath'tik below.
Ah, you've succeeded. I hope you found it a worthy challenge, or at least a reprieve from all of the corruption I've tasked you to fight.
Ah, you've succeeded.  Thank you for this.  It will be interesting to study.
How fascinating. I wondered if it would unweave the corruption, but I did not expect it to do this.
You've returned. Thank you for destroying that creature. The damage it was doing to this Realm was extensive.
Welcome back. It is good to know another blow has been dealt against the corruptions of the Book.
Ah, you've succeeded. I hope you found it a worthy challenge, or at least a reprieve from all the corruption I've tasked you to fight.
Welcome back.  It is good to know that such a great blow has been dealt against the corruptions of the Book and its Avatar.
Thank you. The pain of the Great Tree has driven our greatest guardians insane, and it is a great sadness that they must die, but thank you. You helped free them.
Greetings, small one.
I am known as Summercrown, and I am the Master of the Amber Forge.
I use the energies of the forge, along with the blessings of the Deru, to craft empowerments for the Guardians of the Deru, scattered throughout Auberean.
The Deru have agreed that those who reach me in this place and aid us with the corruption that spreads here are worthy of my blessings.
To honor their wishes, I have forged their blessings into the Paragon Weapon Gems. These gems will empower the weapon of your choice with the blessings of the Paragon.
These blessings grow as the imbued weapon gains in experience, and as you complete my challenges, the gems I will craft for you will increase your Paragon Weapon's capacity to learn.

There are 50 challenges to fully imbue a Paragon Weapon, and 50 tiers of learning they can gain the imbue gems I craft. Every time you complete one of my challenges, you will be rewarded with a gem that will increase the level of your Paragon Weapon by 1.
Your first challenge is a simple and practical one. Bring me 100 Infused Ambers, so I may use them to forge the first few gems you will be earning.
Your next task is simple. Travel to the Colosseum, defeat it, and return to me.
Don't worry about those challenges that exist alongside the actual Colosseum. This challenge is only for the timed arena.
In the Lost City of Neftet, the brothers of the A'nekshen Guardians suffer in captivity. Seek entrance into the Sand Temple, and destroy the Mu-miyah Slave Master.

Oh goody, you found one. Come back when you have the whole deck.
Ooo, what's over there?
Haha!
A whole deck? You found all thirteen cards?
The Jester holds the cards to his ear and flips through them.
Yep, it's all there. Wowwie, You sure do have a lot of time on your hands!
I've already made myself a new deck. Since you went to the trouble of finding it you can have this one. First, let me charge it up.
The Jester puts the cards between his hands and begins to giggle. Sparks coruscate across his teeth and his eyes roll back into his head.
Now where did I put that spell? Ah, here it is!
The deck begins to glow and then brighten in stages.
The Jester's Eyes reappear and he hands you the glowing deck back.
There you go all, charged up and ready for fun and games!
You need to give it some time to recharge after you use it. An hour should do it.
Ok, get out of here kid. I have lots and lots of things to do.
Hooray! You pass the test!
Then the Jester says something so horrible your mind refuses to grasp it's meaning. A memory of ageless horrors fills your mind.
You are awarded the Title "Secret Keeper".
Now, I'm going to tell you a secret.
The Jester leans in close. You smell his sickly sweet breath.
The Blighted Dreamer is almost awake. His children walk the land. His eyes are everywhere.
It's coming. He opened the way and it can see us. Hide! Hide!
It doesn't really sleep. That's just how we think of it's long silences.
They all plan down there in the dark you know. He plans to extend his reach to the surface, to corrupt everything within his reach, lalala.
I'm sorry. I'm so sorry! If I had known. But I can't close my eyes anymore unless I see it and I can't sleep lest it take me over. I'm sorry...
I'm just a fool after all. I'm here to dance, joke and sing. I'm here to distract you from what's re*grk
The Jester clutches his mouth and begins to laugh uncontrollably.
I've decided to follow the spirits of my people. Some day I will figure a way to break this cursed life in which I am imprisoned. Then I will join my love Laylana in the next world.
The Blighted Dreamer" they call Him... It. If It dreams its dreams forge our nightmares.
H is for the way It hates all that's bright and warm.
O is for the sound you make when first you see Its form.
R is for the lesser man who dies upon first sight.
R again for greater men who fight its evil blight.
O is for the order foul who follow It for power.
R we see is lastly me who tolls the final hour.
It's a very special time. It's not often the puppet gets to meet the puppeteer.
That which rips and tears and eats is coming for the tasty meats. They run and scream and squish and crunch. Good times! The thing can't wait for lunch.
Listen up! You will all die when I sing the final song. I have to practice because they make me and I'm going to give a concert while it eats. It likes dinner music apparently.
I lost my marbles yesterday... I'm always losing them.
If you happen upon my marbles could you please return them to me?
I don't think I was very far from here.
Hey there little person. Have you seen my cards around? I had two decks, but I can't seem to find them. I probably put them down somewhere when I was talking to the lalas.
It's too bad, I think much more clearly when I can focus on something like my cards or puzzles and games and...
Hey there little person! Gosh you people are everywhere. I was just talking to one of you.

If you find a whole deck of cards can you bring it back for me? I promise I won't turn you into a frathock if you do. I might turn you into something else funny though. I can't swear I won't, but definitely not a frathock, which is a big deal since they are my favorite.
Okay bye now.
Hey! This is what I need! How did you know? Oh wait, I sent you to get this didn't I?

The Jester holds the core in front of himself and begins to move his hands in alternating circles. The core slowly spins between his palms and you see lines of power pulse over it like a burning spider web.

Here, I need you to take this to a place I heard your people just broke into. Rythy's Private Library may have something he kept the Book of Eibhil in. I need you to get the sphere as close to whatever he kept it in.
AHahahahahaha! You should see the look on your face! You remind me of a pet Grobbit I had when I was little. Yes you do! Roll over! You can't have a treat if you don't roll over lalala!
The Jester stares into the distance with his head cocked to one side listening to something. Then he shakes his head and looks at you again.
The core should be able to absorb a small amount of the radiant energy the book gave off during it's stay in Rythy's Book Hole. Return to me if you are successful.
The Jester smiles and holds his arms out charitably.
I'll understand if you're captured and tortured, being still kept alive in a state of anguish for the rest of your brief life, and you're unable to bring back my K'nath Core.
I'm told you may need a seal to access his Library. I remember seeing something like a seal in a tomb's chest south of here.
Good Luck. Oh, and maybe if your really helpful I'll give you some cake.
The Jester takes the core from you and begins to juggle it with a bunch of colorful balls. His dexterity is nothing short of amazing.
Suddenly he grasps the K'nath Core and stares at it as colorful balls fall to the floor around him.
The core. You found where the book was kept.
He closes his eyes breaks out into a fit of giggles before getting himself under control and holding the K'nath Core before him.
Slowly a peaceful green light spreads through the core, overtaking its malignant red glow. The core's light now reminds you of sunlight seen through a canopy of rustling green leaves.
quest: You already have access to the armory if you feel like bugging the Smith. He used to love practical jokes! Or was that me? Anyway he's loads of fun!
I summoned a portal to the armory in one of the crypts here in the Graveyard. I'm sure you can find it.
Hey! You found my marbles!
The Jester holds the sack of marbles lovingly.
I missed you guys.

The Jester looks up at you and quickly stashes his marbles away. He then points down at the ground in front of you. As soon as you look at the place he is pointing to he smacks you in the head with a stamp reading "Marble Wrangler."
First you help me escape from that horrible prison. And now you found my marbles! You're trying to get on my good side aren't you?
Perhaps you have time for a little test? I promise it won't hurt.
Of course excruciating pain or death aren't really something I understand to well anymore... I'm sure it will be fine.
Somewhere through that portal you will find ten markers I've placed around. Simply touch every marker and return the final marker to me to complete the test.
I'm sure a job well done will be payment enough, but perhaps you might find something of value in the armory. And I may tell you a secret if you like.
Couldn't you find Rythy's Library? I need you to place the K'nath Core in whatever Rythy was using to store the Book of Eibhil in.
The Jester holds out an open hand and closes a finger for every statement.
Southern Graveyard. Ancient Chest. Seal.
Sentinel Statue next to Mage Academy Portal.
Find where the book was kept. This is important! Repeat these words, "Klatoo Veranda Nec#%@!
The rmaining word is difficult to hear as the Jester covers his mouth with his other hand.
Place core where book was.
Return core to grateful Jester who will give you some cake.
The Jester holds his now closed fist to his chest in a salute.
The lalalas are back. They're playing games behind my eyes. Go away! I don't want to do that! I just want to be alone for awhile.
Have you ever been in a crowded room with so many people talking loudly that you feel the sound close in on your thoughts like a heavy uncomfortable blanket?
That's what its like for me all the time.
Laylana! Where did you go? I think this is where I'm supposed to meet you. Shut up all you lalas! I need to warn her. So close! Just beneath us.

Old Rythy's a slave to his curiosity. The book has corrupted him and he doesn't even realize it. It wants him to read the spells. If he does, all is lost and I will sing to what remains as it eats its fill.
The floating tower was where Rytheran cursed me so long ago. He must have moved it here after my imprisonment to perform his experiments on my people.
He will pay for what he has done.
Oho! Rythy doesn't know what he's playing with. But I know. I KNOW! AHahahahahaha!
Why won't you leave me alone? Let me die. Please! Please stop talking! Lalalalalalalalalalala! I can't hear you! LALALA!

I can't think with all these lalalas in my head. I had an idea that might shut them out, for awhile at least. I believe that one of the mana suckers feeding on the exposed ley line may have the first thing I need.
The ley line is North of here. It's quite dangerous having it exposed like that, be careful.
Thanks friend! You really did me a favor. Hmmm, what could I do for you. Hey did you ever wonder what it would be like to have six arms? Tentacles? Feelers?
Eh, too much trouble. Here take this Pal.
The Jester waggles his finger in your face.
Naughty naughty! You tried to trick your old pal the Jester! I already gave you a present! You need to learn a lesson little one.
Jester tells you, "This will hurt you more than it hurts me."
The Jester halls back and punches you in the head leaving the title, "Jester's Fool", stamped there.
The Jester stares you in the eye. A horrendous understanding begins to bloom within your mind. Just as you feel your last grip on sanity coming loose the Jester giggles and looks away.
I found this key and the voices told me I should give it to you.
You have been awarded the title Jester's Accomplice.
Thanks for amusing me for awhile! Better luck next time with the whole imprisoning me for eternity thing!
It is too soon to use such potent magics apon you.
Your free skill reset has already been used, and you must be capable of earning Luminance before you may adjust your skills again.
Let me know if you change your mind.
