greetings: As %s smites the Firestorm, the flame-creatures sigh, and begin to disappear back into the submerged vents and fumaroles they surfaced through. The lake of Mount Esper is peaceful again.

As %s smites the Hellfire, the subterranean creatures sigh, and begin to disappear back into the vents and fumaroles they came up through. Mount Lethe is peaceful again... or at least as peaceful as it ever gets.

As %s smites the Hellfire, the flame-creatures sigh, and begin to disappear back into the vents and fumaroles they surfaced through. But, from the base of the mountain's slopes, you hear the whisper of falling ash, and the clacking of petrified bones...
Consumed in flames again. The world bends to HIS will now. Not even the oldest can touch his power. We shall not fail in bringing him to the sanctum.
%s has defeated Strife, the Essence of Flame, repelling Gaerlan's forces back from the cities of the north...for now.

This is not right. My essence, my being. Something is wrong. The master. The master has betrayed us. My essence, my freedom. I was. No more. I am nothing again. Less than nothing, I am harvested. A vessel has been prepared.
%s has defeated Strife, the Essence of Flame. Its form is driven from the world and Gaerlan's forces are routed at Glenden Wood, Plateau Village, Stonehold, and Arwic.
You are not worthy of the lowest of my children. A flare would claim your flesh as its fuel.
I am magic given life. I am the essence of war, strife and consumption. I am flame personified! Your parlor tricks would be better aimed elsewhere.
%s has defeated Strife, the Essence of Flame.
As the elemental creature collapses you feel space fold in on itself. It feels like your gut turned inside out as you're ripped back through portal space.
It is not for me to teach you more. Seek another.
Use this gem to improve strength innate.
One should study the inscriptions before one attempts to activate it.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
To improve strength innate, bring an augmentation gem to me.
Seek out Fiun Rehlyun should you require a blank gem.
It is not for me to teach you more. Seek another.
Use this gem to improve endurance innate. It is suggested that the reading of inscription be thoroughly examined before proceeding.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
Improved endurance can be achieved with the assistance of an augmentation gem.
Seek Fiun Rehlyun should the acquiring of a gem be needed.
It is not for me to teach you more. Seek another.
Use this gem to improve coordination innate.
As with any such things, it is advisable to read the inscription before drawing upon the powers contained within.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
AAs with any such things, it is advisable to read the inscription before drawing upon the powers contained within.
If the improvement of coordination is what is required, bring me an augmentation gem.
If the finding of an augmentation is required, speak with Fiun Rehlyun.
It is not for me to teach you more. Seek another.
Contained within this gem lays dormant the power to enhance ones quickness.
It is advisable to read the inscription on the gem before proceeding with its use.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
To improve quickness innate, bring an augmentation gem to me.
It is not for me to teach you more. Seek another.
To obtain focus one must use focus. Concentrate your thoughts upon this gem and the power within shall be passed on to you.
Instructions have been inscribed upon the gem and it is best for you to read them before proceeding further.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
If it is your wish to improve the focus of oneself, bring me an augmentation gem and I shall empower it thusly.
Fiun Rehlyun should be sought for information upon how to obtain such gems.
It is not for me to teach you more. Seek another.
Empowered with my teachings is this gem. Use this to improve one's self.
Forewarned are you to read the inscription before using.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.

The inner workings of the mind can be difficult to comprehend. My life has been dedicated to such. Perhaps if you were to bring me an augmentation gem I may be able to impart some of my findings unto you so that improvement of self can be reached.
Fiun Rehlyun may be asked if you do not have a gem.
Ah yes, the Master Arbitrator at the Colosseum spoke with me about this.
You wish to improve yourself? Enhance those abilities which might otherwise languish? Return to me the Jaw of the Insatiable. Prove yourself.
quest: One has already proven their worth of that which we would teach.
The highest peak of the deadliest isle contains that which you seek.
One who obtains such as this is truly worthy of that which we would teach. The highest peak of the deadliest isle contains that which you seek.
Fiun Rehlyun closes its eyes and whispers. You feel a subtle vibration within your chest for but a moment, then it is gone.

greetings: Perhaps this key may help to find an element of the machine? The Small Empyrean Vault may be a good place to look. This vault may be found at 80.4N 74.0W.
Perhaps this key may help to find an element of the machine? Ruschk Iceberg may be a good place to look. You may find the iceberg at 96.3N 60.0W.
An odd artifact.
Look. These runes can be translated to Undead Temple. Perhaps this object will be useful there.
Did I give you the recipe prior? Make the machine whole and return to me.
quest: Perhaps you may help again at a later time.
Have you any luck in finding the artifacts friend?
You have assembled the machine! This day is great for us. Perhaps maddened kin will be maddened no more. We owe you much, Isparian.
You come to Silyun, Isparian? Are you no friend of the Slayer?
The Slayer has unleashed the Eaters upon us. They hunt us as they did in the land before. Those they do not kill, they madden instead.
But there may be a cure. The mages who graced this land prior crafted marvelous artifacts - items of great power. Find these items. Create the machine. Perhaps we may cure our maddened kin.
Luck to you and your mission friend.

greetings: You hand the Research Notes to Senior Sage Shibak and tell him of Abayar's fate.
Grim tidings do you bring this day.
Let us hope that Abayar's sacrifice helps to undo the curse we Fiun have brought to Dereth.
My thanks for your services.
Do not be saddened by Fiun Abayar's passing.
The notes you have returned have provided much insight. Perhaps a solution may even be close.
quest: Let us hope that Abayar's sacrifice helps to undo the curse we Fiun have brought to Dereth.
My thanks for your services. Please return to me later as I may need your assistance again.
You can find Fiun Abayar at 92.1N 46.3W. Return to me with what he has spoken.
I am Senior Sage Shibak. I welcome you, Human.
Tales of your great deeds have spread wide and far. Long have I awaited your arrival.
Shibak stares at you silently then continues.
Please return to me when you gather more experience human.
We of the Fiun have long labored to rectify that which we are the cause.
To that end we have dedicated our lives so our fate does not become yours.
That is why it is with great concern that those that would save this world have fallen silent.
Perhaps one such as yourself would help me?
Speak to Fiun Abayar and return with that which is spoken.
The place of which you must seek lies at 92.1N 46.3W and is barred from those not invited.
Shibak touches your forehead with one finger and whispers faintly.
I have opened the way for you.
Hurry. Much importance is of the knowing.

greetings: Need this you will. The Great Frost Tree can not be cut with an ordinary axe.
It must be ignited by Ruschk Fire before it can be used.
This is the thief? This would be the desecrator?
He must pay! He must give us back the Light of the Fiun! He must die! You must take Lunnum back from this foul snatcher of hopes.
Hurry, you need to find the thief who stole Lunnum. She must be returned to the light! The thief was fairly large, perhaps it left some footprints nearby.
The thief has been slain, but I gain no joy in this. She is still lost and I will die without her light.
You have done well in finding the snatcher of hope and you deserve what rewards I can give you.
I have word that Fiun Layeel at the Fiun Outpost whishes to speak with you. Please, leave me now. I must find a way to find her.
quest: This will do. I thank you.
Please accept this gift for your service.
You have aided me in re-stoking the pyre and finding Lunnum's thief. Please, leave me to tend the pyre until something more I need of you.
LunnumsDisappearanceCompleted0106@%tqt

You found the thief, but you didn't slay him? I have great respect for life so I can see why you made such a decision. I however do not hold this Andrilos to be worthy of sympathy. He is beneath contempt.
Be that as it may, you have done what you believe is right and I must respect that. You found the snatcher of hope, but her light is still lost to me.
I have word that Fiun Layeel at the Fiun Outpost whishes to speak with you. Please, leave me now.
Place this on Lunnum's Pyre I shall. Thank you.
Hurry, you need to find the thief who stole Lunnum. She must be returned to the light! The thief was fairly large, perhaps it left some footprints nearby.
LunnumsPyreQuestCompleted0805@%tqt
It is for me to welcome you to this place of sadness. I am Fiun Gaya, Keeper of the Light.
With Lunnum missing my heart is an empty black, still my duty must be fulfilled. My duty, my purpose, is to be sure that the light of Lunnum's Pyre remains bright and pure.
To my sorrow, the ravages of time have consumed this old one.
No longer can I make the journey to re-stoke the fire eternal. Respectfully, I ask for your help.
A Fiun Hatchet, you will need. Retrieve one from this chest.
If you would hear of a dark deed then ask me you must.
Another favor I might ask. Should a Snow Lily be found, perhaps you may bring it to me?
Good journey, friend.
A dark deed must you uncover.

In the night a thief crept to the Pyre while I slept. Awoke I did, the moment the Pyre was disturbed, but quick and sneaky was the thief. It stayed in darkness, but managed to snatch Lunnum from the light. I raged at the thief, but alas I was too weak to stop it. I remember red eyes and then the fog of dreams.
My need is to be here and keep the light. Your need is to catch the thief and return Lunnum. Please, find the thief, she must be returned to the light!
Fiun Gaya starts to weep uncontrollably.
These were Fiun Lunnum's favorite flower. Delicate and pale as her skin.
It is with sorrow that I did have to end her existence.
Before judgment is passed, an explanation is needed. Please listen.
Long ago on our world, we Fiun were a proud race.
Great achievements were ours and our society did flourish, but arrogant did we become.
Fiun Gaya's eyes turn to stone.
Gods we thought ourselves to be and so we tried to create life that was equal in beauty to us.
And that is how the abomination called the Eater was born.
Nearly destroy us they did and our home they now have, as the last of the Fiun fled here to Dereth.
And so followed the Eater.
Not only did we doom our world, we have now also set this world on the same path of destruction.
So it was with great amazement, that for all the evil that we had done, there was still talk among the Fiun of rebuilding our society. Deserve to live we did not.
So I killed she who had done no wrong...my beloved Lunnum. I stand here today in penance for my deeds.
You are not powerful enough to assist me.

greetings: Why, it's one of the old crowns. I haven't seen one of these since we came to this world. Thank you so much for giving me a small memory from home!
Layeel takes the recipe and reads it.
This isn't enough to directly tie Nuhmudira to the theft of Lunnum, but I may be able to use this to scry for places this note has been.
Layeel holds the recipe to his chest and slowly turns around chanting something unintelligible beneath his breath. His eyes grow hazy and unfocused and he slows to a stop facing east.
I have scryed a strong connection to a place located in the eastern end of the Osteth Mountain Range. Travel to 84.3N 24.7E and seek out what lies there.

I have one more favor to ask of you. If you find that Lunnum's corpse has been desecrated in any way I would have you destroy it rather than see it returned to Fiun Gaya in such a state. Better that he never sees such a sight.
quest: It is a shame what became of Lunnum. Thank you for your help in uncovering the truth of her disappearance.
You showed wisdom and compassion by not taking the Huntsman Andrilos's life. I wish to further reward you for your understanding and control.
Say nothing of our investigation to Gaya. We all miss Lunnum, but Gaya's morbid obsession has cost us too much and it ends here.

Thank you for finally finding what became of Lunnum. Do no tell Fiun Gaya of her undeath, I fear he would be unable to deal with the truth. It is better he should keep the pyre burning in her memory. Perhaps you could visit him and provide him some solace by helping him keep his pyre.
You must wait %tqt to assist me again.
You will find the Temple Entrance around 84.3N 24.7E.

I wish that you had not killed that innocent man Andrilos. May you take this as a lesson that people should not be judged without a sound body of evidence. Vigilantism is blood thirst masquerading as justice.
Please assist me in finding the Blue Face Paint Recipe.
Search around Nuhmudira's Mansion at 4.0S, 36.0E.
At this time, my friend Gaya needs your help more than I.
You will find him tending Lunnum's Pyre on the Isle of Ruin at 89.1N 47.6W.

greetings: There is no more master but we are still. We are the essence of the chill, ever shall we return.
We are the memories of the first given form. You cannot defeat us for our souls live on. Remember well this chill for it will be with you always.
You tear asunder the very fabric of what is. Pull at the threads, my death shall be heralded by the birth of another.
Even in this climate I shall be reborn. I am the essence of true preservation and so I shall return to place you lovingly within my eternal embrace. You shall be my most prized treasures.
%s has defeated Stasis, the Essence of Frost, repelling Gaerlan's forces back from the cities of the south...for now.

I have thought and speech, and you would take this from me. I offer you forever. You make my time so brief. But you cannot destroy what I am. I am the Master's guardian. I cannot be removed by the means you possess.
%s has defeated Stasis, the Essence of Frost. Its form is driven from the world and Gaerlan's forces are routed at Qalabar, Kara, Khayyaban, and Mayoi.
You are feeble, a neophyte. You know not what it is you tamper with.
Etched in time forever. You shall slumber, encased within my hold eternally.
Frustrating that I have taken so many of you but still you rise to face me again. I am not yet finished. Hardly weakened. I am still full of life and living. There will be a reckoning.
%s has defeated Stasis, the Essence of Frost, repelling Gaerlan's forces back from the cities of central Osteth...for now.

This is not right. I am the master of stopping the decay, burning the flesh with freezing. I am the one that maintains eternities claim. The master has betrayed me. I live but for him. A vessel has been prepared!
%s has defeated Stasis, the Essence of Frost. Tempest, Corrosion, Strife and Stasis have all been destroyed. In Yanshi something stirs.
I am that which you cannot hope to tame. I have no master and will not be made slavish to your magics.
As the elemental creature collapses you feel space fold in on itself. It feels like your gut turned inside out as you're ripped back through portal space.
The Gear Knight shudders to a stop and begins to rattle. In a fading voice, it intones, "Power core critically damaged, fragmenting. Protocol fails. Uploading to backup."
The Gear Knight turns to attack and announces, "Isparian allies of traitor Asheron detected. Commencing combat protocol. Die, betrayers, die!"
Bah, I have not the time or inclination to foolishly chase you all over this blasted landscape.
What's this you have here?
Atamarr turns the power core over in his hands several times.
It saddens me that it has come to conflict. One can only hope that our efforts will put an end to this quickly.
Allow me to reward you. I am told it is customary here, and the good Master Crafter has provided me with the means to do so.
quest: You have done myself and my people a service. For that, I thank you. When another opportunity arises, I will let you know.
My scouts tell me you have been successful with the removal of the Iron Blade Warmaster. This should slow their advance until they can find a suitable replacement.
Thank you for your assistance with this. I know he was a tough adversary. Allow me to reward you.
Your mission is to eliminate the Iron Blade Warmaster.
My scouts tell me you have been successful with the Copper Cog Craftsmaster. I will monitor his actions, and aid him where I can.
Thank you for your assistance with this. I know the task he sent you on was not a simple one. Allow me to reward you on his behalf.
Your task is to establish contact with the Copper Cog Craftsmaster.
My scouts tell me you have been successful with the Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander. I will monitor his actions, and aid him where I can.
Your task is to establish contact with the Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander.
My scouts tell me you have been successful with the Silver Scope Spymaster. I will monitor her actions, and aid her where I can.
Thank you for your assistance with this. I know the task she sent you on was not a simple one. Allow me to reward you on her behalf.
Your task is to establish contact with the Silver Scope Spymaster.

I have a task in which you may be able to aid me. I have managed to subvert a small number of Gear Knights in the Iron Blade's invasion, and they have identified a Gear Knight in a position of influence within the forces whose loss would slow the expansion of the Iron Blade.

There is an Iron Blade Warmaster who has recently arrived from our home realm. My spies tell me that he is a gifted tactician, and if his skills were given time to be exercised, it could spell trouble for us.
You will find the Warmaster deep within the excavations that the Iron Blade have made in the heart of the area they control in the Direlands.

I would expect he will not be easy to kill, so take care in this mission. I have also been told that he stays on the move, speaking with the troops and formulating plans, so he may be difficult to find. Search in the deepest areas of the excavation, and I am sure you'll find him soon enough. Once he is dead, return to me.

I have a task in which you may be able to aid me. I have managed to subvert a small number of Gear Knights in the Iron Blade's invasion, and they have identified a Gear Knight in a position of influence within the forces that may be convinced to end his involvement with the Iron Blade.
The Copper Cog Craftsmaster they have recruited is of a practical nature, and may be amenable to a truce if you were to prove your worth.
You will find the Craftsmaster in the excavations that the Iron Blade have made in the heart of the area they control in the Direlands.
Go there, and try to establish relations.

The Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander they have recruited is known to me, and I believe him to be a very honorable and rational Gear Knight. I would approach him directly, or send one of my spies, but the Iron Blade Commanders have spread many stories about the Isparians manipulating and controlling those of us who have been recently repaired. I believe it'd be far more convincing to have one of...
You will find the Knight-Commander in the excavations that the Iron Blade have made in the heart of the area they control in the Direlands.

I would expect he will demand some sort of proof. I ask that you follow his requests, and let him come to understand your people as I have come to. Once you complete whatever tasks he sets before you, return to me.

I have a task in which you may be able to aid me. I have managed to subvert a small number of Gear Knights in the Iron Blade's invasion, and they have identified a Gear Knight in a position of influence within the forces that may be convinced to end her involvement with the Iron Blade.

There is a Silver Scope Spymaster who has recently arrived from our home realm. She is a very skilled Spymaster, and I believe she already suspects that the information being imparted by the Iron Blade may be less accurate than it should be. With a little help, she may be convinced of the truth, and aid us in ending this invasion. I wish you to go and tell her about the Apostate Virindi, their...
You will find the Spymaster in the excavations that the Iron Blade have made in the heart of the area they control in the Direlands.

I would expect she will demand some sort of proof. I ask that you follow her requests, and let her come to understand your people as I have come to. Once you complete whatever tasks she sets before you, return to me.

greetings: Ahh, that's what I hoped for.
Kaytin sifts through the box quickly, pulling out several innocuous looking parts, and assembles them together into something reminiscent of a key. He then plugs the key into his torso.

It will take some time to decode this information, but I thank you for retrieving it for me. Allow me to reward you. I am told it is customary here, and the good Master Crafter has provided me with the means to do so.
It is an honor to speak with you, small one. I am Kaytin, one of Atamarr's entourage, as well as his acting supply officer.

In Atamarr's quest to rebuild and maintain the rest of our companions, I have been given the task of collecting parts retrieved from those Gear Knights who are acting against this place and its people.

To this end, I am rewarding adventurers for the collection of Aetherium Power Cores, Aetherium Ore, and Gears from the invading Gear Knights found in either the Direlands, or along the coast of the eastern shore of the Inner Sea. If they wish to present themselves as enemies to the peoples of this land, they can at least be put to more productive use in deactivation.

If you wish to assist us, just bring me whatever Aetherium Cores, pieces of Aetherium Ore, or Gear Knight Gears you find, and we will reward you when you've contributed different set amounts of parts.

Also, if you are willing, I have a secondary task for you. The Iron Blade invasion in the Direlands will have a storage box placed deep in their defenses. It is common for their House to hide updates, orders, etc. in these boxes, where they will go unnoticed by invading forces.
Acquisition for me one of these boxes, and I will see what we can learn about their plans and reasonings in this invasion.
quest: Thank you for your assistance.
The stockpiling progresses well. Please find me more Aetherium Ore, Power Cores and parts from the Gear Knights invading Dereth.
You've handed in at least fifty Aetherium Ore pieces, Aetherium Power Cores, or Gear Knight Gears. Here's your reward.
You've handed in at least a hundred Aetherium Ore pieces, Aetherium Power Cores, or Gear Knight Gears. Here's your reward.
You've handed in at least a hundred and fifty Aetherium Ore pieces, Aetherium Power Cores, or Gear Knight Gears. Here's your reward.
You have been of great assistance to me in this endeavor. May you always be known as an ally of Primus Atamarr's House, for the assistance you have imparted to him this day.
You have been awarded the title, "Ally of the Gold Primus".
Tell the Gold Gear Primus what has transpired between us, and that we may be seeing him soon, under a banner of truce, to hear his words on this.
I don't know why you're here, but you seem peaceful enough, for one of the body-thieves.

You quickly explain about the Gold Gear Primus, the Apostate Virindi and the Simulacra, and how the Apostates are endeavoring to frame the Isparians for the deaths and disappearances of the initial Gear Knights through the Gate.
I don't know if I believe your words, but I believe I can test your truth through your actions.
There are a group of beings that appear to be of your race, camped out over a set of excavated ruins, north of here. They have been cutting down our soldiers, and carting off the bodies.
The Iron Blade won't let anyone outside of their House near this camp, though they battle with the body-thieves there constantly.

I've heard one of the scouts mention a being that matches the description of this Virindi you mentioned, entering the ruins. Bring me something of its that I may examine. There may be a great deal of info about our enemies I can learn from it, if this story is true.
Help! I'm under attack! To arms! To arms!
So, this is from that Virindi creature? Let's see what we can learn from it...
The Copper Cog Craftsmaster attaches a pair of small devices to the mask, and fiddles with small gears that protrude from the devices surfaces.
Well, this is interesting. It seems some of the creatures memories are stored in this mask, and that they can be deciphered with some effort.
I will bring my findings to the Commanders. I know they will see reason. We may have good cause to be in this realm, as our brethren have indeed been taken, but we may be after the wrong beings here.
Come back when you have the mask of the apostate overseer.

greetings: Well met! I am Squire Tylaen, of the Copper Cog under Primus Atamarr.
I am here to both keep an eye on yon northern invasion force, and to reward those who are already Allies of the Gold Gear Primus for further aiding us in resupplying our forces.

To that end, if you are already an 'Ally of the Gold Primus', I will trade you Ornate Gear Markers, which can be used with our Quartermaster, in exchange for the Aetherium-infused Gears that can be retrieved off of the adversarial Gear Knights to the north of here.
Bring them to me, 10 at a time, and I'll reward you for them.
quest: Ahh, that's what I am here for.
Thank you for your further aid to our cause.
Return to me when you have at least 10 of those gears on your person, and we can trade then. My Lord Kaytin has not authorized me to make partial trades of any kind. My apologies.

greetings: As you reach towards Kul Bronzegear, the Gearknight begins to speak.
Purge the flawed. They must be exterminated.

quest: Come back later and I might have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Excellent work my friend! The Rynthid's operation is sure to be hamstrung after losing such a vast amount of Aetherium.
This war is far from over, but we have made great strides forward today.
Those vile Rynthid! They are amassing an army of Corrupted Gear Knights to use as their pawns. I cannot allow this travesty to continue.
Bringing their entire operation to a halt is far too ambitious at this stage, the Rynthid are extremely powerful creatures.
But, if we can disrupt their production, it may give us the edge we need.
Our greatest alchemists have created a liquid that will drain the energy from their Aetherium supplies and render it useless to any Gear Knight.

Several of our kind have infiltrated their ranks and discovered the location of their three largest stockpiles of ore. Take these vials, enter their Foundry and pour the Tainted Oil once onto each of the three Aetherium caches.
This is sure to slow their production and help save many Gear Knights from being further corrupted by the Rynthid.
Have you had any success?
You require more Tainted Aetherium Oil? Please try to be careful with this batch, our supplies are limited.
I suggest returning when you are stronger.

greetings: Alert! Intruder! Attack!
Turgos the Hunter scans the horizon, looking for adversaries.
I will not be lured away so easily.
Gearall the Shield scans the horizon, looking for adversaries.
I will not be lured away so easily.

quest: Tell the Gold Gear Primus what has transpired between us, and that we may be seeing him soon, under a banner of truce, to hear his words on this.
I know why you're here. I have seen Atamarr's spies, but have left them be, for now. Now, tell me what Atamarr has sent you here to tell me.

You quickly explain about the Gold Gear Primus, the Apostate Virindi and the Simulacra, and how the Apostates are endeavoring to frame the Isparians for the deaths and disappearances of the initial Gear Knights through the Gate.
I have heard some of this before, along with many reports that your people are trying to foist your guilt off on other beings. There is, however, a way for you to prove your words.
There are a group of beings that appear to be of your race, camped out over a set of excavated ruins, north of here. They have been cutting down our soldiers, and carting off the bodies.
My attempts to get Silver Scope Scouts into the area have been thwarted by my superiors. I am honor-bound to obey them, but nothing in my oaths says I cannot send you in for me.

See if you can find one of their messages. A group that size, taking orders from elsewhere, as you say, would need a line of communication open. I have not seen messengers entering or leaving, but the Portal Magic of this realm can explain that lack, easily enough. Any messages they have will likely be deep inside their encampments. Bring me one, and we'll talk further.
I know who you are. Do you not have a message from Atamarr?
Is this how they communicate? Interesting.
The Silver Scope Spymaster places the crystal into a small device, which seems to be pulling out and translating the information within the crystal.
Not too different from the Aetherium encoded messages my people sometimes use, though the language may take a little bit. Also seems a few defenses in the crystal to be overcome.

Once I have unlocked all of the information in that crystal, I'll see what I can do about getting the truth out to the troops. I have a bad feeling what I learn from the crystal is already known by the Iron Blade Commanders, and that worries me on several levels.
Tell the Primus what has transpired between us, and that I may be paying a visit to him soon.
Come back when you have the mask of the apostate overseer.
Tell the Gold Gear Primus what has transpired between us, and that we may be seeing him soon, under a banner of truce, to hear his words on this.
I do not know why you have come. Speak quickly, lest I call down the guard.

You quickly explain about the Gold Gear Primus, the Apostate Virindi and the Simulacra, and how the Apostates are endeavoring to frame the Isparians for the deaths and disappearances of the initial Gear Knights through the Gate.
I do not know if I believe your words, even though your voice rings of truth. However, there may be a chance for you to prove it.
There are a group of beings that appear to be of your race, camped out over a set of excavated ruins, north of here. They have been cutting down our soldiers, and carting off the bodies.
I would send my own forces to deal with them, but the Iron Blade are preventing those from outside their house from engaging that camp, and they will not answer as to why.
If these beings are Simulacra, as you say, then I wish for you to go and kill their leader. I am told he is called General Takaris.
Bring me proof of his death, as well as proof that he is not one of your own, and I will trust your words.
Our defenses have been breached! To arms! To arms!
What is this? Some sort of bag?
You explain to the Gear Knight that it is the outer skin of General Takaris, and it is how the Simulacra are formed.

Well, this is indeed something unexpected and profound. Thank you. I will take this to my brethren, and we will discuss how to proceed. My guess is that we will confront the Iron Blade Commander about this, but if there is duplicity at work here, I am not sure what that will cause in response.
It may be that some of us will be leaving here soon, and seeking out Primus Atamarr, to offer our apologies and support to his endeavors.
Tell the Primus what has transpired between us, and that we may be seeing him soon, under a banner of truce, to hear his words.
Come back when you have the mask of the apostate overseer.

greetings: %tn's blow drops the Iron Blade Warmaster to his knees, sputtering sparks and fluid. He then collapses into a heap.

quest: As the ice froze around me I found myself thinking I would never be free again.
Thank you for freeing me from this icy prison.
Please, tell me, when is it? I was frozen, solid.
Many years ago I lost track of time. We Gearknights normally keep perfect time.
The intense cold must have effected me.
I must thank you for freeing me from the ice.
Accept this crossbow, they are granted to our bravest warriors.

greetings: The songs of my sisters echo across eternity and I am left to rot: bound through the arts of ill-wind taught by sisters who had fallen to the call of the twisted dark. Thousands of years bound against my will to a tether not of my making, bereft of power and ability to purchase a final release, I have waited and watched within the walls of this prison.

The skein of her life now draws taut as she is stirred to action, re-exerting her command over these halls and drawing on the lives of those she once imprisoned. Through the countless years, most that were bound here against their will have become lost and slipped into madness, the echo of their lives now scattered dust and formless agony. Not I. Nor the sister wakened from her slumber.

She is given over to shattering the charlatan now standing in the stead of the Lady of Aerlinthe. My task remains unfinished, but my resolve renewed. Aerfalle's homunculus shows renewed strength and understanding, but is magic weaker than the strength of my order. My servitude is no more, I am free as is the Lady who once called these halls her home. Yet the walls ever remain my prison. She she...

Aerfalle's changes continue. Her flesh, the flush of youth and beauty once lost, regained. Far beneath the crusted land and molten fires of Aerlinthe, she returns to perfect her arts and shun, ever more, the curses of undeath. Drawing power still from those bound in these halls she leaves one vestige of herself here to follow.

Magic threads weave together on the head of pin and from that point tendrils latch onto the walls of Aerfalle's former home. They course through the aged and crumbling walls as veins siphoning lifeblood from the walls and all that trespass here. But, her mastery fails her, for her signature lay upon this single point of magic.

A signature that still lay within this keep, and with that source, I will tear wide the fabric of this space and hers and grant you access to Aerfalle to exact vengeance upon her for all the terror she wrought upon my order and my sisters.

Bring me this shard of magic, and I will open the way, but be warned, I will need to protect you from the dangers of such a tear, and to ensure that protection, I will need to temporarily bind you and your companions together for a time. You will need to be bound in Fellowship in order to hunt Aerfalle in her Sanctum. Thus is the nature of what I can do to gain you access to her.
I see you have defeated the cruel Lady and thus achieved retribution for those she has destroyed. A deed of such high measure must be rewarded.
I see the cruel Lady has been defeated. Hand me proof of your deed.
quest: You must create a Fellowship before I can open the way.
Light is not lost on this world yet. I shall enact my part of this bargain, outlander. Seek vengeance for the countless years, the suffering and the agony of those she has destroyed.
Blessings of Ithaenc go with you. You will find your gateway in the place where she once created her greater works, where now her shell of an apprentice resides.
The Ghost of Galaeral chants a few words, binding your fellowship together and settling a protective enchantment over you all.
Your Fellowship is now bound together for a time, and will be protected from the dangers of the tear for the next ninety minutes. Hunt well.
I must go now.

greetings: I failed them... I failed them all...
You must want this infused with Nether energies.

You must be from the mortal, Ciandra. She sent her apprentice to ask my aid in altering these stones. I can aid you, but I will need a source of Pure Mana to do so. The act of setting these stones against their creators is draining on my spirit, and would soon end my existence without the aid of the Mana.
I'll hold onto this, and make the preparations to this stone. Get for me a Decanter of Essence. They hold enough power for me to complete the process.
Oh, my brother's spear! Baranaith was my youngest brother. He was barely more than a child when we were taken to the slave pits of Haebrous. I failed him, most of all...
Take this spear, mortal, as an instrument of vengeance. I have infused it with some portion of my power.
Now go into the North Wing and seek out my brother Korogaith. You will know him by his axe.

This is indeed the axe of my brother Korogaith. He was just a few years older than Baranaith. He was a hunter and a woodsman without peer. He was the one who tracked down Grael in the wilderness... Oh, would that we had never found that accursed soul again but perished together in the snow...
Take this axe. I have infused it with some portion of my power, to serve as an instrument of vengeance against the dark powers that corrupted my brothers.
Now go into the East Wing, the last of the wings, and seek out my brother Hiranaith. You will know him by his mace.

Oh, my brother Hiranaith. This is his mace, with which he served in the town guard, before our father was forced to sell us to the imperial slavers. Hiranaith was a year younger than me, but twice as strong. He was my protector in the slave pits. Alas, I could not help him in his time of need...

I have infused the mace with some portion of my power. Take it and use it against the shadowy things which corrutped us. I give you also my journal, that you may know something of Grael, who was once our master and twice betrayed his followers.
quest: Ahh, yes mortal, this will do.

Farelaith drains the decanter. Glowing slightly, he focuses his anger against the Shadows into the Repaired Shadow Stone. The last, minor flaws in the crystal disappear, and the stone now radiates a gentle warmth, where before it was cold.
There, this should meet your needs, and be an instrument of my vengeance as well. Here
You have helped me already, have you not, mortal? I know your kind are quick of thought and short of memory...
You have my brother Hiranaith's mace? Please, give it to me, so that I know that he has been granted oblivion.
I have no need of this item.
You have my brother Korogaith's axe? Please, give it to me, so that I know that he has been granted oblivion.

You... Yes, you could help me, mortal. I need you to slay my younger brothers, who were corrupted into beings of Shadow by our former master, Grael. Please, you must enter this Temple of the Stirring Shadow. The temple has three wings, and one of my brothers serves in each wing. They have lost their names and faces to the Shadow corruption, but they still bear their own weapons... I was a mage...
Enter the South Wing first, and seek out my poor youngest brother, Baranaith. He wielded a spear in life, as he does now in the shadow. Bring me his spear so that I may know his torment is no more.
Purple and Black energy flows from Farelaith's hands into the stone.
I hope this serves you well, even though I feel the art of Void Magic is a dangerous area for Isparians to meddle in.
A warm glow flows from Farelaith's hands into the stone.
I hope this serves you well.
You must want this altered to attune it to life magics.
I see you have gathered the disturbed bones of at least 10 of the dead.
I will lay these unfortunate souls to rest.

In life I was one of a sacred order tasked with tending to the affairs of the dead. This once sacred place has been buried beneath the earth for countless eons. The recent upheavals that unearthed this place have awoken many angry spirits.
I dare not guess what corruption is unearthing this place and waking long dead spirits. The lords have not yet awoken, but they are restless. I fear this will grow worse.
The graveyard is in disarray, and it is disrespectful to the dead who are buried here. Many long dead bodies have been exhumed by the troubles here.

Each night corrupted bones are forced to the surface all over the graveyard. Destroy the corrupted piles to retrieve the uncorrupted bones of 10 unfortunate spirits. Bring them to me so I may lay them to rest and I am sure fortune will smile upon you.
Lord Cynreft has summoned me here to warn off those who would disturb him. I hope you are prepared!
Prepare yourselves! The Royal Guard of Lord Cynreft come forth to protect him! You have one hour to defeat the guard and battle Lord Cynreft Mhoire!
I await the one who used Lord Cynreft's key. If the one is not among you then begone.

greetings: The Sorceror Lord has appeared! We are doomed!
Lady Tairla Mhoire cries out, "Awake and attend me, my handmaidens, and join our dance!"
Why do you leave the floor so soon? I will not leave the dance!
Her corrupted form destroyed, the spirit of Lady Tairla appears.
Lady Tairla says, "I can linger in this place for only a short time. Come speak gentlefolk."
quest: I am sorry hero, but I have no more keys to give.
The endless dance of madness caused by this... corruption had ended, at least for a time.
I can not thank those who have given me this peace enough, however brief. Take my key and seek my hidden vault. The treasures there are yours.
I thank you for your grace and bravery.
Lady Tairla Mhoire bestows to you the title "Lady Tairla's Champion."

greetings: Lord Cynreft carefully reads the letter.
I wish that things were different for this poor woman. But, there is no chance of the Jester's release.
Long ago my house fled the vile corruption of Geraine and his court. I sought to protect my family and my people from the unnatural magics spreading through the other noble houses.

We came to this small island, an ancient and little used retreat of my people. Here I hid my house from the un-death spreading through our empire. Here I hoped to plan a means of stopping Geraine and his dark reign.
Then we were betrayed!
Lord Cynreft's ephemeral form suddenly coalesces and becomes almost solid. Grief and unspeakable anger rage within his eyes. Then he sags and fades almost from view.

My Court Jester, sharp of wit and nimble of foot, and lifelong friend, the last person I would expect to betray me, snuck away in the night. He met with Rytheran to bargain my house's secret location in exchange for power. I suppose he got his reward. I still don't know how that dark mage Rytheran did it, but he drove that treacherous fool mad with the power he instilled in him.

His mind broken, he returned to my court where he caused havoc and insanity. We finally trapped him, but the death he so richly deserved was now impossible. My most deadly spells had nearly no effect on him. He had grown so powerful he was no longer empyrean. He had become something horrible and everlasting.
I ordered him entombed for all eternity. And set guardians to watch over him.
I fear that I cannot grant the Maiden Laylana's request. It would be unthinkable to release him.

I do feel for her loss all the same. I myself lost those closest to me following the Jester's betrayal. I will let you deliver her Love Letter to the Jester, although it will surely mean nothing to his deranged mind.

Take this key. It will grant you limited access to the Jester. Be sure that you do not listen to his rantings. He may be insane, but he remains as clever a trickster as ever he was. Above all do not try to free him. I took great measures to insure he will never be released and you would surely die in the attempt.
I thank you again for your bravery in destroying my corrupted form.
His corrupted form destroyed, the spirit of Lord Cynreft appears.
Lord Cynreft says, "My time on this world is brief! Speak with me quickly heroes."
Despoilers! You will not lure me from my resting place!
quest: I thank you again for your bravery in destroying my corrupted form.
You have my thanks. My spirit is free from the corruption of this place. I feel at peace. I can only hope that I am not drawn once again into the corruption.
Lord Cynreft Mhoire bestows to you the title "Hero of House Mhoire."
I can only assume I have you to thank for this brief respite. Take this key. It will open a hidden cache of royal treasure hidden in the graveyard. Search for it.
Again I thank you for what you have obviously done.

greetings: Oooh. I love my red ball. Thank you so much!
Oooh. This is one of my favorites. Thank you!
I was so sad when I could not find this!
My snowman! Thanks!
Yay! My toy golem!
Someday I'll become a knight!
I am pretty sure I was playing here with my toys...
It's around here somewhere...
Do you see anything around here?
Hmmm. I think I left a toy near here...
I wonder if this is the place where my toys got lost?
My last toy was lying around here somewhere...
I have to go home now, but I'll meet you back where we first met. That's my favorite spot!
quest: Thank you so much for helping me find my toys! I bet I won't lose them for a whole week!
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.
You found all my toys! I can't wait for you to give them to me!
You found them all! Yay! Now my mother won't be mad... when she gets back.
I also found this coin, but it's no fun.
You have gained the title Amelia's Caretaker!
I think you're the best! My pet needs a new home and I think he would like you.
Let's go!
I need to get my toy box! I will be right back.

My mother told me she would be right back, but she has been gone a long time. When she finds out I lost my toys she will be angry. Would you come with me and help me retrieve my six toys if I can find where they were buried?
Go now. You have no business here.
You can complete this quest again in %tqt.
You try my patience outsider! Haven't you captured the Jester yet?
Have you mislaid the key I gave you?
No matter. Take this one and capture the fool.
Lord Cynreft is very angry with you. You are lucky he doesn't have me stick you down here! Ha!
You are as much as fool as the Jester for having released him. He is dangerous! And since you let him out you have to put him back in.
Take this key and these balls of fire. The key will grant you access to the prison and the fire balls may give you the edge you need to trap the Jester.

Make your way back to the Jesters Cell. I cannot help you with the prison's defenses. You got in once, you can do it again, eh? Once you reach the cell you must light a fire in the center of the room. The burning symbol will draw him in where you may be able to knock him out with the fire balls and capture him once more.
Be careful, he has many tricks. Go now.
Sorry, I don't have anymore to trade right now.
Begone! Only Lord Cynreft may visit the prisoner.
You have not heard of the prisoner? So powerful and so very mad. Once he entertained the court of Mhoire with his antics, but that was before the betrayal. Now he is imprisoned here for all time.
Oh, it won't do to have these things in everyones hands.
Here take this instead.

greetings: My Love, where have you gone?
quest: My love can prove his innocence now. We shall be together again someday. Thank you for your help dear.
You can complete this quest again in %tqt.
My love is free! You have set my soul to rest my dear. May others know you as I do, the "Jester's Emancipator."
Laylana sighs in relief.
Thank you for delivering my letter to my love.
Laylana leans forward and gives you a ghostly kiss on the cheek.
Tell me, will you free him?
I only ask you this because I know my love must have had a good reason for what he did. He was loyal to Lord Cynreft, I know it.
Thank goodness he will let you deliver my letter.
Please, deliver my letter to my love as soon as possible.
You found him? He is imprisoned? Oh, my love, what could have happened.
Please deliver this note to Lord Cynreft and then deliver this note to my love in his prison.
Hello, my name is Laylana. I would ask you a favor.

My love is missing. We are betrothed, but I have not seen him for so long. Please, you must help me find him. He was once the Jester to Lord Cynreft and the House of Mhoire. I fear that something horrible may have befallen him.
Thank you! I will wait for you here.
Laylana bows her head in grief.
Yes, I respect your decision to abide by Lord Cynreft's wishes.
You should be rewarded for all you have done for me.
Luckily I wrote several drafts of my letter to my love, please be more careful with this one.

greetings: The Corrupted Maiden wails madly as she explodes into shards of ice.
It is, isn't it? You've delivered me the combined essences of the progenitors... yes. I will free you as I can not free myself, I must remain to watch after my mistakes.
You have been granted the title of Beginning's End.
quest: You are imbued with the essence, you can use the lever and pass through while I remain... here.
You need not remain. Return to me, bring me the combined ingot of the progenitors.
Time whirls by, have I not seen you recently? Haven't you assisted me?
It has been so long. Time means not to me now. The taste of life I can no longer remember. I ran the experiments here, I created this prison for myself as I locked down the facility.
How have you come to be here? Where are you from?
You must not remain, you must destroy the progenitors. You must return to me with their combined essence. I will free you as I can not free myself.

I, in death, remain here, trapped. You need not remain. You must release the essences of the frost and fire. An aura of this essence will allow access to the progenitor chambers of frost, lightning and prismatic.
The essences of acid and electric, release them to become free... unlike me. An aura of this essence will allow you to use the lever to access the progenitor chambers of fire, acid and shadow.

greetings: The Spectral Handmaiden shatters into deadly ice shards!
You hear a fading voice in your mind, "Thank you for freeing me..."

Light is not lost on this world yet. I shall enact my part of this bargain, outlander. Seek vengeance for the countless years upon this 'appprentice' of our tormentor, for the suffering and the agony of those she has destroyed.

A whisper began in the darkness and wove, within mine ears, a mystery that woke my shattered mind. Discord gave way to logic as the hum of the soft sound set fire to the long dormant desire within a hollow and aged frame. I stirred, at last, reaching through the mist of ages and found an anchor there. A sister's song sung in perfect concert with the pound of a long dead heart aching still with...

Thus I rose and traveled these stone hallways, decrepit and crumbling from the weight of time and neglect wrought upon them by the cruel mistress who once kept them pristine and polished as a mirror. So vain was she once that her reflection must shine upon her everywhere and so the stone shone brightly in her time of breath.

Now, as I return to be at sister's side, she leaves the halls she kept in such perfect union to a flawed and lesser vessel: a guardian, student and imposter. A creation of dust, alteration and magics drawn from the annals of the Dericost. Strengthened further by Aerfalle's own understanding and communion with forces she has yet to fully see, understand and embrace, this straw child proves to be...

Galaeral, my sister in blood, redeemer and rescuer of my once lost soul seeks still to revisit vengeance on Aerfalle and seeks entrance to her true sanctum. Her voice freed me from madness and showed me that this prison is far from the worst fate for the Falatacot. For this, I take her place to seek vengeance on the imposter with the same instruments that have long split the glamour from the sh...

The dagger, which drew forth our Vitae, tore free our souls and placed upon us this curse must be given over to shatter the glamorous visage that shrouds the vessel left by Aerfalle. Bring me this and I will shatter the vessels strength and leave it in ruin as these halls.

quest: The destruction of the corrupt spirit of the throne was a great task. My thanks go out to you.
You may repeat this quest in %tqt.
You have completed all three tests of the Champions of Mhoire! The guardians have imbued you with the purest magical flame.
I can grant you passage to the inner halls of Mhoire Castle. Make your way into the throne room and use this flame on the Mhoire Throne.
The corruption will not be able to bear the purity and will reveal itself. Destroy it and bring one of its corrupt signet rings to me as proof of your deed.
The corrupted spirit is very powerful. You might want to bring a group.
In life I was the Seneschal of House Mhoire. In ancient times I walked these halls and served Lord Cynreft Mhoire.
When the vile Rytheran rained destruction on these halls he used the dark magic of his foul tome to corrupt the throne of House Mhoire.
This corruption is bound to the throne and bears his likeness to mock us. This aberration brings despair to the spirits of this place.
To destroy this corruption you must earn the purest flame by completing all three tests to prove your worth as a champion of House Mhoire.
Fight your way to the top of each castle tower and complete the tests there. When you have completed all three return to me.
You have not yet proved yourself in the test of the southeast tower.
You have not yet proved yourself in the test of the southwest tower.
You have not yet proved yourself in the test of the northwest tower.
You have used the pure flame on the throne yet you do not bear the ring of the corrupt spirit that bears Rytheran's visage.
The flames granted by the tests have been consumed, and yet the throne remains corrupted for the spirit bears all the rings.
Although you have failed in your attempt you may still yet succeed by joining another champion who bears the power of the three tests of Mhoire.
Well done, champion and defender of House Mhoire. You have cleansed the throne of House Mhoire, and countless spirits within these halls rest peacefully.
You have proven yourself a hundred fold, and I am in your debt. The corruption will remain clear of the throne for some time. Take these items as thanks.
You have been awarded the title Champion of House Mhoire!

greetings: I still remember when joy could be found in these halls.
quest: Your collection of Mhoire signet rings has eased the torment of the spirits here. I thank you.
You must wait %tqt before repeating this task.
I see that you have recovered 10 signet rings of House Mhoire.
Thank you, champion. the spirits that own these cursed rings will be allowed to rest peacefully for a time. Allow me to reward you.
In life I was a knight of House Mhoire.
In ancient days, nobles of House Mhoire were bestowed signet rings by Lord and Lady Mhoire to signify their nobility.
Many spirits were cursed so these rings would be lost in life and death. These spirits roam these halls forever restless.
These rings lay among the remains of nobles long dead, their bones strewn about the halls of Castle Mhoire.
Destroy these corrupted remains and gather 10 signet rings from the bones. Return them to me and I will reward you.

greetings: Dreams of the battles in these halls still haunt me.
quest: Your destruction of the corrupted guardians has eased the torment of the spirits here. I thank you.
You must wait %tqt before repeating this task.
Well done, champion. You must be skilled indeed. Allow me to reward you.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm corrupted gargoyles.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm corrupted gargoyles and I will reward you.
In life I was a knight of House Mhoire.
In ancient days, House Mhoire fashioned gargoyles, which is our heraldry, as guardians using craftsmanship and magic.
The corruption used to destroy this place also corrupted their magic. This cannot be allowed to continue.
Destroy %tqm of these corrupted gargoyles to ease the pain of those that wander these halls and I will reward you.
Greetings, once again.
If you wish me to further empower you, simply take one of the tokens here beside me, and give me the one that corresponds to the enhancement you wish.
If all is in order, and you are filled with the Luminance necessary to grow, I shall convert that Light into the enhancement that you wish.
Greetings to you. I was known once as Lady Adja, Seer of the Light Falatacot.
I am both honored by your gift and your desire to join the Path of the Light Falatacot. Shall we begin?
You feel the Light flood over you, and the Path of the Light Falatacot opens to you.
Welcome to the Path of the Falatacot of the Light! You may now gain the greater Luminance augmentations that our Path offers, once you meet any requirements the powers may have.
You may also continue to gain the more basic Luminance augmentations from Nalicana. As the youngest of the Seers, she treats with those upon any Path.
I can see that you are touched by the Light. 'Blessed with an inner Luminance', as we used to say.
The Light has brought me back to serve as the Seer of the Light Falatacot.
Though I was born millenia after the Light Falatacot left this world, I studied much of their ways, and learned many of their secrets in my life.
With that knowledge, I may set those who wish upon their Path as well, and use that bond to further empower them in the Light.
If this is your goal, to walk as one of the Light Falatacot, then simply give me one of these new tradenotes of yours. I believe it is called an 'MMD Note', and I will set you upon the Path.

I can sense great potential in you.  Potential you have not yet tapped.  Go to the isle of the one called Asheron.  In his castle, you will find Nalicana, the Seer of the Yalain.  She can set you upon the Path of Paths.
Sensing that you do not yet walk the path, %n refuses your gesture.
Your Seer Auras have been removed.
Present me with another MMD note as tribute to walk my path.
You have maxxed out increases to Aura of Specialization.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the fifth time.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the fourth time.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the third time.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the second time.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the first time.
Your Aura of Invulnerability has been augmented the first time.
Your Aura of Invulnerability has been augmented the second time.
Your Aura of Invulnerability has been augmented the third time.
Your Aura of Invulnerability has been augmented the fourth time.
Your Aura of Invulnerability has been augmented the fifth time.
You have maxxed out increases to Aura of Invulnerability.
%n looks you over carefully.

Greetings to you, young one.  If you are looking to embrace the Path of the Falatacot of the Light, you must first gain in skill, and then be attuned to the Light by the Seer, Nalicana, who resides in Asheron's Castle.
Go now.  When you are ready, perhaps we shall meet again.
Come back when you are ready to make a decision.
%n nods..
You do not have enough Luminance.
Greetings young one. I sense you are not fully schooled in Nalicana's teachings. Return to me after you have studied all she has to offer you.

greetings: Our traitorous magelord stirs with corruption.
quest: You have proven yourself a great champion with the destruction of the traitor Hovoros. I salute you.
You must wait %tqt before repeating this task.
Though many ghosts and undead trapped in Castle Mhoire have been purified and freed, the corruption laid on this place by Rytheran seeks to more firmly root itself in our midst.

In ancient days the House was betrayed by one of our strongest Archmages, Hovoros, who succumbed to Rytheran's temptation of power. Although the corruption that empowered him prevented him from truly being slain, he was thrown into the deepest chambers of the Oubliette of House Mhoire.

Now the corruption manifests within him, taking the form of a spectral page of magical text. He is using the corruption of this page to torment and tempt spirits here. I ask that you travel into the Oubliette, destroy Hovoros, and bring me one of these pages so I might purify it.
Search for the entrance to the Oubliette behind the throne room and down into the lowest catacombs under the castle.
I sense the corruption of the spectral page upon you. This must mean you have destroyed the traitor and have taken his corrupt power from him!

With the purification of this page and its terrible magic the onslaught of corruption will be slowed to a trickle. We could not approach the Oubliette for fear of madness, but the plans of the traitorous Hovoros have been foiled thanks to your heroic efforts! Let me reward you.
You have been awarded the title Master of the Mhoire Oubliette!

greetings: The sound of ancient bones crashing to the stone floor resonates through the chamber.
Ronin Shimakawa screeches as his bones fall lifelessly to the ground.
Ronin Ginmura locks his lifeless gaze on you as he crumbles to the ground.
A Sickly Maggot crawls out of the bones of Ginmura.

quest: I have nothing more for you at this time. If you seek further tasks find Kousha, they may have more work for you.
I will await you in the final room of the Academy. You must present the blade to me inside of the Academy to pass my test.
Stay your weapons warrior, I mean you no harm.
If we had wanted you dead you would already be at your lifestone, make no mistake about that.
This is not our goal, quite the opposite actually. Hoshino Kei can always find a use for the strongest, bravest, and mightiest of travellers. Are you among the elite of your kind?

Perhaps. Perhaps you will make a fine addition for her. Enter the dungeon behind me and bring me a blade from one of my Masters within...if you can survive and endure the challenge. Only the most powerful of creature could perform such a deed. This will go far in showing her you may be worthy of attention.

There is no shame if you refuse this offer or fail in your attempt. My kind inhabit this Academy where their Masters train them in the ways of death and the destruction of their enemy. Be warned, they will be fierce and unrelenting in defending their chosen Masters, especially in groups.
I only have a use for the strongest, bravest, and mightiest of travellers.
You must present the blade to me to pass the test.
You must speak to me outside to start the trial again.
Darviss takes the sword from your hand.
Well done. Many have tried, and many have failed. This deed will show Hoshino Kei you may be worthy when the time comes.
Do not let this victory swell your ego. Continue to wreak havoc on your enemies throughout this land and one day she may come for you.

greetings: Interesting...yes, this will do.
The Tanada are weaker now. We are closer to our goal of eliminating them from our midst.
quest: You have already completed your task. We have no further need for your services at this time.
Have you slaughtered their recruits? Give me the masks I requested if so. We must send a message that joining the Tanada will only ensure defeat.
I may have a use for you, but you must first prove yourself to Darviss.
Darviss advised me of your potential. We will put this to the test.
The Tanada clan continues to recruit and train new blood, ensuring a strong and prosperous future. This we cannot allow.
Kill the seed before it sprouts and the field will never grow.
Surely she will see this as an act of a mighty and loyal warrior.
Far to the southwest around 42.5S, 72.3E is a temple where the Tanada train their new recruits.
Enter this temple, slay 6 of these upstarts and collect the masks from each of the 6 slaughtered. We have something in mind for these aspiring Tanada, something glorious!
Kousha begins to laugh.

We have recently learned the Tanada are stepping up their training. Our spies spotted a Tanada Kutekei inside of the Temple, one of the wisest and most skilled among their clan. This can only mean they are ramping up for something. We must remain vigilant!
You have not slaughtered enough of their recruits.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Tanada Neophytes.
Excellent work. Once again Darviss displays his skill at finding worthy beings!
Kousha's bony fingers take the bloody masks from your hand and he begins to chant unfamiliar words.
A bone-chilling breeze sweeps through the room and 6 Spectral Nanjou Shou-jen suddenly appear!
The Tanada are weaker now. We are closer to our goal of eliminating them from our midst.
She will be pleased with your work; you have done well. We have no further need for your services at this time.
You Nanjou belong to her now. You will serve her will. You will obey. Begone from my sight!
We only have a use for the strong. Begone from this place.
You have not brought enough of the masks I requested.
You have already completed your task. We have no further need for your services at this time.
Do you have any news? If you have found the information I requested, hand it to me.
You wish to join our cause? All new recruits must first prove themselves to Darviss.
Darviss tells me you have great potential. I have my doubts about that, but I have been instructed to enlist you for a mission of great importance.
Inside of the temple in the distant south near 42.5S, 72.3E you will find the Tanada training their newest recruits. It is here where the Tanada are hiding valuable information we seek.
Our spies tell us that several Jogensha Shou-Jen are within these walls and carry vital information we must possess.

A mortal would not be my first choice to bestow such a crucial task, but the decision was not mine to make. We cannot risk an all out war with the Tanada if my kind are discovered raiding a Tanada temple...not yet.
Do not disappoint us. We do not deal well with failure.
Fine work for a mortal. I was sure you would fail and the Tanada would be torturing you as we speak.
Perhaps Darviss was correct.
Perhaps he was not.
Only time will tell.
Kinchou begins studying the scroll.
I require nothing further from you. You are dismissed.
You are far too weak to be of use.
I trust that we have an agreement.
You must wait %tqt before completing this quest again.
Shorikan looks your way. You cannot see his face but you can feel the tension in the air.
Impossible! This cannot be! We will not fail again.
Shorikan reaches towards you and places a single finger on your shoulder.
I see that you have aided Kinchou in our battle against the Tanada. If you seek more work, Kousha may have a use for you.
You are unknown to me. If you seek work, find Kinchou and Kousha. But beware, they will not speak with you unless you first prove yourself to Darviss.
You have proven to be instrumental in our battle with the Tanada. The tide surely swings in our favor due to your actions.

We are grateful, but the situation is...delicate. None can know of what has transpired. The Tanada would surely wage an all out war and many of our own may view our actions as dishonorable and cowardly.
Nothing is beyond reproach, not to ensure our victory.
Shorikan pauses for a moment.
I must be sure the news of what we have accomplished dies with you. Our success is far more important than your life.
It truly pains me, but I have little choice. Your actions and our involvement end on this day.
You throw the sword at the feet of Shorikan. Shorikan picks up the sword and wipes the dirt from the blade.
You still live? Your skill in the art of battle is impressive.
No good can come from further bloodshed over our misunderstanding. I underestimated you and you have proven me wrong.

Take these rewards, but keep the tale of our interactions silent. Even someone as hardy as yourself would be crushed by the reprisal of both the Tanada and our forces. Let us not forget that the Tanada would show you no mercy for your slaughter of their recruits.
The logical course of actions would be for all to forget we ever spoke. Revenge would only place you in the middle of a war that even you could not win.
You are too weak to be of use. Leave this place.

greetings: Must obey...kill the intruders!
One of us will be set free this day.
I am too weak to fight it.
quest: Darkness waning.
The bond is broken.
This is not how I am.
My actions will haunt me to the end of days.

greetings: You? You think such a pathetic creature as yourself could defeat me?
Your aspirations are as admirable as they are foolish.
Now show due respect and kneel before me!
I escaped death through the misguided visions of the priestess. I will not be taken down by the likes of you.
Come fourth my brothers. Eradicate these vermin.
You are much more difficult to kill than the others. I love a good challenge!
Almost as much as I love the sound of a beaten soul racing to the lifestone
After escaping death and Izexi, your efforts cannot hope to exceed.
Be a good little mortal and die now, would you?
A portal appears in the center of the chamber as scraps of cloth from the Apparition flutter to the ground.

Lord Grymar says, "I can linger in this wood for only a short time. Come speak gentlefolk."
quest: I am sorry hero, but I have no more keys to give.
The corruption of my spirit binds me to these trees. I can feel the burning of the wood as if it was my own flesh.
You have my thanks for becoming watchers of this wood, however burnt. Take my key and seek my hidden vault. The treasures there are yours.
I thank you for your skill and bravery.
Ranger Lord Grymar Mhoire bestows to you the title "Warden of the Burning Wood."

With that, the barnacled golem slumps back down upon the ground and returns to its slumber.

Blood Magic! Blood Magic! Guards! Blood Magic!

The Arbitrator looks confused for a second and then nods his head in apparent understanding.

I think it only fair that they get a chance to test your weaknesses in the Arena. You now have access to the Cow Arena.

I see that you have proved you skill against the Champion, Killagurg. Well done. I hereby grant you the title, Champion of the Wild.
I see that you have proved you skill against the Champion, the Demon Swarm Matron. Well done. I hereby grant you the title, Champion of the Hive.
I see that you have proved you skill against our mysterious Champion, The Master. Well done. I hereby grant you the title, Champion of Assassins.
I see that you have proved you skill against the Champion, Gladiator Diemos. Well done indeed. I hereby grant you the title, Immortal Champion.

In addition to your new title and this useful hook caster, I'll also give you a token that you can trade back to me for a great deal of practical knowledge, or you can trade it in to Fiun Rehlyun at the Fiun settlement in the Halaetan Isles for a blank Augmentation gem. A difficult decision, I know.
I see that you have proven yourself against the Pumpkin King. Well done.
Since you have slain him, you must be will be known as the "Pumpkin Throne Usurper."
Oh, and we found this mixed up in the mess you left in his arena.
And I believe you have earned this bit of practical knowledge.
The Arbitrator reaches out and lightly touches your forehead, sending a jolt of new understanding through you mind.
I see that you have proved you skill against the Thunder Chicken. Well done.
You shall be known to all as the "Thunder Chicken Slayer".
I see that you have proved your skill against the Very Mad Cow. Well done.
You shall be known to all as the "Mad Cow Slayer".

quest: A serene voice fills your mind, "You have come, and you have seen visions of the darkness of that tome. It is only a small sample of the evil you now bear with you, but any wisdom gained is wisdom earned."
A serene voice fills your mind, "This thing you bear, it can be sealed away, for a time."

A serene voice fills your mind, "I can hold the book, once it has all come to me, for an Age, maybe two, but not forever. Its power is too great, and its ties to this world too many, for it to be contained forever, even by one such as me."

A serene voice fills your mind, "We can only hope that the intervening millenia will be long enough for those who follow the path to shatter the book's hold on this world, and then to weaken it 'til it reaches a point where it may be sealed forever. In that, time will tell."
A serene voice fills your mind, "For now, it is best to focus on getting the whole of the book here, which will be a lengthy process in and of itself."

A serene voice fills your mind, "To that end, I thank you for braving the book to bring a page of it here. The corruption of even a single page would forever fill one of lesser stature than your own."
A serene voice fills your mind, "But you have borne it here and survived. For that, I thank you. Please, accept my blessing and be healed of its touch."
The Avatar of the Deru takes the page from you, and it vanishes immediately thereafter. When it is gone, you feel as if a great weight has been lifted from your shoulders.
The Avatar of the Deru then touches you, and a green light pours through your form, removing the taint of the Book from your spirit.
A serene voice fills your mind, "Take this crystal to the one you call Asheron, so he may know of your success and your healing. Go now, with my blessing, and the blessings of all of the Deru."
A serene voice fills your mind, "Greetings, %s. I have been watching your progress."

A serene voice fills your mind, "I do hope my friends did not cause you undue harm. The trial is necessary, as it weakens the hold that the page has gained upon you in the time you've been in contact with it."
A serene voice fills your mind, "You bear a page of the dark tome, the bane of my people. Hand it to me, so it may be sealed away, and you may be cleansed."
A serene voice fills your mind, "Take the crystal to the one you call Asheron, so he may know of your success and your healing. Go now, with my blessing, and the blessings of all of the Deru."
A serene voice fills your mind, "Greetings, %s."

greetings: This is the artifact that was sought. I am empowered to reward you for this effort. But I cannot serve as the crystal's guardian. Please bring the crystal to Harlune. It has become his responsibility to safeguard the artifact.

Go through this portal and seek out the one called Master Malsivir. He has looted a very dangerous artifact from the Collegium called the Void Crystal. There is no telling what kind of catastrophe could result if such foolish and short-sighted beings abused its powers.
You have retrieved the crystal from the human despoiler. Please, give it to me.

We have spoken, but you do not yet have the Void Crystal. Why do you delay? I can wait millennia to receive the crystal, but your short-lived kind have only fleeting moments in which to achieve their goals
