Come back no more, frail one, slaying your kind has lost its challenge.
Fellow warriors, aid me!
I gather you are not a mighty wizard among your kind.  It would be best if you learned your role.
%mn flinches back at the smell coming from the jar.
Disgusting! Keep your evil ichors to yourself!
Is this your proof of having rid our garrison of the olthoi? I'm sorry that just isn't good enough.
Ah, so they didn't survive the journey... Put it away.
Remember, I never saw that letter.
Hah, the fool, writing down directions to our secret garrison. I'm glad he's gone, less competition for me, hahaha.
%mn's eyes glaze over and a soft snoring sound reverberates around the room.
%mn mashes his fists in celebration.
Well done! With this as proof of my defeating the Olthoi below I will garner much respect in our army. You should be rewarded for your assistance.
There, and since I'm feeling so magnanimous I will also grant you access to the garrison whenever I see you wearing your pendant. It's the only way I will recognize you.
Olthoi have a way of coming right back unless you kill them all so you may want to return to insure they have been exterminated.
Thank you, but I prefer paper. Here, take it back.
%mn looks astonishingly like someone trying to look innocent.
Oh, HaHa!
That might buy me some day old rice, I suppose. Thanks.
What! Are you trying to bribe me!? Well, I'll have none of that!
%mn crumples the X-note up and stuffs it into his mouth.
Surprisingly unsatisfying.
Closer...
Your getting warmer...
That's almost enough to make me care.
%mn swiftly reaches out and the tradenote disappears.
%mn whips out a sack and scoops all of the treasure into it.
quest: %mn glances at your pendant, looks around for witnesses and turns to the door.
Tell no one of this.
You shake %mn's shoulder. He seemed to be sleeping with his eyes open.
Wha! Humans! Leave now and you may yet live!
%mn looks you over. His eyes focus on your weapons and jewelry. He glances about the room for a moment.
Perhaps I was too hasty my friend.

Many days ago, our engineers broke into an olthoi tunnel while excavating the lower sections of this garrison. We fought them, and lost all but the top level beyond this door, which I was ordered to guard until reinforcements arrive.
Unfortunately, I have fallen on hard times and could not possibly consider jeopardizing my career by ignoring my ranking officer's orders. If only I could somehow be assured of your intentions...

I suppose you could bring me proof of your defeat of the olthoi below... if I had proof of their defeat, I could assure a promotion... But no, I cannot make a deal so risky without a little something to fall back on in case it were to fail.
Ah, I see that you intend to help us and that I, a loyal Gotrok, would be lax in my duties did I not allow creatures of such obvious honor to assist us in our hour of need.
You must not forget that I am taking a risk in allowing you entrance. Bring me back proof that you removed the olthoi menace from our garrison and I may have a small reward for you.

Also, my fellows within may not recognize you for the heroes that you are so be prepare to defend yourselves. If you can't handle them then you surely cannot handle the olthoi deeper down. If caught, remember to say that you got into the dungeon through portal magic.

Oh, If I see you again I am sure I will not recognize you. You humans all look alike to me with your pointy noses and huge ears, haha! Thus, if you require entrance you will have to pay m... I mean donate towards our rebuilding efforts again.

greetings: Eat fiery hot justice, evil doer!
Cruath Quafeth.  Your kind says that often when hunting us.  Does it mean kill me now?
You have done well to defeat this foe, champion.
Norshuntyr, once a noble protector and now, a corrupt spirit of the wood. You have done well to defeat him, champion!
If even the great Zerzelikyr can be influenced by this madness and corruption what can the others do? It is fortunate we have champions such as you.
You are not interested in my gift? Well then let us see how much amber survived the ritual.
You have faced many dangers to reach this sanctuary. Here under the boughs of the Deru I work to purify and heal the great tree even as darkness gnaws at its roots.
I have devised a ritual that uses the Infused Amber that the great tree showers upon the Viridian Rise. We cannot gather these fast enough to fight off the encroaching darkness.
Bring me 100 Infused Amber for one purification ritual and I will reward you with a treasure from my horde.

I will give you something I have gathered or created. These items are constantly changing. If you do not like the item I gave to you, return it to me and any Infused Amber that survived the ritual will be returned to you.
quest: You have done well to gather these. They will serve to purify and heal the great tree.
You have not yet gathered enough Infused Amber for the purification ritual. Come back to me when you have at least 100.
Have returned to visit me, or has the magnificent view lured you back up to our aerie?
You have climbed far to reach our aerie. That is quite an effort.
Perhaps you would take the Infused Amber I have gathered to Kervim'telek so it might heal and purify the great tree?

greetings: If you want something done right, do it yourself! Come Max!
The relentless pounding of Hea Kanokeh's drum has summoned a nearby Nualuan warrior to join the fight!
As the drum-speaker Hea Kanokeh falls, the Nualuan warriors of Temenua's party lose heart, and quickly leave the field of battle.

Temenua glances down at the hole that now graces his chest, courtesy of %s. "Hm," he says, almost offhandedly, as he fingers the edge of the wound. "You were the better. Well played. I pray Tonk will allow me to face you again some day." With this, he carefully lays himself down on the earth, and dies.
Bah.
The atual arutoa defend me.
The atual arutoa are my keep and my shield.
I will walk where the paths the atual arutoa point me toward.
I will take comfort in the protection of the atual arutoa.
Temenua shakes his head at %s's perforated corpse. "Hmph."
Temenua coolly assesses %s, and announces, "By the authority granted me by Hea Arantah, I must declare you a trespasser in these Hea lands of Palenqual. Remove from here or die. It is one to me."
Temenua silently and efficiently nocks an arrow in his bow, and draws on bead on %s.
Karenua? Some help.

Tuperea staggers and falls to his knees. "Ah, my hunters, my precious children. I shall see you again, some day. Take your fill of my mortal flesh, my dears, and may it make you run strong across these fields."
Tuperea grins ferally at %s, "You are prey."
Tuperea grins ferally at %s, "You are meat."
Tuperea grins ferally at %s, "Here, my precious hunters! Bring this prey down, and we shall sup upon its flesh."
Tuperea grins ferally at %s, "The atual arutoa have taught me the way to remove and cure the flesh of your kind, prey. You will make a beautiful wrap for my wife."
Tuperea laughs as %s falls. "Your head shall make a fine addition to my collection, prey, and your flesh shall feed my loyal hunters."
Tuperea shouts, "Manuaka, Reshalra, Utelari, Sahkurea - to me, my faithful hunters! Run the prey %s to ground, and I shall crack the marrow from its bones for you!"
As %s's feeble spell is repulsed by Tuperea, he is heard to mutter, "Bah. A shaman. They always have such stringy meat..."
This is the second time since moon-turn that those ugly little green thieves have stolen my supplies.
quest: You brought me Hagra's treaty, and I was well pleased. The situation was resolved without bloodshed. Why, then, would you bring me his head? While I appreciate a good beheading as much as the next Hea, this seems... wasteful. You will get no additional reward from me. Begone.

You brought me the head, and that was fine. Well done. Now you give me this treaty? What good is the treaty if you have shown bad faith and slain their chieftain? I had a better opinion of you when you had given me his head, before you tried this craven trick. Be off with you.
Please return to me later human, you have done all that I asked.
We have discussed this, have we not? Go into Hagra's Holdfast at 48.2 N, 88.5 W and confront their chief. Put an end to their theft of my supplies, one way or the other.
Ah, the ugly little beast's head. This will do. It is fair and right that I reward you, human. This is an armored shirt of my own making.
So the little beggar would trade peacefully with me, eh? Still, it is an interesting proposal, and I think they may prove useful to me...

Very well. I thank you for resolving this situation without undue bloodshed. It does not surprise me that you weakling humans always seek peaceful solutions. I will reward you with an armored shirt of my own making...

Much as it shames me, human, I would ask for your help. A group of filthy, smelly creatures known as Mosswarts have made a home on my island and are raiding my supplies. I am but one warrior and cannot attend to my duties and guard my supplies all the time.
I would like for you to go into Hagra's Holdfast at 48.2 N, 88.5 W and confront their chief. Whether you must negotiate with him or just kill him, put an end to their thievery.

greetings: The fighter takes the ticket from you and rips it in two, storing it's half in a bag marked "Bets".
Now this is an interesting vial indeed! Extreme power is contained within, thank you so much for brining me one.
Thank you for the Auroch horn. Let's see you must be tired from all that hunting, take these.
My reward for a Fire Auroch Horns is better.
A Fire Auroch Horn! Thank you for bringing this to me. You look a little singed...
Take those with you in case you get horribly burned.
Thank you for the Mattekar horn. You have to be careful hunting those big ones. Here take this batch of potions I just made.
I can also use auroch horns if you find them.
There you go!  A nice supply of Sunflower oil.
Nasty stuff, but it is essential to my research.
It's also very good for cleaning the horns I use in my potions. Please bring me more if you can.
I'm still testing this acid's corrosive properties for alchemical uses. It's a good way to get rid of useless items though.
Oh, a strange substance. The label claims it is the soul of a virindi...
Well, I don't know a way of bottling a soul, but I will be very interested to find out what this substance is.
What an amazing potion! So spicy!
This will go wonderfully in my new concoction. Thank you.
Lilly sniffs at the infusion carefully.
Whew! Better be careful with this one.
Egad! What a disgusting mess! I'll just destroy this right now!
I use Auroch horns in the making of my potions. I discovered how to use Mattekar horns to produce health elixirs and Sunflowers to make Sunflower oil.
If you give me a horn, I'll give you some of my potion in return. If you give me a Sunflower I'll give you some Sunflower oil.
Caves are the place to be, indeed!
Avoid the great crater, I say; the caves there are none too pleasant, even for me!  Oh, the fumes!
Avoid the lightless ones!  Evil, evil are they!
A note from Iquba! Does that mean you seek the fabled Sword?
That is good. It is a fearsome weapon against the darkness.

Take these notes. They will tell you how to reach the Carved Cave, wherein you may journey to the sad, lost Halls. But first you must fight the lightless ones deep within the cave, and take from them the seventh key. Make no mistake! The lightless ones were the downfall of the ancients! Beware!
quest: Thank you, but no thank you. Perhaps later.
Thank you.

greetings: I will give you money for certain trophy gems that you have, such as the swamp gem.
Have you, in your possession, the rare and unusual jewels of the strange masked creatures?  I shall craft them into something different for you.
I'm not interested in  normal gems or jewels.
Yes, I cut Virindi Jewels. Mind you I get to keep the rest of the stone for myself.
A bit of the stones magic seems to become active in the cut gems.
These strange jewels don't cut like a normal stone. It sounds crazy, but I feel like the stone almost guides my hand.
Excellent! I've been waiting for another of these jewels for my project.
These jewels cast colors I've never seen and can't begin to describe.
These yellow jewels somehow intensify light. If you find more, I will pay well for them.
I'm collecting gemstones to build a window that will transform sunlight into a beautiful show of color and light.
Funny thing, these Swamp Gems always feel somewhat slick.
I find it soothing to look into it's murky green center.
Most people don't appreciate the hidden beauty of these gems.
It's unpolished state belies it's lambent shine.
The reflections in this jewel are stunning.
I think I may cut this into gems for my mosaic.
The light flickers in it's facets like a black fire. Definitely magical.
I have just the place for this in my window.
Oh good, I'm running low on diamond powder.
I've been mixing it into glass to form a lustrous grout for my window.
This is truly an odd find. It is obviously the eye of a gromnie, but it seems to have solidified after the beast's death and turned into this gem.
Oh, I'm sorry, you'll be wanting something correct? Take this oculus. I've taken some samples of the jewel, the rest is yours.
I collect only the rarest of trophy jewels.   I will take gems that have been crafted by other trophy collectors and give you money for them.
But my true specialty lies in the jewels from the strange masked creatures.

This looks like one of those Idol heads those crazy Vesayen mosswarts worship. Hmmm, it's a lot smaller though. You could see if Grearrk, the mosswart living outside Sawato, knows anything about this.
Have you seen any strange black rocks or stones?  If you give me one, I will give you back a piece of it cut into the shape of a pretty gem.
I'm looking for various stones.  Not just any, but only from certain monsters.  I'll also take swamp stones or banderling scalps.
I hear that obsidian comes from volcanoes, or from intense magical disruptions.
The great Obsidian Plain in the Direlands is quite a sight, but I do not like the feel of the place.  I hear it was caused by some kind of powerful magic.
I'll also give you money for some of the trophy jewels you may have, but people tell me my prices aren't very good.
Very pretty.
Such a deep blue. A fine jewel.
Very nicely cut! I'll take this.
A pleasure doing business.
This is quite a fancy jewel!
I might be able to cut a gem like this given enough time...
Ah, yes, these make fine jewels.
Here is a finished one for you.
Ah, not a stone lover?
Take these then, everyone finds pyreal useful.
I work these into perfect spheres.
Nice craftsmanship, eh?
This is a very impressive rock! Here, take one that I've finished cutting and polishing.
The light flickers in it's facets like a black fire. Use that in an Empyrean Weapon.
Here's what I make of those stones.
If you stare into the gems dark center for awhile you can almost make out... movement.
Haha, an unsettling optical illusion. Probably related to it's magical properties.
Oh good, a banderling scalp. Here, take this unpolished gem if you like.
I cure these to make soft rags that I use to polish my stones and gems.
You don't want it? Well, ok, take some coin instead.
It may look dull now, but wait till I'm through with it.
I have something for that.
Thank you.
Golem hearts are fine.
Good, good.
Granite? Yes, I need that.
Very pure Iron.
My thanks.
This is a nice chunk of ice.
Nice hunk of obsidian.
You're lucky to find one of these!
A heart of pure pyreal!
This is very valuable.
A heart of pure platinum!
Not sure what to do with it.
Perhaps I'll try cutting it.
Good for magic, but I can use it too.
I will take a number of trophy stones and jewels, such as virindi jewels, swamp stones, iron, copper, and granite golem hearts.
I'll also take banderling trophies.  But what I really specialize in are the rare black rocks and black stones.
quest: Take this note to Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator. She'll tell you what to do with it.
I'll keep the bounty I usually pay for these.
Yes, very good.

greetings: I collect only phyntos wasp wings.  I'll reward you well for any you happen to have.
Phyntos wasps are not my favorite creature, but I do admire the wings.
I'll reward you for any kind of phyntos wasp wing you can give me.
Ah, a delicate red with a translucent mottling...
Thank you, it's a beautiful wing.
Green as jade. I need a lot of these. Good thing they're common.
Good, blue is my favorite color.
Oooo, look at the colors!
This will make a great addition to my collection.
I don't know about you, but I enjoy collecting wasp wings.
This will be the prize of my collection!
I usually only deal with wasp wings, but these are simply too rare of a find to pass by!
I collect only phyntos wasp wings.  If you happen to have any, I'll pay you for them in pyreals.  If you get me a gold wasp wing, I will reward you with a little extra experience.
quest: Take this note to Fanzen San the Translator. He'll tell you what to do with it.
I'll keep the bounty I usually pay for these.
Good luck in your travels.
Green as jade. I need a lot of these. Good thing they're common.

greetings: I can craft you an axe from an armoredillo spine.  Any spine will do.  I'll also return something for a wood or iron heart.
I don't have a use for gromnie teeth.  But I will reward you for auroch horns.
Spines and golem hearts are what I use.  Have any?
A Black Stone, so easily confused with a Black Rock. Let's see, Mana Potions for the stones.
Wonderful, I've been looking for more of these Black Rocks. Health Potions for the rocks I believe.
This is a very impressive rock!
A heart of mud.
Is it the golem's heart that animates them do you think?
A heart of water.
I am confounded by these solid pieces of water. They aren't cold like ice. Hmmm...
A heart of wood.
The most understandable and natural golem heart. Quite pretty too.
A heart of copper.
Living copper. Did you know golem hearts have hollow chambers much like our hearts.
A heart of granite.
Imagine what it would be like to have a heart of stone.
A heart of iron.
The materials these hearts are made of are purer than our blacksmiths can refine.
A heart of ice! How apt.
At least this one is cold.
A heart of obsidian.
These are among the most beautiful of the golem hearts. See how it shines when I polish it?
A heart of diamond.
The materials toughness seems to have a direct correlation to the golems toughness.
A heart of pure pyreal!
This is very valuable.
A heart of pure platinum!
A heart of... vapor.
These are even more mystifying than the Water Golem Hearts.
Spines are nice.
Thank you.
Spines are good.
Come again.
Spines are great!
Spines are wonderful!
Well, would you look at that? I can probably make a slightly better axe from this.
Oh wonderful, a new spine! Maybe I can .. No .. Well .. Hmm. I'll just hold onto it for now.
A fine quality horn.
May your future see good fortune.
I can resecure this to a haft.
And now you have a Basalt Axe instead.
And now you have an Obsidian Axe instead.
I am interested in armoredillo spines and golem hearts of all kinds.  If you give me one I will craft an item from it, or give you something else of value.
I remember finding stones like this within the mine, but they're only useful as doorstops.
Didn't you read the note?  That place is dangerous.  You'll surely die if you go in there.
Now I have to return the note to the dungeon. Thanks a lot!
I tell you what, hand me the skull of the Tortured Soul that hides in the Grievous Vault and I'll give you access to the mines.
You managed to find a lich's head?  That is impressive.
%n looks at a note thoughtfully for a moment.
Perhaps you can go into the Mines, but I can't give you the key to the final section unless you prove your worth. If you bring me the Skull of the High Acolyte I'll help you further.
The Mines are dangerous and much is unknown about what dwells there.  I know not much about it; however, some great evil lurks in there. I can feel it.
Very impressive! You managed to obtain the most unholy of skulls.
%n holds the Skull of the High Acolyte with much admiration.
You have proven your worth to me.
Take these keys. It will give you access to the place many fear.
You adventurers always seem to be going in and taking these - I think I'd like to keep one of my own. You don't mind, do you?
Lemme alone.  And keep my door closed!

Thank you.  I used to try to live in a place called the Old Warehouse, a dungeon overrun with monsters now.  It's on the hill to the north, toward town.  If you go in, you can keep any treasure you find.
I don't want this.  It's not my business any more.
I used to try to live in a place called the Old Warehouse, a dungeon overrun with monsters now.  It's on the hill to the north, toward town.  If you go in, you can keep any treasure you find.
quest: Oh, memories.   I didn't really want it back, but here, have this as a token of my thanks.
I grow tired of these love games.  Maybe tomorrow I will have made up my mind.

greetings: No, no I don't want to drink that.
Pretty. But I don't understand what it means.
Urrp.
Why me?
Brentsella...
Don't give me that again!
Yuck!
Thanks, that went down well.
Well, I suppose I'll take that back. Thanks.
Brentsella!  Why?  Oh, never mind.  Here, you can have this instead.  Take it before I change my mind.
Oh. Yeah, I have that.  If Harlune sent you, you must be getting something back from him, right? I'll tell you what.  There's this... this thing that I need.  From a volcano in the Direlands.
You'll find it at the very bottom, but you must be level 20 or above to get in.  Wait, I'll write you the location.

You got the Water of Lethe!  I don't believe it.  I... I've wanted this for...  Do you know what this does?  Do you know what it's like... the faces of so many waiting behind your eyes every night?  The children asking you where their parents are?
But... Brentsella. I'll lose her too, won't I..?
Here's Harlune's book. Please go, I have to... I need to think. Thank you, but I need to...
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
You found it. Oh bless you, I had lost it, thought I did but someone stole it left me with an empty mug loop on my belt and no cup with which to hold my drink. But bless you, you found it!
It smells of Ayan Baqur, I've caught the scent before, the desert and dirt and the dirty pyreals. So filthy and unclean.
But you, you've a chip or chunk of a tree from the Tiofor Forest around Glenden Wood on you. I can smell it. Might I see it?
You'd rather cast this spell on your own?
Well I can't argue with that.

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth. If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for a reward.
It has also been requested that I start handing out these gems.
By the way -- if you haven't yet done so, you might want to visit Brentsella at the South Outpost, or Mindorla at the East Outpost. They often have tasks for young adventurers.
quest: Oh, Mindorla!  Well, I suppose you want a reward for delivering this to me.  Here it is.
As long as you're here, see what rumors the barkeep is selling.  You might find adventure around here, like I did when I was younger.
Celcynd takes a deep breath of the Bark.
Ah, the smell of fresh firs and the air around Glenden Wood. Indeed that is where this came from. Somewhere near the city and surrounded by firs. May I keep it?
Oh thank you. It reminds me of the area near the Glenden Wood Prison the trees there smell so nice throughout the year.
Bah, I have no time for you now!  Maybe come and see me tomorrow about Mindorla.
What's this? Not the woods. Not the woods!
You will find gems on the table next to me which will allow you to change this weapon into a Heavy, Finesse or Light version.
You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.
No, this is for you to stamp the letters you find.  Please keep it.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of armor for this. If you take this to one of the Sho towns, you will receive a weapon.
There appears to be very little else of use here. No new orders appear to have come down to Commander Kamenua.

greetings: Thank you!  I like collecting these.
Have you been to Rithwic yet?  I'd like you to take this letter to Celcynd.  He will pay you for it.
This is meant for Celcynd. Please take it to him.
quest: Why that ungrateful...er, thank you for bringing this to me.  Here is a small reward.
You dare mock my pain when my wounds are fresh?  Maybe if you come back tomorrow I will be able to deal with the matter.

greetings: Ah, I do not drink, but thank you.  I can offer nothing in exchange but some information.
Have you heard the word Falatacot?  It has something to do with Dericost, which Alatar Locke thinks was once a powerful, evil Empyrean kingdom.  I hope to learn more someday!

Just between you and me, but are you seeking entry into the Folthid Cellar?  My studies hint of a very fine dagger within it, of ancient origin.  Beware; it may be guarded, and my heart tells me of treacherous danger within.

Also, you will not be able to give it away once you have it; you can only sell it.  To get in to the dungeon, you will need to convince Lady Folthid to give you the key.  Try giving her a wood heart from a golem.
I am in the employ of Lady Folthid.
If you could spare me some blank parchment, I will be very grateful.  I am studying in my spare time, and I need the parchment.
quest: Where did you find this? From the cellar? But how...this bodes ill...
I shall tell you what I know - what I truly know, that is. The cellar you have exited leads into what remains of a Falatacot ruin.

That is right - I know of the Falatacot, and I've studied much more than I make Lady Folthid or passers-by aware of. It is no accident that Lady Folthid's house was built here. I suggested it, at the advice of...another patron. I remain in service here secretly - but as Lady Folthid, being a noble, might talk to other powerful individuals, I have only revealed myself to you as you are not so po...
Since the house was built, I have watched for signs of activity from the cellar. It has been quiet, but this device indicates new activity.

Someone has attempted to use it recently - I can tell by the small tarnish here, which indicates that a surge of portal magic enveloped the device. However, whatever magic was attempted did not work. This is but a fragment of the entire device, and the device would have needed to be whole in order to work properly.
If I were to guess, I would say that there was a faction of Falatacot somewhere doing something - I am sorry I cannot be more specific.
Someone should find Asheron and inform him...but he has not been seen in so long. This note may help. It was research he was conducting shortly before he left. May it be of use to you.
No, I don't know nothing about this. It is pretty, though - mind if I keep it?
%n looks at you blankly.

greetings: Ah, wonderful.  I can scarcely set foot in my own cellar these days.  A travesty.  What are they doing in Cragstone about this monster problem?  Nothing, I imagine.
Anyway, here is your reward.
I am Raxaza Folthid.  Unless you have business with me, I do not wish to speak with you.
You look sturdy enough to do this for me. Take this key.
Go to my cellar, recover a bottle of Old Nectar and return it to me.
quest: If you could not find it on your own the cellar is at 8.6S, 52.9E.

greetings: You found one of my father's axes! Oh, thank you so much! You know, he was going to make me an axe of my own, as soon as I was big enough to hold one ...
I'm sorry ... I just miss him still ...
No, no, I'm okay ... Allow me to reward you. It's the least I can do, really.

What's this? A letter from my father to my mother? ... oh! And he wrote it in the Redoubt, as he was waiting for the end to come. This is ... I cannot speak ... It is so kind of you, to return this to me.  To read his last words ...
No, no, I'll be alright. It just overwhelms me sometimes, how much I miss him. I must reward you for this.
You have been so kind to bring me this remembrance of my father, perhaps you can help my friend Alfrin, just over there by Worcer.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
You'd rather cast this spell on your own?
Well I can't argue with that.
Greetings! Welcome to Holtburg! I am the local representative of the Explorer Society. My job is to help new arrivals in Dereth get settled in and learn their way around.
If you have just arrived in Dereth, you should talk to my friend Worcer. He is looking for some help with an errand. He's a good man - if you help him out, he will help you out.
Or you can peruse the rumors at the bar. Wilomine always knows something that needs doing.
It has also been requested that I start handing out these gems.
quest: My father, Brogord, was a mighty man. He crafted his own great axe to fell timber. Alas, he was slain at the old Redoubt when I was just a babe in swaddling.

This letter speaks highly of you. If you can bring me some remembrance of my father, you will have whatever reward I can offer you. Rumor has it that his axe has come to rest in the Cave of Alabree. Wilomine, at the bar, has directions to that fell place.
I believe that Worcer was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
I believe that Alfrin was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
Ahha! Thank you for bringing this to me!

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth.  Here is a book that explains their mission.
I will also give you a list describing the locations of the nearest stamp and portals to other towns.  If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for a reward.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of armor for this. If you take this to one of the Sho towns, you will receive a weapon.

greetings: My mother's antique platter! Thank you so much!
I never thought I'd see this again! You have my thanks!
Look, it's the old goblet I remember so well! Thank you for bringing it back to me!
I always hated this bowl. But my mother loved it, bless her heart. It will make a great addition to our little memorial. Thank you.
This wedding band belonged to the mother of my good friend Hardunna. She'll be thrilled to have this back!
Hardunna and I use to "borrow" this candlestick to go roaming about at night. Ah, those were innocent days.
Hardunna's mother would ring this bell to call us in to dinner. Thank you so much for bringing it back to us!
Hardunna's father, Roland, brought this with him from Ispar. He gave it to Hope, his wife, when they met. I am so glad to have this for our museum. You have my sincere thanks.
You know, since you've been so helpful to me, perhaps you could also help Flinrala. She doesn't talk about it much, but she still grieves for her father, Brogord. He died defending the Redoubt.
One of his axes is rumored to be in the Cave of Alabree, a bit west of here. Perhaps you could go and take a look? Bring anything you find back to Flinrala - I'm sure she'll be happy to have it.
Here, here are the directions. Wilomine also sells them, in case you lose those.
I'd appreciate your help recovering some items from the old Redoubt.
My parents were killed there when I was but a boy, when Holtburg was overrun with Tumeroks. I was saved, whisked away by the mage Celcynd at my parents' behest.

The Redoubt is directly south of here. We put up an eternal flame at the site, in memory of all the townsfolk who died. Some of us are also trying to get together an exhibit to honor our parents. For instance, my mother had these heirloom dishes she was always polishing. She loved those dishes ...
Anyway, if you could recover any of these items for our exhibit, I will reward you as well as I can.
If you need more help getting to the Redoubt, you can buy directions from Wilomine at the bar.
quest: You found it! Quick, take this to Flinrala! I'm sure she'll be thrilled to have it!
I believe that Alfrin was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
Flinrala is always talking about this type of thing. Why don't you show this to her?

greetings: We must stay vigilant here in Lytelthorpe Keep in case the monsters return.
Ah, I see you've helped Beltslora, perhaps you could help me also. There are monsters in the old distillery to the south of town.
Come to think of it, there hasn't been anything good to drink here ever since the distillery was overrun. If you could retrieve a bottle of distillery nectar for me I would greatly appreciate it.
That Ercel, always thinking about the sky instead of what's going on on the ground. Perhaps you could help me also.
There are monsters in the old distillery to the south of town. Come to think of it, there hasn't been anything good to drink here ever since the distillery was overrun.
If you could retrieve a bottle of distillery nectar for me I would greatly appreciate it.
Thank you! We don't know who built the distillery, but it must be very old. The stuff we have tried making isn't as good as some of the mysterious stuff we found in it.
At the very bottom is a cellar where the best ancient drinks were found. The key I gave you earlier should open it. If you bring me back a bottle of distillery ambrosia, I will reward you well.
Ah, this is a fine bottle! You have done well. Please take these presents as a token of my gratitude.
You may find the Atlan and Isparian weapons are powerful tools in combat.
If you wish to, read these books on how to obtain them.
Ah, a wonderful find -- the most useful and finest drink I have ever tasted! Here is something for you, thank you!
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
Ah, a truly adventurous soul. Here you are!
You'd rather cast this spell on your own?
Well I can't argue with that.

I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth. If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for a reward.
It has also been requested that I start handing out these gems.
quest: You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.
No, this is for you to stamp the letters you find.  Please keep it.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of armor for this. If you take this to one of the Sho towns, you will receive a weapon.

greetings: I hate this grey shirt. I don't look good in it.
It's so nice to live in Lytelthorpe. We used to live in caves because there were monsters in this area.
Thanks! To get to the cave we lived in, follow the line of apple trees directly north of here. Be careful if you go there, and follow the line of candles.
This is amazing! It isn't even torn. Thank you!

Maybe you could help my friend Ercel in East Lytelthorpe Outpost. He's been moaning about a book he lost. And I'll write you a letter of recommendation to take to Lord Aleval in Lytelthorpe proper. He's always looking for adventurers.
I'm glad you helped out Ercel. He's a bit obsessed with this flying idea but he's nice enough. It's certainly hard to read this note! It isn't for me though, I believe it's for Lord Aleval.
Many of us used to live in the caves to the north because this area was full of nasty creatures. But we drove them out and built Lytelthorpe here.
Now the monsters have retreated into the caves where we once lived. Unfortunately, I accidentally left my favorite shirt there. Maybe you could get it for me.
To get to the cave we lived in, follow the line of apple trees directly north of here. Be careful if you go there, and follow the line of candles.
I wonder what it would be like to fly.
I'm writing a book on the aerodynamics of wings.  Did you know Phyntos Wasp wings are over twice as long as their bodies?
I've been constructing a set of wings out of wax and bird feathers. I can't wait to finish so I can test them out!
Thank you. I needed proof that you were new here and not going to steal my ideas. To get to the ruins, follow the pillars going east. Please hurry before the creatures destroy my book.
Oh, once in the ruins, try to find the trail of rocks.
Oh, I'm so relieved that my book isn't damaged. You've saved me months of work.
Perhaps you could help my friend Beltslora in West Lytelthorpe. Lord Aleval at Lytelthorpe Keep is always looking for adventurers too. I'll give you my recommendation to take to him.
This isn't for me, it's to Lord Aleval. You should take it to him.
I'm writing a book on the subject of phyntos wasp wings, but alas, I lost it in the ruins east of here. Now I must start all over again!  If you ever find my book please bring it to me.
To get to the ruins, follow the pillars going east. Please hurry before the creatures destroy my book.
Ah, Thank you. A fine example of Jhong Mi's writing. There are others in the dungeons near Yanshi too.
You may find the Atlan and Isparian weapons are powerful tools in combat.
If you wish to, read these books on how to obtain them.
An early work, but an important one.
A work that shows Jhong Mi's dissatisfaction. Fascinating.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Hey, looks like it got rolled in the mud... Anyway, well done!  Here, take these as a reward.
Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
You'd rather cast this spell on your own?
Well I can't argue with that.

Hello, I am a collector of the writings of Jhong Mi, who was a philosopher who wrote his own interpretations of the teachings of Jojii. If you find any of his writings, please give them to me, and I will reward you. You might start by talking to Lou Ei at the North Outpost, or Te Ven at the South Outpost.

Also, I have been contracted by the Dereth Exploration Society to help them in their outreach program towards the Isparians who find themselves newly exiled in Dereth. If you collect any of the Society's stamped letters, you may bring them back to me for a reward.
It has also been requested that I start handing out these gems.
quest: Copies of this seem to come in often.  Ah, well.  There are other writings by Jhong Mi in dungeons near Yanshi; if you find any, bring them to me.
Hmmm, I have received this letter too often from you recently to give a reward.  See me tomorrow, and I may have a reward for you then.
You will find gems on the table next to me which will allow you to change this weapon into a Heavy, Finesse or Light version.
You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.
No, this is for you to stamp the letters you find.  Please keep it.
Thank you, you must have journeyed far to get here.  You are a true Explorer!

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of jewelry or a wand for this. If you take this to one of the Aluvian towns, you will receive a weapon.

greetings: Very good; I see you can do this task for me.  I suspect my book was stolen by drudges, who have lately taken up residence in the dungeon I filled with lights, the Kindled Path.
Ungrateful creatures.  The dungeon is to the east of here.  Look for the candles that mark the entrance.
Ah, well done.  The drudges seem to like the smell of the book's binding, I guess.

Anyway, here is a reward for you.  From here, you may wish to see what else may be done in Nanto.  By the way, if you've found any broken tapers, I think the Archmage's Apprentice would like them more than I do.
This probably was made of inferior wax, but I will pay you for it.  Next time, take these to the Archmage's Apprentice.
I am a keeper of lights, seeking to illuminate the paths of the lost, as the good Elders would have me do.
I once filled an entire dungeon with glorious candles to help wanderers.  Recently, some creature or other stole my reference book on magical lights.
I suspect my book was stolen by drudges, who have lately taken up residence in the dungeon I filled with lights, the Kindled Path.
Oh, another letter from Ji-Ra?  My thanks.  If you find the Water Temple on the mountain to the west and retrieve the Water Bottle, I will repay you.
Ah, I do take those.  Inuo-Kon must have sent you.
Wonderful.  Here is a reward for your efforts.
You may find the Atlan and Isparian weapons are powerful tools in combat.
If you wish to, read these books on how to obtain them.

Ah, looks like you've found our agent's towel!  Looks like good old F.P. went swimming or something.  Here's your reward.
Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
You'd rather cast this spell on your own?
Well I can't argue with that.

It has also been requested that I start handing out these gems.
By the way -- if you haven't yet done so, you might want to visit Ji Ra Ping at the North Outpost, or Inuo KonKou at the East Outpost. They often have tasks for young adventurers.
If you find the Water Temple on the mountain to the west and retrieve the Water Bottle, I will repay you.
quest: You will find gems on the table next to me which will allow you to change this weapon into a Heavy, Finesse or Light version.
You must stamp this with a Town Stamp to get a reward.  Please read your Book of Quests to find out how to get a Stamp.

You will get nothing from me for this. Go explore and find more towns.  The Society Agents in the Gharun'dim towns will exchange a piece of jewelry or a wand for this. If you take this to one of the Aluvian towns, you will receive a weapon.

greetings: I'm sure you can do better than a white rat tail. Next time, try finding something a little less common.
Not my favorite kind of rat tail, but still worth something for your trouble.
Mmm, I hear these russet rat tails are good eaten.
You have to cook them just right of course.
Well, this is better than those common white rat tails...
A lucky find indeed. Thanks for bringing this to me!
Good. Someone finally brought me a black rat tail. It looks damaged, but I suppose it's worth something.
Not everyone is lucky enough to find one of these, and I'm grateful you brought it to me first!
Amazing! Judging by the size of this tail I would say the rat was unusually large.
You've earned this reward my friend.
Once upon a time, Dereth was nearly overrun with rats.  But through the efforts of many people, most of the rats have been eradicated.
They can be hard to kill because one must aim low to hit them.  I will take any rat tail trophies you find, but rats are much rarer now.
I do know of a small lair of rats southwest of the waterfalls.  Do not go if you hate rats.

My thanks. Some years ago, when the Gharu'n were just arriving here, the young noble Musansayn the Great became the first leader of our people in Dereth, and founded Samsur.  He later disappeared into the desert.
This key will open the door to his famed library.  Follow the road leading southeast - you will see his house off to your left.  If you can find any book remaining there, bring it back to me.
Ah, a fragment of the great work of Khaymahlai.  The historians of Zaikhal must have missed this when they carried off the rest of Musansayn's collection.
The merchant Lubziklan al-Luq will pay well for this.  He wishes his daughter to learn the history of the Gharu'n in Ispar.
You may find the Atlan and Isparian weapons are powerful tools in combat.
If you wish to, read these books on how to obtain them.

Looks like you've lucked out!  Our man F.P. has finished his book, finally!  Here you go...
You'd rather cast this spell on your own?
Well I can't argue with that.

It has also been requested that I start handing out these gems.

Also, have you a moment to help me recover another item? Some years ago, when the Gharu'n were just arriving here, the young noble Musansayn the Great became the first leader of our people in Dereth, and founded Samsur. He later disappeared into the desert.
This key will open the door to his famed library. Follow the road leading southeast - you will see his house off to your left. If you can find any book remaining there, bring it back to me.
