I am the examiner here at the Sho outpost of the Bestowers' Guild.  Please speak with Naba Ko-Zin if you wish to arrange for an examination.  The base piece of the skill puzzle is available in the other corner of this tent.  Be warned, however, that the test can only be taken once per day, and one may only be called by one title.
Ahh many thanks!  You are a true hero!  Here is a reward for you.
I bestow you with the title of Bugstomper!

Finally, I am glad that you saw fit to help me with this little matter, but I now have a new problem.  It seems that while I was busying occupying myself with this Tumerok archaeological site, a whole new host of bugs have taken up my previous exploration site, a dungeon on the other side of the island, named the Dark Lair.  I tried to show those bugs what's what, but I'm afraid I wasn't able t...
Well, aren't you something special?  I knew you could do it!
Well, let me officially recognize you as Gardener Weeder!

Now, while you were out ridding the island of those terrible bugs, I heard tell from a passing stranger that he discovered a Crumbling Empyrean Mansion infested with ugly Olthoi in the eastern lowlands. Bring me one of those Workers' pincers, and I'll reward you well!
This is fantastic! You're the best!
You shall henceforth be known as Worker Obliterator!

Well, you are making your way up in the world.  I was hesitant to bring this up before, but now I feel relatively certain that you are up for the challenge.  Up on the plateau, there is a nest of Olthoi Soldiers plaguing explorer parties that journey up above.  The townspeople have come to me asking if I can rid them of these horrors, and of course I immediately thought of you.  Go up to the pl...
I am most impressed!  You have accomplished much in a short time, traveler.
You deserve a title of Soldier Slaughterer!

I am somewhat embarrassed to bring it up, but it seems as though the townspeople have thought of me as the renowned Olthoi Slayer.  I have tried to explain to them that you are the one doing all the killing, but they don't seem to understand that.  Now they expect me to go kill off a nest of Olthoi supersoldiers!  We call them Olthoi Legionaries, and they are quite terrifying, from what I am gi...

You're back?!?  I mean, welcome!  Of course you're back!  I had the utmost faith...well, perhaps that is too...I was relatively sure that I would see you again, and the fact that you are still alive as well is pure felicity.
And of course, now you are an Exterminator!

I admit it, I have been telling the townspeople that I was the one killing all the olthoi and bringing back the pincers.  As a result, they have been treating me as a hero!  You have to understand, all I wanted was to be an explorer on this new island, but I found all this unexpected attention...gratifying.  But now...now I don't know what to do.  It seems they want me to face off against a hor...
You really are a savior!  Here is your reward.
Here is your new title of Bug Butcher!

Oh, my friend, the onslaughts never end! The moment I feel that we...I mean, you have brought these infestations to their final end, I hear that yet another swarm of even more dangerous Olthoi has made their presence known! Please, my friend, save my reputation once more. The Olthoi Warrior's Nest lies upon the northern part of the Marescent Plateau. Bring me the proof of a single Warrior's pin...
This is really amazing. How did you manage to kill all of those nasty bugs?".
I shall now change your title to Warrior Vanquisher!
Suddenly you see a strange light begin to gleam in Bedho's eye. With great alarm you realize that Bedho is preparing himself to grovel.

Oh great and powerful warrior from the east! Only you can save us from the perils that infest this land! They...they told me... stories of Mutilators boiling up from the plateau's very bowels, acid dripping from their very jaws!
Behdo's voice has now dropped to a whisper.

And they insist that I, Bedho Yi, must go and deliver them from this threat! Please...I promise this is the last time. The Mutilator Tunnels lie upon the northwestern side of the Plateau. Bring me a Mutilator pincer, and I shall reward you!
Thank goodness someone like you is out there looking out for us! Here is your reward.
All shall know you as an Annhilator!
Incredible! I had only heard rumors of these new Olthoi and their savage bloodlust.
All will now recognize you as an Eviscerator Decimator!
Amazing. Simply amazing! Returning with this pincer and keeping yourself in one piece is quite a feat.
All will now recognize you as the Ultimate Warrior!
How intriguing! I have never seen a trophy quite like this before!

I can't believe I have this wonderful tumerok site to explore, and I am forced to loiter around here due to those pesky Olthoi.  If you head up to 42 degrees north and 82.2 degrees west, you can help me with this problem!
The Dark Lair needs a brave adventurer like yourself to rid it of those icky bugs.  I don't remember the exact coordinates, but it was around forty-four degrees north, and sixty-eight degrees west.

There are three sites up on the Plateau that beckon to a hardy young adventurer like yourself.  One is on the southern portion of the plateau, the other two are on the northern end.  Good luck!  Not that, um, you'll need it or anything.
quest: You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.

Hello there stranger!  I am wondering if you can help me in a bit of a predicament I find myself in.  I was busy exploring a wonderfully well-preserved abandoned Tumerok outpost, when I was beset upon by a number of Olthoi!

I had never seen these fearsome creatures that close before, and the fact that I escaped with my life leads me to believe that these Olthoi aren't quite so tough as their mainland counterparts.  If you could journey to this tumerok outpost and rid it of these troublesome beasts I would be most grateful.

If you could bring me back some proof that you have conquered them, such as a pincer, I would reward you well.  I believe the portal to the Abandoned Tumerok Site now lies a bit to the northeast of here -- I have heard rumors that strange eddies in the currents of portal space have shifted it away from its original location.
What are you doing loitering about here?  Bring me proof of those nasty bugs' demise!

greetings: I regret to inform you that this material is too tough for me to craft into a robe.  It needs to be made more supple. Applying any type of acid solution to it should make the pelt supple and ready for use.  I have no idea where you might find such a solution however.
Yes, this is some of my finer work.  Enjoy it.
Yes, I believe this should do the trick.  Be careful, though, I have found that the hide reacts strangely to different types of acid.

This is a shoddy piece.  It is certainly not up to my standards.  Besides, it upsets Britana greatly.  She is very uncomfortable when her brother is mentioned.  I think she feels like she has something to prove to him.  I have tried to explain to her that standing in her light, Ketnan is a mere blade of grass underneath a large oak tree.  A beautiful and lovely tree.
Yes, this is definitely an improvement on the original.
I have no use for these, but Britana has instructed me to keep them.  So I shall.

You have succeeded in your quest.  Here is your Canescent Mattekar Robe.  By the way, have you seen where Britana goes late at night?  I think she is out walking with another...never mind, I am sorry to trouble you.
You have succeeded in your quest.  Here is your Canescent Mattekar Robe.

I am worried about Britana.  Lately she talks not so much about fame and fortune, but about love.  I tried to ask her to take a walk out in the moonlight, but she said she did not have time.  Perhaps tomorrow.
Interesting... but I think it would look better like this.

Yes, I have agreed to help Britana in her quest to fashion a new Hoary Mattekar Robe.  I don't know where this new Mattekar is rumored to be, you would have to ask Britana.  I have to admit, I had never encountered a woman like Britana before back in my home village.  She is quite the woman.
Bachus Flufens examines the spear intensely.

Ah, so there was something to their story after all...what an interesting find! But look here...don't these slots along this side suggest that it is missing a part? I wonder if it lies over in the caves directly to the northeast? For the past season I've been able to watch many Tumerok comings and goings here from my front porch. If you were to bring me back the object in its entirety, I'm sure...
Bachus squints carefully at the figurine.

I have never seen an artifact such as this before...some sort of Tumerok figurine? Ah...but it seems as if it is not in its entirety? Perhaps it should be married to another piece? If you bring me back the completed artifact, I will surely reward you!
Bachus gingerly lifts the weapon from your grasp and weighs it in her hands.
A Tumerok War Taiaha! One of the first examples of Tumerok war craft I have ever seen. I must send this on to Aliester--he will be delighted to further his research on Tumerok culture. I thank you!

An interesting find, this. I am not sure what to make of it. But it does not look as if it could fit to the spear I am speaking of. I am isolated here on my little farm--perhaps there is someone else on the island who could help you discover the secrets of its origin.
quest: Bachus tells you, "So you're back, %s. Good to see you. I am always happy when friends stop by, especially around sunset--the view is spectacular from here! I haven't noticed anything out of the ordinary of late, but can never tell what will happen on the island! Perhaps things will have changed even by next week."

Woe is me! The Hea must have overheard that I have been sending travelers to investigate their caverns, for they invaded my house, burned down my apple trees, and ate my bunny rabbits!  I barely escaped here to safety of Redspire in one piece! Fortunately my dear friend Micon has agreed to give me shelter until I am back upon my feet.

They must hold that relic in high esteem indeed. A most fanciful folk, I must say! I heard that it is a legendary spear that they dismantled and enshrined in two separate caverns on the island. It once belonged to a warrior from an opposite faction, I believe. He tried to persuade them back to traditional ways, but they would have none of it. Somehow they dispatched him but retained his spear.....

Perhaps the answer could be found in the caverns to the northwest along the shore.  Try the area around 40.2N 84.7W --at least that's where I saw the Tumeroks heading last. Beware, friend--it's quite likely to be well guarded. I'd go myself, but I must catch up on my journal today. If you would like to read it, here are a few pages that I wrote the other day.

greetings: Ling Xiao over in Redspire has been rewarding well for these.  You ought to go talk to him.
He thinks I'm envious of his growing collection, but I'd much rather collect other things.
You might want to give this to Shalon--he's more interested in collecting these than I am.
The last time I saw him was in Greenspire. He may still be there, if you're lucky.
My new associate, Hea Riketura, has asked me to send more items like this his way. He's a nice chap--for a Tumerok.
Try looking for him in Ahurenga. Interesting place--I wouldn't want to live there myself.  Too many odd happenings going on all the time...

An interesting find!  I don't think I've ever seen one like this before.  I've heard that there is a Tumerok who will craft this into some kind of weapon over in their city...but I've never met the fellow.
Good luck.  Sorry I can't help you more.
Sorry, but I have no use for these.
Nope, I have no use for that item.
I have no use for these.
Feathers? Thanks, but I'm not a fletcher.
You can have them back--there must be someone else who wants them.
What a pretty bag! But I'm not not interested, thanks.
You can have this back--there must be someone else who wants them.
Feathers?  Thanks, but I'm not a fletcher.
Why, it's a sparkly!  But must I repeat myself?  I collect Carenzi Pouchling pelts, Marsh Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Mud Golem hearts.
I'm not a rock hound.
Have you seen those beautiful birds around the island? I'm collecting their claws, but only those of a certain kind.
If you come across any trophies on the island, I would certainly be interested in rewarding you for some of them.
When I first came to the island, I wasn't sure how I was going to make a living.  But now I'm trading in island trophies--they don't see many like these on the mainland.
I'll reward you for Carenzi pelts, Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Golem hearts--but only specific kinds.
Thank you--these will look perfect in my trophy case. Allow me to reward you for your time and efforts.
There's more where that came from if you come across another.
I am gathering Carenzi Pouchling Pelts, Marsh Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Mud Golem Hearts. If you bring me one of these items, I will surely reward you.
Thanks, but I am not in the market for these. Merlonna might still be interested in them--you should take this to her.
She might still be in Bluespire, if she hasn't already moved on.
Sorry, but I have a very specialized collection. This just won't do.
Ling Xiao doesn't quite share my aesthetics.  Take this to him--he might like it.
I'm not interested in collecting these.  But I've heard there is a collector over in that Tumerok town, Ahurenga.  You might want to try over there...although I wouldn't if I were you.
It's much safer here in the Spires.
Something gives me a really funny feeling about this pendant...
I don't want it. Try taking it to Ahurenga.
Aha!  I met a Tumerok crafter who will make this into a weapon for you.  Hea Ihipura's his name. Strange ideas about nature, but nonetheless he seemed alright.
Try taking this to him.
This looks mothbitten.
No thanks.
I'm not in the market for these right now.
Disgusting!  I hate bugs!.
Get it off me!
I asked for claws, not feathers!
What happened to the rest of the bird?
Why are you giving me this empty bag?
I already have plenty of bags, thanks.
Where's the rest of the bird?
I have no idea what I would do with all of these feathers.
I'm not in the market for trophy jewels at this time.  I'm sure there's someone else on the island who is.
Good luck in finding someone.
There are many fascinating creatures on the island that I have never seen before.  I am rewarding handsomely for certain trophies.
We're a tightly knit community here on the island.  If you bring me something that I'm not interested in, I can probably tell you who is.
I've never been happier since I came to the island and started collecting here.  Soon my collection will be the envy of all!
I'll reward you for Carenzi pelts, Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Golem hearts--but only specific kinds.
Just what I was looking for! Half a moment, I will get your reward.
Just what I was looking for!  Half a moment, while I get your reward.
Thank you.
I am looking for Carenzi Burrower pelts, Littoral Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Sand Golem hearts. I will pay highly for them!
I'm not looking for these right now.  Perhaps Merlonna over in Bluespire could help you.
Thanks, but this is not quite what I'm looking for.
The last time I was in Greenspire, Shalon told me that he was interested in these.
The last time I was over in Greenspire, Shalon told me that he was interested in these.
This is not quite what I was looking for.
Try asking around for Riketura in Ahurenga. I haven't been there myself, but others have told me interesting tales.
This certainly isn't of Isparian craftmanship.
I think there's someone on the island who can craft this into a weapon.  It isn't an Isparian specialty--perhaps you should try Ahurenga.
This...thing probably has fleas.
Please, take this away.
Interesting trophy...you might be able to make a good backscracher out of it.
No thanks.
I did not ask for feathers.
Take these away...I think I'm allergic to them.
This bag has nothing in it!
I'm no fool, you know.
I didn't know one could find these here on the island.  Nonetheless, there is no room for this in my collection.
Soon my collection will be the envy of all!
Those golems certainly are fierce! I'm putting out a small bounty for Water Golem hearts--I was nearly drowned by one the other day.

Merlonna, Shalon, and I all collect trophies from Carenzis, Siraluuns, and Golems. I even think there might be a Tumerok collector over in their town, Ahurenga. Good thing we're all looking for different variants--otherwise we'd be brawling in the streets!
I'll reward you for Carenzi pelts, Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, and Golem hearts--but only specific kinds.
Merlonna will be so jealous of my growing collection! Here, take these health potions with my thanks.
Merlonna will be so jealous of my growing collection! Here, take this with my thanks.
If you were to bring me Carenzi Sentry pelts, Tidal Siraluun claws, Drudge charms, or Water Golem hearts, I will reward you with experience.
Thank you, your heroism is appreciated!
What's this? A note?
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Gromnie training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
What? You want a reward? This is no trophy -- this is just a scrap of paper! Bring me some trophy ripped from the hands of our enemies and then I will reward you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Mask training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
This weapon uses the most modern of military technology! It is specially crafted to be extra damaging against our Tumerok foes!
Lieutenant Kenneth lowers his voice.
Of course, for political reasons, it doesn't work against the Aun or the Hea Tumerok, but only against the Virindi-controlled renegades.
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Reedshark training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Ah, an old recruit come back to finally claim your promised reward!
Oh, and here -- take this.

We'd like to give you a small gift in appreciation for your ... patience, but that item hasn't come yet. But when it does, just give me this token back and I'll give you your reward. Why don't you check back in a month or two?
Lieutenant Kenneth coughs -- or was that a snicker?
Thank you, your heroism is appreciated! Take this!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Falcon training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Shreth training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Serpent training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hello, my name is Kenneth. I'm here to help direct an organized resistance against the renegade Tumerok attacks.
Queen Elysa has called for volunteers to help investigate the Tumerok training camps near Dryreach. You can pick up a news sheet about this menace from the barkeeper.
If you have already investigated the camps, and you have some trophy to prove it, I will gladly reward you. I also accept Tumerok insignia.
Thank you, your heroism is appreciated!

Ufet lowers his voice.
Of course, for political reasons, it doesn't work against the Aun or the Hea Tumerok, but only against the Virindi-controlled renegades.

Ufet coughs -- or was that a snicker?

Hmm ... You say you found this in the Gromnie training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Mask training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Ah! Yes! That was where they were headed. Thank you for finding this! Where did you find it?
As Ufet looks over the note, you relate to him how you found it.
I see. The shreth have always been known to be vicious.
Thank you for this little bit of information, but I will need something more from you in order to reward you for your efforts.
I thank you for this. It seems as though the Order of the Raven Hand have claws in several of my companions.
I thank you for this information. With these bits of knowledge, we will seek to restore the honor of our fallen comrades.
Here is something for your efforts.
The library seems to be caked in madness and filth. Remnants of a Shadow Bulwark perhaps? Soot-layered tombs and air that maddens.
Now I see why the Raven Hand sought this place out. There may be artifacts of powerful shadows within.
It seems, though, that Yalik has done well in guarding the place. This is a hugely important task for one as young as he. I wonder how well he will handle the task in the months to come.
Ufet nearly forgets you in his musing, but quickly returns to the matter at hand.
I thank you for this. We were right to suspect the Order of the Raven Hand were up to no good. Take this as a reward for your efforts.
This came from the Shadow's Garb worn by Rayssid Ibn Alhath? Sadly I know little of the man save for his affinity for ranged weapons.
It seems only fitting that the reward I give you should reflect that. Take this periapt. May it help guide your shots with accuracy and swiftness.
Ah, Tiyol's tassel, correct? I had no liking for that contemptuous man. In fact, it would not surprise me at all if he was the first to fall under the sway of the Raven Hand.
You did the world a great justice by defeating him. And since he was such a vile man, I have no qualms about giving out his belongings.
Before the group left for the library, many of them entrusted some of their belongings to my care. Primarily items that would be of no use to them in the grasslands and forests north of here.
Tiyol left this Cowl. Here, take it. I am glad to be rid of his belongings. Surely you will put the Cowl to a more appropriate use.

You say Rheth Al' Thok wore this upon his Shadow's Garb? He was a bright man, poised to enter the ranks of the Zaikhal Arcanum. Well... that was before my compatriots offered him a place within our ranks. A shame that he was so easily enticed.
Since he joined the ranks of the Zharalim, he was striving to obtain the Shagraka- the casting focus used by many of the Zharalim's sorcerers.
As he is no longer with us, the focus reserved for his use shall be passed on to you.
Any blow against those wretched creatures is a win in my mind.
Keep up the good work soldier.
Good Day. My name is Ufet, and I am here to organize the defense of Gharu'ndim from the depredations of the renegade Tumeroks.
Queen Elysa has called for volunteers to help investigate the Tumerok training camps near Dryreach. You can pick up a news sheet about this menace from the barkeeper.
If you have already investigated the camps, and you have some trophy to prove it, I will gladly reward you. I also accept Tumerok insignia.
You'll pardon me if my mind is on other matters today. Several of my comrades have left for a recently discovered library north west of this city, but they have not yet returned.
I am not usually one to worry, but with all that has happened of late, assassinations, invasions and an increase in cult activity, I can't help but do so.
I must remain at my station, but if you happen to come across them, please let me know where they are. Any information you find will put my mind at ease.
Thank you, your heroism is appreciated!
