Hmm ... You say you found this in the Shreth training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Hmm ... You say you found this in the Serpent training camp near Dryreach? Well, I must show this to my superiors at once! Thank you!
Greetings! My name is Kiroji, and I am a Shosa in the Sho Army. We must rally to deal with the renegade Tumerok alliance. We must not allow Hebian-To to fall!
Queen Elysa has called for volunteers to help investigate the Tumerok training camps near Dryreach. You can pick up a news sheet about this menace from the barkeeper.
If you have already investigated the camps, and you have some trophy to prove it, I will gladly reward you. I also accept Tumerok insignia.
No, this is for you.  I have no need of the Writ.  Use it to acquire your new home!  Even if you have purchased the house, some dwellings further require them for maintenance payments.

What an interesting ... umm ... mechanism! I have no idea what it's for! But you know, those Arcanum Researchers, they've been working with odd metals like this -- you should ask one of them. You can find them in the libraries in Cragstone, Hebian-To, or Zaikhal.
These crystals have many alchemical uses. Ciandra has continued to research what allows these stones to tap into this worlds well of powerful magics.
Here, take this as a reward.
We need all the ingots we can get.  One day, you will be grateful we have such a stockpile.

A rare find!  My congratulations.  Here is your Writ of Refuge.  The Empyrean have left many secrets for us to puzzle out.  Their geomancy recently became transparent to us.  This powder might reveal yet another crucial part of their power.  We shall crush the enemy through their own devices!
Thank you for bringing us this Niffis Pearl. It is thought it may be useful. Take this Writ as your reward.
Well! Would you look at this! This should be useful!
We thought this jelly was useless for a time. But we've recently discovered it has certain properties which are of much interest to us. Please, take this Writ as a reward.
We feared we would never be able to lay our hands on this poison again. Thank you for choosing to part with such a rare item!
This is a strange device indeed. I have never seen anything like this before. Hmm...
The Agent ponders this strange new item momentarily.
I'll tell you what. I'll take this thing off your hands and give you a Writ of Refuge in exchange! Sounds like a good enough deal, eh? Then it is settled!

I've seen a number of pearls in my days... You know we exchange Niffis Pearls for writs correct? ... Anyway, I have seen a number of pearls before, but this is obviously not from any niffis I've seen.

Look at how dark this pearl is, it seems to eat the very light around it. This is a truly rare find, some ancient Empyrean decoration no doubt, but I can't imagine it would be very different from the niffis pearls we know of.
I'll give you a special deal on this pearl, since it is obviously of a different quality than your common niffis pearls.
Oh, the token, I guess you deserve this.
Ah yes, I seem to recall that our leather crafters stopped making shirts out of these. Don't worry, we have plenty in stock. Here, let me get you a shirt this hide.
Forge Essence! We can surely use as much of this as you can lay your hands on.
Thank you. If you need to see the list of tradable items again, just ask.
There are few beasts on Dereth as feared and hated as the Margul Sezzherei. To meet one who has personally slain the creature... I cannot believe it!
You should be commended for your efforts. From this point forward, let it be known to all that you are the Sezzherei Slayer!
Well, you've found an Ancient Empyrean artifact I see. These don't turn up all that often. You should be rewarded for this find. Here you go!

Well, you've found an Ancient Falatacot artifact I see. These things always make my skin crawl. You see, the usual way of activating one of these is to place a drop of blood on the wheel symbol here. I leave the study of these nasty things to others though, you never know what might happen when you activate it. You should be rewarded for this find. Here you go!
A counterfeit Niffis Pearl! You will soon learn the punishment for trying to deceive an Agent of the Arcanum.
How does a thousand year sentence in the Queen's dungeon sound to you?
Agent of the Arcanum seems to be lost in thought for a moment.
Perhaps a deal may be struck.
We have just recently discovered these fakes and have been trying unsuccessfully to uncover the hideout of the forgers who craft these items.
Perhaps you will help us? In exchange for uncovering and destroying their hideout, I am willing to 'forgive' your transgression.
Or if you prefer I can just throw you in the dungeon and be done with it.
It's your choice.
Here. Take this note and return to your contact. Try to get in their good graces and find the location of their hideout.
Once you destroy their ability to produce Fake Niffis Pearls, bring back any leftover inventory to us so that we may dispose of them.
You have done well. I'm sure they will think twice before trying to fool the Agents of the Arcanum.
I absolve you of the crime of counterfeiting.
Although no reward is necessary, please accept this as a small token of our thanks.
You seem wise beyond your years.
Luminance is always a wonderful thing.
I shall share part of what I know with you. Use it well.
Knowledge earned is a great gift. Use it wisely.
A little Luminance is always a wonderful thing.
Ahhh a most intriquing item. I will have to study this and see what powers it may hold.
I see you have proven yourself in the Gauntlet. Please take this in return.
quest: Try back next month.
I am afraid you've turned in all you can for this month.
You must wait %tqt to turn in A'nekshay Gem of Knowledge again.
You must wait %tqt to turn in A'nekshay Gem of Lesser Knowledge again.
You must wait %tqt to turn in A'nekshay Luminance Certificate again.
Hand me another minor crystal like this one and I'll be able to reward you.

Thank you for investigating this matter for the Arcanum!  No, we do not yet comprehend the extent of the schemes of this minion.  I have confidence we shall find out soon, though.  Here is your Writ.  As of this time, we do not need any further tokens from you.  We will however still take the other trophies I mentioned to you.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. You are looking a little green my friend. Are you feeling okay?
We only wanted to see that you had achieved what we asked. Seeing as how you did so well you should keep this.
You never know, you may find a use for it yet.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. Umm, I think your britches may be burning.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. You know your hair looks as though it is standing on end.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. Was it cold in there?
I have recently rewarded you for visiting revenge up on that madman. Please come back to me in one day before asking for another reward.
%n shakes their head at you condemningly.
You are still a cur unworthy of trust. I am only too grateful to the wisdom and compassion of others. With their help, and theirs alone was Nuhmudira freed.

You are fortunate that she has pity within her heart enough to grant you the trappings that you need to obtain housing. If you give me any of these items listed here, then I will grudgingly give you a Writ of Refuge.
%n smiles at you gently.
You have done much to help us. Your sacrifice and actions assisted Nuhmudira in her darkest hour and we thank you for those efforts.
If you have not yet done so, seek out Balthazar outside of Lin. He will instruct you on how you may further aid us.

Housing continues to be provided through a joint effort of the Arcanum and the High Queen. Writs are required for these domiciles. Once you possess a Writ of Refuge, seek out a Covenant Stone and determine what else is needed to purchase your homestead. Also of note are new dwellings that have been opened that offer a more communal living arrangement.
Here is a list items we will accept in exchange for writs.
%n salutes you.
Here, take this as a reward.
I already informed you that we no longer need any tokens from you.  We will however still take the other trophies I mentioned to you.
Wow! You were able to navigate that place again. Great Job! We are not giving repeat offenders the Writs, but everything else is still available.
The Agent bows their head low and speaks softly.

Although Nuhmudira has returned to us, we have learned that there is still a way to show your support for her. Outside of Stonehold there is a portal to the dungeon where she was once imprisoned. There you can choose to sacrifice yourself for her or to abandon her to her fate. It is odd that the magic has yet to dissipate.

If you require writs we will accept any of the items on this list in exchange for a writ. Once you possess a Writ of Refuge, and have satisfied the other requirements for purchasing a home, seek out one of the homestead areas that we have built. If you would rather, you can enjoy living in one of the new dwelling areas that have been established for a more communal living arrangement.
Here is your reward.
I see that you have visited revenge upon the man that wanted to bring our race to an end. Nuhmudira thanks you for this. Here is your reward.
You are not powerful enough to receive the reward for this item, adventurer.
From this day forward %s shall be known as Gaerlan Slayer.

greetings: My, oh my! Just look at the size of this thing!
You say this rabbit was protecting the others? I've heard just about every rabbit story there is to tell, but this one takes the carrot cake!
I'm no April's Fool, you must have stitched this pelt together from smaller rabbit skins...
Hmm, no seams. I just can't get over how darn big this thing is. Ok, give me a minute and I'll have some ridiculously large slippers for you.

There ya go! One Hulking Pair of Bunny Slippers. Since you had so much pelt to work with I did some fancy stitch-work and made another rabbit face for the second slipper. Happy hunting and good speed!

Ah, you're back--and you've got that bunny carcass for me?  No mean feat that--those bunnies aren't just cute like everybody supposes...what with those hoppy legs and twitchy little noses!  Now...watch carefully.
%n skins the bunny, cuts the pelt, and quickly sews a bunny slipper.

There ya go! Gotta warn you though--only one per customer. What...you were expecting a pair? Silly rabbit, have you ever seen a two-headed bunny? But I already showed you how to do it--next time you find a rabbit carcass, use this slipper on it and you'll get your pair. Happy hunting and good speed!
quest: Now now, the demand for these white bunny slippers has been so high, I'm backordered for a month! Come back then, I might have some spare time to make another for ya.
Oh hello--get your white bunny slippers yet? I've gotta tell ya, it seems like everyone wants their own pair.  I've had so many requests, I can't take anymore for at least a month!

Ah, you're back--and you've got that bunny carcass for me?  No mean feat that--those bunnies aren't just cute like everybody supposes...what with those hoppy legs and twitchy little noses!  Now...watch carefully.
%n skins the bunny, cuts the pelt, and quickly sews a bunny slipper.

There ya go! Gotta warn you though--only one per customer. What...you were expecting a pair? Silly rabbit, have you ever seen a two-headed bunny? But I already showed you how to do it--next time you find a rabbit carcass, use this slipper on it and you'll get your pair. Happy hunting and good speed!

What's with all the carrots, you ask? Why, I'm luring bunnies! See my slippers?  Why, I was able to run all the way from the Direlands to here, fast as you can say "Lickety-split!" And I can't tell you how nice it is at the end of the day to curl up by the fire with a good book and  these slippers warming my tootsies. And ya know what? I like these so much, I have them in every color of the rai...

greetings: Making Masks is kind of a waste of time, since Alexander can do it as well.  I can make wondrous thrown weapons though.

Ah, yes, you'll want the Hollow Minion Mask then. Nice thing about these heads is that they are pretty much already masks. I just have to dispel the magic on it and clean it up a bit before you can use it. There you go, a very believable mask.
If you want the Scary Minion Mask turn this into my master right there.
Scarecrow heads have an odd magic this time of year.  If you carve them just right, and perform a little chant... Ah HA!  Success...
Mosswart head, eh? Okay Let me just umm. Yeah. I need the paint. Okay there we go and a little more green and there we go.
It's not that hard... really.

A banderling head, great. Okay so I need to stick this on something. Do you have a stick? Oh never mind I'll just put it on my other hand. Sure and with a twist of the knife here and there. Ow! No, no it's nothing.
There you go. No the bleeding will stop soon don't worry about me.
Interesting. I must say that I am glad to finally be doing something more than second--hand work. Wait a minute! This is something that Alexander didn't want to work with. Perfect! Just perfect!
%n grumbles under his breath. As he grumbles he begins to make changes to the mask.
There! That's the best work I have in me.
Alexander's Apprentice leans over his small work bench and attempts to muffle the sound of his work as much as possible.
As he hands the newly fashioned Sunstone Gauntlets back to you, he quickly brushes the gemstone chips out the nearby window.
Now I know these aren't the highest quality alterations, but I'm learning. Promise me you won't go to Alexander if they fall apart on you in combat.

Hi, I'm Calvin, Alexander's apprentice.  He only lets me practice on skulls and scarecrow heads but he has also allowed me to start work on mosswart and banderling heads, using his old designs. So if you give one of them to me, I'll make something out of it.
Making masks is kind of a waste of time.  I can turn skulls and scarecrow heads into deadly throwing weapons, however.  Just don't tell my master!

Alexander doesn't know it yet, but I am working on a side project that I hope will pad my pockets a bit better once I get better at it. Give me your Sunstone Gauntlets and I'll see about bringing out a nice orange color in them!
I find a flaming skull is the best way to deter a hostile creature from attacking you!

Ah, yes, you'll want the Hollow Minion Mask then. Nice thing about these heads is that they are pretty much already masks. I just have to dispel the magic on it and clean it up a bit before you can use it. There you go, a very believable mask.
If you want the Scary Minion Mask turn this into my master right there.
Carving a fierce face into a scarecrow head is a sure way to make your opponent dread the fate headed towards them.
Well here goes nothing. Okay paring knife to make the eyes... whoops! No problem, no problem. Yeah that works. Whew!
There you go. See, just like Janda's.
Now let's see, carving knife into the skull to separate the... No that doesn't look right. What about? Nope. Hmm. Oh yeah I had the directions upside down.
Quite simple actually.
Ahh, I have been expecting to see some of these soon. I'll be with you in a moment.
%n begins work on the mask. For a moment the mask looks more like a mummy than a virindi.
Whoops!
Heh, tell your friends. I'm improving, aren't I?
Thank you for having the same faith in my skills as Janda. It makes me happy to know that... Oops...
In his zeal, Bleis accidentally gouges the gauntlets.
I'm so sorry! I don't think the gauntlets are damaged badly, if anything they will just be lightly scarred.

Hello, I'm Bleis, Janda's apprentice.  She's letting me work with skulls, scarecrow heads, mosswart heads, and baderling heads. Finally! Of course I'm still learning, I never thought that apprenticeship would take so long. I'll craft the older versions of the mosswart and banderling masks for you. If you would like the old styles or something unique hand one of the heads to me.

Also, with Janda's blessing, I am learning the art of facetting. She believes I am capable of applying what I have learned. If you have them handy, I will be happy to alter your Sunstone Gauntlets and bring a dark red color to them.

Making masks is a noble pursuit.  While researching it, I learned how to bring out the inner magic in skeleton skulls.  This ability also works on scarecrow heads, but only during the Festival Season.
I have learned how the ancient art of bringing out the power innate to undead skulls.  Either that, or I made a deal with the Virindi for special powers.
You never can tell nowadays...

Ah, yes, you'll want the Hollow Minion Mask then. Nice thing about these heads is that they are pretty much already masks. I just have to dispel the magic on it and clean it up a bit before you can use it. There you go, a very believable mask.
If you want the Scary Minion Mask turn this into my master right there.
Scarecrow heads are dangerous, when flaming and thrown at you.  I just wanted to make sure you knew.
There is nothing more wonderful than waking up and knowing that I have a full day of helping people ahead of me. Making things from smelly old heads. Oh, glory!
I've been thinking about joining an acting troupe, what do you think?
I really, really love working with masks. No... really I do. It's the most rewarding job I have ever done, for free. Oh here we go.
%n grumbles, "I need to do something with my life."

Oh great. Thank you. This will be the most fun I've ever had. Let me see gray paint, black paint and white paint. Wow... what an amazing array of colors the virindi use in their attempt to hoodwink us.
%n looks out the window longingly.
%n tosses the mask to you. "There you go."
Hey, thanks! I'm glad that I can be of use for something outside of festival trinkets!
You cringe in horrow as flakes of red sunstone fall to the floor in front of you.
Hmm, well... I guess that did what I wanted to... sort of...

Hi, I'm Zoe, Tsua's apprentice.  He said that I have  polished my basic skills enough to move on to more advanced things. So this year I can craft his old designs for mosswart and banderling heads. Additionally if you give me either a skull or a scarecrow head, I will make a thrown weapon from them.

Making masks is a valuable trade... once a year.  So, to both learn and provide a service to my fellow Isparians, I have taken up the craft of Gem-smithing. If you have a pair of Sunstone Gauntlets, I will take the gauntlets and facet them to bring out the color of the sun in them.
You hear faint cackling as a man laughs about his claim.
I warned you against jumping my claim!  Now don't come back, ya hear?!?
Get off my land!
Double-click on me to hear what I have to say.
Town criers like me are available in most major towns to tell you of the latest news and events. Double-click on me for more tips!
Maximize your chat window by clicking on the little white square at the upper-right corner of your chat box. Double-click on me for more tips!
You can regain stamina, health, and mana by lying down. Double-click on me for more tips!
Drag objects to the short cut bar in the lower-right of your screen, marked with numbers one to nine. Press on the number keys to use them! Double-click on me for more tips!
Double-click on items in your inventory to use them. Double-click on me for more tips!
Right-click on items in your inventory to examine them. Double-click on me for more tips!
To use an item in your inventory on an item in the environment, double-click on your item, then click on the second one. Try to fill this beerstein with some nice cold beer from this keg!
Double-click on me for more tips!
Look at the green buttons under your Inventory. Click on the one with the Wand to pull up your Spell Book. Double-click on me for more tips!
Look at the green buttons under your Inventory. Click on the one with the Flexed Arm to see your Attributes and Skills Panel. Double-click on me for more tips!
Look at the green buttons under your Inventory. Click on the one with the Silhouettes to open your Allegiance, Fellowship, and Trade Panels. Double-click on me for more tips!
Look at the green buttons under your Inventory. Click on the one with the Star to open your World Map. Double-click on me for more tips!
Many items, such as potions, that you'll find in the world are stackable. This means that they will stack on top of each other in the same slot in your inventory.
Excellent work! This gorget may be imbued with the elixirs that I give out in exchange for ruined amulets.

If you need to know more, then take this to the Arcanum Consortium, in the desert sands above Xarabydun, and seek out the Artificer there by the name of Hiro. He will be pleased to see you and your find.

So you fought through the sclavus horde and emerged victorious with a prize! Excellent work, hero. This gorget that you have found may be imbued with the elixirs that I give out in exchange for ruined amulets.
Ahh, a prize worthy of the great efforts you undoubtedly put forth! This gorget that you have found may be imbued with the elixirs that I give out in exchange for ruined amulets.
Excellent work! Hmm taken from the grasp of a Banderling Berserker I see. You are truly a talented hunter. Here take this.
Thank you for retrieving this from the Scrawed Grievver's gullet. We could not possibly do all of our work without your help. Here take this, with my thanks.
You've hunted a Virulent Grievver and lived to tell the tale I see. I applaud your efforts Isparian. As promised, I have a reward for you.
It must have been a difficult fight against the Lich Lord but you appear to have emerged victorious. Here take this as a reward for your efforts.
So you tracked down and killed a Ferocious Monouga to reclaim this amulet. You have done excellent work. Take this and be proud of your efforts.
Was it a difficult fight? Certainly not daunting for one of your talents, aye? Well you have proven that you do wish to assist our High Queen and the Arcanum, take this.
Drudge Lurker you say! Ha! That must have been a very simple fight indeed. Yet still you have found what was lost and I will see that you are rewarded. Here.

Raveners? You have done well to procure this item for us, I only hope that the Arcanum can repair them, all that have been returned to us have been befouled by the creatures who stole them. Ah yes...your reward. Here.

Mosswarts! And from the Vesayen Islands no less. What foul trickery is afoot? We shall dispatch a cadre of warrior to discern greater truths once we have this storage facility cleared. For now I will see that you are rewarded.

Another of the mosswarts from the Vesayen Isles carried this, you say? Well they certainly traveled a great distance after the sclavus. I wonder why they wanted these things so badly. Alas it appears ruined. No matter for you however, here.
Soul Trapper? Those mosswarts have been traveling all over it seems. Well you have done very well to bring this item to me, and you shall be rewarded for your efforts.

Those maddened mosswarts from the islands, the Zealot you say? You have performed this task in a most excellent fashion friend. The Arcanum and your High Queen thank you. Here take this as recompense for your efforts.
A Brutish Monouga had taken this? Well then I am glad you were able to wrest it free from its grasp. Here is your reward.
A Banderling Striker, eh? Well good work! You're a fine hunter, and I applaud your efforts to assist us in the dark time. Here take this.
It must have been a difficult fight against the shadow but you appear to have emerged victorious. Here take this as a reward for your efforts.
quest: %n spits at your feet.

How dare you speak to me? You who think yourself above a woman who was willing to sacrifice all, her sanity, her body, her life for all of us. You make me sick. Leave my presence for I will have nothing more to do with you.
Ah ... You have helped the captured Nuhmudira. You are a very noble person.
%n snaps to attention, and salutes you.

I have been sent here to ensure that none venture into this hold. It is overrun by a horde of Sclavus -- they have stolen some of the items that were collected here by Nuhmudira, the Arcanum and their Agents. These Sclavus are of a potent and singular mind, it seems, and all attempts to root them from their positions have met with great casualties.

Our High Queen has organized a unit of her elite forces and established a foothold within the first rooms of this storehouse. If you are brave enough, you may assist us in restoring the stolen items. In return, you may claim one of the special items that was stored within. Speak to the guards inside the storehouse to learn more.
%n looks you over speculatively.

With your skill you might be able to ... Yes, yes I think you can. When the Sclavus overran this building they were pursued by a variety of creatures that they upset along their migration here. Here is a list of the creatures.

Each of these creatures may have escaped with some of the relics that were stored in this facility. Hunt them, and see if you can't find any of the ... odd relics. If you do find anything out of the ordinary, return it to me, and I will reward you with an elixir which will make the item you claim from the storehouse more powerful.
%n snaps to attention and salutes you.

Hail, fellow Isparian. I have been sent here to ensure that none venture into this hold. It is overrun by a horde of Sclavus -- they have stolen some of the items that were collected here by Nuhmudira, the Arcanum and their Agents. These Sclavus are of a potent and singular mind, it seems, and all attempts to root them from their positions have met with great casualties.

Our High Queen has organized a unit of her elite forces and established a foothold within the first rooms of this storehouse. If you are brave enough, you may assist us in restoring the stolen items. However ...
%n sighs.

I do not know you, Isparian. And I fear that trust is in short supply these days. I must ask you to prove yourself before I can accept your assistance. If you journey to Stonehold and there choose to support Nuhmudira with the sacrifice of your own life essence, then I will know that you are truly on our side.

greetings: Well, look at that. Where did you say you found this?
The Arcanum Researcher studies the mechanism carefully. She rubs it, tries to dent it with a fingernail, even sniffs at the metal.
No, I've never seen anything like this. Although ...
She tilts her head to the side as she thinks.
No, I think I do remember something about a metal like this. Something the undead were working on. Hmmm ...
Why don't you ask the Undead Mechanic, by the waterfall on Marae Lassel? Maybe he can tell you something about this ... umm ... mechanism.
You've made contact with the lost town of Mar'uun?
This is very shocking indeed.
I've read through the research note.
I'm going to send you to talk to one of our researchers, Ned the Clever.
He's been looking into a substance that may tie into this research.
Ned the Clever has been residing in Zaikhal.
You need to see Ned the Clever about this. He's the one familiar with this research.

Why, it's you, %s! I have heard of your valiant deeds from afar. The Arcanum extends its deepest gratitude to you for destroying the Statues menacing our towns. Take this gear to the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun--he will fashion an award made especially for you.

Why, it's you, %s! I have heard of your valiant deeds from afar. The Arcanum extends its deepest gratitude to you for destroying the Statues menacing our towns. Take this coil to the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun--he will fashion an award made especially for you.

Why, it's you, %s! I have heard of your valiant deeds from afar. The Arcanum extends its deepest gratitude to you for destroying the Statues menacing our towns. Take this spring to the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun--he will fashion an award made especially for you.

Why, it's you, %s! I have heard of your valiant deeds from afar. The Arcanum extends its deepest gratitude to you for destroying the Statues menacing our towns. Take these nuts and bolts to the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun--he will fashion an award made especially for you.
quest: I'm sorry--I have to spend the day packing up all these statue parts so I can send them off to the Arcanum. Come back tomorrow--I'll make sure I have enough empty boxes!

Hail, %s, word of your valiant deeds proceed you! What can I do for you on this fine day? If you carry a trophy from one of the statues infesting the foundries beneath the cities of Dereth, I will reward you with experience for them.
The Arcanum will surely be interested in this artifact! For this I shall reward you with 2000 experience. Thank you!
The Arcanum will surely be interested in this artifact! For this I shall reward you with 18,000 experience. Thank you!
The Arcanum will surely be interested in this artifact! For this I shall reward you with 30,000 experience. Thank you!
The Arcanum will surely be interested in this artifact! For this I shall reward you with 60,000 experience. Thank you!

I have the latest reports from the Arcanum with me. Asheron stopped by the Arcanum workshops and gifted the Tinkers with knowledge of Yalaini transmutation magic. Using their new insights, the Tinkers have found the way to penetrate the Foundries from which these statues have come. If you seek out the Arcanum Tinker in the Consortium near Xarabydun, he will be able to tell you more!

Meanwhile, I will still deliver the same rewards for any trophies that you might find on the statues menacing our towns. I will give additional rewards for any interesting items found within the Foundries, for I am sure the Arcanum would be interested in studying them further.
This is indeed an intriguing item, but I am afraid you are too powerful to benefit from the experience that the redemption of this item would merit.
Although I have seen many items like this in the past weeks, the Arcanum has directed me to bestow the same rewards as before. Thank you for your diligence--the statues may yet be defeated!
This is indeed an intriguing item, but I am afraid you are not powerful enough  to receive the experience that  the redemption of this item would merit.

greetings: I've found a way to alter these stones to work with an Isparian Weapon, but I need you to get something for me first. I've managed, in my research, to locate a possible location for one of Atlan's Workshops, where he made the first weapons we based the Isparian Weapons on.
The portal should be at 66.9N 15.9E, along the outside of the Mt. Esper Caldera. Go there, and gather for me whatever information you can.
Ahh, a damaged Atlan Stone. I've seen a lot of these lately. I wonder what's damaging them without destroying them... Very odd...
Ciandra examines the stone intently.
Hmmm... This should work...
Ciandra takes some tools and a few drops of Aqua Vitae to the stone. Suddenly, the cracks seal, and the stone pulses slightly with a chill darkness.
There. I don't think it'll work in an Isparian Weapon, as it is not fully repaired, but it should provide some benefit, if it's set in a secure place and used. Here you go.

If you're interested, I may have a plan for turning these into stones usable in Isparian Weapons. If you are interested in this, just hand the repaired stone back to me to examine. Know this first though, the stone will lose the ability to be placed in a home, if it is successfully altered from what it is now.
Ciandra takes the shard and examines its reflective surface with a satisfied look.
I take it the Nullification Barrier held. I knew it would! The Harbinger should be severely weakened as long as the field holds. I would suggest attacking him soon if you haven't already.
Here's a small token of my gratitude. You've really come through for the Arcanum.
Ahh, the translated tome! Wonderful!
Ciandra examines the book intently.

This is going to take a bit of work, but this first part here is a magical "key" to enter Atlan's Laboratory. I'll attune you to the wards, so you can gain entrance. Go in there and see what you can find.
Ciandra chants quietly, and a soft glow infuses your skin for a moment.
Be careful in there. If these wards are any indication, Atlan was more than capable of setting up his lab to be well defended.
Perfect! This is just the tool mentioned in these notes.
Ciandra examines the Damaged Stone Infuser.
It's been damaged... This will complicate things slightly. Ahh, this is bent too far over here... This part will need to be reset... there.
There you go, it should work now, but those repairs have made it rather fragile. It'll work as it needs to, but I don't think it'll survive more than one use.

The book will tell you how to use it. You'll need two Decanters of Essence to make the process work. The first, you will need to bring, along with a Repaired Shadow Stone, to the Shade of Farelaith, in Northern Osteth. He can be found at 74.3N, 58.6E. The second you will need for charging the Stone Infuser. The information is all in the book.
If you don't have two Decanters of Essence, my Apprentice can direct you in how to get some.

Ah, excellent, an arm from the Harbinger! You must have killed the Essences before you fought the Harbinger and retrieved this limb. You can tell by the lack of thaumic glow I've seen on the Essence bolstered Harbinger limbs. I can't wait to begin testing this! Here take this as a reward for helping to keep the Harbinger in check. Return it to me if you would prefer a less tangible reward.
No problem, let's see, I think you've earned this.

Ah, excellent, an arm from the Harbinger! Oh, just look at the glow it has! That's thaumic residue from the absorbtion of the Essences! This is so exciting, I can't wait to begin testing this! Here take this as a reward for helping to keep the Harbinger in check. Return it to me if you would prefer a different reward.
No problem, let's see, I hope you can use this. If not, then return it to me for a less tangible reward.

I haven't been this excited since we discovered the Temples of Enlightenment and Forgetfullness! I was able to get some of my thoughts on paper, but the most important pieces were in front of us all along. Pyreal motes and Aqua Incanta -- who would have ever known?

In this book you'll learn the very basics. Thanks to Hiro, who supplied the crucible -- a discovery that he simply grumbles about -- we're now able to brew potent magical concoctions that can be turned into solid forms, much like what the Lugians are able to do. Visit Zarri ibn Khaybi to buy your crucible. Good luck!
Oh, and if you've come about the Isparian weapons, you should speak with my apprentice Alaine.
Ah, you found something. An ancient document... Perhaps it may explain this haunting.

Hmm, I believe the document is written in Yalaini. If you take it to Bretself the Translator who resides in Cragstone, he should be able to translate it for you. Please bring it back to me when it is translated.
The translated version. So, it truly was written in Yalaini!
Have you read this already? This chronicle of terror chills my soul.
Frest Greelving shudders

Alas, it appears my gripe is with the Arcanum builders who constructed the mansion here. This ground is cursed and perhaps should not be inhabited. Yet, perhaps you may be able to do something to stop the horror that grips this place. I understand now that it comes from beneath the mansion. There is... something... down there.  If you can eliminate this terror I would reward you.
I now give you permission to enter my mansion dungeon. Here is the key to the chamber where the portal is, you already know why I secured it. Take good care.
quest: You helped me recently but...
they're back!
Go away and let someone else see if they can succeed.
Are you too scared to continue? If so, I would not fault you.

So, you were able to subdue the entity instigating the horrible occurrences in my house? I am delighted! I expect any spectral beings left haunting the mansion should leave soon and allow me to dwell there in peace.
Alas, I am low on cash at this time but I do have a fine piece of furniture I could give you. It just may remind you that there are are forces in the world, unknown, unknowable, unnameable!
I already have my emerald, which you brought me!
I already have my shirt. But thank you for this one.
I can always use another as I stand here out in the open, listening to the horrors writhing within the mansion.
You gave me my platter. I didn't think I had two of them, but perhaps I did. It primarily has sentimental value. Thank you.

Traveller, please! I wonder if I may call on you to help me? An unnamed evil permeates my mansion. I cannot go back in there! There are some objects of sentimental value I wish to have retrieved from my house. I will reward you if you do.

I shall give you a copy of my journal in which I have recorded the growing horror within that house. It also lists the items I would appreciate you retrieving for me. Also, if you should discover any clues of what is causing this horror, please bring them to me.
Thank you, you retrieved my precious emerald! Here is your reward.
Without my mansion I won't be needing this. I've been using it as a decorative piece.
Thank you, yes, that is my favorite puffy shirt! Here is your reward.
I've been using this to make stew. I think it's intended for use with thrown weapons, you can have it.
Thank you, that is my antique platter! Here is your reward.
I used this as a child for a game in which you hit spheres back.

greetings: Kleeoh presses the vial back into your hand.
Dis be powerful stuff!  You not be understandin' the magic of the dead? Haha!
Kleeoh lowers her voice, and leans close to you.
Use dis black poison blood to strengthen da bond you must make.
Kleeoh twists a small lock of fur out of the reeking, moist clump, and tucks it away.  She hands the rest back to you.
You got a lot dere.  I only take what I need, and no more.
I hope you and dat old hermit know what you doing!  Evil maka like this needs a strong bond, and dis big wooly fur is a good start - but I do not know how you will create such a thing.
Aye, you've done well enough with this wretched pocki.
Da blood of da dead will bring you strength in whatever type of maka you trying!
Ah, dis be a special ring.  A loop with a secret catch, to release dis dark poision vial.  Oh, you be thinkin' it be blood in dere?
Aye, blood it was.  But now death it be for those who so much as touch a drip-drop of it.  You be careful now, fussin' around with dis mess.
Kleeoh smiles at you oddly; a strange chill causes you to shiver briefly.
Dere is only one reason why you would be out here messin' with such evil maka.  You be lookin' to make power from idols, you be! Ha!
I know you been talkin' to dat old man.  And I know what you be needin' from here, if you be after the same madness he was.
Some assailers been getting' da jungle sick about them.  Dere furry coat be getting' rough, and da sickness be all over it.

You gonna have to fight the wooly beasts and dere jungle sickness -- and get some fur.  Dey be all over da jungle, like a plague.  You find dem, and bring back to us, bring back to us, bring back to us...
What, you be thinkin' it's easy to make dangerous big maka? Ha ha!
Dis for Kleeoh? Dis be a beautiful flower, no?
Kleeoh, pauses a moment and stares into you with her piercing dark eyes.
Haha, you not here to do me evil. You want someting I think...
Kleeoh smiles at you for a moment.
You know about dis flower? Dis be a Death Blossom. Very beautiful, very dangerous!
You breath too much of its perfume and you go all weak like a baby. You no move for hours you so tired.
Now, you fool enough to lick a petal and you be dead before your head touch ground. Very powerful poison!
Dat Mudmouth was usin dis flower to make da Tusker King sick.
I hear Jilna be makin powerful maka to for him now.
I have need of dis flower for my magics. I tink you will find dis fair payment.
Kleeoh holds up a palm with white powder and blows it into your eyes.
Hello child, I sense dat you be looking for high adventure here where da tusker is king, no? Well let Kleeoh give you da help den. Why ya wonder I hid from ya when first ya came to da island?
Well that be simple, Oolutanga don't be liking those of us dat can think for ourselves. Who's Oolutanga?
You come to da island of da king Oolutanga. A refugee from da halls of a cruel virindi name by Aerbax.
Oolutanga is a special tusker you see. Yes. He be powerful strong and powerful big and powerful smart. He be a tusker dat hates da virindi. He frees his people when he can.
He has a magic about him. A magic dat comes from da hand dat he lost while fighting da former owner of dis island.
%n chortles.
Dey say dat if a person get hold of da hand taken from Oolutanga dey can have three wishes granted. But only in da temple of da king.
You be wanting to go dere den eh?
Well head to da waterfall on de interior of dis island and search for da entrance. Dere you find your way... Dere you find your way.
Read da signs. Dey tell secrets dey do.
Ooo...ooo...eee...aaa...aaa.
Brighteyes looks around nervously.
I have to keep up appearances that I'm just like the other humans here or else they'll cage and collar me.
What is this? This is the left tusk, it's hollow. I cannot use this. It has no value on this island.
Excellent work. This is one of the deadliest of the tuskers, you were brave and showed your dedication to my cause.
I bestow the title of Stone Cold Killer upon you!
The portal gem will get you back to Frozen Valley quickly.
Excellent work. Of course this is one of the lowliest of the tuskers, but you were brave and showed your dedication to my cause.
The portal gem will get you back here quickly, until you steal the scroll from the clutches of the mighty Bobo.
Excellent work. Of course this is the lowliest of the tuskers, but you did show your dedication to my cause.
Masterful. The Crimsonback can be quite ferocious you've done more than you know.
Striking down a Goldenback is no easy feat as I am sure you know. With enough people like you around we'll have this madhouse cleared of the Tuskers in no time.
Yes! Finally getting some breathing space. I've been alone here for so long that I'd begun to think that no one would ever come to help.
Bobo, says that these tuskers are heroes because they have helped to free so many of their brethren. But what about us? We're not free. But thanks to your efforts we will be someday.
Serves them right. You've done wonders here. Killing a mighty slave. You are rising quickly through the ranks.
Dispatched a guard, worthy of song back on Ispar if you ask me. I'd sing but the tuskers would know that I recovered from my head wound.
You found a weak spot in his armor. Well fought. I'm glad you made it back to me safely. Now let's get on with business there are more of these brutal foes to be crushed.
Silvers are deadly. You're getting to be a regular hero. The resistance owes you a debt.
But their armor is so strong, how did you ever? Better not to question, you succeeded and that is good enough for me.
Now we're starting to see who the men and women are. Your efforts are applauded through the entire organization.
I keep forgetting I am the organization.
These are the first of the real ring leaders. I hate these damn dirty tuskers, but not as much as the fabled...we'll leave that alone. My thanks.

Now bring me the head of Bobo! Never mind that he calls himself Oolutanga. His minions and Tusker allies can't say that name -- it's too long, has too many vowels. Don't you see? They don't have opposable thumbs! We should be the superior race! We should be ruling them! Don't you get it?
Sorry, I lost it there a little.
Here you go.
So when you bringing me to the mainland?
Is it pretty on the mainland? You know calm, no tuskers, people think life is grand?
So you said something about the mainland and me getting to go there someday, right?
Yeah I heard about this place where people get respect even if they are a little off kilter, something about some guy named Martine, you're not from there are you?
So I was thinking maybe you should talk to some friends see if they'll take me in. Or maybe you have a cottage, I can be quiet you know.
Maybe you should to talk to Bobo. Give him a tusker husk for me.
What do you mean, well maybe you should wear a tusker mask...
It's people! Mushed nanners is people!
It gets very lonely out here. I've had a lot of time to myself.
Where did you find this?
You point to the west, towards the place where you found the body.
Along the shore you say? Let me examine this note a little more closely.
Brighteyes studies the scrap of paper given to him.
You are lucky I have learned about their strange methods of communication, otherwise I don't think there'd be an Isparian alive who could translate this.
It seems this particular fellow was taken "below" and given...uh...great power.
And somehow it...ah...opened his mind -- see here, it is indicated with the symbol they use for light.
And here, the symbol for...fighting or war, I think.  It is repeated over and over - I am not sure why.
I'm afraid I can't figure out much else -- however I am quite concerned with this "enlightened" sycophant.  A revolution among the enslaved masses of these islands would be my dream come true!
It would seem as though he was escaping from somewhere "below," on the large island to the west.
Possibly the Tusker Assault lair?  I have heard that subterranean complex is teeming with the beasts and their thralls.
The head of the Painbringer -- I have never heard of such a beast before!
You say you found this vile creature within the Assault lair?
I wonder...is it possible that blasted tusker king has His paw in this new evil?  More powerful minions is not the kind of revolution I had in mind!
Well it isn't much, but...here, take this --
'Tis a bit crude -- but what would you expect?
Brighteyes leans towards you and whispers, "Dammit %s! I'm a tailor, not a weaponsmith!"
This should show everyone who the real champion of Aphus Lassel is!
quest: Have you brought me proof that your fighting against the tuskers? If so, hand it over so I can give you your reward. But be discreet, they may not understand Roulean but they know when something is up.
I'm Brighteyes. I can't remember my real name. That fool of a Tusker walloped me over the head real good when I arrived here.
I was immediately grabbed after walking through one of those purple swirling portals on Ispar. One of the big walking rugs here grabbed me.
I said, 'Get your hands off me you damn dirty...' then Wunk! A big stone caps me on the head.
They did it to everyone that came here. No people come here anymore though. Stopped about a year ago.
I am the leader and only member of the human resistance here in this world gone mad. If you bring me proof that you're fighting against these...these...tuskers. I will reward you.
Give me one of their tusks and I'll be sure to reward you well.
You gave me that already.
You gave me before.
Thank you for looking for Tamian.  I don't know what to say.

No word of Tamian? I suppose not, I spoke with most people here myself. I know Delton is still angry at him.  Well, Tamian acted a bit wild that day when he and Delton fought, but perhaps he is just not used to swordplay and grew furious when Delton swatted him.  Delton is quite good with a sword. Tamian knows nothing about them.
Astara sighs

Of late, Tamian had been extremely interested in something a Scribe who was travelling through here had given him.  It had to do with a tower.  Tamian is always drawing towers and such. The Scribe was named Tian Li Quan and resides in Lin, I believe. Tamian is no great traveler and that is quite a way from here. Strange that he would go and say nothing, but perhaps...
Have you found anything out about Tamian yet?
I... I did not know...
Thank you for giving me this.
Oh, Tamian!

Hello. Have you seen Tamian Wilmit around at all lately?  I have not seen him in quite some time now. I am concerned about him, he had been acting a bit strange lately.  He is a very dear friend.  If you could find where he is I would very much appreciate it.  He had a row with my friend Delton Hardor. Very out of character for Tamian.
You got the sword recently, did you not? Or have you lost it already?
I hope you make good use of the sword you obtained so recently.
Ah, so you have returned. Not all do. Did you get a signet from one of the Virindi?  If so, please give it to me.
If you are having difficulty finding the complex, go along Bandit Road and find the note I left.

Thank you. I see you succeeded. You were clever in navigating the dungeon and sufficiently brave to face its denizens. I deem you worthy of receiving the Sword of Frozen Fury.  You may go now and take it from the dais.

If you should desire a weapon that is easier to carry, you may take the sword to Omaro Nagate at the Glenden Wood West Outpost. Omaro Nagate is a skilled weaponsmith and may alter the sword to be a dagger. I wish you safe travels and swiftness of blade when they are otherwise.

Hello. I am Mage Syltyn Rillon, a member of the Explorer Society. Perhaps you are wondering about the sword on the dais in town. I had been a friend of Martine's back on Ispar.  I encountered Martine here, during one of his mad rampages. He knew not who I was, nor did he seem to care and the encounter ended badly for me. Upon arriving at the Lifestone I was angry, yet understood that the Virind...

To obtain this weapon you must first prove your worthiness. There is a Virindi complex north of Bandit Road. I left a note on a tree along Bandit Road, east of Neydisa Castle, marking the location where you should turn north. Go to the complex, navigate through it and bring to me a Virindi Signet. I shall then allow you to take the sword.
Oh, take this.  It will aid you in your journey through part of the complex. Read it carefully.

greetings: I am sorry, thank you for your efforts. Take these, they will better serve you now, I have no need of them. They will only serve as painful memories of happy times that are now gone.
You should also be rewarded for your efforts.
Jaleh's necklace.
It was a gift from his mother. He always wore it, he'd never taken it off around me. Even when he slept. It was the only thing that he had to remind himself of home. Here.
I have no need of it anymore. But you might find the same comfort that he did within its embrace.
I am grateful for your efforts.

His chain shirt crafted by the hands of the finest Aluvian metal smith on Dereth. This is all the proof I need to know that my husband is no longer among the living. For him to part ways with this finery ensures that his life is over.
How I wish that you had not found this item. But you have.
Take this as payment for services well done and please, I beg you leave me to grieve for my lost husband.
This was his favorite shirt. He had it made by To-ping Ra. Though To-ping Ra allowed an apprentice to create it.
Jaleh was more than impressed, he was astounded but true to form he berated the apprentice and had the cost of the shirt lowered.I felt bad for the apprentice but there was little that I could do.
Do me one final favor, please.Take this note to the apprentice so that they might know the truth.
I am very thankful for what you have done.
If only you had known his kindness. Though he was gruff at times and often selfish there was a part of him that was truly and deeply generous and kind.
I knew that part of his life and now that has been taken. Where is the law in this land that will punish his murderer?
Would that there was someone that could bring this criminal to justice. Alas, I must be thankful that you have found this ring, the symbol of our love.

You have done more then ever I would have expected any to achieve. Thank you for setting my mind at ease. It is horrible what has happened but never knowing what had happened to Jaleh, my love, would have been far worse.
I know that this is not much of a reward for what you have done but it is all I can manage.
Though he preferred the open air that a Qafiya afforded him he would often use his turban as a belt or sash. I thank you for returning this to me.
Soft as the desert sand. Much like his touch. I shall miss it deeply. Why must such things happen?
Were they not supposed to have disappeared with the creation of the Lifestones. But now so many are learning ways to circumvent Asheron's potent magic.
Here it is meager I know but it is all I can muster.
What defender allows this to happen to their people?
I want Jaleh back.
Aaminah breaks down in a fit of tears.
I had no idea he had gotten me such a beautiful bracelet. I've never seen it before now.
Thank you so much for bringing me this, I will miss that wonderful man.

Now that I know what happened to my husband there is much that must be done. I want to thank all those that helped find him. I will not go to his final resting place, along the road from the Obsidian Span toward Glendon Wood, for there is nothing there for me.
If you find his things within that place I will still reward you for finding them.
Try giving that to the Tumerok my friend.
Try giving that to the Lugian my friend.
I'm sorry, I'm not in charge of collecting that type of material. Try seeing if the other collectors, Kreavon or Aun Teverea, need any of that.
You have proven yourself to be a skilled Timberman, sure enough.
quest: Hail friend, my name is Caelis.  The Aluvian, Sho, and Gharun'dim peoples united under Queen Elyssa have joined together to form the Isparian third of the new alliance.

We are assigned to this outpost near Wai Jhou, to collect building materials for the continued upkeep of Candeth Keep. I will accept all types of salvaged metal and wood that you can afford to donate to the cause.  Large or small, poor or priceless, your donations will be treated equally.
Would you care to provide us with more materials? I accept all types of salvaged metal and wood that you can afford to donate to the cause.
Welcome back, your continued help is greatly appreciated! Any salvaged metal or wood you can donate is greatly appreciated.
Thank you friend.  Keep up the good work.  In my journies, I have found that banderlings hoard many types of weapons suitable for salvaging.

You are off to a very good start. Yet, building materials are in short supply, please continue to bring me what you can.  Keeping the town in good condition requires a constant supply of wood planks and metal hardware.
Ah, more materials for the stronghold.  Do you find all of this overland, or are you one of those heroes that takes up residence in some dark dungeon?
You have given me one-half the wood and metal materials that I would ask of you.  The residents of Candeth Keep shall know you by your name and your deeds.
Many good people like yourself are bringing cartloads of raw metals and wood.  Candeth Keep can be well maintained with these materials.  Your efforts will be rewarded.
You have given much to help the alliance.  More materials are still needed, but rest assured you have donated the bulk of the quota set forth by the alliance council.

The storehouses are beginning to fill with the materials you and the others have generously given to the cause.  We now have enough materials to make another delivery to Candeth Keep, but we will surely need more to maintain our stronghold.
Friend, your hard work has paid off.  You have given the most that can be donated by any one member.
You will be welcomed in Candeth Keep as a co-founder.  Your efforts in providing the necessary metals and lumber will prove to be a valuable investment in time.
If you would like to be known as a skilled timberman, return this token to me.
Take this hat, it is a tradition to wear it when practicing your craft.

You have given one-half the resources of which the alliance is seeking from each member.  It is people like you who will be considered the true founders of Candeth Keep. The alliance has allocated a symbolic gift for all of those who show dedication to the project.
You have helped us greatly. You can be sure that your efforts in continuing to provide materials for Candeth Keep will not go unrewarded.
You have given more than enough materials my friend. Perhaps the other collectors still require other materials.

greetings: What a foul creature. I have no interest in this!
What a nasty little thing! Enough with the show and tell, you can have it back now!
That's great! Now get it out of my face!
I'm not a collector of skulls! What kind of collector do you take me for?
Wonderful! Maybe I can make this into a drinking mug for you! Then again, maybe I'll just give it back to you and forget I ever saw it!
I have no need for a broken mask.
You probably want to give this to the Olthoi Hunter in Arwic. Perhaps she'll be able to do something with it.
You can't decorate your own?
Just find a carving or whittling knife and go at it!
Wha... that's HUGE! Where did you find that? Be careful when you carve or whittle that, it must be worth a fortune! Unfortunately, I don't buy produce.
Sorry, I'm not going to wear this around town!
There's no way I'm going to wear this!
I wonder if this would fool a banderling.
Thanks for sharing this with me.
Oh! Scary!
Not a bad looking mask.
Something about this mask creeps me out...
Ah yes, the Golden King. Exquisite! What a fine mask this is.
Hmmm, the Assassins Mask, I bet this is nice to have when the desert is restless.
Oh, the Ogre Mask. Somehow the crafter captured beauty in it's ugly features.
King Pwyll looks even more regal in this version of the mask.
You know, this mask is likely to keep people at a distance. No one likes to stand to close to an Assassin.
The mask of the Ogre Magi! I love this mask, but I keep mine locked up at night so I can sleep.
It's as if I'm looking upon King Pwyll himself! Amazing that Alexander could make this from memory.
The Shagar Zharala could have made this. It's a perfect recreation.
Ah!!! A monster!
Oh, hehe, just a mask of Koji's demon. It looks like it's watching me...
Have you a drudge charm, swamp stone, rat tail, or such? I'll pay you good money or items if you give them to me. They're hard to come by.
Did you know there are other people who collect other items, like gromnie teeth?  You might find them in some towns.  I'll take them, but I won't pay you for them!
Very rarely, you can get a perfect red phyntos wasp wing.  If you can give one to me, I'll pay you for it.  I will also pay you for the tails of rats.
I'm particularly interested in the spine of the sandy armoredillo.  Get that to me and I'll give you a health potion.  I'll also pay the same for swamp stones and the scalps of banderlings.
There are others who will reward differently for the same items I collect.  Not all types of monsters carry trophies, and of those variants that do, it's very rare.
Hold on, I'm getting your money.
Keep those rat tails coming!
Another tan rat tail...
Tan rat tails make great boot laces.
Ah, one russet rat tail...
Here you go.
They say grey rat tails are good for the spleen.
Here's your money.
Brown, not bad. I'll get your money.
Here you are, don't forget I have higher rewards for black and red rat tails.
Oooo, this deserves more than a coin reward!
That's the Top Rat reward. I always need more black and red rat tails.
Red! Very good, you get the Top Rat reward for this!
Thanks, hmmm, I think I'll have sausages tonight.
I've been seeing a lot of these...
Next time, see if you can find a blue wasp wing.
Ah, a blue wasp wing!
Thanks, here's your reward.
You found one! I don't see many of these around here...
Here's your reward.
These are my favorite and they are hard to find.
Jingle jingle, eh?
Such a pretty looking wing!
More wings, more coin.
White like the snow. So beautiful, but so dangerous.
And I'll pay the same for more of these.
Let's see, Sandy Spine...
I buy all of the Armoredillo spines.
quest: I'm overflowing in Scarlet Letters right now. Check back later.
I'm overflowing in Gold Letters right now. Check back later.
Why not bring this back to me when you are a bit more experienced.
I'm afraid the knowledge I would give to you would go right over your head.
You must be at least level 40 to turn in a Scarlet Letter for XP.
You must be at least level 40 to turn in a Lucky Gold Letter for XP.
Hey! I remember my first Red Letter.
This is yours in exchange.
10 Red Letters, nice work.
Here, take these in exchange for the letters.
An Explorer Society Gold Letter. A real collectors item.
This should be a fair reward.
10 Gold Letters, nice work.

greetings: Hello! If you are willing, we have a task for you.

The Arcanum lost some important research when Martine raided our Research Facility near Al-Jalima. Martine seems to be gone now, but his minions remain, preventing us from retrieving the decanters we need.

If you can go there and find the decanters, then you can journey to the Fathomless Chasm, a wellspring of pure mana, and use the decanters to collect the essence there. This essence is required to forge the new pyreal weapons, which we are calling Isparian.
Here -- I have literature that explains all this.
The locations of the Research Facility and the Fathomless Chasm are written on the flyleaves.
What a foul creature. I have no interest in this!
What a nasty little thing! Enough with the show and tell, you can have it back now!
That's great! Now get it out of my face!

An Explorer Society Gold Letter. A real collectors item.

10 Gold Letters, nice work.

greetings: Very good, you may keep your cestus. A lady near Zaikhal named Devana bint Hamudi is looking for skilled hunters.
Give this to her.
I seek the teeth of certain creatures, the gromnies.  But I won't take just anything, I want only the most well preserved gromnie teeth!
Give me the rare tooth of the fierce gromnies, and I will craft it into something useful.  I will also take auroch horns.
I require stout gromnie teeth for my craft!
I am still experimenting with the skulls of certain skeletons.  They don't seem to be good for weapons, but I'll give you a health potion for them.
Nasty for you, if they catch you on one of these, eh?
There you are, a bit of a reward and I've made a nice spear from the horn.
Fire Auroch horns are beyond my skill, but I can trade for them. Here, take this reward.
I've heard about some master bowyer named Yuan Hanzu who makes these into bows.
Hmmm, yes, I'll take this horn. I may just trade this for something I can use. Here's your reward.
I think Yuan Hanzu, the Sho master bowyer, makes great bows from these horns.
Well, this tooth is neither that of a gromnie, nor an auroch. I used to avoid trading for these, but I've learned they have offensive properties.
As you can see, this mace will now do some nasty piercing damage.
Ah, one of the smaller Niffis shells. With a special technique I have devised I can flatten and reform these.
Here, I made this shield yesterday. That's sure to make quite a statement on the battlefield.
Hehe, the shell almost looks like a helmet now. With just a little work...
There you are! A beautiful Niffis Shell Helm.
Oh, what a beautiful niffis orb! You deserve a reward worthy of this find.
Don't hesitate to bring me more of these opalescent marvels.
These teeth are light and will fly well. They just won't do as much damage as some of your higher end spiketails.
These teeth are light and will fly well. They just won't do as much damage as some of your higher end atlatl darts.
You might get more if you put this under your pillow, haha!
Jade tooth eh? These are just the right weight for bolt heads.
Enjoy!
Swamp Gromnie teeth are exceptionally sharp. Ow! See what I mean?
Be careful with those.
This reminds me, A lady near Zaikhal is looking for hunters.
Here is your reward. If you wish to know more, hand the dagger back to me as a sign of trust.
It has taken me a few years, but I have finally figured out a use for Sable Gromnie teeth.
It has taken me a few years, but I have finally figured out a use for Ebon Gromnie teeth.
The Brass Gromnie only recently appeared on Marae Lassel. Had I not been inspired to craft, I wouldn't have even thought of making this out of Brass Gromnie teeth!
The Copper Gromnie only recently appear on Marae Lassel. Had I not been inspired to craft, I wouldn't have even thought of making this out of Copper Gromnie teeth!
I hope you don't think me macabre for collecting these.
I will give a greater reward for more unique skeleton skulls.
This skull is very unique, it will be extremely useful to me.
Thank you for bringing me this treasure.
Yes, I have found a use for these. I'll have to cleanse the skull first of course. Yech!!
I know of a sage somewhere in the southern mountain range that also collects these.
Tibia from a grievver if I am not mistaken. Interesting bone structure.
Thank you, bring me more of these and you will receive the same reward.
A Tusker Slave tusk. You can't use these on the Island of the Tuskers. It's a good thing you came to me.
These tusks are exceptionally useful since they are hollow.
Well Done! I expect the Lich didn't give this willingly.
Please convince more Liches to part with their bones.
A thighbone... hmmm, not a Dark Revenant, but I can still use it.
Bring me a Dark Revenant thighbone I will reward you fivefold.
Aha! A Dark Revenant thighbone, quite exceptional!
A fine reward for your formidable deed.
Hard to imagine that they used this as body ornamentation. Thankfully, we can use these as an augmentation of sorts.
This is a nice find. I have a friend that would like this. Thank you, and here is your reward.
With a little carving, and a little work with the top of the bone here... There we go, a rather dastardly looking dirk, don't you think?
Oh I agree... It isn't really enough, so take this too.
Hmm, if we stretch this a little here and disjoint the jaw. We can twist this little bit and then, excellent! Wear this with pride.
Since the helmet doesn't really offer much protection, I think a little monetary reward is in order as well.

Well. This is a little fleshy. Of course we can pull this, oh blech, what was that? Well whatever it was, this poor sod won't need it. Oh and the smell, well, let's just add a little touch of sunflower oil. Much better.
Here you go.
A grim looking shell. The Niffis are never this dark. Well I'll see what I can craft from it.
Odd, there seems to be magic within the shell that was left within when I finished the shield. You might be able to affix a symbol if you center on this shield.
A mite! This large? You're pulling my leg...
quest: What a lovely piece of work! Look at the inlay here! Thank you for bringing this to me.
I wish to study this in depth. Perhaps I can learn this level of work ...
I have already given you one of the nice stuffed Monouga's. But I can still reward you with a little something. There's a little extra money in there for you.
Thank you, but I have plenty to study for at least a month. Perhaps if you return later I will have time to examine this.

This is an excellent find. My friend is working on a collection and has given me an exclusive special offer. You qualify for the special collector's edition Tremendous Monouga Pack Doll. Supplies are limited, so only one per person, per month.

greetings: Some papers? While an interesting read I am sure, how am I to know if this is genuine and not some fiction you yourself devised? Very well, I suppose you deserve some reward even if these papers are fabricated.
You have a lot of nerve to deliver this garbage to me. But I am a man of my word. Here. This is for you, even though you don't deserve it.

Fiction! Pure fiction! I could have written a more compelling tragedy. I do have to admit, even though this is surely a fake, you did put a fair amount of effort into it. If anything you entertained me with this garbage. Here, take this.
I know... I know... you at least tried to help me out. You really shouldn't be getting anything from me, but since I'm such a nice guy I'll make an exception for you.
Cultists... Summoning and worshipping shadows... how ludicrous!

So many people have brought me pieces of parchment with melodrama scrawled upon it. One person even brought me a strange stick, whatever that is for, but this... finally! Solid evidence of wrong doing on the plateau!

Wait... what was I getting so excited over? This is just some amulet caked in carenzi refuse. Hardly proof of anything.  You know what? I am so tired of people bringing me dead ends and fallacies! Here! Just take this!
Aurten hastily pulls a writ from his backpack and throws it at you.
Just because you haven't been helpful doesn't mean I won't reward you for the effort. Maybe next time you'll bring me something worthwhile!

Ah hello! Perhaps you could help me. I am new to this island and am not particularly familiar with the landscape. Could I convince you to help me? I need information on the strange incidents occuring on the plateau.
Aurten kneels down and opens a nearby pack. He tilts the pack so that you can see what is inside and then quickly pulls back the pack from your sight and closes it.
What are you waiting for? I promised my superiors I would have a report for them!
We're under Attack!

You think, "She looked me over like a jeweler appraising a fine gem, sunstone maybe, or white sapphire. Whatever the look meant, it made me feel appreciated. I was pleased that I had figured out what the Dame wanted. I could see by the expression on her face I'd done well."
This is interesting. This man will certainly have information that we can use. Pretty swell work...
You think, " I felt proud, like an adventurer who killed his first drudge. I showed my pride by standing like a conquering hero."
You think, "She handed me two gifts..."

You think, "...a hat and a token. She said she'd take the token and give me a new title. Something like, gumshoe. I didn't ken what the Dame was saying, but the words felt pretty good. Praise is best served warm and meaningful."
It's broken...

You think, "No getting that past this Dame. She spotted the missing line and reel before I handed the broken pole over. I made some quick comment to her about finding it in the bandit hideout. Maybe it'd turn up a clue here or there. It was a lie. It felt like a lie, thinking quick I scratched my head..."
You think, "That threw her off, I don't believe it...it threw her off. Wait, why am I thinking this? Ooo, did she just say something funny..."
You think, "...drat, a second too late and now I look foolish, Hmmm...what to do?"
You think, "The Dame paused and then turned away a moment...I stopped acting like a jerk..."
You think, "Apparently she knew my ruse...still this was better than a useless fishing rod. She bowed..."

You think, "I bowed in response then headed out to join the festival celebrations. I wish that there was something I could do with this mask, this note and this scroll case. Something gnawed at my conscience, like a reedshark gnawing a shin bone, I didn't think that I'd found all there was to know. For now, I was content to enjoy the holiday cheer."
You think, "She started motioning..."
You think, "Next thing I knew she was calling me a Gumshoe."
Interesting, looks like they like to dress up... You too?

You think, "I didn't know if it was a question. It sounded more like a statement. I stood there, bewildered, like a mage waiting for his spell to kill a drudge, only to see the mana disappear into nowhere. She turned away from me as I shrugged."
quest: You think,  "As I approached, I noticed a hint of recognition on the Dame's face. I was here not that long ago, I'd have to wait a little longer. For now, I couldn't go on."
We need to know if there are any clues. Please...
You think, "There it was again. That slow grating tone. We need your help. Can't you help us? Of course I could. The question was - would I?"
The last spot we had heard about him was in a copse of trees, north of Nanto.
You must have seen the sign. Please sit down.
I'm so glad you came...

You think, "They were always glad. It meant that they no longer had to shoulder the weight of what they knew alone. Camaraderie came from such knowledge. She kept talking and I was having trouble listening."

You think, "My mind kept drifting away to other thoughts. She talked fast, like the buzzing of bees around the first flower in spring. I was doing my best to keep up with the conversation but...there was too much. After a moment or two, I didn't care anymore. I got comfortable..."

You think, "The Dame kept going, talking about some man. Maybe in green armor, with a green dagger or something like that; I didn't care anymore. Her voice was grating on my nerves, like cheese drawn over a cheese grater. I shifted and got really comfortable."
You think, "The Dame was worried. I felt like I should stand up, clear my throat, tell her everything would be fine. But that would mean she'd sob."
You think, "Too late. The buzzing sound of her voice gave way to delirious talk about assassination. I pretended to listen and leaned forward..."

You think, "Then it ceased. It was like opening a Singularity Chest to find three perfectly matched dual major armor pieces, each enhancing a skill I possessed. But like every dream, it ended. Reality smacked me in the jaw, like a Peerless Drudge catching me with my faceplate up. The droning pitch of her voice returned. I got comfortable and listened to the rest of the Dame's tale."
...and that's why I need you to help me.
You think, "I stood quickly. Better she thought I had heard everything that she had to say, rather than tell her the truth. I crossed my arms and gave her a stern look."
You think, "Before I could think, I said 'I'll do it.'"
You say, "I'll do it."
You think, "She gave me a clean towel..."
You think, "...a trade note for my trouble..."
You think, "...and a location..."
The last spot we knew he could be found was off the road in a copse of trees, north of Nanto.
You think, "I didn't have to ask what to expect there. Like I said before, Dames were always trouble. I was knee deep with this one."
Thank you, again.

You think, "The kiss was a nice touch. Though it left me with a sinking feeling. Like getting caught off your guard when the Hopeslayer asks you a question. Never peeve the 24 foot tall Lord of Darkness, you might find yourself falling from the top of the world and believe me, you can't see your house from there."
You think, "I weighed my choices and decided what I needed to do. The entrance to the place would be hidden amongst the trees, but I'd find a way in."
This looks like it could be something. I'll have it looked over. You've done well. You deserve a reward-

You think, "She was talking again, but her voice wasn't as annoying as before. There was a pleasurable quality to it now. I'd done good. The Dame was pleased and I knew that I'd be handsomely rewarded. Well earned in my book. She said something funny and we both laughed."
You think, "Then she handed me a gift..."
You think, "Not bad. I bowed..."

You think, "...and headed off to join the festival celebrations. I wish that there was something I could do with this broken fishing pole, the mask and this note. Something gnawed at my conscience, like a reedshark gnawing a shin bone, I didn't think that I'd found all there was to know. For now, I was content to enjoy the holiday cheer."

Something gnawed at my conscience, like a reedshark gnawing a shin bone, I didn't think that I'd found all there was to know. For now, I was content to enjoy the holiday cheer."

You think, "She'd hear nothing of it..."
You think, "She dropped the trinkent into my hands. A reward for a job well done."

You think, "Again, she blew me a kiss. This Dame was strange, it was just a note. Sure it might be a lead to solving a question about who tried to kill the High Queen, but then again it might lead to an interesting new recipe for chicken. I smiled either way, bowed..."

greetings: No! You keep that! I made it for you.
Yes! This is the stuff! I have more than enough to keep my calm for months to come, but I can make some tea for you out of this!
Samuel produces a mortar and pestle and quickly crushes the charred bits of marrow and then stirs the powder into a mug of heated rum.
There you go! One sip of this stuff and you'll forget about all those things that trouble your dreams!
My God! It couldn't be, where did you find it?
This brings me back, back to a better time when I was a young naive warrior who thought he could take on the world.
Thank you for bringing this back to me, it is rare to find something to smile about these days.
If only...if only I had resigned before this. But now, those things, that place...the things I saw. They'll stay with me forever.
I'll drown them out! I swear I will.
I'm not a coward. You hear me!?
The horror...the horror...
The island - the Virindi came there. They took it over, drove the shadows away, for the most part. They reconstructed the island in their image.
Or so they thought.
Samuel manages a meek smile.
Sit?
You see. The Virindi thought that they could take the island over and cleanse it. They thought that they were more powerful than whatever force controls that place.  But they weren't, you see?
They've been there quite a while now, or they were. They're not there anymore, not the normal Virindi. The twisted ones...they're still there.
Samuel's voice becomes low and takes on a surreal quality.
...and so are his spawn. The spawn of the -
No, no. I don't serve as a Royal Guard anymore. If the High Queen wants the uniform back she can come pry it off of my cold corpse. I'm owed! I saw those things. Those horrific creatures.

It has been so many months since that nightmare of an island changed. So many months, but the horrors are still fresh in my mind. I see the shadow in everything now. More than once has a hen stirred me to fright.
Fortunately, I have found something to help me cope with my fears. Oddly enough, this remedy came directly from the Singularity Caul itself.

Before I left that place, I came across some odd things, maybe mineral deposits, maybe the bones of some long dead creature, I do not know. All I know is steeping the stuff in hot water and cutting with rum has done wonders for my nerves.
If you find anything like that on the Caul, you know - charred bones of some sort - bring them to me and I'll brew you up some of this wonder drink as well!
A few years back - you see? A few years back, this island was found. Apparently, Monarchs had gone there before Bael'zharon walked the world, as a test. Something like that-

This island...it was the home of nothing, but that was not the truth. Beneath the land, shadows lived, multiplied and schemed to take the world for their own. With their master destroyed, driven away and imprisoned by our forces and Asheron -
But he's gone now - you see? He's gone and she drove him off...and now - these things.
Samuel seems to slur his words.
I was once Sam the brave, Sam the Cruel...now look at me. I'm Sam the can't even keep his gruel down.
Jonas struggles with the lock intensely for a moment, then manages to release the mechanism.  You wonder if he is more intelligent than he appears.
No chain! Jonas free!
You have shiny for Jonas?
A shiny!  A shiny gift for Jonas!
Jonas have gift for you!
quest: You have shiny?
Give shiny to me! To me!
More shiny! More shiny!
Can...you...help?
Please...help...me...
Can't use these -- you take!
