Broken and dull -- for you!
Too shiny!
Bright!  Not shiny!
Tusker friend...you!
Best shiny friend!
Green not shiny!
Good shiny friend!
I trade for shiny!
Shiny friend!
You eat hungry!

greetings: Interesting. This is the preliminary report on what the renegades have been able to learn about the Burun thus far. I'd be interested in and reward you for any further missives.
Interesting. I have seen this before. Others have brought them in to Aun laokhe and other Royal Guards. You can keep them. We're well aware of what is at work there.
A letter explaining something secret, eh? Perhaps this will provide you with better clues as to where true information can be found. You should keep it.
Another letter with information of a secret location. Haven't you found anything worth while yet?
This will provide us with more information than we currently have. You are to be thanked for your efforts.
quest: The guard listens intently as you explain what happened when you brought up the night of the attempted assassination.  "Interesting discovery, %s. It seems as though Antius' suspicions could be well founded. We shall do our best to track Nuhmudira and ensure that she cannot harm Elysa ever again." For your efforts, Antius wants you well payed.
I have been authorized to teach you the fourteen salvaging enhancements that have been crafted for learning the enhancement spells to the skill that Ciandra has created for all Isparians.
Thank you for your efforts, I will see that Antius is informed.

Hail, friend. My name is Ydnew. I have been sent by High Queen Elysa to discuss the frequency with which the Burun have been appearing. Further, I am here to see that we keep close attention on the movements of the Burun and their new allies, the Renegades.

The events of the past few months has brought a great deal of consternation into the High Queen's court. Since Rage Lao mistakenly opened the first portals from the world that these creatures came from, we have wondered what they were. We still know very little, but we are confident that we will learn more about them soon.
In the past few weeks, we have seen a rise in Renegade and Burun activity near the old swamp temple near 25s and 46e.

I have been given leave to reward adventurers who assist us in finding out as much information as they can about the new relationship that the Renegades have forged with these Burun. Please use caution when approaching the temple. We know that they have enclosed the structure and are busy working toward some other nefarious end as we speak.
If you begin to become overwhelmed, please retreat. We have no cause for people to needlessly endanger themselves against this threat.

greetings: I see you have already learned all that I can teach you. Please leave me be.

Use this gem and you will fall prey to the most critical of strikes far less often than your peers. But mind you, read the gem's inscription before you use it. There is a cost associated with powers such as these.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
I will train you to withstand the most powerful and critical of attacks. Bring me a blank augmentation gem.
Piersanti lowers his voice and looks around warily.
You may need to speak to the Fiun who calls itself Rehlyun. You can find it at the Fiun Outpost.
You might want to give this to Nawamara Ujio, Piersanti Linante, or some other Augmentation Trainer. I can't do anything with this.
If you use this, you will learn more from the challenges that you overcome.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it. This sort of power is not given cheaply.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
Bring me a blank augmentation gem and I will teach you to learn more from the challenges that you face. Visit Fiun Rehlyun if you don't already have blank gem.
Ye be giving me that which I already be giving to ye, ye filthy rascally filthy filth! Be gone with ye!
And ye be saying to me that ye be wanting to learn to increase yer chances of imbuing those things what ye try to imbue? Well, here ye go, ye dastardly dastard. Learn what ye will!
But make sure you read the gem's inscription first. I don't want to hear you complain if you use this gem without being fully aware of the repercussions.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
Arr!
I shall be telling ye of the ability ye may learn in order what to gain more of the luck when doing the imbues of the things that which you be imbuing.
But first, ye shall be journeying to the far-off isles of Halaetan and be bringing me a blank augmentation gem from the creature of the Fiun what goes by the name of Rehlyun.
Use this gem to increase the duration of the spells you cast. Remember to read the gem's inscription before you use it.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
Bring me a blank augmentation gem and I will teach you to increase the duration of your spells.
Visit Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you have not already acquired a blank augmentation gem.
All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will learn the Iron Monouga Stance.
Allow me to be blunt. The dangers found in Dereth are very real.

I am the keeper of the Iron Monouga Stance. With it I can increase my resistance to bludgeoning attacks. If you wish I can teach it to you, but I will need an augmentation gem. Visit Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you have not already acquired one of these gems.
All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will greatly increase your ability to tinker items.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
I can show you some tricks I learned as a warrior on how to get the most out of your items by using Item Tinkering on them, but you'll have to give me a blank augmentation gem first.
Find Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you need a blank augmentation gem.
I see you have already learned all that I can teach you. You will have to visit a different trainer if you wish to learn something else.

Use this gem to increase the number of packs that you can carry. But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it. I can't be held responsible for any long-lasting decisions you may mistakenly make.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
I can teach you to organize your packs more efficiently so that you can carry a bit more than you would normally be able to. But you will have to hand me a blank augmentation gem first.
Visit Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you do not already have an augmentation gem.
I do not know what you expect me to do with this.
When you use this gem, you will learn to better hold onto your possessions when you fall in battle. However, make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.

It is true that Asheron has given us the ability to cheat death with these lifestones. But when one has died as much as I have, one begins to wonder, 'Why can I not resurrect with ALL of my possessions? Why must I lose my favorite sword EVERY time that I die?'

I can teach you to lose fewer of your possessions when you fall in battle, but you will have to give me a blank augmentation gem in exchange. Speak with Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you have not done so already.
Didn't I give this to you? If you want to exchange it for something else, I'm afraid there's nothing I can do for you.
Use this gem to increase your salvaging ability. But make sure you read the gem's inscription first. There is a significant cost associated with this sort of learning.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription first. I don't want to hear you complain if you use this gem without being fully aware of the repercussions.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
I will teach you the secrets of salvaging, so that you can acquire salvage materials much more efficiently. But you'll have to give me a blank augmentation gem first.
If you haven't already acquired one of these gems, you should seek out Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Isles. Until you speak with it, there is nothing I can do for you.
All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will greatly increase your rate of healing. When lying down, that is.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
Hello there, stranger.
Did you realize that you can increase the speed at which you heal by simply lying down?
Furthermore, did you realize that I can teach you to increase that speed? When lying down?
All I need from you is a small, blank augmentation gem. Bring one to me and I will share my secrets with you. I promise, you will be glad that you did.
This gem will improve your ability to carry great weights. Read the inscription on the gem. You shall see.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
I will teach you to withstand the vigors of an overburdened pack. Hand me a blank augmentation gem and I will give you a gem that shall increase your carrying capacity.
You might want to give this to Nawamara Ujio, Piersanti Linante, or some other Augmentation Trainer. I can't do anything with this.
Once you use this gem, beneficial spells will no longer dissipate when you die. You will be able to fight, die, and return directly to the fight without having to pay a visit to the marketplace.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription first. I don't want to hear you complain if you use this gem without being fully aware of the repercussions.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.

One of my greatest irritations in life is that I lose all beneficial spells cast on me when I die. At least, that used to be one of my greatest irritations. I have since discovered a way past that problem.
Bring me a blank augmentation gem and I will teach you my secret.
Why would you show me this man's sketch?
No matter, I've never seen this shabby man before.
No, I cannot say I know what this token means. I would think a hero wouldn't give an important token like this away...
Where did you find this?
If you are responsible for taking this token from a hero I wouldn't dare show it to anyone else. There might be... repercussions.
Sir Binwas Loc. I told Eleonora she could not trust the loyalists. If only she had listened to me.
May your kindness to the people of Silyun be known to all you meet.
For your deeds and service to Silyun I shall bestow the title Hero of Silyun upon you. Kneel before me.
Let it be known that %s has won the approval and support of the people and shall henceforth be called, Hero of Silyun!
quest: The citizens of Silyun have suffered much under Varicci's rule. Now you force us to relive one of our greatest tragedies. Be gone from my sight, villain.
The Grand Mother folds her arms across her chest and cocks an eyebrow at you.
You seek to play two sides, like some duplicitous Souia-Vey?
Be gone from here. I have no patience for those of your ilk.
Beautiful. It is regrettable what had to be done to brave Sir Belfelor, but we are glad the Ring of Karlun is ours. You have our gratitude.
This is from the beast that killed my grandson?
The fire in Grand Mother's eyes slowly fades replaced by tears of sorrow.
For so long I have waited for this moment.
All the old pain and memories flood back into my soul when I look upon this jaw.
Bless you soldier of light. You will forever have my gratitude.
If you would help further in the fight against the tyrant Varicci, I ask you to journey to the town of Ayan Baqur and seek out a man named Mekhmet. He will trust you if I vouch for you.
You dare mock my pain? You fiendish dog! Leave my sight!
I see you have gained access to the isle of Vissidal. There is nothing more I might ask of you. Maintain a presence there. Remain alert. When more is required of you, you will know.
The citizens of Silyun have suffered much under Varicci's rule. You and your kind disgust me. Be gone from my sight.
You are a most kind and generous soul. I knew that we could count on you. You are welcome to stay in Silyun as long as you like.
The King of Sanamar greatly desires this tome. He would reward you generously for it. And yet you bring it to us?
The Grand Knight would have you executed for this. I believe we have found a useful ally in you.
This note... Eleonora's last words.
This will mean much to the Duke. I thank you, friend.
You are a servant of that murderer, Varicci. I wish nothing to do with you, and I do not believe this is the true Ring of Karlun.
You have earned my trust, brave adventurer. I would ask you, in the spirit of our alliance with Queen Elysa, to venture to Ayan Baqur and seek out a man named Mekhmet.
You, who have done so much for the people of Silyun, I now request a boon from you.
Not for the people. Not for the cause. But for ME!
I seek...no demand vengeance. It is my right and I have been denied it for far too long.
For you see, not long after we arrived on this wretched land, my favorite grandson was taken from me.
One of those vile creatures we now call Eaters attacked our camp and brutally killed and ate him as we we all watched in stunned horror.
The short of the tale is that thing escaped and all attempts to kill it have met with failure.
You shall be my blade. My truth. My justice. My revenge!
Seek this creature out and kill it.
Bring me the jaws of this Eater so that they can cause no more sorrow to others.

I wonder if you might help us, since you have helped us once before. There is a group of knights who has broken away from the murderous Viamontian loyalists. They call themselves the Knights of Karlun.
Unfortunately for them, they possess something that would be useful to us: a ring that once belonged to Karlun, the Great Father of Viamont.

I would have you take this ring from their leader, a knight named Sir Belfelor. Kill him if you must. But to even see this Belfelor, you must infiltrate the Knights of Karlun and gain their trust. They have a fortress located at 89.0N, 67.6W.
You are a stranger to Silyun and owe us nothing. Even so, I beseech you listen to my words and help me heal an old man's grieving heart.

The Duke's daughter, Eleonora, was a proud and noble warrior. She led our people to many great victories in the war against Varicci. But her skill was not enough to hide her from the King's vengeance forever.
Before the Fiun barrier was dropped - before we even knew of the existence of lifestones - Eleonora fell in battle against Varicci himself.
He took her to his torture chamber and murdered the poor girl. When he delivered her body to us, we were horrified to learn that he had removed her heart.
The Duke has not been the same since that day. His grief knows no end. But if we could retrieve that young warrior's heart, I am certain that his grief would begin to subside.
Journey to the Royal Hall of Sanamar, enter the torture chamber, and put an end to this tragedy.
But I warn you - if you do this, you will fall out of favor with the Grand Knight of Sanamar. He may well treat you with the same enmity with which he and his King have long treated us.

greetings: Yes, I have had dealings with this man. You say he stole a corpse?
Well, what people do in their spare time is none of my concern.
A hero? A hero wouldn't let a symbol of honor become so damaged. It almost looks like it was worn down on purpose... Who did you say you took this from?
Hmmm, this bears further investigation. Thank you.
The Grand Knight looks carefully at the note. A look of rage slowly creeps across his face.
You dare to steal from the King?
The Grand Knight places a hand on the hilt of his sword.
Be gone, filth. Be gone now.
May your loyalty to the glory of Sanamar be apparent to all you meet.
Your dedication to our King is commendable, and greatly to be praised. I will make it known that you have served us well.
So, you are the Lieutenant Commander's messenger, are you? You have certainly done her a great service. The King will welcome this information.
Now, if you would truly be of service, get back out there and fight. A land at war is a glorious land indeed!
quest: The King may be willing to deal with you rebels, but until I hear from His Majesty directly, I'll have nothing to do with your kind.
The Grand Knight looks carefully at the note. A look of rage slowly creeps across his face.
You dare to steal from the King?
The Grand Knight places a hand on the hilt of his sword.
Be gone, filth. Be gone now.
Excellent work. One might grieve for the man Sir Belfelor was, but he was a fool and deserves his fate.
Ah, this... heart is the key to the bull's health? Very well. This gives me much to think on. I thank you for your service. You are not the first to bloody your hands in the King's service.
If you seek to serve the King further, speak with Garmasi.
I see you have gained access to the isle they call Vissidal. The King has need of capable warriors on that island. Bide your time. Hunt and kill. When more is required of you, you will know.
You have done well. Feel free to stay in Sanamar as long as you like.
You have done well. The Duke's rebels are little more than a nuisance to His Majesty, but we welcome your intelligence.
I know they would call it betrayal. But we call it loyalty to the true throne of Dereth.
Ah, Sir Binwas. A finer warrior have I seldom met. He deserves not the humiliation he suffered at the hands of that wench.
Grand Knight grimaces with hatred.
Eleonora deserved everything we did to her.
You cannot fool me. You are working for the rebels. You stink of their dirty little town. This ring is obviously fake!
I have no need of this...
You have proven yourself to me. Should you seek to further serve your King, speak with Garmasi. He will know of your loyalty.
Well, it seems you may be worthy of royal service after all. Looking for more work, are you? There is one sensitive mission which you could undertake for us...

The Red Bull of Sanamar, which you see at the center of town, has been sick for some time. We don't know how to cure it! The only man who might is the bull's old caretaker, a man named Lascare. Well, he left town some time ago. All we know is that he lives off by himself on a lonely hilltop on the island to the northeast. Seek him out, please, and figure out a way to cure the bull!

You have served us before, I see. There is another task for you, if you are strong enough for it. The King desires a bauble in the possession of a rogue group of Knights who have left our service. These so-called Knights of Karlun disdain the... physical gifts brought about by the transformation of our own Knights. But they distrust the rebels, too!

The leader of the Knights of Karlun possesses a ring that once belonged to the great Karlun, founder of the nation of Viamont. Do whatever you must to gain their trust and take the ring from their Grand Master, a fallen knight named Sir Belfelor. You will probably have to kill Belfelor. Seek them out at 89.0N, 67.6W
You're new to Sanamar, are you not? If you desire to prove your loyalty to the King, I have a task you may find interesting.

The King has been informed of an ancient tome which lies in a ruined underground city. He dispatched a company of knights to the ruins, but they were repelled by the beasts within. The craven dogs spread tales of ghosts and undead before I had them executed for cowardice.

I need someone to enter the ruins and retrieve this tome. If you do this for me, I may have more tasks for you in the future. Of course, if you fail or otherwise betray me, then I'll have nothing to do with you ever again.
You can find the ruins near the outpost of Westwatch at 74.2N 74.2W. I expect to hear from you soon.

But know this - the Grand Mother of Silyun also seeks this tome. Complete this task for me and she will have nothing more to do with you. Though, why you would want to socialize with those damnable rebels is beyond me.

You have done the kingdom of Viamont a great service. Come back to me later. I may have more for you to do. In the meantime, you may wish to pay a visit to Anton Silezzi. I understand he has need of assistance in some matter. You may also wish to speak to the Barkeeper Jean Vaden. He sells rumors you may find of interest.
The kingdom of Viamont requires your assistance.

The Beacon at the top of the Beacon Tower requires regular maintenance. I have been unable to reach this beacon due to Wasps and other creatures taking up residence on the tower platforms. Place this gem within the beacon and you shall have the satisfaction of knowing that you have done your King a great service.
When an agent of Viamont gives you a task, you had best tend to that task immediately. Go to the tower.
Please free up 4 main pack slots for your rewards.
The kingdom of Viamont requires your assistance. Though the task I have for you may not be equal to your abilities, it is an important task and requires immediate resolution.

greetings: Get that thing away from me! Get it away!
If I had spent more time with the sword than with my books, perhaps I could have handled those wild beasts.
My necklace! If my mother were here, she'd strangle me!
That's the last time I tangle with a colony of rabid penguins, I tell you.
You found it! You found my missing necklace! Thank you so much, my friend.
Please accept this as a token of my deepest appreciation!
You should visit Elena du Furza next. She may have an interesting task for one of your abilities.
And, umm, if you wouldn't mind, do you think you could just keep this whole penguin business to ourselves?
quest: You should visit Elena du Furza next. She may have an interesting task for one of your abilities.
And, umm, if you wouldn't mind, do you think you could just keep this whole penguin business to ourselves?
Would you please help me? I have lost my most precious heirloom. And I am afraid that I have not the combat prowess required to obtain it.
A group of wild beasts waylaid me as I wandered outside the city walls. If I had not run quickly to the town gates, I surely would have met my end.
If you would, please explore the lair near 71.7N 60.4W. If you find my necklace, please return it to me. I will reward you as handsomely as I am able.
I realize that such a quest is beneath your abilities, but if you would help me, I would be most grateful.

greetings: I guess you don't need directions then.
Don't be getting lost because I'm not going to look for you.
It'll be cheaper to hire another person than to pay to have your bones found.
Anton takes the letter and reads it.
Ah! Good news indeed. Thank you for your help.
It seems I am in your debt.
WHAT! That old fool! I can't prove it, but I'm sure this is somehow your fault.
Now I'll have to think of a way to smooth things over.
quest: Thanks for all your help. Here's something that'll help you carry all your stuff in future travels.
What? Were you expecting more?
I must be getting soft. Here's a little extra for your troubles.
Oh. If you're looking for something to do, you might talk to Seneschal Dalmour.
I hear he's looking for experienced adventurers.
Please return to me at a later time, I may have more work for you.
Please hurry back when you have word from any of the merchants.
Hurry back when you have word from any of the other merchants.
Anton motions for you to come closer.
You seem to be a person that is out to see the world.
Perhaps you could do me a favor?
I want to establish a trade network between Holtburg, Yaraq and Shoushi.
To do that I need a brave and stu..courageous soul such as yourself to make contact with the local merchants of those towns.
Here. I've prepared these letters inviting them to my trade network.
This letter goes to Lubziklan al-Luq of Yaraq.
This one to Gonjoku Den of Shoushi.
And this last one to Renald the Eldest of Holtburg.
Return to me when you have received an answer and I'll reward you handsomely.
Not that I don't trust your memory, but here are directions so you don't get lost.
I have already given you the proposals. If you would like them again please hand me the Trade Contacts paper and then speak to me again.

greetings: Looks like those filthy Banderlings ripped my book apart and scattered it about the land! Why, if I had the inclination to leave my favorite spot, I'd do something about this. You'd better believe I would!
Be sure of it!
I am the sexiest man in the world. Men envy me. Women faint when they see me. Penguins fear me.

Some say that two brews based on two yeasts of varying qualities are indistinguishable from one another. To those people I say, "You have the taste of a Drudge and the brains of a Banderling!" Heathens, I say. Heathens!
If there's one thing I prize more than beer, it's biscuits.
Anyone have a biscuit?
Wonderful! You found it
I see I owe you a reward. Please accept this masterfully crafted Brew Kettle. If you continue down the path of the brewmaster, you'll come to love and cherish this most wondrous item as I have.
As for those arcane secrets, keep this to yourself, my friend.
I see I have yet another brewing apprentice to deal with. Ever since the King shattered the barrier to the mainland, you people have been showing up in droves.
Well, if you really want to learn the intricacies of brewing, you'll have to do me a favor first.
A band of Drudges stole my brewing bible. I need some hardy soul to find it for me. Last I saw them, the dirty thieves were headed in the direction of the Waterfall Cave at 84.0N 75.4W.
Return that brewing bible to me, and I'll fill your head with the arcane secrets of the brewing world!
Wonderful. You are a warrior of incredible ability. The Kingdom of Viamont would do well to enlist your aid in our continuing fight against the Bloodless.
I do now grant you the title of Ravenous Killer.
Very good. Though this jaw comes from the weakest of the King's weapons. If you wish for greater rewards than these, try your hand at a beast of a little more strength.
I do now grant you the title of Engorged Scourge.
Nice work. You have proven yourself a competent warrior. There are, however, many beasts of greater ability that await you in the world beyond.
I do now grant you the title of Voracious Flayer.
Very nice. You are indeed a warrior of much skill. We may well call upon your services in the future.
I do now grant you the title of Abhorrent Warrior.
Excellent! You are a warrior of unparalleled ability! You have done what few of even our bravest knights can accomplish. I am humbled to be in your presence.
I do now grant you the title of Insatiable Slayer.

I am looking for warriors of exceptional ability to test against the kingdom's weapons. There are five Eater dens that I wish you to infiltrate. Return to me with the jaws of the beasts therein and I will reward you appropriately.
quest: You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.

greetings: Chef Martam takes the egg and taps it a couple times.
What have we here?
Perfect shape and size.
This is the one I have been searching for!
Zee Great Penguin Egg!
Now I can make zee cake for Grand Mother of Silyun." Chef Martam tells you, "Wait here. I will make you a smaller cake from the left overs of the egg.
In what seems like moments Chef Martam returns with your cake.
Here is your special Cave Penguin Cake. I make just for you!
I must be off now. Grand Mother of Silyun's cake can no be made so quick.
Thanks again for your help.
What am I to do?
Grand Mother of Silyun...she is so terribly unhappy.
I must make something to cheer her up. But what?
quest: Chef Martam takes the egg and taps it a couple times.
A bit puny for a Cave Penguin Egg...no?
This will not do at all for zee cake.
Perhaps I can make zee drink for you.
Chef Martam cracks the egg open into a glass and mixes in some herbs.
Perfect! I will call this Essence of Cave Penguin.
Drink this. Let me know if you start seeing double.
Now go and bring me another Cave Penguin Egg!
This is it!
No...perhaps not.
YES!
Then again no. This egg is a good egg, but she is not GREAT!
I must have zee perfect Cave Penguin Egg! Keep looking.
Look. Zee egg has a crack on it.
Perhaps a lesser chef can use this.
BUT NOT CHEF MARTAM!
Bring me another Cave Penguin Egg at once!

greetings: I tell ya what. I needs time to think on this.
Instead of standing there like a dang fool.
Why don't ya go an fetch my Da's old mug for me.
I saw some Drudges make off with it along with a bottle of Apple Cider.
I hear tell they gone and holed up in a small cave South of here. Try looking around 36.9N 35.1E.
By the time ya go and bring back me Da's old mug, I'll have a reply ready for ya.
Another shipment of Ursuin toys, eh? She goes through these awful fast. Well, either that, or the little Ursuin do...
Here, bring her this response. I'll ship those toys to her directly.
Well? What do ya want?
Speak up! Olthoi got yer tongue?
If ya ain't got nothing to say then beat it!
quest: Gyah! Me Da's mug. Ya found it!
Um right. Me answer then.
You can go and tell this Ursuin-spawned dog Anton that Renald the Eldest says...
NO!
I'll not be trading with no accursed Viamontian.
Why? Well...cuz they're BLUE!
Renald the Eldest stares at you as if waiting for you to agree.

greetings: Gonjoku Den reads the Trade Proposal from Anton Sillezi.
A most sound idea.
But can this Anton be trusted with such responsibility and power?
I cannot as yet test this Anton.
But since he has seen fit to place his trust in you.
I shall test you in his stead.
Travel East until you reach the banks of the great river.
Then travel south until you find the entrance to a Mossy Cave.
Go there and bring me a sample of the Mossy Herb that grows within.
Gentle is the breeze that passes through these trees.
Please excuse the ramblings of an old fool.
Gonjoku Den turns away to listen to the wind.
quest: Most excellent! You are a courageous and honorable person.
This reflects well on Anton Sillezi.
Return to Anton Sillezi and give him this letter. I accept his trade proposal.
And this is for you. It is a potion made from the moss you retrieved.
May your journey be swift and safe. Farewell.
The book. I need the book.
The urn is next. Bring me the urn.
I told you, the book, the urn and then the corpse. You've brought me the book and the urn. I require the corpse.
I have nothing more to offer you now. Your discussion, while engaging, does little to aid me in my study. If there were more for you here I would make you aware. Please, be gone.

Nuhmudira has decided that even those who would see her harmed are worthy of redemption as you have proven by your actions in the past. She requires that you obtain two objects for her before I can grant you the stone that you desire.
The first is a book found in the library and the second is an urn from the crypt. Collect these are return them to me in the order I have listed and you shall be rewarded.
Lady Nuhmudira has given me leave to reward those who have shown her the greatest amount of compassion should they complete one small task for her.
There is a book that can be found in the library of this structure. Return this to me and you will receive your just reward.
It is good to see that you following instructions well. Now... collect the urn and then return it to me.
You have done well thus far. Now bring the urn and I shall see this off to Nuhmudira and give you your reward.
Yes, I will need this object. But I asked for the book first. I must ensure that all items are properly logged for Nuhmudira. Please take this back and give me the book first.
There is only one service that lay before you now. Collect the corpse of the woman that served in these halls and all will be complete.
While it is impressive that you have the foresight necessary to plan ahead. I still must follow a rigid set of instructions. I need the book, followed by the urn and then the corpse.
Please, hand them to me in that order. I would not want to displease Lady Nuhmudira.
This is impressive. Truly it is. But it is also not what I need at this time. I require the urn before you hand me this corpse. Take this back.
Hand me the urn so I can properly catalogue your progression.
Your efforts will not go unrecognized. I shall see that Lady Nuhmudira receives a full report on your progress. For now, take your precious reward.

You must now find a sample of Burun blood. Soak the stone in the blood and it will take on properties that are the antithesis of the Burun. Apply that stone to the -Noble- weapons and it will become a Burun slaying weapon.
That is all.

As you turn to leave, you remember that you'd been advised you to ask a question of Nuhmudira's Student. You turn on your heels and call back. "Has Nuhmudira ever spoken about the night that Oswald attempted to assassinate Elysa?"
Nuhmudira and Oswald have had a good --
Camryn looks a bit flustered, "I think you should leave now, %s."

On an errand from the High Queen? Nuhmudira has decided that she will assist those who will continue to show her aid. The lady has been pulled away by business elsewhere. I am her student, Camryn. I will fulfill the role that she once filled in this place.
Within the halls beyond are three objects that I require. I am not wont to leave my study of this place and have no students here at present to undertake this endeavor. You shall do.
Within the halls beyond are three objects.  Nuhmudira requires them in order. I will catalogue their arrival and ensure that you are properly credited with finding the objects for her.

The first is a book found in the library, the second is an urn from the crypt and the last is the corpse of the woman who held court in this chapel. Collect these and return them to me in the order I have listed and you shall be rewarded.
Though Nuhmudira is unaware of your exploits she is not without mercy. If you desire the stone that much she will grant you the device, if you undertake a set of small tasks for her.
The first is a book found in the library, the second is an urn from the crypt. Collect these are return them to me in the order I have listed and you shall be rewarded.
You have succeeded both quickly and efficiently. For this you shall receive your reward.
In addition, your previous service to Nuhmudira makes you deserving of a reward. I will now teach you the spells that Nuhmudira has devised to assist you in your salvaging efforts.

As a final reward, Nuhmudira had decided to make this gem available to those who have aided her. It will enhance the -Noble- armor with an ancient power that allows your mind to focus more ably. It is decidedly more effective than those gems which the High Queen's lack-...that is...servants...give as rewards.
All is complete. I will write a report to Nuhmudira and see that she is made aware of all that you have done for her. Here is your reward.
Interesting, how did you come by this? It is a very nice gift. Thank you.
You've returned with another Fledgemaster's Tusk!
Please accept this on behalf of the king.
With your help we shall push the Ruschk off of Viamontian lands.
Please continue your service to the king.
I thank you for your service to the kingdom.
The Ruschk incursions are still on the rise.
Please continue your good work.

Due to the ever increasing encroachment of the Ruschk upon our lands and the unlawful poaching of the king's animals, the king has decreed that a bounty shall be awarded for every Fledgemaster's Tusk.
You! It is your duty to help stave off the Ruschk.
Go forth for king and country!
Ruschk camps have been spotted on the icy beaches north of here.
Return when you have a Fledgemaster's Tusk and you shall be handsomely rewarded.

greetings: What's this? Tanami's Crossbow ... Oh! That clever young man in Ayan Baqur! Nice enough fellow, although perhaps not much of a scholar.
My notes! My notes! What have you done to my notes?
Not only have you betrayed my trust, but you ruined my work! My great manuscript! Ahhh!
Begone! Get out of my sight! And never return! I will remember your infamy until the end of my days!
Did you know that the Phyntos Wasp is strictly matriarchal? Oh ... wait, that may have been Monougas. Or maybe Mites.  ... I can't quite remember.
Now where did I put that book ... ?
Was it 'red sky at night, reedshark's delight'? Or 'black sky at night'? Black makes rather more sense, but ... I know I wrote it down somewhere.
There it is! The key to my storage chest! Thank you so much! Now I can continue my great work!
Here, as I promised, is your reward. Are you sure you wouldn't like to hear some of my manuscript? I could just run and get my notes ... ? No? Well, no worries.
Thank you again. Be sure to drop by again sometime! You may need to remind me of our meeting, however - my memory isn't so good these days, I'm afraid.
quest: It's you! Well, did you find my lost key? Come on, hand it over! Or ... wait ... did you already give it to me? Damn my frail old memory!
What? What?! You were in my chest? And after I asked you specifically not to pry into my things?!
Well! I don't know how you were raised, but in my family we call that thieving! Get out! Get out of my house now! I won't have anything more to do with you!
Well, hello there, stranger! What brings you to this forsaken corner of Osteth? I myself came for some peace and quiet!
Oh, no, I didn't mean it that way! You are welcome here! In fact, I could use your help ...
Ishaq sighs loudly.
I'm having some trouble remembering where I left the key to my storage chest. My memory isn't so good these days, I'm afraid. And all my notes are in that chest!
Until I find the key, I can't continue on my great work, Volume 12 of "The Peculiar Nature and Behavior of Derethian Fauna with Especial Emphasis on Cross-World Speciation".
Ishaq looks at you hopefully.

Tell you what! If you can find the key for me, I'll let you read my manuscript! How about that? ... No? ... Well, I understand - not everyone is a scholar, I suppose. Hmm ... I do have a nice mace I would be happy to give you. I don't have much use for it myself anymore.

Do we have a deal? Good! I believe I left the key in my cellar - you can find it behind my house. But please - don't go prying into my belongings. I am trusting you in my house; I trust that you will repay me with your good behavior.

greetings: Double-click on me to hear what I have to say.
quest: I already gave you an Exit Token. If you want to leave the Training Academy early, give the Exit Token back to me.
But beware, once you leave the Training Academy, you cannot come back!
If you want to skip your training and leave the Academy early, give this token back to me.
Make sure you talk to Ghaziyah to continue your journey.
Make sure you talk to Alcott to continue your journey.
Make sure you talk to Rufina to continue your journey.
Make sure you talk to Eiichi to continue your journey.
Given the time it takes for these creatures to grow in number, return to me in a day, and I'll have another hunting trip for you.
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.
You've done well in exterminating this aggressive breed of Phyntos.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Phyntos Larvae.
Once you've killed 20 Phyntos Larvae, I will reward you. Keep up the good work.
A new breed of Phyntos has appeared on Freebooter Isle.
This breed is extremely vicious and has killed many society members.
The society will appreciate any efforts you make towards their extermination.
You are not powerful enough to assist me, climb the ranks to knight or above and I may have a task for you.

greetings: If you want to talk to other people, you need to learn how to chat. To type a simple sentence, press [ENTER]. Then enter your text and press [ENTER] again.
Take this book. It will explain the chat system in much greater detail.
Happy chatting!
Ah, you found one of our confidential missives! No, don't worry, I'm not angry. You should read it. It will give you some idea of the current political situation here on Dereth.
Drag this item onto your paperdoll to wear it.

Ah, you must have confused me with Jonathan. Give this token to Jonathan and he will let you exit the Training Academy early. But beware! If you leave before you've been fully trained, you may be in for frequent trips to the Life Stone!
quest: You found some armor! To equip your armor, drag it from your backpack onto your paperdoll. You can wear armor over your clothes, but you cannot wear a piece of armor over another piece of armor.
You may now proceed to the Training Area.
Looks like you need some armor! There are 3 different pieces of armor here. Can you find them all? Double-click on me again when you are done.

greetings: This is what you found in the Lugian Ice Tunnels? Most curious. It seems that Oswald has taken an interest in the Ruschk, for some reason. I believe the location to which he refers is the Ruschk Icehold. You can find it at 87.3N, 51.8W. Please go there and continue the investigation.

And this is the evidence of Oswald that you found in the Ruschk Icehold? Interesting, indeed. So Varicci seeks the assassin for his own purposes. If the King's soldiers have captured Oswald, then they would have taken him to the Royal Prison. That grim dungeon is located at 92.0N, 41.6W. Please go there and see if Oswald is, indeed, in captivity.
Ah, a very interesting look into the mind of this most troublesome killer. This gives me much to think about. Consider your service ended. I thank you for your assistance...

Oswald's journal makes note of a skill manual he wrote, in Tracker's Script. That is a secret language known only by the most accomplished hunters and trackers of Ispar. If you find that skill manual, I could translate it for you and train you to be more skillful.
quest: Excuse me? I believe we have already done our business. You have chased Oswald as far as he could be chased, and I have trained you in skill to reward your efforts. Please ask no more of me.

This is the skill manual that Oswald wrote about in his journal. It is written in a most curious cipher. This is in Tracker's Script, which was a coded language used among the most accomplished hunters of Ispar. That is a very interesting clue to Oswald's background. Let me decipher it for you...
The Royal Prison is located at 92.0N, 41.6W. Please go there and see if Oswald is, indeed, in captivity.
You can find the Ruschk Icehold at 87.3N, 51.8W. Please go there and continue the investigation.
I have asked you to journey into the Lugian Ice Tunnels, located at 93.3N, 50.1W , bring back any evidence of Oswald's whereabouts.

So, you are indeed a mighty hunter of beasts. How are you as a hunter of men? I have been tracking the infamous assassin, Oswald, for some time. By last report, he traveled into a series of tunnels belonging to those grey giants, the Lugians. Please journey into the Lugian Ice Tunnels, located at 93.3N, 50.1W , and bring back any evidence of Oswald's whereabouts.

You are new to Silyun, are you? If you are a skilled hunter, you may be of some use for me, in helping me track the most dangerous quarry of all: the assassin, Oswald! Of course, first you must prove your skill. Bring me the jaw of an Abhorrent, Ravenous, or Insatiable Eater, and we will talk of how you may help me.
Please return to me when you are better skilled.

greetings: Fighting alongside one of those foul Eater things would make me feel as debased as a Milantean...
Karlun would not have approved of using fiendish beasts to do our fighting...

Well done. You have my thanks, but you have not proven yourself to the Knights of Karlun just yet. Now I must ask you to take on a more sensitive task. One of our leading warriors, a knight of great virtue named Sir Coretto, journeyed into the Heart of Madness to discover what afflicts the Fiun who have gone mad. It has been some time since we heard from him. Please follow him into the Heart of...

This is... heartbreaking. We all will mourn the great man that Sir Coretto was, and I thank you for putting him out of his misery. You have proven yourself to me. I will give you permission to enter the Hall of Karlun and speak with our Grand Master. You have also been judged worthy to receive a piece of armor of the Knights of Karlun. Wear it with honor.
quest: This is... heartbreaking. We all will mourn the great man that Sir Coretto was, and I thank you for putting him out of his misery. You have proven yourself to me. I will give you permission to enter the Hall of Karlun and speak with our Grand Master. You have also been judged worthy to receive a piece of armor of the Knights of Karlun. Wear it with honor.

Well done. I see you have succeeded in making contact with Sir Coretto. Give me his last testament, and I will grant you permission to enter the Hall of Karlun and speak with our Grand Master, the honorable Sir Belfelor.
Ah, you found my sword. Wonderful. Please give it to me, and I will tell you how else you might aid the Knights of Karlun.

Well done. You have my thanks, but you have not proven yourself to the Knights of Karlun just yet. Now I must ask you to take on a more sensitive task. One of our leading warriors, a knight of great virtue named Sir Coretto, journeyed into the Heart of Madness to discover what afflicts the Fiun who have gone mad. It has been some time since we heard from him. Please follow him into the Heart of...
Ah, have you come to join the Knights of Karlun? I do not trust you enough to send you on to speak with our Grand Master. Perhaps if you could prove yourself trustworthy...

If you would enter our confidence, seek out the vile Eater-thing that swallowed my sword. It can be found at the heart of the Eater Pit, located at 88.8N, 72.6W. Bring me my sword, and we will speak further.

greetings: And so I die by treachery. Go running to your masters, corrupt puppet.

You may have fooled Sir Ginazio, outsider, but I know you are working for someone else, and that you seek the Ring of Karlun. I will not attack you, but you will get nothing from me. You may as well leave.
Thank you...
I would wager my friend Sir Ginazio sent you to find me. Noble of you, but futile. I am no use to anyone. I am... broken. I have discovered things too terrible to bear.
Please, put me out of my misery. Strike me down so I may die like a true Knight. And when I am dead, take my last testament to Ginazio... So he will know. So they all will know.
Enough blood on my hands already...
Oh, mother! I swore I'd never touch one of those nasty things again. You can just take that directly to the Grand Knight himself for all I care.
quest: Oh, so the old Grand Knight sent you here, eh? I figured that brute would need my help eventually. That bull has an ugly secret - so ugly I dare not speak it, ha ha! The answer to your problems lies in the Cannibal Caverns, 88.0N, 58.5W. You can figure the rest out if you read my journal.

greetings: Do with this as you see fit, friend.
quest: Luressi di Maki lowers his voice to a whisper.
I see you and I share a common bond, my friend.
May the Stag of Bellenesse live on.
Luressi di Maki straightens his back and clears his throat.
Ah, a loyal subject of the rightful King of Dereth. The Viamontian Guard thanks you for your assistance.
I know I'm taking a grave risk in talking to you, but I must follow my conscience.
There is a town on the island north of here where the rebels of Bellenesse make their home. They call this place Silyun. You can find it at 87.1N 70.6W
Go there. Speak to the Grand Mother. I think she will convince you, as she did me, that the rebels of Silyun should be aided in their rightful struggle against the King.
If you would like, I could sell you a portal gem to Silyun. One V note is all I ask. As a gesture of goodwill.

greetings: Yes, I have seen this man. He shops in town quite often. I believe his name is Andrilos. He lives somewhere in the Northern woods of Lotila Island.
quest: It is wonderful to see new Viamontian arrivals on Dereth! Be glad you did not arrive here when we did. The war with the Duke was bad enough, but the siege of the Olthoi nearly destroyed us all. May King Varicci be forever blessed by the glory of Karlun!
You Bloodless swear loyalty to that fool Asheron. But where was he when the Olthoi laid siege to our city? He helped us not, just as he has abandoned you now.

greetings: The Duke's rebellion died a long time ago, which we are all grateful for, of course. But to think of how the King ended it...
I know that Eleonora du Bellenesse slew Prince Renlen, and for that she deserved her execution. But the manner in which it was done... It's enough to make you weep.

quest: Stay clear of the Eaters. The King may have found a way to harness their destructive energy, but they're still a most fearsome beast. They would as soon slay us as they would the Bloodless.
Tread lightly, friend. One false move and the King will feed you to his pets. You've seen them, haven't you? If not, you're sure to meet them soon enough.

greetings: All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will specialize your skill in Salvaging.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
You want to specialize your skill in Salvaging? Go to Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands. Bring me a blank augmentation gem and I'll see if I can help you out.
You might want to give this to Nawamara Ujio, Piersanti Linante, or some other Augmentation Trainer. I can't do anything with this.
Using this gem will teach you the Armoredillo Curl defensive technique. Those who master this technique can increase their resistance to slashing.
Be sure to read the gem's inscription before you use it.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
I have mastered the Armoredillo Curl defensive technique which allows me to resist slashing damage.
Bring me a Blank Augmentation Gem and I will share my knowledge.
All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will learn the Drunken Drudge fighting technique.
Watch your back.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.

I am master Rujen. Bring me an augmentation gem and I shall teach you the Drunken Drudge fighting technique which will increase your resistance to piercing attacks. Visit Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you have not already acquired one of these gems.
All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will learn the Diving Duo fighting technique.
The amount of danger found in Dereth is shocking
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.

By using my special Diving Duo fighting technique you can increase your resistance to electrical attacks, visit Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands. Bring a blank augmentation gem to me and I will teach you what I know.
All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will learn the Reedshark Cover fighting technique.
Stay safe out there. Some people just want to watch the world burn.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
I am the master of Reedshark Cover fighting technique. Give me a blank augmentation gem, and I will improve your resistance to fire attacks by teaching you this technique.
Fiun Rehlyun of the Halaetan Islands can tell you how to get one of these gems.
You might want to give this to Nawamara Ujio, Piersanti Linante, or some other Augmentation Trainer. I can't do anything with this.
Once you use this gee you will gain the use of the Sho mantra to resist frost damage.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription first. I don't want to hear you complain if you use this gem without being fully aware of the repercussions.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
I can teach you the ancient Sho mantra for making ones body resistant to frost attacks. Bring me an augmentation gem and I shall inscribe it for you.
You might ask Fiun Rehlyun of the Halaetan Islands about augmentation gems if you do not have one.
Use this gem to learn the Olthoi Whip technique.
Keep up your strength, lest your will erode.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
Go to the Halaetan Islands and speak with Fiun Rehlyun. Bring me a blank augmentation gem and I will teach you the Olthoi Whip technique.
When hit by acid, this technique will allow you to quickly remove the acid from your person and thus take less damage.
When you use this gem, your skill at Armor Tinkering will become a bit more... specialized.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
If you'd like to vastly improve your skill in Armor Tinkering, bring me a blank augmentation gem.
If you don't already have one of those, go talk to Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands.
All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will specialize your Magic Item Tinkering skill.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
Bring me a blank augmentation gem and I will help you specialize your Magic Item Tinkering skill.
If you haven't already done so, go talk to Fiun Rehlyun. When you get the gem, come back to me.
All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will specialize your Weapon Tinkering skill.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
If you want to specialize your Weapon Tinkering skill, bring me a blank augmentation gem.
You can get a blank augmentation gem from Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands.

It is true that the Fiun are responsible for creating the Eaters. However, they did not do so out of malice. They thought they were doing the universe a great service. But the Eaters broke free of their bonds and decimated the Fiun homeworld. Now the Fiun focus their collective will in an effort to permanently eradicate the Eaters.
Please deliver this note to my brother, Suzuhara Baijin. You can find him in Stonehold.
%mn coughs loudly.
Phlegm rattles in %mn's lungs as a nasty bout of coughing racks his weakened frame.
Ah, this cough is going to kill me.
Blessed sea breeze, work your magic.
A package? From my dear brother? What a wonderful man! So thoughtful, he is!
And I should thank you as well for delivering this package to me. Would you be so kind as to return to him with this note of gratitude?
Hello, friend. How do you like this ocean breeze? I feel it has quite a restorative property.
I came down with this nasty cough a few months ago when my brother and I explored one of those new Burun pits. I just cannot seem to shake it.
This ocean breeze seems to be working. I feel much better now than I did before I arrived.
Please deliver this package to my brother, Suzuhara Sheshumi. You can find him at the Beach Fort at 76N, 49W.
A portal to the Beach Fort lies at the bottom of the the Pit, which is located at 23.4W, 64.3N.
Excuse me, is anyone going to the Beach Fort?
Might someone be able to help me?
Thank you for your help, my friend! My brother's health means all the world to me. I do not know what I would do without him.
Please accept this meager reward.
Hello, brave adventurer! I wonder if you might aid me in a small task.
My brother, Suzuhara Sheshumi, suffers from a dreadful ailment of the lungs. He used to reside with me in Stonehold, but has since retired to the Beach Fort.

I tried to take a Care Package to him, but lost it in a nearby dungeon. There is a portal to the Beach Fort at the bottom of the Pit. I was hoping to take that portal, but the Monougas there are much tougher than I remember. I am afraid the package is still there.
I fear I am not strong enough to re-enter the Pit. But perhaps you could do it! Go to the Pit at 64N, 23W. Find the package, then take it to my brother at the Beach Fort at 76N, 49W!
Stand back peasant! Do not get too close to the statue or I might have to punish you.
I make sure that Eleonora du Bellenesse's honor remains intact.
She's so beautiful isn't she?
As hard as it is to believe, there are some who would try to defile this statue.
I can't tell you how many times I've had to scrub pictures of a red bull off of this statue.
If I leave my post someone will defile the statue.
Rain or shine I stand watch over this statue.
Do not disturb me. I must be ever vigilant.

quest: I feel a chill coming on.
I'm so hungry.
Won't you give a few pyreals to a fellow citizen?
Please, some pyreal to feed my eight children and old grand mother.
I shall pray for you.
May the light of Eleonora du Bellenesse shine upon you.
I am saved. Thank you.
Thank you. May your kindness be its own reward.
I may be poor. I may be hungry. But at least I'm Viamontian. Unlike you.
I got these clothes from Agonno the tailor. He said some Bloodless had brought them in and he couldn't sell it.
Even I have my pride. I won't beg from a non-Viamontian.
I'm of the lowest class in Viamont, but at least I'm Viamontian.
Mendica Scarsolo throws your pyreal to the ground.
I would rather starve than receive charity from the Bloodless.

greetings: Silyun is the last refuge for the people of the Duchy of Bellenesse. Long ago we rebelled against King Varricci. Unfortunately our rebellion was short lived and we were forced to flee. This town is all that is left of the survivors.
One cannot help but notice the enmity of those that dwell in Silyun.
Those who are not blue are perceived as inferior.
This I do not understand as they were once oppressed themselves.
I must contemplate on this some more.

quest: For King and country!
Fratellone Ribellarista turns away and spits and then whispers.
King's dog...
I have heard of you. The Grand Mother has sent word of your deeds.
Know that the time is near. The Stag of Bellenesse will once again rise up to unshackle the bonds of our oppressors.
Death to the King!
Keep the faith my friend!
Long live the Red Bull of Sanamar!
As you can see, like you, I am loyal to the King.
Such loyalties require that I make a most distasteful decision.
My twin brother Fratellono has chosen to ally himself with the rebels.
I beg of you to go and speak with him.
Convince him that what he does can only bring strife and misery to our people.
I have heard of your deeds.
The Stag of Bellenese is dead! Why must you and my twin brother resurrect this old hate.
Are you so blind that you cannot see the misery that this will bring?
Renounce your ties to the rebellion. It is not yet too late.
Fratellodunon Ribellarista breaks down and cries.
Not..too..late...

greetings: My rye! Thank you!
My wheat! Thank you!
My corn! Thank you!
You killed that brute that stole my seed! Thank you so much! You are truly a hero worthy of the name.

If you are looking for more adventure friend - and you certainly seem to be good at it - you might want to peruse the rumors that Wilomine has at the bar. Or perhaps you should journey to Shoushi. I hear that there are many good people there who may need your help!

Hello, hello! May I buy you a drink? Oh ... no, I am out of pyreal again. I had forgotten. That is the danger of drowning your troubles, I suppose - you may forget the troubles in the drink, but you forget everything else as well!

My troubles? How kind of you to ask. I would be happy to tell you my troubles! You see, I am a farmer ... well, all right ... an aspiring farmer. I just know that I could be a good farmer if I could but get the seed in the ground. But drudges keep stealing my seed!

If you could retrieve my seed bags for me - all three of them - and perhaps bring me the head of the dastardly drudge who is behind the theft, I will reward you well. You can find the drudges in their nearby Hideout; Wilomine at the bar has directions.
quest: Hmmm? No, this isn't mine. Why don't you try asking Flinrala about it?
I believe that Worcer was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?
Flinrala is always talking about this type of thing. Why don't you show this to her?

greetings: What's this? You helped Ishaq? I hope that you were merely earning his trust so as to better shame him in the future! That moony malefactor!
What's this? I don't want this! Bring me my stolen notes!
Oooh! That Ishaq! I'll get even with him yet ...
I must get my notes back!
Thank you! Perhaps you can help me again in the future. Now, I must begin deciphering these immediately ...
Excellent! Excellent! You took - I mean, you found some of my notes!
Tanami Kei tries to read the sad mass of paper, to little effect.
Oh my. These are in some condition. Well, at least I have them now. And I believe I promised you a reward for your help.
Berkholt, in the bar, sells directions to this miscreant's dwelling. Please, friend, help me restore my reputation!

I've been making a name for myself lately, with my astute and erudite writings about the mysteries of cross-world speciation. But success breeds jealousy! And a certain man - I will not call him a colleague, nor even a rival, for in truth he is not worthy to be listed among the ranks of Natural Philosophers! - a certain man has stolen from me the notes I was compiling for my next book!
If you can retrieve any of my notes for me, in any condition, I will reward you with a handsome crossbow I have made!
Can you help me, friend? I'm a Natural Philosopher. I study the ways and means of Dereth's natural flora and fauna - and her unnatural fauna as well.
No, I insist you keep this.  You've earned it.
This looks to be a key of some sort. You better keep it. It might be important.
This looks like it's a part of something. You better keep it. It might be important.

This is obviously an important banderling token. Look! The sides have scrape marks on it. It looks as if it was meant to fit into something. Search the village carefully. I'm sure whatever this fits into is there.
Those heathens were worshipping some kind of spirit, huh? I guess with you killing their 'god' they won't be coming back.
Good job! Here's a little something for your troubles.
Hey! Wait a minute. I can't drop this stone...
quest: Thanks for your help in clearing away those bothersome banderlings. Now I can starting building my resort.
Hmm...for the life of me I still can't drop that Oily Stone you gave me.
You're back. Any luck getting those banderlings to relocate their village?
No? Well hurry up then. If you don't do it I'll hire someone else who is more persuasive.
Remember, the banderling village is east of here. I don't care how you do it, but get those banderlings to leave.
Greetings! I'm Cyphis Suldow and you are? Nevermind, who you are is unimportant. The important thing is I need some help and you seem to be more than qualified to do so.
I want to build a resort for the weary adventurer and I found the perfect spot just to the east of here.
The only problem is that some banderlings have a village there. That is where you come in my friend. Go and...relocate those banderling.
Come back when the job is done. I'll give you a nice reward, but I'll need proof that the banderlings won't come back.
I need some help, but apparently so do you. Come back when you have a bit more experience under your belt.

greetings: No my friend. Keep this. It may be useful.
What is this?
%n's eyes bulge out as he reads the plans.
I did not know that drudges were capable of building such a thing. I must report this to my superiors.
Here is a reward for your services.
What an interesting key. Thank you.
quest: I have given the plans to my superiors to be studied. Who would have known that drudges were capable of creating such a machine? We will have to keep an eye on them from now on.
Any luck spotting the great flying beast?
The last sighting was south and west of Fort Tethana, along the western coastline of the Direlands.
I have received reports from adventurers that a great beast has been seen flying across the Direlands. They say it is as big as a house and spits fire and acid.
This beast must be investigated and catalogued. Go and seek out this beast and bring back proof of your findings.
I am searching for someone to do some scouting for me. Unfortunately, you are as yet too weak to complete this task.

greetings: The Tursh Totem. If they had escaped with this object...
You have done our Queen a great service. I am only sorry that the totem had to be destroyed in the process. Still, that is better than the alternative.
You deserve a reward for your heroic actions. Please take this replica as a show of our gratitude.
quest: I am sorry, but we have need of adventurers more experienced than you. I am afraid there is little you can offer our queendom at this point in time.

These vaults house numerous objects of immense power. Whoever these invaders are, we cannot allow them to obtain that which they seek. I need you to infiltrate the vault and repel the interlopers. If you happen upon the object they are after, return it to me.
These creatures cut off surface access to the vaults. You will have to enter the sewers beneath in order to break in. Access to the sewers can be found in an old temple at 77.2N, 33.0E.

Please, the Queen is in dire need of your assistance! A group of creatures recently assaulted one of the Queen's hidden vaults. The few guards who were able to escape told me that these creatures were after some sort of artifact.
This is a reward for the service you have done our Queen. We are in your debt.

greetings: Happy New Year! Isn't it wonderful?
Be sure to get some black-eyed peas from Fispur Ansel or one of his fellow grocers!
I have so many party invitations, I just don't know what to do!
quest: I know you're excited, but I've only got so many gifts to give out!

Tell you what, if you don't like the gift I gave you, you're an ungrateful... no, I'm kidding. If you don't like it, just give it to me and I'll give you a different gift! And even if the new one is just like the old one, trust me, you'll love this one even more!
Happy New Year! The High Queen has asked me to give out these lovely presents in celebration of the new year. Let's see what we've got for you...
Ah, some lovely balloons! Don't they look festive?
Ooooh, this will be fun! Be careful with this!
Ah, now this is nice! Purely decorative though, I'd hate to see the towns of Dereth if folks tried to drink all of this!
Here we go! A party hat for all occasions!
Wow, this is really pretty! Take good care of it!
Now, if you don't like what you got, you can hand it back to me and I'll pull something else out of my bag.
Of course, it might be just like what you got the first time! Just be sure you like what you've got before I leave here in a month!
Oh, and there's something else. This isn't from the High Queen, though. In fact, I'm not entirely sure she'd approve!
The ACEmulator Team hopes you have a great year!
Ah, not your cup of tea? That's all right, I'm sure someone else will love this. Let's see, how about one of these?

greetings: Seek me out if you should need more of these.
quest: Thanks to you I now have a means to put end to my torment and yet I now lack the courage to use it. Does my life mean so little that I can throw it away so carelessly? Was I put here on this land for a purpose? So many questions to be answered.
Yes! This is it!
Hermit carefully collects the Thrungus Dust from your clothes and then suddenly her smile turns to one of sadness.

You deserve to know the truth. It is my belief that this dust will sever my ties to the Life Stones so when next I die I will not be brought back. My heart aches for having to deceive you, but I feared you would not help me had I told you the truth.
But do not despair my friend. For while you were gone I started to have misgivings about my actions. Perhaps death is not the answer I should seek.
I bestow upon you the title of "Thrungus Reaper".
Please hurry! The pain I suffer is unbearable.
Hermit removes her hood to reveal a face that is half melted away.
Stranger! Hear my words.
Long ago I stumbled upon an ancient Falatacot tomb. In my foolish quest for riches I defiled the tomb only to trigger an ancient curse that causes my flesh to melt. Behold!
This melting of my body will continue until I die in twisted agony. My peace lasts but a moment as those accursed life stones will bring me back to life whereupon the cycle will begin anew.

My search for a cure has brought me here. Will you not help me find solace? The Thrungus within this cave possess a unique ability to process rocks by digesting them. Take these and feed them to the Thrungus. Bring me back a sample of the processed stones.
Feed these Life Stone Chips to the Thrungus and return with the processed stones.
Snow Lilies! I can use as many of these as you can find.
I'll buy this one from you.
You must wait %tqt to turn in more Lillies for xp.
Thank you for bringing the Snow Lilies. The Grand Mother will be so pleased.
If you should find some more Snow Lilies, I will gladly buy them from you.
What am I to do? The Grand Mother has placed an order for fresh Snow Lilies, but I am all out. Can you help me?
Go to the Isle of Ruin and bring me back three fresh Snow Lilies. They are very rare so you will have to search for them.
Be careful when picking them as they tend to attract hungry creatures.
But I'm sure you'll have no problem dealing with the nasty monsters.
I shall make a gorgeous flower arrangement for the Grand Mother with the Snow Lilies you found!
Here. This is for you.

greetings: This is yours. Keep it if you like, or just put it on the ground to get rid of it. Of course, if you want to keep the world free from litter, you can give this note - and any other trash you might have - to a Town Crier.
Why don't you go talk to the Agent in the next room? Double-click the doors to open them.

If you wish to skip this tutorial, go talk to Jonathan in the next room. He will reward you with all the items and experience you would have otherwise received by completing the Academy. But be warned; once you leave the Academy, you can never come back.
quest: Why don't you go talk to the Agent in the next room? Double-click the doors to open them.
Hail and welcome to Dereth! No time to chat! Time to get on with your training!
Click on the Backpack in the lower right corner of your screen to open your Inventory. Click on the blue Calling Stone, and drag it to me.
When a character speaks to you, her chat is displayed in the chat box at the bottom of your screen. Read the text in your chat window to see what the Society Greeter has to say.

greetings: So, the King of Sanamar courts Fort Tethana. And they are still receptive, even after what happened to Kurth? Damn them all.
Take this missive to Lieutenant Commander Margyle. They will show allegiance to their Queen! No further dealings with Varicci are to be tolerated!
Go!
quest: You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.
You have done your duty, please return to me later.
They make demands of the Queen? Their allegiance is not theirs to barter!
I apologize. I should not raise my voice to you. You have done your Queen a great service. Take your reward and go.
You! If you would do your Queen a service, I bid you listen to me.

Our forces have spotted several Viamontian Knights in the area around Fort Tethana. When attacked, they quickly fled into the hills. We have sent emissaries to Teth in the hopes that they might shed some light on this situation, but our emissaries have not exactly been met with the warmest of receptions.
I do not like this situation. There is something about it that fills me with dread. Go to Teth. Scout the hills north of Teth. If you find anything of note, report back to me.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.

greetings: You seek Commander Kurth? He has been gone for some time. You'll want to speak with Lieutenant Commander Margyle. The Renegades are tunneling beneath the fort. There's a force of men down below to deal with the creatures before they can break through the earth. You can find the entrance to the pit just southwest of here. It's still on the plateau, though.
I've seen those Knights in action, and I must say, I am impressed. If Fort Tethana were to gain control of soldiers such as those, Fort Tethana would surely be a force to be reckoned with.

We hear the talk of blue-skins out of the north. We understand the fear they instill in many who follow the Queen, but we have our own problems to deal with here. If the blue-skins would aid us in this conflict, who are we to hold to ancient grudges?

I thought that when Commander Kurth went missing, we'd have morale problems in the fort. But the truth of it is that we have no time to worry about that while we're constantly under siege by the Renegades.
The Renegades have been at our door for years. And in all that time, what reinforcement has the Queen shown us?
Where are you Darling?
Darling come home!
Has anyone seen my pet?
Oh no! This is horrible. My cherished Darling is dead.
Xsao Lann begins to sob quietly
I loved her so very, very much.
Xsao Lann suddenly looks up at you.
You said there were lots of Tuskers down there?
They're kind of cute too.
quest: I've lost so many pets, I'm starting to lose count.
I wonder if Grievvers make good pets?
Have you found Darling? Look around around 4.6N 89.5W that is where she disappeared. Please hurry.
Have you seen my pet? I was walking around 4.6N 89.5W when she disappeared.
Her name is Darling and I would be ever so grateful if you could bring her home to me.
Xsao Lann starts to break down in tears.
Xsao Lann tells you, "*sniff*"
I miss my Darling so much. Please hurry and find her.

greetings: At last! He will be most pleased...I mean the Stag of Bellenesse thanks you, adventurer. It is through your efforts that the course of history shall be forever changed.
Well met, adventurer!
Ricardo lowers his voice warily and then continues.
My name is Ricardo and I am part of a rebel faction of Viamontians that seeks to overthrow the despotic ruler, King Varicci.
Recently our spies have learned that the King has launched a massive campaign to recover a powerful Falatacot artifact called the Blood Gem of Rikt Zir.
What this gem does is still unknown, but one thing is for sure. We can not let Varicci get his hands on it.
Our sources have unearthed an obscure legend from some ancient Falatacot ruins.
It claims the gem was fractured into three pieces and then hidden in some caves near the ocean.
We believe the caves referred to in the legend are the Coral Caves at 90.5N 42.5W.
Ricardo winces and rubs his injured leg.
I tried to recover the gem myself, but was grievously injured and had to take refuge here.
I have no choice, but to ask you to retrieve the Blood Gem for me...No. For the rebellion!
Return the Blood Gem to me and may the Stag of Bellenesse watch over you!
Very good! These will do nicely.
Take these to an Agent of the Arcanum and we'll split the profits.
Double cross me and I'll put a price on your head.
I'm a personal friend of Oswald.
A word from me and you'll be dead before you count your last Housing Writ.
This is a fine piece of Blue Coral! One moment while I finish making your Fake Niffis Pearl.
Shanrek the Forger leaves and returns carrying a small round object.
Here you go. Take this to any Agent of the Arcanum and trade it for a Housing Writ.
Shanrek the Forger's eyes widen noticeably as he reads the notice.
We'll make a fortune!
I tell you what. You seem like a trustworthy person.
There's a portal around back that leads to our hideout.
Go and fetch me as many Fake Niffis Pearls as they have and bring them back to me.
Hold on a moment, I need to sprinkle some of this on you in order for you to be able to pass though the portal safely.
Shanrek the Forger sprinkles some powder on you.
This stuff will allow you access to the portal for about a week.
So don't dawdle.
quest: Is this supposed to compensate me for helping you destroy our counterfeiting ring?
Shanrek the Forger gestures rudely in your direction.
I'll take your money, but you better watch your back.
You've made some powerful enemies this day.
You traitor! I don't believe you turned us in to the Agents of the Arcanum.
It just so happens I can make perfect copies of Niffis Pearls that can fool even the most discerning Agents of the Arcanum.
I'm just missing one key ingredient Blue Coral.
Once I have some Blue Coral, I'll be able to make some counterfeit Niffis Pearls which can be traded to the Agents of the Arcanum for Housing Writs.
Shanrek smiles broadly at you.
I thought I saw a Blue Coral Reef at 75.6N 46.9E.
I'm sure you can find some Blue Coral there.
Good luck!
Well? Did you get it yet?
Do you need cheap Housing Writs?
For the kindly donation of a Trade Note (10,000), I'd be willing to tell you how this can be done.
Shanrek the Forger wrings his hands anxiously.

greetings: You found it! Wonderful! My patron went to great pains to find this axe for me. She was most distressed when she'd heard I lost it.
You deserve a reward for your troubles. Please accept this helm. It's much tougher than it looks. I promise!
Hail, friend!
You look like a hunter on the prowl. If you are in search of adventure, I bid you listen to my tale.

There is a fort east of here that has been overrun with skeletons. Nasty suckers, those skeletons, and I ought to know. I was contracted by an emissary of the Queen to clear the skeletons out of the fort, and was doing pretty well, too, until I was set upon by a Bone Knight! I slammed my axe into his head, which should have been the end of him. But the axe stuck! So now the foul beast is runnin...

I tried to get it back, but with no weapon, the skels made short work of me. And so here I am at the lifestone again. If you could spare a moment to retrieve my axe, I would be most indebted to you. You can find the fort at 32.5N 66.1E.
Good luck to you!
There it is! My chickens will be happy that their feed bag has been returned. They were getting really hungry. Thank you!
Hey! My missing shovel! This is great. Now I won't have to dig in the yard with my wife's wooden spoon. Thank you!
My water bucket! Where did you find that? This will make trips to the well so much easier now. Thank you!
There they are! I've been looking for those gloves. Maybe these blisters on my hands will heal now. Thank you!
