greetings: I am here to stand vigil at the memorial of brave Antius Blackmoor. The Queen has also charged me to reward those who helped slay his murderer, the traitor Kurth. If you have a shard of Kurth's armor or a shard from that loathsome sword he wielded, give it to me and I will reward you.
Interesting... Very well, allow me to direct you to the nearest Chapterhouse. It is not far from here, at 85.4 N, 70.4 W. Simply present yourself to Commander Jin Zo for further orders.
quest: You have already helped me by slaying Baron Entemarre. There is nothing else I would ask of you now, but you have my continued gratitude.
CampEntemarreCompleted@%tqt

Yes, at last... This wretch Entemarre was responsible for great suffering among the people of Silyun. You must realize that there can be no official acknowledgement of your deed. However, I can reward you through my own resources...
Have you found Baron Entemarre at his encampment in the Direlands yet?

Queen Elysa has sent me here to establish a formal relationship with the good people of Silyun, who have rebelled against Varicci's tyranny. In order to aid them in their fight, I would ask you to journey into the Direlands near Ayan Baqur. The Viamontians have built a fortress at 62.7S, 82.5W. Bring me the head of Baron Entemarre, the garrison commander. The people of Silyun seek vengeance upo...

greetings: Ahh the mark of the Overlord, you are a brave adventurer indeed. Let me reward your efforts.
quest: The Queen thanks you for your assistance in the defense of Dryreach.
Return to me later and I may have need of your skills again. For now, the Tumeroks have withdrawn, and we do not wish to press them into more drastic actions.
The wind carries a strong odor of tumeroks.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Excellent work, friend! You have slain many of those who lay siege to this fair town! Allow me to reward you!
In the name of Queen Elysa, I officially recognize you as a member of the Dryreach Militia. May you serve long and well.
You must wait %tqt to retreive the Mark of the Overlord again.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Tumerok Gladiators.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Tumerok Gladiators and I will reward you.

The Queen is concerned that the Tumerok siege here is growing, and we do not have the resources to stop it. To this problem, I have been authorized to reward those stout and loyal souls who will go outside the walls and thin the numbers of the Tumeroks a bit.
Track down and slay %tqm of the Tumerok Gladiators for me, and I will reward you for your aid in the defense of Dryreach.

greetings: This is the mysterious metal, is it? I cannot say it seems all that menacing to me, but there are people more clever than I who are waiting to analyze it. Thank you, you have helped us immensely. I will remember your service. If you seek to further aid our cause, speak to Harkwull, here in Ayan Baqur.
quest: You have helped me gather ore recently, have you not? I thank you for your service, but I have nothing more to ask of you at this time. Why don't you go speak to Harkwull, here in Ayan Baqur? If you're strong enough, I am sure he could use your talents.
You have an ore collector's hammer, do you not? Where is the ore?
The Grand Mother must have sent you. Yes, I know how much you helped the people of Silyun. Now that Silyun has formally allied with Queen Elysa, their cause is our cause.
If you would seek to defeat the tyrant Varicci, journey to the Shade Iron Mine in a cavern south of here, along the coast at 65.0 S, 87.6W.

The Viamontians have been extracting a metal known as Shade Iron there. This is the metal they crafted the foul blade Heartbreaker with. We must know more about it, so I would ask you to obtain a sample of the ore. The ore is difficult to properly extract. I suspect you will have to take a proper tool from the Viamontian mages in the mine who collect the ore.
Ah, I don't think I know you well enough to do business with you, friend.  However, we can discuss future cooperation if you can earn the trust of the Grand Mother of Silyun.
Yes, you brought us Commander Jin Zo's notes recently. Have you forgotten already? The crown has no further need of your services yet.

Splendid work. But you were attacked as you entered the Chapterhouse? Ah, I see, these notes explain much... A fine job, then, of battling through an operation gone wrong. Yes, I do believe you possess the skills and loyalty required to join us...

Aha! You helped us in the delicate matter of the bull, did you? His Majesty has need of your services again. We seek to infiltrate an organization known as the Whispering Blade, which seems to be some gathering of assassins and spies cobbled together by the desperate followers of the Bloodless Queen.
Bring this note to a Gharu'ndim named Hashina, in the rebel town of Silyun... It is a forgery that should gain you entrance to their base of operations...
I want you to enter their secret lair and, by whatever means necessary, obtain their commander's notes.
If you seek to gain the King's favor, I suggest you speak with the Grand Knight of Sanamar. Once he has deemed you worthy, you may seek me out again.
What are you waiting for? Go to Silyun and make contact with Hashina.
I see you have Commander Jin Zo's notes. Please hand them over.

So you've made contact with Hashina and been granted access to the Silyun Chapterhouse. I believe your orders were to proceed into the Whispering Blade compound and get the commander's notes. Is there some reason you are dawdling?

greetings: We'll protect this town to the bitter end. But, honestly, we're pretty well fortified. I think Kryst is safe.
We'll protect this town to the bitter end. But, honestly, we're pretty well fortified. I think Kryst is safe.
We'll protect this town to the bitter end. But, honestly, we're pretty well fortified. I think Kryst is safe.
We'll protect this town to the bitter end. But, honestly, we're pretty well fortified. I think Kryst is safe.
Ah yes, that was a big rat wasn't it? You appear unscathed as well. Excellent work my friend. Now you will see the ancient rat catcher art of rat tail weaving.
Ok then, you have proven yourself worthy of the title Rat Reaper.
quest: The rats haven't been as much trouble since you deposed their king. You never know when they may get uppity again though. Check back with me in a few weeks.
Excellent, I believe you are ready to help me with my little problem.

You see, the rats in town have been getting a bit bolder than we would prefer. It seems they have some sort of leader organizing them and helping them to steal the town's food supplies. It's my job to keep the rats out of town, so I'm too busy to go frolicking about the countryside looking for some leader rat.

You must go and find this clever rat and kill it before I lose my job. I've heard rumors that it lives in a cave to the west of town. Go and bring me proof of the clever rat's demise and I will reward you as only a Rat Catcher can.
I require an experienced hunter for the task I have. Let's see what you've hunted...
You haven't finished hunting the Blood Shreth.
You haven't finished hunting the Polardillo.
You haven't finished hunting the Dire Mattekar.
You haven't finished hunting the Littoral Siraluun.
You haven't finished hunting the Olthoi Nettler.
You haven't finished hunting the Olthoi Nymph.
You haven't finished hunting the Olthoi Drone.
You're not ready to help me with my problem. Here, complete the tasks that the people on this list have for you and I will allow you to help me.

greetings: I wonder what they're doing out there ...
What's this? You found this in the Creepy Chambers, eh? Wait ... *this* is the bandit's super-weapon? Well shoot! No, no, it's fine... it's just -- I'm not a staff warrior. I was hoping for a sword.
Well, I did say I'd reward you. Thanks anyway, I guess.

Hello! Say, I don't suppose you could help me out with a small favor? I've heard that there's this group of bandits out in the wilderness, a bit south of the Obsidian Rim. Rumor has it that they're stockpiling treasure and ... well, doing something strange with creatures. Either breeding them or worshipping them -- no one is quite sure which.
But it's the treasure that I'm interested in! And my curiosity is just killing me! I even heard that they might have some sort of super weapon!

Will you go and see what you can find out for me? I think their lair is called the Creepy Chambers. The barkeeper here sells a rumor with better directions than I can give you. And if you can find that super-weapon, bring it back to me! I'll reward you!
The times are changing. The other Master Armorers have started work on a new type of shadow armor.
I prefer the old ways so I have decided to hang up my smithing hammer. The other Master Armorers will be happy to assist you.

quest: Oh, this just won't do. I can see you are already a full member of the Ordina Rossu Morta. My associates and I cannot do anything about those records. I cannot help you.
If you have been helping the rebels and Queen Elysa and seek to clear your record to take service with King Varicci, I suggest you speak with my associate, Giordonni, in Sanamar.
You've just done the one thing in Queen Elysa's service?
For the price of an MMD note, my associates and I can erase any evidence that you served on that single occasion.
Be warned, however, that neither I nor my associates will be able to do anything like this for you again.
Ah, I can see that some of my associates have already helped you erase the evidence of your previous loyalty to Queen Elysa. We can do no more for you.
I see that you have gone to some great lengths to serve Queen Elysa. If you regret what you have done my associates and I can help you. Speak with me if you wish to wipe your record clean.

Excellent work. I will make sure that the royal archives no longer have any trace of your cooperation with King Varicci. However, this does not mean the Queen's agents or the Grand Mother will trust you. You will have to earn their trust.
So you still have not chosen a side in the war between Queen Elysa and King Varicci?  Neutrality has its perks, I suppose.

I see that you have gone to some great lengths to serve King Varicci's interests. If you regret what you have done, and wish to take service under Queen Elysa, my associates and I can help you. We can arrange to have all evidence of your... transgressions disappear.
But first you must do something for me. I seek an artifact, a Ruschk funerary fetish, from the Ruschk burial mound at 91.5 N, 68.8 W. Bring me the artifact, and your record will be wiped clean.
Be warned, this is a very difficult and risky operation, so neither I nor my associates will do this for you again. We will only help you change your allegiance once.
I see that you have gone to some great lengths to serve Queen Elysa.
Return when you are stronger and we can arrange to have all evidence of your... transgressions disappear.
Ha! Good try, friend. I can already see you have become a full member of the Whispering Blade. There are some archives that are beyond my reach. I cannot help you.
If you have been doing King Varicci's dirty work and seek to clear your record to take service with the rebels of Silyun and Queen Elysa, I suggest you speak with my associate, Lydda in Ayan Baqur.
You've just done the one thing in the Grand Mother's service? If you regret what you have done, and wish to serve King Varicci, I can help you.
For the price of an MMD note, my associates and I can erase any evidence that you served the Grand Mother on that single occasion.
Be warned, however, that neither I nor my associates will be able to do anything like this for you again.
Ah, I can see that some of my associates have already helped you erase the evidence of your previous loyalty to Queen Elysa. We can do no more for you.

I see that you have done a couple of things for the Grand Mother of Silyun. If you regret what you have done, and wish to serve King Varicci, my associates and I can help you. Speak with me if you wish to wipe your record clean.

Excellent work. I will make sure that the royal archives no longer have any trace of your cooperation with the Grand Mother or Queen Elysa. However, this does not mean the King's agents or the Grand Knight will trust you. You will have to earn their trust.
So you still have not chosen a side in the war between Queen Elysa and King Varicci?  Neutrality has its perks, I suppose.

I see that you have done a couple of things for the Grand Mother of Silyun. If you regret what you have done, and wish to serve King Varicci, my associates and I can help you. With a word in the right ear, we can make your disloyal acts disappear from the royal archives.

But first you must do something for me. I seek some arcane magical equipment, guarded by Sclavus in a fortified compound at 34.1 N, 50.6 W. Bring me the Sclavus' Umbral Crucible, and your record will be cleansed. I should tell you that the artifact may be incomplete, and need to be re-assembled.
Be warned, such influence as I wield must be exercised with discretion, so neither I nor my associates will do this more than once for you.
I see that you have done a couple of things for the Grand Mother of Silyun.
Return when you are stronger and we can make your disloyal acts disappear from the royal archives.

greetings: Your returning your gift? I will reward you another way.
%n sorts through the stack of paperwork, checking that it all in order.
This paperwork seems in order. Though, why she is selling Thrungus is beyond me.
Here, give her this letter. She'll need to send it with whomever she sends to pick up the next batch of those little things...
quest: Ahh, yes. This is the blade that was stolen. Allow me to reward you for your valor and loyalty to Sanamar and King Varicci.
If this shield is of no use to you, return it to me, and I will reward you in other ways.
Greetings.
I have been authorized to offer rewards to anyone who can return the blade that was stolen from the Vaults of Sanamar. The blade is gold in color, and bears the markings of the Bellenesse family.

The craven thief was last sighted near a cave at 71.1 N, 50.2 W and is believed to be hiding within. Find the thief, do justice upon him, and return this blade that was wrongly taken from this Kingdom.

Bring the blade to me, and your loyalty will be rewarded. Be warned, however. I have heard that both Silyun and some Bloodless in Yaraq also seek this blade. They must not be allowed to gain that which is rightfully Sanamar's.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.

greetings: As you wish.
quest: Lucari carefully examines the blade you have given him. With a very sad expression, he sets the weapon gently aside and looks to you.
Thank you... This is indeed the sword that was lost to us. All in Silyun thank you for returning this to us. It is a noble thing you have done.
Please, accept this token as a gift from us, and know that you have our gratitude for the valor and nobility you have shown to us this day.
If you do not wish the shield, return it to me, and I will find another way to reward your kindness.
Greetings to you, friend.

I have heard reports that a sword has been stolen from the Vaults of Sanamar, and that the thief is hiding in a cave near 71.1 N, 50.2 W. If the reports are to be believed, the weapon is the very Sword of Bellenesse, lost in our coming to Dereth from Viamont.
We have not the resources to confirm this rumor, but, if you would be interested in checking out this rumor for Silyun, I can provide something in reward for this.

Go to the cave, find this thief. If he has the blade on him, and you'll know it if you see it, it is hard to miss, bring it to me. If this is truly the Sword of Bellenesse, all Silyun will be in your debt.

Be warned, agents of Varicci will also be seeking to return this blade to the Vaults of Sanamar. Also, I have heard rumor that someone in Yaraq also seeks the blade. The blade is the rightful property of the Duke Bellenesse. I hope, if you manage to find it before others do so, that you will return it to Silyun, so it may be returned to its rightful owner.
Please return to me when you are stronger.

greetings: You wish not this gift? Very well, I have other ways to reward you.
I do hope that this gift is more to your liking.
This is a well crafted item with interesting innate magical abilities. I'll be able to use this for parts. In exchange I'm granting you training in the skill of this weapon type.
quest: Bhravarn examines the blade intently, handling it with the most loving care and grace.

Ahh, truly the work of a Master. I've not seen its like ever come from Viamontian hands. Please, accept this gift with my blessing. It is a blade I created based on the stories and paintings I have seen of this blade. It is a humble replica, but is not warded against a non Bellenesse wielding it, as the true blade is.
If you do not wish this blade, return it to me, and I will reward you in another manner.
Salutations, friend.

I wonder if you could aid me in a piece of research, for which you will be well rewarded. Recently, a sword was stolen from the Vaults of Sanamar, the Sword of Bellenesse. It is reported to be one of the most exquisite pieces of Viamontian Weaponsmithing of its time.
Rumor has it that the thief is hiding in a cave around 71.1 N, 50.2 W. If you could get this weapon so that I could study it, I will reward you well for your time.

Have a care, however. If you choose to aid me in this, you will have to find the blade before the agents of Sanamar or Silyun do so. I do not wish to get in the middle of their feud, and would not wish for you to be needlessly caught in it either. All I wish is a chance to learn from the blade.
I thank you for coming to me, alas the assistance I need requires one of greater skill than thou.

greetings: I see that the banner you give me is that of the Viamontians. Great praise shall be heaped upon you for your efforts against the enemy.

You have achieved much in vanquishing the Viamontian foe. Though the need is no longer as pressing, keeping that corridor open for supplies in case of a future attempt to move forces to the northern Direlands is still a vital goal.
For your efforts, I award you with one of the shields we give to members of our army. Return it if you do not wish it as a reward.
I shall ensure that this is brought to Queen Elysa's attention.
This shall be given to one of our soldiers, then. I am afraid that I do not tell stories the way Lord Marsan used to...
The lieutenant's eyes mist a little.
He was not such a bad man, in truth. Perhaps given to boasting, but he did not deserve the fate he received.
A...a...a thing greater than evil than the Hopeslayer? Can such a thing be? But what?
It...it must just be rhetoric. But I shall make Queen Elysa aware of this...just in case.
I can only imagine the horrors you have seen. Take this, with the knowledge you have earned it.
You wish not to bear the elite shield? As you wish.

It seems the esteemed Lord Marsan may have met a poor end, as have perhaps the other armies arrayed on that field as well. Astonishing, that something can slay so many with so little apparent effort. I shall report to Her Majesty about this. But what is that great force that he writes about?
quest: Peace be with you in these dark times. I serve Queen Elysa Strathelar in an information gathering role, but currently those of us who gather information for Her Majesty are baffled by a strange occurance.

We recently sent an army to the Fort Tethana region, a move that was matched by the Viamontian loyalists. We have heard nothing about either force since a report that they had sat down to parlay, except for a rumor of Tumerok activity in the area.
The Queen would like you to explore the area, and return with any information you find.

I have heard that others are in search of information about what happened to the forces. Although Her Majesty would prefer that people aid her, in this matter she believes that something which transcends this war has occurred. As such, if you choose to aid the Viamontians, there will be no negative ramifications from our side.
Also, if you have ventured to the fortifications between here and Fort Tethana, I will accept any Viamontian banners you may have retrieved.

I do not think you have enough experience to aid me in the matter of the vanished army. However, if you have ventured to the fortifications between here and Fort Tethana, I will accept any Viamontian banners you may have retrieved.

greetings: There is a hint of conspiracy here. You say you found this in Lord Marsan's camp? He is a fool. Was a fool, I suppose. Still, normally he would aggrandize himself, not reveal his true cowardly nature in his writings. Unfortunately, his ramblings do nothing to help us assess the true nature of this foe - simply inspire a certain level of skepticism and make me wonder if this is a ploy by Elysa o...
After reading the tattered pages, Lieutenant Durgan looks pale and shaken. He rapidly regains his composure.

I see that you have succeeded. Never in my wildest dreams would I have imagined that such things were afoot so near to us. I will recommend to Commander Margyle that we begin to prepare to repel whatever dark dreams these shadows and their allies have in store.

And you have served Tethana well. May I interest you in this document? It concisely details what we, the citizens and soldiers of Tethana, would have of any who would claim sovereignity over us. Perhaps reading it will bolster your will as well, and you will be inspired to stand against tyranny? If it does not inspire you, return it to me for a further reward.

Although I am disappointed that you do not wish to keep that manifesto, I understand. We must all make our way in the world. Take care that you do not allow yourself to be blind to the follies of your leaders, however.
quest: Greetings, friend. I know that you are familiar with the area we now call the Shadow March. I like to ensure that I have as much intelligence as possible of the area. If you have fetched items from that area, I will take them from you and reward you.

Greetings, friend. Though we do not claim independence...yet...we still must look after our own concerns, since Elysa Strathelar won't. At times, we look to outsiders for aid. Are you willing to be that aid we seek?
The lieutenant shrugs his shoulders.

I am Commander Margyle's intelligence chief, and I have a very vexing problem. It seems that Elysa sent her army in our direction, no doubt to put us directly under her heel again. A Viamontian force also made passage from Marae Lassel, and all projections indicated that they would fight each other north of here, near the coast.
No matter who won, we would have gained an advantage. But what I find odd is this...

There was also word of a Renegade Tumerok band mobilizing to engage the other two forces. The three armies apparently encamped and parlayed, but there is no word from any of the forces after that. No army can keep themselves so hidden, especially not on our territory.
I want to know what happened to those three armies, and I will reward you to tell me. If you are truly helpful, I may discuss what the future holds for beloved Tethana.

greetings: The log of the Bloodless who led the enemy forces? And it seems that a great force swooped in and destroyed them all.
I am skeptical of this report, and yet there is no other obvious explanation. I shall accept it as written, then.
The Viamontian spy wipes his forehead nervously.
I've heard stories of the Hopeslayer. Will the world be shattered under the weight of a greater power? I must warn the king.
Here is your reward. Fly it proudly.
You do not wish to display loyalty to King Varicci? I suppose it was too much to ask, especially in these tense times.
Deliver a green wing to a Sho who specializes in collecting such.
quest: Your deed precede you. I've heard you are one of the few to dare tread in the Shadow March. If you have found information there, I'll gladly see it. Do not feel like you are betraying any trusts...based on what I've seen, this threat affects all of us.
Let me be honest. Your allegiance, whether for or against His Majesty, doesn't matter for the particular matter I am dealing with. Frankly, it seems like a threat against all Isparians.

The two warring sides were on the brink of battle, at long last, near the northern coast of the Direlands. But Count Di Orza has not sent a report back to King Varicci. Neither have the Bloodless sent a report back to their leader. There was a detachment of Tumeroks in the area as well, and they also have not been heard from since.
Something awful has happened, I fear. Please gather what information you can and return, and I will do what I can to help you.

greetings: No, that's yours, friend. You have earned admission to our Chapterhouse. Welcome to the Whispering Blade.

What a grisly memento the Falatacot left behind. Still, very curious, and it gives us an insight into Dardante's operations. A job well done. I feel confident in admitting you to the Whispering Blade. You can be trusted to see most of the translation... There are some parts that must still be reserved for our most senior members. On behalf of our Grand Master, I thank you.
Right, well, this won't be much use to you any more. Thank you again for your assistance.
quest: You're a servant of Varicci's. Don't try to hide it from me. Go away.

You've helped me recently, haven't you? I am grateful for the assistance, but I have no more to ask of you at the moment. If you still have the Summoning Adept's Ring, you can give it to me in exchange for practical knowledge...
We have already been over this, haven't we?  I asked you to go to Dardante's Workshop beneath the Royal Hall in Sanamar, so that you may investigate Dardante's Summoning Chamber.

Ah, excellent... I have been looking for a person of your obvious skill who is loyal to Queen Elysa and the good folk of Silyun... as well as another organization. I seek someone of skill and daring to infiltrate the Summoning Chamber of Count Dardante,, King Varicci's chief thaumaturgical counselor.

You must journey to Sanamar, to the Royal Hall itself, and find the portal to Dardante's Workshop. In there, you must find a way to gain access to his Summoning Chamber, and find what information you can from the spirits that the Count binds and torments there. Bring me what you find, and I will further initiate you into the mysteries of the Whispering Blade.

I must also warn you that if you have made it this far into our confidence and are thinking of making use of those unscrupulous "plumbers" to erase your record of service... Well, suffice it to say, royal archives can be pillaged, but the Whispering Blade does not forget its own.

I see that you have already done much to serve Queen Elysa and the brave rebels of Silyun. But before I can trust you with a task of this sensitivity, I must ask you to go assist my associate, Mekhmet.
So you've picked up the fragment, have you? This is good news. Please, give it to me.
Sorry friend, I don't think you are strong enough to help me.
You have earned a high honor, to be granted a Silveran Weapon from our very limited supply.  Wield it well.
How did you get this?

I welcome you to the Chapterhouse of the Whispering Blade.  I am glad to count you as a true ally in the fight against Varicci's tyranny.  I have no urgent business for you now, but I may in the future.
Well done, friend.  You have earned a most powerful reward for your loyal and courageous service to the realm.
Perhaps a different weapon is more suited towards you.

greetings: This is part of what I need, but I want you to gather and assemble all three fragments. I need the complete Elder Spirit Tablet.
A fascinating record of the mysterious Grael. Count Dardante and our King are both very interested. I thank you for your service.
quest: You can't fool me. You work for the rebels. Go away, you're tracking filth into my home.
You've done some work for me already, haven't you? Sorry, I don't have any more deep pits of eldritch magic to push you into at the moment.
Have you found the Elder Spirit Seal in the Black Spear Temple yet? Remember, the temple is located in the Obsidian Plains, at 68.4 S, 66.1 W.

Ah, I'm glad you came to me. I can see that you have done some dangerous and unorthodox things in the service of our King. I would ask you to do more. In the Obsidian Plains, at 68.4 S, 66.1 W, there is an ancient temple that the Order of the Raven Hand has been using as some site of worship. It is called the Black Spear Temple.

Within the depths of the temple complex, there is a pedestal which bears the seal of the Elder Spirits that serve the "Living Darkness" the Raven Hand is so infatuated with. The seal is broken, but I have the missing fragment. I would like you to take it and explore the levels that the cultists have not yet been able to penetrate.

I seek a tablet of ancient knowledge, which has been split into three pieces. The three pieces are guarded by ancient Shadows known as Shonossoar, Kaihoatai, and Parfarrail. Take the fragments from these creatures of Shadow, assemble the tablet, and bring it to me.

There is one thing for you to remember. I know that there are ways of concealing one's service to the King. Just know that this is a sensitive enough task that there will be no way that your involvement can be forgotten by any simple raid on the Royal Archives. However, if you do this for me, I will grant you full membership in the Ordina Rossu Morta.
You have not yet chosen to serve our King... But neither are you a pawn of the Bloodless Queen. If you would serve Sanamar, speak first with the Grand Knight.
So you've picked up the Parfarrail Fragment, have you? Combine it with the other two fragments and give me the complete tablet, if you would be so kind.
Please return to me when you have gained more experience.

greetings: Dirty deeds, dirty hands...
quest: You have earned a high honor, to be granted a Silveran Weapon from the King's own armory. Wield it well.
How did you get this?

Well met, friend. I welcome you to the Chapterhouse of the Ordina Rossu Morta. I am glad to count you as a true ally against the Bloodless Queen's dogs. I have no urgent business for you now, but I may in the future.
Well done, friend. You have earned a most powerful reward for your loyal and courageous service to King Varicci.
Perhaps a different weapon is more suited towards you.

greetings: This confirms our worst fears. I thank you for the risks you have taken on our behalf. Surely, dark days lie ahead for all who fight against the Shadow.
quest: You've already retrieved Pheraion's Notes for me, haven't you? Please move along.
Did you need me to remind you of the location of the Raven Hand fortress?  It's at 60.0 S, 75.5 W.

If you would do more for the Whispering Blade, I would ask you to investigate a Raven Hand installation in the Direlands, not too far from Ayan Baqur. We have reason to believe that the Raven Hand has made common cause with the Ordina Rossu Morta. There are only a few reasons I can think of why these groups would work together, and they are terrible reasons.

Please seek out the home of the Raven Hand Diviner Pheraion at 60.0 S, 75.5 W and bring me back what evidence you can of their dark collusion. Whatever else you find in Pheraion's lair is yours - but I must have his notes!
You have Pheraion's Notes? What are you waiting for? Please hand them over.
Please return to me when you are stronger.

greetings: So it seems to me that our messenger was intercepted, and most likely by these people he spotted... You must investigate this assassins' hideout he wrote of. It says here that the hideout is not that far east of where he was brought down. Go there and retrieve the message he was carrying for us. For now, I will reward you for finding this page of the messenger's note...
Barsinni calms himself down and looks steadily at you.

The betraying bastards. How dare they double-cross us on our own double-cross! The information we gave them was valid, but incomplete. The ritual will fail catastrophically without Count Dardante there to guide their clumsy efforts! Those fools of the Raven Hand may have doomed us all!
Very well. Preparations must be made. We will all be terribly busy in the coming days, I am sure. I must reward you for your loyal service.
quest: You've already retrieved the Intercepted Note for me, haven't you? I don't have anything else for you at the moment.
I told you, our messenger vanished in a Direlands valley northeast of Ayan Baqur, somewhere around 83 W, 54 S.
Did you need me to remind you of the location of the Assassin Hideout? It's east of where our messenger was brought down. So I would start with the corpse and head east.

Come closer, friend, you might be able to help me. One of our messengers vanished on the way back from a meeting with some, ah, new associates. He was last seen in a wooded Direlands valley, around 83 W, 54 S. He was bringing back some very important information for us. We must assume he was intercepted. Find him, but most importantly, find the information he was bringing back to us!
You found the lost messenger's journal? That would be valuable information... Please hand it over.
You have the Intercepted Note? What are you waiting for? Please hand it over.
Return to me when you are stronger.

greetings: No problem, let's see, I think you've earned this.
quest: Ah, Essence of Artifice! I can't wait to start testing this. These Essences react differently to various alchemical tests than the pure essence we collect from the Fathomless Chasm.

Ah, Essence of Enchantment! You didn't get any on you I hope. I theorize that this essence could have dangerous effects if it comes in contact with a creature. I'll have to be very careful while I'm testing this.
Ah, Essence of Strife! War in a bottle eh? I don't know where to begin testing this. I'll have to confer with some of the Arcanum's War Magic specialists.

Ah, Essence of Verdancy! It's a good thing this decanter is enchanted or the essence would have eaten right through it and through the floor stones and through the ground beneath. In fact I don't think it would stop until it reached its source.
You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Artifice for me.
You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Enchantment for me.
You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Strife for me.
You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Verdancy for me.
The four Essences have sunken into the ground below Old Yanshi. The Menhir rings that once focused and held them have been overpowered by the Harbinger's magic and he now feeds from their power.
Yes, you look skilled enough to help me. I require a sample from each of the four Essences below Old Yanshi.

All of the Arcanum's attempts at collecting these samples ourselves have failed. Fifteen of our best agents were defeated in a recent attempt on the Essence of Verdancy. Find yourself a group of adventurers at least as powerful as you before you go anywhere near these new Essences.

First, you need to retrieve four Enchanted Decanters from the Arcanum Research Facility outside of Al-Jalima. You will use these decanters to collect each Essence's essence. The details are in these instructions.
Good luck and don't underestimate the power of the Essences. They are raw magic after all.
No offense, but you aren't powerful enough to help me collect samples of the Essences. Keep improving yourself and I'm sure that you will be able to help me in the future.
Let's see, where did I put those enchanted gloves.
Excellent, more essence samples. These will prove invaluable in my continuing research. Let me mix your reward.

Talar combines a small amount of each essence into a small vial of viscous red oil. He holds the bottle up to the light and watches as the oil clears and prismatic colors can be seen spinning in vial.

Here you go. This oil works on the same principle of elemental energies that the Prismatic Plume uses. Apply this oil to a piece of Greater Amuli Shadow Armor and you should be able to instill it with an impressive amount of elemental protection. If you would prefer a different reward then give me back the Prismatic Oil and I'll see what I can do.

If you wish to apply the Prismatic Oil to one of the other Greater Shadow Armor pieces you should read this report we received from an Arcanum Researcher on Aerlinthe Island. He found a buried structure there which may hold the required intermediary you need to instill the other armor sets with the Prismatic Oil.

greetings: You do not wish this as a reward? Very well, but remember that its ownership and display infers a certain level of respect in our Order. But the decision is yours. Please, accept this in exchange for the aegis.

Ahh, a frozen crystal shard. The mages in the Order have had some luck with figuring out what this was. It seems that this is a fragment of some sort of Totem, similar to the Ice Totems built by the Ruschk.
We haven't been able to reconstruct the totem yet, as the pieces are small and badly damaged, but we are hoping to collect enough pieces to reconstruct at least one complete totem.
It is our hope to use this totem to learn more about the Mukkir, and possibly make a weapon against them.
It was a great risk and noble act that you undertook in acquiring this crystal and bringing it here. Sarkin has given me these medallions to award to those whom have aided us in this.

I have been brought here to assist Sarkin Killcrane in the collection of the Frozen Black Crystals he has been receiving from adventurers as of late. If you wish to try to retrieve one of these crystals for us, I have heard that they can be found on a Mukkir named Targor. Targor seems to be a part of an ongoing conflict between the Raven Hand and a group of Shadows up around 68.4N, 66.6E.
Also, there have been reports of Shadows and Raven Hand Cultists erecting statues to the Hopeslayer in what people refer to as the 'Valley of Death'.

If you find any small idols or some such in their possession, my colleagues in the Knighthood would be interested in studying them. I'd say, three of them, total, would be enough to allow them to magically study them for information.
Let an Aluvian collector see the charm of a drudge.
quest: Once again, you have stepped up where few others would and protected Dereth from the rise of a creature who could spell the end of all of us. Please, accept these rewards.
Remember, the Aegis I have given you is a rare symbol amongst our Order, and that to carry and display one is considered a great honor.

Another Shadow Statue, wonderful. I don't know if I should be pleased that we have more subjects for research, or horrified that you find these so readily available. Here, allow me to pay you for this one.

The final statue requested, wonderful. With these three statues, my colleagues should be able to figure out what those shadows and their Raven Hand helpers are up to in the Valley. These three should hold them for a while, about a week if I had to guess. If you find any more of these statues before then, however, I'll pay you in good, old fashioned Trade Notes for them.
Now, for the reward both promised to you, and rightly earned.
Also, if you have any more of those small shadow statues, my colleagues do not need them at the moment, but I'd be interested in buying them off you for, say... 100,000 pyreals a piece?
What is this?
You explain where and how you came to have the Essence to Riordin Nightbane.
This creature must've been truly powerful to have its essence survive its death...
You have done us all a great service, in aiding in the death of a Shadow such as this one. Please, it would honor me if you would accept these humble rewards for your noble and courageous act.
Riordin Nightbane grants you the title, "Prodigal Shadow Slayer".
Know that the Aegis I have given you is a rare symbol amongst our Order, and that to carry and display one is considered a great honor.
Riordin Nightbane looks over the statue, with a dark look on his face.
Disgusting little things, aren't they?
Not quite a set of three yet. Hand me another statue, if you have one on you, or go get more. I'll need a set of three to send off.
Sorry, not my decision, it's what they requested of me. On the third statue, I'll reward you for your efforts.

greetings: Ahh, the Eastern Catacombs Tablet...
Kiriel Nightborn examines the tablet, muttering over the runes while tracing them with a finger. A cold darkness slowly covers the runes.

There is a second tablet in the Western Catacombs. It contains the rest of the enchantment I need to gain you access to the crystal. With this Tablet, I can give you access to the Western Catacombs. Enter the Western Catacombs, find the tablet hidden there.
There, now you can enter the Western Catacombs. Good luck.
Kiriel Shadowborn intones softly and a cold chill passes over you for a moment..
The Western Catacombs Tablet...
Kiriel Nightborn examines the tablet, muttering over the runes while tracing them with a finger. As with the first tablet, a cold darkness slowly covers the runes.

Now, I'll be able to complete the enchantment gaining you access to the Northern Catacombs. At the bottom of the Northern Catacombs, you should find the gate to the crystal we seek. Find it. Destroy it. Bring me proof of its demise, and I will reward you.
Kiriel Shadowborn once again intones softly and a cold chill passes over you for a moment..
There, now you can enter the Northern Catacombs. Good luck, and take care. The path only gets more difficult from here.
A shard of the partially reformed Soul Crystal...

It is good that this crystal not be allowed to fully reform. There is a chance, if the Falatacot and the crystal were left alone for long enough, that they could re-sink the Dark Isle, cutting us off from the opportunity we sought in its raising.
Please, accept this humble reward for your continued efforts to keep the Dark Isle above the waves.
quest: You must wait %tqt to assist me again.
Thank you for coming. I feared many would not be willing to hear me out.
Kiriel Nightborn looks you over speculatively

I will accept your aid in this, but be warned. Many things in the place I will send you are very, very dangerous for one of your level of skill. I would highly recommend either going with many, many others, or a large fellowship of those most powerful of adventurers.

Grael has awakened. My lord tried to stop this, but it has come to pass. I fear the Black Spear's rage will consume this world, if he is not stopped. To that end, my Lord has sent me to aid you and all those who go with you.
First, a little lesson in history...

Long ago, Grael, the Black Spear of the Kemeroi, chose to sleep. The place he chose to sleep was an isle north of here, north of Vissidal Isle. His presence covered the island in Shadow, and the isle soon came to be called the Dark Isle.

Those Falatacot who followed the Old One, N'cthail took a chance and used ancient seals to sink the isle below the waves. It was their hope that none would ever wake Grael and that this world would be free of him forever. Now, however, that wish has been undone by another.

I can show you the path to this Temple. Though the original Crystal binding the Isle to the deeps has been destroyed, it must not be allowed to reform, lest the Isle sink back down beneath the waves. The Temple is heavily defended. There are wards that block the use of the portals to the Catacombs. I've located a tablet that will allow me to enchant you to bypass the Eastern Temple Catacomb's w...
I am sorry. Though your resolve is strong, I'm afraid your skills are not up to this task. Perhaps when you have grown.

greetings: Thank you for bringing back Aigonne's heart. Just a cursory inspection of this grisly trophy indicates that something very strange happened to Aigonne down there. You also have Maegris' head, do you not? Please hand it over. With the head and the heart, we should be able to use some of our more, ahem, unorthodox tracking techniques to locate Grael.
quest: I've got the head and the heart. Clearly we are in deep trouble, but don't go saying anything about that outside of this chapterhouse. Right now I've got nothing for you.
We've spoken recently, haven't we? The summoning chamber can be reached through the Black Spear shrine on Vissidal Island, at 75.8 N, 70.5 E.

The head of the faithless Pontifex Maegris should help us conduct a full investigation of what happened in his summoning chamber. You have also brought in Archmage Aigonne's head, so I thank you and pronounce myself satisfied with your efforts. You may find this orb useful... It will allow you to recall directly to this Chapterhouse.
Go speak with the Chapterhouse Chamberlain about an additional reward.

You may be strong enough to help me, friend. We recently learned of a shameful and idiotic betrayal by Pontifex Maegris of the Raven Hand. It was stupid to trust him, but that is another matter. What most concerns us is that a team of Count Dardante's most capable assistants, under Archmage Aigonne, located Maegris' summoning chamber, from where he apparently tried to wake Grael. We know someth...
Please hand me the Heart first.
You have, ah, Aigonne's heart? It is grisly and unpleasant, but it had to be done. Please give it to me.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.

greetings: What a magnificent brute. Almost a pity that he had to die. He was the last of his proud bloodline, you know. Yes, this will help with my tracking methods. Now, if you would be so kind, please journey to Vissidal Island and seek the altar of Grael. Near the altar, at 75.9 N, 69.4 E, is the nest of a powerful Mukkir, who I think would help me with the second part of my tracking technique. Bring...

Truly, a fearsome head. This will serve, yes. I commend you for your excellent work and for your courage. Now, the rewards I promised... Practical training, as well as an orb that you may use to recall to this Chaperhouse...
You have also earned the right to a Silveran weapon from our most closely guarded stores. Please pick a token representing your weapon of choice from the table behind me.
quest: I have nothing more for you at this time.
We've spoken recently, haven't we?  I asked you to journey to the Vissidal Island and seek the altar of Grael. You should find the nest at 75.9 N, 69.4 E.

We've spoken recently, haven't we?  I asked you to journey to the eastern coast of the Isle of Ruin and bring me the head of the Ruschk known as the White Spear.  The wily old Ruschk lives in a cave at 93.8 N, 40.1 W.  And watch out for his guard penguins!

You ou may be a doughty enough warrior... I'll tell you my needs plainly. I need help to track down Grael. Yes, a tall order, but not as tough as one might think. There are creatures we have had reports of, who might be, ah, enough like Grael to help us track him down. It's a peculiar kind of tracking magic, not well known outside of the Whispering Blade.

If I had the heads of a Ruschk elder of particularly rarified blood and of a Mukkir Scion, that may be enough for me to start on his trail. Please, first go to the east coast of the Isle of Ruin in the Halaetans and bring me the head of the Ruschk elder called Harrak the White Spear. He is a tough and crafty old fiend, and of surpassingly pure blood, so beware. The White Spear's cave can be fou...
So you got the White Spear's head? Excellent work. Please, hand it over.
You've picked up the Mukkir's head? Excellent. Please, hand it over.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.

greetings: Found a better helmet already, have you? Well done. I'll take that back from you. In exchange, I'll give you a bag of high quality Granite, which ought to be useful to you when you start tinkering your weapons.

Found better gloves already, have you? Well done. I'll take that back from you. In exchange, I'll give you a bag of high quality Steel, which ought to be useful to you when you start tinkering your armor.

Found better footwear already, have you? Well done. I'll take that back from you. In exchange, I'll give you a bag of high quality Steel, which ought to be useful to you when you start tinkering your armor.

Don't need this robe any more? I'll take that back from you. Take this Sturdy Iron Key. Should you come across a Sturdy Iron Chest in your adventures throughout Dereth, this key will open it, and with luck you will find some useful armor or weaponry in that cache.

Found a better set of leggings already, have you? Well done. I'll take that back from you. Take this Sturdy Iron Key. Should you come across a Sturdy Iron Chest in your adventures throughout Dereth, this key will open it, and with luck you will find some useful armor or weaponry in that cache.

Found a better hauberk already, have you? Well done. I'll take that back from you. Take this Sturdy Iron Key. Should you come across a Sturdy Iron Chest in your adventures throughout Dereth, this key will open it, and with luck you will find some useful armor or weaponry in that cache.
quest: Welcome to Dereth! I can see by this token that you are newly arrived from our home on Ispar. We, the Pathwardens, are dedicated to helping all new arrivals with their starting equipment. Take this key. It can be used to open this chest you see behind me. The chest contains a full suit of armor that should help you until you can outfit yourself with quest equipment or treasure. Be warned, howev...
Once you have outgrown a piece of Pathwarden armor, you can bring it back to me to receive some other useful items.
I hope that armor treats you well, Dereth can be a dangerous place.
Simply hand me that token and I'll give you a key to the chest beside me.
So Buckminster sent you huh?
I'll tell you what. You give me that Pathwarden Token you've got in your main pack and I'll give you a key to this pretty chest. Won't get a better deal than that.
Don't forget to talk to your fellow adventurers. Simply type /cg before your message in chat to talk with the whole server.

Greetings, friend! Are you new to Dereth? If you are, you might have found a Pathwarden Token in your pack when you arrived here. If you give me that token, I'll give you a key to the chest you see behind me. The chest contains a complete set of armor, provided to all newcomers by my fellowship, the Pathwardens.

greetings: Queen Elysa has stationed me here to reward those brave adventurers, such as yourself, that destroy the corrupted beasts of this 'Dark Isle' and bring me proof of their deeds.
quest: Please return to me later.
Queen Elysa would have you accept this as a reward for your continued efforts to cleanse this isle of its corrupted denizens.
Queen Elysa will be pleased. Please, accept this small reward for your deeds. Bring more trophies to me, and I may have greater rewards for you.
Very well.
You are not powerful enough to claim a reward.

greetings: King Varicci wishes to reward any who defeat the servants of this foul Grael. Bring any remains to me, that he shall know of your deeds.
quest: Please return to me later.
King Varicci would have you accept this as a reward for your continued efforts to cleanse this isle of its corrupted denizens.
The King shall know of your valiance. Bring more remains and you may receive a greater reward.
Very well.
You are not powerful enough to claim a reward.
I don't think I have seen you around these parts before... You must be one of those new recruits.
The Barkeeper sneers at you.
Get out of here, go around back and use the trap door!
We're all out! Get out of here before I have you removed!

greetings: I see you have found a ledger, this will serve us quite well.
Take this key, you will find an old footlocker here with me. In that footlocker you will find rewards that will assist you in continuing your good deeds throughout these lands.
Take the weapon and the shield and select only one of the breastplates.
If you feel you do not need these items you may return them to me and I will reward you differently.
I will see that this gets put to good use elsewhere.
quest: Thank you again for your assistance.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.

Hello, I am Sergeant Huang, apprentice to the Ryu Jou Gai, temple of the Dragon of Power. The people of Sawato, in this obscure swamp, have gone unnoticed and unprotected for too long. Because of this bandits have moved in and are extorting the people of Sawato. As an apprentice to the Ryu Jou Gai I have been charged with organizing efforts to remove or at least hinder these bandits.

Take this mask, I believe it will allow you to infiltrate the Bandit's hideout. Their hideout can be found near 25.6S 56.5E. Talk to the Barkeeper there, our intelligence leads us to believe he acts as some sort of door man.
Gain access to the base of these bandits and bring me back any information you may find about their activities in this region.
May you be guided by the Four Stones of Jojii.
I appreciate your initiative, but I suggest returning when you are stronger.

greetings: Well done. The blood of Garaktar is indeed helpful. It allows me to make this token, which will gain you entrance to the chambers of Grael's White Totem. Simply give this Gateway Token to the White Totem Gateway on the Halaetan Islands, and a portal should open up for you. Once you have gained access to the White Totem Temple, destroy the White Totem, and that will help split Grael's power...

Excellent! This means that Grael's power has been dealt a serious blow! The shattering of the White Totem temporarily split his avatar. I will get this to our mages, who might be able to work the proper rituals of sympathetic magic to keep Grael's spirit sundered. You have done the realm of Dereth a great service, friend.
For defeating the Ruschk Aspect I grant you the fitting title of Champion of Daemal.
Also take this as a reward.
You do not wish such a trophy? Here take this.
quest: I'm sorry, you have already helped me, and all of Dereth, by sundering the White Totem. I thank you, but I need nothing more from you.
You've given me Garaktars Blood. In return, I've given you the White Gateway Token, haven't I? Please proceed to the White Temple Gateway with all haste.
I've already asked you to venture to 87.3 N, 48.8 W in the Halaetan Isles and bring me back the blood of the Ruschk chieftain known as Garaktar. Please hurry.

You may be able to help me... I would ask you to seek out a Ruschk chieftain named Garaktar. His blood has some unique properties, and may be of great use to us in our efforts to combat the demon known as Grael. If you are strong enough to fight the mightiest of Ruschk, venture to 87.3 N, 48.8 W in the Halaetan Isles, and bring me the blood of Garaktar.
Do you have the Shard of the White Totem? If so, please hand it to me.
You may actually be too powerful to help me! More to the point, your great talents can be more productively used by one of my counterparts. Kindly speak with Soju Bo-Ki of the Whispering Blade.

greetings: Well done. The essence of Hastar the Misbegotten is indeed helpful. It allows me to make this token, which will gain you entrance to the chambers of Grael's Black Totem. Simply give this Gateway Token to the Black Totem Gateway on the Singularity Caul, and a portal should open up for you. Once you have gained access to the Black Totem Temple, destroy the Black Totem, and that will help split Gr...

Excellent! This means that Grael's power has been dealt a serious blow! The shattering of the Black Totem temporarily split his avatar. I will get this to our mages, who might be able to work the proper rituals of sympathetic magic to keep Grael's spirit sundered. You have done the realm of Dereth a great service, friend.
I salute you as a true hero, friend. I thank you on behalf of Dereth and on behalf of the Whispering Blade for the great thing you have done.
Soju Bo-Ki grants you the title Hero of the Golden Flame.
Very well, if you do not desire this gem, I will take it in exchange for a bit of advancement...
quest: I'm sorry, you have already helped me, and all of Dereth, by sundering the Black Totem. I thank you, but I need nothing more from you.
You've given me Hastar's Essence. In return, I've given you the Black Gateway Token, haven't I? Please proceed to the Black Temple Gateway with all haste.
I've already asked you to venture to 92.9 S, 94.7 W in the Sigularity Caul and bring me back the essence of the Shadow lord known as Hastar the Misbegotten. Please hurry.

You may be able to help me... I would ask you to seek out a twisted Shadow lord named Hastar the Misbegotten. His essence has some unique properties, and may be of great use to us in our efforts to combat the demon known as Grael. If you are If you are strong enough to fight mighty Shadows, venture to 92.9 S, 94.7 W in the Singularity Caul, and bring me the essence of Hastar.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.
Do you have the Shard of the Black Totem? If so, please hand it to me.

You are actually too powerful to help me! More to the point, your great talents can be more productively used by one of my counterparts. Please speak with Hoshar ibn Jalaq of an, ahem, independent guild of adventurers.

greetings: I salute you as a true hero, friend. I thank you on behalf of Dereth and on behalf of my master for the great thing you have done.

Well done. The Ichor of Hastar the Misbegotten is indeed helpful. It allows me to make this token, which will gain you entrance to the chambers of Grael's Abyssal Totem. Simply give this Gateway Token to the Abyssal Totem Gateway on the Dark Isle, and a portal should open up for you. Once you have gained access to the Abyssal Totem Temple, destroy the Abyssal Totem, and that will help split Gra...

Excellent! This means that Grael's power has been dealt a serious blow! The shattering of the Abyssal Totem temporarily split his avatar. I will get this to our mages, who might be able to work the proper rituals of sympathetic magic to keep Grael's spirit sundered. You have done the realm of Dereth a great service, friend.
You do not want this? Very well have some experience instead.
quest: You must wait %tqt to assist Hoshar again.
I've already asked you to venture to 86.4 N, 57.4 E on the Dark Isle and bring me back the ichor of the Mukkir Progenitor.  Please hurry.

You may be able to help me... I would ask you to seek out a powerful Mukkir known only as the Progenitor.  Its ichor has some unique properties, and may be of great use to us in our efforts to combat the demon known as Grael.  If you are strong enough to fight mighty Mukkir, venture to 86.4 N, 57.4 E on the Dark Isle, and bring me the ichor of the Progenitor.
Sorry, you are not strong enough to help me.  Perhaps you should speak with my counterpart from the Rossu Morta, Lamorda Loschi.

greetings: An Armoredillo Pup, eh? Very well. Just remember, if he steals anything, it's on your head, not mine.
I am a trader in fine Armoredillo Eggs. These eggs are enchanted to allow you to call forth from inside a docile Armoredillo Pup, who will follow you in your travels.
Simply bring me a Baby Pet Token, and I will give you an Armoredillo Egg in return. If you seek a token, ask Larinne Kerendova, by the entrance to this humble shop.
A fine baby Drudge for a fine adventurer with impeccable taste. Here you go.
I train and sell well-mannered baby Drudges.
If you bring me a Baby Pet Token, and I will give you an Baby Drudge Crate in return. If you wish a token, ask Larinne Kerendova, who is over by the entrance.
A baby Thrungus, eh? Very well. Just remember, if he steals anything, it's on your head, not mine.
I trade in baby Thrungus, catering to those who like unusual and... creative Pet Shop Quest.
Simply bring me a Baby Pet Token, and I will give you a Baby Thrungus Crate. If you need a token, ask Larinne Kerendova, over by the door.
A Ursuin Cub, eh? Very well. Just remember, if he steals anything, it's on your head, not mine.
I train and sell Ursuin Cubs. Want one?
If you do, bring me a Baby Pet Token, and I'll give you one of my cubs. If you seek a token, ask Larinne Kerendova, over by the entrance to the shop.
Larinne glances at the letter and hands it back to you.
You should bring this to Uber P right away. He will want to see this as soon as possible!
Larinne reads the letter and starts to smile.
Please bring this to Mr. P in MacNiall's Freehold. It warms my heart to read such a happy ending.
No, no. I don't need these back. I have plenty. Give them to Mr. P.
You tell Larinne Kerendova about your interaction with May'ad ibn Ibsar, and tell her what was said.
Beautiful! With that shipment of enchanted sand, we'll be able to hatch another batch of Armoredillo Eggs.
You tell Larinne Kerendova about your interaction with Nen Ai, and tell her what she said.

Great! The Drudge Chow she makes is second to none! Her experience with raising and caring for Drudges is unmatched, and what she has learned of their care and training is what makes it possible to keep them as pets at all.
You tell Larinne Kerendova about your interaction with Renald the Eldest, and tell her what he said.
Thank you. With the toys Renald carves for me, we've been able to raise the Ursuin to be much more gentle than they would be normally.
You tell Larinne Kerendova about your interaction with Turien Di Furza, and tell her what he said.
Excellent. With that paperwork filed, I'll be able to get another shipment of baby Thrungus delivered.
Larinne eyes the pages with a surprised look on her face. Suddenly you notice a small tear roll down her cheek.
It has been so long since I have seen penguin writing. What a tragic tale this letter tells. Sometimes the best of intentions can lead to the saddest of conclusions.
Uber P is quite the eloquent writer, but I will try to summarize his words for you. Uber P had already lost a little brother named Mr. P to the warmth of the southern islands.

Penguins are extremely family-oriented don't you know, so when another younger sibling started showing a distaste for the cold weather Uber P feared he would lose yet another brother to the sandy beaches of the Vesayen islands.
He thought if he could just get Mouf to spend some time with fellow cold-lovers that he would take to his natural instincts and want to remain in the frozen north with his family.

So Uber P sent his little brother off to the Frigid Grotto, but sadly his plan backfired. Upon repeatedly hearing of Mouf's disdain for the cold, the Grotto's inhabitants refused to let little Mouf leave.
Larinne's eyes start to tear up.

Uber P realizes he made a mistake in trying to make Mouf's decisions for him. He only cares about little Mouf's happiness now. Damning him to a lifetime in the cold is something Uber P just can't live with.
Please go to this Frigid Grotto located at 97.1N, 51.8W and help free Mouf from his frozen prison.
Be warned though, the inhabitants of the Frigid Grotto are no pushovers. Expect heavy resistance from the creatures within.
Larinne sighs.
I bet a cute little penguin would just love to call a place like this home.
What's this? Ahh, Mr. P is looking for more penguin treats. Very well, here you go.
What? How do I know that? It says so right here, see?
Larinne Kerendova points at the paw-print, and then at the placement of the toes.
quest: This is the final response needed, thank you! Now, you've earned this token, so here you go.
Thanks for your help.
I am waiting for all four letters.
Hurry back with the responses from the others. Thanks again!
Welcome to my shop!

If you'd like a pet of your own, I can provide the token you will need to acquire one. Normally, I'd just sell these, but I'm in need of a bit of help, and I'm willing to waive payment in coin if you'll help me out.
I have four letters that I need delivered to certain people around Dereth. Normally I'd go to deliver these myself, but there is so much to do with the shop open now, that I don't have the time.
Take these letters, bring back word from the people they go to, and I'll give you a token you can trade for an adorable new pet.

The first letter goes to Renald the Eldest in Holtburg, the second to Nen Ai, along the road southwest of Shoushi, the third to May'ad ibn Ibsar in Yaraq, and the final one to Turien Di Furza in Sanamar.
Hurry, I'll need the answers as soon as possible. Those supplies are vital to the proper care and raising of these cute little Pet Shop Quest.
%n smiles.
Larinne Kerendova doesn't know what to do with that.

greetings: I see you didn't want to keep this, that's a shame

Belinda du Loc tells you, "I have enhanced this item using the essence of the creature that once wielded it, put it to good use. If you do not want it give it back and I will reward you alternatively.
I see you didn't want to keep this, that's a shame.
What have you done to this? Let me fix it for you...
There, good as new!
If you still do not want it give it back and I will reward you alternatively.
quest: We don't want to hunt these rare and extraordinary creatures to the point of extinction, talk to me again at a later date.
You must wait %tqt to hunt the banished creatures.
You have killed %tqc out of %tqm Banished Creatures.
Return to me when you have killed %tqm Banished Creatures and I shall reward you.
Excellent, you are now an experienced hunted of banished creatures. If you have any trophies from these creatures that you don't need I will accept them and reward you alternatively.
You have been given the title of Expert Banished Hunter
You must wait %tqt to hunt the Fallen creatures.
You have killed %tqc out of %tqm Fallen Creatures.
Return to me when you have killed %tqm Fallen Creatures and I shall reward you.
Excellent, you are now an experienced hunted of fallen creatures. If you have any trophies from these creatures you don't need I will accept them and reward you alternatively.
You have been given the title of Expert Fallen Hunter.
You must wait %tqt to hunt the Rare creatures.
You have killed %tqc out of %tqm Rare Creatures.
Return to me when you have killed %tqm Rare Creatures and I shall reward you.

Excellent, you are now an experienced hunter of the most elusive creatures. If you found anything on these creatures I can use my expertise and knowledge to bring out the essence of the creatures in the item and return to you an enhanced version.
You have been given the title of Elite Head Hunter.
I would like you to experience the hunting of the elusive banished creatures. Return to me when you have located and killed 10 of them.
Hello, I am Belinda a hunder of rare creatures. There's nothing like the hunt to let one know they are alive.
I would like you to experience the hunting of the elusive fallen creatures. Return to me when you have located and killed 10 of them.
I would like you to experience the hunting of some of this lands rarest and most elusive creatures.
Use that list as a reference. Kill 50 of the creatures in the "Rare Game" section of that list and I will reward you greatly.

greetings: These crystals have many alchemical uses. Ciandra has continued to research what allows these stones to tap into this worlds well of powerful magics.
Here, take this as a reward.
Very good, I can most certainly make use of this.
quest: Return to me when you have fought twenty-five of these creatures.
Zahir listens to all that you have to tell him about your encounters with the elementals.
Very interesting, I hope I can use this information to further my research.
Oh, did you by any chance find anything in your adventures? I could certainly use materials that come directly from these elementals.
You have been given the title Elemental Eradicator.
I have recently rewarded you for your assistance, don't get greedy. Research grants don't grow on trees you know. Come back later when I'll be able to reward you again.
Hello, you look like the very kind of person who would be able to assist me in my research.

After the events with the Harbinger and the Essences interest in elementals has gone up considerably and thanks to that I have been able to secure grants that I can use to fund my research... but you don't care to hear much more about that, do you?

Okay, here is what I'd like of you, Please venture out and find Caustic, Synnast, Inferno, and Hyem. Fight twenty-five of these creatures and then return to me and tell me everything you learned about them.
I will also accept, and reward you for, anything you find that may be of value to my research.

You have killed many Tusker Guards and have advanced in your skills. Part of our training is knowing when to stop and reflect on what you have done. Come back to me later, after you have thought much on your experiences with the Tusker Guards.
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.
Excellent, now go contemplate what you have learned from fighting the Tusker Guards. You may be able to apply these pratices in various different types of combat with a great variety of creatures.
You have been given the title Tusker Blight.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Tusker Guards.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Tusker Guards and I will reward you.
Greetings, have you come to train?
There is much you can learn from fighting any opponent. I have specialized in the fighting of Tusker Guards and have learned many, if not all of their weaknesses.
If you wish to do the same you must first go out and experience combat with these creatures. Return to me after you have killed 500 Tusker Guards and I will reward you.
Excellent work, friend! You have slain many of the cunning beasts! Allow me to reward you!
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.
So, you wish to prove your hunting prowess? Well then. Track down and slay %tqm of the cunning Kilif Zefir for me, and I will reward you appropriately.
I see you haven't completed your task. Return to me when you've killed %tqm Kilif Zefirs.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Kilif Zefirs.

Good, those cows will be set for a while, you can take a break. I expect you to report back here tomorrow to continue though, we can't let down our guard. Even better, search out cows around the world and tip them. They must all be stopped.
You are Obviously Bored, maybe you should check your titles.
Don't tell them I gave that to you, you don't want to see them when they get very mad.
We're almost there, I can sense it. The cow brain waves have been interupted. I know you can sense it also.
Don't stop tipping now, you've tipped 200 or so by my count. Have you got your tippin' calluses yet? Those are a sign of distinction my friend.
Which sounds to you more like "Could I have another piece of pie please?"
Moo Mo mooo moooooo moooo mo moo mooooo?
Ahem, or... Moo Mo  mooo mooooo mooo moo mo moooo?

They've been herding at night again. They can't fool me though. No one can sleep standing up! I can see their lips moving in cow whispers. I can hear the whispers late at night. They're up to something! You tip those cows. Give those treacherous bovine a good shove for me!
Mooooooooooo!!!! Mooo! Mo.
I'm practicing my cow speak. Now if only I could lose this darn accent.
You should return to the field. I've never met a more formidable tipper. You shall be a hero of the people when the Cow Insurgence is stopped!
Huh!? What's that!
Oh... my... goodness. The cows must have had control of my brain, I didn't even know you were there.
They're in my head, get them out. Get them out! Tip more cows!
Good, good, our plans are working, they're being distracted. We've bought some time but you need to buy us more time. We need more time!
Go, go tip the cows, they must be stopped!

You've seen them lingering around town, haven't you? They've been here all along, you know that, don't you? They have spies all over the place. They see and hear everything. They must be stopped, and stopped the only way we know how. Simply killing them isn't good enough, we need to tip them and tip them often. Go, go tip the cows, they must be stopped!

greetings: Excellent. This is the final ingredient I require. I can now construct for you a new gem setting to add to your Silifi of the Crimson Stars. As I said, it will imbue your Silifi, with whatever combination of jewels you currently have, with the power of Critical Strike and Lightning Cleaving. However, this new gem setting can only be applied to a Silifi that already has three gems attached to it...
If your are not an axe wielder and do not want this item, while I have to wonder why you bothered to speak with me, then I will take back the gem setting in exchange for some practical knowledge.
A pity you have no use for this... Then again, we can't all be strong enough to wield such a mighty axe. Perhaps some practical knowledge will serve you better.
quest: I've already given you an infusion to improve your Silifi of the Crimson Stars, I believe.
You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.
I can see the light of the ruby shining out of your pack. Please hand it over.

I've received the Shadow Fragment and the Plate Armoredillo Spine from you... But what of the ruby? I asked you to take Darayavaush's ruby. That old undead lords over a crypt located at 12.3 N, 8.2 E. Go there and take his ruby.

Yes, you've given me the Plate Armoredillo Spine... I asked you to assemble a Shadow Fragment for me, didn't I? Hunt those terrible blights upon creation until you have collected enough material to combine into a Shadow Fragment. Once you give me the Fragment, we can discuss final steps to improving your Silifi.
Have you found a Plate Armoredillo Spine yet? I cannot help you until you've brought me one of those.

Excellent. This Shadow Fragment will help me repair the setting on the axe... But in the meantime, you need to seek out the final ingredient... There is a crypt not too far from here, ruled by a terrible undead lord named Darayavaush. In life he was a great king, but in undeath he is a terrible tyrant. Go and destroy Darayavaush, and bring me the ruby he carries. It is his ruby that will provid...

Do you wield the Silifi of Crimson Stars? Would you like to wield a Silifi like mine? If so, I can help you improve the weapon, to add the Critical Strike ability and Lightning Cleaving properties to it... Yes, I have a way of repairing one of the damaged jewel settings. But my method demands a very particular ruby... Never mind that for now. If you wish to start on the path to improving your S...

Yes, this will do. I need this to reinforce the blade, which will break under the power of the enchantments I plan to - but that is not important right now. The next step is for you to bring me a Shadow Fragment. Yes, you must slay Shadows, those blots of corruption. Collect enough of their shards until you have combined them into a Shadow Fragment. We can go no further until you bring me that.
I don't think you're strong enough to bother with.  Come back when you are tougher.

greetings: My family smiles from the far-beyond place. Thank you.

It has been told to me that the Tanada clan of the Nanjou Shou-jen have come through the portals from Ispar to Dereth! I bear a great grudge against them - my clan on Ispar was slain by them, leaving me with only a sister left alive. I desire revenge against them.

I understand they hone their skills in the Egg Orchard, the Dark Design, the Path of the Blind, the Feeding Tubes, and the Forgotten Chasm now. Seek them there and slay them for me. Each bears upon themselves a golden shuriken bestowed upon them by their clan leader. If you give me sixteen of these shuriken to prove that you have slain many of their number, I shall give you a replica of the gea...
Ahh, the Ice Totem. Thank you. My comrades will be much pleased to have one of these to study. Please, allow me to reward you for your efforts.
Also, if you have the time to hunt more Ruschk, speak with me again, and I can set you another task or two.
quest: You look like you've been busy. Have you completed the tasks I set before you?
Well, it looks like you've killed all of the Ruschk I set you to, they seem all stirred up like you poked a hornet's nest with a stick. Have you had any luck getting the Ice Totem from 95.5N, 42.3W?
Greetings. If you have the time, I have a set of tasks you could aid me with. I'm here to help thin out the number of Ruschk in the valley below, and to gain one of their Totems for further study.

If you were to kill, say... 30 of the Ruschk in the valley, and then acquire one of their smaller Ice Totems from the encampment at 95.5N, 42.3W, I'd be more than happy to reward you for your efforts.
I'd kill the Ruschk first. That should throw them into enough disarray that you should be able to grab the Totem unnoticed.

greetings: Thank you.
With this Totem out of their hands, we can keep them from amassing the power to possibly disrupt our separation of Grael into containable Aspects.
Please, allow me to reward you for your efforts.
Arialle du Bellenesse awards you the title of "Squire of New Viamont."
quest: Greetings, noble Squire. I have not seen any sign that the Grael-worshipping Ruschk abominations have successfully created another Totem. From previous experience, it takes them about a day. Return later. If they've successfully created a new totem, I'll have work for you again.
Have you managed to retrieve the Totem?

Greetings. If you have the time, I have a mission that you may be interested in. To the northwest, at 95.5N, 51.8W , there is a Temple to that accursed Grael. Inside, the Ruschk seem to have created a Totem capable of empowering Grael himself.

This Totem cannot be allowed to stay in their possession. They could possibly even use such a thing to overcome the splitting of Grael into Aspects, and we'd have to battle a fully empowered Grael, all over again.
Retrieve this Totem for me, so we can seek a way to prevent these from aiding Grael, as well as removing it from their possession, and I will reward you for your efforts.
Do you have the Totem? Please hand it to me.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.

greetings: I believe I can truly make something special out of this. Here, take this, and wear it with pride!
Wow I think I out did myself on this one. Maybe I should take a break ...
Excellent. Let me have a moment or two to craft the pieces needed to complete this mask. There! A little touch here and there, and it's finished.
The Stag of Bellenesse. Wear it with pride. And remember to tell people where you had it crafted!
Excellent! Give me a moment here ...
Ahhh. This material is exquisite. With such beautiful materials at my disposal, I shall create for you a most honored Regalia, the Royal Bull of Sanamar!
Wearing this Regalia is sanctioned by King Varicci II, and is considered a showing of respect to his Royal Line. Enjoy!
There! It's finished.

I am honored to even hold a mask of such power and grace as this one. From this, the most beautiful things can be created. From such a noble and potent base material, I will, instead of making a heraldic creature, will forge this mask in the very image of Karlun himself!
Here you go, Karlun's Visage. A most noble and honorable Regalia.

Greetings, I am Trilaine di Ricard. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance. If you bring me the complete mask from one of those strange and gifted creatures, the Virindi, I can forge for you a piece of Regalia worthy of the ancient Viamont Heroes of lore!
