If you seek one of the more common masks or costumes, tied to the Bloodless festivities, I'm afraid you will need to seek out one of their crafters. Such creations are frowned on in Sanamar, so I have not practiced the art of their creation.
After some discussion with the Bloodless Mask Makers, I have mastered the ability to turn Virindi Desecrator Masks into my latest Regalia Creation.
All you need to do is use this gem to learn Asheron's gift.
Take this, and use it wisely.
I've had the opportunity to study with those who have studied with Asheron himself - and I have decided that Asheron's gift should be available to all those who can master its power.
You may speak to the Fiun who calls itself Rehlyun in order to find out how to get a blank augmentation gem.
quest: You have already received Asheron's gift.
All you need to do is use this gem to learn Asheron's gift.
You do not have the experience to receive Asheron's gift.
Let me know if you change your mind.

greetings: Well done. This confirms some of my fears. I cannot tell you very much now, as I feel that most of what I know will be lost on you.
But here, I should reward you... I will give you some gems that I think you will find useful... And a book, to help you learn something of the nature of the Tanada clan and their deadly mission.
If you do not find these Gems of Balance to be useful, you can return them to me for practical knowledge.
Sayuji Jina looks at you speculatiely.
If you would aid me again in dealing with this matter, speak to me again.
You do not want this? A pity. Very well, I will simply grant you practical knowledge instead...
Sayuji Jina reads the letter from Ookami Kiri, a barely noticeable smile forming on her face as she does so.

Ookami Kiri speaks well of your aid to both her and my Mistress. For this I thank you, and would like to reward you once again. My Mistress has entrusted me to give this gift to those who have aided her in this matter directly. I think you've earned it.
If such a blade is not useful to you, you may return it to me for more practical knowledge.
Very well. It is a pity that you do not wish to keep it, but not all have use for blades, so I understand. I hope this practical knowledge is more useful to you.
quest: You've already aided me once, for which I thank you. I would ask you to aid me a second time.
Sayuji Jina writes out a note, and then places the Enlightened Master's Medallion into the letter and seals it.
Take this missive to Ookami Kiri, in Yanshi. She may have additional work for you, once she reads this.

Ah yes, I remember your excellent work in the past on this ongoing Tanada investigation. I would ask you to tangle again with those renegade Nanjou Shou-Jen... My colleague Meshenq in Zaikhal had a run-in with some Tanada while he was exploring the southern land bridge. Please go to Zaikhal and see if there is some way you can help him.
You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.
Have you any word from Ookami Kiri?
Please return to me later.

I've asked you to journey into the southern mountains and seek out the Tanada training school at 68 S, 45 E. As far as I can tell, you have not proven yourself to any of the shrines, let alone confronted the Enlightened Master, so I have to ask why you are here. Please, go to the Tanada House of Air and take the Enlightened Master's jade medallion. I need to inspect that medallion. It will shed...
You have brought Kiri-san and I 25 of these medallions now. Your aid in this requires a special reward. Here, allow me to reward you appropriately.
Sayuji Jina grants you the title, "Initiate of the Blade".
If you find any more of these, please bring them to either Ookami Kiri, or myself. Your assistance in this is greatly appreciated.

You may be able to help me... I seek knowledge of the Tanada clan of the Nanjou Shou-Jen. Their appearance in this land could bode great ill, even for the Sho people whom they are supposedly pledged to protect. I would have you seek out their training school in the southern mountains of Osteth.

If this school is like the schools they maintained on Ispar, you will have to defeat the Master of each school - Storms, Wind, and Breath - and prove your worthiness to three shrines, before being allowed to see the Enlightened Master of the school. The Enlightened Master should be carrying a jade medallion which I would very much like to see. You will have to take it from him by force. If you...

A medallion from one of the elusive Tanada Clan? This may aid in my research into their appearance in Dereth. I will gladly reward you for any of these that you come across. Here, allow me to reward you for this one.
You are not strong enough to help me.  I mean no offense.  I would not want to send you forth to a hopeless task.

Thank you for this. I should be able to add this to my research into the Tanada Clan, and hopefully come up with a method to free the Tanada from their corruption. Here, allow me to reward you once again.

greetings: I can't do anything with this. The cuneiform is certainly of the Falatacot script, but I haven't learned to read that yet. Please get it translated for me. I believe Fanzen San, the translator based near Hebian-To, would know what to make of this.
Oh my. Just as we feared. I will have to report back to the Queen with this dreadful news. Thank you for your help.
quest: You've found the Soul Hunter's Orders and brought them to me. This is all I can ask of you at the moment. I thank you for your service.

I've asked you to find the Soul Hunter's Lair and bring me back whatever information you can. Remember, I asked you to search in the area of 28 S, 56 E. Please, go. I think something very important is happening there...

I would ask of you a favor, friend. I have received information that the one who protects us all is in some mortal peril himself. I'd rather not say more now. I'd just ask that you head into Blackmire Swamp and see if there is any strange Falatacot-related activity in the vicinity of 28 S, 56 E. Please go there, seek out a being called the Soul Hunter, and bring me back anything you find.
You have the Soul Hunter's Translated Orders? Please, give it to me. The noble lady whom I serve would be most curious to see them...
Please return to me when you are stronger.

greetings: Ookami Kiri takes the note with a polite bow, and then reads over it quickly.

It seems, looking at this medallion, that Sayuji Jina-san's fears have born fruit. My Mistress feared that this may have been the case, and has left me with a course of action, which I will now pass on to you.

There is an Enlightened Master of the Tanada Clan, one who came to Dereth in the beginnings of the Portals appearing in Sho lands. My Mistress has left me with a message to send to him, to seek his aid should Jina-san's fears prove true. If this corruption upon the Tanada Clan of the Nanjou Shou-Jen be a recent one, which it does seem to be, then he may be free of it still.

Take this letter to the Tanada training school, hidden at 66.3N, 7.6E, and deliver it to Master Seijuro. Be warned, however, that the students of this school will not take kindly to your arrival, and you will need to prove your worth to meet Master Seijuro, much as you did in gaining this medallion for Jina-san.
Ookami Kiri examines the medallion intently, while you tell her of your encounter with Master Seijuro.
This is the response Master Seijuro has sent? Very well, I will get it to my Mistress with all haste. Thank you for your assistance in this. It is greatly appreciated.
Here, take this letter to Sayuji Jina, in Shoushi. I believe she has a reward for you, for all that you have done to aid us.
Greetings.
quest: You have brought Jina-san and I 25 of these medallions now. Your aid in this requires a special reward. Here, allow me to reward you appropriately.
Ookami Kiri grants you the title, "Initiate of the Blade".
If you find any more of these, please bring them to either Sayuji Jina, or myself. Your assistance in this is greatly appreciated.

A medallion from one of the elusive Tanada Clan? This may aid in my research into their appearance in Dereth. I will gladly reward you for any of these that you come across. Here, allow me to reward you for this one.

Thank you for this. I should be able to add this to my research into the Tanada Clan, and hopefully come up with a method to free the Tanada from their corruption. Here, allow me to reward you once again.

greetings: At last! The item we seek!
Shan Zhen looks closely at the book.
Yet I fear that it doesn't have any new information. Still, you've done as I asked, so I shall assist you.
Shan Zhen touches your forehead and mutters a few words.
Now it will be possible to pass through Prince Borelean's portal to Bur. You have my thanks, Queen Elysa's thanks, and the thanks of my mistress, whom I should not name.
quest: I asked you to seek out the Portal Servitor Golem at 67.4 N, 30.5 E. Have you done so? If the Portal Servitor makes a strange request of you, come back to me and I may be able to help you... I am well studied in the ways of Asheron.
So now, the Portal Servitor seeks a goblet of the House of Realaidain? I think I have a note that would help this search...
The Portal Servitor demands a ring of the House of Realaidain? Fair enough, I believe I have a piece of information that would illuminate your search...

Ah, you've made contact with the Portal Servitor? Excellent. But it demands some kind of family heirloom of Asheron's? A necklace that once belonged to House Realaidain? I half-expected some kind of test like this. Here, this note may illuminate your search for such a necklace...
You have completed this task too recently.
AsheronsDepartureJournal@You must wait %CDtime to complete this task again.

I need to ask your help, and you may possibly even need my help. We still seek much information about Asheron before he left Dereth. The Portal Servitor Golem that kept track of Asheron's last movements prior to his departure to Bur still maintains a very tight security and refuses to divulge its master's secrets! Please travel to the Empyrean temple at 67.4N 30.5E and see if you can get the Go...
Please return to me once you are stronger.

greetings: I can't make much sense of this. Please give it to Diyas al-Yat here in Zaikhal. He should be able to translate it. Please just give me his translation.

A house of the Tanada has been corrupted by the chaos Virindi? Terrible news! I have much to report to my colleagues who share this task of investigating the Tanada... In the meanwhile, I thank you for your excellent service.
I'll also give you a copy of this translation, for your own edification...
A letter for me?
Meshenq reads over the letter.
Where did you get this?
You explain that you found the letter on the corpse of a Tanada from the House of Water, and that the corpse was in the Black Death Catacombs.
First Chaos Virindi, and now this? I'll send this along with what you've told me. In the meanwhile, I thank you for your excellent service.
quest: Ah, you've already helped me with my incident in the wilds, have you not? I am confident that you brought justice to those Tanada and whoever is directing them. I thank you again, but there is nothing more I would ask of you now.
Any luck in the investigation of the Tanada? Make your way West of my camp at 85.2 S, 4.4 W and bring back any evidence you find.
Ah! Sayuji Jina told me of you! You helped her investigate the Tanada houses of Earth and Air, did you not? Excellent! I need your help now.

I was exploring the southern land bridge when I was attacked by a pair of Tanada! But these were strange Tanada, not like the descriptions I've heard from Jina. They killed me and sent me back to my lifestone here in Zaikhal, but before I died I was able to tear this medallion off one of them...

My camp was at 85.2 S, 4.4 W, and I think they came from the west. I would advise you to search the area and see if you can locate some trace of the Tanada presence... Please bring me back any evidence you might turn up of what has brought the Tanada to that area.
I'm sorry, I don't know you at all, and unless you were sent to speak with me by my friend Sayuji Jina of Shoushi, I don't have much to say to you.
Also, take a copy of this letter for yourself. It may prove useful information to have.
This may be related to the Olthoi activity being investigated at 43.8N, 54.9E. If you're curious, it may be worth a look for yourself.

Ah, so you found some kind of black crystal shard on a Virindi that was hiding among the Tanada? Fascinating. I hadn't counted on Virindi involvement, and they are quite beyond my realm of expertise. I think you should give it to Diyas al-Yat here in Zaikhal. He's able to translate those strange artifacts... Please bring me the translation that he gives you.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.

greetings: Don't feed the Drudges, it just emboldens them.
Those thieving drudges!
Keep an eye on your backpack at all times. The Drudges have been stealing anything not nailed down recently.
Why, yes - this does look like some of the food lately stolen from Cragstone. Will those pesky drudges stop at nothing?
At least you stopped them. Good work.
Ah, this is from that pyro-maniacal Drudge. I never did buy him as the leader of the raids.
Still, I'm glad you were able to defeat him. I'm so tired of trying to put out all the fires he keeps starting.
I hereby name you a "Cragstone Firefighter."
Ah one of BoneCrunch's treasures?
Thank you, here is a small reward for your help.
Ah one of BoneCrunch's treasures? Let's see what he does without his hammer.
Oh boy, this can't be good. What do the Drudges want with pieces of the Spire? Maybe they just think of it as building stone... maybe.
I need to inform the Council about this. Here, take this bit of knowledge I've gleaned as a merchant here in Cragstone. Thank you for your help.
quest: You should wait %tqt before attacking the Drudge fort again. We need to make sure they won't retaliate against Cragstone.
Ah, I see you bested the Drudge leader, Bonecrunch, again. Well done! His sudden rise to power still worries me though.

The Royal Council is investigating the various creature uprisings in Dereth. It seems that the Mosswarts and Banderling have also been acting a bit odd lately. These are troubling times. I am glad that we have brave souls like you to protect our people.
You have killed enough Drudge Lurkers for now.
Come see me when you have killed all 100 Drudge Lurkers.
You killed 100 Drudge Lurkers!
You did it! That should keep those Drudge Lurkers out of our town for awhile.
For your help in fighting the Drudge menace I grant you the wisdom of the Town Elders of Cragstone and the title "Drudge Doom."
You have killed enough Drudge Stalkers for now.
Come see me when you have killed 100 Drudge Stalkers.
You killed 100 Drudge Stalkers!
Well done! Finding one hundred of the nasty Drudge Stalkers is no easy task and eliminating them is even less so.
For your help in fighting the Drudge menace I grant you the wisdom of the Town Elders of Cragstone and the title "Stalker Stalker."
You have killed enough Drudge Raveners for now.
Come see me when you have killed 50 Drudge Raveners.
You killed 50 Drudge Raveners!
Very impressive. I must admit, you actually frighten me a bit with your bloodthirsty hunting skills.
For your help in fighting the Drudge menace I grant you the wisdom of the Town Elders of Cragstone and the title "Ravenous."
You have killed enough Drudge Altereds for now.
Come see me when you have killed 40 Drudge Altereds.
You killed 40 Altered Drudges!
Well Done! Drudges will never overtake Cragstone with noble protectors like yourself at hand!
For your help in fighting the Drudge menace I grant you the wisdom of the Town Elders of Cragstone and the title "Altered Hunter."
You have killed enough Augmented Drudges for now.
Come see me when you have killed 40 Augmented Drudges.
You killed 40 Augmented Drudges!
Congratulations! Cragstone owes you a debt of gratitude my friend.
For your help in fighting the Drudge menace I grant you the wisdom of the Town Elders of Cragstone and the title "Augmented Hunter."
This is the weapon that Drudge you called Burnja was wielding? Not very sophisticated is it?
I'm sure I can find someone who will buy this. Here have some of my writings on economics in a Post-Magical Revolutionary society.
You must wait %tqt before turning any more scraps in.
You have already handed me this piece.
Jarvis Hammerstone gives you the Title "Cragstone Militia".

Yes, this is their "Plan." It hasn't changed much since I first saw it. See here? This already happened. That fellow in red burning the windmill, that would be Burnja. We drove off that psychotic little pyromaniac before he could burn the windmill. And we now know that they've built the fort shown here west of town. They used all the things they stole from us to build it.

The only thing I don't know is who this drudge floating over the fort is. The council sent me a lengthy letter from Aliester the Loquacious theorizing that the Drudge depicted there is some sort of magic wielding warlord. I prefer getting more substantial information before I jump to any conclusions though. Let me know if you find out anything else.
Now, for your service to our town I hereby make you a member of the Cragstone Militia, with the knowledge due a militia member.

So, this BoneCrunch was behind the "Plan." From what you told me about him I think we can assume he is the Drudge depicted shining above the Drudge Fort. Where did he get all of this power? I mean, some of the Drudges that the Virindi modified are able to wield magic and fight impressively, but nothing like what this BoneCrunch can do. And he's organized the Drudges...
I'll need to pass this along to our Queen and council. Please wait awhile before attacking the fort again. I wouldn't want the Drudges getting it into their heads to attack Cragstone again.
We've driven those theiving Drudges back to their fort! but I'm worried they're still planning something...
Jarvis lowers his voice to a whisper.
Alot of help those Royal Guard were, just standing around and sending messages back and forth!
The Healer, Avalenne, says she can see Drudges patrolling their fort west of town.
The Cragstone Elders have charged me with the task of getting rid of the drudges and I will reward you well if you can discover what they're doing in that fort of theirs.
The Drudge raids have lessened since you brave souls have started defending the town.
I don't know what good the Royal Guard are, just standing around and making plans! They say the defense of Cragstone isn't under their charter. Pshaa! They can stuff there rules!

The Healer, Avalenne, says she can see the Drudges building some sort of fortification to the West of town. Looks like they're still following that "Plan" of theirs that we uncovered. After all the trouble they caused recently, I don't relish the idea of having those thieving parasites as neighbors.
In the meantime I need to rid the surrounding area of some of these Drudges. There seem to be more every day. Take this and come back to me when you have completed any of the tasks listed.
Kill 100 Drudge Lurkers and I will reward you.
Kill 100 Drudge Stalkers and I will reward you.
Kill 50 Drudge Raveners and I will reward you.
Kill 40 Drudge Altereds and I will reward you.
Kill 40 Augmented Drudges and I will reward you.
Collect more unique scraps so we can figure out their plan.

This is one of BoneCrunch's treasures? It looks like some of the other Drudge Charms I've seen, but it's obviously more powerful. I'll have Suya the Jeweler take a look at it. Thank you, here is a small reward for your help."
You can't cheat the system!
For your continued bravery and service to Cragstone I grant you the wisdom of the Town Elders of Cragstone and the title "Cragstone Knight."
For your continued bravery and service to Cragstone I grant you the wisdom of the Town Elders of Cragstone and the title "Guardian of Cragstone."
Please return to me later I may need more assistance.

You fought valiantly against the Falatacot that imprisoned Asheron on Bur, didn't you? I have seen council reports on your bravery. I commend you for your past service, and I would ask for your assistance once more in a very sensitive matter of utmost importance to the realm. Some of us have reason to believe that Lord Kresovus, the leader of our Lugian allies, is... not what he seems.
Please venture to the Lugian stronghold of Linvak Tukal and discreetly investigate Lord Kresovus' quarters. It could be that there is some evidence there of what has happened to him.
Have you delivered the Royal Summons to the Lord Kresovus imposter?

Be sure that you have him alone before you attack. We wouldn't want the Lugians of Linvak Tukal believing we were trying to assassinate their Leader. I believe once the imposter is dead we can prove to the Lugians their Leader has been missing since the attacks on Linvak Tukal began.

I've asked you to discreetly investigate Lord Kresovus' room in Linvak Tukal.  Please complete your investigation as soon as possible and bring me anything that can shed some light on the mystery surrounding our troubled Lugian ally.
Thank you for bringing this to me... Though you seem a little familiar...

You do seem like a mighty warrior, but can I trust you? If you can earn my trust by defeating the plans of the Falatacot witches that once imprisoned Asheron on Bur, I'll be more inclined to trust you with a very sensitive mission...

This is exactly the sort of thing I was looking for. I think the presence of the Virindi confirms our suspicions that the Lord Kresovus who resides now in Linvak Tukal is an impostor! But please, keep this discreet. I cannot even share with you what we translate from this shard. Some secrets are too sensitive. But I thank you for your loyal and courageous service.
You might also find this useful, since you've been to Bur... A scroll to help you recall to that mysterious and intriguing world.
You found that a Virindi was somehow connected to Lord Kresovus?  This goes a long way to confirming our suspicions.
I see that you found a message shard on the Virindi as well. May I?
Very well.
I'm sorry, I don't think you're strong enough to help me.
I may have another mission for you, should you choose to accept it.
You've investigated the matter of the Lord Kresovus impostor to my satisfaction.
I have another mission for you that may prove far more dangerous, but your people need you.
Deliver this Royal Summons to Kresovus. He will have to accompany you if he wishes to keep his cover. When you and the imposter are away from Linvak and alone you must dispose of him.

greetings: What is this? Some sort of odd crystal? Ahh, I've heard of these. The Virindi use these much as we use letters.
Go, get this translated, and bring it back to me. I do not have the time to deal with such things.
quest: Please return to me later, I may need more assistance.
Have you found anything useful?

Ahh, the translation. Thank you for this. I will forward this on to my superiors, and those to whom I am aiding in this investigation. Here, take a copy of this for yourself, and also, the reward I've promised you.

Greetings. Your name is on the list of people Guard Winterborn has given me. It seems you were helpful to him in his investigations. My King has graciously lent my skills to the... Queen, Elysa, for further investigation into this mutual threat.

Guard Winterborn has been telling me of this 'Harraag' and his apparently massive increase in power over that of his kin. He has also told me of the findings brought by those, such as yourself. These shards, filled with the power of both the Virindi and the Shadows.

Given what information Guard Winterborn could provide, I was able to locate a Cave, off to the north of the Banderling-creature, where a large gathering of 'Chaos-Virindi' have gathered, and seem to be monitoring the Banderling-creature's present predicament.
My job for you is simply this: Go to that cave, located at 58.6S, 81.5W and bring me back any information that you find. Do this for me, and you will be well rewarded.
Hmmm... You could be useful to the investigation I am aiding with. Go speak with Guard Winterborn. If he deems your help valuable, I may have a job for you.
Ennio di Cinghalle awards you the title, "Royal Investigator".

greetings: You don't need to give me the materials. Just inform me what the plans are.
I think we can find a soldier to equip this with. Thank you for the contribution.
quest: Thanks for your help with the Mosswarts. I think we can handle the situation for now.
You explain in detail how Researcher Tharin interpreted the Mosswart plans, and then mention the Mosswart shaman you freed and his intentions.
Well done, adventurer! We appreciate what you've done to help protect Kryst from the Mosswart threat.
You present the transcribed papers you gathered to the sergeant.
Can you read these? I can't. Without being able to make out what they say, they're not much use to me.
The sergeant pauses for a moment to ponder, then speaks again.
I've heard that there might be someone in MacNiall's ragtag village who is doing research on the Mosswarts. Maybe you should bring this note there and see what he thinks of it?
Do you need a reminder of what we need? Alright.
The Mosswarts presumably have plans to take Kryst at some point. We need to interrupt their plans somehow, and the best way to do this would to know what exactly their plans are.
While you're at it, we've also heard that not all Mosswarts are working along with Bragara. It would help our cause if someone freed some of those Mosswarts to encourage unrest among the enemy.

Welcome back. We believe that the Mosswarts have devised a new plan, and if you could retrieve the information for us it, and free another shaman along the way as well, that would be very appreciated.
Friend, welcome to our lines. I am Sergeant Brigitta, second in command of the defense here. We're managing to keep Kryst safe, but there are things you could do to help us against the Mosswarts.
The Mosswarts are led by a being named Bragara. However, we are not concerned for him so much as we are concerned about the movements of his forces.
Go to the caverns under the Mosswart Holding and bring us the plans for his attack, and we will be better able to stop their advance.

Also, there are shamans who did not agree with Bragara's claim of godhood among the Mosswarts. We have it on good authority that some shamans have been imprisoned in the very same caverns that the plans are located in. While you are in there, please free a shaman. It will help the Mosswarts be able to muster a resistance against Bragara, which will in turn make our jobs easier.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.

greetings: Here's a more in-depth translation of what you took, for your own records. I doubt that your Sergeant Brigitta will need any of this information - this is for your own purposes.
From the translation job that Tharin did, however, you do feel like you understand the Mosswart plans better, and are now prepared to report them to Sergeant Brigitta.
quest: You introduce yourself to the researcher, and briefly summarize the contents of the plans you read in the Mosswart Holding
Yes, these Mosswart do seem to utilize a strange cipher - unusual even for Mosswarts. Luckily for you, I've figured out what they mean by some of these keywords...
Researcher Tharin spends a moment explaining the most recent scheme of the Mosswarts - enough for you to report back to Sergeant Brigitta.

Greetings. I know it seems unusual for one such as myself to be among the sorts of folk who live in the Freehold, but this is the best place for me to observe the activities of these new Mosswarts.  Plus, it doesn't hurt that they realize that I'm comparatively poor and not worth their time to rob.
Return to me when you have fought fourty of these creatures.
Well done, warrior. You have slain all the Mosswarts that I requested of you.
You have been granted the title Defender of Kryst
Some warriors have helped drive the Mosswarts back for now.  Still, they remain out there in the jungle - tread carefully.
Hail, warrior. Have you come to help the defense of Kryst? The sheer number of Mosswarts in the jungle and assaulting the town are overwhelming us.
I have a specific way that you might help. We need warriors who are willing to strike a blow at the heart of the Mosswart holding.
Slay forty of the Mosswart Townsfolk who live in the Mosswart holding, then return back to me.  Good luck, warrior.

greetings: It always amazes me how something so delicate and beautiful can also be so deadly.
Take this to Kleeoh. She'll know what to do with it.
Yes, this looks perfect.

Jilna places the white petals of the flower into a mortar and sprinkles a number of dried herbs over it. She then uses her pestle to grind the ingredients together and adds the resulting powder to a potion of blue liquid. The potion fizzes and its blue color swirls to a pearlescent white.
Excellent, take this potion to Oolutanga and see that he drinks the whole thing.
A huge smile spreads across Jilna's face and she jumps in enthusiasm.
Well done! That horrible mockery of Oolutanga makes me ill. I shudder to think of it out there somewhere in the dark.
Oolutanga has asked me to award you this Title.
Attention everyone! Ok ooo Aoo ook!
Let it be known that %tn shall henceforth be known as the Prodigal Tusker Slayer. Oook Ooo, %tn, Oooo a okoo, o ok-oo Ook Ooo ok.
I think I'm going to be sick.
Jilna looks momentarily green.

How can Mudmouth call himself a Tusker and make helmets from the skulls of his own people? Is have my doubts if that evil paw licker is even a true Tusker. Thank you for bringing this to me for destruction.
In payment to your service to the Tusker King I am honored to give you this.
Jilna hits you over the head with a rock and smiles with pride. You feel a flood of awareness spread from the lump she made.
Goodness! Is this tusker bone? Does that foul tusker Mudmouth have any conscience?
Yes, better this be destroyed by me than allow it to trade hands.
Oh, I see that Mudmouth decorated this wand with one of those horrid little tusker paws.
Well, I'll be glad to see the last of these.

Now that King Oolutanga is free of Mudmouth's hold I can treat him for the Jungle Orchid poison Mudmouth gave him. It's amazing he survived really. That much poison would have killed any normal Tusker. To create more of the potion he needs I'll need more King's Crown.
You can find the King's Crown water lily at the base of a giant tree overlooking the Chapel of Xi Ru on the last of the Vesayen Islands. Be careful, I hear it is protected by Moarsmen.
Oh, if you are able to find and destroy Mudmouth, I have been honored by Oolutanga to reward you in exchange for any befouled treasures he may have wrought.

quest: We haven't been able to stop them completely, but your efforts should help keep the lands safe for a time.  Come back in about tomorrow, and I should have more for you to hunt.

You've done it!  That should help thin their numbers for a while.  We haven't been able to stop them completely, but your efforts should help keep the lands safe for a time.  Come back in about tomorrow, and I should have more for you to hunt.
Your hunt is coming along nicely!  Keep hunting!
Greetings to you. I'm glad you've come up this way. If you're willing to aid us against these strange new Olthoi, I could set you to a task that you may find enlightening.

Go out to the places where these new grubs have been appearing, and kill them before they grow into something far worse. Kill, let's say, 50 of these Paradox-touched Grubs, and I'll reward you for your aid in this. They seem to be most concentrated in the nearby valley, but I've seen signs of them all over 'Olthoi North'.
You have done well. I offer my thanks to you, and humbly ask that you return in a day, to help keep their numbers down.

You have done well. With the losses you have inflicted upon their young, it should slow their expansion considerably. I offer my thanks to you, and humbly ask that you return in a day, to help keep their numbers down.
I sense that your hunt progresses well.  Please, continue.  Return when 50 Paradox-touched Nymphs have died by your hand.
Greetings to you.  I am glad you have come up this way.  If you are willing to aid us against these strange new Olthoi, I could set you to a task that you may find enlightening.

In large numbers nearby, but seen throughout this 'Olthoi North', there are young Olthoi, those Nymphs of their species, touched by a strange Paradox of energies.  Slay them, 50 should do for now, and return to me.  Do this task and you shall be rewarded for it.
Another egg.
Adrien Swiftblade sighs.
I'm glad you've brought me this, as the researchers needed another, but I had vainly hoped these would run out eventually. Ah well, such is life in Dereth, I guess.
Please, allow me to reward you for your noble and necessary efforts.
An Olthoi egg?
You explain to Adrien Swiftblade the circumstances of the catacombs and of the egg room.
Damn. So, it seems this new threat is one that won't go away lightly. Nothing is ever simple in this world.
I'll send this along to our researchers. Perhaps, with time and effort, we can find out where these new Olthoi came from, and find a way to put a stop to them before the threat they pose grows worse.
You've done this world a great service today. Please, allow me to reward you for your efforts.

Thank you again. The egg you have provided us should keep the Researchers busy for a while. They don't seem to keep well away from their cave though, so they tend to lose their usefulness in a day after you take it from the catacombs. So, if you're interested in helping us again, return then.

You'll find the entrance to the Ward Guardian in the infested valley below us.  Once he's dead, the wards should fail and you should be able to gain access to the Deeper Catacombs of the Paradox-touched Olthoi.
The portal to these catacombs is found within the upper area of the Black Death Catacombs.  Once in there, look for anything that will aid us in our research of these strange Olthoi.
What's this?
Where did you find this?

Wonderful!  I see word is indeed spreading, if kind-hearted people such as yourself are aiding in this without me having to ask them to do so myself.  Dereth is indeed full of wonders.  Please, allow me to reward you for your generous act.
Greetings. If you're of a mind to help in this odd situation, I could certainly use your help.
Along with the rise of these strange new Olthoi, there is a Portal, warded by powerful magics, which formed in the Black Death Catacombs. You may've seen it already, or you may not have.

Anyways, I've found a way to get the wards to drop for a time. There is a Ward Guardian in a cave located in a heavily infested area nearby, around 43.6N, 55.5E. When that thing dies, the wards falter for a time.
You are not powerful enough to aid me.

The Ward Guardian is presently alive, so you will not be able to enter the Deeper Catacombs of the Paradox-touched Olthoi until it is killed. Once in there, look for anything that may be of use to use in our research and bring it back to me.

The Ward Guardian is presently dead, so you should be able to enter the Deeper Catacombs of the Paradox-touched Olthoi.  Once in there, look for anything that may be of use to use in our research and bring it back to me.
If the Portal is closed again when you get there, you should find the Ward Guardian in his cave and kill him.

Be warned, however, the Ward Guardian has grown dramatically in strength since it first appeared. It is now as strong or stronger than those twisted bugs that wander the inner areas of the infestation, and should not be taken lightly.
I would hurry though, every time the Ward Guardian dies, it's either reborn, recreated, or whatever roughly six hours after its death, and the Wards return with it.
I thank you for the assistance you've given us. We are still analyzing the notes, and I'll let you know if we need more help.
Have you had any luck on the task I asked of you?

Greetings to you again, %tn. We could use your assistance again. It seems that some of the researchers want additional information from inside the research laboratory you investigated for me before. Here, take another of the portal gems the researchers created and get yourself back to the lab.
The guard nods at the journal.
While I've seen a similar notebook before, I'm sure the researchers will appreciate any new information they might glean from this. Thank you.
Greetings, adventurer. I greet you in the name of Queen Elysa, whose command brings me here today.

We seek intrepid adventurers like yourself, who might be willing to help us investigate a concerning development. It seems that some travelers have discovered a cavern in which drudges have been keeping monougas captive. What is unusual is that the drudges have very sophisticated portal sending enchantments which would seem to be beyond their means. We suspect Virindi involvement of some sort.

Therefore, Prince Borelean led an expedition to investigate this drudge cavern. When he was finished, he had determined a way to reverse the portal sending - to open a portal from that location to the source of the monougas. These portal gems are the result of that determination.

The Queen has commanded that whatever lay on the other side of that portal transit should be explored carefully, with the assumption that whatever is there is hostile. To do so, take the gem I have given you and charge it against the feeding bell. It will reverse the workings of the bell's portal sending magic, and, instead of summoning a drudge and a monouga, will open portals to the source of...

You are welcome to explore the drudge cave, although many have explored it before now. The Queen seeks adventurers to enter the portal from which the monougas come, and hopefully more fully identify exactly what all of this humanoid activity means to the Isparian inhabitants of Dereth.
The guard skims the book, then looks at you with a blank expression.
This doesn't bode well for the future. Not well at all.
I'd better get this to the royals post-haste. They'll want to see this.
Greetings, friend. I am afraid that you are unlikely to be able to help me. Please, return to me when you are more experienced.

greetings: Ah, unfortunately, I cannot translate this... You may wish to bring it to Diyas al-Yat of Zaikhal for translation.

You have done well to retrieve this medallion from the corrupted Master of Depths. You can see the corruption in the jade itself! What a terrible thing has happened to a once-noble House of Nanjou Shou-Jen. Our sources tell us that the key to the corruption of the Tanada can be found back at the Temple of Black Water. There is a Virindi Watcher there whose lair may be accessed through the Shrin...

So it is done. The foul Virindi presence that has corrupted the Tanada has been rooted out. This will not save the souls of the Tanada who have already been corrupted, but at least we know what we are dealing with and can take appropriate steps. I am grateful for all the help you have given us.
If you don't need that mask, I'll take it back in exchange for practical training.
Really? You're not interested in this lovely mask? Pity, I find it quite stylish. Still, if you don't want it...
quest: You've already resolved the situation at the Temple of Black Water for me. I can ask no more of you.
Have you found your way to the lair of the Watcher of Black Water yet? Use the Shrine located in the Temple.
I have asked you to journey to the Tanada Temple of Black Water, in the swamp at 24.2 S, 57.1 E. Please return with the medallion.

So you've already helped us investigate the three other Tanada temples! You are both brave and dedicated. I must ask your assistance as well, as my colleagues Sayuji Jina and Meshenq have already done.

I ask you to journey to the Tanada Temple of Black Water, in the swamp at 24.2 S, 57.1 E. There you must find the Tanada assassin known as the Master of the Depths. Slay him and bring me his jade medallion. I will need his medallion to be able to get to the bottom of the corruption of that clan of Tanada.

I apologize, I do not have time to speak with you right now.  I seek adventurers to investigate a dangerous temple in the swamps, but I dare only trust those who have already helped my friend Meshenq of Zaikhal investigate the Tanada House of Water.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.

greetings: Here's a bug slayin' weapon for ya.
I'm called Crusher.

We came up when we heard about these new twisted bugs. The Aluvian Queen sent scouts to ask us to come up and help. We've been killin and watchin, but these bugs are damn twisted, and I think it'll take time to get to the bottom of this.

I also make weapons out of the ones I kill, and I've agreed to make one of these new weapons for those who aid in killin the new bugs. Axes, that's what I make. If you're looking for a sissy weapon like a sword, ask on of the others.
The good thing about these axes is, they kill the old regular bugs better than anything else I've ever made. And, since killing bugs is a lifestyle, I'm going to share the advantage.
If you want one of these proven bug-killin weapons, I'll craft one for you if you bring me a token from that Wintermaine fellow, up in the encampment over the new bug valley.
Here's a bug slayin' weapon for ya.
Make it fast, stranger. I's busy.

Call me Deena. We's came up from ours home whens these new bugs started comin' around. Then we's got the call from dat Aluvian Queen. Heard she sent scouts to asks us for our help. Which is whys we's been so busy and no time for chattin'. We's spends most of ours days killin' the new bugs.

Blasted things just keep coming'. Gonna take some time to get a good strong foothold. Gotta come up with news ways to get these critters good. I's came up with a new type of katar that is just the thing for these blasted bugs.
Now, look at the construction of these babies. They's perfect for killin' da critters. Just right for the new bugs and even better for da old ones.

Would they's help ya in some bug killin'. Words come down from the encampment set up in the valley over there. The ones where the new bugs are. There's this bloke, Wintermaine, he's been needin' a hand. I's owe him a few favors, but can't leaves my post. You's do me the's favor of helpin' him out and I'll's let yous take one of these in trade.
Back so soon? Welp, since yous done did yar part, I's do mine. Here's one of the best shields ya'll find.
Best to ya Upworlder. Take my advice though... crawling under an open sky just ain't healthy.
Good day to ya! I'm Tikka.
So yar an Upworlder, huh? Do ya really crawl around up on the surface? Don't that make all weirded out with so much space?
Tikka shudders.
Wes heard about you folks when the Aluvian Queen sent scouts to ask us to come up and help. Wasn't sure that the stories were true, but here yar are.

So we's been spendin' most our time these days killing the new bugs. IT's what's we good at. But even the best bug killers need down time. I's uses my down time make shields. See, I's uses those bug hides back against them.
Tikka knocks on her shield.
See? Good sound stuff. Works great against the new buggies. Works even better against the old buggies.

Interested? That Wintermaine fellow and I's have an agreement. Wes help each other out. I's know he's been needing some help lately, but I's too busy. Yous give him a hand and he'll give ya a token. Yous bring that token here and I'lls give ya one of my shields. He in the encampment over the new bug valley.
Here's a bug slayin' weapon for ya.
Yah. I'm Miko. How's yar health?

Me? I'm might busy these days. We's was sent this-ways when da Lady Queen cames asking for help. Seems da bugs we used to fightin' now no longer da bugs we used to fightin'. Wes givin' a hand cuz no matter what bugs need killin', we da best at it.
Good thing about killin' so many bugs is ya get lots of leftover parts. Me? I use da pincers Wintermaine and his mates collect from the huntin' ground. I use 'em to make da best spears around.
Betch ya won't find no spears around these them parts that can kill bugs like my spears. They's are just beauties. What's even better, da the old-style bugs even lickity-split.

Tell ya what, day Wintermaine fellow, up in the encampment over the new bug valley, he's always helpin' me out with stuff. He's been needin' some help. Yous go over and give him a hand. When yar done, he'll give ya a token. Bring back the token and ya can have one of my fancies.
Here's a bug slayin' weapon for ya.
Greetings, I am Sasha.
Sasha bows.

The Aluvian Queen sent her brave scouts to ask us for help. We's spent our whole lives trainin' and killin' the great bugs. We's have gotten a reputation of bein' the bestest at killin' the great bugs. Now there are the bugs and the Queen has called on us for help.

We's also gotten a reputation for makin' the best weapons ya can out of the bugs. We's uses their body parts ta make some of best bug killin' weapons ya can get. Dat way some good comes from those horrors.
Me? My peoples taught me to make swords. Ain't they fine killin' tools? They be killin' the new bugs just right and the old bugs right quick.

Be a good addition to yar arsenal, no? Make a pact with ya. Ya go over above the valley were the new bugs are. There ya'll find one named Wintermaine. He's good and honorable folk. Ya help with a task he be needin' aid with. When's it done to his satisfaction, he'll be givin' ya a token. Brings dat token to me and I'll be givin' ya one of my swords.
Is this how all of the adventurers are getting past the sealed passage? Well, you're all braver than I thought.

Well, what are you waiting for, go kill the damnable Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen. I will be awaiting news of your success, or waiting to see if your death and reformation at the Lifestone removes the smell.
No need for a weapon, I see. Very well, accept this instead.
This will make quite a trophy. Allow me to reward you.
Ethan Wintermaine grants %s the title, "Paradox-touched Queenslayer".
quest: Thank you again for your part in killing the Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen. If I have more work for you in the future, I'll let you know.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Is this what I think it is?
This is great news, and I am glad to hear it. Please, accept this reward for your efforts.

This is great news, and I am glad to hear it. I love it when adventurers such as yourself take the initiative and hunt down problems without having to be asked to do so. Please, accept this reward for your efforts.
Ahh, you've killed her again. Very good.
Please, allow me to reward you for your victory.
Greetings citizen.

If you're of a mind to help quell this invasion, I have a mission for you. We've found that, with the increase in the infestation of this area, that the stronger Paradox-touched Olthoi have some capacity to pass beyond the Sealed Olthoi Passage that those aiding the Guard Swiftblade have found.
Those who have hunted them have been able to use these stronger Olthoi to gain passage beyond the door themselves.
Beyond that passage lies my mission for you. It's a simple one, in concept anyways.
Ethan Wintermaine smiles.

Before we get to that, you'll need to bypass the Wards on the Deeper Catacombs Portal. Guard Swiftblade, in the tent behind me, has more information in bypassing the Wards. Speak to him if you need more information on that process.

Go beyond the passage, find the Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen, and kill her. Bring me back proof of her death, and I'll reward you for your part in it. Be warned, however. She's not a creature to be taken lightly, or hunted alone.
You are not powerful enough to aid me.
Guard Swiftblade informs me that the Paradox-touched Olthoi Ward Guardian is presently alive and that the Wards protecting the Deeper Catacombs Portal are active.
He can direct you in how to find and defeat the Paradox-touched Olthoi Ward Guardian and bypass the Wards.

Once the Ward Guardian is dead, the portal to the Deeper Catacombs of the Paradox-touched Olthoi can be found within the upper area of the Black Death Catacombs.  Once you enter, seek the Sealed Olthoi Passage in the deepest parts of the Catacomb.  If you can get past the Passage, you'll be able to get into the Paradox-touched Queen's Lair.
I would hurry though, every time the Ward Guardian dies, it in some way returns six hours after its death, and the Wards return with it.
Guard Swiftblade informs me that the Paradox-touched Olthoi Ward Guardian is presently dead and that the Wards protecting the Deeper Catacombs Portal are down.
Bring the token to one of the Olthoi Weaponcrafters in the valley below, and they'll exchange it for a weapon you may find very useful.
If you're not interested in the weapon, I can take the token back and reward you with something else appropriate.

greetings: Yes, these bones make good handles.
Havala deftly carves the Ancient Bone into a Fine Atlatl Handle.
Here you are. This can be used on Composite Atlatls to increase their effectiveness.

I wouldn't use that to upgrade your atlatl unless you are sure you can handle a more powerful weapon. It may prove to be more than you can wield. If you decide you would rather have a different reward I can pass along a little experience I've learned in hunting.
Alright, I'll just take that then. Here are a few pointers in tracking your target.
Yes, this bone has the kind of tensile strength that comes from proper aging. It will make a wonderful handle.
Havala deftly carves the Hardened Bone into a Superb Atlatl Handle.
My yes, this bone will make an astoundingly good handle. The texture and weight of fossilized bone... Nothing beats it, really.
Havala deftly carves the Fossilized Bone into an Exquisite Atlatl Handle.
Yes, this will be suitable. I can carve this into a shape suitable for atlatl construction.
Have you read my work on composite atlatls?
I can help you by carving pieces of horn to go into the atlatl's stave. Later, if your skills have outgrown your Composite Atlatl I might have a way to upgrade it.

quest: It does not react to the interaction.
You hold the gem up, and its energy flashes from it to the Virindi.
I tell the news of events in far off lands. In my spare time, I might be..ahem...encouraged...to speak of some more private matters I might have heard.
I serve the varied interests of our own organization. You may have heard of my mistress? We handle housing, research into the arcane secrets of this place, and such.
D'you want something to eat or drink? Don't know if you rightly can... anyways, I hear a lot from those that them through these parts, and that's a side business I run - the trade of information.

If you see a gem so sparkling and clear that you almost mistake it for the desert sun...that is my work, dear sahr. I also take those gems that others find, that I might craft greater works from them.
We have learned how to scribe magics onto parchment - a remarkable achievement. We allow others mages of our community to use these harnessed magics.
Is it not obvious who we are, fellow observer? We have been stationed here less time than you, but our mission is the same. And why do you persist in the use of the singular even here?
Greetings, atua ngamaru. I and my partner help in the hunt against golems. For my part, I hunt the coral golems.
Greetings, atua ngamaru. My purpose is the hunt - the hunt against golems. Today I seek the Platinum Mountain King.
I work with my compatriot metalworking for Ayan Baqur. I craft armor for the Whispering Sword shop, and those who would frequent it.
I would call myself a bowyer, but not just a simple bowyer. I help to craft those unique weapons called composite bows.
I've seen quite a bit of fighting, and I put that experience into these bows that I make. You'll not do better.
I run a business of repute - I am the mayor of this town.
Ever since my husband died, I have sought the aid of others to bring his killer to justice.
We record our history and philosophies in these parchments. I can share them with you, in return for pyreal.
I bring relief for those have been wounded and come to this sanctuary. I am a healer.
I am the weaponsmith of Ayan Baqur, honorable sir. Our shop is named the Whispering Blade.
Those Coral Golems won't be scratching my armor again.
You have not yet killed 50 Coral Golems.  Return to me once you have accomplished this task.

Those detestable coral golems, every time I even go near the water I seem to step on one! Do you know what kind of damage coral does to armor? Those scratches are hard to buff out of your sollerets! It won't make them go away but I'll reward you for every 50 Coral Golems that you kill.
You have earned the title of Reef Breaker.
You have earned the title of Reef Builder.
You can continue to kill Coral Golems and if you kill another 50 I'll reward you again. Maybe if you kill enough I'll be able to scrounge up a special reward for you...
Mind if I ask what you did with all that coral? You must have built a reef out of their remnants.
You must wait %tqt before attempting the Umbral Rift kill quest again.
Truly amazing isn't it. You are one of us, you are a Rift Walker.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Umbral Rifts.
I see you've followed my advice. Come back and tell me more when you've been in the proximity of 30 dying Umbral Rifts.
You must wait %tqt before attempting the Tenebrous Rift kill quest again.
You truly live on the edge of the rift.
To have experienced that many rifts you must truly be chosen.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Tenebrous Rifts.
You need to be patient my friend, come back and tell me about your adventures when you've killed 350 Tenebrous Rifts.

I've spent many of my days in the place known as Singularity Caul. It was in my travels that I made an amazing discovery, one that would surely change anyone's life. I've experienced that proximity to a dieing rift has certain effects on the psyche.
It's truely amazing. Go out and experience it for yourself. Different rifts seem to have different effects.
Kill 30 Umbral Rifts and let me know of your adventures.

The experience of hunting Umbral Rifts appears to have a heavy but short lasted effect on the psyche, on the other hand Tenebrous Rifts have a minor but long lasting effect. If you seek to truely explore your own essence I'd suggest you kill 350 or more Tenebrous Rifts, it's truly amazing.
You have been given the title of Rift Shifter.
You have been given the title of Rift Walker.
You have been given the title of Chosen of the Rift.
Ah, friend, it is good to see you back again! But we must take care not to wipe out all the Slithis, yes? Give them a couple of weeks to replenish their numbers, then come see me again!
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.
Excellent work, friend! You have slain many of these creatures! Allow me to reward you!
You have been given the title Slithis Slayer.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Sishalti Slithis.
So, you wish to prove your hunting prowess? Well then. Track down and slay 150 of those lurking Sishalti Tentacles, Tendrils and Eye Stalks for me and I will reward you appropriately.

greetings: Impressive! DeathTail is quite the beast. You are truly gifted at slaying rats!
You have gained the title Grave Stalker!
More rats cleaned out, and DeathTail destroyed. Well done. I don't expect to see hide nor hair of DeathTail for at a day.
quest: More rats cleaned out, and DeathTail destroyed. Well done. I don't expect to see hide nor hair of DeathTail for at a day.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Impressive. You are a capable rat catcher, even here.
You have gained the title Crypt Rat!

I have been hunting a dangerous beast, a spectral and corrupted creature called DeathTail. He is very dangerous and I can't kill him alone. If you get a group together you could destroy him. You'll need to find a rat burrow and place rat bait into it. DeathTail will be drawn out into the open. If you think you are up to the task, get rat bait from my pack, destroy DeathTail and bring me back a...
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm rats.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm rats and I will reward you.
The Lo family has been hunting rats for generations. My younger brother hunts them back in the capital but I came out here for bigger game.

The rats are everywhere, and even I have trouble keeping up. Something drives them mad and makes them stronger. If you want to help me, kill %tqm of these Grave Rats. Maybe then I will have more work for you.
The rats around here are really big. Perhaps you should talk to my brother Lo Raen back in the capital.

greetings: Greetings, Citizen.
quest: You shouldn't have this...
If you have this, it must mean that Aerbax brought Sangi back and continued his mad plans...
Thank you for once again freeing Dojiro Sangi. Please, accept this reward.
You have something for me?
I recognize this... Where did you get this?
You tell Ryukai Hiro about your encounter with Dojiro Sangi in Aerbax's Lab.
I see. It is a great sadness that things needed to turn out this way, but you did the right thing, and saved Sangi from a terrible fate. Please, allow me to reward you.
Ryukai Hiro grants to you the title, "Dojiro Sangi's Savior".
You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.
Have you resolved the situation with the Hea Tumerok known as Rheaga yet?  Please, be on your way and return to me when you've sorted that Tumerok out.
A very interesting note you've given me here. I suppose this is enough to confirm that this Rheaga has no interest in uniting his kin for a war against us. I thank you for your service.

Funny, the beast doesn't look any smarter than any of the other Tumeroks. Good job, bringing that dangerous creature down. Oh, he may have protested his innocence, but all of these things that Aerbax twisted... Well, they can't help eventually turning to his will, can they?

Ah, you may be suitable for the task I have at hand.  We've received reports that the Virindi renegade Aerbax has endowed a Hea Tumerok with increased intelligence and magical power.  You can only imagine what danger this creature would pose if it came to unite the Tumeroks, the way Aerbax's other experiments have tried, yes?
Please venture to the Lonely Fortress on the western edge of Dereth, north of Ayan Baqur, and see to it that this Tumerok poses us no threat.
Nomea ibn Makar has granted you the title "Friend of Rheaga"
Nomea ibn Makar has granted you the title "Slayer of Rheaga"
Please return to me when you have increased your strength.

greetings: Wait a second, lassie - we're comin' ta get ya!
Alright, boys! Let's be squashin' some bugs for the lady!
Lass...I brought ye some tea. It's not good, but it's the best we be gettin' from the surface.
Ye be welcome, m'love.
Well, lassie, truth be - I canna read.
Oh? What's it say?
We've been over this before, lass - there's too many ta fight. We can stay here, safe...
I dinna think so...the magics that our people know do nothing against 'em, and wouldn't this Asheron have fought the Olthoi off if he could've?
Ye mean this, lass?
Alright, lass. I'll go with ye to visit this...Asheron.
I think we be wastin' our time, m'dear. If whoever be inside be at all interested in talkin', they be doin' a good job o' hidin' it.
Lass, ye've returned! I was worried for ye, but I dinna know how ta enter...
What did he say, lass?
And how d'we do that?
What be that?
I dinna think we're ready for an open confrontation quite yet...but if it be true, if it be the first step, maybe...
Ye foul fiend!

This ingot is attuned to the power of Isparian potential. The being it is most similar to is Queen Elysa. I have heard the story of how a female voice was involved in the quest, though my theory is that it was the voice of the long-dead Olthoi Queen which helped to break the spell.

It seems that Queen Elysa's fate shall forever be intertwined with the Olthoi. As such, the Olthoi may prove to be a means to purify this ingot. Scouts in the Olthoi North have reported a newly-discovered cavern of Olthoi - there may be a sufficient means of purification there.
This cavern is not located in a dangerous place. I would advise seeking a vassal, perhaps, who might be willing to perform this task for you.
This ingot is attuned to the power of Isparian potential, but it has been purified already. You need not do anything else with this ingot, except wait for an opportunity for it to be used.

This ingot is attuned to the power of Shadow. The being it is most similar to is Bael'zharon. To purify it, one would need access to a power that is similarly dark, but not allied with Shadow. I would suggest inquiring with the Deep - its appetite for destruction is unparalleled, yet it fights Shadow as surely as those who follow the Light.
Note that the journey to the Deep is dangerous - only the strongest heroes should consider purifying this ingot.
This ingot is attuned to the power of Shadow, but it has been purified already. You need not do anything else with this ingot, except wait for an opportunity for it to be used.

This ingot is attuned to the power of Light. The being it is most similar to is Asheron. To purify it, I would seek the font from which Asheron's powers spring forth. If you could find a primal vessel, something deep at the foundation of what we call the Deru Tree perhaps, that should suffice.
The places where the Deru Trees are located do not tend to be as dangerous as some places on Dereth. I would advise seeking a vassal, perhaps, who might be willing to perform this task for you.
This ingot is attuned to the power of Light, but it has been purified already. You need not do anything else with this ingot, except wait for an opportunity for it to be used.

Greetings.  I have come to Asheron's tower to continue my Mistress's studies of the nature of the Quiddity Ingots that Aerbax was using to power the Quiddity Seeds.  I believe I have determined something about them.  If you hand me the Quiddity Ingots extracted from the trophies you found on your quest, I will identify them for you.

Very interesting! This medallion can actually be used to directly siphon mana out of a node between ley lines, if one possesses the geomantic skill necessary... Not useful to one such as yourself, you understand, but I have colleagues who would find this medallion to be valuable and informative. All I can do is thank you with some practical experience...

Greetings! Have you run into any human bandits that belong to a group known as the Shroud Cabal? I represent a group of concerned Geomancers who are afraid that these renegades may pose some kind of threat, or represent a new threat to the people of Dereth... If you come across any of their artifacts, please bring them to me and I shall try to reward you.

Yes, this is the seal of Rytheran's that I asked you to find, but the seal itself does me no good. As I told you, the gate to Rytheran's Library can be found near the old Mage Academy. The entrance portal to that dungeon can be found at 74.7 N, 18.5 E. Search for some new formation or artifact near that portal.
quest: I've asked you to fetch Lord Rytheran's journal, have I not? Have you found the book yet?
You recovered Rytheran's journal? Excellent!
Danira briefly skims the pages of Dericostian runes.

Unfortunate... The journal provides little information about where he has hidden the Book of Eibhil. I suppose it was too much to hope for. Still, this book has done much to illuminate the undead lord's thinking, and it shows us that he is intimately involved with the ley line disturbances and the rise of the graveyard... Oh, what has Rytheran unleashed?
I thank you for this. I'll provide you with a translation of the text, for your own edification, and some practical knowledge...

Ah, you may be able to help me. I seek an artifact of the dread undead lord Rytheran. I think the ley line disturbances across the realm have opened up a gate into his personal library. There is some kind of gate that appeared within the old Mage Academy... But I believe, to enter it, you must have a seal of Rytheran's... A seal that my scouts have traced to a crypt in the Empyrean Graveyard in...

Go search the crypts in that graveyard, and try to find Rytheran's lordly seal that will allow you into his Library. Enter the library through the gate near the Mage Academy and search for books. It may be too much to ask that the Book of Eibhil is still in there, but perhaps some journal of Rytheran's would help illuminate the trail to that terrifying artifact. In any case, please bring me wha...

greetings: So this is the egg of one of those things. See how it is corrupted, as compared to a normal moarsman egg. Whatever's driving the moarsmen to shore is not benevolent.
quest: The moarsmen will be sedate for a while.  Give it time - they'll be active again soon.
Hail, traveler. Do you want to know something?
There's moarsmen down on that beach - yes, moarsmen, even in this cold!
They're unnatural, these moarsmen are. I've seen a bit in my time.
I'm sure the captain of this outpost wouldn't complain if you went and wiped out the population of that den of moarsmen. Eventually those things are going to get hostile and attack us up here.

greetings: An egg? They're hatching more of these fish-things? Dad's not going to be happy about this...
quest: There's no more moarsmen attacking the outpost for now. Thank you!
Warrior - come and help us out!
We've got a problem with moarsmen on the beach! They've started building a little coral outpost, and we don't have the manpower to drive them off.
Can you wipe out their little holding?

greetings: Young Temo's note tells me that you helped him recover the scepter of Menilesh... We thank you for your devotion and your interest in the glories of ages long past. Perhaps, in time, you can join the Eldrytch Web and do your part to bring those glories back to Dereth, from the ruins and forgotten memories of the present day. We are not accepting new members now, but your assistance in this matt...
Do I know you? I will not treat with you unless you have a letter of introduction from one of my fellows.

So, Candrus tells me in this note that you helped him with that infestation of blight spirits. Well done! We welcome your service to the greater good of all Dereth. A spirit as noble as yours may one day find welcome in the ranks of the Celestial Hand, who act to defend all the inhabitants of Dereth from the ancient evils that besiege it. We are not accepting new members at the moment, but we h...
I'm sorry, but my orders are not to deal with anyone unless they have a letter of introduction from another member of my faction.

I see you have been of use to one of my scouts. That Jawaq always was a little weak in the sword arm, if you know what I mean. Well, if you did what he could not, perhaps, in time, you may be useful to me. The Radiant Blood is not accepting more members yet, but we may in the not-too-distant future... Suffice it to say you have been noticed, and may be watched. For now, allow me to present you...
Unless you have a letter of introduction from one of my scouts, I don't have any time for you.

quest: You may complete this quest again in %tqt.

Ah, so that curious Arcanum scholar sent you. I would be willing to give you the knowledge you seek on his behalf, if you would simply retrieve an artifact for me from this infected pit here before us...

In that crypt below, there is a chest that contains an ancient scepter. The scepter is an artifact that is of some interest to my superiors. Find the key among those creatures milling about in the pit, unlock the chest, and bring me the scepter. That will prove you worthy, and I will write you a letter of introduction to bring to my commander.

Ah, the ancient scepter of Menilesh... Barely recognizable under the dust and decay of the millennia. Still, my masters will be pleased to see that I have recovered it. I will reward you with some practical knowledge. I will also give you a letter of introduction to bring to my commander, Qurakh al-Taal in Ayan Baqur. In time, you may prove yourself worthy of the Eldrytch Web...
I do not know you. Nor were you sent by that over-curious Arcanum scholar Jondor in Zaikhal. I have no time for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.

Ah, that Arcanum scholar sent you to find out what you could from me, eh? Well, there may be a way for you to prove yourself worthwhile to me, and to my superiors. Down in this pit nearby is a foul, diseased creature known as a Blight Lictor. It is a symptom of the contamination that is creeping across this land. Bring its head to me and I will give you a letter of introduction that you can pre...

I am well pleased. It brings a savage joy to my heart to see that foul creature's severed head. Allow me to reward you with some practical knowledge. I should also give you a letter of introduction to bring to my commander, Vierana du Canamorra in Ayan Baqur. You may be worthy to one day become a member of the Radiant Blood...
I'm sorry, I have no time for you. You weren't sent here by that persistent Arcanum agent Jondor in Zaikhal, were you?
You've already shown me this book. I don't need to see it again, I've already made my copy. You weren't trying to hornswoggle more experience out of me, were you?
If you have a manifesto that you would be willing to allow me to copy, I will reward you with practical knowledge. Just hand it over to me for a few moments and I'll be quite happy.
Excellent! This is just what I was looking for. Most fascinating...
There, I've copied what I need. I thank you for all your assistance in this, ahem, delicate matter.

Perhaps you could help a simple scholar... I've been told that strange landscape formations have appeared around the Empyrean graveyard, and that scouts from mysterious new secret societies have taken up positions at these sites. There are scouts at these formations to the north, east, and west of the graveyard.

I would be most indebted to you if you could somehow gain the trust of these scouts and bring me whatever written materials you can about the beliefs that their societies espouse. I would reward you with a bit of practical knowledge for any manifestoes that you could bring me. I have also heard that there are more senior representatives of each society in Ayan Baqur, but I doubt they'll talk to...

greetings: Nah...bring it to Celcynd. In Rithwic. Some people...
What would I want with this?  Have you been drinking this?
Listen, if I wanted a pot I would have asked you for one!
I gave ya the smelting pot for a reason, ya know.
Harlune doesn't want me muckin' with those staves more than I have to
Harlune was tellin' me that Celcynd used to be pretty good at what he did, before he went and became a drunkard. Anyways, here's the reward Harlune told me to leave for ya.
Careful when ya use that spell.
Hey...ya, I recognize this thing. Harlune told me it might be floatin... around, what with the Viamontians back and all. It's the Rose of Celdon. It's a symbol of independence or somethin' like that.
Here, ya better hang onto it - could be useful, ya know.
Harlune told me that this might be a signal that there are intruders in Knorr. Ya gotta go to the golem Balior and help it out. Bring somethin' back to me and I'll see what I can do.
Oh, yeah - Harlune told me what this is. I'll pass it along to him. He left word somethin' like this might appear. I'll pass it up, and Harlune'll keep it safe.
Here's a reward for ya. Harlune didn't tell me where he got it from, so don't ask me!
quest: Ya seem like a glutton for punishment. Still, I gotta admit - I'm impressed.
You have been given the title "Hard to Kill" by Roderick.
Alright...Umm...Harlune told me how to do this...
Alright. Take this and go to Colier Mines.
If ya find some ore in a wheelbarrow and ya bring it to me, I think it'll be enough to fix the staff, alright?
Alright...let me give it a shot...
The warrior takes a scroll out and silently reads it. Suddenly, his eyes start to glow and his voice changes.
What are you bothering me for? More imbeciles asking to have that staff repaired? Fine. Here, just go away afterward!
Roderick's eyes stop glowing and he looks around, dazed, as he pockets the scroll.
Um...I guess that's it. I think ya better go, now. He doesn't like to be bothered.
So...ya survived, huh? Congratulations. To think I thought ya wouldn't make it...
You have been given the title "Expendable" by Roderick.
Harlune told me not to fix more than one of these for folks. Ya better get goin'.
That is nice and all, but I need a staff to fix before that slag is of any use.

Harlune'll be out of here for a while - I've been asked to stay and watch over Alia. Harlune gave me instructions, though - if you've got something that ya needed to talk to him about, I can take care of it for ya.
Ya think ya might be interested in doin' a favor for Harlune? Ya look tough enough to survive what he has in mind.

The Falatacot Matriarchs sent him a message, ya see, askin' if he'd like to ally. Well, of course he don't - the Falatacot can't be trusted one bit. So he wants to send a message back...but ya know how Harlune can be.

Anyways, he asked me to find some volunteers to deliver the mission. He didn't tell me to mention it, but I'll be nice and mention it anyways - the Falatacot ain't gonna be happy when they read the message.

Here, take this and bring it to Bur. One of the statues up there should lead to a new place where ya can go and deliver the message, and then ya better be ready for a fight. If ya win, bring something back to prove to me that ya won.
Oh the Trinket, please hand it over.

Ya have the note - what are ya doin' here still? Go to Bur and find the way to deliver that note. Ya need to use a new statue to get in - it's in a place that us Isparians ain't never been to before now. Don't forget to bring back proof ya won.
Oh...hmm...I remember that Harlune used to ask for folks to go and deliver a message for him. Here ya go - I'll be lookin' for that history book back, and then I'll give ya the scroll.
Ya have already helped me deliver the note. Perhaps I will have more work for you once time has passed.
Ya lost the note?  I got extra copies, but be careful with the thing!  Bring me back proof ya won, when they attack.

greetings: Very well, if you do not wish to keep the repaired yari, I can make great use of it in my research. Please, accept this instead.
Very well, if you do not wish to keep the repaired Yoroi Cuirass, I can make great use of it in my research. Please, accept this instead.
quest: I see that you have retrieved both the Cuirass and the Yari, may I see them?
Greetings, I am Hiro Ishigame, a scholar studying the history and artifacts of the Green Mire Warrior.

Perhaps you could assist me. When the Green Mire Warrior died, he was set to rest in a large complex used to serve as his grave. Since that time, however, it has been completely overrun with drudges, mosswarts, and all sorts of other horrible things.

If you were willing to go retrieve the Yari and Cuirass from those invading creatures, I would gladly reward you for the chance to study them. I can also repair them, if they are too damaged to be used and you wish them returned to you after my studies.

I have been told that the pieces no longer reside in the coffin itself, and that the entirety of the Green Mire Grave is separated by locked doors and hidden keys. So, if you go, it may take some exploration to find them both.
You will find the Green Mire Grave at 27.8S, 71.6E, northeast of here, upon a small hill to the east side of the river.

greetings: Amazing! You actually convinced Rytheran to part with his precious memory of the Book of Eibhil? I do not know what you had to do to accomplish it, and perhaps that is for the best. You have my thanks, and the thanks of the realm of Dereth for the good you have done here. These memories will be invaluable in helping us solve the mess that Rytheran and that book created.
This mask is... breathtaking. It once belonged to Lord Rytheran himself? Truly a precious artifact. If you do not want it, I can grant you some practical experience for it.
quest: You cannot fool me. You've already sought out Rytheran on Nuhmudira's behalf. Be careful of your associations. The blood witch is treacherous and would think nothing of sacrificing you for her own ends. I am afraid I can have no dealings with you.
I believe you have served me already, have you not? I have no further tasks for you now, but I thank you for your attentiveness.
You have already taken on this task on behalf of Nuhmudira's agent, that barbarous woman Lacarra. I do not think we can cooperate.
I've already asked you to journey to the Empyrean Graveyard, find the way in to the Gardens of Menilesh and seek out Rytheran's mnemosyne. Please, there is little time to waste.

Excellent, perhaps you can help me. My superiors seek some knowledge of the troubles affecting the ley lines of Dereth, and the problem seems to trace back to Rytheran, the ancient Dericostian noble. We have become aware that a path into Rytheran's current abode within the ruined Gardens of Menilesh has opened somewhere in the Empyrean Graveyard.

Find a way to seek out Rytheran and see if you can retrieve his personal mnemosyne... We need access to his memories about the reading of the Book of Eibhil. It may not be necessary to destroy the undead lord, but merely to attain his cooperation.
I don't believe you can help me. I seek a stronger champion to face great peril.

greetings: Well done! I will not ask how you got this artifact from the hoary old tyrant. But this should contain the information we need to find out what Rytheran did wrong, and what we can do to stop what he has unleashed...
You do not want this?  What a pity.  A beautiful mask, and with significant historical value... I know my lady will want this.  I thank you.
quest: I can already tell that you've helped that groveling fool Heishan with this matter of Rytheran. Beware of the time when you are forced to choose between your own kind and the Empyreans who would enslave us all.
You've already retrieved Rytheran's trinket for me. I thank you for your service, but I have nothing for you now.
You stink of Empyrean filth. Let me guess, you're already working for Ben Ten's little minion, Heishan, aren't you? I have no use for you.

Did we not already speak of this matter? I wish you to seek out the moldering fool Lord Rytheran in his lonely perch within the Gardens of Menilesh. Be on your way, others have already begun the search as well, I am sure.

You may be worth my time... My masters have determined that the dusty, deposed Lord Rytheran is the source of our current troubles with ley lines. If you would make yourself useful to us and to all the humans of Dereth, seek him out in his garden sanctuary.

There is a portal to these gardens located in the midst of the Empyrean Graveyard. We need a mnemosyne from Rytheran, bearing... vital information about a book he once held. Take it from him, by force or coercion, and bring it to me. You will be well rewarded.
You are too weak to help me, youngster. Seek me out when you have become stronger.

greetings: This be interestin' - I think ye should keep it. I be seein' all that I need.
Well done, ye scurvy scaliwag! Ye've done well against these scum!
