You have been awarded the title "Defender of the Sea" - congratulations!
Are ye seekin' for something ta do, lad? I might know something ye could stand ta be hearin', if ya don't like these foul, tainted moarsmen no more than I do.

On Ispar, I do be a ship's captain, but we do not be havin' navies here on Dereth. Instead, I be reduced to speakin' my understandin' of the lore of the sea - such as these fortresses which be appearin' upon the coast.
When the blighteed moarsmen came forth, they be leavin' a way for a cunning dog such as yerself to enter their tunnels.
If ya find yer way to the bottom, and ye find anything of interest, be lettin' me know what ye find. I'll be seein' what I can be doin' for ya.

Yes, this is exactly the kind of crystal we need to feed into the six pyramids, as detailed in my book.  But this does no good to me.  I'm glad you have it, make no mistake.  Just take it to a pyramid and make use of it there.  Have you seen the book I wrote on it?  If you ask nicely, I may give you one.
Here you go...
quest: Greetings!  Are you here to help reclaim the land's ley lines from the corruption of T'thuun?  At the behest of our noble Queen Elysa, the mage Asheron has raised six pyramids over the most tainted ley nodes in Dereth, the sites most under the grip of the wicked creature T'thuun.  These pyramids must be powered!  Certain creatures found in the vicinity of those nodes

Bring these crystals to each of the pyramids!  Once a pyramid has been sufficiently stoked by brave Derethians such as yourself, all that will be required to defeat T'thuun's power at that site is to destroy the guardian that T'thuun has stationed there... I have written a book that explains all this.  I'll give you one now...

But be warned, though you may be capable of hunting the creatures near the pyramid sites, the minions that T'thuun has chained there are quite powerful and may be too strong for you to fight.  You may want to bring powerful friends.

I think I've already given you a book, haven't I?  Those books aren't free.  If you need another one, give me a C trade note and I'll give you another.  Otherwise, perhaps it's time to head on out to the pyramid sites and start doing what you can to power up those pyramids.
Those Brood Mothers you described will surely refill the Spawning Pools. Return to me in a day or so when I will require your help again.

Well done, I know that was nasty work, but we have to ensure that we keep the Blighted Moarsmen population under control. Allow me to reward you for your service to our Society.

Your Society needs your assistance. The number of the Blighted Moarsmen in Nyr'leha, the Moarsmen City, has been growing incredibly fast. We need to keep their number down to keep their potential threat to a minimum.

Go to the Moarsmen City, South East of Candeth Keep, and search for their Spawning Pools. Kill any of the foul beasts you find in the pools. Take no pity on these beasts. They sacrifice their own young much of the time.

greetings: Here's an interesting bit of information for you. Mhoire had his family's emblems infused with a small bit of mana - enough that I can use it in the forges successfully. I'll give you a key - one of the special keys, not my normal keys - in thanks.
Welcome to the Mana Forge!
This wonderful place is one of three locations where the Arcanum is putting the wonders of the Ley Lines to work for the betterment of all Dereth.
If you wish to partake of the works of the Mana Forges, there is something you must do.

To power the forges, we need Pristine Mana Shards, which are often carried by creatures in one of a few locations. It takes 25 of these to power the forges for long enough to make the average chest's worth of items.
If you bring me 25 Pristine Mana Shards, I will give you a new key to one of the various Mana Forge Chests. The key will work on any of the chests within the lower Mana Forge.
You can find the Pristine Mana Shards in the Graveyard Rytheran reawakened, on the Dark Isle, on the Isle called Freebooter Isle, and in the Moarsman City T'thuun's followers raised from the sea.
You can also find them in Neftet, the Frozen Valley, at the Gearknight camps in the Direlands, and from Hoshino's Fortress. Good luck and good hunting to you.
quest: Hmm...you've been bringing these things by an awful lot of late. We're swamped by them. Bring it by in two weeks, perhaps - I might be more interested then.

Here's an interesting bit of information for you. Mhoire had his family's emblems infused with a small bit of mana - enough that I can use it in the forges successfully. I'll give you a key - one of the special keys, not my normal keys - in thanks.

greetings: Shhhhh... Not so loud. What do you think I am, a minstrel?
If you're talking to me, I guess you're interested in the 'services' I provide for those who wish to sever their ties to the 'Societies' that are so wrapped up in everything these days.
For a fee, I could possibly be persuaded to go in, remove any records of your involvement, and get you a fresh start in said 'Societies'. Let's call that fee, say, 100 MMD Notes.
If you're in a Society and want out, or want a fresh start so you can join another one, bring me 100 MMD notes, and I'll see what I can do.
As a warning though, I won't do this for anyone more than once a month. Too risky to be worth the pay.

I have a task suitable for one who has visited the Dark Isle. Listen, and I shall instruct you.
There is, upon the Dark Isle, an undead Ruschk named Vaeshok. He has thrown off the mantle of his former master, and now seeks to serve a new master - the dark power behind the Blight.
Go and defeat him, then return to me. I shall know if you have succeeded.
Any more and you risk damaging yourself!

Bring exactly ten of this black coral to me. Any more and you risk damaging yourself.
This is sufficient. I shall take them from you.

We must determine what to do with this power - if it is safe to utilize, or if it must be destroyed.
Bring exactly ten of this black coral to me. Any more and you risk damaging yourself.
This is sufficient. I shall take them from you.
In a week, it will be safe for you to collect more. In the meantime, take this reward with my appreciation.
There must be 10 samples!
You are not powerful enough to assist me, climb the ranks to adept or above and I may have a task for you.
Any more and we risk being discovered!
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.

Greetings, friend. The Falatacot have begun activities of their own on Dark Isle, and it is almost to be guaranteed that they don't intend well for our interests. We must monitor their intentions closely.

Go to Dark Isle and collect the Falatacot reports. Now, while the Falatacot themselves are almost guaranteed to have a report for their superiors, you may also be able to find them on the other creatures of the island who may have had hostile encounters with the Falatacot.
Come back when you have 10 - this should be a sufficient number to get a good idea what the Falatacot intend in the near future. I don't need any more than that.
Ah, here we go. Hand those over.
I'd say we could use this kind of survey work again in about a day. Come back then, and I should have more work for you.
No, I asked for 10 reports.  Come back when you've got enough.
You are not powerful enough to assist me, climb the ranks to adept or above and I may have a task for you.
Well done. I can tell that you have completed your scouting of Dark Isle, and it would seem that any ley lines have not emerged, and are likely not to emerge for now. This is satisfactory.
In about a day, we will need to check these locations again.  Come back then.

You need to take that crystal and hold it near three markers on the Dark Isle - by the Ruschk iceberg, the entrance cavern where Grael was imprisoned, and a low point in the Coral Forest. Once you have done that, bring it back here and I shall take it and reward you.
Greetings, comrade in arms. I seek your aid in a task.

There are many places of power in the world, and the Dark Isle is one of these places. With all the recent ley line upheaval, we believe that one may become exposed there - it was, after all, a place of power for a long time.

Take this crystal and hold it near three markers on the Dark Isle - by the Ruschk iceberg, the entrance cavern where Grael was imprisoned, and a low point in the Coral Forest. Once you have done that, bring it back here and I shall take it and reward you.
You are not powerful enough to assist me, climb the ranks to adept or above and I may have a task for you.

I gave you the one I had, and it'll be up to you to go into the west and north wings to get their keys before you can go after Bened...

Always an honor.
It is nice to see you have completed your obligations for this rank. I can do no more for you, however. You must report to the Promotions Officer to become fully vetted in your new rank.
You have retrieved the whole Lens of the Filinuvekta? Well, you've succeeded beyond my own expectations. Please hand over the lens and I can give you your reward.

I can tell you what it says, for I have already read it. We return the journal to its location every time an adept brings it to us, as a test of their persistence and skill.

It details the existence of a place called Degar'Alesh - a powerful place to the Light Falatacot, for it was a secret place untouched by the darkness. Here it was that their most powerful temple had been built, atop a powerful ley line which sustained them and their servants.

I tell you of this place because, now that it has come to light, many would seek to use it for their own ends. The Blighted One has made its appearance there, and slain the Deru Tree that once protected the island. Now we are able to make our way to that place, but beware - so can our rivals from the other factions.
Now you know the secret of Degar'Alesh. Now, to continue your service to us, you must go there and fight in the War of the Ancient Powers.

There is a place called Freebooter Keep. Go there now, fight for our cause... and win. But first, be sure to go to the Promotions Officer. You have proven yourself worthy of the next rank in our order, and you should ensure that you are given your just reward.
Greetings.  You have completed my tests, and I have no further tasks for you.  Good luck to you and your endeavors.
Congratulations again on completing the tests, but shouldn't you be talking to the Promotions Officer now?
You are supposed to be retrieving something from the Hidden Sisterhood. Have you something for me?
So... you are here for your third trial, adept. Welcome, and heed well what I say.

By now you should be aware of the existence of the Falatacot, and the two branches from which they spring. One calling themselves Dark, another Light. One dealing in the power of undeath and corruption in service to their Old Ones, and one working to protect what they considered to be worshipful spirits - the Deru Trees. The followers of Adja looked to the Light Falatacot for inspiration

There was a hidden place where some of these Light Falatacot congregated once, long ago. They were known as the Hidden Sisterhood, for they hid from the vengeful attacks of their Dark cousins. In their cloister they recorded much of what it was to live in that ancient world. Eventually, they passed on - but their cloister still remains.
Go there now - bring the secrets of the past to me. I have heard it said that there may be, in specific, a leatherbound journal which reveals many secrets of the past.
Bring that to me. I can read Falatacot, and can tell you what it says if you show it to me.
You are not yet prepared for the tests of Knight Rank, return to me when the Commendations Officer sends you.

I can tell you what it says, for I have already read it. We return the journal to its location every time an adept brings it to us, as a test of their persistence and skill.

It details the existence of a place called Degar'Alesh - a powerful place to the Light Falatacot, for it was a secret place untouched by the darkness. Here it was that their most powerful temple had been built, atop a powerful ley line which sustained them and their servants.

I tell you of this place because, now that it has come to light, many would seek to use it for their own ends. The Blighted One has made its appearance there, and slain the Deru Tree that once protected the island. Now we are able to make our way to that place, but beware - so can our rivals from the other factions.
Now you know the secret of Degar'Alesh. Now, to continue your service to us, you must go there and fight in the War of the Ancient Powers.

There is a place called Freebooter Keep. Go there now, fight for our cause... and win. But first, be sure to go to the Promotions Officer. You have proven yourself worthy of the next rank in our order, and you should ensure that you are given your just reward.
Greetings.  You have completed my tests, and I have no further tasks for you.  Good luck to you and your endeavors.
Congratulations again on completing the tests, but shouldn't you be talking to the Promotions Officer now?
You are supposed to be retrieving something from the Hidden Sisterhood. Have you something for me?
So... you are here for your third trial, adept. Welcome, and heed well what I say.

By now you should be aware of the existence of the Falatacot, and the two branches from which they spring. One calling themselves Dark, another Light. One dealing in the power of undeath and corruption in service to their Old Ones, and one working to protect what they considered to be worshipful spirits - the Deru Trees. The followers of Adja looked to the Light Falatacot for inspiration

There was a hidden place where some of these Light Falatacot congregated once, long ago. They were known as the Hidden Sisterhood, for they hid from the vengeful attacks of their Dark cousins. In their cloister they recorded much of what it was to live in that ancient world. Eventually, they passed on - but their cloister still remains.
Go there now - bring the secrets of the past to me. I have heard it said that there may be, in specific, a leatherbound journal which reveals many secrets of the past.
Bring that to me. I can read Falatacot, and can tell you what it says if you show it to me.
You are not yet prepared for the tests of Knight Rank, return to me when the Commendations Officer sends you.

greetings: The Vault Keeper looks the writ over.
Everything appears to be in order. Here you are.
Welcome, do you have a writ for me to authorize?

quest: Vaeshok is not a threat currently - leave him be. If he should arise as a threat again, I shall tell you.

you have succeeded in my task. Very admirable. Take these in recognition of your service to our Society. Vaeshok may again be a threat to us in a week's time. Return then if you wish to defeat him again.
I have a task suitable for one who has visited the Dark Isle. Listen, and I shall instruct you.
There is, upon the Dark Isle, an undead Ruschk named Vaeshok. He has thrown off the mantle of his former master, and now seeks to serve a new master - the dark power behind the Blight.
Go and defeat him, then return to me. I shall know if you have succeeded.
Vaeshok is not a threat currently - leave him be. If he should arise as a threat again, I shall tell you.

you have succeeded in my task. Very admirable. Take these in recognition of your service to our Society. Vaeshok may again be a threat to us in a week's time. Return then if you wish to defeat him again.
I have a task suitable for one who has visited the Dark Isle. Listen, and I shall instruct you.
There is, upon the Dark Isle, an undead Ruschk named Vaeshok. He has thrown off the mantle of his former master, and now seeks to serve a new master - the dark power behind the Blight.
Go and defeat him, then return to me. I shall know if you have succeeded.
It's too soon. The Deep would surely catch on that you do not mean it well. Be patient, and return to me in a bit.

Well done...and sorry about the little trip. This should set back those who would support the Deep a little, cause a little confusion. We can't hope to damage the Deep permanently in such a fashion, but every little bit of chaos helps.
Would you like to help me with a task? I assure you, your aid will be rewarded.

You are probably familiar with the...thing...which exists in the cave on the Dark Isle. Some call it 'The Deep' and pay it homage by slaying its enemies. It has shared enemies with us, but there is more to it than meets the eye.
It is actually one of the Dark Falatacot Old Gods - I will not name it, but suffice it to say that it uses us toward its own ends.

It is in our interests to set it back a little. I have a specially prepared Dark Remoran fin which will hurt the Deep - just a little, but enough to interfere with its plans elsewhere, perhaps. Trust me when I say that this will help us - it just may not be evident how. Come back here when you are done and I will reward you.
Return to me later, and I may have more work for you.
You look like you've been busy. Have you completed the task I set before you?

Ahh, success. The researchers will be very pleased. With this, we can hopefully find some way to end this infestation of the Deru Trees. The researchers told me that it'll take roughly a day to complete the tests on this eye. Return to me after that, and I may have more work for you.
Greetings.

I have a task for you, if you are willing to aid us against the beast, T'thuun, who has been harrying the Deru Trees on Marae Lassel. The Tumeroks up on the Plateau have been in an uproar about this T'thuun since the first tentacles appeared.
Our researchers believe, if we can get one of the eyes from the largest tentacle by the Trees, that we can use it to find a long-term solution to this problem.
The challenge is, that unless the tentacles are weakened and the large tentacle is distracted, it's impossible to get an eye off of it.
Killing the smaller tentacles seems to distract the larger one. Killing 50 should be enough to get an eye off of the larger, eye covered one.
Bring me back an eye, and I'll reward you on behalf of my superiors and the Tumeroks on the Plateau.
And, here is your reward, on behalf of my superiors and the Tumeroks up on the plateau.
Tamara du Cinghalle awards you the title, "Plucker of Eyes".
You have been rewarded already.
Good job.
You have been awarded the title "Dereth's Elite".
The ritual should be in a fragile state but we have little time. Go now, stop their ritual before they succeed in dooming us all.
Return to me when you have all the books.
The ritual is already taking place, please hurry!

We have finally found a way into those pyramids. I suspect there may be ancient texts for the summoning ritual inside. If you bring those books to me perhaps we can weaken their ritual enough to allow for a plan of attack.
The Ritual is already taking place, please hurry!

greetings: Hmmm... This seems to be the head of that annoying little Sclavus, Tch'Keryk the Emissary. We've been looking for him. Here, allow me to reward you.
Narthran Two-Blades awards you the title, "Negotiator".
Ugh. This one stinks. I think I've heard of this thing. The Blight-caller, wasn't it? The bosses will be pleased to see this thing gone. Here, allow me to reward you.
Narthran Two-Blades awards you the title, "Bane of the Blight".
Hmmm... This seems to be the head of that annoying little Sclavus, Tchk'Tain the Tender. We've been looking for him. Here, allow me to reward you.
Narthran Two-Blades awards you the title, "Defender of the Deru".
Impressive! I didn't think they grew this big. I think I can come up with an appropriate award for this.
Narthran Two-Blades awards you the title, "Bane of the Blessed".
Greetings.
I collect certain rare trophies from our adversaries on Freebooter Isle and the Moarsman City dedicated to T'thuun. If you find one of these trophies, bring it to me and I will reward you for it.
I see you have brought me an honorable trophy from conflict. Let me see...
Hiro Sawatogo peers into the dead eyes of the severed head.
Tch'Keryk the Emissary? Truly a worthy kill. Please, accept this humble gift in exchange for the service you have done our Society.
Hiro Sawatogo awards you the title, "Negotiator".
Hiro Sawatogo examines the large head, spending some time peering into the lifeless eyes.

There was much power in this one. Much dark power indeed. The death of this abomination is good for all of Dereth, not just our society. Please, accept this humble gift in exchange for the service you have done our Society.
Hiro Sawatogo awards you the title, "Bane of the Blight".
Tchk'Tain the Tender? Truly a worthy kill. Please, accept this humble gift in exchange for the service you have done our Society.
Hiro Sawatogo awards you the title, "Defender of the Deru"
Hiro Sawatogo awards you the title, "Bane of the Blessed".

I collect certain rare trophies from our adversaries on Freebooter Isle and the Moarsman City dedicated to T'thuun. If you find one of these trophies, bring it to me and I will reward you for it.
Ahh, the head of the infamous Tch'Keryk the Emissary. The Mistress will be gladdened to hear of his demise. Please, accept this for your service.
Marek al-Evv awards you the title, "Negotiator".
Ahh, the head of the infamous Blight-caller. The Mistress will be gladdened to hear of his demise. Please, accept this for your service.
Marek al-Evv awards you the title, "Bane of the Blight".

Marek al-Evv awards you the title, "Defender of the Deru"
Ahh, the head of the infamous Giant Blessed Moarsman. The Mistress will be gladdened to hear of his demise. Please, accept this for your service.
Marek al-Evv awards you the title, "Bane of the Blessed".
Greetings.
I collect certain rare trophies from our adversaries on Freebooter Isle and the Moarsman City dedicated to T'thuun. If you find one of these trophies, bring it to me and I will reward you for it.

%tn has proven to be a true Master of Exploration, having found all 100 markers, hidden over, under and around Dereth! Let it be henseforth known that %tn is truly an Elite Explorer!

Hello traveler, my name is Sean, I'm a member of the Explorers Society. I've spent years exploring the wonders of Dereth. There are many interesting corners of Dereth that sadly go unvisited, but that's why I'm here.

In order to introduce others to the joy of exploration I've placed markers on, above and below Dereth. If you feel the urge to explore you may come across a few of these Exploration Markers like the one next to me here. Come see me when you've found at least 10 of them and I'll reward you.
Go ahead and use this marker. I hope it will be the first of many you find while exploring the majesty of this world.

Over the past several months, I have been hiding more and more markers across this wondrous land. There are now a grand total of 100 markers hidden in the world, some of which are linked by theme. If you find all 100 markers, I may have something special for you.
Got a pack spot free? Very Well.
You need at least 1 pack spot free to trade this token for the backpack.
Let's see what you've found so far..

I bestow you with the title of Frozen Fighter.

You tell Tokashi of your adventures inside the crag.
You've come a long way and done so much for us. This is the least I can do to reward you.
We have quite a bit of work ahead of us. Hopefully we'll some day be able to discern what happened here.
This Ja'qu you talked about. I wish only that he could remember... we could learn so much from him.
I've been sent to head up the research in this area however I am not able to make significant advancements on my own.
It's been decided that I should bring others in to assist with the exploration and research about the creatures and crystals in this region.
I've also been able to recover crystalline shards in the remains of the wisps. They'll assist our research and I'll reward you for bringing them to me.
If you find any unique wisps they may have unique crystalline shards that I'd be able to grant you a greater reward in exchange for it.
There are also a few locations that I have not been able to reach on my own. If you can reach these places you may find great reward there.
Return to me with any objects you may find. Talk to my associates about any other rewards.
Now get out there and have an adventure!

This crystal contains the remaining essence of the wisp it was recovered from. I thank you greatly and here is your reward.
You have discovered ten of these crystals. We can make use of these. You've done excellent work, thank you and here's your reward.
Quite the discovery. Please return to me when you have 10 of these and I'll reward you for them.

Excellent work in your hunt. We'll find your reports very useful.
Congratulations! You are now truly a Wisp Whipper.
You haven't made enough progress in your hunt yet. Return to me when you have killed 100 or more wisps in this region.
I'm here as a hunter and to assist Ando in his research. Go out and kill 100 Wisps in this area and I will reward you.

We need warriors that have no fear to find a way into those pyramids and find out what is going on.
If you find any of those stones they were collecting before please bring them to me so that we may study them.
Collect 30 of each type of stone you find and I'll reward you for your trouble.

greetings: Truly? You wish to surrender this magnificent and elegant weapon?
Very well, as you like it...
quest: You have already purified the scrolls for me! I can ask you for no more. You have brought peace to my family, and for that you have my eternal gratitude.
Have you made your way to the Chamber of the Scrolls in the southern mountains at 52.2S, 63.2E yet?

Greetings! I can see you have aided my clan in the sensitive matter of the Temple of Black Waters. I am Tanada Sajo. You have aided us once before, so I must ask for your help again. Though your actions at the Temple of Black Waters helped free the majority of our clan from the thrall of Aerbax, another important task remains.

Because Aerbax succeeded in corrupting the Masters of Air, Earth, and Water, he was able to steal the scroll of each House. Only my uncle's House of Fire remained uncorrupted. Aerbax has locked the scrolls inside infernal devices of his own creation and continues to try to influence the acolytes of the orders through them. We cannot appoint new Masters of the schools until the scrolls are recov...
I am sorry, but unless you helped us in the matter of the Temple of Black Water, I cannot trust you on sensitive clan matters.

Well done! All three scrolls recovered. I would reward you myself, but my uncle, the Master of the House of Fire, wishes to see you. With no further delay, I shall take the scrolls from you and send you to see my uncle, Tanada Han-Tu.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.
Return to me when you have all 3 scrolls.

greetings: Greetings. My name is Jusad, and I have come to this place in order to collect bundles of the Mana-infused Jungle Flowers for my colleagues.
For every bundle of 10 Mana-infused Jungle Flowers that you bring to me, I will reward you.
Do not bring me the larger lilies. I do not have any requests for those at this time.
quest: Thank you. Here is your reward for this bundle of flowers.
If you have more bundles of flowers, I'll take them whenever you wish to part with them.
Return to me when you have collected 10 Mana-infused Jungle Flowers.

greetings: Welcome to the stinkiest, slimiest, waste of a landmass I ever had the displeasure to set foot upon. I've never seen so many ugly fish-men in one place...
All that aside. My colleagues left me to rot here in order to collect these Blight-encrusted Black Coral chunks which seem to wash up on this poor excuse for a sandbar.
If you bring me 10 of these coral chunks, I'll happily reward you for them. Saves me from having to run around getting them myself
Oh, don't mind my mask, it keeps out the smell...
quest: Ahh, a stack of 10 Blight-encrusted Black Coral chunks. You didn't break any of these to make multiple pieces, did you?
If you have any more stacks of Blight-encrusted Black Coral, I'll take them, 10 at a time.
Whats this? Bring me 10 at a time you cheapskate! Get back out there and find more.. so I dont have to.

greetings: Hello, and welcome! I offer the chance of a new rare gem, every time is a winner! If you'd like to get a pull from the bag of gems just hand me two MMDs and then a rare gem. In return you will get a new rare gem or a grand casino key.
quest: You've already paid! Now all I need from you is a rare gem for you to get a pull from the bag of gems.
Please give me an MMD first, then try handing me this rare gem again.
Great! Now all I need from you is a rare gem for you to get a pull from the bag of gems.
I am sorry, You need two MMD notes as payment to exchange rare gems. When you have two, hand me this note again.
I hope you got something you wanted, if not why not try again?

greetings: You can't fool me!  This is the copy I gave you. I give you credit for your attempted cleverness, but I am too alert, friend.
quest: You have already retrieved that very troubling message shard for me... There is no more I can ask of you.
I must have misplaced my notes... Did I not already ask you investigate the strange facility at 48.7S, 68.9W and bring me whatever intelligence you gather?
Good work, my friend! I knew I could count on you!
Aruq takes a moment to read the translated message.

Zounds! What a fell plot the rebel Virindi are hatching here! I am glad you were able to escape with this critical intelligence. I will send it on to my superiors on the Royal Council. No doubt they will dispatch scouts as soon as possible to comb the lands for these Nexuses they speak of. I imagine the secret societies will be quite interested in this as well... But here, here is your reward....

On further consideration, I should also give you a copy of this translation, for your own records... And perhaps you can help spread the word, if you belong to a secret society, that the Virindi rebels are rising to threaten Dereth again!

Aha! A doughty Derethian warrior! You may be just the person to help me here... There is a strange new fortified location in the Direlands, guarded by fearsome Gotrok Lugians! It is quite strange to see renegades outside their normal bailiwick in the southern mountains, and our scouts report that these monsters are even more powerful than the others of their ilk that we have previously surveyed.

We suspect, based on geomantic emanations from that location, that they are working at the behest of rebel Virindi again, but we need an intrepid adventurer such as yourself to personally infiltrate the installation and gather intelligence. Could you do this for us? Journey to the depths of the new Gotrok fortress in the Direlands at 48.7S, 68.9W and bring back whatever message shards you can f...
Ah, Diyas translated the shard for you? Please hand it over, I am most curious to see what it will reveal...
Please return to me when you are stronger.
You expect me to forgive you so soon? Death's a business and business has been a little too good for you. Come back next week and maybe I will change my mind.
I will keep this, too. Let that be a reminder to you that forgiveness isn't free.
I have already given you enough of these useful things for this week.

Death's a business. This is something I definitely understand. I'll forgive you of your transgressions against me for now but if you do it again it'll cost you more coin and I'm only willing to let you redeem yourself once a week.
In the grasp of the wicked you can often find useful things. I took this key from one who stood against our point of view after I slew him in single combat.
As a precaution I can only give you one of these every week.
I looted this off the corpse of a man I killed just outside the Black Market. I took it from his grasp as I watched the life drain out of his eyes when he was pulled back to his lifestone.
You are now a member of an elite fraternity of assassins.
As a member of this fraternity you may display the title of Assassin.
You have been granted the title of Assassin.
Go forth and dispatch those who stand against your authority.
This is your duty as a Death Dealer.
You have been granted the title of Death Dealer.
You've come a long way to find me.
Be it through intelligence will or brute force, it matters not.
What does matter is the business that we deal in, the business of death.
Creed will supply you with the things you need to hold a position in our ranks.
Do you have what it takes to stand amongst the members of this elite fraternity of killers?
Get over here!
I'll have nothing to do with you.
I have been offended by your actions.
Creed may have something that will get you back in my good graces... but it'll cost you.

greetings: I have built up a large stockpile of level eight spell components. If you would like a chance to trade a component you do not need for a new one it will cost you one MMD and the spell component you wish to exchange.
quest: You've already paid! Now all I need from you is a spell component for a chance to trade components.
Great! Now all I need from you is a component you would like to exchange.
Please give me an MMD first, then try handing me this component again.
I hope you got something you wanted, if not why not try again?
You have already been attuned with the portal's energy and may enter.
You have been awarded the title of "Darkness in the Light"
You have been awarded the title of "I Am Darktide"
You have been awarded the title of "Bathed in Blood"
You have been awarded the title of "Player Slayer"
Behind me is the entrance to the Derethian Combat Arena. This is a dungeon filled with devices to aid in combat.

Upon entering the dungeon you will receive a Mark. Collect 10 of these Marks to turn in at the statue located in the bottom of the arena to receive a Durable Legendary Key, Luminance, and a few MMD Trade Notes.
However if you die in the dungeon all of your marks will drop allowing another player to reap the reward for all your hard work.
If you have already been in the arena you may turn in any remaining Marks for 2 MMDs each.
If you wish to enter this arena give me 4 MMDs and I will attune you to the portal's energy.
You are not yet ready for the Derethian Combat Arena.
The Derethian Combat Arena is not open at this time.
You have now been attuned with the portal's energy and may enter.

greetings: Yes, well done, this must have belonged to the Master of the Apostate Nexus. It only takes a few alterations, and a realignment of the energy lattice contained therein...
If you don't like that, or find it less than useful, you can give it back to me in exchange for some practical training.
This is very interesting indeed.
I've been working with a substance called Aetherium, we actually sent a shipment to Mar'uun to assist in their experiments before it vanished.
I put togeather several diagrams and several notes for the researchers based off their notes.
Take my note to Marcus, it'll help him determine the cause of the accident.
My personal theory is that they used the Aetherium in a way that destabilized portal space...
Sundering a barrier between the planes of existance and time...
Truely shocking.
As I suspected, it seems their calculations about the resonant properties and volatility of aetherium were off.
I've corrected their calculations in this note. Please deliver it to Marcus.
I am also suggesting that they hold their experiments for the time being, at least until we know more.
quest: Please return to me later I may need your assistance.
You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.

Congratulations! I've already been able to see, through my instruments, that you have successfully infiltrated the Apostate Nexus and placed my resonator in their deposit of purified Aetherium. This is exactly what I needed to keep track of the Apostates' activities for the Arcanum. The realm is grateful. Allow me to reward you...
If you picked up a mask from the master of that facility, you can give it to me and I'll make it useable for a human.

Excellent! You can help me! We in the Arcanum think the Virindi Apostates are up to no good, but we're not sure what they're doing. It all seems to be involved with this rare Aetherium metal that's been recently discovered. We think they are stockpiling great quantities of the ore, but we do not know what they intend to do with it. We need a doughty adventurer like yourself to seek out a deposi...

We have traced some suspicious energy patterns to the old Nexus discovered during the days of Bael'Zharon's rise. This facility may hold some clue to the location of a Virindi Apostate storehouse. Seek out the Nexus portal in the Direlands at 40.1S, 79.2W, investigate the facility, and see if you can find a way from there to the Apostate deposits. Once there, you can place this Aetheric resonat...
Have you placed the Aetheric resonator within the deposit yet?
Seek out the Nexus portal in the Direlands at 40.1S, 79.2W.
Very well. If I were you I'd prefer to hold on to such a remarkable souvenir of my exploits, but I suppose you get a lot more excitement than I do.
Did you misplace your Aetheric resonator? No problem, I have another one for you.
Place this Aetheric resonator within the deposit, and I will be able to monitor their activities for the Arcanum.
I'm sorry, I'm looking for help with a bit of geomantic investigation, but I'm afraid you're not strong enough to help me.
Hey! It doesn't look to me like you still have the Nexus Crawler Mask any more... What are you trying to pull here?
Let me know if you change your mind.

greetings: We are so grateful for all the support our family has received. Unfortunatly I am betting we haven't seen the last of that evil man.
I don't see what the complaining is about, this armor looks fine to me. I think people were making trouble for the sake of making trouble.
quest: You want to hear the story of the Unknown Warrior huh?
Well I will share this part of the story with you, this very town was attacked by his foot soldiers not too long ago.
They were searching for me. However my family and I had moved over to Lin, knowing we were being hunted.
It didn't take long for them to track me down and I faced them head on in attempts to save the innocent townsfolk from their abuse.
However they made off with my wife during the battle. And that was when we found the hideout...
Well, come back when you're stronger, and I might share it.

greetings: Greetings. The Blackmist family has accepted the position of investigators of the paranormal for the Arcanum.
quest: The magic in the area seem less corrupt. Due to your efforts I can continue my studies. Perhaps tomorrow I will need more help.

The recent unearthing of Mhoire Castle has left unusual paranormal disturbances in the rubble left behind. These unseen spirits corrupt the magic in this area. I need you to find and destroy the spirits there. Unfortunately the spirits are invisible and incorporeal.
I have developed two pieces of arcane equipment to locate and banish these spirits.
The Crystal of Spectral blood will glow red when it detects a spirit. If the spirit is close it will whisper to you.
The Skull of One Thousand Torments can destroy these spirits. The problem is you must be very close to a spirit for it to work. It alos takes a few seconds to recharge.
You must figure out the location of these spirits using the crystal and destroy three of them. Nothing will be left except for their corrupted, spectral hearts.
When you have obtained three hearts as proof that you have destroyed them hand one to me and I will reward you for your efforts.
Have you destroyed three of these invisible spirits and retrieved their hearts? If not you can find them in the rubble under Mhoire Castle now that it has risen into the sky.
If you have the hearts then hand one to me.
I don't know why you are giving these to me but thank you.
Excellent! I can now finish my studies! Take these tokens as a reward. The nobles have asked the Arcanum to acknowledge this reward and trade 10 of these tokens with forge keys.
I have a very busy schedule. Aren't you a bit... inexperienced to be traveling in this area?
Your level must be at least 100 to be eligible for this quest.
How did you manage to lose my Jewel? Here's another. Be careful not to lose it.
How did you manage to lose my Skull? Here's another. Be careful not to lose it.

greetings: What's this?
... but, this is my hand writing.
I never wrote this.
Marcus talked to me about this, but I didn't really believe him.
So, we really all do die?
Rips up the scrap of paper.
Hell with this. I'm gonna live!
Wonderful, look at this workmanship.
I just need to...
There we go. This will work wonderfully.
Keep bringing me parts like this and I might just fall in love...
This machine really is a beauty, how could I not!
Beautiful piece of work isn't she?
Kaywin looks at the machine quizzically.
No matter how many time I fix her she just seems to keep breaking down.
A friend of mine found that list, it's full of wonderful things I could use. With my skills and those parts I could keep her running indefinitely.
How am I supposed to fix this with nothing but naught? Maybe I'll get a few more pieces of alloy today... that'd be so great!
quest: You're really dedicated, I appreciate that in a person!
You have been awarded the title of Dedicated!
Oh, I could always use more pieces...
Hey! Maybe if you bring me enough I could come up with a little something special for ya, ya know?
Oh, I see you're here for Marcus's latest requests.
Truely wonderful gadgets.
One is used to open rifts. It's a crazy sight to behold... you'll be ripped directly into the rift.
The other is used to close rifts once you are inside. I can't truly say what that's like...
Beautiful piece of work isn't she?
Kaywin looks at the machine quizzically.
No matter how many time I fix her she just seems to keep breaking down.
A friend of mine found that list, it's full of wonderful things I could use. With my skills and those parts I could keep her running indefinitely.
How am I supposed to fix this with nothing but naught? Maybe I'll get a few more pieces of alloy today... that'd be so great!

greetings: I can't tell you how happy I am to know that you're going to help us.
I was so afraid I would die...
Now I know it's going to be okay with all these people assisting.
... You are helping us right?
Wren seems preoccupied.
Uh, I can't talk right now.
Please leave me be.
I can't even start to tell you how much we appreciate all the help we've received from the great adventurers of Dereth.
Marcus changed our experiments thanks to the information we received from the Arcanum though it wasn't all in time.
We've been left with rifts coming through trying to merge the elemental planes with our own.
Luckily we're only dealing with the base four elements and we can control this.
quest: There does not seem to be more you can do to convince Wren.
Thank you for your assistance as a test subject. We could use more good subjects like you.
You think you have already done everything you can here for now.
It seems like a good idea to check back in a day's time.
If time progresses in this lost place the people here will soon learn more.
The process has been prepared. When you are ready use the test portal.
Please talk to Marcus about our work and then return to me if you would like to help.
You tell Wren about the things you've seen in Mar'uun and her coming demise.
She seems disturbed by your story.
I'm really not certain who you are, but we're trying to work here. Please leave me alone!
This is never going to work...
When do we expect to get new test subjects?
Where did I place those documents...
Examination in process.
I'm examining the modulation of the portal... now.
We'd greatly appreciate any assistant. We need unique test subjects...
...I mean volunteers.
I've been helping Marcus revise our experimental protocols.
We're certain that we're going to make this work. We've temporarily aborted our plans to experiment with aetherium until we've learned more.
Now I know it's going to be okay with all these people assisting.
Please deliver that note to the Arcanum for me.
This note is going to assist us greatly.
Give me a few seconds to read this over and write a reply.
You describe to Marcus the contents of the note from the Aetherium.
It would have been much more helpful if you could have brought us the note...
But the information you brought me and the information I've received from others should be enough.

Thank you for all your assistance. We have gathered what we can from our understanding of your personal properties, the sum of the things you've done and how that interacted with our experimental portals.
You think you have already done everything you can here for now.
Talk to my assistant if you would like to help further our understanding of portals.
Starting next iteration...
Sorry about that, I needed to finish initializing the current iteration of our portal experiments.
Our current experimentation is intended to further understand and possibly bypass the restrictions of certain portals.
This is only our current round of experiments. We're hoping to unlock all the secrets of portal space and time.
You can talk to me again if you would like to assist us.
Process complete. Observe the results and make the proper notations.
You tell Marcus about what you've seen in Mar'uun.
We're here to do serious research, I'm really not interested in your ghost stories.
You think you need to find some way to make him believe you.
It seems like a good idea to check back in a day's time.
If time progresses in this lost place the people here will soon learn more.
It seems like it would be a good idea to talk to the assistant as well.
You tell Marcus about the Virindi, Jean and Luc who will soon be moving into town.
You expect me to believe that Virindi are going to materialize here out of the blue?
I'm not certain which of your stories is the least likely...
You elect not to tell Marcus about the Virindi, it may be best not to upset him any further.
Continue to monitor the mana flow.
We're never going to make any progress at this rate. We need to bring in some test subjects.
Examining portal differential.
We need to examine the properties associated with this modulation.
Don't get discouraged and be patient.
We should have more subjects any time now. This place has no lack of adventurers.
We need to stay organized to maintain the validity of our experiments.
Make sure that the note is delivered and returned to me.
If you're correct this is a matter of life and death.
I'm uncertain as to how you knew there would be Virindi named Luc and Jean coming to our town...
This certainly does lend credence to your stories.
Take this note to an Arcanum Researcher. I think they can help.
If we're displaced in time you may find it difficult to reach us again.
From what you've told me it seems like it may take about a week before you can reach us again if time shifts.
Many adventurers have come through here telling stories much like the stories you told me...
It would be reckless of me not to think that these things may be true.
We received a shipment of aetherium.
I had intended to use it in our experiments, it would have been ground breaking...
But thanks to this information from the Arcanum we'll have to adjust our experiments.
This note describes how the Arcanum thinks aetherium will effect our experiments.
We'd previously scheduled the addition of the aetherium substance in our tests.
We're going to have to back over our calculations... I still think this can work.
Please come back and see me again later... if everything I suspect is correct you've saved us all.
Return to Mar'uun in its original location. You'll have to compensate for the variance in time again.
You are truely an adventurer of space and time. You have been granted the title of Timeless Adventurer.
You explain to Marcus the contents of the note you received from the Arcanum.
It would have been great if you could have delivered the actual notes.
I'm going to have to take your word on this. But it seems that aetherium has a possibly volatile reaction with our research.
We'll have to look through our experiments again... possibly we can make this work.
Any further exposure may cause catastrophic consequences.
My calculations say that you'll have to wait at least a day from your last exposure to the elemental planes.
Adventurers into the elemental planes act as an anchor, rooting it. Any one individual spending too much time in the elemental planes will cause it to become coterminous with our own plane.
Trust me, that's something we don't want but we must close these rifts...
Luckily we stopped our experiments before we tapped into any planes beyond the four basic elemental planes.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Excellent, you've closed all the rifts.
The Arcanum has given these to reward those who aid our call for help.
This won't be the end of the rifts. By my calculations you'll be able to assist us again in over a day's time.
Our experiments opened rifts to the elemental planes.
We need to seal these rifts...
I've commissioned the creation of several items to my specifications.
Go see Kaywin and she'll provide you with what you need.
However, the exposure of someone such as yourself to the elemental planes might have catastrophic consequences.
You should come back when you are more powerful.
I've paid you the bounty for culling the prison population too recently. I am not authorized to pay it again yet.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
For culling the moarsman prisoner population here's the bounty you're owed.
I've paid you the bounty for the Ardent leader too recently. I am not authorized to pay it again yet.
For putting down the Ardent leader here's the bounty you're owed.
Talk to me again once you've completed all my tasks for an additional bounty.
I've paid you the bounty for the Blessed leader too recently. I am not authorized to pay it again yet.
For putting down the Blessed leader here's the bounty you're owed.
I've paid you the bounty for the Verdant leader too recently. I am not authorized to pay it again yet.
For putting down the Verdant leader here's the bounty you're owed.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm prisoners.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm prisoners and I will reward you.
I'm authorized to pay a bounty for culling the population of escaped moarsmen prisoners by twenty.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Large Ardent Moarsman.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Large Ardent Moarsman and I will reward you.
I'm authorized to pay a bounty for the death of the Ardent moarsman leader.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Large Blessed Moarsman.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Large Blessed Moarsman and I will reward you.
I'm authorized to pay a bounty for the death of the Blessed moarsman leader.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Large Verdant Moarsman.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Large Verdant Moarsman and I will reward you.
I'm authorized to pay a bounty for the death of the Verdant moarsman leader.
You do not meet the requirements to do this task, grow stronger and return.

greetings: I'll open the gate to let you in. Once you're inside the best way out may be to simply recall. If you can call to me from inside the door I'll open it for you to let you out.
Quickly, pass through the door before the prisoners are roused to strike out against us.

Yes, this is exactly what I was looking for! It reveals some of the plans of the Apostates. Daring of them to be attempting to construct a New Singularity after the failure of Levistras. Now we know why they are so interested in this Aetherium ore...
And Lord Asheron will want to know immediately about the lost Primus. Well done indeed. You have my gratitude. And I have not forgotten the rewards I promised you...
And for your own edification, since you seem to have taken an interest in this particular threat to the realm, I will give you your own copy of the translation.
quest: You've helped me before, haven't you? I am still analyzing the information I found in the Apostate message shard you brought me.

Hrm, you look to be a tough enough adventurer to suit my purposes.  The realm needs you!  The Apostate Virindi have been working on something in secret for some time, and we have been unable to find out what they are up to.  But scouts have brought back word of some new dig site in the Direlands where the Virindi are excavating an ancient site that hails from the days before the Olthoi invasion.
Please find the pit at 24.6 S, 56.2 W and bring me back whatever intelligence you can find.  I will reward you handsomely for your effort.

Ah, you have a message shard taken from the Apostate Excavation Master in charge of the dig site?  Well done, but there is one more thing you must do.  Please bring it to Diyas al-Yat for translation.
So you have the Apostate Excavation Master's message shard, translated by Diyas al-Yat?  Please hand it over.  Then I can reward you and report my findings to the Arcanum.
I've asked you to investigate the Virindi excavation site in the Direlands at 24.6 S, 56.2 W.  Have you done so yet?
Sorry friend, I am seeking the assistance of someone a little tougher than you are...

greetings: Thank you, but I can read the original. That's for your collection, and for posterity.
Fascinating!
These appear to be exceptionally advanced when compared even to the most intricate Empyrean Golems. I've never seen anything like this.
Nurino sets the large gear aside and examines the head very carefully.
There seems to be a great deal of interlocked parts in this head...
What's this? Some sort of socket? Hmmm...
Nurino pulls out a book, flipping quickly through the pages and comparing diagrams to the socket in the head.
It just might work...

In my studies, I've heard of a gem that should fit in this socket. The last known owner of this gem was the undead, Rytheran. As, last I heard, he was having problems in the Direlands, why don't you go, um, explore for this gem in his Library. if you happen to find this strange gem, and happen to accidently pocket it and return to me, we can see if I can make this golem function.

You should begin your search for the Mana Gem in Rytheran's Library. It's the only place where I've heard reports of a gem that matches the general dimensions of the socket I found in the head of this golem-like contraption.
Beautiful! It looks like it'll fit!"
Nurino flips the head over in his hand, working the gem into the socket with the other.
Now, we'll see if this works..."
With a whirring click, the head begins to generate small internal lights and a crackling sound.
The Gear Knight Head yells, "Have at thee!"
The Gear Knight Head yells, "This is one Gear Knight you won't defeat so easily!"
The Gear Knight Head says, "Oh, where am I?"
The Gear Knight Head begins to spit out sparks.
The Gear Knight Head says, "Initiating diagnostic scan... Massive internal and external damage. Missing 95% of systems. Status: Critical."
The Gear Knight Head says, "Well, this is unfortunate..."
The Gear Knight Head spits out a gout of sparks and smoke.
The Gear Knight Head says, "Seek the *crack* book! Lyceum... Knorr... Tome. Directions... for *fizzle* Healing... Us."
The Gear Knight Head says, "Aetherium Core Failure. Shutting down..."
Oh my...
This seems to be a lot more than a Golem.
If I could garner your assistance once again, I was wondering if you could go retrieve this tome the Gear Knight head mentioned. If it still exists, it could be the key to bringing this being back.

If this book is a guide for these beings, these Gear Knights, then it was likely a highly valued tome. Things of such an occult nature were usually stored, as I've been told by other adventurers who've been there, in the deeper sections of the Lyceum.
If you could find your way into the Lyceum of Knorr, and find this occult tome, we may be able to unravel this mystery once and for all.
I'll be here if you need me, seeing what I can make of these parts...
Very well, I can always use this for my research. I can reward you thusly instead.
quest: Thank you again for your assistance. In all my researches, I never expected to find an entire sentient race of golem-like creatures. I could spend my entire life researching and studying these Gear Knights!
Have you found the tome mentioned by the head?
Before it... fizzled, the head noted the existence of a book in the Lyceum of Knorr. I leave it up to you to find your way to Knorr and retrieve this occult tome.
Look in the deeper sections. The more valued an item was in the Lyceum, the deeper in it was placed.
Were you able to retrieve the gem from Rytheran's Library?
Fascinating. Of course, it's written in Empyrean, and in the rather esoteric hand of a true scholar of mysteries. Let me take that and see if I can translate it for us both.

This is amazing! The whole first section of this book appears to be a documentary of the Empyrean exploration of the Gear Knight world, as well as their interaction with the Gear Knights, up through the Olthoi Invasion and the collapse of the Portal Network!

I've never seen such a detailed study of a race of beings before. The whole second half of this book is filled with diagrams and notes on how these Gear Knights work. I don't even know where to begin...
Oh, sorry. I almost forgot you there for a minute. Please, let me give you this copy of the history. I'm afraid these diagrams defy simple translation.
Also, I was able to fashion this large gear into something you may find useful.
Greetings.

My name is Nurino. I am a researcher for the Arcanum who specializes in ancient constructs. I've recently heard both rumors and reports of some strange parts being seen that could be a portion of some ancient form of Golem. I would be very interested in piecing together the truth of these rumors, and if they are true, piecing together this Golem itself.

The majority of the reports have come from adventurers who were dealing with some problem with thugs. I sent a scout to look in the areas reported, but the pieces seem to have been moved. Perhaps the pieces can be found wherever these thugs have gone?
Were you able to retrieve the pieces from the Thug Hideout?
You are not powerful enough to aid me, adventurer.

greetings: A most interesting find! From what you tell me, the Apostates were ambushing these clockwork soldiers, Gear Knights as you call them, and harvesting their Aetherium for their own purposes. And to use Simulacra to do it, so the Gear Knights blamed us Isparians for it...
Whatever else they are, these Apostates are very clever.
I must send news to the Arcanum and to Lord Asheron, and all the royal council... What a discovery!
quest: Thank you for your interest, but I think you have already helped me quite well in the matter of the gutted Virindi facility. I need nothing more from you at the moment.
I've asked you to investigate the Apostate Virindi facility in northwestern Osteth.  Did you forget the location?  It is at 40.1 N, 50.9 W.

Hail, friend! Are you as concerned about the Apostate Virindi threat to Dereth as I am? If you are, I would ask you to investigate a site in northwestern Osteth that seems to be the source of some very interesting energy emanations.
Seek the site at 40.1 N, 50.9 W, investigate it to its deepest levels, and bring me back anything interesting that you find. You will be well rewarded.

Fascinating! So you discovered some kind of hostile metal men in that dungeon? And they've destroyed the Apostate facility I asked you to investigate? Well, that's quite a development. I see you brought back some kind of souvenir from your excursion. I'd love to analyze it to learn more about these clockwork soldiers. May I have it? I will reward you, of course...

greetings: I still can not believe that complete strangers would risk their own lives to rescue me from that dungeon. The kindness of strangers is truly amazing.
quest: Thank you once again for saving me, you are so kind.
Thank you ever so much for releasing me and finding the antidote to the poison.
I must leave here quickly and find my family, please take this reward as a small token of my appreciation.
I think I am dying, please save me!
Please get me out of here! You don't know what they do to us, it is terrible!
Oh thank you, I'm feeling much better already, I think that did the trick.
Get me out of here please!
Oh thank you, I'm... not feeling so well.
He gave me something, something I think is killing me. I am feeling weaker by the minute, please find a cure.

greetings: Once you use this gem you'll be able to land critical hits more frequently. You'll crit 1% more frequently.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription first. I don't want to hear you complain if you use this gem without being fully aware of the repercussions.
I've discovered an attack technique that increases the chance of your attack hitting a critical location.
Bring me a blank augmentation gem and I will teach you my secret.
All you need to do is use this gem. Then you will increase the damage from all your attacks.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
With training you can learn to make all of your attacks hit harder.
All I need from you is a blank augmentation gem. Bring one to me and I will share my secrets with you. I promise, you will be glad that you did.
Use this gem to reduce the amount of damage you take from attacks. Make sure you read the gem's inscription first, though.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
If you want to discover the secret of reducing the amount of damage you take from attacks bring me a blank augmentation gem.
You can get a blank augmentation gem from Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands.
When you use this gem, you will no longer require a focus to cast Creature Enchantment spells. Read the gem's description before you use it though.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
You want to cast Creature Enchantment spells without the use of a focus? Go to Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands. Bring me a blank augmentation gem and I'll see if I can help you out.
I have enhanced the gem so that it can teach you how to use Life Magic without a Focus.
Be sure to read the gem's inscription before you use it.

I can teach you how to use Life Magic without the use of a Focus. I can teach it to you, but I will need an augmentation gem. Visit Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you have not already acquired one of these gems.
Take in the essence of this gem in order ot cast Item Enchantment spells without the use of a Focus.
Be sure to read the gem's inscription before you use it.
I'll teach you the way of casting Item Enchantment spells without the use of a Focus. Bring me an augmentation gem and I shall inscribe it for you.
You might ask Fiun Rehlyun of the Halaetan Islands about augmentation gems if you do not have one.
In using this gem you'll increase your skills with all of your melee weapons.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it. This sort of power is not given cheaply.
With an augmentation gem I can inscribe for you ancient teachings that will increase your abilities with all melee weapons. Visit Fiun Rehlyun if you don't already have a blank gem.
If you use this, you will learn more from the challenges that you overcome.
But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
I've trained with the greaters masters of offensive magics. I'll be able to instruct you in how to use War Magic without a Focus if you desire.
You may speak to the Fiun who calls itself Rehlyun in order to find out how to get a blank augmentation gem.
This gem will allow you to understand air patterns and use this knowledge to increase your skill with projectile attacks. Read the inscription on the gem.
You can improve the accuracy of your projectile attacks through the understanding of air, I can teach you this. Give me a blank augmentation gem and I'll prepare the gem with this knowledge for you.

Using this gem will teach you my trick to increasing your magical skills. But make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it. I can't be held responsible for any long-lasting decisions you may mistakenly make.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.
I have a trick that will enhance all of your magics. But you will have to hand me a blank augmentation gem first.
Visit Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you do not already have an augmentation gem.
When you use this gem, you will learn to deal more damage to critical locations. However, make sure you read the gem's inscription before you use it.
Come visit me sometime and perhaps we can practice your newfound ability.

Anfram believes that his technique is superior, he may be able to land more critical blows but I've discovered the true form. My form will increase the damage you deal when you hit a critcal location.

I can teach you how to hit critical locations harder but you will first have to provide me with a blank augmentation gem. Speak with Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you have not done so already.

quest: Given the time it takes for these Squires to regroup, I'll have more work for you by this time tomorrow.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Congratulations, you survived and succeeded. Here, allow me to reward you for your assistance to our Queen.
Given the time it takes for these Knights to regroup, I'll have more work for you by this time tomorrow.

You have the thanks of the Royal Guard. The Gearknight Knights you destroyed here have helped considerably in quelling this invasion force. If you come back later, I'll have more work for you by this time tomorrow.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Squires.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Squires and I will reward you.

Greetings, I am Sir Yanov, and I am in charge of recruiting assistance against this mechanical invasion. If you wish to help me, just head over to the area these 'Gear Knights' have occupied. Thin their numbers for me and I'll reward you.
Kill 10 Gearknight Squires and I will reward you for your efforts.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Knights.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Knights and I will reward you.
Kill 10 Gearknight Knights and I will reward you for your efforts.
You do not meet the requirements to do this task, grow stronger and return.
Given the time it will take them to get a new leader into the area, I should have another task for you about this time tomorrow.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
I am pleased to see that you have been successful. Allow me to reward you for your assistance to the Crown.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm armoredillos.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm armoredillos and I will reward you.
Greetings, I am Dame Trielle, of Queen Elysa's Knights. I've been sent here to organize the disruption of the Gear Knight forces by eliminating key leadership.
Near the center of these invading forces, you'll find a Gear Knight called the Iron Blade Commander. Go kill him, and I'll reward you.
I'm afraid the tasks I have are too difficult for you at this time, come back when you are more experienced.

greetings: T'ing Douzen examines the piece while you explain where it came from.
Well, this is a fascinating piece. You say is came from a larger Gear Knight called an Overseer?
I've heard mention of these particular Gear Knights before. They are impressively strong.
Please, allow me to reward you appropriately for this. I'm sure it'll make one of the Arcanum Researchers very pleased and busy for some time.

Salutations, I am known as T'ing Douzen, and I have been sent here by the Arcanum to collect the Aetherium Power Cores dropped by the Gear Knights, and the Aetherium Ore they've been piling up in their excavations here.

greetings: Greetings!

To this end, I am rewarding adventurers for the collection of Aetherium Power Cores, Aetherium Ore, and Gears from the invading Gear Knights found in either the Direlands, or along the coast of the eastern shore of the Inner Sea.

To my left are the easier tasks, to my right are the harder tasks. If you go straight you'll find access to other tasks for which we won't be able to reward you but are worth the effort.

greetings: So you got the guts, do ya? Now, get out there and lash 'em good.

Forget all those long distance weapons these other guys use, I like to get in there where I can lash out at these bugs face to face.

Would they's help ya in some bug killin'. Words come down from the encampment set up in the valley over there. The ones where the new bugs are. Here it is, the all original slicing mace. Go to town on those bugs.
I love to get in a group of these bugs and swing my mace around wildly in all directions, I guess that's why they call me thrasher.

I've developed a new type of mace to make swinging it around even easier. Instead of a big flat head, I cut two blades out of olthoi caraces and stick them on the end of my maces. Pure slicing action.
There is no rush like running into a hive of bugs and slamming my mace into every last one of them, you want in on this? Then bring me a token from Wintermaine and I'll hook you up.
Here, a life magic version of Peda's wand.
A good day to you, I am here to assist Peda in her research of this place.
So far I have been able to modify Peda's research to allow one of her wands to be empowered by one who uses life magic.
Bring me a token from Wintermaine and I will provide you with one of these wands, we could use more trials.

I am Slasha. With my powerful Great Sword I can slasha right through one of them bugs in one swing and that is only the beginning. Stick two of those creatures in front of me and I will take them both on at once with ease.
If you want one of these powerful blades, bring me a token from Wintermaine and I will see what I can do for you.
This should let you get a kill or two, even at your low skill level.
I am the one known as Long-Shot.
I can hit the heart of a target at over 40 meters. You won't find a better shot then I.

I have developed a bow made from parts of these evil bugs. This bow will help even a person far below my own skills to strike a deadly blow into an olthoi. Bring me a token from Wintermaine and I will build you one of these bows.
Here is your olthoi-slaying casting device, as promised.
Hello young one, an auspicious day to you.

Peda is the agnomen I am often referred to. I did not think these rabble possessed the schooling to know a word so seldom used in order to make a nickname such as mine. Enough about my own personage, The Queen sent me to this wretched place to commence a study upon these aberrant olthoi while these ruffians are busy killing them.

A most potent energy flows through these bugs. So far my studies have led to the discovery of a process where I can create a casting device which has proven most efficacious in disabling olthoi. This device uses a thaumaturgic process enabling the energy to.... I apologize I have a tendency to expatiate a subject beyond the interests of my listeners.
Wintermaine has been tasked with aiding my research. Bring me a symbol of services rendered to him and I shall create one of these wonderous casting device that you may use to destroy olthoi.
Here's ya very own bug smasher.
Yea, What do ya want?
My name is Mac, who's asking?
Oh, you want to know the story behind this staff, well maybe I don't want to tell ya. I will say that it is the best bug killing weapon in these parts.

Unlike those other fools, I create my staves to give a good solid whack. Nothing like the sound of a staff smashing against an olthoi. I feel this type of damage works much better on the creatures then piercing or slashing.
Well, you don't seem as annoying as most people that come around so I will tell you what. Bring me a token from Wintermaine and I'll give you your own bug smasher.

Welcome into the Light. You now may gain inner Luminance from your adventures, if they be truly challenging to your strength.
This Luminance, in turn, may be used to empower both auras and items for your benefit.
You may always come to me, for the Path of the Yalain is open to all who have proven themselves to the Light.
In addition, you may also seek out one of the more... specialized... paths from the history of the Empyrean.
You must choose only one specialty path, for when you choose to walk one Path, you lose access to the others.
This book will explain the details.
I see that you have not yet chosen to walk one of the more specialized paths yet.
There are special benefits that can be gained by choosing to follow one of the Seers of the past cultures of the Empyrean.

The Seer of the Light Falatacot, the Shade of Lady Adja, can be found in the Cathedral of Ithaenc. Her specialties focus on furthering your resistance to damage, and your skill at the skills you have specialized in.

The Seer of the Dark Falatacot, Ka'hiri, can be found near the town of Sawato. Her specialties focus on furthering your ability to damage others, and your skill at the skills you have specialized in..
The Seer of the Dericost, Liam of Gelid, can be found in the entrance of Frore. His specialties focus on furthering your ability to damage others, and your ability to critically damage others.
The Seer of the Haebrean, Lord Tyragar, can be found in Silyun. His specialties focus on furthering your resistance to damage, and your resistance to critical damage.

As for myself, I will empower any and all who have proven themselves and absorbed the Luminance necessary to empower themselves or items to help them. I recommend also following one of the other, more specialized paths.
If you wish to leave one specialty path for another, speak with the Seer you wish to follow, and they will tell you what they require in order to induct you onto their Path.
Be warned, To change one's Path, once chosen, will disrupt your existing attunements to the Light. All of your specialty path auras will fade.
You may empower another Blank Augmentation Gem again in %tqt.
You cannot spend any more Luminance on skill credits.

Greetings, I am Nalicana, the Seer of the Yalain.

Due to several factors, including both the return of the... altered... Empyreans, as well as Geraine's manipulations of time via the Book of Eibhil, the Light has empowered several Seers, including myself.
We may, in turn, empower those who prove their worth to walk the ancient Empyrean Paths, and gain power from the Light itself, known as Luminance.

The different eras of Empyrean history have each empowered a Path, from our beginnings in the Paths of the Falatacot, through the more recent Dericost and Haebrean Paths, up to the Path of the Yalain.

To prove your worth, and be empowered to gain Luminance, my task for you is fairly straightforward. There is an Undead, known as Battle Lord Gregor. He is one of Geraine's top nobles, and is the overseer of the forces which now include the beings called Gurog.

Hidden deep in the area held by these Gurog, he organizes the forces Geraine has chosen to put forth. Find him, defeat him, and bring me his Mnemosyne. Contained therein, we hope to find much knowledge on what Geraine is up to.
The Gurog have emerged in an area of the mountains of Northern Osteth. You'll find the Battle Lord deep in the caves there.

If nothing else, we at least need to shut down the creation of these Bloodstones.
This ritual they mention worries me. Anything that involves the Archons and Geraine bodes very ill for the rest of us.
Sir Donovan reads the first couple of pages, but shuts the book once it moves into the technical creation of the Bloodstones.
Sometimes, Kuyiza amazes me.
I'll send this book to the Prince. With any luck, either he or Asheron will be able to make heads or tails of the notes.
As for this part Kuyiza noted. This I can do something about now.
I can use this enchantment she noted to protect you from the wards on this facility. Since you've succeeded in finding everything so far, it's only proper I let you see this through.

Find this Bloodstone Facility, do whatever you can to hamper their production. Better yet, see if you can find this 'Master Bloodstone' they mention. Bring me back proof of your success, and I'll make sure you are properly rewarded for it.
Now, as for this enchantment...

Sir Donovan mumbles a few words, while tracing a finger through the transcribed array. Then he reaches out and touches your forehead. A jolt of power passes through your body, making your hands and feet go numb for a moment.
Well, that seemed to work. Let us hope Kuyiza transcribed it properly...
Good luck!
Well, it looks like you were successful.
You've done well. That crystal radiates a ton of geomantic power. The Master Bloodstone must've been very powerful.
Here, let's see if we can put some of that power to work for you.
Sir Donovan pulls out some salvaged supplies, and converts a section of the shard into a rather delicate looking wand.
If you are not specialized in the use of Life Magics, I can reinforce the wand to make it a bit less delicate, but it'll weaken its effects slightly. Just hand it back to me and I'll do so.
Also, if you wish a reward other than the wand, hand me back the reinforced wand, and I'll release the Luminance trapped within the crystal and channel it into you.
Very well. Let's see if I can remember how Nalicana taught me to release the luminance in an item...
Sir Donovan concentrates, and the wand in his hands disintegrates. Then he reaches out and touches your forehead.
There. That worked pretty well.
Greetings.
My name is Sir Donovan. I have been dispatched here by Prince Borelean, in order to learn more about these mysterious Bloodstones that have been appearing in the area.
If you find any information pertaining to the Bloodstones, perhaps we can get to the bottom of this mystery.
quest: Very well. This will only take a moment.
