You must wait %tqt to assist me again.
You have another batch of information for me, wonderful.
Sir Learth chants for a moment, and there is a flare of energy that jumps from your hand to his.
Thank you again for your assistance. The more information we gain from the points, the better our chances of breaching their defenses.
I can sense the changes in the enchantment I placed upon you. I take it you found the points I asked you to?
Ahh, yes. You have found all of the points. I'm not skilled enough in Geomancy to read these findings, but Lord Asheron and the Prince should be able to decipher them.
I'll pass this info along to them. Thank you again for your assistance. Once we pinpoint the ritual and breach the wards, we'll have more work for you.
Any luck in finding these points?
Please return to me when you have found all 10 points.
Greetings, Citizen.
Lord Asheron, using several clues and occurrences, has determined that the Dericost Emperor, Geraine, is using a powerful ritual which is destabilizing both the mana and temporal flows of this world.

Due to the clue Sir Donovan found in the report on the Bloodstones, the Prince believes that the ritual mentioned is likely the one causing the disturbances my Lord Asheron has detected. This is why I am organizing the hunt for this site from here.

I am seeking adventurers who will help me put an end to this treacherous and dangerous ritual Geraine is performing. To that end, we must first locate this ritual, and pierce whatever defenses are guarding it.

My Lord Asheron tells me that to conduct a ritual of this magnitude in secret, they would need to have created a series of anchors, or points, with which to feed power to the ritual as well as shield it from outside magics.

These anchor points will most likely be made using something dear to the Dericost, though we have not confirmed what that may be yet. These points are also most likely in places of power where the undead are in control.

My Lord Asheron believes that there should be ten of these points, scattered throughout Dereth. Any less, and the mana flow would not be strong enough to empower a temporal ritual. Any more, and the energy flows of the wards themselves would be detectable.

As we do not yet know specifically what and where to seek, I am gathering any and all willing to help me in my goal. I will place an enchantment upon you, that should let you interact with these points, and draw information out of them which will allow Lord Asheron and the Prince to both pinpoint and breach the defensive magics of the ritual site.
Sir Learth chants softly for a moment, and a warm sensation flows over you.
That should do it. Hunt well, and good luck.
Please return to me once you are stronger.

I did, Lady Daenerah.
It has become increasingly dangerous to store these copies of the Book here.
We have decided it is best if they are hidden far from the castle at this point.
Borelean hands Lady Daenerah a rolled parchment.
Have all the books moved to that location, and make sure all further tomes are sent there as well.
And, Lady Daenerah, speak of this to no one.
The less opportunities the enemy has to hear of the Book's true location, the less likely they are to try to retrieve all of these copies.
It has to be here somewhere, it just has to be...
Borelean pours through copies of the Book, looking for something.
There just has to be a way in these copies to bring my wife back...
A whisper of a female voice echoes through the room, "Seek the path, my love. You will find the way to me."
I will not lose you, my love. No death in Dereth is permanent. There has to be a way...
Why can't I find it?
Borelean pours through book after book, lines of desperation etched deeply into his face.
A whisper of a female voice echoes through the room, "Seek the path, my love. You will find the way to me. Do not lose hope."
With all of the powers in this world, there has to be a way to make this work...
A whisper of a female voice echoes through the room, "You will find the path, my love. You will find your way to me."
Bah! These copies are useless. I must find the Book itself. I *need* the Book of Eibhil itself!

A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "You have called to me, by despair and blood, and I have come. If you will pay my price and learn my secrets, that which you seek can be returned to you. But, with all your soul, you must desire this above all else, and you must be willing to do all that must be done. The road is long, but all things are achievable."
I could get her back? Bring her back to life?
Borelean looks around the room, fear and hope both showing on his worn features.
A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "That and more, my love. That and much more."
Borelean stares intently at the Book of Eibhil, seeming deep in thought.
There has to be some way to perform this ritual without sacrificing another's life. There has to be.

A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "Without the spark of a fading spirit, her own spirit will be weakened, likely to the point where she cannot be revived. Would you let such a simple fear hold you back? What is the cost of one spirit compared to the return of your beloved wife?"
Borelean thinks for a moment, seeming conflicted.
No. There must be another way. What if several each gave of themselves willingly? From what you've said, the life energy needed for this ritual need not come from a single spirit.

A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "You would offer willing sacrifice? From several, as opposed to the totality of one? Very well, but each must swear by blood and spirit to me, and to me alone. Only then will there be enough power to attempt this."
It shall be done. I'll spread the word to my closest Knights and her Handmaidens. All will be sworn to secrecy, and those who volunteer willingly will join in the ritual.

You hear a whisper in your mind that Borelean does not seem to hear, "It is unorthodox, but done properly, and I will get to feast on the spirits of many. These fools know not what they offer, nor the totality of their price."
So many have answered the call, so many have come. With so many volunteers, the cost to each should be small. This will work.
A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "Yes, my love. Each will only have to offer a small shard of their spirit into the ritual itself."
All have sworn to you, by blood and spirit, as you asked. Let's do this.
The Book begins to glow more brightly, and a chant fills your mind, seeming to echo off the walls.

After a moment, a red light begins to slowly emanate from Hoshino Kei's body. As the light slowly grows in intensity, the chanting grows louder, and voices seem to join in, until it seems an entire chorus is calling her back.
Rise, My love! Come back to me!
With a loud crack, a new body forms over the old.
My love? Is that you?
What's wrong?
Borelean reaches out, but stops when he feels the cold radiating from Hoshino Kei.
You told me I could bring her back! What did you do to her!
An amused, mocking female voice echoes in your mind, "Foolish boy. I told her you could get her back, and you have. I never said I would return her to life."

An amused, mocking female voice echoes in your mind, "She is to be my new Avatar in this world, and I have you to thank for wakening her. Moreso, thank you for all of these fine sacrifices. I will enjoy them slowly, and leave you for last, my love."
NO!!!
Arggh!
You... You're the one ... who warned me about my mother's assassination... Why?
Leave... Her... Alone!
The Apparition of Borelean Strathelar struggles against the magical bonds that hold him.
The Apparition of Borelean Strathelar struggles against the magical bonds that hold him, almost escaping before the magic redoubles and pins him to the ground.
You have called to me, from beyond the depths, and I have come.
Of course, my love. Who else would come to such a summons?
As the ritual winds down, a strange coldness begins to radiate from Hoshino Kei.
Well done, indeed, my love. I have returned, and the strength of the Book flows through me. There is so much to do, and you have so little time.
Until then, be well my love, and know that I will always be watching you.
Arggh!
You summoned me, Your Highness?
As you wish, Your Highness. It will be done.

Greetings, I am known as Lady Dan'eel Trianna. I am a researcher in the newly reforming Lyceum at Knorr. I have been sent here by Lord Asheron to enlist help in the gathering of several components needed in a ritual of exceptional importance.

A group of noble, but foolhardy individuals attempted to aid Prince Borelean in an exceptionally dangerous ritual to bring his lost wife, Hoshino Kei, back from the dead. To do this, they used the Book of Eibhil to 'resurrect' her. Each participant sacrificed a portion of their spirit in order to fuel the ritual.
This unfortunately led to them raising Hoshino Kei as a spectre and an Avatar of the Book itself, while also corrupting all of the participants in the ritual.
Five of the participants withered soon after the ritual's completion, also raising back up as spirits of terrible power. The remainder are also beginning to wither in the same fashion.

As their sacrifices were willing, there is a chance to undo the damage that was done. To that end, Lord Asheron tasked us with researching the lost rituals of the Light Falatacot. We have located a ritual that may heal these individuals, or at least keep the corruption at bay until we can find a more permanent solution.

The ritual itself is tied to a legend about four sisters. Each sister governed over an aspect of the world. Together, the four could cleanse any corruption and heal the very spirit. Each sister had something that was considered sacred to them, and when the four materials are brought together, they can be used in rituals for healing the spirit.
As we are trying to reconstruct these rituals from only scraps of information, we cannot guarantee their success, but it is somewhere to start.

To aid us in this, I am prepared to reward Adventurers of sufficient experience for their efforts in collecting 10 pieces of Alb'arean Ore. Alb'arean Ore was sacred to the third sister, who was considered the Lady of Twilight and Rest. We've been able to locate a supply of this ore in the area held by the Gearknights along the Inner Sea.

I have been authorized by the Lyceum to reward each adventurer who helps me only once per week. The ore can be unstable, and we're trying to take only enough to perform the necessary rituals at any given point.
Ahh, a full stack of 10 Alb'arean Ore. Thank you. Please, accept this reward for your service to the Lyceum, Lord Asheron and all those whom this ritual will help save.

While I am impressed that you are out here, I am not authorized to reward Adventurers below a certain level of skill.  Lord Asheron does not wish to encourage the younger and less experienced residents of Dereth to risk their lives unduly.
Return to me when you have found 10 of the ores.
Thank you again for your assistance. I'll likely have another task for you soon, if you wish it.

Thank you again for your assistance. I'll likely have another task for you soon, if you wish it.
%tqt
How goes the collecting? It's not too dangerous out there, is it?
Thank you again for your assistance. Please return later I may need more of these.
I also see that you have aided all of my sisters in this important task, and that deserves some additional recognition.
You have been granted the title, "Healer Ritualist".

Greetings, I am known as Lady Kiara Trianna. I am a researcher in the newly reforming Lyceum at Knorr. I have been sent here by Lord Asheron to enlist help in the gathering of several components needed in a ritual of exceptional importance.

A group of noble, but foolhardy individuals attempted to aid Prince Borelean in an exceptionally dangerous ritual to bring his lost wife, Hoshino Kei, back from the dead. To do this, they used the Book of Eibhil to 'resurrect' her. Each participant sacrificed a portion of their spirit in order to fuel the ritual.
This unfortunately led to them raising Hoshino Kei as a spectre and an Avatar of the Book itself, while also corrupting all of the participants in the ritual.
Five of the participants withered soon after the ritual's completion, also raising back up as spirits of terrible power. The remainder are also beginning to wither in the same fashion.

As their sacrifices were willing, there is a chance to undo the damage that was done. To that end, :Lord Asheron tasked us with researching the lost rituals of the Light Falatacot. We have located a ritual that may heal these individuals, or at least keep the corruption at bay until we can find a more permanent solution.

The ritual itself is tied to a legend about four sisters. Each sister governed over an aspect of the world. Together, the four could cleanse any corruption and heal the very spirit. Each sister had something that was considered sacred to them, and when the four materials are brought together, they can be used in rituals for healing the spirit.
As we are trying to reconstruct these rituals from only scraps of information, we cannot guarantee their success, but it is somewhere to start.

To aid us in this, I am prepared to reward Adventurers of sufficient experience for their efforts in collecting 10 pieces of Rez'arean Ore. Rez'arean Ore was sacred to the fourth sister, who was considered the Lady of Mysteries. We've been able to locate a supply of this ore in the area held by the Iron Blade Gearknights in the Direlands.

I have been authorized by the Lyceum to reward each adventurer who helps me only once per week. The ore can be unstable, and we're trying to take only enough to perform the necessary rituals at any given point.
Ahh, a full stack of 10 Rez'arean Ore. Thank you. Please, accept this reward for your service to the Lyceum, Lord Asheron and all those whom this ritual will help save.

While I am impressed that you are out here, I am not authorized to reward Adventurers below a certain level of skill.  Lord Asheron does not wish to encourage the younger and less experienced residents of Dereth to risk their lives unduly.
Return to me when you have found 10 of the ores.

greetings: Oh, you again? I forgot I sent you off, I am very busy with so much important work and all.
An undead, you say? Working with Sclavus? Making an army for his mistress?
That is one heck of an interesting story. I bet lots of people far away from me would love to hear about it directly from you.
You should go. Don't keep them waiting, such heroics must be shared with the world!
Kraytuss laughs under his breath.
Here's the reward I promised you. Off you go now; Kraytuss has a lot of important stuff going on right now.
quest: Sorry little guy, I don't have anything for you to do right now.
You may repeat this quest in %tqt.
I guess you're one of those late bloomers? Take your time, no hurry at all. We will all wait around until YOU find time in your busy schedule for such a simple little task.
Kraytuss snickers.
Huh? What do you want? Can't you see I'm a busy man? How rude of you, wow!
Well since you've already disturbed me, you might as well make yourself useful. A lot of people around town have been complaining lately.
It's so annoying, but being the important person that I am I can understand why they would come to me with their concerns. I'm a man that gets things done, after all.
The people of Stonehold have been complaining about an awful green mist that's been emanating from a small hill to the west.
Not only is the mist eerily out of place, but it also has a smell far worse than any of the town inhabitants. And that's saying something, let me tell you!

Be a good little citizen now, would you, and take a look around 67.6N, 25.3W and see what you can find out. I'll gladly reward you if it means these lowly peons of the town will stop going on and on about the "big scary mist".
Run along now; the adults have important business to attend to.
Ah, but I have already given you a stipend this week.
Try back a little later adventurer.
Welcome citizen!
I have been tasked with rewarding citizens for their service to Dereth.
I will reward you with one stipend every week. You may use them to purchase special goods from the vendor over there.
May it serve you well. Best of luck citizen!
You have been awarded the title of "Derethian Newbie"
I am afraid you've received all you can for this month.
Try back next month.
You must wait %tqt to receive stipends again.
What true dedication you have. I've heard many impressive stories about you.
You have been awarded the title of "An Auberean Legend"
Dereth owes you many thanks for all the work you've done here.
You have been awarded the title of "Paragon of New Aluvia"
Wear those battle scars proudly; you've certainly earned them.
You have been awarded the title of "Epic Warrior"
New Aluvia heralds the triumphs you've had on these lands. Good work soldier.
You have been awarded the title of "Supreme Soldier"
You must have explored every inch of these lands by now. Oh the things you must have seen.
You have been awarded the title of "Intrepid Explorer"
The places you stumble upon when doing things for others. I've been there myself. Those were the days...
You have been awarded the title of "Adept Adventurer"
The people of New Aluvia have gained respect for you. Keep up the good work.
You have been awarded the title of "Notable Citizen"
Don't be afraid to explore new areas and find new battles. I have faith in your abilities
You have been awarded the title of "Novice Wanderer"
You have returned young one!
Another stipend for your service.

If her influence continues to spread this could mean a war will be upon us, and I can't say that we would be able to stop her.
It was important for you to explore her fortress. You have earned this.
You have earned the title of "Captain".

I represent the Arcanum and have been sent here to discover what secrets lie within Hoshino's Fortress. We must learn as much as we can as quickly as we can, we have no time to waste.
Who knows what Hoshino Kei is planning, but whatever it is it can't be good! Her fortress rises from the ground seemingly overnight. No doubt that evil book is responsible.

Please investigate the fortress and see what you can discover. We cannot sit idly by as she forges forward with her scheme. We must be proactive and put an end to this before it is too late. All of Dereth is in grave danger!

I will start working with the Mosswarts immediately to ensure things never regress this far again.

Please save my pets.
Please convince 10 of the workers to return to work.
This can't be happening. No, this CAN'T be happening!
The workers have all gathered and they are refusing to return to work without another large increase to their wages.
Not only that, but they are also holding my three little pets hostage to try and force my hand in meeting their demands. My poor babies must be so scared.
Please bring this message to them at my sanctuary located around 22.9N, 37.0W. Hopefully they will accept the offer and return my pets. I must prepare you though.

If they refuse the offer they can be unpredictable and may become violent. They mean well, they are a good group. The pressure of the mob mentality has forced many of the workers to act in such a manner.
Please do your best not to kill the workers. If they are "roughed up" a bit though, they are sure to come to their senses and stop this nonsense.
Convince 10 of the workers to return to work. I bet once several see the errors in their way that the others will follow.
The victims in all this are my poor little pets. A Tusker, an Armoredillo and an Ursuin.

They aren't much for strangers but if you feed them this meat it should make them groggy enough to where you can safely place them back in their cages. I have added a special ingredient to the food to tranquilize them very quickly.
I apologize, but I have no time to talk. There is much on my mind.
You have been awarded the title of "Pet Savior".
You saved my babies and the workers were not killed in the process?
Thank you! Thank you so much.
My little ones thank you for saving them as well. I don't know what I would have done if I had lost them!

greetings: Excellent work. Be wary though, a formidable opponent awaits you just ahead.
A ghostly spirit of great power lies below. This creature possesses the key we will need to gain access to the Count's chamber.
Destroy this guardian and take the key. I will meet you at the chamber door.
Grularr vanishes into the shadows.
We are close now. Just beyond this door lurks Count Phainor's resting place.
Surely he has felt your approach as you cut down his minions.
Prepare yourself brave warrior. Use Phainor's Chamber Key on the door behind me when you are ready.
Grularr disappears in the blink of an eye.
quest: The sooner you can meet me at the crypt entrance, the sooner we can help each other out.
Hello there, you seem like the adventurous type. Perhaps we can help each other out.
I am a collector of trinkets from times long past. The craftmanship and the stories behind the pieces are simply unmatched in today's age.
There is an exquisite amulet that lies within a tomb hidden deep in the Graveyard of the southern Direlands. The Count Phainor once wore this piece many years ago. The amulet is one of a kind.
I absolutely must have this piece for my collection. As you can see though, I am hardly a warrior. Battling through the Count's undead minions is not feasible...for me that is.

If you could meet me inside the Count's tomb I can assist you on your way to the Count's chamber. I will use the shadows to hide from sight of the evil beasties within and follow from a safe distance, assuring you find your way.
Once Count Phainor is defeated and we can access his treasure room, I will have my amulet and you will have your fair share of his legendary loot.
I will gather my supplies and meet you inside the tomb when you are ready.
Here we are: the point of no return. If your courage is fading then now is the time to turn back.
I will be following you from the shadows, good luck my friend.
Grularr disappears into the darkness.
Hello there. I don't have much time to talk, I am expecting someone very important.
Thank you again. I have been wanting this exquisite piece in my collection for ages.
Success! The amulet...it is even more beautiful than I ever could have imagined.
A piece of such beauty should not be rotting away in a dusty old crypt. It should be on display for the world to see and admire.
My thanks. This would never have happened without your help.
Take this my friend, you have earned it. I wish you all the best.
Thank you again for saving Dereth from great peril. Though held at bay for a time, Hoshino Kei will return and we will soon have need of your aid again. Take this moment to rest.
You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.
I can see by the strength of the enchantment upon you that you have located all three of the surrounding wards. Well done.
Now, gather your companions and seek the entrance to the catacombs up in the Fortress itself.
The once hidden entrances can be found in the towns surrounding the fortress. Each will likely have guardians that protect the wards which seal off the catacombs under the Fortress.

Find all three of the wards, and touch them. The spell I have placed on you will gather the information needed to bypass the final defenses into the catacombs and help empower the ritual you must perform there.
I see that you have freed all of the Sisters. They will aid you when it is time to face the spectral Hoshino Kei in battle.
To reach Hoshino Kei, however, you must first breach the wards protecting the catacombs under her fortress.
We have uncovered once hidden entrances in the surrounding towns believed to contain the wards.

To be able to aid me, you will need to have helped all of Popkin of the Gate's researchers with their tasks. I see that you have not yet aided Shah-hi in her task. She can be found at her excavation site in the Vesayen Isles, at 77.7S, 97.0E.

It is important that you help each of the researchers in freeing the essences of all the Sisters, as it will be those essences you personally freed which will allow them to aid you when it is time to face the spectral Hoshino Kei in battle.
Greetings, citizen. To aid me, you must first grow stronger.
I see you found Lieutenant Karul. Thank you for your assistance.
You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.
Any news on Lieutenant Karul? I fear they will not survive long without assistance.
Recently, Lieutenant Karul rushed ahead despite my warning.
I fear they will not survive long without assistance.
I am afraid that to aid me, you must first grow stronger.
You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.
Surely Lieutenant Roothe sent you. I suppose I deserve the berating he will rightfully give me for not listening to his wise words.
Your assistance is greatly appreciated, my friend. Having such brave adventurers battling her forces, Hoshino Kei is sure to fall.
I must swallow my pride and return to the camp. I need to gather my senses...and my pieces. I will embark shortly.
You have earned these rewards.
You may receive up to four total Gems of Forgetfulness before you must then wait a week.
It has not yet been a week.
You may receive up to eight total Gems of Forgetfulness before you must then wait two weeks.
It has not yet been two weeks.
You may receive up to sixteen total Gems of Forgetfulness before you must then wait three weeks.
It has not yet been three weeks.

greetings: You did it! You found the 4 pieces of the Signet! Let's release the magic within and continue on our quest.
El'Yst places the Signet against your forehead and begins chanting.
The protections placed on the Sanctuary will no longer affect you. Journey deep within the Recluse's lair in the heart of the Lost City and find the Mu-miyah's Idol.
There is so much to learn from this trinket.
quest: What? How did you get this?
Perhaps return to me tomorrow as your assistance may be needed again.
You have already assisted me in retrieving the Signet. Make your way to Sanctuary of the Recluse located at 20.8S, 7.5E.
You must find the 4 hidden pieces in order for me to allow you to bypass the Recluse's Wards on his lair.
Find the 4 pieces, combine them, and return to me.
The Idol...can it really be?
At long last! We can't even begin to imagine what powers and knowledge this item contains.
El'Yst presses the Idol against her head and begins to murmur softly.
I have channelled what power I could from the Idol into this device for you. I hope it serves you well.
Good day, friend. If you have a moment, I have a task I need assistance with.
Many moons ago a powerful mage "removed" himself from society so he could focus solely on mastering the magical arts.
Using his knowledge of ancient powers, he succeeded in locking himself away from the rest of the world, along with a certain artifact I very much desire.
To enter his sanctuary, you will need to find 4 pieces of a sigil that were hidden from the prying eyes of Dereth. All four pieces are needed for his protections to be bypassed.
They have been sent to the 4 corners of Dereth, hidden far from the citizens of the mainland.
Return with these items and I will be able to grant you access to Recluse's lair.
Good day young one.
El'Yst gently pats you on the head.
The Gearknight Phalanx you destroyed in the Direlands have gained us some good standing with the people of Dereth.

Thank you again for your assistance. If they get the device up and running again, I would be honored if you would assist me once again.

Bring back parts from 10 of the Gearknights and I shall reward you.
A solid blow to their forces. May they learn they are outnumbered and outclassed.

greetings: How magnificent! This crystal is teaming with incredible power!
Rinne takes the crystal and closes his eyes. He begins to whisper softly to himself as he clasps both hands tightly around the Spirit Crystal.
The horror! Such unspeakable evil! Only with the assistance of my guardian spirits was I able to take something so vile and create something so beautiful.
May this item guide and protect you from the wicked influences of this plagued land.
quest: Come back later and I might have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
I am bubbling with anticipation! What have you discovered about the increased unusual activity in the area?
Rinne appears to be engrossed in thought. He smiles as he notices your presence.
Why hello there. With such a drastic change to the Obsidian Plains by our new visitors, it's of little surprise that a surge of strange and unnatural activity has permeated the area.
The energy I am detecting from the area is riddled with feelings of destruction, jealousy and malice. There are forces at work here that we can't yet hope to understand.
This is why I am here, to learn all I can from the spirits that now reside here. But I can't hope to do this alone, I am a scholar not a warrior and the Rynthid would tear me to pieces.
If you can find the source of these spirits, retrieve any artifacts or relics and bring them to me. I will reward you handsomely for your efforts.
Rinne appears to be engrossed in thought and does not notice your presence.
Thank you again for your assistance. Return later, and I may have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
You have been awarded the title of Night Owl!
Return to me tomorrow and I may again have use for your skills.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Empowered Wisps.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Empowered Wisps and I will reward you.
Well met adventurer. I am Tillahan, hunter of the Wisps that plague this region. My task will not be complete until the Wisps of the area are no more.
Defeat %tqm of the Empowered Wisps that stalk the night and I will reward you for your bravery.
Be warned, they are a deadly foe and will be relentless in their pursuit of destruction.
I am afraid the task I have is too difficult for you.
Return to Hernd tomorrow and there may be more for you to do.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Hernd is impressed! Your thirst for carnage is commendable!
Return to Hernd after you've killed one of the Rynthid champions.
Hello there fellow warrior! Ever since Hernd was a young one, he aspired to fell the mightiest of the mighty. The deadlier the creature, the stronger his drive to defeat it!
With the Rynthid terrorizing this area, there was little doubt that Hernd would step up to the challenge and slaughter the most ferocious beings this region had to offer.
If you are fortunate enough to cross paths with one of these elite Rynthid warriors, slaughter it with haste and return. The bravest of Dereth should be rewarded for such courage!
These mighty Rynthid are cunning and brutal champions, Hernd would be foolish not to advise you that assistance from others like yourself may be prudent.
Hernd thinks you're not strong enough yet.
You've completed your quest already.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Thank you for your service. Here is your reward.
Once you've killed 5 Wisps in the Graveyard, I will reward you.
The wisps which wander this graveyard are a grave threat to any who explore here.
Destroy 5 Wisps within the Graveyard and I will reward you for your efforts.
Thank you again for your assistance. Return later, and I may have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Well done. Please, accept this reward with my thanks for your assistance.
Return tomorrow if you wish to aid us again.
Once you've killed 10 Spirits in the Graveyard I will reward you.
The spirits which haunt these graves do not know of the great warriors they once were.
End the suffering of %tqm Spirits within the Graveyard and I will reward you for your efforts.
I'm afraid this task is too difficult for you at this time, come back when you are more experienced.
You've completed your quest already.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
With every crash of bones back into the ground, we grow stronger. Here is your reward.
Once you've killed 30 Skeletons in the Graveyard, I will reward you.
My mission is to destroy the skeletons sending them back to their graves.
If you wish to assist in these efforts, kill 30 Skeletons within the Graveyard and I will reward you for your efforts.
You've completed your quest already.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
A solid blow against the corruption of these lands. Here is your reward.
Once you've killed 30 Wights in the Graveyard, I will reward you.
It is time for us to fight back against the corruption of these lands. I've been tasked with eradicating the Wights which hobble through these grounds.
Kill 30 Wights within the Graveyard and I will reward you for your efforts.
Those giant beasts of ice fall all the more magnificently.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Frost Golems.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Frost Golems and I will reward you.
There are giant beasts of pure ice smashing their way through the Frozen Valley.
Watch your step and kill 20 Frost Golems, then I will reward you for your efforts.
You do not meet the requirements to do this task.
Those frozen dread could return at any time. Check back with me later.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Thank you for removing those ghastly spirits. Please accept this reward.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Frozen Dreads.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Frozen Dreads and I will reward you.
I've seen spirits. They wander through the Frozen Valley. They attack whomever they see with a biting frost.
Kill 10 of these Frozen Dreads and I will reward you for your efforts.
Are you a fool? The task I would set upon you would certainly spell your doom. Return to me when you grow in power.
Thank you again for your assistance. Return later, and I may have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Those creatures send chills down my spine. Thank you for getting rid of them.
I'm authorized to send adventurers out on daily hunts, so return tomorrow if you wish to aid us again.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm frozen wights.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm frozen wights and I will reward you.
Seeing a frozen mindless wandering undead man chills me to my very core.
Kill 20 Frozen Wights and I will reward you for your efforts.
I'm afraid the tasks I have are too difficult for you at this time, come back when you are more experienced.
Well done sir. If you keep this up you just might be as legendary as me one day.
I don't usually do quests. But when I do, I do legendary ones.
If you want to be like me. Go complete 30 of the truly legendary quests and I will reward you.
Best of luck.

greetings: Impressive.  This could not have been easy to acquire.
quest: Come back later and I might have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Greetings, I am known as Morgethais.
I was wondering if you would assist me with my task.  I am seeking adventurers to hunt down and defeat the rogue 'Lothus' Virindi known as the Curator of Torment.
Our investigation shows that he is the entity responsible for the invasion of the Obsidian Plains by the crazed Virindi known as the Rynthid.

We know that his sanctum is hidden within the portalspace folds created by the Rynthid Area, and it is somehow warded by specific crystals within the area itself.  We believe if the crystals are destroyed, the magics sealing off the sanctum will fail, and brave souls such as yourself will be able to confront him directly.
Find him.  Bring back proof of his defeat, and I will reward you for your efforts.
I suggest returning when you are stronger.
I've sensed a great disruption in the local portalspace field. Did you manage to drive off the Curator of Torment?
To access the Curator of Torment's sanctum, locate and destroy the 4 warding crystals that protect the entrance.
You'll find the crystals scattered through the area controlled by the Rynthid.

greetings: All hail the Pumpkin... Lord? I guess it works.
You've been granted the title, 'Pumpkin Lord'!
It is an honor to meet you.
quest: No, no, wrong wrong WRONG! It must be exact!
Wait, you're trying to guess, aren't you?
Are you sure you want to do this?
If you're trying to guess one of my passwords, you're not doing very well.
This is going to end... poorly for you.
I think I've been more than patient with you.
You again? Seriously? I tire of your insolence.
Nope, still not it. Go learn something useful.
You're a persistent little morsel, aren't you...
Varinia looks aggravated.
Again!?! What did I ever do to you?
Varinia smiles.
Here, I'll be nice and... whoops, I changed my mind!
You could just, oh I don't know, EARN the password
I... wow, just. Wow. I think this calls for a different title for you.
You've been granted the title, 'Epic Fail'!
I appreciate that. One day you'll change your mind.
You've been granted the title, 'Epic Win'!
I'm afraid that password has expired.  Look for new ones in the future!
Duly noted. Here, have a title.
You've been granted the title, 'Follower of Asheron'!
You sure must like birds.
You've been granted the title, 'Fowl Follower'!
Ah, madness after my own heart.
You've been granted the title, 'Harbinger of Madness'!
I was just thinking that when I saw you coming around the corner.
You've been granted the title, 'Haunts Your Dreams'!
I'm glad we agree.
You've been granted the title, 'Likes Asheron'!
This one seemed appropriate.
You've been granted the title, 'Likes Getting Titles'!
And I don't let just anyone in. Remember that!
You've been granted the title, 'The Cool Kids Club'!
Yes, but can you do the dance too?
You've been granted the title, 'Thriller'!
I'm not dancing alone for your amusement... DANCE!
Yay! That was fun.

greetings: A wishbone? I love these things! I must warn you though, I never lose. Raising animals for years I know exactly how much pressure to place and at what angle to break the bone.
Farmer Ar'Oyd grabs one end of the wishbone and pulls, snapping the bone in two.
You see he clearly has the larger piece in his hand.
I told you I never lose! A wish? That's easy. I wish someone would "clean out" the basement of my barn. The place has become a nightmare since the holidays ended.
A warning though, this gem will only open a portal to my basement once. Be sure you have gathered the bravest of your companions before entering.
The basement is cleared out? That's good to hear. These turkeys are turning into nothing but problems!
Thanks for the help.
Lovely day today, isn't it?

quest: Thank you again for your assistance. Return later, and I may have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
That was some fine destruction, my friend!
I'm authorized to send adventurers out on daily hunts, so return tomorrow if you wish to aid us again.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm frozen crystals.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm frozen crystals and I will reward you.
I love the cold weather, the chill in the air is invigorating! You know what I don't love, though? Those walking ice boxes!
Large blue crystals have started appearing across the landscape that spawn those pesky Frost Golems.
Destroy 4 of these Frozen Crystals and you will be rewarded.
I'm afraid the tasks I have are too difficult for you at this time, come back when you are more experienced.
Thank you again for your assistance. Return later, and I may have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
The less insects around here, the better! Thank you.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm cacti.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm desert cacti and I will reward you.
Nothing like the sun beating down on you, warming you from head to toe. That is, until those infernal Wasps start buzzing around your head!
The insects here love to make homes inside of the desert cacti. Remove their home, and just maybe they will find elsewhere to live.
Destroy 6 of the Desert Cactus and I will reward your efforts.
You do not meet the requirements to do this task.
Thank you again for your assistance. Return later, and I may have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
I am glad those dead are dead!
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Sarcophagi.
Return to me after you have killed %tqm Sarcophagi and I will reward you.
Hoshino Kei continues to strengthen her army by using her dark mages to convert the recently deceased.
Find and destroy 4 Sarcophagi within the town to prevent more from joining her and I will reward you.
I'm afraid the tasks I have are too difficult for you at this time, come back when you are more experienced.
You've completed your quest already.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Here is your reward.
Destroy 6 of the Corrupted Gravestones.

This place gives me the creeps, especially at night! The deceased just...CRAWL their way up out of their graves and start shambling, giving no thought to how this might horrify a little ole caretaker like myself!
Destroy 6 of these Corrupted Gravestones within the Graveyard before their resident makes it to the surface and I will give you a little something for your efforts.

greetings: All right, hold on to your socks! I hope you've put on your best dancing clothes!
If you have a Night Club Ticket, give it to me and I will send you directly to the Night Club.
I tire of supposed diplomats who think that their own desires are more important than the needs of a tired fortress beseiged on all sides by enemies.
Lieutenant Commander Margyle appraises you with a steady eye, then nods.

I do not think you are of the same cloth as them. I have a letter prepared. I trust you to deliver it to whoever you feel is most likely to aid Fort Tethana, be they a Queen...or a King. Let them send men to reinforce us, and then perchance we will consider alliance.
I have assumed command with the absence of Commander Kurth. Speak quickly if you have business - we have a war of our own to fight around here.

quest: Thank you again for your assistance. Return later, and I maybe I will have more to tell...
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Please.. Please.. Let this horror end... Return to me any information you may find.
They tore them to shreds. Literally tore limbs from bodies!
What did we do?!
Friedrich was always good to me. I knew he had his doubts about this place. We should have listened to him. But now, now we all die for these sins.
And this note...
It is clear we were used. Success or failure, I now suspect we'd be dead either way.
Leave me. I've seen too much and stood idly by as all this unfolded. I deserve my fate.
They paid us with these keys. Just holding one makes me feel sick.
Is this all the information you've found.. there has to be more..
Is this all the information you've found.. there has to be more.. If you have, I would be most interested to learn what you have found.

greetings: Oh, it's very... red. Aaah! Look, don't be too greedy. The more of these you take the more likely the Order will decide to come back and question me! Aaah! Aaah!
You better leave now and make sure no one sees you leave! Aaah!
Oh, it's very... pink. Aaah! Look, don't be too greedy. The more of these you take the more likely the Order will decide to come back and question me! Aaah! Aaah!
quest: Aaah! Who are you? Oh, it's you. Show me the rare you acquired from the Pakinites.
Aaah! Who are you? What? What was that explosion? You'll never take me!
You, you're not here to take me back to Ulgrim? Aaah! He's got it in for me, I know it! I was clever. I hid out down here and he never found me. He'll never find me.
Look, if you keep my secret I'll let you in on a secret I've been keeping.

There is a secret order of Zharalim, the Pakinites, who have discovered a wondrous rare item. They have been keeping these items to themselves in order to insure its rarity. I happened to know a few things that they needed to know in order to find these items.
They have this secret bookcase in Xarabydun. If you pull the book labeled 'A Treatise on Uncommon Artifacts' it will open the way to their hidden chambers.
Come back and see me when you have one of the rares. I'm interested in seeing what they've been hiding. Make sure you aren't followed though. Aaah!

greetings: A voice echos in your mind, "Miserable failures! Can you not do something so simple as remove a few pathetic meat-bags?! Guardians! Succeed where the guards have failed, or face my wrath for your failure."
A wave of cold radiating from northern Osteth rips through the air like a shockwave as %s strikes down the spectral form of Hoshino Kei!
A ragged voice in your mind says, "You may have defeated me, for now, but this little trap of yours will not hold me forever."
The Spectre of Hoshino Kei's voice echoes in your mind, "Your pathetic magics may've solidified my form for the moment, but it will avail you not. I will kill each and every one of you."
An amused voice in your mind says, "Is that it? Is that all you have, %s?"
A somewhat disappointed voice in your mind says, "Is this the best my poor husband could muster against me?"
A voice in your mind says, "You'll learn to serve me, soon enough."
An amused voice in your mind says, "A pity, you didn't last nearly long enough to be entertaining, %s."
A mildly annoyed voice in your mind says, "Since you've worked so hard to get my attention, %s, I think I shall give it.
An amused voice in your mind says, "Well struck, %s. Perhaps there's hope for you yet."
An amused voice in your mind says, "You may yet make a fine servant, %s, with some additional training."
An amused voice in your mind says, "You begin to see how feeble your magics are when compared to the powers of the Book."
An amused voice in your mind says, "When you are dead and raised into my service, %s, I'll teach you real magic."

quest: Thank you for freeing me from the infinite torture I have been enslaved to.
You must wait %tqt to be rewarded again.
Being the guardian of this temple was never my choice, but instead was a duty thrust upon me and labeled as an honor.
I hope the little I can give helps to repay my debt to you.
You have been awarded the title of "Heretic".
Your task is complete. We have no further business.
I know why you are here. I know who sent you.
I have no intention of stopping you or alerting the warriors within these walls to your presence.
Although I will not allow the souls of the young to be manipulated to their side.
I offer you a choice.
Complete your task as you were instructed, this will benefit everyone involved. But, return the masks to myself when you are finished.
I will reward you handsomely, far more than your current employer could hope to.
The decision is yours to make. I suggest you consider my offer, it is beyond fair.
You have not slaughtered enough recruits.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Tanada Neophytes.
Your reward, as promised, along with a note for your employer.
You have not brought enough masks.
The Gem glows brightly for a moment when you activate it, and a Portal appears.
The Gem pulses fitfully, giving a sensation of pulling upward.
You hear a faint voice in the back of your mind. It sounds female, and really tired.

Hello? I can feel your presence, faintly. I can't move. The Undead brought me up to this tower. They carried me through some large castle, and into a Great Hall. The last thing I remember passing before they opened the portal to this tower was a throne of some kind. Please help me. You're my only hope.
Acid dissipates into the surroundings. The sour taste of acid lingers in the atmosphere.
Fire dissipates into the surroundings. The atmosphere warms and your flesh blisters.
Frost dissipates into the surroundings. The atmosphere cools and a chill numbs you to the core.
Electricity dissipates into the surroundings. A charge lingers in the atmosphere striking at exposed surfaces.
A crystal has been given.

greetings: I do not want to become one of those monsters. That is a fate worse than death.
Welcome to my humble shop.
Please come back any time!
An interesting find.
I hope you enjoy it.

quest: Thank you once again for saving me.
Thank you for getting me out of that cell. I need to get out of here before they grab me again.
You have been awarded the title "No Cage Can Hold Me".
Please get me out of here! You don't know what they do to us, it is terrible!

greetings: I'm telling you, you have the wrong man. Why do you insist on attacking me.
Your final blow silences Andrilos and he slumps limply to the cave floor.
quest: I keep telling you, that is not me! Why would I want to take this Lunnum you speak of?
I remember you! I won't talk to you. All I will say is that I have been unjustly accused.
These fungal growths are facinating. Don't you agree? Collecting and categorizing the fungus in these caves is my hobby. It's important to have a hobby.
Did you want to ask me something?

Hmmm, I have to admit that this does look like me, but I was nowhere near Lunumm's Pyre when you say the theft took place. I... I was engaged in a private matter. I can't disclose all of the details or I might endanger other peoples lives, but I assure you that I am not your thief.

greetings: Mmm, sugar and wax. I'm sure it's delicious, but... I've had my daily recommended allowance of wax today. Thanks for thinking of me!
Ewwww! An undead! No way.
Party! Someone bring me another Stout!
Grrrrr Arrrrrrgh!
Ah, that's better I've had a horrible cough lately. My throat seems so raspy and dry. I can't seem to keep hydrated.
As Ungrim drinks the stout it pours right out from between his ribs and onto the floor.
Ah, that was refreshing.
The people in this bar are slobs! Wasting all that stout by sloshing it on the floor. What a shame.
Hey Ystig, there's another puddle of stout on the floor over here!
Want to play a fun Festival trick? Go visit the Little Guy on my island. I made a bet with him and he lost. It's worth going just to see him dressed up.
When you get there try giving him a Wi Stamp. No really, it's hilarious.
Ungrim suppresses a snicker.
Have you noticed something around here smells pretty ripe?
Oh well.
I look different? How?
Kindof dead looking? Well, I have had quite a bit to drink lately and perhaps I may not be getting enough sleep...
Nope, I can't see anything out of the ordinary. Maybe you should sit down and have a drink. I think all of these Festivities might have been to much for you.
Have you seen an ear around here. I seem to have lost one of mine.
I swear if my head wasn't attached I'd probably loose that too.
Come to think of it. I haven't seen my head recently either...
Oh good, it's still there.
Festival Season is one of my favorite times of year. I'm giving away treats. Would you like a trick or a treat?
Treat! Here you go.
That's my own recipe. Let me know how much you like it.
I slave over a hot stove all day and people say they don't like my pies!
I'm not unreasonable, I mean no one wants to eat my pies.
Fine, I'll just go inside and eat some brains...
I mean pies, pies of course, who would want to eat delicious brains? That's just crazy.
No thanks, it's not ready yet.
Hey, a ginger bread pumpkin!
Mmm, those taste even better with warm stout.
Hey Peppermint! Have you tried my secret recipe?
Then try some of my Peppermint Pumpkin Pie!
What is this?
No! I don't eat brains!
What were you thinking?
You must be one of those traumatized survivors of the recent zombie attack.
You have been granted the title of Zombie Incursion Survivor
Zombies give me the creeps.
You see Ungrim move his hand towards his mouth.
What? Was I going to eat that brain, you ask? Why, would you like some?
... err, I mean, I was just about to dispose of it, don't want to leave these things just laying around.
A Zombie Arm?
A Zombie Head?
A Zombie Leg?
A Zombie Torso?
Oho, another Zombie for my army of the dead!
Hehe, just kidding. Here you are, some words of wisdom.
Never forget to remember to wear your boots.
I'll just stack this one on top of the others.
Now to impart some wisdom on you.
Remember, when you have drained your mug that the mug is not empty. It is still full of potential for more drink.
What am I going to do with all these Zombies?
I guess I could set them to build me the worlds biggest mug or something. Oh, right you want some wisdom.
Wisdom is something that builds up over time. Like that hopsy stuff at the bottom of a keg.
Bring me some stout and we'll have a nice chat. Bring me two stouts and I'll tell you whatever you want to know. Bring me three stouts and I'll make some stuff up for you.
quest: Oh, you already gave me two Zombie Arms. Don't you remember?
Oh, you already gave me a Zombie Head. Don't you remember?
Oh, you already gave me two Zombie Legs. Don't you remember?
Oh, you already gave me a Zombie Torso. Don't you remember?
Hey! You've gotten all the Zombie bits. Now lets see, just a little paste here and some needle and thread there. Here you go, your very own Zombie Butler!
Of course he won't do anything until you animate him. I hear that Mnemosynes can be used. Hmmm, I wonder why I know how to raise the dead? I've never made a habit of it before...
Oh well, I can't be worried about trivialities. Oh, one more thing. Never use a Tiny Mnemosyne to animate your Zombie Butler. Ugh!
Ulgrim shivers.
Yes, I can use this to fashion arms for your Zombie Butler!
Yes, I can use this to fashion a proper head for your Zombie Butler!
Yes, I can use this to fashion legs for your Zombie Butler!
Yes, I can use this to fashion a proper body for your Zombie Butler!
Your Zombie Butler still needs an arm or two.
Your Zombie Butler still needs a leg or two.
Your Zombie Butler still needs a head.
Your Zombie Butler still needs a torso.
That was nice, but where's the candy?
See, it's a cookie.
That's good enough for me.
Candy! Candy! Candy!

Sorry, I don't make it a habit to eat things made of unknown substances, even if they are sweet and covered in sugar. Those are exactly the kind of things you should be most wary of. If you had a Marshmallow Eep though...

greetings: This is from that Orisis fiend? I was running the news in Mayoi when he came to town. I knew he was bad news right from the start, but nobody wanted to hear it. They were all caught up in his sob story about being a poor helpless undead. If only those fools had listened to me...
Well, that's all in the past eh?
There do seem to be fewer undead now. For helping to clean up Al-Jalima I award you the title "Death Knight".
Trevor looks around and in a whisper tells you some secrets to fighting the undead.
... and remember never ever give one of those to an undead. Ever.
quest: If you're not going to leave Al-Jalima why don't you make yourself useful and take out some of these zombies. They seem to be more concentrated on the NE side of town.
Hey, good luck kid, and watch yourself.
Oh, thank goodness! I almost shot you. It's good to see another living face. It feels like it's been days since I've seen anyone. How are the rest of the towns? Has the plague spread?
Just Al-Jalima? That's odd. I presumed they had taken over everywhere. I wonder what's so different about Al-Jalima.
Trevor shivers violently.
I can't seem to get away from the undead! First that Orisis in Mayoi and now here...
They must be after me!
Well, I'm not going down without a fight! That's why I'm up here on the roof.
You better get out of here before they smell your brains.
I came to shoot zombies and chew monougat.
And I'm all out of monougat.
No one's getting up here without a pack of mana charges and a pulse!
Ooo! Head Shot!
I got one!
Take that you dead bastard!
That's right! You just got sent back to the grave by Trevor's magic!
I'm sorry, but would you all stop shambling?
It's just that it's getting to me, all this shambling. Perhaps you could try some lurching or crawling.
Eww, that's not right.
Damn Zombies!
A large pack of angry Gurogs have been spotted advancing on Tufa.
Panic has gripped the citizens of Yaraq as a group of balloons drift towards the town!

greetings: Pon Mi looks at you sullenly.
If you want a confession, you'll need to take it off my cold dead body!
Pon Mi points at one of his corpses.
No, seriously - go ahead and take one. There's plenty for everyone.
Please don't kill me anymore.
You hand the confession to Chow Doun and explain what you saw.

My supplies...used for that? But this confession explains one thing - this Pon Mi was no master of the Tanada clan after all, but simply an honorless thug whose ambition got the better of him. I suppose the name of his house should have been a hint.
I do not think he is of any concern to me anymore. I will not get my supplies back, but at least my honor is restored thanks to you.
quest: Thank you for your help. While I'll never get those supplies back, at least that villain Pon Mi is getting what was coming to him.
Hello again. Have you had any success in tracking down the missing supplies or Master Pon Mi? It worries me that the Tanada clan has taken such an interest in my humble baking.
The baker leans in and begins to conspiratorially whisper.
But seriously, Tanada House of Pancakes? Aren't they supposed to be centered around the elements? For that matter...pink?
Chow Doun resumes his normal speaking voice.
In any event, do you need another Butter Knife of Slaying?
Here you go. May it serve you well when all other utensils fail you.

Greetings, greetings. I have no baked goods today, I am afraid. My supplies have been stolen - STOLEN!" Chow Doun tells you, "The malefactor is an evil man named Pon Mi, who is affiliated with that group spoken of in shadowy whispers as...
Chow Doun's voice drops to a whisper.
...the Tanada clan of Nanjou Shou-jen.
Now, I know that it seems unusual for them to want to steal my flour and eggs and such, but I've no doubt that it is all part of some evil scheme. I need your help...please find my supplies.

I'm led to believe this particular group refers to themselves as the "Tanada House of Pancakes" when they allow their shadowy selves to be perceived. They have conveniently left a portal to their hideout over there - please, enter and discover what they are about!
Take this to aid you in your quest. It is the Butter Knife of Slaying, bane to all those foul creatures of the night who are...um...made of food, really.
A resonant voice cries out in anguish.

greetings: To be honest, I be glad to rid myself of this weapon. It's a vicious thing, and it eats itself from inside out after a day. I won't ask what ye be using it for.
I see that ye be an adventurer of extravagant means. I hope you didn't blow your fortune on this. Very well, hold still, I'm about to grant you practical knowledge...
I see that ye be an adventurer of extravagant means. I hope you didn't blow your fortune on this. Very well, hold still, I will convert this into Luminance for you...

Welcome to the premises upon Freebooter Isle. I'm your humble freeholder, and I congratulate your Society on its exclusive access to this emporium of exotic goods. By your leave, we're not interested in any of your political squabbles. The plink of your pyreal and is all we're interested in.

For your convenience, we maintain a fully stocked Archmage and Provisioner shop, and we carry some interesting items you'll not find elsewhere. We also have a resident Fence, Lormish, who'll exchange advancement gems for MMD notes at a harsh, but fair, rate. And Pak Li-Shung, our Finagler, can get you Society writs in exchange for some bone trophies... Never ye mind where Li-Shung gets the writ...
To be honest, I am glad to rid myself of this weapon. It's a vicious thing, and it eats itself from inside out after a day. I won't ask what you'll be using it for.
I see that an adventurer of extravagant means stands before me. I hope you didn't blow your fortune on this. Very well, hold still, I'm about to grant you practical knowledge...

Welcome to our exclusive operation here at Northwatch, and congratulations on your Society's achievement! Please leave your factional squabbles at the door. We are as neutral as those with negotiable loyalty can be.

Our hold maintains fully functional Archmage and Provisioner shops, with a few... interesting extras. Our resident Fence, Ilnorra, trades advancement gems for MMD notes and Finagler Janaris gives Society Armor Writs in exchange for interesting bone trophies. Speak with them if you're interested in their wares. And don't ask where they come from, eh?

quest: I sold you keys not too long ago, kid. What do you think those grow on trees? Don't try to corner the market. Come back later.
There you go, kid. Dont spend it all in one place.
Price to steep for you? I understand some of us got it, some of us don't.
Sorry, kid. Too rich for your blood.
I sold you keys not too long ago, kid. What do you think those grow on trees? Don't try to corner the market. Come back later.
There you go, kid. Dont spend it all in one place.
Price to steep for you? I understand some of us got it, some of us don't.

greetings: Oh, our transaction is over. The Master of this hold does all the training. Bring the gem to him and he'll teach you.
quest: I sold you a gem not too long ago, kid. What do you think those gems grow on trees? Don't try to corner the market. Come back later.
There you go, kid. Bring that to the Master of the Black Market and he'll train you up.
I understand. Not everyone is willing to meet our price. Best of luck to you.
Sorry, kid. Too rich for your blood.

greetings: Oh, our transaction is over. The Master of this hold does all the training. Bring the gem to him and he'll teach you.
quest: Trying to put one over on ol' Lormish? I already sold you one of these gems, not that long ago. I don't grow them out of my armpits or something. Come back later.
Righto, that'll serve you. Just bring it to the Master of the Black Market and he'll train you right. Littlefinger's honor.
I understand. Not everyone is willing to meet our price. Best of luck to you.
Sorry, kid. Too rich for your blood.

quest: I sold you a gem not too long ago, kid. What do you think those gems grow on trees? Don't try to corner the market. Come back later.

Sorry, kid. Too rich for your blood.

greetings: Settle down, kid. Your own Society's provisioners will accept that. Guaranteed.
Settle down, kid. Just talk to me and I'll check your pack and see if you've got enough. Remember, a writ will cost you 20 bones.
quest: Sorry, we've done business too recently. I'm not done with all the bones you brought me before. Come back later.

I can get you an armor writ that your Society will accept, if you can bring me what I seek. I want some exhumed bones from the Empyrean Graveyard in the Direlands. There's some kind of ghostly gravedigger who seeks them so he can lay them to rest, but I have... other uses for them. Bring me 20 of those bones and I'll give you a writ to receive a piece of your own Society's armor. Do we have a d...
Great! I'll take those bones, and give you this writ... Your own Society's provisioners will accept that. Guaranteed. Don't ask me how I get them, and I won't tell you.
I understand. Not everyone is willing to meet our price. Best of luck to you.

greetings: I assure you, your Society armorsmith will accept it.
Just talk to me and I'll check your pack and see if you've got enough. Remember, a writ will cost you 20 bones.
quest: Sorry, we've done business too recently. I'm not done with all the bones you brought me before. Come back later.

Want to get ahead in life, young one? I can provide you with a flawlessly forged armor writ to bring to your Society's armorsmith... For a price. I don't seek money. I seek exhumed bones from the Empyrean Graveyard in the Direlands. I know some kind of undead gravedigger seeks them too... Well, I need them myself. Bring me 20 of those exhumed bones and I will give you an armor writ. That's a ve...
Well done. I'll take those bones from you, and give you this writ... I assure you, your Society armorsmith will accept it. You have my gratitude.
I understand. Not everyone is willing to meet our price. Best of luck to you.
If you return to me in a days time, I may have another task for you in the Dark Isle.
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.
Well done, well done indeed. You have proven your skill and honored my task. I thank you. Here is the reward promised.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Black Coral Golems.
Once you've killed 20 Black Coral Golems, I will reward you. Keep up the good work.

It is an honor to greet you. I have a proposition for you, if you are interested. There are some recent additions to the Isle known as the Dark Isle, specifically the Black Coral Golems. If you would be willing to go there and prove your prowess by destroying 20 of these strange golems, I will reward you handsomely for your actions.
You must be a Lord in your Society to assist me.
If you return to me tomorrow, I may have another task for you in the Dark Isle, Honored Master.
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.
Impressively done, Honored Master. You have accomplished all I have wished from you. Now, for your promised reward.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Blighted Coral Golems.
Once you've killed 20 Blighted Coral Golems, I will reward you. Keep up the good work.

"Ahh, a true and honored Master of the Societies. I am pleased to speak with you. I have a task for you upon the Dark Isle, one that is worthy of your obvious skill. I wish you to destroy 20 of the foul, Blighted Coral Golems upon the isle. Do this for me, and I will reward you greatly for your impressive deed.
You must be a Master in your Society to assist me.
Return to me later, and I may have more work for you.
That should do it! The Mana flows around the Ruins of Degar'Alesh are moving much better now, thank ye. Here's a little something for yer efforts.
You look like you've been busy. Have you completed the task I set before you?
Greetins to ye.
Me name's Valerian, Velerian McGreggor. I've been studying the dead-lookin Deru Tree to the north of the Ruins of Degar'Alesh on Freebooter Isle, but me researches have been interrupted as of late.

Ya see, these nasty tentacles, like the Slithis you see on occasion, but bigger, erupted out all over the roots of the tree. Worse! Since they've appeared, the Mana flows around the ruins have been all choked up! That there's bad for me and bad for business.
I'll tell ye what. If ye go out there and kill 50 of those tentacles for me, just the ones on Freebooter, mind ye, I'll make it worth ye while.
The Marae Lassel Deru Trees can rot for all I care. Damn Tumies won't let me within a mile of them for some reason.
You must be a Knight in your Society to assist me.
Nice to see you again. Next time you may want to buy the recall gem and skip this challange thing.
I see that you've made it past the floor puzzle.
You have to be sure of each step you take or else everything you worked for could be undone.
Not sure why I'm telling you this, you are here.
You have been granted the title of Sure Step.
Well, you really gave up on the trial? Looking at you, I am not surprised.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Black Rats.
There's a still a chance to redeem yourself, assuming you can use your mind instead of your weapons.

Generally people only come down here as a last resort or if they're too much of a brute to handle the task ahead of them. If you can prove your endurance by killing 50 of these rats I'll portal you directly to the next portion of the trials but I will think less of you.
Completing this once is an impressive feat, but completing it again is astounding! Congratulations.
I've watched many people fall during my time here.
How could I not love my job! It's a laugh a minute.
I have to congratulate you on making it this far, that was some quality bridge jumping.
You have been granted the title of Bridge Jumper.
Okay, you've killed all 50. Guess you can pass now. I really don't know why we let in people who can't defeat such a simple challenges.
You still need to kill more of these carenzi to prove your endurance.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Weak Mangy Carenzi.

Not much of a jumper are you? When people come talk to me it means they've already tried and failed the task ahead. If you need to bypass that challenge due to a lack of skill you can simply kill 50 of these carenzi for me as a show of your endurance.

greetings: Ah, there you are my child. I have been expecting thee.
With a wave of his hand, the Apparition of Emperor Geraine magically pins Hoshino Kei to the ground.
Oh no, whelp. You will not be interfering today. There is much here for you to learn, and I'd hate to have to kill you before then.
With a wave of his hand, the Apparition of Emperor Geraine magically pins Borelean to the ground.
That's better. Stay there for a while, and learn something for once.
That was a pivotal moment in your timeline, boy.
That assassination would've driven forth a timeline that was... less than optimal to my plans.
Your actions saved me a great deal of effort in this ritual, I should thank you.
The Apparition of Emperor Geraine smiles.
And, I should thank you for bringing your darling wife here. I've been waiting for her to come back to me.
Oh, I'm afraid I cannot do that, boy..
You see, she has been a key to my success for some time.
Why did you think I had my undead kidnap her all those months ago?
I set in her the preparations needed to sacrifice her to the Book, so as to complete this ritual in its entirety.
You came here to stop me, but all you accomplished was guaranteeing my success.
For that, I thank you.
The Apparition of Emperor Geraine points at Borelean in mocking laughter.
It will take more than that to break my hold on thee, boy. Now sit quiet and watch. You're about to see history remade...
With a screm that tears through your heart and soul, Hoshino Kei dies.
The Apparition of Emperor Geraine laughs maniacally.
Ahh, boy, you have made all of these long plans so worthwhile.
For that gift, and the soul of your wife, I'll send her corpse to you after you leave this place.
I'm afraid that's all of her that you will be getting back, however.
The Book is a rather voracious eater when it comes to certain sacrifices.
The Apparition of Emperor Geraine sighs.
Now, I tire of this.
Die.
The Apparition of Borelean Strathelar lets out a strangled grunt as the life is crushed out of him and he is whisked back to the Lifestone.
No one can stop me now. Not you, whelp, not your precious mother and not even your upstart of a tutor, Asheron.
With this sacrifice, this ritual will be anchored in eternity!
The Apparition of Emperor Geraine pulls a struggling ball of light from Hoshino Kei's chest.
Begin the final stage of the Ritual! Our victory is now at hand!
A hot, dry wind blows through the chamber as the vision fades. Shortly thereafter, a ripple seems to pass through everything, and the world shifts.
The air shimmers and hums with power as time itself shifts, revealing the Time Ritual's defenders.
As Master Seijuro reads the letter, a look of mild surprise passes over his face.
Well, I honestly never thought I'd see a letter in this handwriting ever again...
It's been years since the battle at Yanshi, and she's been gone ever since. Now, she resurfaces, with such dire words, requesting my help...
Were these words to have come from any but the one who sent you, I'd have killed you on the spot for such an accusation. But, I owe her my life, and I trust her judgment.

Here, take this token to the one who sent you. She will know what it means, and will know how to respond to it. Consider it my final test of you, to ensure that this letter is real. If this letter is a fake, and your Mistress is not whom I think it is, then you will know the wrath of the Tanada Clan. Now, go.
quest: I see you have not yet delivered my reply to the one who sent you. You should do so with haste.
You have fought well to come here. Why have you come?

greetings: So you are the promising young warrior who has helped our clan so greatly. You have the eternal gratitude of all Tanada, past present and future, for recovering our scrolls and helping defeat our corruption. Though no material reward can match what you have done for us, please accept these meager gifts as a token of the esteem of the Clan Tanada.
I hope you will forgive the abruptness of your departure, but we have pressing clan business to conduct...
I thank you for retrieving the Scroll of Air so that we Tanada may reclaim our good name.
I thank you for retrieving the Scroll of Earth so that we Tanada may reclaim our good name.
I thank you for retrieving the Scroll of Earth so that we Tanada may reclaim our good name.

quest: Return to me when you have fought fifteen of these creatures.
You are such a brave young soul. Dereth needs more people like you.
You have been awarded the title of "Holly Jolly Helper"
I have recently rewarded you for your assistance, don't get greedy. Come back later when I'll be able to reward you again.
I can't tell you how shocked I was when we arrived at the final stop of our Derethian Holiday Tour here in Sawato.
The town was full of those...things! Spewing off at the mouth about crushing the holiday spirit.
The group ran as fast as their Run skill allowed. Maybe you could "persuade" them to leave town?
Destroy 15 of those Mosswarts and I will find something to reward you with for your bravery.
Be careful young one, it's dangerous. You shouldn't stray so far from the other children. Safety in numbers.
Thanks again. If the adventurer thing doesn't work out for you, there's always a bright future for you as a Courier.
You may repeat this quest in %tqt.
Great work. You have made some young ones very happy this holiday season.
You have been awarded the title of "Gift Gopher"
You have been awarded the title of "Holiday Hero"
The big guy sure is getting lazy this year. Don't tell him I called him "big", he's pretty sensitive about his weight.
Not only did I have to check his list this year, but he made me double check it. Now he needs ME to deliver presents to the young ones across Dereth?
If you could help out by delivering these presents to the proper recipients I would be very grateful.
Here is a list with the names and towns that each present needs to go to.
Time is of the essence, you only have 30 minutes to make all four of the deliveries. Hurry along now!
Please hurry and deliver those presents!
Oh no! The undelivered packages didn't arrive in time... The big guy is not going to be happy about this. Best we not speak about this again until tomorrow.
I thank you for the gift I have already received.
You have completed your deliveries for Raymond!
A present for me? Thanks!

Hello.
I was very good this year.
