greetings: Defilers! Your trespass will be paid for in blood!
Attack!
Holcha begins to stomp the ground with all its might!
With a high resonating note the Knath Mother flips over and begins to quickly melt away leaving a crystalline core behind.
A quandary. I am all that is energy and living thought. I have form and can be destroyed. I am matter and energy at once, and yet I am defeated. No matter I am not dead, merely transformed!
%s has defeated Tempest, the Essence of Storms, repelling Gaerlan's forces back from the cities of the east...for now.
In my new gained sentience I did not understand destruction. But now I see that even I can be dispersed. But my death like yours is not permanent. I shall return sooner than you think.
%s has defeated Tempest, the Essence of Storms. Its form is driven from the world and Gaerlan's forces are routed at Tou-tou, Sawato, Lin, and Baishi.
Fractured and blistered by the scorching tendrils of pure energy.
Your magic is devoured by my power!
%s has defeated Tempest, the Essence of Storms.
As the elemental creature collapses you feel space fold in on itself. It feels like your gut turned inside out as you're ripped back through portal space.
This is indeed armor of station amongst the Gotrok.  By presenting it to me, I am assuming you defeated it in combat?  Show this to Ulkas, and he will reward you for you great deed.
This is an old crest with the symbol of our fortress on it.  Perhaps you can get Ulkas to repair it for you.

This is one of the old scepters of office we brought with us through the rifts.  They were traditionally held by our defenders, before they were slain in combat.  Due to your deeds, I think you should keep this.  If you wish, Master Ulkas will repair it for you, and refuel its inner power.

This pauldron belongs to one of the Gotrok generals!  You are indeed mighty to have slain it.  Perhaps if you show it to Ulkas, you will impress him.  He is not easily shocked, however the fact you have slain a Gotrok general...
I am not worthy to possess such an item.  Please, return it to one of the emissaries my people sent to contact you.
Lord Kresovus grips the hide of his old pet and drops his head in silence.
I raised him from a little Mattie. He was my best friend.
I will miss you Balor.
Kresovus loosens his grip on the hide.
Balor would want to be of use. He was always so brave...
Take it and go. I wish to be alone with my thoughts.
Lord Kresovus rears back and screams a great cry of anguish to the uncaring skies above. "BAAAAAAAAAAALLLLLOOOOOOOOOOOOOOORR!!!!!"
Balor... What have they done to you?
Lord Kresovus slumps forward, obviously overcome with grief. After a short moment, he remembers himself, his position, and his company. Lord Kresovus straightens his back and looks you in the eye.
I thank you for your service. The heart grieves, but...
Thank you.
Kresovus reads the summons. You suspect you see a small smirk flit across his face.

I cannot speak of this here. There is a spy in my court and I fear for my life. You must meet with me in secret below. Use the chest here to access the chambers beneath Linvak Tukal. I will meet you there.

I can't believe they thought you would be able to remove me from Linvak Tukal! Was it Oswent? He only found out about my meeting place here because I needed a distraction in order to fulfill an agreement my master made with the undead. A certain animal was painstakingly modified for them.
Your interference is at an end. Just like the spy they sent to watch me you will never be found.
I won't even bother dealing with you myself.
Kresovus waves his hand and a number of Lugian Guards file into the room.
Kill him.
Kresovus portals further into the dungeon.
Thank you. I must ask that you defeat my imposter alone. I am not strong enough to fight him now. Please follow him and insure he troubles us no more.
Good luck my friend.
Kresovus makes a sweeping gesture recalling to his lifestone.
Kresovus heaves a sigh of relief and gives you an appraising look.
quest: These are grim tidings indeed. But valuable - most valuable information. You have done Linvak Tukal a great service. You are indeed marked for greatness.
Lord Kresovus shakes his head in wonder, "He keeps returning. When will that imposter learn that Guardian's like yourself will never allow him back?"
Take this Chorizite Pea. I have also given permission to Auritis to upgrade any of the armor or weapons of the Arm, Mind and Heart that you may have. Speak with him to find out more.
The Guardians report they have been unsucessful in removing the darkness from the last of the chambers below. I suspect we have not seen the last of this Shadow Kresovus.
Return in %tqt to fight Shadow Kresovus again.
Thank you for freeing me from that horrible shadow. Tell me friend, have you defeated him yet or does he still dwell in the warrens beneath?
Welcome back Guardian. The other Guardians report trouble in the lower levels. It would appear that Shadow Kresovus has returned. Do your duty and destroy this mockery in my name.
You must wait %tqt to complete this quest again.
Lord Kresovus heaves a great sigh. "Thank you for freeing me %tn. I owe you a great deal."
Kresovus chuckles lightly to himself.

Long have I trained the best of my people in the three paths we Lugians brought with us from the old world. You have not only seen the Trials of the Arm, Mind and Heart, but you must have bested each of them to save me from the cowled ones and the shadowy imposter.
Had a human ever asked to take the trials I would have denied them such a presumptious request, but you have proven your Strength, Clarity and Purity beyond doubt.

Lord Kresovus clears his throat, "All who may hear my words. I am proud to bestow the honor and duty of 'Guardian of Linvak Tukal' on %tn. Their honor and dignity continue to prove the wisdom of our friendship and loyalty to the Humans.
Thank you for freeing me human. My people and I owe you more than can ever be repaid.

Greetings, small one. You have come at a most critical time. After years of siege, our walls have been breached. Though not by the Gotrok. Some other foul tribe forced their way past defenses which have long stood fast. A tribe of some foul thing I cannot begin to describe. Bodies usurped, brothers possessed... the mind recoils at such horrors.

These fiends invaded under cover of darkness. They attacked while I slept. They meant to slay me - or take me prisoner - I do not know which. There was one with them, one whose appearance matched my own! I do believe he meant to assume control of Linvak Tukal in my stead.

Were it not for the valiant efforts of Captain K'rank, and my own doomed Balor, I fear I would have been overwhelmed. As it turns out, we were not overwhelmed. We repelled the invaders. But not without our own casualties.
Several of our own were taken prisoner by these beasts of Shadow. And Balor... my dear Balor...
My scouts tracked the demons to a location in the northernmost reaches of the Direlands. I fear I do not know more than that.
If you seek to aid us in this conflict, find these demons. Slay these demons. Return whatever information you might find.
And if you happen to find him, please do return my precious Balor to me.
I am not worthy to possess such an item.  Please, return it to one of the emissaries my people sent to contact you.
I do not want this, Isparian.
Wonderous! Wear these with pride, human, for they are a strong portion of my people's beliefs.
Free me!

greetings: No, use this on your Sleeves of the Arm. But in order to imbue the spear with the strength of righteousness, you must be strong and tireless, like a rain of ceaseless axe blows.
No, use this on the Staff of the Mind. But be warned, you need to have a strong mind and understanding of the ways of mana to use it successfully.

No, this must be used on the Spear of the Heart. But be warned, you must understand the nature of the Lugian heart. You must be able to pierce quick and righteously, like a spear of truth, if you wish to craft your item successfully.

My brethren of the Arm will be very glad to see this returned. Tukal has a debt to you, little Isparian. The Tukal Elders have authorized me to have sleeves fashioned from some of our most talented crafters. Here, take these Sleeves of the Arm.  While they are not quite suitable for use yet, if you can find one of our emissaries we sent to the Isparian Arrival points, they may have something of...

My people are strong. But in the immortal words of General Casarius, "Strength alone cannot win me this war. My mind must tell me where to strike." Returning the Sceptre of the Mind brings peace to many of our kin who follow the way of the Mind. The Tukal Elders have authorized me to have a Staff formed by some of our most talented crafters. I present you with this Staff of the Mind. It cannot...

Do you ever wonder why we have a blade as our totem of the heart? My brothers who believe in the Path of the Heart preach this to the uninitiated, "Trust your heart like you would trust your blade.   Use it in the cause of righteousness and none can withstand you. Leave it unguarded and you shall know the final sorrow." I thank you for mending this breach in our heritage.  One day maybe we can...
Ah yes, I remember these sleeves from the old days. Allow me to exchange these for this newer version.
Ah yes, I remember this staff from the old days. Allow me to exchange its for this newer version.
Ah yes, I remember this spear from the old days. Allow me to exchange these for this newer version.
quest: Here you are Guardian. Thank you for your part in defeating that vile imposter of Lord Kresovus.
Lord Kresovus sent me word of your honor. You may have one item from this list upgraded to the quality befitting a Guardian of Linvak Tukal my friend.
Fine Lugian workmanship here. If you want me to upgrade this you'll need Lord Kresovus' approval. We don't give just anyone our best work.

The raiders are striking hard now. They are fearful of our efforts to reach out to the Isparians. We have lost three of our most sacred totems due to their depredations. The Cloth of the Arm, the Sceptre of the Mind, and the Blade of the Heart must be found to ensure the continued stability of Linvak Tukal.

Our scouts have compiled information as to the whereabouts of the raiders' encampments into this report. You may find it useful in retrieving our totems. Kifandel the Imbuer now carries the Book of the Arm, Mind, and Heart, which records the words of Lauriagne, our first Matriarch. Read her words you will understand why the recovery of our totems is of the utmost importance to us.
I've recently made some improvements to the Sleeves of Inexhausitibility, the Staff of Clarity, and the Spear of Purity. If you would like to have one of these items, I will gladly improve it.
No, this is your reward. Go find one of the Gem Sellers. I believe there were three dispatched, each one to a different Isparian Arrival point. They can help you with this.
Congratulations!  You have earned it

greetings: Try giving that to the Tumerok my friend.
Try giving that to the Human my friend.
I'm sorry, I'm not in charge of collecting that type of material. Try seeing if the other collectors, Caelis or Aun Teverea, need any of that.
You are off on a wonderful adventure of stone.
Ahh, my friend K'rank finally got around to sending someone to collect the most recent collections, eh? Well, I hope your back is strong Isparian. This load would make the stoutest Mattekar whimper.
Kreavon loads several collections of minerals onto the wheelcart then passes it to you.
Be careful out there, if you get caught and surrounded before you return that to K'rank you are liable to end up next to a lifestone. Give K'rank my best.
quest: Well met Isparian.  I am Kreavon, a Linvak Lugian and also a member of the new alliance.  All Lugians loyal to Lord Krevesous are sworn members of the alliance.

We are assigned to this outpost near Wai Jhou, to collect building materials for the continued upkeep of Candeth Keep, the South Direlands stronghold. I will accept all types of salvaged stone and gem that you can afford to donate to the cause.  Large or small, your donations will be treated equally.
Would you care to provide us with more materials? I accept all types of salvaged stone and gem that you can afford to donate to the cause.
Hello again, your continued help is most welcome! Any salvaged stone or gem you can donate is greatly appreciated.
This is a good start friend. The Lugian planners continue work on the walls of Candeth Keep and the upkeep of the town. We need to supply them with a continuing supply of materials.
You are off to a very good start.  Yet, materials are still in short supply.  Please continue to bring me what you can.  Rock or gem, all materials are needed for Candeth Keep.
This is a fine haul, friend.  I have found my renegade brethren in the underground mines keep gemstone weaponry close at hand.  Seems like they must be mining more than just Chorizite down there, eh?
You have given me one-half the stone and gem materials that I would ask of you. The residents of Candeth Keep shall know you by your name and your deeds.
Lugian, Tumerok, and Isparian -- all working together. I never thought I would see the day. But we have unified in our common goal to build Candeth Keep and make it a foothold in the South Dires.
You have given much to help the alliance.  More materials are still needed, but rest assured you have donated the bulk of the quota set forth by the alliance council.

The storehouses are beginning to fill with the materials you and the others have generously given to the cause.  We now have enough materials to make another delivery to Candeth Keep, but we will surely need more to maintain our stronghold.
Friend, your hard work has paid off.  You have given the most that can be donated by any one member.

You will be welcomed in Candeth Keep as a co-founder.  Your donations of mineral and gemstone will be most beneficial to the continued work on the stronghold.  I am sure that those who have given of themselves will be rewarded in time.
If you would like to be known as a skilled miner, return this token to me.
If you're going to be mining you should have the proper headgear. Take this hat and wear it to keep your small skull from being crushed.

You have given one-half the resources of which the alliance is seeking from each member.  It is people like you who will be considered the true founders of Candeth Keep.  The alliance has allocated a symbolic gift for all of those who show dedication to the project.
You have helped us greatly. You can be sure that your efforts in continuing to provide materials for Candeth Keep will not go unrewarded.
You have given more than enough materials my friend. Perhaps the other collectors still require other materials.

greetings: This looks like one of those Idol heads those crazy Vesayen mosswarts worship. Hmmm, it's a lot smaller though. You could see if Grearrk, the mosswart living outside Sawato, knows anything about this.
I hear that obsidian comes from volcanoes, or from intense magical disruptions.
I'll also give you money for some of the trophy jewels you may have, but people tell me my prices aren't very good.
I'm looking for various stones. Not just any, but only from certain monsters. I'll also take swamp stones or banderling scalps.
Very pretty.
Such a deep blue. A fine jewel.
Very nicely cut! I'll take this.
A pleasure doing business.
This is quite a fancy jewel!
I might be able to cut a gem like this given enough time...
Ah, yes, these make fine jewels.
Here is a finished one for you.
Ah, not a stone lover?
Take these then, everyone finds pyreal useful.
I work these into perfect spheres.
Nice craftsmanship, eh?
This is a very impressive rock! Here, take one that I've finished cutting and polishing.
The light flickers in it's facets like a black fire. Use that in an Empyrean Weapon.
Here's what I make of those stones.
If you stare into the gems dark center for awhile you can almost make out... movement.
Haha, an unsettling optical illusion. Probably related to it's magical properties.
Oh good, a banderling scalp. Here, take this unpolished gem if you like.
I cure these to make soft rags that I use to polish my stones and gems.
You don't want it? Well, ok, take some coin instead.
It may look dull now, but wait till I'm through with it.
Yes, very good.
I have something for that.
Thank you.
Golem hearts are fine.
Good, good.
Granite? Yes, I need that.
Very pure Iron.
My thanks.
This is a nice chunk of ice.
Nice hunk of obsidian.
You're lucky to find one of these!
A heart of pure pyreal!
This is very valuable.
A heart of pure platinum!
Not sure what to do with it.
Perhaps I'll try cutting it.
Good for magic, but I can use it too.
Ah, Sunstone is truly a beautiful gem. A shame that clumsy hands have marred it as such. I shall restore it for you.
Pagrok pulls a few small vials of oil and a pair of fine chisels from a nearby pack. As he finishes the repairs, he polishes the gauntlets and hands them back to you.
Such a powerful wand that was built using information gained from the Virindi. This offers just a glimpse into their power with portal energies.
I must reward you for a trophy of this greatness.
I will take a number of trophy stones and jewels, such as virindi jewels, swamp stones, iron, copper, and granite golem hearts.
I'll also take banderling trophies.  But what I really specialize in are the rare black rocks, black stones, and the repair of Sunstone Gauntlets.
No, this is for you.  I have no need of the Writ.  Use it to acquire your new home!  Even if you have purchased the house, some dwellings further require them for maintenance payments.

What an interesting ... umm ... mechanism! I have no idea what it's for! But you know, those Arcanum Researchers, they've been working with odd metals like this -- you should ask one of them. You can find them in the libraries in Cragstone, Hebian-To, or Zaikhal.
These crystals have many alchemical uses. Ciandra has continued to research what allows these stones to tap into this worlds well of powerful magics.
Here, take this as a reward.
We need all the ingots we can get.  One day, you will be grateful we have such a stockpile.

A rare find!  My congratulations.  Here is your Writ of Refuge.  The Empyrean have left many secrets for us to puzzle out.  Their geomancy recently became transparent to us.  This powder might reveal yet another crucial part of their power.  We shall crush the enemy through their own devices!
Thank you for bringing us this Niffis Pearl. It is thought it may be useful. Take this Writ as your reward.
Well! Would you look at this! This should be useful!
We thought this jelly was useless for a time. But we've recently discovered it has certain properties which are of much interest to us. Please, take this Writ as a reward.
We feared we would never be able to lay our hands on this poison again. Thank you for choosing to part with such a rare item!
This is a strange device indeed. I have never seen anything like this before. Hmm...
The Agent ponders this strange new item momentarily.
I'll tell you what. I'll take this thing off your hands and give you a Writ of Refuge in exchange! Sounds like a good enough deal, eh? Then it is settled!

I've seen a number of pearls in my days... You know we exchange Niffis Pearls for writs correct? ... Anyway, I have seen a number of pearls before, but this is obviously not from any niffis I've seen.

Look at how dark this pearl is, it seems to eat the very light around it. This is a truly rare find, some ancient Empyrean decoration no doubt, but I can't imagine it would be very different from the niffis pearls we know of.
I'll give you a special deal on this pearl, since it is obviously of a different quality than your common niffis pearls.
Oh, the token, I guess you deserve this.
Ah yes, I seem to recall that our leather crafters stopped making shirts out of these. Don't worry, we have plenty in stock. Here, let me get you a shirt this hide.
Forge Essence! We can surely use as much of this as you can lay your hands on.
Thank you. If you need to see the list of tradable items again, just ask.
There are few beasts on Dereth as feared and hated as the Margul Sezzherei. To meet one who has personally slain the creature... I cannot believe it!
You should be commended for your efforts. From this point forward, let it be known to all that you are the Sezzherei Slayer!
Well, you've found an Ancient Empyrean artifact I see. These don't turn up all that often. You should be rewarded for this find. Here you go!

Well, you've found an Ancient Falatacot artifact I see. These things always make my skin crawl. You see, the usual way of activating one of these is to place a drop of blood on the wheel symbol here. I leave the study of these nasty things to others though, you never know what might happen when you activate it. You should be rewarded for this find. Here you go!
A counterfeit Niffis Pearl! You will soon learn the punishment for trying to deceive an Agent of the Arcanum.
How does a thousand year sentence in the Queen's dungeon sound to you?
Agent of the Arcanum seems to be lost in thought for a moment.
Perhaps a deal may be struck.
We have just recently discovered these fakes and have been trying unsuccessfully to uncover the hideout of the forgers who craft these items.
Perhaps you will help us? In exchange for uncovering and destroying their hideout, I am willing to 'forgive' your transgression.
Or if you prefer I can just throw you in the dungeon and be done with it.
It's your choice.
Here. Take this note and return to your contact. Try to get in their good graces and find the location of their hideout.
Once you destroy their ability to produce Fake Niffis Pearls, bring back any leftover inventory to us so that we may dispose of them.
You have done well. I'm sure they will think twice before trying to fool the Agents of the Arcanum.
I absolve you of the crime of counterfeiting.
Although no reward is necessary, please accept this as a small token of our thanks.
You seem wise beyond your years.
Luminance is always a wonderful thing.
I shall share part of what I know with you. Use it well.
Knowledge earned is a great gift. Use it wisely.
A little Luminance is always a wonderful thing.
Ahhh a most intriquing item. I will have to study this and see what powers it may hold.
I see you have proven yourself in the Gauntlet. Please take this in return.
quest: Try back next month.
I am afraid you've turned in all you can for this month.
You must wait %tqt to turn in A'nekshay Gem of Knowledge again.
You must wait %tqt to turn in A'nekshay Gem of Lesser Knowledge again.
You must wait %tqt to turn in A'nekshay Luminance Certificate again.
Hand me another minor crystal like this one and I'll be able to reward you.

Thank you for investigating this matter for the Arcanum!  No, we do not yet comprehend the extent of the schemes of this minion.  I have confidence we shall find out soon, though.  Here is your Writ.  As of this time, we do not need any further tokens from you.  We will however still take the other trophies I mentioned to you.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. You are looking a little green my friend. Are you feeling okay?
We only wanted to see that you had achieved what we asked. Seeing as how you did so well you should keep this.
You never know, you may find a use for it yet.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. Umm, I think your britches may be burning.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. You know your hair looks as though it is standing on end.
Wow! Great work. Here is your reward. Was it cold in there?
I have recently rewarded you for visiting revenge up on that madman. Please come back to me in one day before asking for another reward.
%n shakes their head at you condemningly.
You are still a cur unworthy of trust. I am only too grateful to the wisdom and compassion of others. With their help, and theirs alone was Nuhmudira freed.

You are fortunate that she has pity within her heart enough to grant you the trappings that you need to obtain housing. If you give me any of these items listed here, then I will grudgingly give you a Writ of Refuge.
%n smiles at you gently.
You have done much to help us. Your sacrifice and actions assisted Nuhmudira in her darkest hour and we thank you for those efforts.
If you have not yet done so, seek out Balthazar outside of Lin. He will instruct you on how you may further aid us.

Housing continues to be provided through a joint effort of the Arcanum and the High Queen. Writs are required for these domiciles. Once you possess a Writ of Refuge, seek out a Covenant Stone and determine what else is needed to purchase your homestead. Also of note are new dwellings that have been opened that offer a more communal living arrangement.
Here is a list items we will accept in exchange for writs.
%n salutes you.
Here, take this as a reward.
I already informed you that we no longer need any tokens from you.  We will however still take the other trophies I mentioned to you.
Wow! You were able to navigate that place again. Great Job! We are not giving repeat offenders the Writs, but everything else is still available.
The Agent bows their head low and speaks softly.

Although Nuhmudira has returned to us, we have learned that there is still a way to show your support for her. Outside of Stonehold there is a portal to the dungeon where she was once imprisoned. There you can choose to sacrifice yourself for her or to abandon her to her fate. It is odd that the magic has yet to dissipate.

If you require writs we will accept any of the items on this list in exchange for a writ. Once you possess a Writ of Refuge, and have satisfied the other requirements for purchasing a home, seek out one of the homestead areas that we have built. If you would rather, you can enjoy living in one of the new dwelling areas that have been established for a more communal living arrangement.
Here is your reward.
I see that you have visited revenge upon the man that wanted to bring our race to an end. Nuhmudira thanks you for this. Here is your reward.
You are not powerful enough to receive the reward for this item, adventurer.
From this day forward %s shall be known as Gaerlan Slayer.

greetings: Toberik, you crazy hoktor! Well Isparian, it appears as though you brought this report to me in good time. Toberik means to detain Morgluuk's brother, Torgluuk, so that we can face just the one brother. The plan is not without trouble though. We have managed to learn much from the blueprints that we obtained from the Burun fortress in the Blackmire Swamp.

Currently, we believe that the best course of action is to approach the fortress from their north. The walls are weaker there, it appears as though the Renegade builders have been spending more time trying to discern the goals of the Burun and not enough on shoring up their work.

This will not be a simple fight. We will need you to be quick and efficient in your assault. We Lugians will assist the Tumeroks of Marae Lassel in laying an assault against one of the Renegade fortresses to provide you a small amount of assistance.

Once you break the walls down, you will need to enter the catacombs that the Burun have built beneath the fortress. Find your way through and defeat Morgluuk. He is very strong, there may be ways to weaken him without facing him... I would advise trying to find a way to weaken him before assaulting him directly.
Captain K'rank says "Good luck to you, %tn!"

Incredible work. You've done a remarkable job in collecting these specimens. I can see that you spent a good deal of time collecting these at the Ma--in the wilderness! Great work! As promised, you are deserving of a fair reward.
Come back tomorrow, I might have more work for you then.
These are wonderful finds. I'm going to see that these find their way into our sages hands as quickly as possible. For now, I must get you your reward.

Nasty smell coming from this crate. You must have freshly killed the majority of these creatures. Your efforts should not go unrewarded and to prove that we Lugian's are as noble as we claim, I offer you these.
I offer you my thanks and the small tokens that I shall give you in a moment. The information contained in this missive may one day save a great many lives.
Gorak must have been pleased to see the axe, he overpaid. I'll make sure that this finds its way to him in a future payment. You've been a great help, please take this with my thanks.
Olcris is sure to have been up to something no good. I'll have a scholar look over this missive as soon as I take care of your reward.
Ugh! That was rather heavy, you could have warned me before just tossing into my arms like that. Cripes! Nonetheless, you did as I asked, so you are deserving of a fair reward. Here, take these.
quest: Captain K'rank says, "Hail %tn."
I see that you have returned to shatter the morale of the Burun again. Your efforts continue to assist our people in lessening the threat these creatures pose. Here are your rewards.
The key will open whichever chest you choose in that room. Each chest should clearly display what it holds.
That is all that I have to give.
Captain K'rank says, "Thank you again for your efforts, %tn."

Again you take the head of the Burun leader, Morgluuk. You are surely a hero to all. As we have already placed the creatures head outside of the city in your honor, this one will be turned into a trophy that you can display with honor.
%tn has defeated Morgluuk and received a glorious reward for their efforts.
You should also be able to draw your rewards from the High Queen's treasure as well. Here take this key and this gem.
As you know, this key opens whichever chest you choose within that room. You are due just another small token, %tn.
That is all I have to give.
Captain K'rank says, "You are a hero to us all, %tn."
You come have to aid us, no? Well then, let me see what I have for you.

Captain K'rank says, "Ah, you said your name was %tn, yes? Well it appears as though you've been here recently as your name appears in my notes. We're trying not to overwork you too much, so please finish up what we asked of you and then take some time for yourself. Come back to me tomorrow and I'll see what I can have you do."
No, it looks like you helped us with this one.
You've familiar blood on your armor. It is the blood of our brothers who succumbed to the way of the Virindi. Is it possible that you have found Toberik? Quickly, if have news from him let me see it.
Filthy creatures these Burun. As promised you are to be rewarded for your efforts.
A brave warrior who has continued our efforts to crush the morale of the Burun and the renegades. You have done well. Here take this and display it proudly.
The High Queen also wishes you to take a small reward from her coffers. Take these.
The key will open whichever chest you choose within the treasure room to which the gem brings you.

Hail Isparian, I am sorry if I appear preoccupied. I am waiting on a very important report from a spy working amongst the Renegades. His report from the Renegade fortress in the Direlands is overdue and we have seen an increase in the number of camps surrounding the fortress. I should not bother you with such concerns.
You have come to aid us, no? Well then, let me see what I have for you.
Captain K'rank seems to consult some notes.
Let me see what I have for you.

Here is one. We are collecting information of the varying hides of the Armoredillos. We're looking into ways to create layered armor from their hides that would afford better than usual protection against all different forms of damage. Here take this.

Put the specimens in this sack in the following order, no need to write this down, we've already listed the order on the outside of the sack. I'm just making sure that you've been told as well. Small armoredillo hide, followed by the regular hide, the large hide, then the sturdy hide and lastly the plate armoredillo hide. When you have filled the sack return it to me for a handsome reward of no...

This one should prove interesting. Our sages are interested in the geomancy that makes the Golems 'live'. We need specimens of the Golem's hearts to continue our study. Since we're used to working with stones it comes as no surprise that we are specifically interested in the different stone and mineral golems. Take this.

Put the specimens in corresponding collection slots. They are listed on the front of the crate for easy reference. Just to be clear however, I will tell you the order they should be collected in. First collect a granite heart, followed by iron, copper, obsidian, gold and finally a diamond heart. Then return to me with the full crate.

A little less sanitary than other collections, but no less important. Recent findings by Isparian adventurers, the High Queen, Lugian Sages and Tumerok Mystics, has resulted in a wide-spread belief that the Sclavus are an amalgam of creatures. Yes, this was first proffered forth by other more notable scholars, but even the recent findings are still full of conjecture. Perhaps the Sclavus that l...

Inside the crate you'll find several bags labeled for the different body parts that are commonly harvested from the Sclavus. You should collect the specimens in the following order and then place them into the bags in the crate. The outside of the crate also has the order listed. But I want to make certain that I have done my best to inform you of your duty. Collect the small hide of the creatu...

Not long ago I met a rugged traveler from the Island town of MacNiall's Freehold. This savvy traveler struck an efficacious deal with me, one that I intend to uphold as best I can. I'm to deliver a collection of treated herbs to him in exchange for some information that he has been collecting for me. If you're so disposed to assisting me, bring these herbs to MacNiall and return to me with the...
Be swift, MacNiall's information is very important to our cause of unity. Hurry along now.

An old friend of mine, Gorak, was sent to support the besieged town at Dryreach. Unfortunately, Gorak was sent to the beleaguered city before he had time to pick up his new axe. If you'd be so kind to deliver the axe and collect payment from Gorak for the work, I am certain that I can muster a small reward for you.
Please, hurry. Every moment that Gorak is without his axe is another that the townsfolk of Dryreach live in danger of invasion.
Though many believe that we Lugian's have either thrown our lot in with High Queen Elysa or with that traitorous dog, Muldaveus.
Captain K'rank spits.

Excuse me... That belief is untrue. Some Lugians actually struck out on their own when Nuhmudira was claiming that she desired to create a grand place of learning. One such Lugian, Olcris, joined with Nuhmudira and started acting very strangely. Well... my reach isn't so short that I don't have eyes on him. In fact, I have a contact at the Beach Fort that keeps up with all his comings and going...
It's a small price to pay someone for such important information. Feruza's reports and return them to me for a fair reward.

I am certain that you're aware that we assisted in the reclamation and restoration process of Wai Jhou, yes? I was never given to trying to make a swamp city better. Honestly, it's in a swamp. They'll be lucky if that town doesn't fall down, sink into the swamp, then burn and sink into the swamp before a real city thrives there. I'm sorry, got a little off topic. We have a worker stationed ther...
Kreavon is responsible for collecting minerals, they can get quite heavy over time. We've crafted this wheelcart for his use. Would you mind brining it to him?
Wait for Kreavon to fill the cart, then return it to me for a fair reward.
Captain K'rank exclaims, %tn, "You have killed the Burun leader, Morgluuk!"
This head is proof of what you have done. All should know your name.

%tn has slain Morgluuk and returned his head to the Lugian capital of Linvak Tukal. There it is to be placed on a pike as a symbol of victory for the Isparian, Lugian and Tumerok people and a symbol of defeat for the Burun that threaten our way of life. Huzzah, %tn!
You must be rewarded for your efforts.
The portal gem will take you into the High Queen's Vault. There you will find many chests that house treasures and weaponry that has been worked on by the finest smiths in the land.
Captain K'rank says, "Take your gift and use it well, %tn. You are deserved of much praise in this victory."
Captain K'rank says, "That is the final reward I have for you. You have become a hero to all of Dereth, %tn. I shall never forget your name or your deeds."
You have gained access to the island they call Vissidal, have you not?
%n smiles broadly.
May you spill much blood.
Take this, may you need it.
Welcome, friend. I seek warriors in search of great adventure. I represent one who would grant the Isparians of this world much power, much knowledge.

She has found something. Something powerful beneath the waves of this world. A city, ancient and doomed. The blue-skinned King did his part to raise it from the deep, but I daresay he could not have done it alone.
Now that the island exists, the lady would ask Dereth's hunters and adventurers to explore its mysteries.
If you seek such a challenge, I bid you take this gem and place it within the empty eye of one of Aerlinthe's Watchers. The Watchers will tell you what else you must do.
You have the spark of adventure within you. Good luck, my friend.
Nice day, is it not?
By the way, could you take this off my hands? I have no idea what to do with it.

greetings: For the honor of Linvak Tukal!
Protect the Lord!
The fighter takes the ticket from you and rips it in two, storing it's half in a bag marked "Bets".
The mines have been shut down and it's costing us in pyreal.
Our contracted miners get paid if we're getting ore or not.
If you're in the mine bring a pick axe, you'll need it to look around.
I'll accept a stack of fifty ore in exchange for its trade note value.
quest: You must wait %tqt to turn in more ore.
Looks like you're quite the miner.
Take this as compensation for the ore and your hard work.
We don't accept small parcels of ore, this is a large operation.
You will only be paid for stacks of fifty ore.

greetings: Someone has already given me this axe.
You see right here?
He points to a mark on the handle of the axe.
I mark every axe I see to keep track of it. It's something I learned keeping track of all this mining equipment.
What is this? This is old...
Where did you find it?
You tell the story of the fortress you found.
When I was a boy I heard stories of an ancient fortress. I never imagined it could be true.
The mine has become too dangerous and we were forced to stop all work.
It's not unstable, we Lugians are excellent builders and miners.
We've encountered a new creature deep in the tunnels, some sort of Water Elemental.
They're very dangerous to fight with normal physical attacks.
If you find anything of value in the tunnels bring it to me.
Bring this to a scholar who can translate these writings. This text could reveal who is responsible for our misfortune.
Neelic takes the parchment. You can see the rage grow in his eyes as he reads.
What is this? How insulting! To think the mighty Lugians could be so easily used!
Perhaps we were careless. We will be sure our guard is doubled. Our resources and workers will not fall prey to such deception again.
Our great city thanks you. Your courage will be remembered and rewarded. Take these gifts as a sign of our gratitude.
quest: Your work has proven to be of great help. We have increased security for our resource caches and all workers have been notified of the threat.
You may repeat this quest in %tqt
Have you found the cause for our missing materials and crafters?
Neelic appears preoccupied.
My apologies, but it appears we have been the victim of theft. How could this happen here? Our guards are second to none!

Allow me to explain. Our caches of raw materials used to craft the finest of Lugian weapons have been pillaged. Large quantities of ore and lumber have gone missing, but our guards reported nothing out of the ordinary.
More disturbing than the theft of our resources are the disappearances of many of our finest young crafters. They simply disappeared.

I sense foul play. No Lugian would ever abandon their duties or conspire to steal from their own kind. These are desperate times, and I humbly ask for your assistance in getting to the bottom of this so that we can hold those responsible accountable for their misdeeds.
If you can track down these bandits and bring them to justice, we would be in your debt. Please make haste, our forges are all but shut down due to the loss of so much raw material and crafter alike.
My apologies. These are troubling times. I would not enlist the help of young adventurers that would surely give no progress.
Please direct any seasoned veterans my way. Their help could prove valuable.

greetings: You are not authorized to be here!
This is quite an interesting offer. Bring this document to your Raksaa.
And a small token for your assistance, little messenger. Quickly use your key and then begone.
quest: What are you still doing here? For your size, you are quite slow.
I do not know how you managed to traverse this far. Speak quickly if you have something to say or I will squeeze the life out of you.

greetings: Commander Keeson grunts, "Commander Presk is not to be disturbed. Guards! Kill all trespassers!"
Raksaa takes the sealed scroll and begins to read the contents.

Good, good. Commander Presk has agreed that working with the "vermin" of Linvak is an acceptable solution to destroy the oppressive stranglehold of the Rynthid. This is a far better response than I expected.

It is a small step, but it is a step forward in ridding the Plains of these vile creatures. Your courage is most impressive, a lesser creature could never have hoped to survive Commander Presk's warriors.
This stone feels too light for throwing, perhaps you can find a use for it.
quest: We have heard rumors that one of the corrupted Lugians named Commander Presk is seeking to break free from the control that the Rynthid are trying to impose. We must take advantage of this!
If he is willing to accept aid from Linvak, we may be able to swing the war against these Rynthid in our favor.
Be wary of his minions. They will not recognize you as friend or ally and will attack you on sight, but if you can reach Commander Presk within his bunker, he may be willing to consider our offer.

Deliver this sealed scroll that contains our proposal to the Commander inside his bunker to the Southwest and return to me right away with his response...that is, if you survive Presk's forces and he doesn't crush you into jelly.
What news do you have from Commander Presk?
What was the Commander's response to our offer?
Come back later and I might have more work for you.
This is a matter of the utmost importance. Try not to lose the parchment this time.
I suggest returning when you are stronger.

greetings: Balor growls in warning...
Balor eyes you warily.

I welcome you, human. You may be surprised to find a Merwart with my vocabulary and elocution. We here on Vissidal Island were raised out of our primitive squalor by Angry Grandfather, a human shaman.
He gave us names and speech and taught some of my cousins how to cater to the needs of the human adventurers who would surely come here in search of excitement.

Welcome to Vissidal Island, human. We were told to expect your coming. Vissidal is the name of this land, or so Angry Grandfather told us. It once belonged to people called... Fa-la-ta-cot. Yes, that's the word.
I thank you, human. This means Bloodmouth have died and that makes me less sad. Let me reward you...
If you don't like that weapon, give it back to me and I will share knowledge with you.
You don't like the weapon I made? Too bad. But not everyone fights the same way. I will share knowledge with you instead.
quest: Ah, it is you, who showed me kindness before. I thank you, human. If you get another Bloodmouth Maw, I can make you another Remoran Fist weapon... And if you don't like your Remoran Fist, you can give it to me and I will share knowledge with you.
Help me, human! Before Angry Grandfather showed us the way of the blue stone, my family was killed, eaten, devoured by horrible Bloodmouth Remoran! I seek vengeance!

Go find Bloodmouth Remoran by the ruin of my house near the bay east of here. Kill them, and bring me back a Bloodmouth Maw! It may be difficult, because their wicked jaws are so well concealed inside their hateful little heads! But I will reward you with a weapon like the one I hold!

greetings: You did it! I dance for joy if Angry Grandfather not think it so undignified! You deserve big reward, human. Take this club, I need no more.

If you no like club, I take it back, in exchange for enlightenment. If you get stronger and want to make club stronger, bring me golem heart, I carve for you to attach to club. What heart? Memory so bad... Platinum! Yes! Bring me Platinum Golem Heart, I carve for you to strap to club, make club whang harder!
You no like? Your loss. Great weapon. Soon to make many legends. Oh, well. Humans dumb, like Angry Grandfather always say.
You no like? Your loss. Great weapon. Even better with Platinum Golem Heart strapped to it. Club not whang as hard as you want, even now? Oh, well. Humans dumb, like Angry Grandfather always says.
Oh! You want improve Club of Surprising Cunning? I carve this for you. Here, take this, strap it to club. Make club swing harder, spells stronger. Go make big whang!
quest: You already brought me hand of Blightfinger. I need no more. Thanks again!

Have you killed Blightfinger yet? Taken his big stinky hand? No? What you wait for then? You forget? I tell you already, he live in hole in the ground, north of here, along beach! Just follow beach and find Blightfinger and his stinky friends!

You! Yes you can help! I serve the great god Angry Grandfather from that human town nearby. I explore lands for him. But I am stopped now. There is a big stinky fin-face acid-spitter nest north of here! They are crawling out of a hole in the water! Interfering with my exploration! Kill their leader, the biggest and stinkiest one of them all! Bring me hand of Blightfinger, and I give you reward!
You come back when stronger.
Only one person may attempt the puzzle at a time.
If you can solve the puzzle you can gain access to Santa's House.
Be careful. If you make a 3 mistakes you will have to start over.
You have 5 minutes. Good luck.
You have already freed me, please help the others.
The Moarself bows before you; thankful to be free from his prison.

greetings: The fighter takes the ticket from you and rips it in two, storing it's half in a bag marked "Bets".

quest: I already give you note! You go talk to Big 'Rok with spear! Go now!

You! Human help Hagra! Big 'Rok with spear in 'Rok village, very angry with Hagra! Hagra have no choice, Hagra's people very hungry! We escape bad things on bigger land, need food to live and make more Mosswarts! You take this to Big 'Rok with spear, tell him we be friends!
Humie been around too much lately. Me uneasy about humie. Maybe it better if I wait for things to calm down.
You rapidly explain your reason for being here to the Mosswart shaman, who after a moment nods.
Me trust you. Me seek out others of my kind who maybe resist Bragara. Wish luck.
Not trust! Not trust! Not get fooled by tricks!
Humie help Mosswart shamans flee Bragara. Humie receive great spear from Mosswart gods as reward. Mosswart debt to humie end here.
This place holy to Mosswart gods and heroes. Ahumba care for place, not fight in it. But you not belong here. You go. Nothing for you here.

greetings: You hear a voice in your mind, screaming with agony. You can barely make out the thought, "Master! Protect me!"
At the same time, you hear a sound like a shattering crystal.
%mn throws the Wallbound Niffis back in your face. It is clear that she is angry with you for rejecting her gift.
%mn flexes her tentacles.
%mn beats the air rapidly with her wings.

%mn sighs deeply. You get the feeling that beneath her prize-fighting, rough and tumble exterior lies an ocean of despair and longing. You wonder just what could cause such a deep feeling of sadness in one who has accomplished so much. Yet before you can question her, she wipes away a purple tear with one shaking tentacle, cocks her head, and resumes her previous stance of fighter, champion, wa...

%mn ponders the note for a long moment. She looks you in the eye and your heart breaks at the sadness you glimpse beneath those dark, melancholy orbs. This is a fighter who has abandoned those that love her. And for what? Glory? Acceptance? Approval from those who would use her for naught but entertainment? Or worse, for profit?

%mn regards you for a time, then nods her head. You don't quite understand what passes between you, but you think it feels a little something like gratitude. Perhaps you have helped this poor, small Niffis. Perhaps you have pointed out the path - that path which all of us seek - towards contentment.

%mn's tentacles quiver, as if itching to lash out. You get the feeling that this is a well-trained and well-disciplined fighter and you know, deep in your heart, that she will not hurt you now. No, she will not. She's saving it for the ring.
Drop unwanted items into the acid pit to destroy them.
Putiputipuh idly nibbles at the artifact.
Putiputipuh rubs up against the artifact, then ignores it.
Putiputipuh stares (if you can call it that) at the artifact for a moment. Then stops.
Putiputipuh happily gnaws on the end of the bow for a moment, but does nothing more.
Putiputipuh smells the note, chews it up, then spits it out. Yuck.
quest: Putiputipuh whines, so softly and at so high a pitch you can bearly hear it.
The grub doesn't seem hungry at the moment.
The grub rustles, but otherwise ignores you.
The grub seems to sniff the air, but doesn't eat.
Tekapuapuh sighs. "Hmm. I remember washing my hands in those splashy-bubble-pots, before feeding her an onga. Maybe your hands are dirty?"
As you reach out with the apple, the grub emits a faint, high-pitched whine. You feel something squirming under your skin, along your arm and into the apple.
The grub happily devours the apple, swallowing it core and all.
Tekapuapuh squeals with delight. "You did it! Putiputipuh's happy again! Thank you thank you thank you!"

greetings: As the Hive Maggot Giant collapses to the ground, a voice echoes through your mind...."A small triumph, an insignificant loss. Meaningless."
Revel now. But know this - death is coming.
May your bones freeze and snap, fleshling.
Mr. P looks at the letter and hops up and down with excitement. You don't know what the letter said, but you can see the happiness on Mr. P's face.
Mr. P sticks his head into the Igloo, chatters something to the small pengy, and then looks at you approvingly.
Mr. P thinks MacNiall's Freehold needs a candy store.
Mr. P is enjoying the warm sunshine and soothing ocean sounds
Mr. P is sitting outside nibbling on cookies when you hand him the Small Sack of Penguin Treats.
Mr. P sniffs at the sack and can smell the pengy food. Mr. P sticks his tongue out at it but knows that a proper diet is best for young pengys. Mr. P nods at you for a job well done.
Mr. P continues to nibble on his cookie a bit then hands it to you.
Odd, it's shaped like an igloo... Maybe you should look for a mechanic who knows a thing or two about igloos.
Mr. P inspects your Portable Igloo and nods. Mr. P has never been fond of igloos but understands that not all pengys like the warm weather like he does.
Mr. P has one final important task for you. He has received news that a pengy rookery has been overrun by mean old Eaters. Mr. P wants you to help save the pengy population and rescue an egg.
Mr. P draws a small but highly detailed map of the Halatean Isles in the sand, pointing out a location that seems to be at 80.8N, 57.4W.

Mr. P is so happy to see that you have saved an egg he jumps up and down and does a little belly slide. Mr. P waddles into his house for a moment and returns with a gift for you, your very own pet pengy.
quest: Mr. P looks at you with pride in his eyes, and then nibbles on a piece of candy contentedly.
Mr. P reaches into his "P-pocket" and pulls out a small piece of candy. His eyes light up at the sight of it and he quickly tosses it into his mouth.
Mr. P leans back and continues to enjoy his sweet treat when he realizes he is being watched.

Feeling a little embarrassed Mr. P puffs up his belly and squints at you. You feel as if this strange little penguin is judging you. After a few awkward moments he picks up an old candy wrapper from the ground, smoothes 						it out a bit and hands it to you.
Mr. P sits back again and hums to himself while rubbing his tummy.
Mr. P sniffs at your pockets, and then looks through your packs for the pengy food. Not finding any, he draws a tiny but highly detailed map of Osteth in the sand.
Looking at the map, there is a Pet Store noted at 35.2N, 39.4E.
Mr. P sniffs at your pockets, and then looks at you expectantly.
Mr. P looks at you for a minute, sighs, and then draws a tiny but highly detailed map of Osteth in the sand.
As you look at the map, you realize you should be looking around 68.5S, 25.5E for a Snowman.
Mr. P shivers slightly, like the temperature suddenly dropped, and then looks at you expectantly.
Mr. P looks you over for a pengy egg, seeming a bit excited that you may have one.
Mr. P looks you over for a pengy egg.
Failing to find a pengy egg on you, Mr. P draws a small but highly detailed map of the Halatean Isles in the sand, pointing out a location that seems to be at 80.8N, 57.4W.

greetings: Uber P looks at the letter and hops up and down with excitement. He stops after a moment and looks at the ground sadly.
He draws a detailed map in the snow that you recognize as MacNiall's Freehold and slips a letter into your pack.
Uber P hops up and down with excitement. It's clear this penguin has something for you.

quest: Mouf appears to be busy gathering his belongings. He looks like he is preparing to leave.
Mouf cowers as you approach. He draws a large "P" in the snow and slips a piece of paper into your pack.

greetings: The baby penguin shrieks when it sees you, alerting a nearby adult.
The Poisonous Brier Wasp creates a cloud of dangerous gas!
%s has slain the %n.
You hear an odd scritching, splintering sound. Something nearby is gnawing on bones.
Tuperea cries out in dismay as nimble Manuaka falls to %s's attack!
The lithe Manuaka bounds over the collapsing bulk of %s, then races away.
Manuaka's muzzle twitches as he catches the scent of %s!
Manuaka bays for assistance from the pack!
Tuperea whistles for Manuaka to heel.
"Reshalra! No!" Tuperea cries as %s lands a killing blow on the brutish hunting reedshark.
Reshalra tears a hunk of meat from %s's corpse, and his muscular form bounds away seeking new prey.
Reshalra whirls to face %s, his lips curling back into a feral snarl.
Reshalra bays for assistance from the pack!
Tuperea whistles for Reshalra to heel.
A shudder passes through Reshalra's massive form as %s's blow finds a weak point.
Huntmaster Tuperea howls in anguish as %s releases loyal Sahkurea's soul from the prison of her Virindi-augmented body.
The relentless Sahkurea has run %s to ground!
Sahkurea perks up at the sound of %s's footsteps.
Sahkurea bays for assistance from the pack!
Tuperea whistles for Sahkurea to heel.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Stares into your soul as if looking to freeze by glare alone.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Stares into your soul as if looking to freeze by glare alone.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
You look into the Ruschk Leader's eyes and he nods and gives you a piece of paper. You suddenly know that the thief dropped this when escaping the Ruschk Camp.

As you look into the Leader's eyes you see an image in you mind. A small, funny looking Ruschk sneaks into the tent and takes a totem. Then the Ruschk attack the stranger, but it manages to summon a portal and escape.
The Ruschk looks greatly pleased. He presses his right fist into his left hand and bows to you.
The Ruschk then looks at you quizzically, seeming to wonder if you wished to hunt more Knights.
quest: The Ruschk sees you have been busy, he wonders why you have not completed the tasks he has asked for.
The Ruschk sees you have killed all the Viamontian Knights he has asked you to. Have you recieved the Vial of strange fluid 93.5N, 51.4W?

A chill passes through your body, numbing you to the core. For a single moment, you feel like you're going to die from the sensation alone. The Ruschk opens his mouth; his speech comes out in but a whisper...
%tn

In your mind, the following information becomes apparent to you. The Ruchk standing before you wishes you to kill 30 of the Viamontian Knights in the valley below. Once this is complete, he wishes you to retrieve a vial from the westernmost Knight Encampment in the valley, near 93.5N, 51.4W. You get the impression that the vial is in a small building, toward the back of the encampment.

greetings: The Ruschk looks at the Totem with obvious contempt, and drops it unceremoniously in his pouch. Then, with a look which seems to beam with pride, he claps you on the back. With obvious effort, he speaks in a barely audible whisper.
Well... Done.
The Ruschk, Kalakh, awards you the title of "Friend to the Frostglaive."
quest: The Ruschk wishes you to return later in the event another totem is created.
The Ruschk wonders why you have not returned with the Totem.

The Ruschk looks you up and down, like he is gauging your strength. With a nod of approval, he stares into your eyes, and with a wash of deathly cold, the following information becomes apparent in your mind:

The Ruschk wishes you to enter the Temple of the Black Spear, located at 95.5N, 51.8W, and retrieve a small totem, important to the followers of Grael. Once you bring the totem back to him, he will reward you for your strength.
The Ruschk's eyes are instantly drawn to where you have the totem stashed away in your packs. He looks at you expectantly.
The Ruschk looks you up and down, like he is gauging your strength. Come back when you are stronger.

greetings: The fighter takes the ticket from you and rips it in two, storing it's half in a bag marked "Bets".
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
You do not wish to partake of the Harbinger's Blood?
Issk's eye slits expand in surprise. In an eager voice he speaks almost to quickly to understand.
I would gladly exchange sssome ssecret knowledge with you for the blood.
Exceedingly well done "Blood Seeker"... She who ssings to the world may find a use for this strange Harbinger's blood.

Our Mistress tells us that Aerbax has begun his experiments anew. Perhaps you have seen ssome of his children? The Harbinger has long evaded his attempts to uncover its secretss, but he may have discovered a way to control its energies. I must inform my Mistress of this new manifestation.
Here take this infusion and protective gem my Mistresss devised from the Harbinger's many gifts.
quest: You have done all you can, and she who sings bid you rest for a time, so that your body may adjust to the gift you received. There are others to take up the cause and to assist us in righting what has been made wrong.
You have chosen to aid the foul Aerbax. You have the stink of corruption already upon you. Leave my presence at once.
You have slain my brethren in battle and offended our most high Priestess, Nuhmudira. She shall hold a special place for you. Fear the blade, fledgling, its pain is succor and the blow is swift.
Fear the sound of your life ebbing away, as your limbs grow heavy and your heart grows light.
Your lifeblood shall serve as the river that feeds the land. Leave this place or feel my bite and welcome cool sleep.
You have done well to earn your reward.
Why do you linger here, when she who sings has made her will apparent? Be off with you.
