This should not be, you rewarded me with something. Please allow me to examine you again.

You seek to assist she who sings to the world? Well you should. She has risen from the ashes to call all to her side. She seeks to repair the hurt wreaked upon the land and close the wounds that hemorrhage still.
Would you take up her banner and stride forth into the darkness wherein the true enemy lies? I think you weak.
I think you know fear. I think you suffer and suffer you shall. She bids me give you this.
She bids you read it. She bids you understand. She bids you complete the task and return to me. She needs the proof of your resolve. She needs to see that you will not fail.
Where to begin...
The Priest drones on and on and while you do learn quite a bit you realize there must be a better way to acquire experience.
Very well, perhaps another time.

greetings: This book is most precious... Mistress will reward Ssavish. I cannot share translation with you, warmblood. This knowledge is too powerful for all warmbloods except Mistress. But with the information in this book, I shall make for you a reward that echoes the mighty Grael.
At last, the Grael Rebellion... Mistress will be pleased. I thank you, warmblood. I will translate this text for you and share its knowledge with you.
At last, the Song of Grael... Mistress will be pleased. I thank you, warmblood. I will translate this text for you and share its knowledge with you.
quest: I have told you where to find the archives, yes? Go forth and bring me the books, warmblood.
If you need a reminder, the Lost Coastal archive is at 37.4 N, 67.0 E.
The Lost Desert Archive is at 4.0 N, 2.4W.
The Frozen Cenotaph is on the Halaetan Islands, at 90.6 N, 66.7 W.
Help me, human! My mistress seeks books of Grael! Three books in three places, find them and bring them to me!
Seek the tome of the Song of Grael in the Lost Coastal Archive of the Dericostians, at 37.4 N, 67.0 E, and bring it to me.
Seek the tome of the Grael Rebellion in the Lost Desert Archive of the vanished Yalain, at 4.0 N, 2.4 W, and bring it to me.
Seek the tome of the Dreams of Salt and Ash in the Frozen Cenotaph of the Ruschk, at 90.6 N, 66.7 W on the Halaetan Islands, and bring it to me.

greetings: Why have the Old Ones abandoned us to the foul leeches of Dericost?
Master's voice... It hurts, it hurts...

At last, my master can rest in peace. At last, his voice no longer wails in my mind. I thank you, man-thing. Perhaps there is a way I can give you to speak with my Master yourself, that he may show you his gratitude...
quest: At last, my master can rest in peace. Please return to me later I may need your assistance again man-thing.
Hurry man-thing help me end my torment. Go into this portal, defeat the Harvester, and destroy the tomb of Adhorix.

Help me, man-thing. Help me. My master's tomb lies defiled within that portal, profaned by the Dericostian sorcerer-dog known as the Eternal Harvester. Day and night, sleep and wake, I hear the voice of Master Adhorix. He is in pain because of the Dericostian's desecration.

End my torment. Go into this portal, defeat the Harvester, and destroy the tomb of Adhorix. It is the only way we will have peace. Bring me rubble from the tomb once you have done this, and we will reward you.

greetings: Hassha grants you leave to enter the Cells of the Black Book, human. Tread carefully, but rejoice! Great power lies within. You must take it, and use it... Let it be known, the portal will only accept you if you have given yourself to blood and darkness. You may only enter the Cells of the Black Book if you seek the blood of your fellow humans...
As he dies, Tch'Keryk the Emissary howls at %tn, "T'thuun take you! Missserable creature!"
Sssoon, very sssoon, we will be poised to crusssh the defilersss of our landsss...
Yes... a letter... I will give you the letter... but first you must serve...
Go to the Empyrean foundry, in the swamps northwest of Sawato... Bring me one of their pyreal daggers... and you will be rewarded... by the darkness.  You will need this key...
Such... pure metal... how it shines... how bright... take this katar and walk in the darkness... You have pleased the Dark Master.
Go... away... unless... you have business with me...

The wind brings tidings: The shadow of Ler Rhan has been destroyed by %s!  Coolly, the Shadow General moves on to the plains nigh upon the borders of the Aluvian realm.  Seek again the aspect of Ler Rhan; he may be reached soon...soon...
Ler Rhan collapses, but hisses in amusement as he falls: "You have defeated this form, %s, but it is merely a shadow of my true self. I shall rise again elsewhere, and 'ware unto you!"

The wind brings tidings: The shadow of Ler Rhan has been slain by %s!  Ler Rhan has been pushed southward to the realms of the Sho and the Blackmire Swamp.  Seek Ler Rhan's shadow; he will arrive soon...
Ler Rhan collapses, but hisses in amusement as he falls: "You may have defeated this shadow of mine, %s, but I shall rise up elsewhere!"
The wind brings ominous tidings: The shadow of Ler Rhan has been slain by %s!  But Black Ferah has taken up the assault within the Direlands...
Ler Rhan collapses, but hisses in amusement as he falls: "So, you have defeated me, %s. Well played. Yet, I have the aid of Black Ferah, who will now take up the forces in the northern Direlands!"
I see that you have brought some useful information.
You have been awarded the title of Undercover of Darkness.
quest: Isin Dule's interferance is testing my patience. We will move forward again once the time is right.
Stop wasting time. Bring me the pieces of the device.
Stop bothering me and report to Black Ferah.
Isin Dule still thinks he has any chance of stopping our forces? That fool.
He never was the strong one, and he is even weaker now.
Soon we shall corrupt this land and all who have served us will gain great power.
You have been awarded the title of Shadow Soldier.
I suggest you leave this place.
I've heard that Black Ferah received my message. Perhaps you will be of use to me in the future.
Isin Dule's forces may have stopped our summoning of Bael'Zharon, but what he doesn't realize is we never expected it to succeed.
It was mearly a test of a theory on how it could be accomplished and the test ran long enough for us to gain valuable information for the future.
You dare go against me and then bring this Energy Scintilla as proof of that fact?
I do not accept this defeat.
We shall reconstruct the device and attempt to pull Bael'Zharon back to the surface.
One of the pieces is in the room with the strange crystals.
The others appear to be in the caves around Tou-Tou.
Collect all of the pieces and bring them to me.
Perhaps you will be of use to me in the future.
You have been awarded the title of Shadow Puppet.
How about delivering that message instead of wasting time annoying me?
Either deliver that message to Black Ferah or suffer a fate worse than death.
Finally, I expected these pieces sooner.
I will set my engineers to work.
Take your compensation and leave me be.
Take this message to Ter Shen in the cave at 29.2S 95.8E.
She will give you instructions from there.
You've survived to make it this far. Perhaps you have skills we could put to use.
Take this message to Black Ferah at her scouting post near Tou-Tou.
If you fail to do this, do not return.

greetings: The sun seems to dim, and you can see your own breath for an instant.

A new regime shall rise, a new master to take the place of the old. Darkness consumes all that light offers. Join with the darkness and become one with oblivion. Stand against us and be swept aside in the tide of destruction.
The abyss offers a solace far exceeding the gifts of life. To return there is to find the embrace of oblivion anew.
A cascade of buzzing voices invades your mind.
I HATE YOU! I HATE YOU! DON'T EVER TALK TO ME AGAIN!
You think you hear a little voice say "Mommy..."
You hear the distant echo of childish laughter, fading away.
A sense of depression wells in the back of your mind as the Abyssal Shadow Child falls to the ground.
A cascade of buzzing voices invades your mind.
You listen to the buzzing, but hear nothing but an insane childish laughter.
You think you hear a little voice say "Mommy..."
You hear the distant echo of childish laughter, fading away.
An uncontrollable hate seeps into your thoughts as the Depraved Shadow Child falls before you.
A cascade of buzzing voices invades your mind.
Why do you hate me?
You think you hear a little voice say "Mommy..."
You hear the distant echo of childish laughter, fading away.
As the Forsaken Shadow Child dies, you are overcome with a sense of rejection.
A cascade of buzzing voices invades your mind.
I'm sorry if I made mommy and daddy hate me...
You think you hear a little voice say "Mommy..."
You hear the distant echo of childish laughter, fading away.
Against your will, tears of sadness fill your eyes as the Pandemic Shadow Child collapses at your feet.
A cascade of buzzing voices invades your mind.
Why did you leave me? Was I being bad?
You think you hear a little voice say "Mommy..."
You hear the distant echo of childish laughter, fading away.
As the corpse of the Shadow Child sinks to the ground before you, you are momentarily overtaken by tremendous guilt.
Captain Faalx falls with an angry growl. An ominous black mist begins swirling on the ceiling.

quest: As was promised, my Master has opened the path to the Dark Isle. However, the Mukkir have reacted quickly, raising Wards about the Isle to stop us from gaining access to it.

My Master has located a nest of Mukkir on Vissidal Isle, near that village of strange Merwarts. He believes they are the ones holding the Wards in place. Go there, find a way to bypass their Wards, gain entry to the Dark Isle.

greetings: The "Great Experiment", the Shadow Stone Black Ferah worked so hard upon. This will do nicely.
Varetha examines the stone intently.

I will reconfigure the magical matrix in this to contain Grael's Mukkir Aspect. While I do this, travel to 37.2 S, 67.0 W. I have managed to track the Aspect to that location. Hunt it down and kill it. I'll take care of the rest.
Now, this will make a trophy to be remembered.
Shadow Power fills the shattered remnants of the Black Spear, which reforms completely.

It is no longer a weapon of destruction, as it once was. It'd be too dangerous to leave in that state. However, the power of it is strong, and I've augmented it a bit myself. Place it somewhere secure, like those homes you build for your people, and you should be able to tap its power there.

Bring the Token to the representative your Monarchs have set out to guide this task. They wished to be informed when one aided in Grael's defeat. I'm sure they have some sort of reward for you as well.
You do not wish such a trophy? Very well, I can reward you in other ways, and pass this along to my Lord, who will no doubt be amused by it.
quest: Greetings to you, Slayer of the Black Spear.  The Mukkir Aspect has not yet managed to escape the trap we laid for it.  It will not last forever, though.  Check in from time to time.  If he has let slip his bonds, I will have work for you again.
Have you found the Shadow Stone yet?  You will find Black Ferah's Vault at 39.1 S, 60.1 W, in case you've forgotten.
Have you bypassed the defenses Grael has amassed and found his inner sanctum yet?  The portal to the location I've tracked him to is 37.2 S, 67.0 W, in case you've forgotten.
Varetha touches your forehead, sending a dark chill throughout your body.

My Lord, Isin Dule, has sent me to aid you in the containing of the Mukkir Aspect of Grael. Though it will be a difficult thing to accomplish, this can be done. To do so, however, we will need to gather the proper tools.

There is a Shadow Stone, created in Black Ferah's experiments, that should do nicely. I have managed to locate the stone, but so have Grael's followers. Gather this stone for me, and I should be able to modify it to hold Grael's Mukkir Aspect for a time. I will attune you to the defenses of the location...
You will find the stone at 39.1 S, 60.1 W. Go there and retrieve the stone. While you are gone, I will prepare what I need to modify it.
The Black Spear.
Varetha smiles.
Please, hand it to me, so that I may reward you properly for what you have done.
Please return to me when you are stronger.

greetings: As %tn strikes the final blow against Kirienne Palacost, the Shadow Child screams out in agony! A voice echoes throughout the land, carrying along with it a searing pain in your mind, "I hate you %tn!!! I'm telling my uncle and he's going to get you!!"
Kirienne Palacost stirs, as if lost in the throws of a fitful sleep.
As %tn reaches out toward Kirienne Palacost, the Warding Sphere reacts, releasing a torrent of violent energies.
The great Ler Rhan sends his greetings to all of you, and regrets only that he could not find time to personally see to your destruction."

Well done! The skull of poor young Avoren. Ilservian's rage was so great... But this sentimentality serves no one, does it? I am now one step closer to freedom from this prison realm that Aerbax constructed. The Hopeslayer of this dream realm will never recover this skull, and will thus remain vulnerable... But you all have more work to do. You must defeat this shade of my former master. I beli...
quest: I've sent you through this portal once before, have I?  What happened, did the paroxysms of this half-realized Hopeslayer send you back to your mortal mooring?  Whatever the problem, I suppose I can re-open the portal for you...

Human! You can help end my bizarre imprisonment here by that unjumped bag of air Aerbax. Some half-formed shade of the Hopeslayer himself awaits in the chambers below! An agent of Aerbax, a creature known as the Thief of Dreams, has taken the skull of Avoren Palacost, and seeks to destroy humanity's accomplishment in defeating Bael'Zharon! You must act quickly, and stop the Thief of Dreams from...

Yes... you have the skull of little Avoren Palacost. Such a sweet-natured boy he was, the light of his father's life. What lengths we go to, for the sake of our offspring. But I suppose I would not know. Hand me the skull and I can help you find the Hopeslayer's lair, and hopefully you will be able to interrupt the schemes of this Aerbax upstart and free me from this ungracious prison.

greetings: Contained within this gem is the sum of my knowledge of the Void. With this you will be able to cast spells without relying on a foci.
Be sure to read the gem's inscription before you use it.

They call me Morathe. It was not always my name, but after I changed forms I felt my former life was now dead and no longer wished to go by that name. Bring me an augmentation gem and I shall teach you the ways of casting Void Magic without relying on one of those foci.
Visit Fiun Rehlyun on the Halaetan Islands if you have not already acquired one of these gems.

quest: Come back later and I might have more work for you.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
The Rynthid cowards were twisting the Captives minds and feeding on their fear like the leeches that they are.
You have my gratitude for rescuing them from a fate far worse than death.
How are the freedom efforts progressing?
Those Rynthid cowards know no honor! They invade our lands and imprison our warriors, not kill them. There must be a logical explanation for their actions.
We know little about these beings, but we do know they are fueled by emotions. Who knows what devious plans these Rynthid have brewing, but we must do everything in our power to stop them.
Find where they are keeping these prisoners and free five of the trapped Shadows from within the Rynthid's confines.
Hurry, there is no time to spare...the Rynthid grow stronger with each passing minute.
I fear if you were to help me now, you would only end up a captive like those I am trying to free. Come back when you are more experienced.

You are one of the chosen who understands power and blood. Within this crypt amber has spilled from the exposed roots and has become corrupted by the masters. Bring these to me and I will reward you with items from my own collection.
My magics will require 100 Corrupted Amber. I will reward you well for this task.
I am pleased by your service. These crystals will empower our magics. And now for your reward.
You are not one of the chosen.
You have not yet gathered enough Corrupted Amber. My magics require at least 100.

greetings: Ler Rhan wants the timeline moved up.
Ter Shen appears to go deep into thought.
Go find Quaron and have him give you access to the site below. There is no time to waste.
quest: Go find Quaron and have him give you access to the site below. There is no time to waste.
Do you have a message from Ler Rhan?
Take this key and head down towards the site. Use the key to enter the doors on the sides of the hallway and inform the gatekeepers that I sent you.
Ter Shen is elsewhere in the cave.
Defend me until the ritual is complete!
I am ready to begin the ritual.
I require a source of energy to begin the ritual.

greetings: You may pass through the gate.
Feel the power of my new form, human!  We transcend the limitations of your flesh!
Ah, a human approaches!  You will not find me as easy a kill as other Virindi, meat puppet!
Do you think me to be as weak in magic as your own race?  Your magic is still too feeble to hurt me.
Feel the power of my new form, human!  We transcend the limitations of your flesh!
Ah, a human approaches!  You will not find me as easy a kill as other Virindi, meat puppet!
Do you think me to be as weak in magic as your own race?  Your magic is still too feeble to hurt me.
Go back to your crude settlements, human, and tell your fellows that the end is coming soon for you all!
Ah, fellow human!  Come closer, so that we may converse!
Your magical fumblings are contemptible, human.  How can you hope to stand against the Virindi, the power that gave me life?
Go back to your crude settlements, human, and tell your fellows that the end is coming soon for you all!
Ah, fellow human!  Come closer, so that we may converse!
Your magical fumblings are contemptible, human.  How can you hope to stand against Martine, the power that gave me life?
Can you not see that the Master has already won? You're precious defender sits in seclusion, as I spill your blood!
Come, fellow human! Allow me to impart the master's wisdom upon you!
Must you still use such mundane materials to coalesce your spells. The master can release you of those feeble trappings.
Can you not see that the Master has already won? You're precious defender sits in seclusion, as I spill your blood!
Come closer fellow human, I wish to impart the master's wisdom to you.
Must you still use such mundane materials to coalesce your spells. The master can release you of those feeble trappings.
A shell is nothing more than a device that allows us to traffic amongst your ilk. This body will return with me as its host. Our lives are eternal thanks to Aerbax.
Our goals near fruition much like the fruits of this farm, food is inessential only exposure to the energy source. Have your spirit make the journey.
Welcome to my farm. Have you come to join with the other compost?
Aerbax was correct exposure to the energy source heightens ability to withstand continued onslaught. Rejoice! I shall soon be impervious.
%tn strikes the killing blow on Mudmouth.
You only defeated me and the large one through sheer numbers. Think how things would have gone if an army of Tuskers had been behind us. You keep thinking on that human.
Bobo! Assist me!
Back off! Give me some room.
Mudmouth protects himself.
Let's see how you handle this!
Mudmouth redirects your spells energy and summons and Imp.
Mudmouth glares at you and casts a spell in return.
Come closer fellow human, I wish to impart the Master's wisdom to you.
Come closer fellow human, I wish to impart the Master's wisdom to you.
Come closer meatbag.
Hanaurel...
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "Written thoughts - letter..."
Kall ama te fen? Reann au..?
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "Who was it for? Where do I..?"
Etah si au hisenaa!
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "Why can I not recall!"
Zorn... zorn...
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "All gone, all gone..."
Au virinaa! Au... baeaa?
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "I breathe not! I... am not... slain?"
Ai, Metresa?
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "Yes, Mistress?"
Suvani hasode, Metresa, tamaa Dar Hallae.
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "Yes. The Shadows remain below, Mistress, at the Old Ring."
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "Why do you fight me?"
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "I do not understand why you attacked me..."
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "Who are you? Help!"
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "My forge... Where is my forge?"
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "Shaura..."
In your mind, the dusty voice of Ejan whispers, "Yes, Mistress? I come."
The Lord of Decay groans as it collapses in a heap of bone, "We will drive you away!"
The Lord of Decay groans as it collapses in a heap of bone, "Our great armies - blown away like sand! Who shall remain to defend our proud fortresses?"
In death I should find freedom, but the shackle holds still.
Your stature is smaller, your bones more brittle and your flesh more maleable. You are not of our masters legion, so your death comes with rewards...my thoughts returned.
Within the Blood I have bathed. Your fledgling magics are piteous.
Lord Cambarth bids you...mine
Must do...as Cambarth commands...
Serve...Cambarth
Wealth...wealth...
More miners...more miners needed...
You will serve...the Hope Bringer
Work...must mine...for Cambarth
Tired...
Release...me...
The flames will engulf you.
So long has it been since I have had visitors. Let's play, shall we?
Happy Birthday!
And here I was hoping we could be friends...
I'll be back again someday AND THEN YOU'LL BE SORRY!
Isn't it just beautiful out today? NO, IT'S TOO HOT!
It's a shame I can't make more friends. FRIENDS ARE FOR LOSERS!
LETS KILL BUNNY RABBITS! How horribly unfeeling.
I'm soo Happy! ...YEAH, ITS GOOD TO BE BAD!
A CARROT! WHY A CARROT?!? I like my carrot. YOU WOULD!
Oh now, why did I go and do that? GRRRRRAGH!
I don't WANT TO HURT YOU!
HAHAHAHA! Oh, I'm so sorry!
YOU CANT HANDLE THE CHILL! Not again!
Oh good, a visitor! GO AWAY!
ARGHUGARGAHAGA! What?
Ow! Stop that! YOU WANT SOME OF THIS!?!
NORMALLY I'D SMOOSH YOU, but I'm feeling happy today.
Please, just chop off HIS head OR I COULD TAKE YOURS!
Wait, I'm not that bad, let's just talk about this. ONCE YOU'RE FROZEN SOLID!
That was pretty good, you almost had me. CHUMP!
Who's there? I..I've got an icicle!
I'm not dangerous. See? I'm smiling.
Have you seen my eyes around?
Much more of this and I'm going to become an Unhappy Snowman.
quest: Hooray! My Perfect Eye!
Oh wait, you already gave me back my eye. This must be some other poor Snowman's eye. You keep it safe until you find out whose it is.
You must wait %tqt before turning this item in again.
Ah, more coal? You are very kind, but I have all I need to refashion my eyes. It may take some time, but you have helped me enough. Here, have this back in case you lose your eyes.
What's this?
A stick? Well, my left arm has been acting up a bit, only in the warm weather though.
The Blind Snowman raises the peppermint stick to his carrot and sniffs.
Oh, another peppermint stick! Well, you've been so generous that I don't need any more. Have it back.
Perhaps you could get something from the drudges for it. I hear they love sweets.
Excellent, I hope that teaches ol' Three Eye a lesson. Here a little secret I found in the snow the other day.
Hooray! My Perfect Eye! I'll have to clean it and polish it and maybe refacet it again, but at least I have it back.
Thank you, thank you. Here you deserve a reward for all of your help. Let's see... well not see per se... one second.
The Blind Snowman scoops up a pile of snow and casts a spell. The snow coalesces forming ice crystals that shift and rearrange as if alive.
I can't be sure it turned out exactly right, but I hope you like it.
May your bottom stay cold and your eyes stay put. Soon I'll be able to see the snow again!
The Blind Snowman attempts to swallow the Perfect Snowman Eye, but after a lot of coughing just sticks it in his pocket.
What's this, a lump of coal? It's huge!
Wohoo! Thank you! I'll be able to make a huge set of eyes with this once it gets cold enough! I'll bet I'll be able to see better than any other snowman with my new huge eyes.
You deserve a reward for your good deed. Let's see... well not see per se... one second.
The Blind Snowman attempts to swallow the Huge Lump of Coal, but after a lot of coughing just sticks it in his pocket.
I can't believe it! It happened again!
There I was putting the finishing touches on my masterpiece. An eye so perfect, I would be able to see the individual beauty of a snowflake a mile away.
I heard a crunching and sliding in the snow nearby. I'm pretty sure it was a Snowman since it said...
The Blind Snowman makes a face and says in a cold nasty voice, "Whatcha got there melt bottom? That looks like a pretty nice eye! You won't mind if I take that will ya? Yoink!"

Then he grabbed my Perfect Eye! You have to get it back for me. I heard him exclaim as he bounced out of hearing that he was going to use it as a third eye so he could see better to hit people with iceballs. The villain!
Go and find the Three Eyed Snowman and get me back my eye. And teach that no good Three Eye a lesson. Kill him five times and maybe he will learn not to go around stealing other peoples dreams.
Wohoo! Thank you! I'll be able to make a new set of eyes once this gets cold enough!
The Blind Snowman swallows the Lump of Coal with a contented smile.
A stick? But, I've already got two perfectly good arms.
Minty! Oh, thank you! Now I can take strolls without tripping over things.
Here, have this, I found it in my... I found it that last time I tripped.
I will not fight for I follow the Path of the Snowflake.
I had a Seeing Eye Drudge, but he thought yellow snow was funny.
I would go for a walk, but some nasty little beast stole my Peppermint Stick!
I'm really worried that a fire elemental might come by. Normally I could run and hide. Maybe I'll try building a snow castle.
One person suggested I use diamonds for eyes. I tried that and it was really pretty, but the thousand little views made me toss snow.

greetings: Why does everyone keep attacking us? We are a peaceful race. All we want is to live in pea...
That one's for Frank!
%mn screams, Defend the town!!!
Merely a slush wound!
Take your heat somewhere else! We don't want you violent types in our town!
You are frizzin' hero, you know that?!
You remind me of this guy I knew. He was a good guy, a little thick, but a good guy, ya know?
Here you go. It just came out of the Ice Box.
I only use the freshest snows and ice in my cooking. If you can't make it fresh don't make it.

I know people who know people who might be able to take care of Scold -- but once I call that favor in, I'll owe them one. And you don't want to owe these guys nothin'! So, if you can teach that magma-hucker a lesson, I would be very grateful.
Eh, if it helps, I'll chill you up somethin' real delicious for after you give Scold his ice-bath. He should lay of the spicy food, it's bad for his disposition.
A pinch of this, some frosting - and FREEZO we got ourselves a frizzin' delicacy.
Oh, another weed.
Well, I'll be! You made it back in one piece! I have to admit I thought taking on Scold in his own cave was a bit crazy, but you proved how lucky you are!
I'm a snowman of my word, so here's your reward.
Hehe, now everyone will know you have the biggest carrot around, eh?
That Scold is a real trouble maker. Yup, he's been tearing around town melting our houses and trying to drive us off. He claims that this whole mountain is his.
He really hates snowmen...
If you can get rid of Scold I promise you I'll reward you as best I can.
Don't you worry, my word's as good as ice on a cold day.
Scold destroyed my last harvest. He sauntered right into town and stomped all over my garden.
Snow Gardens require special attention. Mine needs fresh snow daily or the crop will wither and die.

I once saw a rabbit try to steal a carrot from my garden. Why he was even up here in the first place I don't know. Anyway, he seemed so happy with himself when he dug the carrot out that I didn't have the heart to stop him.
You should have seen the look on his little rabbit face when he tried to bite into it. Guess he wasn't used to ice carrots. Funny little critter.
Well, carrots are very important to us snowmen. We use them for our noses of course and it's always good to have a backup. Then there are the other carrot related activities.
Ow! It's still hot, and burning. The fact that it still gives off heat is interesting. Let's see, I have your reward over here.
I just finished it. It's a marvel of ice and function. You will see here the controls with three settings: Chilly, Freezing and 'My fingers are stuck to the ice, it's so cold.'
It works on the Frostian Principle of inverse hyper-therma-whatchamaglavins.
What's it for? Well, the theory is obvious to even the simplest of advanced thermo-mechanical engineers.
Oy! For winter's sake! It keeps your house cool.
No thanks, I'm not hungr...  Oh, wait!  This is not so much food as a request from that odd little penguin for a Portable Igloo!
Did he come to his senses and finally decide it's too hot in the south, with the sand and the sun and the Oy this place is so very hot?
You better get this to him quickly, before he melts.
Hmmm... Do penguins melt?
I tried ice-bombing Scold's cave last week, but he must have some heat source down there. Otherwise he should have been frozen solid almost instantly.
I would like to have a piece of Scold to study should you find one, say during your frenzied death march on his cave.
I've been studying Scold - with the burning and the melting and excruciating pain, RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!
He seems weak to cold attacks.
What?
Have you ever wondered why we don't call you Meatmen?
Eat snowball, heatbag!
Freeze heatbag!
Frozen and Furious!
Go jump in the snow!
I can see through time!
I see you! Now which of you three to attack...
Ice Ice baby!
I'll shoot your eye out!
I'm gonna freeze you solid meatsicle!
I'm twice the magically animated man you are!
Stop ruining my day heatbag!
Aim for the face!
You allow David to examine your Blazing Shard.
You hand the Blazing Shard to David. He abruptly drops the shard into the snow and it instantly turns to ice and shatters.
You found this near the crystals? It all makes sense now!
Reflecting the light and heat through the crystals at the mountain to the north would surely cause an avalanche and bury the village in snow.
Why melt the town when you can cover it in a mountain of snow and ice? The thought of being buried alive like that is chilling!
Your bravery will never be forgotten. Please take this as our way of saying thanks.
You have been awarded the title of "Avalanche Avoider"

Did you notice the odd crystals forming around the edge of the village? They seem to grow larger each day.
My frozen gut tells me that fiend Scold is behind this. We need to find out the meaning of this before it is too late.
Search the area to the north of the village where the largest crystal formations have appeared. Anything you could do to help our frosty little abode would be greatly appreciated.
Return to me with any news and I will inform the Mayor of the situation.

I see you've found my lair. Well... good for you. If you've come to join me all you need do is pass my tests, alone. You do that and I just might take you on as an apprentice in the less savory arts. You fail and well anything you drop will be mine.
Perhaps if you are an astute observer you'll find my true intentions at some later time. Either way I congratulate your efforts thus far.
You seem to have some odd preoccupation with rubbing trees. Perhaps you should speak to someone about this.
You think, "Ever since I left the Dame standing in her room all alone I couldn't help but wonder..."

You think, "What was the towel for? I stopped and looked myself over twice, nothing on my face or hands. I knew I should have been paying attention while she was talking, but her voice kept me occupied."

You think, "I found myself running my hands over trees. They all looked alike in this little copse. I felt strange, like being watched. The feeling passed after a moment... As I ran my hands over the tree in front of me, I was struck by an odd feeling of deja vu..."

You think, "I didn't remember seeing this place before, but somewhere in the dark shadows that shrouded my mind, I knew I had. Sure it had changed, but a lot had changed since I walked through that first swirling portal on Ispar. I was no hero there. I was simply living my life. I felt like I was waiting for something."
You think, "I had the urge to dance..."
You think, "I suddenly realized that this tree was different from the others. There was a light syrupy texture that coated the branches. I pulled my hand up to my lips for a quick taste."

You think, "A heavy weight landed on my shoulders in the form of my head. It was like having 'Weight of the World' cast on you while making a run to the shop to unload your latest armor haul. Everything slowed down and a taste of honey filled my mouth.  I dropped to a knee..."
You think, "...but it wasn't enough. I fell to the ground, like a mosswart who had zigged when he should have zagged."

You think, "The world spun out of control, a long gray tunnel filled with purple shards told me that I was heading back to my lifestone. The tree's sap had played the role of hammer to my olthoi shell."
You think, "But my ride through the big swirl dropped me somewhere else. I didn't know where I was. An open book on a nearby desk called to me."
You think, "I like trees. Cripes, I hope no one saw me rubbing up against this tree."

You think, "I was rattled. I found myself unable to find the forest for the trees. I ran my hands along the bark, searching for any type of clue that might help me understand what the Dame wanted. I should have been listening. Now I was out here playing patty-cake with a tree..."
You think, "...I felt pretty foolish."
You lean trying to disern the purpose of the carving on this tree.
Just as confusion as to the purpose of this mark sets over you a voice on the wind reaches its way to your ear.
It says "Bring a heart of mud to a Gharu'ndim collector of such."
You think that this is what you were meant to learn here and you should now be on your way.
There is a mark scratched into this tree but it doesn't mean anything to you.

greetings: That melon-headed buhka. Riding a Wharu into the center of town. I still can't believe it!
A puh like that shouldn't have been allowed to stay on the island.
If he ever shows up in town again, I'll make him and his 'Putiputi' sorry...
That hits the spot. So, Tekapuapuh. He's this melon-headed buhka -- an idiot boy. Goes out for his first hunt alone, and finds one of those death-bringer Wharu.
'Cept he calls it 'Putiputi!' It's no ladybug! I still remember it... he comes into town, RIDING the Wharu. Nearly flattened the center of Ahurenga.
He's puh now -- outcast. Lives on the tip of the delta out west of here. I hope he stays there. Anyway, thanks for the ale, human.
You haven't heard the story, human? Fetch me an ale, and I'll tell you.
I'd tell you more but, ah, I'm a little parched. Need a little ale.
Hea Arantah looks around his town brazenly.
Hea Arantah belches softly.
Hea Arantah's arm moves suddenly, too quickly to see, and snatches a small flying insect out of the air. He hums a merry child's tune, and methodically pulls its wings and legs off.
The youthful voice of Hea Arantah mutters, "When, my friends? Soon? ...Very well, I understand." He seems to be talking to the fountain, though his eyes are glazed and glowing faintly.
Hea Arantah's youthful voice shouts, "We have freedom, my friends! The islands are open to us!" The residents of the town hoot a loud Tumerok cheer.
Hea Arantah wipes spilled liquor from his lips. His voice cracks as he cries, "Aren't we mighty? Don't the Aun cower in their beds in fear of us?" The residents cheer again... somewhat uncertainly.
All at once, the youthful voice of Hea Arantah screams across the square. While the visiting Isparians look at him in confusion, the Hea bury themselves in their work.
Arantah gasps, clutching at his head. His eyes are shut tight, but a painful violet light burns out from behind his eyelids.
"WHAT? What did I do? Yes... I understand. The upland patrols. Reinforced. At once, Collector. Please... my xuta is watching."
The light ceases like a snuffed candle. The Tah of Hea staggers.
"Warriors!" he calls, rather weakly. "I want raiding parties on the plateau at once! Temenua isn't doing his task... our friends are angry!"
Young Arantah's eyes narrow as he reads furiously.
...What? What is this? No! They said... they said I was the only one! This can't be true! What does this mean?
Arantah crushes the journal in his fist, then methodically begins to tear it to pieces.
They lied to me.
His eyes glower a dark, thunderhead purple.
As the pieces of Martine's journal flutter towards the ground, they burst into flames.
I'm more powerful than this stupid man-thing. The first. The best. I'll show them. Them and their man-puppet.
quest: Hea Arantah tells you, "You're %s! They told me what you did - you killed that poacher Ralirea! Give me his figurine. Quickly, quickly!"
Ah! I can tell by the flickering of your keh that you have broken one of the Aun's precious rocks in the last few weeks.
My atual arutoa brothers like to see the wharu running free across this land.
So, this is the face of one of the stonebreakers the Aun hate, eh? A drink to the enemy of my enemy.
My atual arutoa brothers like to see the wharu running free. They collect them, you know.
Young Arantah belches softly, and you catch the fetid odor of a poor imitation of distilled Empyrean dew.
Wow, great! Ha ha! I warned them not to send their hunters on to my plateau!

Young Arantah clutches his fist around the little figurine, so tightly the veins in his wrist stand in relief. His eyes flash violet, and after a muffled crunch, clay dust begins to trickle through his fingers. He looks up at you and grins boyishly.
That was a trick my friends taught me, way back when I was driven from Timaru. I could do the same to your head, you know.
I'm kidding! You've been a friend the Hea, and I reward my friends. Here...
Arantah places his hand on your forehead and his eyes glow blue-white. You feel... enlightened...
You have gained a skill point!
Ha! Yes, this was given to you by Aun Kahmaula, right? He threw stones at me. I was only ten... I needed that bread to live, damn it!
Arantah's eyes flare with inchoate rage, casting violet light upon the ground. Around you, the residents cringe and hold their breath... But a smile breaks across his face.
Well, I'm glad to see him set back, anyway. Here. A gift from my atual arutoa allies.
From the medicine pouch of Aun Gehaua, I see? Great! I got this from my atual arutoa friends. My warriors and I often raided this area in the early years of our alliance.
I wonder whatever happened to that damned portal mage of theirs? He cost me a nice wrap. Did you know human children make the softest leather?
Ah, this still resonates with the keh of Aun Tanaua, the old fool who talks to rocks.
Anyway, here's a little something the atual arutoa gave me. I hear they use this a lot themselves, as a stop on their way to talk to those turtle-nosed freaks in the south.
Aun Laiaua's mark is on this. He always seemed like a dull old worry-wart to me. Going on and on about the how the atual arutoa were soulless and all. Stupid.
The Aun never thought that the atual arutoa have no anima because they ARE the anima of the universe. At least, that's how I understood what they told me.
Young Arantah's eyes glitter with mad glee at the sight of the figurine.
Aun Aanaua has cursed you! Wonderful! This means Wharu runs free, and Aun are pressed! Now is the time for me to release my raiders!
Now THIS gift of the atual arutoa - you'll LIKE this one! Now go.
Young Arantah glowers at you.

What do you want, man-thing? Be quick, and do not lie, for the atual arutoa have given me many eyes to see the truth with. Annoy me at your own risk, for my anger is quick and my power great... As the Aun have learned.
Young Arantah looks annoyed - which seems to be his natural state.
What? Can't you see I'm busy? I have many responsibilities here!
That Aun hunter, for one. What's his name?
Arantah belches loudly as Nyrinua calls over, "Ralirea, my Tah."
Ralirea, yes. Don't CORRECT me, Nyri.
Anyway, this old Aun dustongue - Ralirea - poaches the gromnies of my plateau! If someone would kill him, and bring me that figurine he wears within a day as proof...
A suspicious scowl lumbers across the young Tumerok chieftain's face.
Hea Arantah tells you, "Now wait. My memory isn't what it used to be since the atual arutoa... bettered me, but I do remember your face, %s."

Hea Arantah tells you, "Yes... I rewarded you for Ralirea's death before. That means this figurine must be a fake! You dare try to fool the mighty friend of the atual? Go away before I use my Grip on you!"

Ha! Your keh is all wrong! You were not the one who slew Ralirea this day - someone else did, and gave you his totem. Tell your friend to come and collect my reward himself, I am too important to deal with errand-runners.
What? Are you KIDDING? I already rewarded you for breaking the stones of the north in the last three months. Flee from me now, beggar, or I'll use my Grip on you!
Arantah throws the clay totem at you!
What? Are you KIDDING? I already rewarded you for breaking the stones of the northeast in the last three months. Flee from me now, beggar, or I'll use my Grip on you!
What? Are you KIDDING? I already rewarded you for breaking the stones of the southeast in the last three months. Flee from me now, beggar, or I'll use my Grip on you!
What? Are you KIDDING? I already rewarded you for breaking the stones of the southwest in the last three months. Flee from me now, beggar, or I'll use my Grip on you!
What? Are you KIDDING? I already rewarded you for breaking the stones of the northwest in the last three months. Flee from me now, beggar, or I'll use my Grip on you!

greetings: Aun Hareltah looks around his town worriedly.
Aun Hareltah regards the totem gravely.

This is a work of Aun magic. You say you took this from a Hea? I have little wonder. This is a Totem of Tanae, the Forest, who wraps the world in his green arms, whispers deep wisdoms, and, on our world of Ezheret-Hazahtu, shelters our people from the great sisters Wind and Rain, as they eternally grapple for the love of Father Sea.

This is the handicraft of Aun Shimauri. You may find him at the base of the plateau, to the east of Timaru. I charge you who have recovered this great medicine to bring it to Shimauri. May Wind, as she winds her paths about the world, speed you there.

This is a work of Aun magic. You say you took this from a Hea? I have little wonder. This is a Totem of Audetaunga, the Mountain, she who stands proud and immovable, tempering even her great and fickle daughter spirits Wind and Rain.

Aun Hareltah cocks his head to the side, as if listening to something inaudible.

"Wind has brought tidings of your deeds, friend. She whispers, '%s has slain the brutal Temepuh, who calls himself Temenua as he hunts your people on the upland. Temenua, who sheds your xuta's blood at the behest of the soulless atua ngamaru.'"

"From this point forward, %s shall be known and honored among all Aun as Queenslayer."

He pulls the startled %s into a warm embrace, as the Aun whisper among themselves. "...not of Tonk!" Aun Dreganaua is heard to protest.

I thought you were going to the surface to let others know of this?  Take this crystal back, I cannot take it now.
I cannot get up yet. Did you bring Valara crystals?  Nuhmudira will certainly need them now! Someone hit me from behind... The crystals have been taken, we have been robbed!

Ow, my head! I was knocked down... the crystal supplies were stolen! I did not see who it was.  All right, I'll take the Valara...  you go through the surface portal and alert the guard.  There was a student here a minute before you, I sent him there also.

greetings: %s, you have struck me down, but my memory is long and like your death mine is not the final release. I will return to carve your hide, %s!
Yes, you should have stepped to the right and not the left.
You were coddled too much as a child.
Your intrusion shall be as short-lived as your life!
You strike like a frightened child!
Oh dear... It looks like death is just as boring as the rest of this uninspiring existence...
Is there anyone at all like me? Anyone as unfortunate as me?

Greetings, human. Have you come to slay me? I have divined, through my vast intelligence and penetrating senses, that a human named Nomea in your shantytown of Qalaba'r wishes me dead. Simply because I am a failed experiment of the meddler Aerbax. I can assure you that I pose no threat.

I have no desire to meet, let alone unite or enslave, my brethren. Nor do I care to wage any kind of war, by arms, sorcery, or guile, against humankind. I have studied enough to know that no good can come of treating with your people.
If you would slay me, be done with it now. I can assure you, death neither fascinates nor terrifies me. I am not particularly attached to the life I have been given.
If you would spare me, merely pick up the note you see before me, and deliver it to Nomea. I am convinced it will convince Nomea of my benign intent.
Be warned, I will fight back if attacked. I am not completely apathetic, after all. I do possess some survival instinct.
The rift pulses, and disgorges a creature!
The rift surges with crackling energy, and a creature appears!
The air becomes heavy with ozone, and another creature spawns from the rift!
The force of your killing blow breaks Rampager's tusk!
The force of your killing blow breaks Devastator's tusk!
Me like nanners!
Me like nanners.
Bobo king, me watch village.
Yeah! We save Bobo! Ooo! Ook!
Humans like Tuskers now! I show you how to eat nanners with your feet sometime, Ook.
Only bad thing is Mudmouth get away. You find him and mash him good for the bad things he did, Ook!
Jilna ask me to tell you she in Bobo Town now. She still making potions for Bobo to not be sick. Ook.
Oh thank you! I so hungry I could eat my paw, but nanners taste much better.
quest: Isn't Bobo great? You should talk to Jilna in Oo.. OLoo... Bobo's Refuge at the base of the volcano. She's a nice human who makes potions for Bobo to keep him from getting sleepy and sick.
Bobo showed that ugly old Mudmouth! He drove Mudmouth away from Tusker Island with his mighty stone fist! Stupid, bad Mudmouth.
I like nanners.
Haha, you hairless types look funny.
Did you see!? Did you see!? Bobo drove away that bad old Mudmouth!

greetings: %tn brings down Dark Bobo with a fatal blow. The dark beast's huge bulk crashes to the ground, his eyes staring at his attackers in dull hatred.
Dark Bobo shrieks in pain as he comes into being. A sickening noise like tearing flesh issues from his writhing form as bits of meat and fur seem to crawl up the tremendous figure of bone and sinew.
Dark Bobo whips around swinging a massive fist only inches from your nose.
You strike Dark Bobo so hard he begins to bleed, but his fur knits itself into the wound closing it.
Dark Bobo shakes his head and grunts in annoyance as your blow dazes him.
Bubba quickly devours the meat.
After several moments, Bubba falls to the ground. The sedative looks to have worked.
quest: This must be one of the pets Colton mentioned.

greetings: As it collapses into a mass of bone and rot, the ancient mage mutters, "Enjoy your triumph, outlander, but your time in the light is fleeting. This world belongs to us..."
As it collapses into a mass of bone and rot, the ancient mage moans, "All our powers come to dust. Is this how it shall end for proud Dericost?"
Musansayn, what has become of me?
I've failed you... failed...
Wari al Sha'im shakes his head and says, "Where... am... I..."
In a confused voice, Wari al Sha'im says, "The Silifi... Where is the Silifi..."
The Baron of Colier has been defeated.
As the Lich Overseer falls to his endless sleep, you hear him say, "Maharani, I have failed you! Now the relic falls into their hands...But they will never learn how to use it!"
Maharani, in your name I strike down this insignificant mortal.
Soon you will fall into the endless slumber of death.
In your mind, a soft voice sighs, "Please leave me be... I wish thee no harm."
In your mind, a soft voice sighs, "So many turns of the world have passed. When shall my torment end?"
In your mind, a soft voice sighs, "Disturb me not... Travel past this hole in the earth."
Leikotha inspects the haft.
It is almost as I remember it when he carried it in his hand. Not quite though. Some harm cannot be undone.
Leikotha sighs.
Ai, Wari. One like thee, a child of another sun. He carried this haft, a great blade resting within it, and sought to release me. He failed... and now has been cursed as I have.
A single tear rolls down Leikotha's cheek. She raises a hand to her face and the dry wrappings absorb the tear instantly.
As I have said, I shall reward you.
If thou returns with the gems that once graced this haft, I will reward thee again.

Mine thanks. This gem was but the first one that graced the axe Wari once wielded. Thy people had begun to establish holdings here on Ireth Lassel when Wari came across this ancient tomb. This place of mourning that I have haunted for millennia.
Leikotha looks to the ceiling above her, and then returns her attention to you.

After defeating those that surround me, Wari approached me. The long days had gone by so slowly, and this diminutive creature, one so much like mine own people, intrigued me. For a moment, this curiosity lifted the burden of my torment off my soul.

I hailed this creature, asked him his name and what he sought. A moment he stood silent, considering me. Then he told me his name, what had passed on the land above, and that he now looked for a cause to lend his blade to.

A spark of hope entered my heart, if I could still be said to have one. So long had I sought to undo Nerash's binding, the curse that forever keeps me from passing. Perhaps this curious creature could finally undo it. Ai, I was wrong, so very wrong.
Ai, I see I have tarried thee long enough. I will reward thee for thy efforts.
If thou brings me another of the gems, perhaps I will tell thee more.
The fifth gem. I see thou have seen Wari. Fate has not been kind to a soul so noble. Some once said the same of me. However, thou does deserve a reward for giving Wari a moment of peace.

Now you know what I found when I entered Sylsfear. Wari had sought out the undead lords, those who, in their life, had maintained the facility and studied the mana and structure of this world. These undead lords and their minions had overpowered Wari, had discovered why he sought them out, and thought of an appropriate punishment.

His mighty blade was shattered and spread about the undead minions as trophies. He was left with but one piece; the gem thou have brought to me. The lords also cursed Wari in a manner similar to me. Yet Wari's curse had been imperfect and his mind was now as shattered his axe had been.
I wept bitter tears when I returned to this tomb, seeing what had become of this noble child of distant sun. Ai, the tears were for me as well, for now I knew my torment would not end.
Thou does know the tale now, and I have but a few final words to offer thee: Do not fear the fate that awaits all creatures that draw breath, for fates much worse than that can be meted out.
Now please leave me be.
Wari's fourth gem. Thank thee.

I had stood here, impassive, watching the days begin and end, ceaselessly. As the millennia had passed, I thought I had but one feeling left to me: sorrow. Yet Wari had shown I had another: hope. Now this fleshless fool, the one who told me of Wari's death, had brought out yet another: fury.
I struck down the fool, although not before I found out where Wari had fallen. Wari had sought the answer to unbinding me in the dungeon Sylsfear.
I left this tomb, something I had not done for untold ages, and sought out those who had done this.
Ai, if only I had not. If only.
The second gem from Wari's axe. Allow me to reward thee.
Since thou has shown an interest in Wari's tale, I will continue to tell it to thee.

I had told Wari of Nerash's poison arrow and my fall at the Plateau of Gelid. Of how Nerash, a foul undead minion of Dericost, had sought to keep me at his side for all eternity. Of how I had been tortured and twisted by his dark rites and doomed to never know the peace of oblivion. Of my daughter, Alysse, who only knew her mother as a loathsome monster, who had been forced to flee the light.

Wari's noble heart was moved, he swore to find a means to undo Nerash's binding. I told him of the undead lords who roamed the sands of this land. The secrets of blood were known to them, perhaps they could aid him in releasing the binding.
Wari set off to find these lords. Never again did I see him.
Ai, thou have found the third gem from Wari's axe. You shall be rewarded.
Many days passed after Wari left this tomb. Days that had been very much the others before Wari had come, yet the spark of hope remained.

Then one of these creatures, these minor undead who derive a sick pleasure from seeing mine torment, told me that Wari had fallen. It cackled, the teeth in its fleshless skull rattling together with pleasure.
The spark of hope died. Ai, if I could but join it.
quest: Leave me be, I have nothing to offer thee right now.

Ai, another comes, breaking mine wretched musings. Why have you come to this sandy tomb, filled with unnatural beasts? Is your heart filled with greed, seeking what treasures may lay within? Or is your heart of a more noble nature, perhaps seeking to release me from this torment? It matters not, for I have but one thing to offer you.
Like so many things found on this unhappy world, it is broken. Once though it belonged to a friend. One like thee. One who hoped to release me. Ai, he failed... he failed.

Take the haft, I would see it used again in his name than have it stay with me and crumble to dust. If thou have no use for the Haft, I would still see it as it once was. Return the haft to me, repaired, and I will reward thee. Those that surround me speak of one of thy kind who may know how to set it to order once more. Look for her at 1.7 S, 36.6 E.
Thy mind tells that the haft has been repaired. Give it to me, and I shall reward thee.
Leikotha releases a dry, rasping gasp.
Ashbane... mine own sword.
Leikotha examines her sword, feeling the weight of the blade in her hands.
I had dropped this on the hill of Ayn Tayan... My rage had so blinded me. Ferah, had played me for the fool...
Spinning lies in my mind...
What I did...
A sound slowly builds within Leikotha, until finally an unearthly scream emanates from her. You feel the din about to deafen you when the scream stops.
Why... why...
Leikotha stares silently at the blade of the sword.
How... where... ai, thy mind tells me that thou has found in one of Aerfalle's caches. Foul magus that she is. I shall reward thee for thy efforts.
Now leave me. Leave me with my bitter memories...
I have given you all I have to offer. Take the haft, seek the one at 1.7 S, 36.6 E.
Leikotha tilts her head from side to side, as if judging you.
I have no time for a child's pestering. Be gone, lest my rage return and I strike thee down.
Be glad that mine ire is held in check.

greetings: Magic swirls around the acolyte, forming a portal to the next area.
Magic swirls around the acolyte, forming a portal to the next area.

On far Aerlinthe Island, an intrepid band has found the lair of the Dark Lady Aerfalle, at whose whim the earth itself does shake. But the bold %s has driven back the apprentice she left to guard her home... for now.

The withered corpse of Aerfalle's Apprentice hisses in rage as it is hewn in twain... "I shall not be sent to a final rest by primitives like thee, %s!" her severed head says from the stones. "Enjoy this small victory, child. For my mistress will yet have her vengeance upon thee!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Did that hurt thee, %s?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Perhaps I play too roughly with you fragile outlanders..."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "I am one of the primogen of Dericost. I am not like mine countrymen you have fought. If you strike me down, I shall rise again!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "I shall not be defeated!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Is that the best you can do, my poor child?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Tell your little gods who sent you to them, %s!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "That head will make a fine trophy. Which of you will next decorate my keep?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Vermin!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Don't you have anything better to do than bother me?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Disturb not your betters, child!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Guards! To me!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "A little help here, please."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Gentlemen, could I trouble you to perform thy task?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Bah. There are Dark Spawn and Walkers yet in the world. You are not worthy of my attention."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Guards! Clean up the mess in here. I have more important things to attend to."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "A skillful attack, %s."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Impressive, child. Your people do sometimes surprise me."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Your so-called magics are no match for those of old Dericost!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Your spellcraft is feeble, %s! Are you sure your calling is that of a mage?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Is that the extent of thy powers, child? I shall show thee true power!"
What, you don't like this one? It's the greatest jitte in existence! There's just no pleasing you people sometimes!

My old jitte! Thank you! It seems rather inferior now, with the advances I have made in jitte technology. But it has great sentimental value. Take this new jitte I've been working on, see how it works out. If you want something better than that... Well, hand it back to me and we'll talk about truly extreme techniques in jitte crafting.

Well done! Didn't take you that long, did it? Actually, I can't really tell how long it takes people to do things. My sense of time passing doesn't really work. It's as if I'm frozen in some unchanging state... But maybe that's just because I am so focused on the crafting of my jitte...

Now what I need is the thighbone from one of the undead. Yes, a Dark Revenant Thighbone. I'm sure you know what they look like. Personally, those shambling skeletons give me the creeps. There but for the grace of Jojii go I, I always say. But, yes, bring me a Dark Revenant Thighbone, and we'll be one step closer to getting you the world's finest jitte!

Hrm, yes, a nicely desiccated thighbone. Lighter than normal bone, but retains the famous tensile strength of Dereth's undead. You know, looking at this, I get a strange, creepy sensation... Like someone walking over my grave. Except I don't have a grave. But you know what I mean, right?

Now I only need one more ingredient. This might be a tougher to get hold of than the other items, however. I need the cartilage from the body of a particularly old and vicious Reedshark. His name is Old Scratchy. He lives in a cave at 29.1S, 26.6E. He was one of my greatest enemies when Ben Ten and I were competing over who could make the biggest pile of Reedshark corpses. Old Scratchy got the...

Aha! Yes, this cartilage will work nicely. It's almost a shame that Old Scratchy had to die so that my jitte may live, but if I were a Reedshark, I'd feel honored that a part of me live on in such a wonderful weapon... It'd be like immortality!
Now that the ingredients are all gathered, I just need you to hand me your old Improved Jitte, and I will return to you the Remastered Jitte of Mi Krau-Li!
quest: Take my new Remastered Jitte and strike mightily against the fearsome beasts who continue to plague Dereth!
Now that the ingredients are all gathered, I just need you to hand me your old Improved Jitte, and I will return to you the Remastered Jitte of Mi Krau-Li!

I have a Pyreal Bar and a Dark Revenant Thighbone from you. Well done so far. But as I've already told you, I need cartilage from the body of the ancient Reedshark known as Old Scratchy. That tough old fellow lives in a cave at 29.1S, 26.6E.

Yes, good job bringing me the Pyreal Bar. No, I don't need to know how many golems you had to hunt down for it. Why, I could tell you some stories about my legendary fights against golems in the dawn of humanity's days here on Dereth that would curdle your blood! But that's neither here nor there. I still need a Dark Revenant Thighbone to continue working on the mixture for my next generation j...

Have you compiled a full Pyreal Bar yet? If not, why are you here? There's golems out there that need killing! Get me a Pyreal Bar, and we can start talking about further steps to get you a next generation jitte.
Yes, yes, the components you gathered for me will work perfectly here... This will only take a moment, since I already prepared everything else... I've got a lot of free time down here, you see.

Do I know you? I find it harder and harder to remember names and faces. To be frank, everyone who visits me these days smells unpleasantly of flesh and sweat. Upsetting the delicate dry atmosphere of my laboratory with all your moisture and heavy breathing. Anyway, if you've got my old jitte, I'd be happy to exchange it for a much improved one. I think I lost my old one in the Catacombs of the...

Yes! You are a prime candidate to test out my new jitte design! All I need are a few ingredients... Ah, first, I'll hand you back the Improved Jitte. Hold on to it until you've gathered all the ingredients. You might need it to collect them, after all.

Well, let's start from the beginning. First, I need a bar of Pyreal. You know, a bar made of the Pyreal Motes that come from golems. So get to hunting golems, friend! Kill enough until you've got enough Pyreal motes to make into a bar. Bring me a Pyreal Bar, and we'll move on to the next ingredient.
The perfect weapon... Soon, I will make the perfect weapon... By the way, have you seen my old jitte anywhere?

greetings: As the ancient mage collapses into viscera and rot, it groans, "May my sacrifice bring closer the resuscitation of the Ice Throne!"
As the ancient mage collapses into viscera and rot, it groans, "His Eternal Splendor will return to deal with your insignificant race!"
As the ancient mage collapses in viscera and rot, it groans, "It was near Anadil's encampment all along..."

In your mind, the ancient mage whispers, "Listen to me, outlander. The Dark Spawn did not seek to make a binding on Aerlinthe... they sought... to break... one." The pale fire in the creature's eye fades before it can say more.

In your mind, the ancient mage whispers, "There are horrors worse than us in this world, child. We merely seek a kingdom. The Spawn seek... But I cannot speak such blasphemies! Why do you fight us? Why do you aid the Enemy?"
This is work for Saelar's Apprentice, not me.
Saelar's Apprentice gathers these.
This is work for Hahnain's Apprentice.
Hahnain's Apprentice.
No.
Yes, this is for me.
Yes.
Hand me the Mnemosyne.  You will get your just reward.
You should have handed this to Saelar's Apprentice, it is his job.
I do not understand why the Archons do not just torture these secrets out of you! I am not the collector for these. Go see Saelar's Apprentice.
This is for Renselm's Apprentice.  Step through that portal there.
So much of our glorious history is to be found in that Mnemosyne.  Be careful with it outrider, be very careful.  Go see Renslem's Apprentice through that portal.
Bah, Saelar has told us not to concern ourselves with the keys.  He says it is beneath us.
We should force the secrets of this device out of you!  But Saelar says to have patience.  So for now outlander...
If Saelar's Apprentice didn't want this, then I have no use for it.
Yes, here is the reward you were promised.

I cannot believe that you fledglings know how to unlock Tennar's great Mnemosynes, and Saelar refuses to do anything about it.  If Tennar were still alive...But Saelar is a more cautious sort.  Here is your reward.

Yes?  Hahnain told me to expect you.  Why we need to deal with you...I will accept the Mnemosynes, but Renslem's Apprentice has been tasked with collecting and sorting the largest of the Mnemosynes.  He can be found through that portal.
Thank you for bringing this to us.  If you step through the portal and bring it to the other assistants, they will be able to reward you.
Thank you for bringing this to us.  I am gratified to see that you found a way to unlock it.  If you step through the portal and bring it to the other assistants, they will be able to reward you.
We Dericost do not concern ourselves with these manual affairs.  I have no need of this.
I have no desire to understand this outlander scribbling.
Thank you.  It is a disappointment that I cannot unlock these, but I will hold them until that day.  Here is your reward.
In His Name, who Walks Eternal!  I never thought I would see these unlocked.  I urge you to bring me more of these unlocked treasures, so that the Dericost society may live forever.

Greetings, outlander. I am the apprentice of Saelar of Menilesh. His master, the great Tennar Portheran perished during the Fourth Sending, along with so many of our people. But before he died, he set in motion a way for our people to preserve our heritage and our memories in the face of the recent catastrophes that have befallen the Dericost. He invented a number of Mnemosynes, devices that al...

Tennar commissioned a locksmith from among your kind, whose name I do not know, to make these Mnemosynes lockable and to make keys to the Mnemosynes which only Tennar would possess.  Unfortunately, I have no idea what happened to the lockpicker or his keys.  The Mnemosynes have been coming in, and I have no way of opening them.

But still, if you come across a Mnemosyne please bring them to me and I will reward you well.  The collection for the larger Mnemosynes I have tasked to the other assistants whom can be found through the portal.
I have failed the master, more of me is taken. How long until all of what was me is gone?
You should not have trespassed here. We are set to the task and supported by the master.
These magics you use. They are not native. You do not have control of true Heiromancy. Feeble.
Kikt viktia ti ikni liViliakti, Ij vaik zikt kta im iak, jakti im iakvi av tiu ikni likik ilkin akti.
Im vaik av tiu ikni liViliakti.

quest: Ekta livaik ikti vik ilkian, ia klia livaik ix vik iak.

greetings: Ekta livaik ikti vik ilkian, ia klia livaik ix vik iak.
Im iakvi av tiu ikni Viliakti, Ij fiak kilt zakiik.
Im vaik av tiu ikni liViliakti.
Ek, taivti Tik Vaiktu Kiktij tiu ikni arkvikt.
It cannot be! The interlopers invade our halls, disturbing our sleep. I have failed...
I will not fail my charges!
I release you of your burden. Yet, I know your kind will be back now that you have found this place. Very well, let them come.
Yes, return to your waypoint outlander. Do not disturb us again.
You should not have come here.
I take no pleasure in your pain. Do not return to this place.
You wish to taste death as well? Let me help you.
You cannot win outlander. Your kind are so very unruly and unfocused. I am amazed you have survived here this long.
Can you hear the song? No, you cannot. Your kind do not belong within our places of rest!
Like the buzzing of annoying insects. Stand still, so I may swat you.
I have no time for foolish outlander!
A strong blow outlander, but you will fall before me.
You fight well outlander, but I am the Ward and Keeper and I will not fail in my duties!
Pathetic! And you still use implements to focus your magics. Humorous.
The door Jrvik was guarding slides open as he is defeated.
