The withered corpse of Aerfalle's Apprentice hisses in rage as it is hewn in twain... "I shall not be sent to a final rest by primitives like thee, %s!" her severed head says from the stones. "Enjoy this small victory, child. For my mistress will yet have her vengeance upon thee!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Did that hurt thee, %s?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Perhaps I play too roughly with you fragile outlanders..."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "I am one of the primogen of Dericost. I am not like mine countrymen you have fought. If you strike me down, I shall rise again!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "I shall not be defeated!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Is that the best you can do, my poor child?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Tell your little gods who sent you to them, %s!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "That head will make a fine trophy. Which of you will next decorate my keep?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Vermin!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Don't you have anything better to do than bother me?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Disturb not your betters, child!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Guards! To me!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "A little help here, please."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Gentlemen, could I trouble you to perform thy task?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Bah. There are Dark Spawn and Walkers yet in the world. You are not worthy of my attention."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Guards! Clean up the mess in here. I have more important things to attend to."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "A skillful attack, %s."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Impressive, child. Your people do sometimes surprise me."
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Your so-called magics are no match for those of old Dericost!"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Your spellcraft is feeble, %s! Are you sure your calling is that of a mage?"
A coolly amused voice seeps across your mind, "Is that the extent of thy powers, child? I shall show thee true power!"
Tursh stares into your soul as if to freeze it by glare alone.
Ruschk mumbles something incoherent...an icy chill comes over you.
Bur Lizk smiles as her body falls to the ground. She looks briefly to the center of the room, then closes her eyes.
The Ancient Steward falls to the floor, his bones cracking on the stone. Looking around in obvious confusion he addresses the room.
Falatacot scum! Why do you insist on polluting the world with your unnatural presence?
General Tain'Kivix says, "Enough of this.  I will deal with the interlopers myself."
This must be stopped.
quest: I see that you have gathered 10 shrouds of the pyre.
Excellent. The deceivers shall never gain these shrouds.
You are foolish to brave this cursed place.
For untold ages my court, the Latzimestal, has warred with the Filinuvekta, known to us as the deceivers. Our court can sense the foul work of their nobility in this place. I have come to stop it.

In ages past, when this place was destroyed the traitorous soldiers were wrapped in shrouds and thrown on pyres. At the time there was much corruption and the shrouds became tainted. It is our fear that our enemy will try to use these shrouds.
Bring me 10 of these Pyre Shrouds so I may destroy them and I will reward you.

greetings: On far off Bur, a telling blow has been dealt against the ritual of the Three!  %tn has killed the High Acolyte of the Blood!
On far off Bur, a telling blow has been dealt against the ritual of the Three!  %tn has killed the High Acolyte of Sacrifice!
You would dare such insolence? Fear our wrath!

quest: The Falatacot Herald reads the message from Harlune. At first, his aged face is impassive, but as he continues reading a visage of sheer fury appears.

You would dare mock our offer so?! You would dare present me with such insults?! Do you see that corpse in the corner? That is from the last messenger we had to deal with, dispatched from that Dericost worm Rytheran!
It is fortunate for you the Matriarchs themselves are indisposed - your deaths shall be quick, instead! Come, servants of the Blood, destroy these interlopers and drain their blood for our ends!
Why do you bother me, human? If you have nothing for me, leave!

greetings: Records... must be kept... even in the face of apocalypse.

quest: Be on your way now and report back to your masters. Which ever of them you might serve. Heh, heh. I know something you don't know...

So, my secret friends have a secret helper! I'm not sure I've seen you before, but then again all you breathers look and sound the same to me. I just need the supplies you brought. Here, let me take that...
Hmmm.. Do you have something for me? Why do you arrive empty handed?!

greetings: An expression of dumbfounded surprise flashes over Kazyk Ri T'thuunixis's face as he is brought down by %tn.
You humans have meddled for the last time!
Let us sacrifice them in the name of T'thuun!
Now you all die!
You are not welcome here.
%s wounds Kazyk Ri T'thuunixis badly and a gout of blood falls to the ground. His eyes flash and you hear him whisper something you can't make out.
An expression of dumbfounded surprise flashes over Minik Ra T'thuunixis's face as he is brought down by %tn.
Minik Ra T'thuunixis deflects your spell with an absent minded wave of his hand.
Leave this place insect!
%s wounds Minik Ra T'thuunixis badly and a gout of blood falls to the ground. His eyes flash and you hear him whisper something you can't make out.
An expression of dumbfounded surprise flashes over Nivinizk T'thuunixis's face as he is brought down by %tn.
Interfere and die human.
%s wounds Nivinizk T'thuunixis badly and a gout of blood falls to the ground. His eyes flash and you hear him whisper something you can't make out.
Fool. His Eternal Splendor's works cannot be undone. Even your precious Lightbringer cannot undo the works of the Book!
The intrepid adventurer, %tn, has killed the Filinuvekta Hieromancer!
Fool. Even disrupting my form is but a hollow victory. It is too late for the trapped Yalaini scum. They will suffer all of their lives for what His Eternal Splendor has stripped from them.
The intrepid adventurer, %tn, has killed the Filinuvekta Exarch!
Your kind are not even worthy to serve as slaves to His Eternal Splendor.

quest: Greetings, once again.
If you wish me to further empower you, simply take one of the tokens here beside me, and give me the one that corresponds to the enhancement you wish.
If all is in order, and you are filled with the Luminance necessary to grow, I shall convert that Light into the enhancement that you wish.
Greetings. I am Liam of Gelid, Seer of the Dericost.
I am both honored by your gift and your desire to join the Path of the Dericost. Shall we begin?
You feel the Light flood over you, and the Path of the Light Falatacot opens to you.
Welcome to the Path of the Dericost of the Light! You may now gain the greater Luminance augmentations that our Path offers, once you meet any requirements the powers may have.
You may also continue to gain the more basic Luminance augmentations from Nalicana. As the youngest of the Seers, she treats with those upon any Path.
I can see that you are touched by the Light. 'Blessed with an inner Luminance', as we used to say.
The Light has made me the Seer of the Dericost.

Do you find it strange that an undead such as myself can still hear the Light, let alone serve it? It is not so strange. Despite my present state, I am still an Empyrean. The Light fills all of my race, no matter the choices we have individually made.
And, by that Light, if you wish, I can set you upon the Path of the Dericost, and use that bond to further empower you.
If this is your goal, then simply give me one of these new tradenotes of yours. I believe it is called an 'MMD Note', and I will set you upon the Path.

I can sense great potential in you.  Potential you have not yet tapped.  Go to the isle of the one called Asheron.  In his castle, you will find Nalicana, the Seer of the Yalain.  She can set you upon the Path of Paths.
You are not bound to my path. I can sense the Dark Falatacot magics upon you.
I can sever your ties to them, if you wish to join with the Dericost, but there are prices to pay.
Firstly, I will need one of those Trade Notes that people use these days, the one worth 250,000 pyreals. This is to show the strength of your intentions.

Secondly, you must be prepared to start anew, stripped of the enhancements granted by the Light by all others, save Nalicana's gifts. To walk from one Path to another always has this price. It is... unavoidable.
If you are willing to pay these prices to join with the Dericost, then give me an MMD Note, and we will begin.
Sensing that you do not yet walk the path, %n refuses your gesture.
Your Seer Auras have been removed.
Present me with another MMD note as tribute to walk my path.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the first time.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the second time.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the third time.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the fourth time.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the fifth time.
You have maxxed out increases to Aura of Destruction.
Your Aura of Retribution has been augmented the first time.
Your Aura of Retribution has been augmented the second time.
Your Aura of Retribution has been augmented the third time.
Your Aura of Retribution has been augmented the fourth time.
Your Aura of Retribution has been augmented the fifth time.
You have maxxed out increases to Aura of Retribution.
%n looks you over carefully.

Greetings, young one.  I do not get many visitors down here. If you are looking to embrace the Dericostian Path, you must first gain in skill, and then be attuned to the Light by Nalicana, who I believe resides in Asheron's Castle.
Go now.  When you are ready, perhaps we shall meet again.
Come back when you are ready to make a decision.
%n grumbles..
You do not have enough Luminance.
Greetings young one, I sense you are not fully schooled in Nalicana's teachings. Return to me after you have studied all she has to offer you.
You have returned to me.
If you wish me to further empower you, simply take one of the tokens here beside me, and give me the one that corresponds to the enhancement you wish.
If all is as it should be, and you are filled with the Luminance necessary to grow, we shall make you stronger.
I am Ka'hiri, Seer of the Dark Falatacot. I see you, and I see your worth.
It is time to set your feet upon the Path of the Dark Falatacot. If you are prepared?
You feel the Light flood over you, and the Path of the Dark Falatacot opens to you.
You have chosen well. You may now gain the greater Luminance augmentations that our Path offers, once you meet any requirements the powers may have.
You may also continue to gain the more basic Luminance augmentations from Nalicana. As the youngest of the Seers, she treats with those upon any Path.
Greetings. I am Ka'hiri, Seer of the Dark Falatacot.
I can smell the touch of the Light upon you. This is good. That touch can give those determined enough to use it great strength.
The Light is what chose me, of all my sisters, to be the Seer of the Dark Falatacot.

Do you find it strange that one such as myself can still touch the Light, let alone wield it? It is not. The blood of the Empyrean still flows through these long-dead veins. It is the call of blood to which the Light speaks.
It is by that power that I can set you upon the same Path that I walked, so very long ago, and then use that shared bond to empower you.
If this is your desire, then give to me one of these new tradenotes of yours. I believe it is called an 'MMD Note', and I will set your feet upon the Path.

I can sense great potential in you.  Potential you have not yet tapped.  Go to the isle of the one called Asheron.  In his castle, you will find Nalicana, the Seer of the Yalain.  She can set you upon the Path of Paths.
Sensing that you do not yet walk the path, %n refuses your gesture.
Your Seer Auras have been removed.
Present me with another MMD note as tribute to walk my path.
You have maxxed out increases to Aura of Specialization.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the fifth time.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the fourth time.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the third time.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the second time.
Your Aura of Specialization has been augmented the first time.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the first time.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the second time.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the third time.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the fourth time.
Your Aura of Destruction has been augmented the fifth time.
You have maxxed out increases to Aura of Destruction.
%n looks you over carefully.

Greetings to you, young one.  If you are looking to embrace the Path of the Dark Falatacot, you must first gain in skill, and then be attuned to the Light by the Seer, Nalicana, who resides in Asheron's Castle.
Go now.  When you are ready, perhaps we shall meet again.
Come back when you are ready to make a decision.
%n grumbles..
You do not have enough Luminance.
Greetings young one. I sense you are not fully schooled in Nalicana's teachings. Return to me after you have studied all she has to offer you.

greetings: Fool. Killing me will not change anything back to what it was. It's too late for that now.
The intrepid adventurer, %tn, has killed the Filinuvekta Emissary!
Fool! My demise will not stop anything set in motion here! I'll be back for you...
Psst, over here.
If you bring me 100 of those A'nekshay Tokens, I'll give you something of great power.
A gem which will allow you to kill those filthy A'nekshay far easier.
Sound like a good deal?
quest: Have fun killing those dirty beasts, the more the better.
I require 100 A'nekshay Tokens, return when you have collected more.

greetings: Now where did I put those catalysts?
quest: Thank you, traveler. These grubs will prove crucial to my experimentation.
You must wait %tqt before repeating this task.
I see that you have recovered 20 Red Veined Grubs! Most excellent.
Thank you, traveler. These grubs will prove crucial to my experimentation. Allow me to reward you.
Like many of our house, I have been freed from torment and my mind is my own.

In recent times we of House Mhoire have found alchemical ways to free our tormented kin from the grip of madness that has befallen this place. None the less, it is a painstaking and time consuming process. I hope to refine the process so more tormented and mad undead here can be purified.

To that end I need specific grubs, Red Veined Grubs to be exact, that feed on the remains of the undead in the Oubliette below. Destroy corrupted undead in the Oubliette and gather 20 Red Veined Grubs from the bodies. Return them to me and I will reward you.
We are still working on decoding the writing you brought us. Hopefully the text contains where Geraine has been hiding.
You must wait %tqt to be complete this quest again.
Have you found any trace of Geraine?
Recent events have lessened the corrupted hold over the House of Mhoire.
We must use this opportunity to go after the cause of all our problems... Geraine.
There may be some clues about where he has been hiding out around the last place he corrupted in Dereth, the Frozen Valley.
If you discover anything bring it to me at once and you will be well compensated.
What is this?
I shouldn't be surprised his information is encoded. I am sure we will break the code with time.
Thank you for bringing this to me.
I suggest returning when you are stronger.
Our Lieutenant has traveled to Wai Jhou to set up a forward position for our troops.
I am sure he would like to meet those who defeated all of Geraine's Hosts.
This will keep that despicable monster hidden away for some time I'm sure. I'm glad you're on our side.
You may repeat this quest in %tqt.
We have deciphered enough of the text retrieved from Geraine to know it wasn't Geraine at all.
Apparently Geraine has been using willing hosts for thousands of years.
This foolish beings give themselves to him, allowing him to roam the lands in complete safety.
We've also discovered that he currently has seven other forms.
If we destroy those hosts, he will be weak and exposed.
If you discover any of these hosts do not hesitate. Destroy them at once.
I am impressed. I did not think anyone would have the power to bring down all of his hosts.
A most wretched trophy, but impressive none the less. Well done soldier.
There are still too many Geraine hosts out there. Destroy more and I will reward you.
You must defeat at least the first four of Geraine's hosts to be rewarded.
There are still more Geraine hosts out there, but I can reward you for those you have defeated.
You must truly have a Fiery Spirit to stand strong in the face of such a powerful foe.
You have been awarded the title of "Fiery Spirit"!
You have a Shocking Disposition to be able to carry yourself with such pleasantness after all you've been through.
You have been awarded the title of "Shocking Disposition"!
You must truly have ice flowing through your veins.
You have been awarded the title of "Icy Veins"!
You must have an acidic soul to fight back against the evil of Geraine.
You have been awarded the title of "Acidic Soul"!
You must have Grounded Morals to take on a task of such extreme risk but equally great importance.
You have been awarded the title of "Grounded Morals"!
You must have a Darkened Heart from all the evil you have witnessed.
You have been awarded the title of "Darkened Heart"!
To have defeated such a great evil, perhaps you are the one who should be called The True Emperor.
You have been awarded the title of "The True Emperor"!
This will keep that despicable monster hidden away for some time I'm sure. I'm glad you're on our side.
You may repeat this quest in %tqt.
I am impressed. I did not think anyone would have the power to bring down all of his hosts.
The citizens of New Aluvia have indeed struck a powerful blow against the evil that is Geraine.
It may not be much, but you all deserve this reward.
There are still too many Geraine hosts out there. Destroy them all and I will reward you.
You must defeat all of Geraine's hosts to be rewarded.

greetings: You come for the meaningless souls of these desert beings? Their lifeforce serves so much more purpose infused into metal and wood. Eternal. The vision does not end on this day, not by the likes of you!
I have failed you my mistress. Forgive me!
I've been expecting you. Your painful demise awaits.
Intruder!

quest: The Gearknight Phalanx you destroyed in the Direlands have gained us some good standing with the people of Dereth.
You must wait %tqt before attempting this quest again.
Satisfactory. Take these rewards as compensation for your efforts.
You've killed %tqc out of %tqm Phalanx.
Once you've killed 10 Phalanx, I will reward you. Keep up the good work.
Greetings, the Gearknight Phalanx in the Direlands are causing quite a problem for adventurers who travel there. Go there and defeat 10 Phalanx.

greetings: "As Lord Kastellar collapses into dust, a maniacal voice echoes in your mind, You're too late %tn! The Bloodstones are complete, and you will never stop them now!
"Fool! My demise will not stop anything set in motion here! I'll be back for you..."
It is too soon! He must not be disturbed before the bond is complete.
As Shikken Moriyaki crumbles to the ground, a woman's laughter echoes through the chamber.
Shikken Moriyaki ceases his ritual when he notices you approaching.
What is this? She will have her followers. I will deliver the serpents to her, this is their fate.
One with such raw power would make an excellent addition to her army, yes.
Perhaps you are worthy of joining her army.
You clearly need more practice little one. Your attempts at magic are feeble at best.
The Dericost undead's body collapses into rot and dust, but a voice in your mind sneers, "Pathetic little wretch! I shall rise again soon enough."

The Dericost undead's body collapses into rot and dust, but a voice in your mind sneers, "I should like to see you test your mettle against my Master, barbarian dog! He is a far more powerful magician than I."

The Dericost undead's body collapses into rot and dust, but a voice in your mind sneers, "I trust my defeat makes you feel slightly more in control of your destiny ... less like a dog at the end of Asheron's leash? Get you from my Master's halls before I rise again!"
A voice in your mind sneers, "Faugh! Pathetic."
A voice in your mind sneers, "It is difficult to imagine that the Great Ones would waste skin on such as you, %s."
A voice in your mind sneers, "You would not have lasted a halfbreath against my Master, barbarian!"
A voice in your mind sneers, "Do not return here again, %s. The boy's spinning rocks would not protect you if I released my full power."
Rytheran's Apprentice stamps his foot contemptuously on %s's corpse.
Rytheran's Apprentice gleefully spits on %s's corpse.
A voice in your mind sneers, "I believe I have, as you barbarians are wont to say, 'owned' you."
A voice in your mind sneers, "Don't you people have anything better to do than bother me?"
A voice in your mind sneers, "Oh, now what do YOU want, %s?"
Rytheran's Apprentice turns to fix his steely gaze upon %s!
Rytheran's Apprentice notices %s entering his sanctum, and rolls his rotting eyes in exasperation.
A voice in your mind sneers, "Oh for the throne and all that comes with it... Guards!
A voice in your mind sneers, "You bore me, and I have a letter to complete. Shoo, pest."
A voice in your mind sneers, "Your powers are weak, dog!"
A voice in your mind sneers, "The thought of a primitive like you besting me through Art is laughable! Show me your sword, that I may enjoy this battle!"
Rytheran's Apprentice blinks in surprise, then begins to chuckle at %s's inept spellcasting!
Rytheran's Apprentice resists %s's feeble spell. He shakes his head, muttering something about "the mages these days" under his foul breath.
If only I had more time to study the staff...
With the lead ritualist's death, the temporal distortions caused by the ritual fade.
As Lord Winstead collapses into dust, a maniacal voice echoes in your mind, "You are too late, %tn! The world is irrevocably changed!"
The tormented Falatacot sighs gratefully as you discorporate the shell he had been bound into. "Thank you, man-thing..."

The Bound Falatacot speaks within your mind: "You will serve, man-thing. I had not looked to see another in here, and I can tell you are not one of the minions of the overreaching fool Dardante. Slay me, man-thing, and release me from my torment. I will grant you the knowledge you seek. Be warned, I shall fight back when you attack. The code of my people demands that I go to meet oblivion with...

Ahh, the Soul Trap. It is good to see you carrying it, as opposed to the other way around. I see you heeded my warnings. Now, I will prepare this to contain the Shadow of the Black Spear. It will not hold him forever, but it will serve for a time.

Go to the following location, 76.9 S, 93.8 E. There, you will find the portal to where Grael's Shadow lurks. My Lord tells me this, so you may know it to be true. Find the Shadow, kill it. I will deal with the rest.
Well, this is indeed a fitting Token. Perhaps it will also make a suitable reward...
The Abbess chants over the shattered remains, which reform into a spear.

It will not survive use as a weapon, but the magicks within the pieces are strong, and tappable, if you place the spear in a secure location. Also, take this token, so you may prove to your people that you are worthy of whatever reward they have in store for you.
The Spear does not suit your desires? Very well, I think you'll find this gift more... inspiring.
quest: The Shadow Aspect is diminished, for now. I do not think this will last for long. Return later, if the Shadow Aspect has escaped, We may need to begin this process all over again.
Have you defeated Grael's Shadow? Go to the following location, 76.9 S, 93.8 E.
Any luck in finding the Soul Trap? You will find the Vault at 74.7 S, 98.2 E.

Yes, you may aid in this. Strong enough to, most likely, survive, but not so strong that the Black Spear's wards will hold you out. I can aid your people in removing the Black Spear from this world, as is the will of my Lord, Nc'thail. To do this, you must gather a thing lost for me.

There is a thing called a Soul Trap. My people have not used such in ages, but it may find use here. I have managed to locate one, but those who serve the Black Spear have reached the location first. I can enchant you to bypass the magicks on the portal there, so you can gain the Soul Trap.

Go to the portal you will find at 74.7 S, 98.2 E. Somewhere in that ancient vault, you will find the Soul Trap. Beware those who will try to stop them, and have a care while carrying the device, lest you accidentally activate it...
Go, bring the Soul Trap back to me. Remember my warnings.
Please return to me when you are more experienced.

Alas, in an attempt to hide from those powerful enough to destroy him, Grael, even in his weakened Aspects, has found means to stop one of your strength from aiding us in this. Seek those hunting the Mukkir aspect, for it contains the greatest part of him, and Grael is too proud to hide himself fully.

greetings: The Phylactery, and it appears unharmed, wonderful. With this, I can now truly help you with this Ruschk Aspect. I have managed to divine the location that the Aspect is hiding in. Go to 74.0 N, 28.6 W. Find the Aspect, kill it, and I will do the rest. Bring back proof of your involvement. From this range, it will be difficult to tell exactly who took part in this task.
You were able to defeat the Aspect! Perhaps this shard will also make a suitable reward...
Lord Pyrovor chants over the shattered remains, which reform into a spear.
The power of the spear is strong, I've augmented it a bit myself. Place it somewhere secure and you should be able to tap its power there.
The Spear does not suit you? Very well, take this instead.
quest: I have nothing more for you at this time.
Have you met with any success in gaining access to the Ruschk Aspect of Grael? You will find the portal to his 'Sanctuary' at 74.0 N, 28.6 W.
Any success with getting me the Phylactery? The Vault is located at 74.7 N, 24.6 W.

Greetings to you, child of Ispar. I have studied your kind for some time, which is why I was chosen to meet with you now. If you seek to bring battle to the Ruschk Aspect of Grael, I can set you upon that path. First, you must gain for me something that belongs to my people, but was recently lost to us. It is a Phylactery, which I can use, with some small modification, to aid in containing the...

I have opened the portal to the Vault the Phylactery was contained in at 74.7 N, 24.6 W. Go there, defeat whatever of Grael's forces gets in your way. Bring the Phylactery back to me, so that I can use it to aid you.
Lord Pyrovor chants for a moment, and a slight chill covers your body.
There, I have attuned your essence to the portal, so you may gain entry to the Vault. Good luck, Isparian.

I appreciate your enthusiasm, Isparian, but I cannot use your aid. There are magics in place, set by Grael, to prohibit one of your strength from entering the hiding place of his Ruschk Aspect. Seek those aiding with the other Aspects.

greetings: The Kazyk Ri's Raid Commander laughs. Fools, you will never defeat our masters. They will raise the Whispering One and the world will bow before our might.
The Minik Ra's Raid Commander laughs. Fools, you will never defeat our masters. They will raise the Whispering One and the world will bow before our might.
The Nivinizk's Raid Commander laughs. Fools, you will never defeat our masters. They will raise the Whispering One and the world will bow before our might.

The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind. A sibilant, chattering voice breathes, "Sap of Alaidain. Sap of Karishna. The watchful stars turn, man of the south. Soon they shall return. But in that coming, there shall be turning. One shall be another. They shall not know you. There shall be no singing, and no sleep."

The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind. A sibilant, chattering voice breathes, "How death comes: the great sap of the earth runs to dust, the maw yawns like the idle hunter, branches of eternal feversleep rake poison across the writhing bark of the world."
The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind. A sibilant, chattering voice breathes, "The saplings of the warmer light and the cleaner light shall crowd each other out."

The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind. A sibilant, chattering voice breathes, "A sapling shall stand before the seeds of the warmer light. The sapling is bent to loathe its sap, the man of the south, and all seeds of the cleaner light. Weights of earth and anger shall be tied to it, and the sapling shall bend in pain and confusion. But there shall be none to comfort, for the...
The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind, as if a sibilant, chattering voice were saying, "Where be the women with the totems in their hair?"

The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind, as if a sibilant, chattering voice were saying, "Beast you are, Watcher, and no planter of stones. We shall have our own. Her eyes shall be clear water. She shall stand at the side of the great and chosen, though not always both at once. She shall whisper in the dark, and that shall resound evermore."

The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind, as if a sibilant, chattering voice were saying, "Marked was the coming of you, man no longer man. Your seedbearer's sap stains still your leaves. The women teach you false and foolish things."

The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind, as if a sibilant, chattering voice were saying, "Auraken. Wind-Lord. Go not among your people evermore. Fly, fly to the high home. Too late, too late. The spore's mark has run its course among them. They fall and bite. Your kin shed lambent tears, and are forgotten."
The wind blows mournfully through the trees.
The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind, as if a sibilant, chattering voice were saying, "Cold..."
The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind. A sibilant, chattering voice breathes, "Seek the dead one where the waters twine and twist into their own life."

The dead leaves of the trees above you rustle in the wind. A sibilant, chattering voice breathes, "When all the circles are broken, she comes. The air smells of her. Her children smell her. They pour across the blighted land in numbers greater than the leaves of a forest. Alas, alas. This mote is safe no more."

quest: You have completed this quest too recently.
You take the Sword of Frozen Fury from the dais.
You have not proven yourself worthy of wielding this sword.

greetings: The Pumpkin Buffer bursts open spraying treats.
You drop the stein on the hatch. The stein shatters and the black ball explodes, blowing the hatch open. You jump through the open hatch just as a rope is pulled slamming it shut behind you.
quest: As you open the hatch, you feel the familiar tug of portalspace.
The hatch appears to be stuck.

greetings: As you place the Gem into the Mana Siphon, there is a large discharge of Mana into the sky!
You look the Mana Siphon over, but the modifications the Gear Knights have made to this Empyrean Device make even less sense than the Empyrean workings do.
These appear to be the cause of the problem. Someone has sown the seed of anger in my patches. Here, take this Golden Pumpkin as a reward my friend.
Amazing this little seed resisted the corruption of the Pumpkin Lord. I shall give this seed the gift of growth.
The Majestic Pumpkin blows it's warm loamy breath over the seed. The seed splits, unfolding green leaves and growing into a thick vine dotted with small orange pumpkin buds.
Please take care of this vine for me. It will thrive on your caring and attention.
Be sure to take it's pumpkins out for a walk every once in awhile.
quest: My thanks to you child. You have killed three of the Pumpkin Lords.
The corruption of my spirit has subsided. I will soon be be able to set down roots and sleep for another year.
My thanks to you child. You have killled ten of the Harvest Reapers.
The growing places are once again safe. I will soon be able to set down roots and sleep for another year.
You are truly a "Follower of the Vine."
You are a "Harvester" my friend
You are a "Harvester Harvester" my friend.
You are a "Harvester Harvester Harvester" my friend.
You must find more Pumpkin Lords. Return to me when you have ensured the safety of Dereth's Pumpkin Patches.
Do not fear me friend. I am a spirit of the earth and I would have you help me.

A few days ago I witnessed a terrible evil while visiting one of the growing places. A monstrous form was moving in the patch. It's shape was that of a huge man, but it's body was made of my kin. I do not wish to speak of what :I found in the patch after destroying the abomination. Know that it fills me with a great sadness and rage.

I will not abide with these perversions of my kin. Find three of these Pumpkin Lords, as they call themselves, and destroy them. Return to me when your task is complete and I will reward you as best I can.
Kill 3 Pumpkin Lords and return to the Majestic Pumpkin.
You must find more Harvest Reapers. Return to me when you have ensured the safety of Dereth's Pumpkin Patches.
A look of deep concern falls over the normal jovial features of the Majestic Pumpkin.

A new threat to my kind has risen from some fouled piece of land. We know them as the Harvest Reapers, tall headless skeletons robed in black and wielding my kin in place of thier lost heads. They seek out the growing places and slay my kin wholesale, wasting their spirit by leaving their smashed bodies to rot in the field. The destruction must be stopped if my kin are to fulfill their purpose.
The Harvest Reapers hunt the forests and plains for the growing places. The more dangerous the land the more likely you will see one of these horrors.
Don't fear the Harvest Reapers, they are strong, but I believe you to be stronger.
Return to me when you have killed ten of the unnatural horrors.
Kill 10 Harvest Reapers and return to the Majestic Pumpkin.
As you reach for another piece of the shattered core, you feel the one in your possession begin to resonate with the pile in a bad way, and decide that discretion is the better part of valor.
You deftly pluck a piece of the shattered core out of the unstable mass.

The Jester tells you, "Psst! You can go on just a bit further into the prison and help me out. It's not that dangerous really. Just a little deadly. Find my entombment wall and knock it down. That's all, just a little demolition and I'll be out of your hair. It's really not asking too much is it?"
The Jester says, "Hello?"
An oddly humorous voice cries out for help.
The Jester tells you, "Please, please set me free. I was only trying to help."
quest: The Jester tells you, "Oh, it's you again? Have you come to free me from the unjust oppression under which I am held? Come on, please!"
The Jester tells you, "Please, you, yes you, the one talking to a wall."
The Jester tells you, "You must free me. I was incarcerated without due process. There were mitigating circumstances!"
Suddenly you hear a ripple of mad laughter.
The Jester tells you, "Free me and I shall give you a boon, my most magnificent friend."
The Jester tells you, "Sorry about that sire. Sometimes the urge to laugh at my situation is too great."

The Jester tells you, "Set me free O' noble hero! I am but a lowly court Jester who ran afoul of his wish to do good. I don't claim to be innocent, but who is? In this case though the punishment does not befit the crime."
The Jester tells you, "Ok, I'm done. Please come back when you feel the need to free me."
The Jester tells you, "Shhh, I'm talking to my new friend! No, go away, I'll play with you later!"
The Jester tells you, "Sorry oh beneficent one. Where was I? Let's see, free me, imprisoned unjustly, laugh madly, offer the dolt a reward... Oh, right."
The Jester tells you, "Free me so that I may return to my love, Laylana. She knows not what has befallen me."

You have killed an Invader.
You have killed an Invader.

Anomaly! Anomaly! Chaos! Disruption!
No.

Anomaly! Anomaly! Disruption in the Order!
Leopold's eyes darken and his heal lolls to one side.
Ah yes, a mask for me to repair. Order from Chaos. Chaos from Order. I see now that this is the true way of things.
Intricate tendrils of purple energy reach from Leopold's robes and rebuild the mask with blinding speed.
Your mask fellow human.
As soon as Leopold releases the mask he eyes flicker to life. His head rises and he looks around for a second.
I appear to have mastered the human art of sleep. Which is what I as a human do periodically in order to reacquire energy and clarity of thought.
How may I help you comrade?

How do you expect to fool anyone with a disguise that poor? Quickly, my comrade, you are fortunate that I have proper magics with which to fix your mask! Go now, into the world and continue our mission!
Comrade, what is this? Where did you find it? Ah, an Observer mask. I shall keep this broken mask, but you may have this repaired Inquisitor mask as your reward.
I do not wish to know how you acquired this, my friend. But this world is a dangerous place, and by wearing this mask you have proven you are a predator, not the prey.
Well! Do not the wise men say, "We do the best we can!"? And "How about those assorted mascot animals?"!
Anomaly inconsistent with structure. Form devoid of contact. Conclusion, disruption to the Singularity. I must --
Please do not bring me any more masks like this. They are ... disturbing to me.

Hello, my name is Leopold! It is awfully hot out, is it not? Good thing I am wearing short sleeves!

greetings: You feel the energy released by the rift's destruction enter you.  You feel changed...

The Virindi's cloak seems to boil, as if a thousand insects were seeking to escape before it collapses. The dying Virindi shares its final thoughts with you: "Your life is forfeit, human.  You simply do not know it yet.  In killing me, %s, you have gained access to your doom."
As the Virindi falls to the ground, there is a bright flash of light!
My hands once were weapons, too.  Look what has happened to me.
So many things devoted to destruction.  Even the tools of the earth, shaped from the ethereal and the ideal, with a singular purpose:  To break the bonds that tie.
My former kin never used the piercing objects.  But I have seen...I have seen it now with my own eyes...the piercing works well.  The flesh is weak.  Weak and filled with red.
Flying death, floating death.
Before I became owned by the Master.  I had not known such a small quarrel could make a head explode.  While this whole experience has been painful and shattering, it has certainly been educational.
Oceans of red. He bled.
Crush and crush and crush and crush.  Crush and crush and crush and crush.
That blade looks sharp.  Can I touch it?  I would like to touch it.  The Master does not allow me to touch sharp things anymore.  There is no escape.  There is no escape.  There is no escape.
Death sings through the air.  Small sharp sticks raising their voice.  A chorus of blood.
Slicing and dicing is fun.  I used to be able to do it so much more before the Master came to me.   But I am not complaining!  You must not tell Master I was complaining.
The Master once told me that his people had a saying, 'If you prick me, do I not bleed?'  But I was watching him during one of his 'presentations.'  He did not bleed at all.

The Master would be pleased to see you have made it so far, little one.  You haven't lost your pretty Singularity weapon now, did you?  Give it to me, and we shall embark on the next step on this journey...yes?  Yesssssss.
If you already have one of my pretty Singularity weapons, let me enhance it for you.
This device... looks like an item I saw that Sclavus giving the Blood Witch. Perhaps you should investigate Issk further.
I am not interested in collecting bits of inferior creatures.
You have done something odd to this. I do not approve.
Yes, it is repaired. Now use it.
How did you obtain this artifact? Well, no matter. It can be repaired and used.

You are made of flesh, and are therefore the one whom I seek.  Grant me the ore delivered by the Quiddity, and I will make what you desire.

The room begins to crackle with energy.
The meatbags again attempt to interfere with my vision!
This insolence must be met with punishment. Know that your intrusion has lead to the death of one of your kind.

You my child. An example must be made. You have been chosen.
This blood is on your hands.
Your feeble attempts to stop me again fall unsuccessful. These humans are mine.
Come forth my archetype! Obey me! Kill our unwelcomed guests! Their suffering is your reward.

A voice echos in your mind, "So, you've worked so hard to find me. You've interrupted my experiments and you've interfered with my plans. I cannot let you continue to exist, but I'm still not convinced you're worth my time. Guards! Remove this vermin from my sanctum. Their presence pollutes this place."

A voice echos in your mind, "You've survived my guards and defeated my lieutenants... Very well. I will deal with you myself."
quest: There is much that still needs to be done. I have no time to waste on you insignificant little ones.
This will be a perfect test for my newest toy. Come Dravann, slay the intruders. Leave none alive. This I command!

I have more pressing matters that now require my attention with this latest change in direction.

quest: You have done all you can for now.
You may complete this quest again in %tqt.
Have you freed the enlightened? Return to me when you have stopped the Reaver of Dreams. Please hurry before it is too late!
The Virindi motions you towards it.
Greetings fellow Derethian. You look brave enough to complete a task to free the ones like me - ones that have escaped the oppressing control of the Quiddity.
Rarely our kind will show signs of individual thought, signs that we have become enlightened and free from the grip of the single-minded.
See the crater to the south? A strange portal appeared recently and I can feel the call of my brethren from within. I can feel their identity being ripped away from them.

I was drawn to the portal by the voices but I saw one of the Reaver of Dreams' minions guarding the entrance, so I hid here before they discovered me and dragged me into their facility. I am too little to attempt a rescue - the Virindi within are far too powerful for me to handle by myself.
I do not know what the Reaver of Dreams is doing in there, but it can't be good and we must put a stop to this evil.
Free any of the enlightened within and slay the one in charge. This will not stop the Reaver, no, but it will show that we will not crumble to their will.
Return to me when you have put an end to their experiments and I will reward you.
I'm sorry, but you are not yet strong enough to help me. Only the mightiest have a chance to accomplish my task. I will not send you on a suicide mission.

These Virindi are unlike any you have battled against in the past. Gather your most powerful companions and venture into their newly created habitat.

I suggest fleeing this area, it is far too dangerouns for one as inexperienced as yourself.

Thank you. Gems aren't really common in the woods, but I like the sound of it.
Thank you. They say there are abandoned mines with many gems.
Thank you. It's hard to make a living in a forest town, but I enjoy the challenge.
It's a pleasure doing business with you.
A fine choice.
Greetings.
Thank you. Come again.
Fine, fine.
Good, good.
Welcome to the Southern Town Bows.
Thank you, and may my goods serve you well.
How wonderful.
Well chosen.
Welcome to Jewels of the South.
It was very kind of you to stop by.
A good find. Thank you.
A fine choice!
Good day.
A pleasure to do business with you.
Well done.
Ah, very good.
Ah, good..
Welcome to this humble shop.
Thank you. May your travels be safe.
South from here is Mayoi. To the southwest is Lin. But you won't see me traveling far from Nanto...
That's a good choice.
Very good!
Welcome! Can I interest you in a charged mana stone?
Hail. I am Jiz ibn Ijfai, the town's sage.
You'll have to visit more often.
Maybe I'll see you again...
Thank you.
A very good purchase.
Welcome! How may I help you?
Return again when you need more supplies.
Interesting. Thank you.
Might be of some use to me...
A fine decision.
Welcome to the House of Treasure.
Always keep my humble business in mind for all your esoteric needs.
Oh yes! Something to make a profit on!
Yes, this might be a good buy.
Very good, indeed.
Welcome!
Please return again!
Thank you.
A fine choice.
Can I offer you something?
I'll probably be seeing you again.
Hah! Pretty good deal!
More of this! More of that! Just sell it all to me!
Thank you!
Greetings. What's your pleasure?
I wish you well on your travels.
Very good.
Thank you for your purchase.
Welcome traveler, to the Desert Magic Supplies shop.
Welcome traveler!
Desert surrounds this town. Traveling outside of town can be quite dangerous.
Al-Arqas is the nearest town from here, and that's many miles to the northwest.
Thank you.
That's a choice well made!
Welcome!
Thank you for your patronage.
I might find some use for this.
You made a good purchase.
Welcome!
Thank you for visiting.
I like it!
Wonderful.
Welcome to my shop.
Come back again!
I'm glad to see someone with scholarly interests.
Very good.
Welcome! I carry general supplies for travelers such as yourself.
Welcome to my shop.
Come again and spend more money any time.
I'm glad to be of service.
Your business is always welcome.
Welcome to the East Yaraq Outpost shop!
Thank you for your patronage.  The town of Yaraq is to the west; be careful to check your directions.  Should you be new here, also be sure to go through the Training Academy.

Thank you.  If you're new to the world, be sure to go through the Training Academy first!  The town of Yaraq itself it to the west.  There are many other merchants there.  Check your compass to make sure you're going west, though.
Thank you!
May it serve you well.
You needn't go to Peldin.  My prices are better!
Just remember to come here instead of Peldin's.
Ah yes, a fine item.
This will make a fine addition to my shop.
Thank you.
Isn't it cheaper than at Peldin's?
We once had a lot of people coming through here, when that Aluvian knight's party went missing. Now it's pretty quiet again.
Best of luck to you.
I saw there was no archmage here, so I decided to open a shop.  I hope it is useful to you.
Very good.
Thank you!
Welcome to the ancient Underground City.
This place has a proud history in humankind's revolt against the Olthoi.
People complained there was no archmage here, so I came.
I will accept that; thank you.
Thank you.
I sell and buy bows and arrows.  Are you interested?
I wonder if the axes on the walls were used against Olthoi? .... Never mind
This castle must surely have seen more pleasant days, long ago.
Watch out for the wisps.
That is acceptable.
Thank you.
I sell harmless snowballs, which are good for safe Player Killer action! I also sell instructions on how to make flattering likenesses of me.
If you think my prices are too high, you should see my cousin's!
Very good.
Quite good.

Come to see my iceballs? Well, now, the prices here are the best you'll find. Oh, maybe you want to praise my coldness by creating a likeness of me from snow. I sell the instructions for almost nothing.
If you don't like my prices, too bad! And I don't recommend fighting me, either!
Hrrmph!
Hmph.  An outsider.  Well, as long as you're here, you might as well make yourself useful.  So buy something or talk to our captains.  They'll give you something to do.
Stay out of trouble.
I suppose I can take that off your hands.
Yes, yes, will that be all?
Whatever you need, Murdo's got!
Watch your back out there, eh?
I think we can cut a deal.
There, see, try find that anywhere else within miles of here!
I sell armor.  For other needs, talk to my boss, Sang Nen-Kai.  But be careful, she is quite stingy.
Have a nice day.  At least you don't have to spend all day cooped up in this smelly shop.
Here's your money.  It's a good thing you sold to me, instead of my boss.
Here you go.
Welcome to the Smoking Axe Tavern.  I tried to set up shop in Arwic, but my customers kept getting portal-stormed away!
Come back soon!
Good old Berkholt treats you fair, doesn't he?
You'll always find a square price with good old Berkholt.
In my day, we didn't bother with all these fancy arrows and quarrels!  Now what are you interested in?
I'm Thiuda the Sharp-Eyed.  Welcome to the Old Campaigner's Bows.  That's me, the old campaigner, heh heh.
Good hunting.  Remember, one shot, one kill, youngster.
I suppose I could take that off your hands.
Smart choice, youngster.
Hello! Anything for sale?  Or are you here to buy?
Hurry back! I am always looking for more merchandise.
I can buy this from you, at quite a reasonable price!
Well chosen. Enjoy!
Please be at ease.  Welcome to the Secluded Sanctuary.  Take a rest from your travels.
Fare well and safe journeys.
I hope you find this a fair price.  It is the best I can offer.
A sensible purchase.
Welcome to our new town.  Are you looking for jewelry today?
Be careful and be well.
I gave you a good price.  You should be grateful.
Excellent.  I hope your purchase pleases you.
Welcome to Ayan Baqur.  We are proud of our town... But I am distrustful of that Virindi north of town.
Fair journeys.
I have been looking for something like this.
Excellent choice.
Welcome to the Whispering Blade.  My assistant, Sung Wenxio, sells armor as well.
Guard yourself well outside of town.  These lands are hazardous even to the strongest adventurer.
Thank you.
Thank you for your business.  I hope it serves you well.
Greetings, greetings! It is my honor to meet a fellow traveler in this distant land. Could I interest you in a memento, for the kids back in Dereth?

Please tell your peers about me. No doubt they also have eager young journeymen under their tutelage, eager for spoils from this island. Surely, one of my shirts would be the most unique and memorable twink... er, souvenir!
Ah. I may be able to use that.

Bet they wish they could make it here, yes? Truly, it is a rare place in this strange world that hasn't been overrun by humanity. Aerlinthe brings back memories of the good old days in Dereth, does it not?
Welcome, fellow seeker.
Another soul may have some use for that.
May it serve you faithfully.
Many Empyrean texts were found here, but the Zaikhal Arcanum snatched them all up. I can only wonder what marvels they may have told of.
Go see the living grottos before you leave. They are quite lovely.
May the gods stand between you and harm in all the empty places you must walk.
Welcome! It's always nice to see a fellow archer down here in the tunnels.
You can always use more ammunition. Want some?

Can you believe they let that... that VIRINDI live in Ayan Baqur? I'd put a quarrel right between its eyes if I were Thiuda. Or maybe hire that Oswald fellow. I mean, what's next? Are we going to let Lugians start selling their axes in our towns?
Yags are pretty useless compared to Sho or Aluvian bows, aren't they? I'm trying to improve the design, with Ashaira's help. Maybe one day we'll have something to show for our efforts.
This looks a bit worn, but I'll make it good as pretty and twice as new.
See you around, child. Remember, only dumb brute swordsmen fight close quarters. Archers fight smart, from the walls.
What do you want?
Good, good. Anything else?
Hmph. Probably a worthless geode. I'll examine this carefully - if it's a fake, I'll have the Bey run you out of town.
Come back when you're ready to buy more!
If you ever need any... tools... I'm your man. Just remember that.
What do you want? If you talk to those Virindi get them to sell me some of their jewels.
And I suppose you are going to tell me that the Olthoi are not a problem anymore as well?
Good day.  It has been a while since Kryst has had any welcome visitors.
Be careful.  There are many dangerous things in the jungle.
Thank you, I will be able to use this in my research to dispatch the Olthoi once and for all!
Thank you.  With the extra money, I may be able to get off this island eventually.
May it serve you well.
Ahh.  Another person that realizes the foolishness of melee fighting.
Hello, my name is Sharon.  Welcome to the Olthoi's Eye.
Good luck, and be careful out there.  There are some creatures out there that can surprise you!
Thank you.  If I manage to get enough money, perhaps I can purchase a "viscera" composite bow.
You have good taste.
Wow.  Most people around here don't have use for jewelry.  Can I help you?
Heh, I just opened this place, and I'm making pyreals hand over fist!  You guys are great!
Leaving so soon?
Thanks for selling this to me.  I may be able to sell it to some other su... err, customer.
It's great that you give actual money for shiny baubles!
Thanks a lot!
Welcome to Kryst, friend.  Beware the Mosswarts, because it seems they are on the move.
Beware the Olthoi, for they will strike when you think you are safest.
Ahh, a new item to add to my collection.
Good choice!  It is good to see someone that reads something other than those tawdry romance novels!
Welcome to MacNiall's Freehold, outsider. We have almost anything you could want... at a price.
I suppose I could buy that from you...
Always a pleasure to take people's money.
Go in freedom.
Your bow is your best friend when traveling these dangerous islands. What do you need?
Strike down one of those filthy Mosswarts, if you can.
That's useful enough, you have a deal.
I hope you can put that to good use.
Managed to escape the Olthoi, did you? Well, welcome to the Vesayen Isles, and to MacNiall's Freehold. What is your need?
Safe travels.
Excellent, we can never have too many of those...
That'll work well.
Living free and independent, on this wild island, requires strong tools. What can I help you with, stranger?
Ware the Mosswarts, they can be quite tenacious in a fight.
Not a bad buy. Thanks.
Thanks for your business. I hope it serves you well.
Salutations. I am a humble wandering archmage, following the desert wind. Could I interest you in any of my wares?
I'll take that off your hands.
A bit scuffed... I can probably sell this at discount.
Ah, my old master had one just like this.
Whoo! Did you pull this out of a drudge midden?
Hasina waves a hand below her nose.
There you are.
Very good.
I found a strange puzzle box half-buried in the sand. I don't know how it works. It's yours if you want it.
Safe journeys, friend. May the gods go between you and harm in all the empty places you must walk.

Doubtless you heard about the infiltration. The demons took us unawares, late at night. Were it not for Captain K'rank, I fear our city would have fallen. Though you're not like to hear him say much about it. His battle prowess is rivaled only by his modesty.
Seek out Lord Kresovus. He may have need of your aid.
Thank you.  I may be able to use this in my research...
Thank you.  With more pyreals, we will be able to smelt more weapons.
Many of the demons fell to my bow. Unfortunately, I was not quick enough. The beasts escaped, and they took Balor with them. Oh, how the heart grieves.
If you wish to aid us in this conflict, speak with Lord Kresovus. We dare not spare more forces than we have already lost.
This item will greatly aid us in our struggle.
Your contribution is appreciated.
The ease with which they infiltrated our walls! They must have placed someone on the inside long ago. Probably some turncoat Isparian, if you ask me.
I thank you for your business. But if you wish to do us a true service, speak with Lord Kresovus. We must not allow such crimes to go unpunished.
Thank you.  Hopefully this will help our cause.
We are running out of those, so use it with caution.
Welcome to Monty's Den of Iniquity.  Don't cause any trouble.
Fortune favors the brave.
Sure, we could stock up on those.
Knock yourself out, kid.
Welcome to Arshid's Den of Iniquity.
Remember, moderation is the key.
I will buy that from you.
May luck be with you, but do not fret if you lose.
Welcome to Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity.  Would you care for a drink?
Good luck.  See if you can win a cute Drudge doll!
The house needs more of those.  Certainly.
Enjoy!
I don't haggle, I don't mince, I give you my price and you take it or leave it.
We may be a bit out of the way but don't you go thinking we're backwards, you can't rook me. Now, what do you have for Greta today?
Don't go listening to my husband too closely, that sauce he's always trying to perfect is rotting his brain.
Watch your back out there.
I still think you're getting the better end of this deal.
I thought you'd find that a fair price.
I do hope that we draw a few people to this place, I'd hate to let Zisaha down.
May you be blessed in your travels.
I think I can put that to use, I thank you.
Excellent. I truly hope it serves you well.
Many seasons ago, we followed Hea Arantah to this placed and named it the City of Hope.
We have gained much through the pact with our Virindi friends.  For this we have named them Atual Arutoa--Granters of Freedom.
Farewell--and do not believe the lies of the Aun in Timaru.
There is always room for more on my shelves.
It is always wise to be prepared, especially on this island.
I am eagerly waiting my turn to leave the island! In the meantime, I am helping my brothers prepare for their journey.
Is it true that there are many wondrous sights to see on the land across the water?

I would not bother traveling up to the highlands if I were you--it is dangerous there and populated only by timid, unimaginative folk. I've even heard that bukha Aun Ralirea has been spotted stalking the Ebon Gromnies among the plateau's peaks. Every year he stocks his lodge, expecting company...Aun just don't know when to let go.
Thank you.
You'll find this comes in handy, I'm sure.
A brother of mine is camping near Dryreach.  Perhaps you have met him?
Our Aun brothers should have been so wise to come with us.
Thank you.
Don't believe any of Laranawa's silly tales. They are stuff for children--and all lies at that.
I don't know why my xuta brethren say I'm not ready to leave for the mainland yet. I've followed the rules in our pact with the Virindi!
Next time we meet will be on the mainland, I'm sure!
I don't think this will match my outfit, but I'll keep it on hand should someone else want it.
Good choice.
The Virindi have only our best interests in mind--if you engaged their friendship, you might benefit as well.
Be careful as you adventure here--the Aun are not to be trusted. I would not be surprised if they tried to drag you into their hopeless crusade.
My thanks. Doubtless there will be more who have need of these.
If you had only half of Hea Arantah's powers you would not have need for items such as these. Perhaps one day you will be lucky enough to meet our friends, the atual arutoa.
I am so tired with Wharu's invasions and the Aun's sordid preoccupation with them! I'll bide my time here, then I'm off to join my brothers in Samsur.
Our Aun brothers should have been so wise as to come with us.
Don't take any wooden pyreals--I could name other xutas who aren't as honest as we are here in Ahurenga.
Many thanks.
A present fit for a Tah! You have exemplary taste.
We have been watching your settlements grow and are happy that trade has begun between our kinds.
Please come again--I would love another chance to practice your language!
I am always interested in a good bargain.
Thank you.
Well met, my friend! As you will see, my prices will beat out Klar's little foodmart any day!
Come back soon--the prices will still be as low as ever!
This is how to make your business popular--buy high, sell low!
Thank you--and there's more where that came from!
How may I help you, oh worthy adventurer?
I am glad to be of service. Please do come again.
Thank you for choosing my humble shop to sell your beautiful gems and jewelry.
I sell only the finest quality here. One never has to worry when he makes a deal with Nathious Agoren.
Hello. You are one of the many newcomers visiting our settlement of late. Do not be lured by the beauty of the island, stranger. There are dark things at work here.
Yes, I have the components you need. The magic is ever-hungry, yes? It always needs sustenance.
Be careful, stranger. Not all things that go bump in the night are children's tales.
This isn't Ayan Baqur, stranger. This is what I can afford to pay, and no more.
Use it wisely, adventurer.
I have many beautiful things in my inventory. Please, take your time to examine them carefully.
Come again soon--I am always looking for new items for my collection.
Ah! Lam Yi will be so jealous that I made this find!
A beautiful adornment. A gift for someone special, perhaps?
Things have been uncharacteristically quiet here on the eastern shore...the quiet before the storm, no doubt...
Take care to stay to the roads on this island, stranger--and even then you may not be safe.
Thank you.
Make sure you have all that you need--my shop has been so busy lately that I cannot guarantee a full stock on your next visit.
Good day, traveler! How may I help you today?
If you visit Bluespire during your travels, be sure to visit my brother Yusnar's shop. Together we have the best prices on the island!
This is the wonderful thing about frontier territories--anyone can do well by themselves, if they only put out the effort.
Do you think it's too soon to start planning the Ibn Lomaq Brothers grocery franchise here on the island?
Come, take a look at my beautiful gems and jewelry.
Please come again.
You've made the perfect choice.
My sales come with a satisfaction guarantee.
Greetings, traveler. My shop has not been here long, but it has already started to thrive on the business brought to the island by new adventurers.
Be sure to stop by Micon Stuvis' tavern before you leave town--he may have interesting tidings for those who wish to explore the area.
I can always stand to replenish my stock.
I'd ration that if I were you--supplies aren't always easy to come by on an island.
The Hea will never be permitted back in Timaru so long as they persist in their dealings with atua ngamaru!
Please don't squeeze the shaman.
Thank you. May trade between our kind always be this amicable.
I hope this will serve you good stead.
quest: Hmph. So, the adopted kin of Aun Hareltah graces me with coin. Do your business and be gone, Queenslayer. I desire peace with the tailless Ispar xuta, but only because I know your people to be reckless and dangerous. I will not suffer your names to be joined with ours. Deru has told me of the Soul Crystals.
Back so soon?  Forgot something, did you?
The Olthoi must never be allowed to invade our territories! May Buadren guide the hands of our drummers, so they never falter.
When the Virindi first came to us, we sounded for the anima of their kind...and then we were filled with terror, for we found that they had none.

greetings: Be sure not to cooperate with the Hea...or you may find our gates will be closed to you as well.
More for my arsenal. I'm sure these will come in handy very soon.
Take this...please use it against all those who have associated with those Virindi demons!
quest: Aun Paikitea sneers at your approach.

Aun Paikitea tells you, "So, the mighty %s, strutting within the safety of Timaru's walls as if they sky above was there merely for the Queenslayer's plucking. Tell me, great one--when do you plan to do something about the abominable Hea?"
Well THAT was quick. I suppose I should have expected as much from a tailless. Why the atua ngamaru are so interested in the Ispar xuta is beyond me.

I'm glad the Hea are no longer among us--I couldn't stand to be in their tainted presence ever again. Tailless abominations! Just look at their boy-tah. His traffic with the atua ngamaru left him quite mad, you know.

greetings: Please come again--I will have many more items in the future.
A true bargain!
The trinkets loved by your kind are certainly curious...although nowhere near as beautiful as our tattoos. Nevertheless, I am sure another of you will want to buy this.
quest: Aun Ngaiona tells you, "Ah, Queenslayer %s. Surely a name as illustrious as yours has found many sparkling items. Stone told me that the grey giants walking the south of your island make many fine things."
Forgot something?
You will never be able to find ornaments as fine as these in Ahurenga--that town of outcasts and thieves!

greetings: Some trust in Buadren. Some trust in Hoari. I believe I have found a new and more potent spirit here--Pyreal.
I have much use for these items.
May these items sustain you on your journeys.
quest: Aun Mireona tells you, "Queenslayer %s. To see you does this heart of mine much good. If you are here, Timaru is safe."
Aun Mireona raises his brow.
A short journey? Or did you forget something?
Aun Ralirea is far afield, seeking the hide and meat of the gromnie for Timaru. If you see him, do not inquire after his wife. And do not tell the wretched Hea that you have seen him!
As long as I can hear the drummers of Timaru, I'll know that we are safe.

greetings: Good Morning!
May I help you?
It sure has been a long day...
Hmm.  I suppose my master could use this in one of the pieces in process.
Thanks!  My master appreciates your support!
I sure hope you measured that before you bought it...
Good Morning!
May I help you?
It sure has been a long day...
Hmm.  I suppose my master could use this in one of the pieces in process.
Thanks!  My master appreciates your support!
I sure hope you measured that before you bought it...

May I help you?
It sure has been a long day...
Hmm.  I suppose my master could use this in one of the pieces in process.
Thanks!  My master appreciates your support!
I sure hope you measured that before you bought it...
Welcome to my table! I buy and sell most anything.
You have something that'll interest me?
Heh, come again, and better luck next time... Sucker!
Thank you, come again.
You'd think after all this time, you guys would know this place was fixed...
Ah yes, family heirloom no doubt?
And here's your money. Please visit again when you get short on pyreals, but bring something valuable.
Right then, more junk means more money for me.
Thanks!  This is useful... honest.
Can't find that make anymore, at least not around here. That's a rare item I bet. No wait, I don't bet, it's a waste of money.
That's a fine choice there! Almost like brand new that is. Enjoy.
Keep buying my friend. There's plenty more where that came from.
Here you go.
More for me.
That is a good one--lots of people are snapping those up these days.

Welcome to my shop! Appraise items in my inventory by right-clicking on them. Scroll down through my complete inventory by clicking the green down button. Buy items from me by double-clicking on them.
Good luck in your travels!
Could I interest you in some firewood?
Would you care to see any of my log furniture?
I have some treated wood that should burn extra hot for the winter.
Perhaps you would like a small tree or shrub to plant near your house?
Tell I've made a deal with the Tumeroks to sell their finely carved chairs. Why not buy one and impress your friends with your sophistication.
Wood, it's improving the quality of life in every way. Buy some wood.
The woods are really beautiful around here and the wood is of surpassing quality. Oh, you're leaving so soon? Ok then, stop by when you need more wood.
Yeah, I can change that for you.
Bet you could make something really nice from that.
I'm sure that will enhance your property value.
Ah, the great outdoors!
Isn't it wonderful what Asheron and the Arcanum were able to accomplish for us?
Good luck in your travels, friend.
Thank you.
No more components, or that dreaded research!
Make your choice. And be quick about it.
Go and fight. Bring glory to the great one.
May you spill much blood.
Isn't it wonderful what Asheron and the Arcanum were able to accomplish for us?
Good luck in your travels, friend.
Thank you.
No more components, or that dreaded research!
Make your choice. And be quick about it.
Go and fight. Bring glory to the great one.
May you spill much blood.

Good luck in your travels, friend.

Go and fight. Bring glory to the great one.

Good luck in your travels, friend.

Make your choice. And be quick about it.
Go and fight. Bring glory to the great one.

Good luck in your travels, friend.

Make your choice. And be quick about it.
Go and fight. Bring glory to the great one.
May you spill much blood.
Take as much as you like. The lady is most magnanimous.
Spill much blood.
Use this knowledge well.

Sure, being down here has isolated me from friend and family. But, really most of my family is back on Ispar. I say down with Asheron! Martine is a great man. He gives us the right to buy and sell too.
Shoot straight, and if you get a chance tear away a virindi cloak or two.
A bow's all I need out in the wilderness. You use those well now, you hear?
A fine choice, a fine, fine choice.
Hoo, ooo oo oo?
Aaa oo.
Aaa, aaa aaa oo ooo Ooo!
Ooo oo ah.
Hoo, ooo oo oo?
Aaa oo.
Aaa, aaa aaa oo ooo Ooo!
Ooo oo ah.
Hello, my names Akane, can I interest you in some food or drink?
Have a seat and stick your feet up. I'm not much for formality. What do you need?
Oh! That scar looks pretty big. You must have fought bravely! I'm Akane, pleased to meet you.
Hello, I'm Akane, and you must be hungry. Hello, Hungry! Hehee.
Welcome traveler, I like the way you dress, very impressive!
Awww, leaving so soon! Well, please come back and visit me again.
You come back and visit or I'll get very mad with you!
Try talking to everyone in town. They're all very good people and love to meet new friends.

Ahem! Four stones pave the Path to Paradise. These four stones, sometimes known as the four tenants or principles of Jojiism are Humility, Discipline, Detachment and Compassion. The Elders, the Dragon of Power, Ryu, the Unicorn of Grace, Chiran, and the Firebird of Splendor, Iiwah, all do their best to lead us, humanity, along the path. If we apply ourselves and are true to these four Sho virtu...
I've been practicing that for a week. I heard that we might be getting more visitors and I wanted to let them know what Wai Jhou stands for.
Ok, I can use this to make a really good meal.
Yup, I need some of that for sure.
Oh! I really like these, but I mustn't use them all. I'll take one and give the others to the needy.
I'm part of the Jojii Zhen Gai, that's the Order of Jojii. We work hard to follow his four principles and trying to teach them to others.
If you like after your done eating you can visit our shrine. It's in the big tower in the middle of the water. Use the path, that way you get less wet.
I hope you like it, I made it special for you.
If your mean to me I'll smack you on the head with a table!
Just because I have a happy disposition doesn't mean I'm not bright.
Ahem! No principle has been truly learned unless it is applied to oneself first. The wise Ken-gou once said that.
May the Dragon protect you from harm, the Unicorn bless you and the Firebird lead you on your path.
May you find your balance in the stones that pave the Path to Paradise.
May the Unicorn grace you with a compassionate eye, so you may seek those in need and help them.
Welcome friend. I have handcrafted bows, crossbows and atlatls for sale.
You are most welcome here friend. How may I help you?
Always ask yourself why you do a thing.
Please visit our shrine across the way. It's very simple, but a good place to think.

When I came to this world I thought I had been brought here to slay the beasts that threatened our very lives. I used my skills as an archer to slay every creature I sighted. I can't count how many I killed...

One day while hunting in the Tiofor Woods I came across an Ursuin. It rushed me and I slayed without a thought. It wasn't any real threat, but I thought it might have some trophy I could sell. When it's death throes had finished I went to search it for treasure and heard a low growling mewl. I searched for some time eventually finding a flap of moss covering a small den hidden in the roots of a...

Inside the den were two baby ursuin cubs crying for their mother. I crouched there in shock for what felt like hours. I had become the beast that killed without thought, destroying families. I gathered the small cubs promising that I would learn from my mistakes, promising them to become a better person, that I would never lift my bow without good reason again.

I returned home to the desert and was ridiculed for my perceived weakness. It was a huge joke for the locals. They thought I was crazy. I knew better though and felt sorry for them. They would make the same mistakes over and over as I had done.

I raised the two cubs as though they were my own, living free and happy in the woods, occasionally trading with curious hunters. One such hunter stayed awhile and taught me the teachings of Jojii. She never told me her name, but she was kind to me and seemed to understand my failings as though she too had wrestled demons.

When the cubs, Kogo and Not, were old enough I let them go. They were still wild at heart and needed to run free, away from their mothers over protective eye. I had taught them how to hide from hunters and forage for food and beyond that they would need to find their own way. I wandered from place to place helping those in need and I finally ended up here in Wai Jhou, my new home. I now try to...
A fair buy.
I have no need of this, but someone else may.
Use your weapon with compassion my friend. Know when to release the arrow and when to lower it.
May Iiwah the Firebird guide your arrows flight.
Good choice, I use one just like this myself.
I hope you find my weapons effective. I use only the best materials and personally test them myself.
Let humility dwell within you. Without humility you will be easily misled and lose your way.
Let discipline hone you. Without discipline you will tire and fall away.
Let detachment guard you. Without detachment you will be unable to let go and move forward.
Let compassion be in your every thought and action, as you strive to help others in their paths.

Do not make the mistake of following only one of Jojii's Principles. You must strive to attain a balance between the four stones. Only then will you reach the inner peace you seek and walk the path to heaven.

An unbalanced arrow will not fly in a straight path and will hit something other than your target. If you balance you life with all of the Four Stones you will fly a true path. Don't be afraid to fail and forgive yourself your failings. We all fail on our paths occasionally, but we must notch our arrow again and aim for our goals.
Hey there, I sell provisions and buy most everything else.
After your done here you should go try some of Akane's cooking she makes a delicious bowl of mushroom rice.
Remember, no matter what your path strive to do your best and be honest with yourself. Everything else should fall into place.
Thanks for stopping by, don't forget to write.
Ooo, that's a bargain!
If I can't sell this I know a good person who can use it.
I think I have the hardest time with Detachment. I mean, I'm not greedy, but I find certain items I own give me a sense of well-being.
I'm not making much on this, but if you use it wisely I'm more than pleased to sell it to you.

Let discipline hone you. Without discipline you will tire and fall away.

I try to be like the Koji of legend. She was humble, disciplined, detached from greed and compassionate to those in need.

Think of the Four Stones as weights on the edge of a child's spin toy. If the stones aren't perfectly in balance then the toy will flip all over the place, chaos. But if you position the stones equally around the toy then it spins powerfully with grace and splendor.
Good luck on your travels. Beware the Dragon and it's tricks.
Goodbye, if you care to, you may visit the shrine upstairs. It is a place of peace and insight.

Aun Teverea, the Tumerok collector outside of town told me that they have already collected enough materials to start building Candeth Keep. I went to the crater location he mentioned. They have already done an impressive amount of work. The lugians are amazingly adept at building. I would expect them to have the town mostly built by Verdentine.
Fine fine workmanship, I can use some of the techniques I see in the crafting of this weapon. My thanks!
This weapon is destined for someone's hand. I must do my best to prepare it for when they arrive.
Use this honorably my friend.
Do not forget that great power must be tempered with discipline.
