May the Dragon protect you from harm, the Unicorn bless you and the Firebird lead you on your path.
May you find your balance in the stones that pave the Path to Paradise.
quest: I can see you have found the Dragon's Power. Be wise and compassionate in how you use that power lest you become it's slave. Show your discipline and balance your training with the other heavenly virtues as Koji did.
Welcome, please take a look at my weapons. I have very fair prices.
Welcome to Wai Jhou friend. This is a place of rest and spiritual learning.

greetings: Greetings, Lady Dain has asked me to tend to her magic supplies. May I help you?
Ok then, thanks for stopping by. I'll see you later.
It was nice talking with you. Bye now.
Thank you for visiting Lady Dain's Magics and Supplies. I hope you enjoyed your shopping experience with us. Please come again soon. And remember...
Gilly stares skyward for a moment, biting her lip.
Oh right! And remember, at Lady Dain's we know how to spell value.
Ok, that looks magic.
I'll put this over next to the other magic doodads.
This is a very pretty magic thing. I wonder what it does?
Yes, you can buy that.
That is one of my favorites. It fizzles when you smack it against the wall.
Is it lunch time yet?
Common over here! You look like you could use some food and good rest. Well your in luck, we've got plenty of both and no waiting.
Welcome to the Ravenous Mattekar! Sit, sit and I'll get you something hot. What'll you have?
Hello small friend. This is my place. What do you think? It's a touch of home out here in the Dires.
Candeth Keep is no Linvak Tukal, but it's beautiful in a wide open kind of way.
If you need to rest there are some cheap and clean beds for rent upstairs.
Come on back when you need a break from the daily smash and kill.
Thank you for coming to the Ravenous Mattekar! We also host events in case you get tired of cleaning up your Allegiance or Meeting Halls.
Did you enjoy yourself? If you have any suggestions just carve 'em into the tables and I'll see what I can do.
I just can't resist a good buy.
This looks good. I'll take the whole lot.
I don't just buy any slop and drink for my place. You bring me more like this and I'll pay you the same.
Ha, you can't fool me human. I buy this at half that price from Dojiro. Here take this, it's more than it's worth, but I like your salesmanship.
I think you might enjoy this. It's a human recipe, but I added a few lugian touches to it. It'll take the hair off your chest, if you have any.
Tell You just give me a shout if you want anything else. Oh, and no fighting inside I keep a clean Inn and I want to keep it that way.
Enjoy your purchase.
Oh, Ha Ha, I didn't shortchange you. Think you're so bloody clever. I've heard them all pal.
Judge me by my size, do you? After you finish with that why don't we test your strength? I'll arm wrestle you for your lunch.
I used to feed this stuff to my pet mattekar, but you humans seem to like it even more than he did.
I'm a bit short tempered when it comes to my height if you know what I mean. Look I don't make twig-man jokes about you humans.
Greetings, looking for the bow, the arrow or both?
Welcome to Shot in Arm. I sell good sturdy equipment and missiles that fly true.
Hello, take a look at my weapons. You have to kill to get a better price... or just get to Tunlok on the tree platform, but I supply him so either way I win.
Welcome to our shop. I shoot them and Oreilauri heals them.
Hope to see you back here. I'm thinking of installing an archery range so that people can test their skills.
Thanks for stopping by. Remember to aim with your tail, oh right, sorry.
Take it from Dereth's greatest archer you've got talent kid.
Make sure your downwind and remember what I told you. Heel to toe, heel to toe that's the way to sneak up on your prey.
Good wood, nice flex, it's a deal.
A bargain, I almost feel a little bad about it...
Ok, bad feelings past.
You want to keep your string at just the right tension. Any more and you will damage the bow and less and you lose power on your shots.
I like your style human. I think I'll try this one out sometime.
Good choice, I use the same type sometimes. Want me to sign it?

You see, I have a distinct advantage over humans when it comes to archery. My tail gives me a steady aim and perfect balance. Not to mention it looks marvelous. I've been thinking about fashioning a fake tail for you unfortunate humans.
There you go. Take it from a master, if you want to hit your target first you have to imagine yourself hitting it, then let go.

That's a good buy. It reminds me of the time I was hunting gromnies and this one launched itself right off a cliff at me. Crazy thing would have killed itself just falling on me if it weren't the dozen arrows it suddenly sprouted from it's chest.
Good to see you. I have some fresh cabbage in today from Xarabydun.
Welcome to my shop. I supply everyone here in town with imported foods. The only thing we don't have to trade for is meat, thanks to Aun Xathurea and his aurochs.
Hello, need some fresh fruit or perhaps some cooking supplies?
What can I get for you today?
Goodbye, give the monsters a whack for me.
See you later. I'll see if I can't get more of that stuff you like. I get deliveries every week or so, so stop by.
Every now and then I like to get out and fight the monsters too. Maybe we could go hunting sometime.
It's exciting living out here on the edge of danger. What can I say I'm a thrill seeker.
Good, my stores are getting a bit old and I need all the fresh food I can get.
This is nice to have. We don't get a lot of this out here.
Mmm, this is for dinner tonight.
Sure do need some of that.
Glad you like it. I got that in a trade for some old motes I had lying around.
Eventually I want to have my own garden so that I can sell really fresh produce.
There you go. Thanks to you folk I have a pretty good business starting up here.
I've got lots more of that in my stores. I also can deliver to the Inn if you decide to rent a bed there.
Welcome, my friend. You have helped this town greatly. How may I serve you.
Good casting in the field Town Founder.
Keep your magical skills honed.
Please come again.
Magic isn't just a weapon or tool, it's a calling, you must respect the power and use it wisely before you can attain any real skill.
Yes.
I will buy this.
It will be mine.
You have much that I need.
Use that with care and it will care for you.
Attack only that which you are prepared to fight up close.
Fell your target before it can reach you. This is the way of the mage and the archer.
Can you tell the difference between a powerful mage and a shaman? Hmm.
Welcome! What's your pleasure today?
Thank you for your business. Please return soon.
You drive a hard bargain, my friend.
An excellent purchase.
Welcome! How may I help you?
Thank you, please come again.
This might come in handy.
Good choice.
Oh, it's so nice to have a customer.  I don't get many visitors out this way anymore.
Must you leave so soon?  You just got here!
Well I don't have much, but I can certainly pay you for that.
A wise purchase.  Tell me, how are the townsfolk of Al-Jalima doing these days?

quest: How might I serve you this day?
Excellent choice!
Wonderful! I'm sure to make a fine profit from this!
Have a wonderful day, my kinsman!
Can't say I relish the prospect of doing business with one of the Bloodless, but a good citizen does as the King decrees.
Now take your wares and leave me be!
I'll have to wash this before I sell it.
Leave my sight.

Though your skin be not of the same hue, I have pledged to aid all who ask it of me.
A mighty blue-skinned warrior! When my brother returns from his current mission, I'm sure he'll want to speak with you!
Wonderful choice! With warriors like you, we will soon crush the backs of the Bloodless!
It's amazing how much steel the monsters of Dereth accumulate, is it not?
Remain vigilant, my kinsman. This world will soon be ours.
I do business with you because my King commands it. But know this; if I had his leave, I would gladly roast your heart in my forge.
You'll need that. When the King gives his leave, we will descend upon your kingdom with the might of a thousand warriors!
I'll have to re-forge this one. It reeks.
Go now. But I'd watch my back if I were you.

I thank you.
I wish you well.

I can't afford to pay much for your wares. I hope you will be satisfied with this meager stack of pyreals.

quest: How fare you, my kin?
You will not regret this purchase!
Thank you! I haven't seen one of these in some time!
Thank you for your time!
What do you need from me, cur?
Are you done here? Because I have no desire to spend any more time in your presence than I have to.
What else do you need from me, dog?
Now leave me be.
I had heard that an influx of new arrivals were headed this way. Please take a look at my wares! I'd be happy to do business with a fellow Viamontian!
I can't say I much like the thought of doing business with the Bloodless, but perhaps if I show you a kindness, you will choose to align yourself with our noble King rather than the Bloodless Queen.

greetings: I make the best blades and armor in all of Dereth! And all of them proudly bear the mark of the Stag!
Ah! Excellent choice! You're obviously a person who knows a thing or two about weapons and armor.
This will bring a fair price.
Good luck in your ventures!

quest: Welcome to my shop.
May these serve you well.
This is the best haul yet!
May your aim be straight and true.
Deliveries are around back. What? Oh, you wish to purchase something.
Hurry up then. I can get a bad reputation if I'm seen dealing with your kind.
Sorry if I was rude to you earlier. The KING just decided to raise taxes.
I'll buy this junk this time, but next time I'll have to charge you for dumping this stuff here.
You're leaving town now right?
My books are made from the finest parchment and animal skins. Please take your time and peruse my wares.
Thank you for your purchase.
here did you find this? If you should come across any more bring them to me and I will buy them from you.
Fair tidings to you.
I specialize in the written word. I am sure one as ignorant as yourself has no need of my services.
For a few extra pyreal I can read this to you.
I jest of course. Find someone else to read it to you.
Here's your pyreal, minus the King's tax on foreigners.
Leave the door open on your way out. It just won't do to have this stench in here.
Perhaps that was a bit too circumspect for you. Take a bath before your next visit.

greetings: Come again. Remember all are welcome at my shop.
I assure you that I gave you a fair price for that.
An excellent choice. I must say I outdid myself when I made that piece.
quest: Welcome to my shop. I sell only the finest jewelry.
Welcome!
You may have noticed a slightly cool reception from some of my fellow merchants.
Personally, I don't judge a person by the color of their skin, but rather by the weight of their purse.
All are welcome here as long as you have the pyreal.

greetings: Welcome. Step this way and I shall measure you for a fine set of clothes.
Did you hear? I heard the rebels are secretly recruiting. Of course, you didn't hear that from me.
Wherever did you find this? The quality is superb!
Wonderful! Shall I wrap that for you?
quest: Come and see me again if you should ever need anything. Perhaps a tunic with a Stag of Bellenesse emblazoned on it. Just a thought for next time.
Agonno Filleteppe the Tailor mutters something as you leave.
Dirty Bloodless!

greetings: Ah! A customer! What can I do for you today?
Come again!
Calvinne Sporgenzenni the Shopkeeper leans over and whispers quickly into your ear then turns away as if nothing happened.
Join the Stag of Bellenesse and help us overthrow the King!
Tell I haven't seen one of these in a long time! I'm sure it'll sell right away
Thank you for your purchase. I'll make sure to stock up on those for your next visit.
I am very busy. Can this not wait? No? So be it then! Please hurry.
Now perhaps I can finish my book
I can see why you would want to sell this. Got this off a dead body you say? That would explain the blood stains.
Greetings to you, my friend. If you have come to learn of the new wonders in alchemical versatility, may I recommend you purchase my book, "A Treatise on the Combat Uses of Alchemical Phials."
I may have a use for this...
Good luck to you, my friend. May the wonders of Alchemy serve and protect you.
quest: A wise choice for one so young.
These are not toys to be played with. Are you certain of your choice? I ask only because you have the look of a dullard.

greetings: A harsh land such as this ensures that I have a steady stream of customers. How may I help you?
Thank you for your business. Please return soon.
quest: Excellent choice!
I can always use more of these. Come back if you should happen to find some more.

I must charge you extra for being not of Viamontian birth. You can thank the King for that. There are those who are against this unfairness. Perhaps if you ask around town you can join them. That is if you are so inclined.
By order of the King I must charge you an outsiders tax on these items. I'm sorry. The King has taken to unfairly punishing those who aren't Viamontian.

greetings: You wish to purchase the Oil of Rendering? Please do! It's the only thing I have left!

To purchase items, select an item in the vendor's inventory and click on the 'Buy Item' button. If you want to sell something, drag the item from your inventory onto the vendor's inventory panel, then click the 'Sell Item" Button.
Walk upstairs and visit the Senior Guard. I hear he has a job for you. While you're up there, you may want to pay a visit to the Wordsmith, Shopkeep, and Academy Crier as well.
Use the Oil of Rendering to improve your Training Weapon.Double click the Oil, then click on your weapon.
Excellent choice, my friend!
I know lots of things that happen around here. For the right price I'd be willing to share some of this information.
Enjoy!
What am I going to do with this junk?
I'll do some more digging. Perhaps I'll have some new rumors when next you visit.

Can't say I expected to meet anyone out here in such a remote area. But I'll not turn away a potential customer. Take a look at my wares - such as they are - and let me know if I've aught you wish to purchase!

Thanks for stopping by! Oh, and be careful. The ridge on the eastern side of this canyon is crawling with some rather nasty-looking young men. And the beasts they're traveling with... Fearsome, I say.
I suppose I could find some use for this.
Yeah, you're going to like that. I promise.

quest: Ah, a kinsman. These pathetic Bloodless are poor company.
Would that monk have had prices like mine? I think not!
Ah, very nice. I should be able to get a good price for this.
Come back soon, these barbarians grow tiresome.
I suppose you're looking for that monk, eh? Well, he's not here. Now buy something and leave!
Yes, I'll take your pyreals if you'll kindly take yourself out of my tent.
Ugh. I'd almost rather burn this than sell it.
Begone from here. And tell that jeweler that I'm sick of hearing her weeping!
Welcome. I'd have been terribly disappointed if you'd brought your business to that Bloodless across the way.
It makes me sick to think of how this shop was wasted on its previous occupant. I understand he rots in a cell these days.
You see this, Dorlan? One more piece that's in my inventory and not yours!
If you make it back to Sanamar, tell them that business is booming.
How fascinating, even a Bloodless can acknowledge the superior quality of my work.
Take it and leave, before the guards drag you off as they did the poor fool who used to reside here!
Yes. Fine. Are we done?
Go and run, run crying to your false Queen.

greetings: Hello, human! Angry Grandfather told me to help people, so I sell healing things.
Good day, human. Tell Angry Grandfather that Hargurg does a good job!
Hargurg thanks you! Enjoy your pile of metal things!
Hargurg hopes that helps you find Angry Grandfather!
I buy and sells lots of things, like Angry Grandfather told me to.
Good luck, human!
I am sure that will come in handy for us somehow.
Sold! Soon Huldurg will have a bigger pile of pyreal things than anyone else!
Bulidurg has many pretty things for hurting...
Have fun killing things!
Bulidurg can use that. Thank you, human.
You get good use out of that.
I am the keeper of the sacred fire-water! What would you like?
Live well and drink well, human!
Guzglurg will take that.
Okay! Don't spill it!
Hello, what can I do for you?
Shoot straight, friend. Preferably at a Viamontian Knight.
You drive a hard bargain, my friend.
An excellent purchase.

Greetings, the Arcanum has arranged for me to remain in this burnt husk of a town in order to provide a faster means of travel for the people keeping the Harbinger under control. I don't know what I did wrong to get assigned here. Oh well, did you need anything?
Don't forget to do your part in preventing the Harbinger from destroying this great land and please come again soon.
As you wish.
Thank you. All sales are final. Any problems that you may have with our products should be directed to the Arcanum's Magical Rites and Incantations Department.

Welcome to my shop, here on lovely, fragrant Bur! I operate a duly enfranchised branch of Ketnan's Trading Enterprises and I am teaching our scaly friends here on Bur about the fine points of mercantilism.
Happy adventuring! Remember to come to Ketnan's for all your trading needs!
Sure, I'll buy that from you. I may as well be cutting my own throat, giving you such a good price, but we at Ketnan's Trading Enterprises are altruistic, as well as keen traders.
This will make a fine addition to my shop.
Thank you.
Good choice, and an excellent value, what with all the trouble we go through to import our stock from Dereth.
Have you come to trade with me? How exciting! I am still learning, but counting out the shiny coins is fun.
Come back to trade with me again soon, friend human!
And now I give you pyreals and take that from you... This is exciting! I enjoy commerce!
Yes! I will sell you that now! Oh, what a nice pile of shiny pyreal you have given me.
It has been many centuries since I have practiced my craft. I will create items for the living, but only for the ancient coins of my lord's house.
I have forged those ghostly items for the living.
The years have stolen memory and skill from me. Choose wisely, for I may create different items in times to come.
You found my sanctum from the daylight. Here I make spectral weapons from the ingots the Forge Golem makes. Bring me a Spectral Ingot and I will sell you one.
Greetings. I have been sent here by the Arcanum to observe what we can about this place. I have also been empowered to sell materials to intrepid adventurers in the area.
A fine choice. Good luck.
I hope my provisions are useful.
Welcome Traveler! I have many wondrous items from the farthest shores and deepest dungeons. Only the best for my patrons. All I require is proof of your heroic deeds. Do you have any Hero Tokens?
A most excellent choice Hero. May it serve you well.
Return with more stories of your adventures my friend. I am sure to have more fantastic items in the future.
Welcome, do you have Small Olthoi Venom sacs to trade with me? I have many things to offer you if you do.
Thank you. I hope your purchase serves you well.
Thank you again for bartering with me. The Arcanum will make good use of these venom sacs in our studies of these strange Olthoi.
Welcome gladiator, perhaps you have won some of Colosseum Coins? I have a number of interesting items you can exchange Colosseum Coins for.
Enjoy your spoils gladiator and return when you have more coins.
Enjoy your time in the Colosseum!
Greetings, friend. If you have a Writ of Apology, I can exchange one of my items for it.
Pleasant journeys to you!
We sincerely apologize for your difficulties, and hope you enjoy your future in Dereth. Bring this order to one of the royal guards stationed here, in Holtburg, in Shoushi, or in Yaraq.
Greetings!
Safe travels to you, come again!
I hope your purchase serves you well.
I'm sure I can find a good home for this..

Here's what you requested.
I've been looking for one of these!
Good hunting to you out there.
